title: Chunk route#29: "WGSL compute aggregation + 10k spans/sec budget — compute shaders for time-series aggregation, frame_duration_ms metric event, reduced-motion respect"

data.head: ### Chunk route#29: "WGSL compute aggregation + 10k spans/sec budget — compute shaders for time-series aggregation, frame_duration_ms metric event, reduced-motion respect"

body: **Constraints across domains:**

- (security) New `telemetry.frontend.record_frame_ms` TauRPC procedure MUST have BOTH router registration in `ui-bridge` AND a corresponding entry in `pulse-app/capabilities/` JSON before merge — Tauri capabilities are negative-default; missing entry = silent runtime rejection (per security plan §API Security TauRPC capability authorization + Anti-Patterns API row 1).

- (security) `record_frame_ms` argument struct MUST go through `serde` deserialization on every field — `f64`/`u32`/smart enums for `wgpu_backend`/`webview_backend`/`timing_method` (no free-form `String`); rejection returns `AppError::Validation { field, reason }` (per security plan §Input Validation row 3 TauRPC bridge boundary).

- (security) The `f64` `duration_ms` value crossing the bridge MUST be range-bounded (`0.0 ≤ duration_ms ≤ 60_000.0`, NaN/Inf rejected) BEFORE recording into the AllowList — webview JS numerics are untrusted at the IPC trust boundary (per security plan §Input Validation row 3 + §Logging redaction discipline line 340).

- (security) The `metric.webgpu.frame_duration_ms` AllowList entry pre-staged at chunk #28 has bounded fields `[duration_ms, wgpu_backend, webview_backend, timing_method]`; resolver MUST NOT add fields surfacing OTLP attribute values, raw browser error messages, or webview Channel payload bytes (per security plan §Logging & Monitoring NEVER-log list rows 1+6).

- (security) WGSL compute shaders read from `GPUBuffer`s mapped from broadcast-fan-out Arrow IPC payloads; producer-side 8 MB size cap on `Channel::send` per arch §Standard Contracts Real-time push remains load-bearing for compute pipeline ingest. Compute pass MUST NOT loop unbounded over buffer extent without an upstream span-count check (per security plan §Input Validation row 8).

- (security) `requestWebGPUAdapter()` failure-reason discriminator pattern from chunk #28 MUST be preserved when extending to compute-pipeline initialization — sanitized allowlist tags only (e.g., `'compute pipeline creation failed'`), NEVER raw `GPUError.message` or shader compile error strings (per security plan §Anti-Patterns Logging row 4 + §Error Handling sanitization rule).

- (design) WGSL fragment / compute shaders MUST source design-token colors as uniforms read from CSSOM at canvas-init; aggregated outputs MUST NOT inline RGB literals — only structural numeric literals (clear color, position output) permitted in shader source (per design-system §Color Palette + chunk #28 session-learnings WGSL color-uniform discipline).

- (design) Compute aggregation results that drive Halo State Pulse rhythm MUST clamp `throughput_hz / 1000` to 0.8–2.4 Hz BEFORE pulse-cycle emission, and color interpolation MUST traverse the LCH path between `--color-primary` (#4A90E2) ↔ `--color-accent` (#C7556A) (per design-system §Brand Identity signature element + §Downstream Readiness obs hook directive).

- (design) Frame-loop instrumentation feeding `frame_duration_ms` MUST respect `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`: Halo State Pulse degrades to static glow (rhythm suppressed; LCH hue still updates per error rate); chrome transitions become instant (per design-system §Motion Accessibility + §Anti-Patterns hard-limit row "NO canvas/WebGL except dedicated Halo State Pulse layer").

- (design) Compute-shader pipeline ownership stays inside the WebGPU canvas layer; results MUST NOT escape into React's render tree as per-frame state (per design-system §Surface: desktop-webview Performance notes — "Charts are rendered directly to canvas, NOT inside React's render tree — Arrow data is pushed into canvas via WebGPU compute shader, side-stepping VDOM diffing cost").

- (design) Frame budget under sustained 10k spans/sec ingest MUST NOT introduce decorative motion to compensate for visible aggregation latency; only state-confirming motion within 150–200ms chrome budget permitted (per design-system §Motion Hard limits + §Anti-Patterns Universal Bans).

- (design) WebGPU adapter unavailability fallback message MUST remain "WebGPU not supported in this browser" verbatim (per design-system §Surface: desktop-webview Component Patterns Canvas Container).

- (layouts) WGSL compute shader work MUST execute inside the canvas region already specified by `<CanvasContainer>` (chunk #28); compute pipelines do NOT introduce a new surface region — they sit behind the same `<canvas>` already placed in compact widget hero, full dashboard hero, and tray overlay (per layout-templates §Component — Halo State Pulse canvas + §Signature placement enumeration).

- (layouts) Frame-loop reduced-motion gate MUST be wired identically across all three Halo State Pulse canvas placements (compact widget unified halo, full dashboard per-service halos, tray icon halo overlay). Behavior contract: halo becomes static glow, hue still updates per error rate, no pulsing rhythm (per layout-templates §Component — Halo State Pulse canvas "Reduced motion" + §Surface: desktop-native §Component — Tray icon "Reduced motion").

- (layouts) The frame metric event (`telemetry.frontend.record_frame_ms`) is a back-channel IPC binding from inside the canvas region; does NOT surface as a visible UI element (no observability widget / status bar entry / menu item is specified for raw frame timings) (per layout-templates §Component — Footer enumerates ingest rate / error % / retention only).

- (tests) Performance test MUST inject 10,000 spans/sec sustained for ≥10s (100k total) and assert buffer ingests all without dropping; ring buffer memory must stay bounded within retention window (per test-plan §1 Coverage triggers `performance-budget: WebGPU canvas throughput`).

- (tests) Frame-rate validation (≥30 fps p50 / ≥25 fps p95 / ≥20 fps p99 at sustained 10k spans/sec) is OUT OF SCOPE for the agent-driven harness and MUST be deferred to the `tauri-driver` headful E2E suite — agent-driven assertions stop at IPC contract + WebGPU compile success + frame_duration_ms metric event emission (per test-plan §1 + §10 perf budget + §6 P5 trade-off + §11 Universal "NEVER include human reviews canvas").

- (tests) Webview unit tests for compute-pipeline factory functions MUST live co-located as `pulse-app/ui/src/canvas/*.test.ts` and be run by `vitest` 3.x with `jsdom` 26 + `@testing-library/react` 16 (per test-plan §4 webview Framework row).

- (tests) Performance / chaos tests at 10k spans/sec MUST use `proptest` 1.10.0 with seeded deterministic generators + regression files under `proptest-regressions/` AND/OR `tokio::time::pause()` for retention-window determinism — never real `std::time::Instant::now()` (per test-plan §7 Seed strategies + §11 Universal "NEVER use real time").
- (tests) Test runtime MUST be deterministic — zero-flakiness budget is hard: any flake → quarantine + root-cause; no retry-once policy (per test-plan §10 Zero-flakiness budget + §11 Quality).

- (tests) frame_duration_ms metric event tests MUST verify both production code path (TauRPC resolver fires with bounded fields) AND grep-able presence in `agent-latest.jsonl`; test must NOT assert raw OTLP-attribute-shaped payloads (per test-plan §11 Integration ban transposed to AllowList shape).

- (tests) 5-command harness MUST stay green for chunk #29 — `boot`/`status`/`cleanup` exercised by every E2E test must continue to return `health.subsystems.buffer.rows_ingested >= N` after the 10k spans/sec injection (per test-plan §3 Test Harness Contract).

- (obs) Backend resolver for `telemetry.frontend.record_frame_ms` MUST emit `tracing::info!(target: "metric.webgpu.frame_duration_ms", duration_ms = N, wgpu_backend = ..., webview_backend = ..., timing_method = ..., ...)` per the metric event convention with `metric.{module}.{measure}` prefix (per obs-plan §5 Metric emission convention).

- (obs) Label cardinality on the WebGPU frame metric MUST stay enumerated: `wgpu_backend ∈ {vulkan, metal, dx12}`, `webview_backend ∈ {WebView2, WKWebView, GTKWebKit}`, `timing_method ∈ {cpu, gpu}`. NO per-frame-id, per-trace-id, or unbounded labels (per obs-plan §5 Metric label cardinality discipline + §11 Metrics anti-pattern row 1).

- (obs) Frontend MUST bridge frame timing through TauRPC `telemetry.frontend.record_frame_ms(duration_ms, wgpu_backend, webview_backend, timing_method)` — NO browser OTel SDK linked into the webview; the single JSON log file at `~/.andromeda-pulse/logs/agent-latest.jsonl` is the unified self-observation surface (per obs-plan §1 desktop-webview surface row + §3 Logging stack Frontend bridge + §12 Decisions Log Frontend instrumentation).

- (obs) The `metric.webgpu.frame_duration_ms` event MUST emit at appropriate level; high-frequency emissions MUST be level-gated (`if tracing::enabled!(Level::INFO) { ... }`) to avoid hot-path payload formatting cost (per obs-plan §11 Metrics anti-pattern row 2 "NEVER format expensive `tracing` event payloads inside hot paths without level-gating").

- (obs) Compute-shader aggregation paths (the inner per-row WGSL reduction) MUST NOT emit per-iteration spans/logs; instrumentation belongs at the surrounding render/dispatch boundary only (per obs-plan §11 Telemetry Strategy row 1 + §11 Logs anti-pattern).

- (obs) Compute aggregation events MUST inherit trace context from the surrounding TauRPC handler span via `tracing::Span::current()`; if explicit child span added (e.g., `webgpu.compute.aggregate`), MUST use `.in_current_span()` across `.await` boundaries (per obs-plan §3 Trace context propagation + §11 Spans/Traces anti-pattern row 4).

- (a11y) Compute aggregation frame loop MUST respect `window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches` — under reduce, continuous aggregation cadence MUST degrade (no per-frame compute dispatch driving visual change); state still conveyed via color + text + focus ring per "motion-as-data" exception (per a11y-plan §11 Motion row 4 + §11 Visual row 3 + §9 Motion tokens verification).

- (a11y) WGSL pulse / aggregation cadence MUST NOT flash content > 3 times per second — SC 2.3.1 Three Flashes (A); compute shader update rate driving visual change must stay within design-system motion-token cadences (per a11y-plan §11 Motion row 2 + §6 Motion tokens WCAG SC).

- (a11y) Motion MUST NOT be the ONLY signal for state — under reduced-motion override, the same data conveyed via the compute pipeline must remain available via static color / text / focus indicators (per a11y-plan §11 Motion row 3).

- (a11y) The existing `<region aria-label="Telemetry visualization canvas">` semantic wrapper around the WebGPU canvas (chunk #28) MUST be preserved — canvas itself has no built-in semantics; wrapper provides SR context (per a11y-plan §1 WebGPU canvas row + §7 Landmark roles row 5).
- (a11y) Lighthouse a11y category score MUST stay ≥ 90 on every desktop-webview URL touched by the compute pipeline (per a11y-plan §10 Build/deploy failure conditions row 2).

- (a11y) A11y CI gate MUST fail on any new WCAG AA violation introduced vs base branch — zero-new-violations-per-PR invariant; no retry-once policy for a11y flakes (per a11y-plan §10 Standard+ invariants + §11 SLO row 1).

- (arch) Visualization stays in the webview WebGPU substrate (`<canvas>` + `navigator.gpu`, WGSL) — no native `wgpu` 25+ Rust render surface introduced for chunk #29; native is the documented post-v1 upgrade path for compact widget only when browser GC jank becomes measured problem (per arch §Established Decisions [WebGPU Visualization Surface]).

- (arch) The `telemetry.frontend.record_frame_ms` TauRPC procedure MUST follow the `<router>.<verb>` dotted-namespace shape with `snake_case` segments; router (`telemetry`) and verb (`record_frame_ms`) each `snake_case` (per arch §Conventions Endpoint naming + §Inherited Defaults API style).

- (arch) Procedure MUST return `Result<T, AppError>` where `AppError` is the `serde`-friendly enum (`Validation`, `NotFound`, `Internal`, `Plugin`, `Storage`, `Ingest`); module-internal `thiserror` errors convert at the bridge via `From` impls (per arch §Conventions Error response schema).

- (arch) Any payload type carrying `duration_ms` / `wgpu_backend` / `webview_backend` / `timing_method` across the TauRPC bridge MUST be `serde::Serialize` — enforced at compile time by TauRPC derive macros (per arch §Cross-cutting Patterns Cross-bridge data shape).

- (arch) Live span input feeding WGSL compute aggregation MUST consume the existing `pulse://stream/spans` Tauri Channel API binary Arrow IPC payloads — no SSE/WebSocket, no JSON-stringify path, no new event name (per arch §Standard Contracts Real-time push contract + §Occupied Resources Tauri IPC events).

- (arch) Compute shader code (WGSL) lives in `pulse-app/ui/`; Rust resolver code for `telemetry.frontend.record_frame_ms` lives in `ui-bridge` crate (per arch §Conventions Workspace API style + §Project directory structure).
- (arch) Default features stay minimal — chunk #29 introduces no new Cargo `--features` flag; any flag would be `kebab-case` and off by default (per arch §Conventions Feature flags).

- (arch) Module dependency direction: `ui-bridge` crate hosting the new resolver MUST NOT depend on `pulse-app` binary; the dependency graph is a DAG with `pulse-app` as the only root (per arch §Cross-cutting Patterns Module dependency direction).

- (arch) No new env var introduced for chunk #29 — reserved `ANDROMEDA_PULSE_*` namespace stays as enumerated; spans-per-second budget knob inherits `ANDROMEDA_PULSE_RETENTION_SECONDS` semantics or is hard-coded (per arch §Occupied Resources Environment variables).
**Patterns to follow:**

- (security) TauRPC introspection-envelope shape: `telemetry.frontend.record_frame_ms` follows the dotted-namespace pattern per Conventions Endpoint naming Shape (b) `<router>.<verb>`. Mirror chunk #25/#27 capability JSON entry shape (per security plan §API Security).

- (security) AllowList per-leaf-entry discipline established chunk #26 + reaffirmed chunk #28: each metric/log target gets its own `AllowList` entry; resolver writes via existing `metric.webgpu.frame_duration_ms` entry — NEVER add wildcards or merge with sibling entries (per security plan §Logging & Monitoring).

- (security) Sanitized tagged-union fallback pattern from chunk #28's `requestWebGPUAdapter()`: `{kind: 'available', ...} | {kind: 'unavailable', reason: <allowlist-discriminator>}`. Compute-pipeline initialization mirrors this discriminant (per security plan §Anti-Patterns Logging row 4 + chunk #28 precedent).

- (security) `AppError` From-impl matrix at the `ui-bridge` boundary (chunk #26): resolver's failure modes collapse to existing `AppError::Validation` and `AppError::Internal` variants with sanitized one-liner — no stack traces / library versions / Rust struct names (per security plan §Error Handling §External responses).

- (design) Halo State Pulse data-driven motion as canonical exemption pattern: data-driven canvas motion at 0.8–2.4 Hz lives outside chrome expression budget (per design-system §Motion High-impact moments).

- (design) CSSOM → uniform color binding pattern from chunk #28 substrate: at canvas-init, read `--color-primary`/`--color-accent`/`--color-base`/`--color-inset` via `getComputedStyle`, parse, pass to compute/fragment uniform buffers (per design-system §Surface: desktop-webview Tokens + chunk #28 session-learnings).

- (design) Canvas Container chrome (`#0F1117` Inset background, full container width/height) as parent for any compute-driven visualization region; aggregated time-series renders inside the same `<section role="region">` semantic wrapper from chunk #28 (per design-system §Component Patterns Canvas Container).

- (design) Reduced-motion branch at frame-loop / pulse-emission boundary: gate fires once per `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` query change; switches Halo from data-driven rhythm to static-glow + hue-only updates; compute aggregation itself continues unchanged (per design-system §Motion Accessibility).

- (design) Performance-budget pattern: rendering directly to canvas from compute-shader output side-steps VDOM diffing for high-frequency telemetry (per design-system §Surface: desktop-webview Performance notes).

- (layouts) Existing canvas placement pattern from chunk #28: single `<CanvasContainer>` element wraps the WebGPU `<canvas>` with prescribed token-based chrome + `aria-label` slot — compute pipeline mounts on same `GPUDevice` already returned by `requestWebGPUAdapter()`, no new container hierarchy needed (per layout-templates §Component — Halo State Pulse canvas).

- (layouts) Reduced-motion graceful-degradation pattern from chunk #28's adapter detection: same tagged-union discriminator discipline applies — frame-loop gate driven by `useReducedMotion()` hook returns enumerated states (`'animated'` / `'static-glow'`); static-glow path keeps hue updates bound to error-rate data and disables only pulse rhythm (per layout-templates §Component — Halo State Pulse canvas).

- (tests) 10k spans/sec injection via custom Rust load-driver (no external k6/vegeta) — `tonic` 0.14.5 native gRPC client driving loopback `:4317`, `MockTraceSpan::builder()` factories, `cargo nextest run --workspace --profile ci --filter-expr 'e2e'` for matrix execution (per test-plan §1 Surfaces + §6 Drivers per surface).
- (tests) Vitest unit tests for `pulse-app/ui/src/canvas/` modules — co-located `*.test.ts`, `vitest.config.mjs` at `pulse-app/ui/vitest.config.mjs` (chunk #28 precedent).

- (tests) `tokio::time::pause()` + `tokio::time::advance(Duration::from_secs(700))` for retention window edge cases triggered by sustained ingest crossing 5–10 min boundary (per test-plan §8 Time mocking).

- (tests) Ingest-then-poll pattern: drive synthetic OTLP via `tonic` client, then poll `health` TauRPC for `subsystems.buffer.rows_ingested` increment within 5s timeout (per test-plan §6 P1 verification signal).

- (tests) Reduced-motion gating tests follow chunk #28 precedent — Vitest jsdom `matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)')` stub + assert compute-aggregation frame loop early-returns or reduces work when reduced-motion is set (chunk #28 wired the `useReducedMotion` gate).

- (tests) AllowList event presence test mirrors chunk #26/#28 per-leaf-entry discipline — add `allowlist_for_target_resolves_metric_webgpu_frame_duration_ms_resolver` style test in `pulse-app/src/observability.rs`.

- (obs) Frontend frame-time bridge pattern: DOM `performance.now()` + `device.queue.onSubmittedWorkDone()` measured in webview JS → TauRPC `telemetry.frontend.record_frame_ms` command on `ui-bridge` → backend `tracing::info!(target: "metric.webgpu.frame_duration_ms", ...)` event in shared JSON sink (per obs-plan §1 telemetry surfaces table desktop-webview row + §3 Logging stack).

- (obs) Metric event convention: `tracing::info!(target: "metric.{module}.{measure}", value = N, ...)` events (no OTel Meter / Histogram / Counter); agent computes p50/p95/p99 by tailing `agent-latest.jsonl` with `jq` post-test (per obs-plan §5 emission convention).

- (obs) Per-frame instrumentation pattern: emit ONE event per frame from frontend with the four enumerated labels; backend resolver attaches `service.name` / `service.version` / `deployment.environment` automatically as default subscriber fields (per obs-plan §3 Service identity).

- (obs) SLO assertion via `jq` aggregation over runtime events: `jq '. | select(.target == "metric.webgpu.frame_duration_ms") | .fields.duration_ms' agent-latest.jsonl | sort -n` then quantile 0.99 ≤ 33; identical aggregation shape used by other perf-budget-instruments triggers (per obs-plan §10 SLO budgets row 2 + CI gate row 4).

- (obs) Allowlist-extension pattern from chunk #28 substrate: AllowList entry for `metric.webgpu.frame_duration_ms` already exists at `pulse-app/src/observability.rs` (after line 668) with bounded fields; resolver wiring inherits without re-architecting (per obs-plan §8 PII Scrubbing Default-deny posture).

- (a11y) Reduced-motion gating uses `useReducedMotion` hook from `motion/react` 12.x in canvas frame loop (chunk #28 wired this for the substrate; chunk #29 extends to compute dispatch cadence): when hook returns `true`, suspend continuous compute-driven animation while preserving final aggregated visual state (per a11y-plan §3.5 motion-tokens-respect-install + §11 Motion row 4).

- (a11y) Tailwind v4 `motion-reduce:` variant on any CSS-driven motion paired with the canvas — `motion-reduce:duration-0` collapses to instant (per a11y-plan §3.5 motion-tokens-respect-install + §11 Visual row 3).

- (a11y) Reduced-motion verification via Playwright `page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: 'reduce' })` asserting computed `transition-duration: 0s` AND state still conveyed via non-motion channel (per a11y-plan §6 Motion tokens Verification).

- (a11y) Frame-duration metric event emission discipline: any new performance signal surfaced visibly in DOM uses `aria-live="polite"`; no `aria-live="assertive"` on routine perf metrics (per a11y-plan §7 Live regions table row 1).

- (a11y) WebGPU canvas SR test: per-surface SR pass spec verifies the `<region aria-label="...">` wrapper announces correctly under NVDA/VoiceOver/Orca even with compute pipeline running (per a11y-plan §3 Screen reader test pattern step 9).

- (arch) Tauri 2 IPC `Channel` API with binary Arrow IPC payloads for live span/metric streams (event names `pulse://stream/spans` / `pulse://stream/metrics` / `pulse://stream/logs`) — chunk #29 compute aggregation consumes existing channels, does not add new event names (per arch §Standard Contracts Real-time push contract).

- (arch) TauRPC router-per-crate template: each crate exposes a public contract module with `pub` surface, `pub(crate)` internals, `thiserror`-derived error enum, optional TauRPC-router module (per arch §Project Intent Template patterns + §Conventions Module visibility discipline).

- (arch) Self-observation discipline: frame duration captured for self-telemetry goes through `tracing` ecosystem only — `tracing-subscriber` JSON formatter to `~/.andromeda-pulse/logs/agent-latest.jsonl`. NEVER instrument with OTLP network exporter pointed at own ports (per arch §Cross-cutting Patterns Self-observation discipline).

- (arch) Webview WebGPU pattern: WGSL shaders run unchanged across WebView2 (Windows) and WKWebView (macOS); IPC pushes Arrow data into the canvas — chunk #29 extends chunk #28 substrate with compute shaders alongside existing 3 render pipelines (per arch §Stack Visualization surface row).
**Anti-patterns to avoid:**

- (security) NEVER add the `record_frame_ms` procedure to the TauRPC router without the matching `pulse-app/capabilities/` JSON entry — silent runtime rejection (per security plan §Anti-Patterns API row 1). D3 streams.* drift is the live counter-example.

- (security) NEVER log the raw `wgpu_backend` / `webview_backend` strings before bounding them to a fixed enum — they originate from `GPUAdapterInfo` exposed to webview JS (untrusted at IPC trust boundary); unbounded backend string field invites cardinality explosion + log injection (per security plan §Logging Anti-Patterns row 3).

- (security) NEVER bypass the existing 8 MB Arrow IPC payload size cap on the broadcast fan-out fed into compute-shader buffers (per security plan §Input Validation row 8 + Anti-Patterns Input row 6).

- (design) NEVER inline RGB/hex literals in WGSL fragment or compute shader sources for design-token-derived colors. Structural literals like `vec4<f32>(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0)` permitted; tinted values MUST flow as uniforms (per design-system §Color Palette + chunk #28 session-learnings WGSL color-uniform discipline).

- (design) NEVER add canvas/WebGL motion outside the dedicated Halo State Pulse layer, even for "debug" or "loading" visualizations of the compute-aggregation pipeline. Skeleton states use existing pulse pattern (per design-system §Anti-Patterns Universal Bans + §Motion Hard limits).

- (design) NEVER let frame-budget pressure justify bounce/spring/staggered/scroll-driven motion in chrome compensation. Chrome easing remains ease-out / ease-in-out at 150–200ms regardless of compute-pipeline frame timing (per design-system §Motion Easing).

- (layouts) Do NOT introduce a visible frame-rate / frame-ms / fps counter overlay or footer entry — frame metric is back-channel IPC, not a wireframe-visible affordance (per layout-templates §Component — Footer enumerates ingest rate / error % / retention only).

- (layouts) Do NOT regress the reduced-motion contract by gating hue updates on the same flag as pulse rhythm — hue MUST continue updating per error rate even when motion is reduced; only pulse rhythm degrades to static glow (per layout-templates §Component — Halo State Pulse canvas).

- (tests) NEVER include "human reviews canvas" / "did you see jank?" / pixel-comparison checks in agent-driven tests — canvas compilation success + frame_duration_ms metric event emission is sufficient at Standard tier (per test-plan §11 Universal + agent-driven-discipline trigger §1).

- (tests) NEVER use `sleep(N)` for the 10s sustained-ingest window — wait for explicit signal via `health` polling or `pulse://stream/spans` Channel events; use `tokio::time::pause()` + `advance()` for retention assertions (per test-plan §11 E2E + Universal).

- (tests) NEVER lower the 75% line / 70% branch / 85% function coverage threshold to absorb uncovered compute-shader factory branches — extract testable pure functions; mock the GPUDevice surface (per test-plan §11 CI + §10 Coverage thresholds).
- (tests) NEVER add a retry-once policy to mask 10k-spans/sec flakes — flake = real bug = quarantine + root-cause (per test-plan §11 Quality + zero-flakiness rationale §10).

- (obs) NEVER emit `metric.webgpu.frame_duration_ms` events with unbounded labels (per-frame-id / per-trace-id / arbitrary backend strings) — explodes JSON line size + breaks `jq` aggregation cost (per obs-plan §11 Metrics row 1 + §5 cardinality discipline).

- (obs) NEVER add OTel SDK / OTel Meter / OpenTelemetry browser instrumentation to the webview to capture WebGPU frame timing — `tracing` ecosystem + TauRPC bridge IS the design (per obs-plan §11 Universal anti-pattern row 4 + §12 Decisions Log 2026-05-02 user pivot).

- (obs) NEVER instrument inside the WGSL compute shader inner reduction loop or per-row dispatch — span overhead matters at 10k spans/sec; instrument at surrounding render-tick boundary only (per obs-plan §11 Telemetry Strategy row 1 + §11 Logs row 4).

- (obs) NEVER skip p99 coverage on the WebGPU frame budget — emit raw per-event `duration_ms` field, do NOT precompute quantiles in the emission path; agent-side `jq` aggregation is the convention (per obs-plan §11 Metrics row 3 + §10 budget row 2).

- (a11y) NEVER drive a continuous canvas frame loop without checking `window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches` — SC 2.3.3 AAA violation; vanilla canvas loops require manual check even when `useReducedMotion` covers React surrounding chrome (per a11y-plan §11 Motion row 4).
- (a11y) NEVER flash compute-driven visual updates more than 3 times per second — SC 2.3.1 A seizure risk (per a11y-plan §11 Motion row 2).

- (a11y) NEVER emit a `frame_duration_ms`-derived UI signal (perf overlay, throttle warning, frame-loss banner) using motion or color alone — must include text label/icon supplement under SC 1.4.1 (per a11y-plan §11 Visual row 1).

- (arch) Do NOT introduce a native `wgpu` 25+ Rust render surface for chunk #29 — locked decision is webview WebGPU for v1; native is documented post-v1 upgrade path for compact widget only (per arch §Established Decisions [WebGPU Visualization Surface] hybrid Option C).

- (arch) Do NOT bypass the TauRPC bridge for frame-duration emission (no raw `tauri::command`, no manual TS re-declaration, no custom JSON envelope) (per arch §Established Decisions [Tauri IPC Bridge — Surface 2]).

- (arch) Do NOT add a new `pulse://stream/<name>` event for compute aggregation output — reserved event set is closed; adding requires `/andromeda-scope-arch` (per arch §Occupied Resources Tauri IPC events).

- (arch) Do NOT skip the `pulse-app/capabilities/` JSON entry when registering the new `telemetry.frontend.record_frame_ms` TauRPC procedure — same negative-default trust model that already produced D3 streams.* drift (per arch §Cross-cutting Patterns Webview IPC capability policy).
**Contract bindings:**

- **security ↔ obs**: chunk #29's `metric.webgpu.frame_duration_ms` AllowList field schema owned by obs (PII Vector 6 — bounded-field discipline). Security side: ensure no field widening in resolver write site that introduces `error_message`/`gpu_error_detail`/raw shader source. Obs side owns per-event field schema.

- **security ↔ tests**: chunk #28 added `csp.test.ts` as a CSP regression invariant; chunk #29's TauRPC procedure addition MUST be covered by an equivalent `xtask capability-drift` regression test that fails CI when `record_frame_ms` lacks a capabilities JSON entry. Existing chunk #27 capability-drift test infrastructure extends — no new harness.

- **security ↔ arch**: chunk #29 introduces NEW IPC method shape (`telemetry.frontend.*`) NOT in arch §Occupied Resources today. Either compounds the active `streams.*` D3 drift category OR requires `/andromeda-scope-arch` to add `telemetry.*` namespace before merge. Capability JSON entry MUST land in chunk #29 regardless (capability-drift gate is independent of arch documentation status).

- **design ↔ a11y**: `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` reduced-motion gate at frame-loop / pulse-emission boundary is the design-side enforcement of WCAG SC 2.3.3 (a11y SC). Halo State Pulse rhythm suppression + LCH hue-only updates is design-supplied degradation; a11y owns assertion that gate fires correctly via media-query test fixtures.

- **design ↔ tests**: Motion lint targets — durations 150ms / 200ms / 250ms / 350ms; easing names; 7 hard-limit bans. Compute-aggregation chunk introduces no new motion tokens; tests assert no regressions in existing token set.

data.head: # Phase 26 Plan — chunk route#29: "WGSL compute aggregation + 10k spans/sec budget"

body: _Generated by /andromeda-phase Phase 4. Read by /andromeda-implement._
- **Phase number:** 26

- **Route chunks covered:**
  - route#29 "WGSL compute aggregation + 10k spans/sec budget — compute shaders for time-series aggregation, frame_duration_ms metric event, reduced-motion respect"
- **Epoch:** Epoch 5 — Visualization surfaces (second chunk)

Wire chunk #28's WebGPU canvas substrate into the per-frame timing pipeline by (a) introducing a WGSL compute shader for time-series aggregation alongside the 3 existing render pipelines, (b) standing up a new `TelemetryApi` TauRPC router with the `record_frame_ms` resolver that emits `tracing::info!(target: "metric.webgpu.frame_duration_ms", ...)` against the AllowList entry pre-staged at chunk #28 (`pulse-app/src/observability.rs:671+`, fields `[duration_ms, wgpu_backend, webview_backend, timing_method]`), and (c) replacing the explicit `TODO(chunk #29)` markers in `pulse-app/ui/src/canvas/{frame-loop.ts:13-18, CanvasContainer.tsx:71-87}` with the actual frame-timing capture (`performance.now()` + `device.queue.onSubmittedWorkDone()` → TauRPC bridge → backend tracing event). Reduced-motion respect (the chunk title's third axis) extends chunk #28's `useReducedMotion` substrate gate into the compute-dispatch cadence: under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, continuous compute aggregation cadence degrades while LCH hue interpolation continues per error rate (per design-system §Motion Accessibility + a11y-plan §11 SC 2.3.3 AAA). The 10k spans/sec budget is enforced via the `tonic` 0.14.5 native gRPC injection harness from chunks #18/#20 (10,000 spans/sec for 10s sustained → `health.subsystems.buffer.rows_ingested ≥ 100,000` + p99 `duration_ms ≤ 33ms` via `jq` aggregation per obs-plan §10 SLO budgets row 2).

This chunk is substrate-only for the metric resolver + compute pipeline shape; data binding (real spans → compute aggregation → render) lands at chunks #34/#35; per-surface dimensions land at chunks #30/#33/#36; the Halo State Pulse signature shader lands at chunk #31. The new `telemetry.frontend.record_frame_ms` TauRPC procedure introduces a `telemetry.*` namespace not yet listed in arch §Occupied Resources Tauri IPC routes — structurally identical to the active D3 `streams.*` drift (chunk #23). **Resolution path requires user decision before /andromeda-implement runs** (see Phase 6 review escalation).

1. **Define the `TelemetryApi` TauRPC trait + impl** in `crates/ui-bridge/src/telemetry.rs` (new module). Use `#[taurpc::procedures(export_to = "ui/src/bindings/index.ts")]` to extend the merged TS bindings file alongside the existing `IntrospectionApi` / TracesApi / MetricsApi / LogsApi / StreamsApi traits (per chunk #25 export_to mechanism + chunk #27 trait pattern from `health.rs:291-298`).

2. **Define `FrameDurationInput` struct** in the new module with `serde::Deserialize` + `specta::Type` (under `taurpc-runtime` feature gate) + smart enum types for `wgpu_backend ∈ {vulkan, metal, dx12}` / `webview_backend ∈ {webview2, wkwebview, gtkwebkit}` / `timing_method ∈ {cpu, gpu}`. `duration_ms: f64` is the only numeric field; reject NaN/Inf and clamp to `0.0..=60_000.0` returning `AppError::Validation { field: "duration_ms", reason: "out of range" | "non-finite" }`.

3. **Implement `record_frame_ms` resolver body** to emit `tracing::info!(target: "metric.webgpu.frame_duration_ms", duration_ms, wgpu_backend, webview_backend, timing_method)` after validation passes. Wrap in `if tracing::enabled!(Level::INFO) { ... }` to satisfy obs-plan §11 Metrics row 2 hot-path discipline.
4. **Add public re-exports** to `crates/ui-bridge/src/lib.rs`: `pub mod telemetry;` + `#[cfg(feature = "taurpc-runtime")] pub use telemetry::{TelemetryApi, TelemetryApiImpl};`.

5. **Add tests in `telemetry.rs` `#[cfg(test)] mod tests`** mirroring the contract.rs test module pattern: serde round-trip, enum kebab-case serialization, range/NaN/Inf rejection returning `AppError::Validation`, tracing-info presence at `metric.webgpu.frame_duration_ms` target on success path. Use the in-process `CapturingSubscriber` pattern from `contract.rs:359-391` (per testing.md Session Additions 2026-05-07 — minimal Subscriber, ~25 lines, no `tracing-test` workspace dep).

6. **Add a `scrubber_passes_metric_webgpu_frame_duration_ms_fields` test in `pulse-app/src/observability.rs`** mirroring the chunk #24 `scrubber_passes_app_boot_gpu_check_fields` pattern at lines 2407–2436 — verify the existing AllowList entry preserves all 4 fields under default-deny posture. Pair with `scrubber_redacts_non_allowlisted_metric_webgpu_frame_duration_ms_field` to assert the boundary.

7. **Register `TelemetryApiImpl` in the Tauri builder** in `pulse-app/src/main.rs` alongside `IntrospectionApiImpl` / TracesApi / MetricsApi / LogsApi / StreamsApi router merging. Constructor signature is parameter-free for `TelemetryApiImpl` (no `data_dir`/`features`/`broadcast_senders` needed — emission goes through `tracing` directly).

8. **Create the WGSL compute shader** at `pulse-app/ui/src/canvas/shaders/aggregation.wgsl`. Substrate-style minimal placeholder: declare `@group(0) @binding(0) var<storage, read> input: array<u32>;`, `@group(0) @binding(1) var<storage, read_write> output: array<u32>;`, single `@compute @workgroup_size(64) fn main(@builtin(global_invocation_id) gid: vec3<u32>) { ... }` entry point with structural numeric literals only (no design-token RGB literals). Data-binding semantics deferred to chunks #34/#35 per design-tokens.md Session Additions 2026-05-08 + scope discipline.

9. **Create `pulse-app/ui/src/canvas/compute-pipeline.ts`** with `createAggregationComputePipeline(device: GPUDevice) -> { kind: 'created', pipeline: GPUComputePipeline } | { kind: 'failed', reason: 'compute pipeline creation failed' | 'unsupported feature' | 'unsupported limit' }`. Mirror `render-pipeline.ts` factory shape; import shader source via Vite `?raw`; sanitized rethrow on `device.createComputePipelineAsync` rejection (NEVER pass `GPUError.message` through; NEVER include `wgsl_compile` / `panic` / `expect` substrings in `AppError`-bound surfaces).

10. **Create `pulse-app/ui/src/canvas/frame-metrics.ts`** with `recordFrameMs(input)` function invoking the TauRPC `telemetry.frontend.record_frame_ms` binding from `pulse-app/ui/src/bindings/index.ts` (auto-regenerated). Defense-in-depth: pre-clamp `duration_ms` client-side (the backend also validates) so an out-of-range invocation returns AppError::Validation cleanly without crashing the frame loop. Do NOT throw on validation reject; emit a sanitized warn-tier console event so the next frame can still record.

11. **Wire the timing capture into `pulse-app/ui/src/canvas/CanvasContainer.tsx`** lines 71–87: replace the no-op `onFrame` with a closure that calls `performance.now()` at start, `device.queue.onSubmittedWorkDone()` at end, computes `duration_ms`, then invokes `recordFrameMs({duration_ms, wgpu_backend: adapter.backendKind, webview_backend: detectWebviewBackend(), timing_method: 'cpu'})`. Add `webview_backend` detection helper (small function checking `navigator.userAgent` for `Edg/` → `webview2`, etc.; sanitized fallback `'unknown'` rejected at backend per the smart-enum constraint, so detection MUST always return one of the 3 enum values).

12. **Wire the compute pipeline into `CanvasContainer.tsx`** alongside the 3 existing render pipelines at lines 67–69: call `createAggregationComputePipeline(device)` and store the result; on `kind: 'failed'`, render the existing `<Fallback>` component instead of the `<canvas>` (mirroring the chunk #28 unavailable-adapter branch). Compute pipeline output is NOT bound to data in chunk #29 — chunks #34/#35 wire the dispatch cycle.

13. **Update `pulse-app/ui/src/canvas/frame-loop.ts`** lines 13–18: remove the `TODO(chunk #29)` comment; the timing capture now happens via `onFrame` (consumer-driven), so frame-loop stays generic. Also bump the comment-block chunk references in `frame-loop.ts` and `types.ts` to remove the `(chunk #29)` TODO and reflect chunk-#29-as-shipped.

14. **Add reduced-motion gate test** in `pulse-app/ui/src/canvas/frame-metrics.test.ts` (or extend existing `CanvasContainer.test.tsx`): with `mockReducedMotion(true)` (per `pulse-app/ui/src/hooks/mock-reduced-motion.ts`) + `motion-dom` global state reset, verify that `recordFrameMs` is still callable and emits the same 4-field shape (per obs cross-domain binding "stable shape across motion modes"). Reset `motion-dom` globals in `beforeEach` per testing.md Session Additions 2026-05-04.

15. **Run `cargo xtask typecheck`** to regenerate `pulse-app/ui/src/bindings/index.ts` with the new `telemetry.*` ARGS_MAP entry; confirm the existing `bindings.test.ts` regression test still passes (or add a new assertion if the file's smoke test enumerates expected namespaces).

16. **Run `cargo xtask capability-drift`** to confirm the gate's exit status. If exit=1 with `extra: ["telemetry.frontend.record_frame_ms"]`, the user-decision (Phase 6 review) on the architectural escalation determines whether to extend the xtask expected list (Path B tactical) or run `/andromeda-scope-arch` first (Path A architectural). /andromeda-implement should NOT silently extend the expected list without the user-decision; surface the failure and halt for manual resolution.

- `pulse-app/ui/src/canvas/compute-pipeline.ts` — `createAggregationComputePipeline` factory mirroring `render-pipeline.ts` (per combined.md `(security)` constraint "sanitized tagged-union fallback pattern preserved").
- `pulse-app/ui/src/canvas/compute-pipeline.test.ts` — Vitest cases for created / failed paths + WGSL grep test (per combined.md `(design)` criterion "no inline hex/RGB literals in shaders").
- `pulse-app/ui/src/canvas/shaders/aggregation.wgsl` — compute shader placeholder, structural literals only (per combined.md `(design)` constraint WGSL color-uniform discipline).
- `pulse-app/ui/src/canvas/frame-metrics.ts` — TauRPC bridge invocation + defense-in-depth client-side validation (per combined.md `(obs)` pattern "Frontend frame-time bridge").

- `pulse-app/ui/src/canvas/frame-metrics.test.ts` — Vitest cases for invocation shape + reduced-motion stable shape (per combined.md `(obs)` criterion "Reduced-motion-active runtime path emits same event shape").
- `crates/ui-bridge/src/lib.rs` — add `pub mod telemetry;` + feature-gated re-exports (1–3 line addition).
- `crates/ui-bridge/src/contract.rs` — possibly extend AppError test cases for the new validation pathway (optional; existing test module pattern accommodates trivially).
- `pulse-app/src/main.rs` — register `TelemetryApiImpl` in the Tauri builder router merge (1–3 line addition; mirror existing `StreamsApi` registration per chunk #23 precedent).

- `pulse-app/src/observability.rs` — add `scrubber_passes_metric_webgpu_frame_duration_ms_fields` + `scrubber_redacts_non_allowlisted_*` tests (~30 lines mirroring chunk #24 pattern at lines 2407–2436); existing AllowList entry at line 671 + existing `allowlist_for_target_resolves_*` test at line 1529 unchanged.

body: **Constraints across domains:**
- (arch) Window management code lives in `pulse-app/src/` (binary crate); no library crate may depend on the binary; library crates flow toward `pulse-app` per arch §Module dependency direction.
- (arch) Close-window action MUST minimize to tray; process termination only via Quit menu item (per arch §Cross-cutting Patterns §Tray icon policy).
- (arch) Any new TauRPC procedure for widget state requires a matching `pulse-app/capabilities/` JSON entry; capabilities are negative-default (per arch §Webview IPC capability policy).

- (arch) New TauRPC namespaces must be registered in arch §Occupied Resources via `/andromeda-scope-arch` BEFORE merge — xtask catches capability JSON gaps but NOT arch registry sync (per security.md §Session Additions 2026-05-09).

- (arch) Snap-to-edge persistence MUST NOT introduce new env vars beyond reserved set; expressible via `config.toml` under `ANDROMEDA_PULSE_DATA_DIR` (per arch §Occupied Resources §Environment variables).
- (arch) `ANDROMEDA_PULSE_CONFIG_PATH` / `ANDROMEDA_PULSE_DATA_DIR` govern `config.toml` location; widget position storage inherits strict-path canonicalization (per arch §Inherited Defaults).

- (security) Widget window capability — if shares `pulse:default`, document intent; if separate, define explicitly in `pulse-app/capabilities/` with rationale (per security plan §Tauri Capability Gating).
- (security) New TauRPC procedures need router registration AND capability JSON entry; `xtask capability-drift` (chunk #27) enforces in CI (per security plan §Tauri Capability Gating).
- (security) NEVER grant `fs`/`shell`/`dialog`/`http` Tauri core APIs to widget capability without explicit rationale (per security plan §Tauri Capability Gating).
- (security) Geometry persistence write path MUST canonicalize via `strict-path` and assert under resolved data dir; CWE-22 applies (per security plan §Input Validation §Path env vars).

- (security) Close-to-tray policy keeps Tokio runtime + OTLP receivers live; loopback-only bind constraint must NOT be re-evaluated/widened at runtime (per security plan §Loopback-only network surfaces).
- (security) `tracing` instrumentation for window events MUST NOT log raw coordinates / display bounds (per security plan §Self-observation + §Logging & Redaction).

- (design) Titlebar 32px height; app icon 16px + title text "andromeda-pulse" + settings button (aperture, 20px) + window controls per platform; full-width drag region excluding buttons (per design-system.md §Surface: desktop-webview Component Patterns §Navigation / App Shell).

- (design) Widget background `--color-base` (#1A1D24); elevated chrome `--color-raised-1` (#262A33) with 1px border `rgba(74, 144, 226, 0.3)`; no shadows (per design-system.md §Color Palette §Surface Scale + §Depth Strategy).
- (design) Frameless window via Tauri `"decorations": false`; custom titlebar renders all OS controls in React webview (per design-system.md §Surface: desktop-webview §Platform-Specific Notes).
- (design) Spacing uses `--spacing-{xs,sm,md}` tokens (4/8/16px); base unit 4px; no magic pixel values (per design-system.md §Spacing).
- (design) Border radius uses `--radius-sm` (4px) controls / `--radius-md` (6px) panels (per design-system.md §Border Radius).
- (design) Focus ring 3-4px outset, color #4A90E2; `:focus-visible` on all focusable (per design-system.md §Surface: desktop-webview §Focus / Keyboard Navigation).
- (design) Chrome transitions `--duration-fast` (150ms) `ease-out`; no opacity > 200ms; no spring/bounce/parallax/scroll animations (per design-system.md §Motion Hard limits).
- (layouts) Fixed quarter-screen frameless window; no CSS media-query breakpoints (per layout-templates.md §Wireframe — Compact widget + §Decisions Log "Responsive breakpoints").

- (layouts) Custom frameless titlebar flex row: `[app-icon + title | grow | settings-button | window-controls]`, `height: space-lg`, `padding: 0 space-sm`, `gap: space-sm`, bottom 1px subtle border (per layout-templates.md §Component — Custom titlebar).
- (layouts) Titlebar carries `data-tauri-drag-region` attribute on full-width region excluding interactive buttons (per layout-templates.md §Component — Custom titlebar "Drag region" note).
- (layouts) Window controls placement: macOS traffic-light left; Windows/Linux minimize/maximize/close right (per layout-templates.md §Component — Custom titlebar "Window controls").

- (layouts) Halo State Pulse canvas container fills viewport between titlebar and footer with `position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; background: color-inset; border: 1px subtle; border-radius: radius-md; padding: space-md` (per layout-templates.md §Component — Halo State Pulse canvas).

- (layouts) Footer read-only flex row, `justify-content: space-between; height: space-sm; padding: 0 space-md; border-top: 1px subtle` showing ingest left + error % right in `font-data` `color-text-tertiary` (per layout-templates.md §Component — Footer).
- (layouts) Esc key minimizes widget to tray (process continues); X button minimizes to tray; only Quit terminates (per layout-templates.md §IA notes "Navigation model").
- (a11y) Compact widget is assertable desktop-webview entity; axe-core + Playwright focus harness required (per a11y-plan §1 + §2).
- (a11y) Focus order: title / expand button / minimize button (Esc also minimizes); single focused region (per a11y-plan §5 Keyboard Navigation compact-widget focus order).
- (a11y) Esc minimizes to tray AND focus restores to tray icon on widget restoration (per a11y-plan §5 Focus restoration + §4 Critical Path P5).
- (a11y) Always-on-top toggle + expand button MUST be native `<button>` or React Aria Components — never `role="button"` on `<div>` (per a11y-plan §11 Anti-patterns ARIA + eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y).
- (a11y) Custom titlebar drag region MUST NOT suppress `:focus-visible` outlines; `--border-focus` token applied to all `:focus-visible` targets (per a11y-plan §11 Keyboard + §6 Focus ring tokens).
- (a11y) All chrome transitions respect `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` — degrade to instant per SC 2.3.3 AAA (per a11y-plan §1 Trigger-driven AAA + §6 Motion tokens).
- (a11y) State colors paired with text label or icon supplement — never color alone (per a11y-plan §11 Visual + §6 State color tokens; SC 1.4.1).

- (tests) P5 critical path "Widget compact mode ↔ dashboard expansion ↔ tray icon visibility toggle"; full GUI automation DEFERRED to tauri-driver headful E2E; agent-driven surrogate uses TauRPC `health` IPC contract (per test-plan §6 P5 "Status: DEFERRED").
- (tests) New React components require co-located `*.test.tsx` files asserting DOM-shape contracts; vitest 3.x + jsdom + @testing-library/react 16 (per test-plan §4 webview unit tests).

- (tests) Platform-specific window behavior gated via `#[cfg(target_os = "…")]` + exercised under 3-platform CI matrix `macos-latest`/`ubuntu-22.04`/`windows-latest` (per test-plan §3 Command 2 + §9 Matrix builds).
- (tests) Window state persistence tests use `ANDROMEDA_PULSE_DATA_DIR=$TMPDIR` isolation; no shared mutable state (per test-plan §7 + §11).
- (tests) Coverage gate: ≥75% line / ≥70% branch / ≥85% function for new `pulse-app` Rust window-management code (per test-plan §10 Standard tier thresholds).

- (obs) Compact widget transition (compact ↔ expanded) is P5 must-trace path; spans `ui.layout.transition` (`layout_mode_from`, `layout_mode_to`, `duration_ms`) + `tray.visibility.toggle` MUST be emitted (per obs-plan §4 Scenario P5 + §1 Critical paths table).

- (obs) App boot emits platform-specific spans: `app.boot.webview.init` (`webview_backend`), `app.boot.gpu.check` (`gpu_available`, `wgpu_backend`), `app.boot.tray.init` (`tray_api`); widget window init is child of `app.boot` (per obs-plan §1 telemetry triggers).
- (obs) MUST NOT emit layout_mode/snap-to-edge coordinates at `info` in window-move loop — only on discrete state transitions (per obs-plan §11 Anti-Patterns Logs).
- (obs) All log lines conform to JSON schema with `service.name`/`service.version`/`deployment.environment` default subscriber fields (per obs-plan §3 Log format + §6 Required fields).
**Patterns к follow:**
- (arch) Single Tokio multi-threaded runtime owned by `pulse-app/src/main.rs`; library crates do not spawn runtimes (per arch §Inherited Defaults).
- (arch) TauRPC router per owning crate; widget IPC procedures belong on `ui-bridge` crate's router (alongside `get_settings`/`update_settings`/`app_info`/`health`/`ready`) (per arch §Conventions).

- (arch) Config precedence: env vars > `config.toml` > built-in defaults; widget geometry defaults overridable via `config.toml`, not new env vars (per arch §Cross-cutting Patterns §Config management).

- (arch) Frameless window + custom titlebar + drag region established in chunk #25 webview shell — compact widget follows same discipline (per arch §Established Decisions §Tauri 2 + Epoch 4 chunk #25).
- (security) Capability-first window design — decide capability assignment before frontend IPC code (per security plan §Tauri Capability Gating).
- (security) `strict-path` for geometry persistence — same canonicalize-then-assert-under-data-dir pattern as plugin/snapshot paths (per security plan §Input Validation §Path env vars).
- (security) `tracing` event shape: structured `tracing::info!(event = "widget.window.opened", ...)` — no raw coordinates in payload (per security plan §Self-observation).
- (security) Existing capability JSON pattern: router-level `core:default` + plugin-level perms — NOT per-procedure strings (per security rules.md §Session Additions 2026-05-03).

- (design) Compact widget navigation: settings icon in titlebar → Settings panel; Tab through controls; Esc to minimize/focus loss (per design-system.md §Surface: desktop-webview §Navigation Pattern).

- (design) Settings button uses **aperture** custom SVG glyph (`<Icon glyph="aperture" />`) registered at `src/components/icons/`; 20px size, 6px container padding (per design-system.md §Iconography).
- (design) Titlebar typography: IBM Plex Sans 14px weight 400 (Body) or 12px weight 500 (Label); NOT JetBrains Mono (per design-system.md §Typography).

- (design) Canvas container for Halo State Pulse uses `--color-inset` (#0F1117) — recessive, allows halos to pop (per design-system.md §Surface: desktop-webview §Component Patterns §Canvas Container).
- (layouts) Three-region stack (titlebar / canvas hero / footer) — same region order used by successor chunks #31 + #32 (per layout-templates.md §Wireframe — Compact widget).
- (layouts) Custom titlebar shared between compact widget and full dashboard — implement as reusable React component from start (per layout-templates.md §Decisions Log "Custom titlebar ownership").

- (layouts) Snap-to-edge controlled via Settings modal's 9-position radio grid; shell reads persisted snap on startup, applies to window position (per layout-templates.md §Component — Settings modal "Widget snap position").
- (a11y) Compact-widget titlebar marked as `<header>` (or `role="banner"`) for landmark role (per a11y-plan §7 Landmark roles).

**Anti-patterns к avoid:**

- (security) Do NOT bind tray-interop IPC to `pulse:default` — `pulse:notification`/`pulse:tray` are outbound-emit-only; input-event handlers need separately-named capability (per security plan §Tauri Capability Gating).

- (security) Do NOT widen `pulse:tray` to write/execute permissions — outbound-emit only; static-analysis enforcement gap = author discipline only (per security plan §Tauri Capability Gating §static analysis gap note).
- (security) Do NOT log display geometry values — environment topology data (per security plan §Logging & Redaction).

- (design) NEVER use gradient overlays / glassmorphic / box shadows on widget chrome — flat matte + border-only depth; Halo State Pulse canvas (chunk #31) sole exception (per design-system.md §Anti-Patterns §Universal Bans + §Depth Strategy).

- (design) NEVER hardcode hex/pixel values — all colors/spacing/radii trace to `@theme` CSS custom properties (per design-system.md §Surface: desktop-webview §Tokens).
- (layouts) Do NOT introduce CSS media-query breakpoints in compact widget — fixed quarter-screen by design (per layout-templates.md §Decisions Log "Responsive breakpoints").
- (layouts) Do NOT place navigation tabs / sidebar inside compact widget — navigation via Settings toggle / keyboard shortcut only (per layout-templates.md §Component — Primary navigation).

- (layouts) Do NOT render per-service Halo State Pulse dots in compact widget canvas — single unified halo around aggregated badge; per-service dots are full-dashboard only (per layout-templates.md §Wireframe + §Decisions Log "Signature placement strategy").

- (a11y) NEVER convey always-on-top / snap-position state via color alone — pair with text label / icon (SC 1.4.1; per a11y-plan §11 Visual).

data.head: # Phase 27 Plan — chunk route#30: "Compact widget shell — quarter-screen window, snap-to-edge per-display memory, always-on-top toggle, custom titlebar"

body:
_Generated by /andromeda-phase Phase 4. Read by /andromeda-implement.
Manual edits between runs are fine; do not edit during /implement run._
- **Phase number:** 27

- **Route chunks covered:**
  - route#30 "Compact widget shell — quarter-screen window, snap-to-edge per-display memory, always-on-top toggle, custom titlebar"
- **Epoch:** Visualization surfaces (Epoch 5)

Make the compact widget honor user preferences for snap position and always-on-top behavior, persisted across restarts. The substrate from chunks #24-29 (frameless window declared in `tauri.conf.json`, `pulse-app/src/window.rs` with platform-detection + close→tray hook + `show_compact_widget`, `Titlebar.tsx` + `WindowControls.tsx` React shell, `Settings { widget_position: WidgetPosition }` already in `crates/ui-bridge/src/contract.rs` with `get_settings`/`update_settings` IPC) leaves chunk #30 with a narrow delta: extend `Settings` with `always_on_top: bool`, add a `apply_widget_settings()` function in `pulse-app/src/window.rs` that reads persisted settings on startup and calls `set_position` + `set_always_on_top` on the compact-widget window relative to the current monitor's geometry, and emit `ui.layout.transition` spans on apply (per obs-plan §4 P5 must-trace + arch §Tray icon policy + design-system §Surface desktop-webview frameless config + a11y §6 reduced-motion-honored chrome). Per security plan §Tauri Capability Gating + arch §Webview IPC capability policy: extending an existing `Settings`-shaped IPC avoids adding new TauRPC procedures, which means no new `pulse-app/capabilities/` entries and no `/andromeda-scope-arch` registry update — the carry-over xtask capability-drift D3 (4 missing entries from chunks #23 + #29) is unchanged by chunk #30.

The "snap-to-edge per-display memory" route language is interpreted loosely (snap relative to whichever display the widget is currently on, computed from `current_monitor().position() + size()`), not strictly (HashMap<display_id, WidgetPosition> per-display state) — see Implementation notes for rationale + follow-up trigger.

1. **Extend `Settings` struct** in `crates/ui-bridge/src/contract.rs`:
   - Add `pub always_on_top: bool` field with `#[serde(default = "default_always_on_top")]` returning `true` (matches existing `tauri.conf.json` `compact-widget` window default).
   - Update `Default` impl to set `always_on_top: true`.
   - No change to `Settings::validate()` needed (boolean has no out-of-range states).
   - Extend tests in `contract.rs::tests`: `settings_default_always_on_top_is_true`, extend `settings_round_trips_through_serde` to include the new field, extend `settings_partial_deserialize_uses_defaults_for_missing_fields` so existing config.toml files without `always_on_top` get the default.

2. **Update `update_settings` tracing emission** in `crates/ui-bridge/src/health.rs` (line 452):
   - Extend the `setting_keys_changed` field value to include `always_on_top` (currently `"theme,widget_position,retention_seconds,mcp_server_enabled,notifications_enabled"` → add `,always_on_top`).
   - No allowlist change needed (the existing `ui-bridge.update_settings` allowlist entry covers `setting_keys_changed`; new value is a string literal extension, not a new field name).

3. **Add `apply_widget_settings()` in `pulse-app/src/window.rs`** as the "apply persisted Settings to compact-widget window" surface:
   - Signature: `pub fn apply_widget_settings<R: tauri::Runtime, M: Manager<R>>(app: &M, settings: &Settings)`.
   - Resolve compact-widget window via `app.get_webview_window(COMPACT_WIDGET_LABEL)`; if `None`, emit `warn!(target: "app.boot.window.show", ...)` (existing pattern from `show_compact_widget`).
   - Compute target position via `window.current_monitor()?` → `monitor.position()` + `monitor.size()` — derive top/bottom + left/right pixel coords from `WidgetPosition` enum (4 variants: TopLeft / TopRight / BottomLeft / BottomRight). Window outer size is read via `window.outer_size()?`.
   - Apply via `window.set_position(PhysicalPosition::new(x, y))` and `window.set_always_on_top(settings.always_on_top)`.
   - Emit `tracing::info!(target: "ui.layout.transition", layout_mode_from = "boot_default", layout_mode_to = position_label, duration_ms = elapsed.as_millis() as u64, always_on_top = settings.always_on_top, "applied persisted widget settings")` — no raw coordinate values per security plan §Self-observation + §Logging & Redaction.
   - Add unit tests in `window.rs::tests`: `apply_widget_settings_handles_missing_window` (warn path), `widget_position_label_collapses_to_bounded_enum` (string conversion).

4. **Wire from `setup` closure in `pulse-app/src/main.rs`** (line 259, after `window::show_compact_widget(app);`):
   - Resolve settings: read `data_dir/config.toml` directly via `fs::read_to_string` + `toml::from_str::<Settings>()` (mirror `IntrospectionApiImpl::get_settings`); fall back to `Settings::default()` on file-not-found OR parse error (boot must not fail on settings read).
   - Call `window::apply_widget_settings(app, &settings)` after the show call.
   - Order matters: `show_compact_widget` first (window must be visible to be positioned), then `apply_widget_settings` (set position + always-on-top).

5. **Extend `pulse-app/src/observability.rs::AllowList::production()`**:
   - Find the `ui.layout.transition` allowlist entry (added at chunk #24); ensure the field set includes `always_on_top` (boolean) and `duration_ms` (number) in addition to existing `layout_mode_from` / `layout_mode_to` / `tray_visible`. If the existing entry doesn't include these, add them.
   - Add a probe test `allowlist_for_target_resolves_ui_layout_transition_to_expanded_field_set` per the 2026-05-07 session-additions probe pattern (assert allowlist for `ui.layout.transition` includes `always_on_top` + `duration_ms`).

6. **Verify TS bindings regeneration** (no manual change):
   - `pulse-app/ui/src/bindings/index.ts` regenerates automatically when `cargo nextest run --filter-expr 'test(emit_taurpc_bindings)'` runs (chunk #25 emission test). The new `always_on_top: boolean` field appears in the generated `Settings` TS type. Webview consumers (settings modal at chunk #38) will type-check against the regenerated bindings.

7. **No tauri.conf.json change**:
   - Keep `compact-widget` `alwaysOnTop: true` as boot-default; runtime `apply_widget_settings` overrides if persisted setting differs. Avoids race condition (window is created with always-on-top=true at Tauri context generation; runtime override happens after first paint).
(none — all changes land in existing files. Optional `pulse-app/ui/src/components/AlwaysOnTopToggle.tsx` deferred to chunk #38 Settings modal form.)

- `crates/ui-bridge/src/health.rs` — extend the `update_settings` `setting_keys_changed` tracing string to include `always_on_top` (line 452); no other change to IntrospectionApiImpl needed.

body: _Generated by /andromeda-phase Phase 4. Read by /andromeda-implement. Manual edits between runs are fine; do not edit during /implement run._
- **Phase number:** 28

- **Route chunks covered:**
  - route#31 "Halo State Pulse signature element — WebGPU pulse 0.8-2.4 Hz from throughput/1000, LCH Earth Blue↔Alert Burgundy per error rate, 4-16px blur per cycle, reduced-motion static-glow"
- **Epoch:** 5 — Visualization surfaces

Materialize the design system's named signature element — the **Halo State Pulse** — as a foundational, reusable WebGPU module that all three downstream surfaces (compact widget aggregated badge, full dashboard per-service constellation, tray icon unified halo) consume without re-implementation. The chunk lands four discrete pieces: (1) pure-function mappers (throughput → pulse Hz, error_rate → LCH-interpolated hue, error_rate → blur radius envelope), (2) a WGSL fragment shader using `HaloUniforms` + `ColorUniforms` patterns (NO inline RGB literals — colors as JS-uploaded uniforms), (3) a `<HaloCanvas>` React component with own `<canvas>` element + own WebGPU pipeline + reduced-motion gate + recordFrameMs SLO instrumentation, and (4) wiring into `App.tsx` alongside the existing `<CanvasContainer>` substrate so the Halo is visible end-to-end with synthetic input.

The chunk reuses the established substrate without introducing any new TauRPC procedure or capability JSON entry: `streams.subscribe_metrics` (chunk #23) is the canonical input channel for downstream real-data binding (chunks #34/#35), `telemetry.frontend.record_frame_ms` (chunk #29) is the canonical frame-budget reporter, `useReducedMotion` from `motion/react` 12.x (chunk #15) is the canonical reduced-motion hook, and the WGSL shader pattern + Vite `?raw` import + tagged-union failure return + sanitized boundary errors are all established by chunk #28's `render-pipeline.ts` + `compute-pipeline.ts`. The capability-drift triple binding (security ↔ tests/CI ↔ arch) stays untouched — the carry-over D3 (4 missing entries in `xtask/src/main.rs::EXPECTED_PROCEDURES` from chunks #23 + #29) is preserved unchanged. Per design's three-surface presence requirement: chunk #31 ships the foundational shader + LCH interp module that chunks #32 (compact widget infographics) and tray-icon downstream chunks compose; chunk #31 itself wires Halo as a peer of CanvasContainer in App.tsx for end-to-end visibility, leaving window-label-conditional placement (compact-widget-only, full-dashboard per-service constellation) for the downstream chunks.

1. **Pure-function mappers** — write three small modules under `pulse-app/ui/src/halo/` with co-located tests:
   1. `throughput-to-hz.ts` exporting `throughputToHz(throughputHz: number): number` returning `clamp(throughputHz / 1000, 0.8, 2.4)`. Handle `NaN` / `Infinity` / negative input by collapsing to `0.8` (lower bound) per design extract clamp ownership. Co-located `throughput-to-hz.test.ts` table-drives the input set per combined.md tests acceptance row.
   2. `error-rate-to-blur.ts` exporting `errorRateToBlur(errorRate: number): number` returning `lerp(4, 16, clamp(errorRate, 0, 1))` — this returns the OUTER ENVELOPE (current target blur magnitude). The mid-cycle sinusoidal blur sweep is the WGSL fragment shader's job (modulating around the target). Co-located `error-rate-to-blur.test.ts` table-drives.
   3. `lch.ts` exporting `lchInterpolate(errorRate: number, primaryHex: string, accentHex: string): { r: number; g: number; b: number; a: number }` using `colorjs.io` 0.6.0 LCH interpolation (`new Color(hex).range(new Color(hex), { space: "lch" })(t)`). Returns sRGB float quadruple (0..1) ready for `vec4<f32>` upload. Co-located `lch.test.ts` asserts: error_rate=0 → Earth Blue `#4A90E2`; error_rate=1 → Alert Burgundy `#C7556A`; error_rate=0.5 lands on the LCH geodesic (NOT the RGB midpoint `~#896E96` — assert specific `r` / `g` / `b` floats with reasonable tolerance per design extract acceptance criterion); clamps at boundaries.

2. **Type definitions** — write `pulse-app/ui/src/halo/halo-types.ts` exporting `HaloInput { throughputHz: number; errorRate: number }` + `MotionMode = "animated" | "static_glow"`. Used across modules + test fixtures.

3. **WGSL shader** — write `pulse-app/ui/src/halo/shaders/halo.wgsl` with:
   - `HaloUniforms { color: vec4<f32>, blur_target: f32, pulse_phase: f32, _pad: f32 }` at `@group(0) @binding(0) var<uniform>` (the trailing `_pad: f32` keeps the struct 16-byte aligned per WGSL std140-like rules — verify with WebGPU spec if alignment-sensitive).
   - Vertex shader: standard fullscreen-quad mirror of `metrics-chart.wgsl::vs_main` (6-vertex triangle list, `position` + `uv` output).
   - Fragment shader: radial gradient centered at `uv == vec2<f32>(0.5, 0.5)`. Compute `dist = length(in.uv - vec2(0.5))`. Compute current blur via `current_blur = blur_target * (0.5 + 0.5 * sin(pulse_phase))` — sweeps around the target per design's sinusoidal envelope (0.6-1.2s breath period inverse of frequency). Output `vec4<f32>(color.rgb, color.a * smoothstep(0.5, 0.5 - current_blur / 64.0, dist))` (or equivalent radial-falloff math — implementer chooses concrete falloff; the spec is "blur radius 4-16 px sweeps sinusoidally"). NO inline RGB literals (only structural-zero `vec4<f32>(0.0, ...)` is allowed per design-tokens.md Session Additions 2026-05-08).

4. **WebGPU pipeline factory** — write `pulse-app/ui/src/halo/halo-pipeline.ts` mirroring `canvas/render-pipeline.ts` shape:
   - Vite `?raw` import: `import haloShader from "./shaders/halo.wgsl?raw"`.
   - `createHaloPipeline(device: GPUDevice, format: GPUTextureFormat): HaloPipelineResult` returning tagged union per `compute-pipeline.ts` pattern: `{ kind: "created", pipeline: GPURenderPipeline }` | `{ kind: "failed", reason: HaloPipelineFailureReason }`. Failure reasons: `"halo pipeline creation failed" | "unsupported feature"`. Sanitized one-liner reasons — never raw `GPUError.message`.
   - Co-located `halo-pipeline.test.ts` asserts pipeline creation success path (with stubbed device) + sanitized failure path (mock `device.createShaderModule` to throw).

5. **HaloCanvas React component** — write `pulse-app/ui/src/halo/HaloCanvas.tsx`:
   - Props: `{ ariaLabel: string; throughputHz: number; errorRate: number }`.
   - Hook order: `useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>`, `useState<AdapterResult | null>` (reuse `requestWebGPUAdapter` from `canvas/webgpu-adapter.ts`), `useState<boolean>` for halo-pipeline-failed, `useReducedMotion() ?? false`.
   - Adapter-acquisition `useEffect`: same pattern as `CanvasContainer.tsx:50-60` (cancellable promise; sets adapter state; cleanup on unmount).
   - Pipeline + frame-loop `useEffect` (deps: `[adapter, reducedMotion]`): on adapter available, configure context, create halo pipeline (set `haloPipelineFailed` + return on failure), read design tokens at init via `getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--color-primary')` + `getPropertyValue('--color-accent')` + `getPropertyValue('--color-inset')` (parse hex to floats), allocate uniform buffer (`device.createBuffer({ size: 32, usage: GPUBufferUsage.UNIFORM | GPUBufferUsage.COPY_DST })`).
   - Frame loop construction via `createFrameLoop` (reuse from `canvas/frame-loop.ts`):
     - `onFrame`: compute `pulse_phase = (timestamp / 1000) * 2 * Math.PI * throughputToHz(throughputHz)`. Compute `color = lchInterpolate(errorRate, primaryHex, accentHex)`. Compute `blur_target = errorRateToBlur(errorRate)`. Write the 4-uniform layout to the uniform buffer via `device.queue.writeBuffer(uniformBuffer, 0, new Float32Array([color.r, color.g, color.b, color.a, blur_target, pulse_phase, 0, 0]))`. Encode + submit render pass. After `device.queue.onSubmittedWorkDone()`: `void recordFrameMs({ duration_ms: performance.now() - start, wgpu_backend, webview_backend, timing_method: "cpu" })`.
     - `prefersReducedMotion: reducedMotion`.
     - `onReducedMotionFrame`: ONE static-glow render at `pulse_phase = 0` (no oscillation) using current `errorRate`-derived hue + blur (data-driven hue STILL UPDATES per error_rate; only motion suppressed). Then `recordFrameMs({ duration_ms: 0, wgpu_backend, webview_backend, timing_method: "cpu" })` for stable shape.
   - **Re-render on `errorRate` change under reduced-motion**: per `canvas/types.ts` comment + `canvas/CanvasContainer.tsx:107-118` precedent, the consumer-driven repaint contract requires the `useEffect` deps to also include `errorRate` so a parent prop change triggers a fresh `start()` call (one new static-glow frame at the updated hue). Add `errorRate` to the effect's dependency array (and `throughputHz` for completeness even though throughputHz only matters in the animated path).
   - Render: `<section role="region" aria-label={ariaLabel}>` with same design-token chrome as `CanvasContainer.tsx:130-143` (background `var(--color-inset)`, 1px `rgba(74, 144, 226, 0.3)` border, `radius-md`, `padding spacing-md`). Inside: `{showFallback ? <Fallback /> : <canvas ref={canvasRef} style={{ width: "100%", height: "100%" }} />}`. Reuse the existing `Fallback` component from `canvas/Fallback.tsx`.

6. **HaloCanvas tests** — write `pulse-app/ui/src/halo/HaloCanvas.test.tsx` mirroring `canvas/CanvasContainer.test.tsx` pattern:
   - `vi.mock("../hooks/use-reduced-motion", () => ({ useReducedMotion: vi.fn().mockReturnValue(false) }))` at top.
   - `vi.mock("./halo-pipeline", () => ({ createHaloPipeline: vi.fn().mockReturnValue({ kind: "created", pipeline: {} as GPURenderPipeline }) }))`.
   - `vi.mock("../canvas/frame-metrics", () => ({ recordFrameMs: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined), detectWebviewBackend: vi.fn().mockReturnValue("webview2"), normalizeWgpuBackend: vi.fn().mockImplementation(...) }))` — reuse the substrate's frame-metrics module rather than re-implementing the bridge.
   - `stubGpuAvailable()` / `stubGpuUnavailable()` helpers per `CanvasContainer.test.tsx:37-61`.
   - `vi.unstubAllGlobals()` + `vi.mocked(...).mockClear()` in `afterEach`.
   - Tests:
     a. `<region role="region">` wrapper with provided aria-label.
     b. Design-token chrome on wrapper (color-inset / radius-md / spacing-md).
     c. Canvas renders + halo pipeline created when WebGPU available.
     d. `<Fallback role="alert">` renders when `navigator.gpu` undefined.
     e. `<Fallback>` renders when `createHaloPipeline` returns `{ kind: "failed" }`.
     f. Reduced-motion path: rAF NOT called (`vi.spyOn(globalThis, "requestAnimationFrame")`); `recordFrameMs` called with stable 4-field shape (`duration_ms === 0`, `timing_method === "cpu"`).
     g. Reduced-motion + `errorRate` prop change triggers re-render (one new static-glow frame; verify via additional `recordFrameMs` invocation).
   - Per testing.md Session Additions 2026-05-08: relax pipeline-factory call-count assertions to `toHaveBeenCalled()` (≥1 call) — React 19 dev-mode useEffect double-invocation pattern.

7. **Wire HaloCanvas into App.tsx** — modify `pulse-app/ui/src/App.tsx`:
   - Import `HaloCanvas` from `./halo/HaloCanvas`.
   - Add synthetic input simulator: `useState<HaloInput>` initialized to `{ throughputHz: 1000, errorRate: 0 }`. `useEffect` with `setInterval` driving a sine-wave generator (e.g., `errorRate = 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(t * 0.0005)`, `throughputHz = 1000 + 1000 * sin(t * 0.0003)`) — clearly commented as "synthetic placeholder; real binding via `streams.subscribe_metrics` Arrow IPC parsing deferred to chunks #34/#35".
   - Render `<HaloCanvas ariaLabel="Application status indicator" throughputHz={input.throughputHz} errorRate={input.errorRate} />` as a peer of `<CanvasContainer />` inside `<main>`. Use a flex layout (`<main style={{ display: "flex", gap: "var(--spacing-md)", ... }}>`) so both regions render side-by-side; chunk #32 refines per-window placement.
   - Update co-located `pulse-app/ui/src/App.test.tsx` — expect both regions to render with their respective aria-labels; assert synthetic input simulator interval is started + cleaned up on unmount.
