body: **Constraints across domains:**

- (security) Webview rendering of OTLP-derived strings (service.name, error counts, retention bytes) MUST treat the data as user-controlled content from instrumented host apps; render via React's default text-escaping path only — never `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`, inline `<style>`, `<script>`, or `style={...}` (per security plan §Threat Model Summary + §API Security CSP `script-src 'self'`).

- (security) Service constellation aggregated badge counts, ingest rate, error rate, and retention numbers consumed via existing TauRPC procedures + `pulse://stream/*` Channel events only — NEVER add a new TauRPC procedure or stream event without (a) router registration + (b) capability JSON entry (per security plan §API Security TauRPC capability authorization + Anti-Patterns §API).

- (security) If a persistable display preference is needed, extend the existing `Settings` struct + `get_settings`/`update_settings` flow rather than introduce a new namespace (per CLAUDE.md §Session Additions 2026-05-09 lower-cost Settings-extension pattern).

- (security) `tracing` events from widget rendering MUST NOT log raw OTLP attribute values, service-name strings, or buffer content — emit aggregated counts / IDs / cardinality summaries only (per security plan §Logging & Monitoring + Anti-Patterns §Logging row 1).

- (security) Webview CSP posture is fixed at `tauri.conf.json` + `pulse-app/capabilities/` and MUST NOT be widened in chunk #32 — no `'unsafe-inline'` added to `script-src`, no remote font/image origin (per security plan §API Security CSP row).

- (design) Compact widget surface MUST consume only `desktop-webview` design tokens; no hardcoded hex / pixel literals — use `var(--color-*)`, `var(--spacing-*)`, `var(--radius-*)`, `var(--font-*)`, `var(--duration-*)` exclusively (per design-system §Surface: desktop-webview Tokens + §Anti-Patterns Universal Bans).

- (design) Footer band background MUST be `--color-base` (#1A1D24) or `--color-raised-1` (#262A33) with 1px border `rgba(74, 144, 226, 0.3)` (Subtle); borders-only depth strategy mandatory — NO shadows, NO gradient overlays on chrome (per design-system §Depth Strategy + §Anti-Patterns Universal Bans).

- (design) Footer text follows Text Hierarchy: numeric data uses `--font-code` (JetBrains Mono) at 12px with `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`; field labels use `--font-body` (IBM Plex Sans) Label role at 12px weight 500 (per design-system §Typography table).

- (design) Service constellation aggregated badge MUST sit on `--color-inset` (#0F1117) background; the unified Halo State Pulse from chunk #31 wraps this badge (per design-system §Self-Validation Protocol Signature Test #3 — compact widget aggregated badge is one of 3 mandatory Halo locations).
- (design) Footer spacing MUST use `--spacing-sm` (8px) inline gaps, `--spacing-md` (16px) outer card padding, `--spacing-xs` (4px) icon-to-text gap (per design-system §Spacing table).

- (design) Error-rate metric pairs color encoding with text label/icon — `--color-accent` (#C7556A) border or icon AND percentage text using `--color-text-primary` per SC 1.4.1 not-color-alone (per design-system §Anti-Patterns Universal Bans + §Decisions Log 2026-05-03 accent-lift entry).

- (design) Glance-readable-from-2m intent constrains chrome motion to instant updates — footer numeric values update at broadcast cadence without fade/morph; entrance animations explicitly NONE per 0.35 expression budget (per design-system §Motion table).

- (layouts) Surface = desktop-webview, primary screen = Compact widget; chunk #30 already shipped the shell; chunk #32 fills canvas-overlay-badge + footer regions only (per layout-templates.md §Surface: desktop-webview / Primary screens).

- (layouts) Aggregated service-count badge lives at the bottom-right quadrant of the Halo State Pulse canvas — single unified halo circles the badge (per layout-templates.md §Surface: desktop-webview / Signature placement item 2).

- (layouts) Footer band sits below canvas, height `space-sm`, horizontal padding `space-md`, transparent background, 1px subtle border-top, layout `flex row, justify-content: space-between` (per layout-templates.md §Component — Footer / Compact widget).

- (layouts) Footer content: Left = `"Ingest: {spans/sec}"`; Right = `"Error: {%}"`; Wireframe also shows `"Retention: 8m / 10m used"` line — chunk title cites all 3 metrics ("ingest/error/retention footer band") so retention IS in scope (specialist plan minor inconsistency; treat Wireframe as authoritative per layout-templates.md §Wireframe — Compact widget).
- (layouts) No new modal, no new navigation, no new focusable interactive surface; footer is read-only status display (per layout-templates.md §Wireframe — Compact widget notes).

- (tests) Test framework: `vitest` 3.x + `jsdom` 26 + `@testing-library/react` 16; co-located `*.test.tsx` adjacent to component source under `pulse-app/ui/src/` (per test-plan §4 + .claude/rules/testing.md §Framework).
- (tests) JUnit XML emission to `target/junit-ui.xml` matching `cargo-nextest --message-format junit` shape required for agent-driven discipline (per test-plan §1 Surfaces under test row).

- (tests) Coverage gate scope: webview presentational components excluded from ≥75%/≥70%/≥85% coverage at Foundation pre-shell stage; integration coverage applies via `tauri-driver` E2E from chunk #25; DOM-shape unit tests still required (per test-plan §4).

- (tests) Boot-smoke discipline: chunk #32 is **exempt** (webview UI only, not boot paths) — Smoke gate MUST NOT be added to Test Commands (per test-plan §12 2026-05-09 Decisions Log entry + .claude/rules/testing.md §Pending coverage triggers).

- (obs) Frame-duration timing for compact widget badge + footer render path MUST flow through existing `telemetry.frontend.record_frame_ms` TauRPC bridge (chunk #29) — no new `metric.compact_widget.*` target prefix, no new TauRPC bridge resolver (per obs-plan §3 Frontend bridge).

- (obs) Footer band data flow MUST consume existing `pulse://stream/metrics` + `pulse://stream/spans` Tauri Channel events — chunk #32 reads aggregated values, never re-emits at higher cardinality (per obs-plan §1 Telemetry triggers creator-explicit-telemetry rows).

- (obs) Service identity (`service.name = "com.andromeda.pulse"`, `service.version`, `deployment.environment = "production"`) is registered as default subscriber fields once at boot — chunk events MUST NOT manually re-emit (per obs-plan §3 Service identity).

- (obs) Trace context propagation: existing Arrow `_trace_context` metadata column carries trace correlation; chunk #32 MUST NOT strip or re-write that metadata when consuming Channel payloads (per obs-plan §3 Trace context propagation Real-time push streams).

- (a11y) Aggregated service-count badge MUST expose non-empty accessible name — `<div role="status" aria-label="…">` with structured label like `"24 services, 1.2% average error rate"` (per a11y-plan §1 P5 critical paths ARIA Roles Inventory + §3 Screen Reader Test Pattern).

- (a11y) Footer band MUST use `role="status"` + `aria-live="polite"` (or `<output>` semantics) so live-updating ingest/error/retention values announce non-blockingly without stealing focus (per a11y-plan §1 P4 critical path + SC 4.1.3 Status Messages).

- (a11y) Footer text + badge text MUST meet SC 1.4.3 contrast minimum (4.5:1 for normal text on `--color-base` / `--color-raised-1`); use `--color-text-primary` (~8.5:1) for live numeric values (per a11y-plan §3 Contrast Verification Harness + visual-discrimination trigger row).

- (a11y) Error-rate field satisfies SC 1.4.1 Use of Color via not-color-alone — non-zero error rate conveyed by percentage text PLUS paired visual affordance (icon, border, label) (per a11y-plan §1 visual-discrimination trigger row + SC 1.4.1).

- (a11y) Halo State Pulse motion on the badge MUST respect `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` — chunk #31 wired this; chunk #32 wraps without disabling the gate (per a11y-plan §1 motion-sensitive trigger row + SC 2.3.3 AAA + SC 2.3.1 Three Flashes).

- (a11y) Compact widget focus order from chunk #30 preserved — only interactive element on surface remains the titlebar gear; ZERO new focusable elements introduced (per a11y-plan §1 P5 + keyboard-only trigger row + layouts extract §Anti-patterns).
- (a11y) Live-region announcements MUST NOT be high-frequency — debounce / coalesce announcements to ≥ 5s minimum or threshold-gate so screen readers don't thrash (per a11y-plan §1 P4 + SC 4.1.3).

- (arch) Webview React source for compact widget infographics + footer MUST live under `pulse-app/ui/src/` (binary crate's webview source root) — no new Cargo crate; no new sibling under `crates/` (per architecture.md §Infrastructure Patterns project directory structure).

- (arch) Aggregation logic for badge service count + footer ingest/error/retention numbers MUST live in `viz` library crate (or be exposed via existing `traces.*`/`metrics.*`/`logs.*` query routers); webview consumes typed values via TauRPC-generated `.d.ts` bindings; never composes a SQL fragment (per architecture.md §Modules `viz` row + §Standard Contracts).

- (arch) If chunk #32 needs persistable display preference, the LOWER-COST path is to extend the existing `Settings` struct in `crates/ui-bridge/src/contract.rs` and let it flow through `get_settings`/`update_settings` — sidesteps capability-drift triple binding (per CLAUDE.md §Session Additions 2026-05-09 entry).

- (arch) Real-time updates MUST consume existing `pulse://stream/spans` / `pulse://stream/metrics` / `pulse://stream/logs` Channel events with binary Arrow IPC payloads — NO new event name (per architecture.md §Occupied Resources Tauri IPC events + §Standard Contracts Real-time push contract).

- (arch) AppError sanitization preserved: any error path returns through the existing `AppError` `serde`-friendly enum at the TauRPC bridge — strip stack traces, file paths, library versions, Rust struct names (per architecture.md §Conventions Error response schema (Tauri IPC)).

- (arch) Self-observation discipline preserved: any `tracing` event uses `tracing` ecosystem only (no OTel SDK linked into self-runtime); a network exporter pointed at own `:4317`/`:4318` is infinite recursion (per architecture.md §Established Decisions Self-Observation).
**Patterns to follow:**

- (security) Render telemetry-derived display strings via React component children / props with default JSX escaping; truncate before render as string operation (per security plan §Threat Model Summary).

- (security) Aggregate ingest/error/retention numbers in Rust `viz` crate via DuckDB prepared statements; expose through existing `traces.*`/`metrics.*`/`logs.*` query routers; consume in webview as typed values from TauRPC-generated bindings (per security plan §Input Validation DuckDB row).

- (security) Reuse `pulse://stream/spans|metrics|logs` Channel API + binary Arrow IPC payload contract for live updates; existing size cap pattern in producing crate applies unchanged (per security plan §Input Validation Tauri IPC `Channel` API row).

- (design) Card / panel pattern for footer band: background `--color-raised-1`, 1px border `rgba(74, 144, 226, 0.3)`, padding `--spacing-md`, radius `--radius-md` (per design-system §Surface: desktop-webview Component Patterns).

- (design) Halo State Pulse signature element wraps the aggregated service-count badge — frequency 0.8–2.4 Hz from `throughput_hz / 1000`, hue LCH-interpolated Earth Blue ↔ Alert Burgundy, blur 4–16 px per cycle; reduced-motion degrades to static glow (per design-system §Brand Identity + §Motion + chunk #31 implementation).

- (design) Footer ingest/retention/error data row pattern (read-only) is pre-anchored: chunk #32 materializes the design system §Surface: desktop-webview Navigation Pattern compact widget step 3 anchor.

- (design) Iconography: footer fields use icons from custom set — e.g., `<Icon glyph="circular-pulse" />` for ingest, `<Icon glyph="constellation-grid" />` for service map; 16px size with 4px icon-to-text gap (per design-system §Iconography).
- (design) Tabular numerals for stable column readout: `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` so live-updating values don't shift layout (per design-system §Typography Data row).

- (layouts) Canvas-overlay badge pattern: badge text rendered in HTML/CSS layer above WebGPU canvas via `position: absolute` over the canvas container (per layout-templates.md §Component — Halo State Pulse canvas / Layout: container is `position: relative`).

- (layouts) Footer band pattern: `flex row, justify-content: space-between`; differs from full-dashboard footer (no time-range picker, no service filter buttons); CSS `flex-wrap` or two stacked rows are implementation choices for the retention 2nd line (per layout-templates.md §Component — Footer / Compact widget).
- (layouts) Read-only status display pattern; same status pattern reused on desktop-native tray menu summary line (per layout-templates.md §Component — Tray menu).
- (layouts) Border progression Subtle (1px top border) reuses same subtle border token applied to titlebar bottom (per layout-templates.md §Component — Custom titlebar / Border).

- (tests) DOM-shape contract assertions: assert `aria-*` attributes, `role` flips, semantic tags, `data-testid` hooks, `className` passthrough — NOT pixel positions (per test-plan §4 What unit tests cover).
- (tests) AAA test layout + one assertion concept per test (per .claude/rules/testing.md §Patterns).
- (tests) Mock the data feed, not the component — mock TauRPC subscription / store hook stub via constructor injection (per test-plan §8 What to mock).
- (tests) `vi.unstubAllGlobals()` in `afterEach` for any test stubbing `navigator`/`userAgent`/`localStorage`/`matchMedia` (per .claude/rules/testing.md §Session Additions 2026-05-08).

- (tests) `useEffect` mock-count assertion: `toHaveBeenCalled()` (≥1) for effects with async deps, NOT `toHaveBeenCalledTimes(N)` (per .claude/rules/testing.md §Session Additions 2026-05-08; chunk #28/#31 precedent).
- (tests) `useReducedMotion` consumers reset motion-dom module-globals in `beforeEach` (per .claude/rules/testing.md §Session Additions 2026-05-04).
- (tests) Decorative-vs-meaningful ARIA flip pattern: badge defaults `role="img"` + `aria-label` when meaningful; stays `aria-hidden="true"` when decorative.

- (obs) Frame-timing emission: webview computes via `performance.now()` + `device.queue.onSubmittedWorkDone()` → existing `recordFrameMs({ duration_ms, wgpu_backend, webview_backend, timing_method })` from `pulse-app/ui/src/canvas/frame-metrics.ts` (chunk #31 precedent) (per obs-plan §3 Frontend bridge).

- (obs) Aggregated metric source: `viz` query routers compute spans/sec, error %, retention via DuckDB prepared statements; webview consumes typed values from TauRPC bindings (per obs-plan §1 Telemetry triggers creator-explicit-telemetry rows + §2 Naming conventions).

- (obs) Stable-shape contract for reduced-motion path: same metric event shape as animated path (e.g., `recordFrameMs({ duration_ms: 0, timing_method: "cpu" })`) so agent reading log cannot tell motion was suppressed without inspecting `duration_ms` (per chunk #31 phase-28 plan §Implementation Steps step 5 Stable shape).

- (a11y) Aggregated badge naming pattern: `
{N} services
` — visual text + complete-sentence aria-label.

- (a11y) Footer band semantic shape: `<footer role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-label="Live telemetry summary"><dl><dt>Ingest</dt><dd>{spans/sec}</dd>...</dl></footer>` — definition list gives label/value pairing semantic structure (per a11y-plan §1 P4 ARIA inventory + SC 1.3.1 Info and Relationships).

- (a11y) Reduced-motion test pattern: `mockReducedMotion(true)` in vitest unit tests; assert `requestAnimationFrame` not called for halo + assert color/text/focus state changes still convey error rate transitions (chunk #31 precedent).
- (a11y) Decorative-vs-meaningful icon flip: footer field icons stay `aria-hidden="true"` because adjacent text label carries meaning (per chunk #11 icons decorative default).

- (arch) Settings extension pattern (chunk #30 precedent): if persistable preference added, extend `Settings` in `crates/ui-bridge/src/contract.rs` + add boot helper + apply via `pulse-app/src/main.rs` setup closure — exactly chunk #30 `always_on_top` shape (per CLAUDE.md §Session Additions 2026-05-09).

- (arch) Webview consumes TauRPC-generated bindings from `pulse-app/ui/src/bindings/index.ts` (or wherever Specta emits) — no manual TS re-declaration (per architecture.md §Established Decisions TauRPC choice).

- (arch) Arrow IPC consumption pattern: webview decodes `pulse://stream/*` Channel binary payloads via existing Arrow IPC reader path (chunk #23 + downstream); chunk #32 reuses, decoding only the columns it displays (`service_count`, `error_rate_percent`, `retention_seconds`, `throughput_events_per_sec`).

- (arch) Stable Contract envelope: chunk does NOT modify `app_info`/`health`/`ready` shapes; webview reads `subsystems.buffer.rows_ingested`/`subsystems.buffer.retention_seconds` from existing `health` JSON if needed (per architecture.md §Standard Contracts Tauri IPC introspection).

- (arch) Reuse chunk #31 HaloCanvas as badge halo wrapper — already exports foundational shader + LCH interpolation + reduced-motion gate; chunk #32 imports it and places badge text inside or behind it (per chunk #31 phase-28 plan §Acceptance criteria design "portable enough for compact-widget aggregated-badge").
**Anti-patterns to avoid:**

- (security) NEVER inject service-name strings, error-message snippets, or any OTLP-attribute-derived content into webview DOM via `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`, `innerHTML`, or string-concatenated style attributes (per security plan Anti-Patterns §Logging row 1 + §Threat Model Summary).

- (security) NEVER add a new `pulse://stream/*` event name or new TauRPC procedure for the footer band without matching `pulse-app/capabilities/` JSON entry AND `/andromeda-scope-arch` legitimization in arch §Occupied Resources before merge — carry-over D3 (4 missing entries from chunks #23+#29) MUST NOT compound (per security plan Anti-Patterns §API row 3 + CLAUDE.md §Session Additions 2026-05-09).

- (security) NEVER widen `pulse:notification` or `pulse:tray` capabilities — both are outbound-emit-only; any incoming-event handler requires separately-named capability with stated rationale (per security plan Anti-Patterns §API row 6).

- (design) NEVER apply gradient overlays, glassmorphic backdrop blur, or drop-shadows to footer band or badge container — flat matte surfaces with intentional color blocking; the WebGPU Halo is the ONLY exception, and it lives on its dedicated canvas layer (per design-system §Anti-Patterns Universal Bans + §Depth Strategy).

- (design) NEVER convey error state via background color alone — pair `--color-accent` with text/icon affordance per "NEVER use color purely for decoration" Universal Ban (per design-system §Anti-Patterns Universal Bans).

- (design) NEVER use Inter / Roboto / Arial / Helvetica / system-ui default for labels; both `--font-body` and `--font-code` are locked, bundled WOFF2 locally (per design-system §Anti-Patterns Universal Bans).
- (design) NEVER use generic loading spinner or static color swatch in place of Halo on aggregated badge — Signature Test #3 requirement (per design-system §Self-Validation Protocol §3).

- (design) NEVER use entrance animations / staggered reveals / opacity fades > 200ms on footer band on data updates; per 0.35 expression budget, entrance animations are NONE (per design-system §Motion Hard limits).

- (layouts) NEVER embed the badge inside the footer band — divorces the halo from the badge it circles; mis-locates the signature element (per layout-templates.md §Surface: desktop-webview / Signature placement).

- (layouts) NEVER add interactive controls to compact widget footer — read-only status display per layout-templates.md §Wireframe — Compact widget notes; time-range picker / service filter is full-dashboard footer territory only.
- (layouts) NEVER introduce navigation / tabs / sidebars to compact widget — settings via gear icon (modal) is the only navigation per layout-templates.md §Component — Primary navigation / IA model.

- (layouts) NEVER let badge or footer overlap / occlude each other or the canvas — three distinct horizontal bands (titlebar / canvas-with-badge-overlay / footer); badge stays inside canvas band's bottom-right quadrant.
- (layouts) NEVER deep-link from compact widget — per IA notes "no deep links (glance-only surface)".
- (tests) NO canvas pixel inspection / visual regression / Percy / Chromatic — "glance-readable from 2m" verified via DOM-shape (per test-plan §11 Universal + Anti-Patterns E2E).
- (tests) NO `sleep(N)` for sync — use `findBy*` matchers / `waitFor()` / explicit mock-call assertions (per .claude/rules/testing.md §Synchronization).
- (tests) NO real `setTimeout` / `setInterval` / `Date.now()` in tests — use `vi.useFakeTimers()` (per .claude/rules/testing.md §Patterns).
- (tests) NO `toHaveBeenCalledTimes(N)` for useEffect-driven mocks with async deps (per .claude/rules/testing.md §Session Additions 2026-05-08).
- (tests) NO snapshot tests for badge/footer markup; assert specific DOM contracts (per agent-driven discipline + test-plan §11).
- (tests) NO inline boot-smoke gate — chunk #32 webview-only is exempt per 2026-05-09 amendment.

- (obs) NEVER add `metric.compact_widget.*` or `metric.footer.*` as new event-target prefix — reuse `metric.webgpu.frame_duration_ms` from chunk #29 (per obs-plan §2 Naming conventions + §3 Frontend bridge).

- (obs) NEVER log raw OTLP attribute values, service-name strings derived from buffer telemetry, or any user-controlled host-app content (per obs-plan §1 logging-sensitive triggers Vector 1 + §2 high-cardinality avoidance).

- (obs) NEVER point a network exporter at `:4317`/`:4318` — `tracing` ecosystem only; an OTel network exporter pointed at own ports is infinite recursion (per obs-plan §3 Tracing init + CLAUDE.md §Critical Warnings).
- (a11y) NEVER use color alone (e.g., red footer background) to convey "error state active" — violates SC 1.4.1.
- (a11y) NEVER announce sub-second-cadence footer numeric churn via `aria-live="assertive"` — SR thrash anti-pattern; use `role="status"` (implicit polite) and debounce.
- (a11y) NEVER add new focusable interactive element to compact widget footer band — read-only by layout-templates contract; introducing tab stop breaks chunk #30's focus order baseline.

- (arch) NEVER add new TauRPC procedure or `pulse://stream/*` event name without matching `pulse-app/capabilities/` JSON entry AND `/andromeda-scope-arch` legitimization in arch §Occupied Resources — triple binding; carry-over D3 MUST NOT compound (per architecture.md §Cross-cutting Patterns + CLAUDE.md §Critical Warnings).

- (arch) NEVER bypass the `viz` query layer by composing SQL strings or Arrow filters in webview JavaScript — prepared-statement boundary is the security ↔ arch contract (per architecture.md §Conventions DuckDB tables + §Modules `viz`).

- (arch) NEVER introduce webview-only secondary IPC mechanism (e.g., fetch to localhost dev server, custom message-port) — TauRPC-generated bindings + Tauri Channel events are the only authorized webview IPC (per architecture.md §Cross-cutting Patterns Webview IPC capability policy).
**Contract bindings:**

- **security ↔ obs (tracing redaction)**: chunk #32 footer-band metrics emit through `tracing`; security PII discipline (no raw OTLP attribute values, aggregated counts only) constrains the obs schema; both sides agree at subscriber-layer central redaction (security extract §Contract bindings + obs extract §Anti-patterns).

- **security ↔ a11y (CSP and glance-readability)**: chunk #32 "glance-readable from 2m" implies large typography + high-contrast tokens; CSP `style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'` posture is the constraint a11y-side typography token usage operates under; no remote font origins; if a11y adds dynamic style attributes, MUST be from first-party static token values only (security extract §Contract bindings).

- **security ↔ arch (capability/IPC tri-sync)**: if chunk needs new TauRPC procedure (despite Settings-extension preferred), security capability JSON entry binds to arch §Occupied Resources update binds to xtask `EXPECTED_PROCEDURES` extension — all three required pre-merge (security + arch + CLAUDE.md §Session Additions 2026-05-09 reciprocal).

- **design ↔ a11y (contrast)**: footer numeric/label text on `--color-raised-1` / `--color-base` backgrounds must meet SC 1.4.3 — `--color-text-primary` (~8.5:1) preferred for live numeric values; `--color-text-secondary` (~6.8:1) for descriptive labels (design + a11y reciprocal).

- **design ↔ a11y (motion + reduced-motion)**: Halo State Pulse on aggregated badge respects `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`; chunk #31 wired this; chunk #32 must NOT regress (design + a11y reciprocal).

- **design ↔ a11y (not-color-alone)**: footer error-rate field pairs `--color-accent` border/icon with text — error rate as numeric value satisfies SC 1.4.1 because percentage carries meaning (design + a11y reciprocal).

- **design ↔ obs (constellation badge as service count)**: aggregated badge displays service count from buffer broadcast; design supplies visual surface; obs supplies source signal + may instrument render-frame timing via `telemetry.frontend.record_frame_ms` (design + obs reciprocal).

- **design ↔ tests (token enforcement lint)**: chunk #32 changes UI surface; tests specialist's lint targets (motion durations, easing names, banned-fonts list, banned effects) apply (design + tests reciprocal).

- **layouts ↔ design (typography / colour tokens)**: footer cites `font-data`, `color-text-tertiary`, `color-accent` — concrete typography/colour resolution belongs to design extractor (layouts → design unilateral; design extract supplies the specifics).

- **layouts ↔ a11y (live-region semantics)**: badge + footer carry live status text; binds to a11y `aria-live`/`role="status"` for SR announcements (layouts → a11y unilateral; a11y extract supplies `<dl>` structure + debounce contract).

- **layouts ↔ arch (viz / TauRPC stream)**: badge + footer numbers come from `pulse://stream/spans` / `pulse://stream/metrics`; aggregation in viz crate (layouts → arch reciprocal; arch supplies the contract).

- **layouts ↔ chunk #31 (Halo dependency)**: unified halo from chunk #31 visually circles aggregated badge — badge MUST occupy bottom-right quadrant for halo to enclose geometrically (one-sided dependency on shipped predecessor chunk).

- **layouts ↔ chunk #30 (Compact widget shell dependency)**: chunk #30 owns titlebar + window chrome + always-on-top + snap-to-edge + Settings persistence; chunk #32 hangs inside shell's content viewport (one-sided dependency on shipped predecessor).

- **tests ↔ obs (status endpoint shape)**: if footer band reads `subsystems.buffer.rows_ingested` / `subsystems.buffer.retention_seconds` / `subsystems.ingest_channel.broadcast_subscribers` from `health` TauRPC, field schema is shared contract (tests + obs reciprocal).
- **tests ↔ a11y (DOM contract for ARIA)**: badge `role`/`aria-label` + footer `aria-live` sit at tests/a11y boundary — tests assert DOM contract; a11y owns WCAG semantics (tests + a11y reciprocal).

- **tests ↔ design tokens (className passthrough)**: tests assert classNames + token-class application; design owns token semantics; NO hardcoded hex/px in test assertions (tests + design reciprocal).

- **obs ↔ a11y (live-region observability)**: when footer band threshold crossing triggers meaningful aria-live announcement, no `tracing::info!` event with user-facing text emitted; obs captures underlying state change as `metric.trace.error_rate_percent`; a11y captures SR contract as DOM markup (obs + a11y reciprocal).

   - Pure-function formatters: `formatSpansPerSec(throughputHz: number): string` (e.g., `1234` → `"1.2k/s"`, `45` → `"45/s"`); `formatErrorRatePercent(errorRate: number): string` (e.g., `0.012` → `"1.2%"`); `formatRetentionMinutes(usedSeconds: number, maxSeconds: number): string` (e.g., `(480, 600)` → `"8m / 10m"`); `formatServiceCount(count: number): string` (e.g., `24` → `"24"`); `formatBadgeAriaLabel(serviceCount: number, errorRate: number): string` (e.g., `(24, 0.012)` → `"24 services, 1.2% average error rate"`).
   - Co-located `widget-types.test.ts` table-drives each formatter with edge cases (0, large numbers, NaN/Infinity collapse to `"—"` placeholder, threshold boundaries).

4. **Synthetic widget metrics simulator hook** — write `pulse-app/ui/src/hooks/use-synthetic-widget-metrics.ts` exporting `useSyntheticWidgetMetrics(): WidgetMetrics`. Drives values from `setInterval` at slow cadence (e.g., 1000ms) over a sine-wave curve so footer numbers don't flicker every 250ms (which would trigger SR thrash and look chaotic): `serviceCount` ∈ {3, 5, 8, 12, 18, 24, 30, 24, 18, 12} cycled (or sine-mapped to integer count); `throughputHz` ∈ [200, 1800] sine-wave (matches HaloCanvas range); `errorRate` ∈ [0, 0.10] sine-wave (so accent threshold 5% is crossed regularly for visual verification); `retentionUsedSeconds` linearly ramps 0 → 600 then resets (10-minute simulation); `retentionMaxSeconds` constant 600. Cleanup interval on unmount. Co-located `use-synthetic-widget-metrics.test.ts` asserts: hook returns `WidgetMetrics` shape; values stay within documented bounds; `setInterval` cleared on unmount.

data.head: ### Chunk route#4: "xtask agent-run harness — 5-command discipline (boot/run/status/cleanup/logs) + health TauRPC command (status/subsystems/pid/uptime_ms) + PID file + JSON log format"

body: **Constraints across domains:**

- (security) `health` TauRPC procedure MUST be registered in BOTH the owning `ui-bridge` router AND `pulse-app/capabilities/default.json` — Tauri 2 capabilities are negative-default; missing entry = silent runtime rejection (per security plan §API Security TauRPC capability authorization).

- (security) `health` MUST return `Result<HealthEnvelope, AppError>` — `AppError` is the `serde`-friendly enum (`Validation`/`NotFound`/`Internal`/`Plugin`/`Storage`/`Ingest`); never serialize `anyhow::Error` directly across the bridge (per security plan §Error Handling TauRPC bridge).

- (security) PID file path resolution MUST canonicalize via `strict-path` and assert resolved path lives under the resolved data dir (or `ANDROMEDA_PULSE_DATA_DIR` override) — CWE-22 path-traversal class defense (per security plan §Input Validation env-var row).

- (security) `xtask` MUST NOT pass externally-sourced strings into `tokio::process::Command::new(...).arg(...)` without prior validation — MCP STDIO command-injection class (per security plan §Anti-Patterns Code Patterns).

- (security) JSON log format MUST apply field redaction at the `tracing-subscriber` Layer (not at log call sites); NEVER-log list enforced from day 1 (per security plan §Logging & Monitoring + `logging-redaction-wire` bootstrap).

- (security) `health` envelope MUST sanitize internal subsystem identifiers to stable Standard-Contract strings (`otlp_grpc_receiver`, `otlp_http_receiver`, `buffer`, `ingest_channel`); failure reasons collapse to short strings with no Rust struct names / file paths / library versions.

- (arch) Harness code lives in `xtask` crate (workspace-reserved name); `health` command implementation lives in `ui-bridge` crate; neither relocatable / renamable / mergeable (per arch §Occupied Resources + §Inherited Defaults).

- (arch) `health` TauRPC procedure MUST conform to §Standard Contracts envelope: top-level bare `snake_case` verb (no router prefix), returning `{ status, checked_at, subsystems }` with `status ∈ {"ok","degraded"}`, `checked_at` as RFC 3339 UTC, `subsystems` as string-keyed map. Note: tests-plan §3 + obs-plan §3 both extend this with `pid` + `uptime_ms` fields per the chunk title — this is the canonical envelope at chunk #4 implementation time.

- (arch) PID file location MUST sit under the per-platform resolved data root respecting `ANDROMEDA_PULSE_DATA_DIR` overrides; no new top-level subdir beyond `config.toml` / `plugins/` / `snapshots/` / `logs/` without scope-arch event (per arch §Occupied Resources Filesystem locations).

- (arch) JSON log format emission targets `~/.andromeda-pulse/logs/`; uses no OTLP network exporter — self-observation is `tracing` + file/stdout sinks only (per arch §Established Decisions [Self-Observation]).
- (arch) 5-command harness surface realized through `cargo xtask <subcommand>` only — `xtask` is locked CI task runner (per arch §Stack + §Cross-cutting Patterns Development Style).

- (tests) 5-command discipline MUST be materialized in `scripts/agent-run.sh` (or xtask equivalent) per test-plan §3 5-command implementation bodies (per test-plan §3 Bootstrap phase 2 `5-command-discipline-wire`).

- (tests) `boot` MUST poll `health` TauRPC every 500ms up to 10s timeout, asserting `status == "ok"` AND `subsystems.otlp_grpc_receiver.status == "initialized"` AND `subsystems.buffer.status == "ready"` before returning exit 0.

- (tests) `health` MUST return canonical envelope: `status` enum + `subsystems` object with otlp_grpc_receiver + otlp_http_receiver + buffer + ingest_channel + `pid` + `uptime_ms` (binding contract — both surfaces share one shape).

- (tests) Receiver subsystem statuses (otlp_grpc_receiver / otlp_http_receiver / buffer / ingest_channel) initialize as placeholder values at chunk-completion time since chunks #15-#18 implement actual receivers; envelope must accept canonical key set BEFORE subsystems exist.
- (tests) `cleanup` MUST be idempotent (kill -TERM + wait + escalate kill -9 if needed); second invocation no-op.
- (tests) `logs` MUST emit Rust `tracing` JSON-lines with required fields `timestamp` / `level` / `target` / `message` / optional `fields`.

- (tests) PID file location MUST follow XDG-spec primary `$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/andromeda-pulse.pid` with `~/.andromeda-pulse/run/andromeda-pulse.pid` fallback (Linux), `$TMPDIR/andromeda-pulse.pid` (macOS), `%LOCALAPPDATA%\andromeda-pulse\pid` (Windows); written at `boot` after `ready` confirms; format is single decimal PID.

- (obs) Service identity is compile-time per obs-plan §3: `service.name = "com.andromeda.pulse"` (Tauri bundle id, fallback `env!("CARGO_PKG_NAME")`); `service.version = env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION")`; `deployment.environment = "production"`. NEVER hardcode `"myapp"`.
- (obs) Log file path FIXED per obs-plan §3: `~/.andromeda-pulse/logs/agent-latest.jsonl` default with per-platform overrides; configurable via `ANDROMEDA_PULSE_DATA_DIR`.
- (obs) Log level gated via `EnvFilter::from_env("ANDROMEDA_PULSE_LOG_LEVEL")` with `RUST_LOG` fallback; xtask harness must pass-through (NOT override) user env vars to spawned `pulse-app` child.

- (obs) Heartbeat tick interval per obs-plan §3: 15s for long-running subsystems via `tokio::time::interval(Duration::from_secs(15))`; stall threshold = >45s gap. Tick targets `{module}.tick`. Per-tick fields: `span_count`, `buffer_capacity_pct`, `broadcast_subscribers`, `rows_ingested`, `eviction_count`, etc.
- (obs) Status endpoint shape: `status` xtask subcommand calls `health` over IPC and returns subsystem fields matching `*.tick` event field names — binding contract that tests §3 also consumes.
- (obs) For app stderr: dual sink — stderr (pretty-printed when TTY for dev convenience, JSON when not a TTY) + file (always JSON-only via `tracing-appender`).

- (obs) Panic hook installed at boot per obs-plan §3 + §7: `std::panic::set_hook(...)` calling `tracing::error!(target: "app.panic.fatal", ...)` with `tracing-error` SpanTrace — zero-unlogged-panics SLO enforcement.
**Patterns к follow:**
- (security) TauRPC procedure pattern with `AppError` boundary: every `#[taurpc::procedure]` returns `Result<T, AppError>`; `From` impls from module-internal `thiserror` enums.

- (security) Path env-var canonicalization pattern: `ANDROMEDA_PULSE_*_PATH` / `*_DIR` flows through `strict-path` canonicalize + confine-under-data-dir assertion before any I/O — same pattern future plugin loader / config loader will reuse.
- (security) Capability-JSON pairing pattern: `xtask capability-drift` introspects `taurpc` derives and diffs against `pulse-app/capabilities/*.json`; CI fails on mismatch.
- (security) Structured-logging redaction pattern: `tracing` + `tracing-subscriber` JSON layer with redaction filter at the subscriber, not at call sites.

- (arch) Cross-cutting envelope procedure shape: `health` is top-level bare `snake_case` verb (no router prefix), grouped with `app_info` / `ready` / `get_settings` / `update_settings` and owned by `ui-bridge` crate.
- (arch) Subsystem key naming inside `subsystems` map mirrors `otlp_grpc_receiver` / `otlp_http_receiver` / `buffer` / `ingest_channel` — `snake_case` shape.
- (arch) Module-internal error types are `thiserror` 2.x enums; `xtask` binary uses `anyhow::Result` at top-level (`main`); `xtask` is non-IPC, so `anyhow` is the boundary, not `AppError`.
- (arch) `xtask` lives at workspace root alongside `pulse-app/`; subcommand surface is contributor-facing parity layer for CI steps.
- (arch) Module dependency direction: `xtask` may depend on workspace member crates downward but no library crate depends on `xtask` or `pulse-app`.
- (arch) Configuration precedence: env vars (`ANDROMEDA_PULSE_*`, `RUST_LOG`) > user `config.toml` > built-in defaults.
- (tests) Boot/cleanup verification via `health` poll + TCP handshake check, NOT `sleep N` — mirrors test-plan §11 E2E anti-pattern.
- (tests) JSON-line log format consumed by agent-parseable signals: `jq 'select(.level == "ERROR") | .message'`; `grep 'listening on 127.0.0.1:4317'`; `! grep 'query parameters:'`.
- (tests) Per-test isolation via `ANDROMEDA_PULSE_DATA_DIR=$TMPDIR/andromeda-test-$$` + ephemeral ports — keeps harness composable for Epoch 2+ integration tests.
- (obs) Span/target naming: `{module}.{operation}` for spans (e.g., `app.boot.workspace.detect`); for harness lifecycle, follow `app.boot.*`, `tray.{event}` naming families.

- (obs) `logs` subcommand consumption pattern per obs-plan §3 Snapshot/paste-to-AI integration: JSON log file is "JSON-per-line, immediately greppable / `jq`-able / paste-to-LLM-able" — `logs` subcommand defaults to tailing or printing latest JSONL unprocessed.
**Anti-patterns к avoid:**
- (security) NEVER expose stack traces, file paths, Rust struct names, or library versions in `AppError::Internal { message }` content surfaced to webview via `health`.
- (security) NEVER read `ANDROMEDA_PULSE_DATA_DIR` without `Path::canonicalize()` + assertion — CWE-22 traversal class.
- (security) NEVER `tokio::process::Command::new(...).arg(user_input)` against env-sourced strings.
- (arch) NEVER rename `xtask` crate, `health` procedure, or four locked subsystem keys — canonical names reserved.
- (arch) NEVER introduce OTel SDK or OTLP network exporter to emit JSON logs (architectural infinite-loop).
- (arch) NEVER add new `ANDROMEDA_PULSE_*` env var, new top-level `~/.andromeda-pulse/` subdir, or new TauRPC procedure outside §Occupied Resources reserved list without scope-arch event.
- (tests) NEVER use `sleep(N)` for boot synchronization — wait on `health` polling.
- (tests) NEVER ship `health` response that omits any canonical subsystem key or `pid` / `uptime_ms` fields — agent polling logic depends on shape stability.
- (tests) NEVER include manual smoke step in `boot` — every signal must be machine-parseable.
- (obs) NEVER write to stdout from rmcp stdio sidecar code path (corrupts JSON-RPC 2.0 framing).
- (obs) NEVER use unstructured stderr text — JSON formatter mandatory for file sink; pretty-printed only acceptable on stderr-when-TTY.
- (obs) NEVER hardcode `service.name` literal that bypasses compile-time identity source.
- (obs) NEVER skip panic hook install at boot — zero-unlogged-panics SLO.
- (obs) NEVER lose log file artifacts when `cleanup` invoked — log file is primary CI artifact; cleanup must preserve previous-day rotated files.
- (obs) NEVER use multi-line stack traces — SpanTrace via `tracing-error` is convention.
**Contract bindings:**

- **tests ↔ obs (HEAVY)**: `health` envelope shape (status / subsystems / pid / uptime_ms) is owned jointly. tests-plan §3 Status endpoint shape defines agent-polled fields; obs-plan §3 Observability Harness Contract defines same envelope as canonical liveness JSON. **Both must agree exactly.** Subsystem fields in `health` must mirror `*.tick` event field names so `subsystems.ingest.span_count`, `subsystems.buffer.rows_ingested` etc.

- **tests ↔ obs (JSON log)**: `tracing-subscriber::fmt().json()` schema (`timestamp` / `level` / `target` / `message` / `fields`) — tests-plan §3 Log format depends on obs-plan §3 JSON schema; harness greps file at obs-declared path. Bootstrap phase 4 `log-format-bind-with-obs` is the explicit bind point.

- **arch ↔ tests + obs on envelope**: arch fixes the `{ status, checked_at, subsystems }` shape; tests + obs both extend with `pid` + `uptime_ms`. Implementation uses the tests/obs canonical (extended) envelope at this chunk; arch shape is compatible (additions, not contradictions).

- **security ↔ obs (logging redaction)**: JSON log format established here is substrate for `logging-redaction-wire` bootstrap phase. obs owns the subscriber-Layer schema; security owns NEVER-log enforcement. Both sides land in this chunk because the JSON log format binds the contract.

- **security ↔ tests (capability-JSON pairing)**: `health` TauRPC + capability JSON entry together form binding contract for tests-plan §3 5-command discipline. Capability-drift xtask check (lands at chunk #19 per tests extract OR could land here per security extract — orchestrator notes ambiguity for Phase 4 plan decision) is the per-PR enforcement.

- **arch ↔ ui-bridge / error sanitization**: `health` envelope crosses TauRPC bridge as `Serialize` payload — every field is `serde::Serialize`; error path returns `AppError::Internal { message }` with sanitized content per security's redaction rules.

data.head: # Phase 3 Plan — chunk route#4: "xtask agent-run harness — 5-command discipline + health TauRPC + PID file + JSON log format"

body:
_Generated by /andromeda-phase Phase 4. Read by /andromeda-implement.
Manual edits between runs are fine; do not edit during /implement run._
- **Phase number:** 3

- **Route chunks covered:** route#4 "xtask agent-run harness — 5-command discipline (boot/run/status/cleanup/logs) + health TauRPC command (status/subsystems/pid/uptime_ms) + PID file + JSON log format"
- **Epoch:** Foundation

Make `cargo xtask harness:status` and the TauRPC `health` command work end-to-end — together they unblock the agent-driven verification harness scripts (already in place at `scripts/agent-run.{sh,ps1}` from prior setup-project) and seed the binding contracts that tests-plan §3 + obs-plan §3 jointly own. New code lives in three crates: `ui-bridge` (defines `health` procedure + canonical `AppError` enum), `pulse-app` (installs JSON log subscriber + panic hook + PID file write + registers TauRPC handler), and `xtask` (`harness:status` subcommand calls `health` via Tauri test-runtime IPC and prints JSON). Net result: `bash scripts/agent-run.sh boot` reaches "ready" via `health` poll within 10s; `status` prints canonical envelope with `status` + `subsystems` (4 placeholder keys) + `pid` + `uptime_ms`; `logs` tails JSON-per-line file at `~/.andromeda-pulse/logs/agent-latest.jsonl`; `cleanup` is idempotent. Anchored to arch §Standard Contracts liveness + §Established Decisions [Self-Observation] + tests-plan §3 5-command discipline + obs-plan §3 Observability Harness Contract + security plan §API Security capability authorization.

1. **Add workspace deps** to root `Cargo.toml [workspace.dependencies]`: `taurpc` (latest Tauri 2-compatible version — verify at write time; pin to known-good if uncertain), `strict-path` (latest), `chrono = { version = "0.4", features = ["serde"] }`, `clap = { version = "4", features = ["derive"] }`. (`tracing-subscriber`, `tracing-appender`, `tracing-error` already in workspace per chunk #1.)
2. **Expand `crates/ui-bridge/Cargo.toml`** — add `serde.workspace = true`, `taurpc.workspace = true`, `tauri.workspace = true`, `chrono.workspace = true`. Keep existing `thiserror.workspace = true`.

3. **Replace `crates/ui-bridge/src/contract.rs`** — define the canonical `AppError` enum per arch §Conventions Error response schema with variants `Validation { field: String, reason: String }` / `NotFound { resource: String }` / `Internal { message: String }` / `Plugin { plugin_id: String, message: String }` / `Storage { message: String }` / `Ingest { message: String }`. Derive `serde::Serialize`, `serde::Deserialize`, `thiserror::Error`. Add `Display` impls per `thiserror`. Each variant message must be sanitized — no stack traces / file paths / Rust struct names / library versions (per security plan §Error Handling sanitization).

4. **Create `crates/ui-bridge/src/health.rs`** — define `HealthEnvelope { status: HealthStatus, checked_at: chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>, subsystems: SubsystemStatuses, pid: u32, uptime_ms: u64 }` (canonical extended envelope per tests-plan §3 + obs-plan §3 + arch §Standard Contracts), `HealthStatus { Ok, Degraded }` enum (`#[serde(rename_all = "lowercase")]`), `SubsystemStatuses { otlp_grpc_receiver: SubsystemStatus, otlp_http_receiver: SubsystemStatus, buffer: SubsystemStatus, ingest_channel: SubsystemStatus }`, `SubsystemStatus { status: String /* "initialized" | "ready" | "error" */, error_msg: Option<String> }`. Implement the `health` TauRPC procedure as a `#[taurpc::procedures]`-derived trait method returning `Result<HealthEnvelope, AppError>` with placeholder subsystem values (`{status: "initialized", error_msg: None}` for now since chunks #15-#18 implement actual receivers). Read `pid` from `std::process::id()` and `uptime_ms` from a process-start `Instant` captured at boot (passed via Tauri state or static `OnceLock`).

5. **Update `crates/ui-bridge/src/lib.rs`** — `pub mod contract; pub mod health;`. Re-export `AppError` and `HealthEnvelope` for downstream consumption: `pub use contract::AppError; pub use health::HealthEnvelope;`.

6. **Expand `pulse-app/Cargo.toml`** — add `tracing-subscriber.workspace = true`, `tracing-appender.workspace = true`, `tracing-error.workspace = true`, `taurpc.workspace = true`, `strict-path.workspace = true`, `ui-bridge = { path = "../crates/ui-bridge" }`. Keep existing tokio / tracing / serde_json / tauri / tauri-plugin-updater + optional mcp-server-crate.

7. **Rewrite `pulse-app/src/main.rs`** — significant expansion (target ~50-80 lines):
    a. Resolve data dir: read `ANDROMEDA_PULSE_DATA_DIR` env var; fall back to per-platform default (`dirs::data_local_dir()` or manual platform dispatch); canonicalize via `strict-path` and assert resolved path is creatable.
    b. Create `{data_dir}/logs/` and `{data_dir}/run/` subdirs.
    c. Init `tracing` subscriber: `tracing_subscriber::registry().with(EnvFilter::from_env("ANDROMEDA_PULSE_LOG_LEVEL").or_else(|_| EnvFilter::from_env("RUST_LOG")).unwrap_or_else(|_| EnvFilter::new("info"))).with(fmt::Layer::default().json().with_writer(non_blocking_file).with_default_fields([("service.name", "com.andromeda.pulse"), ("service.version", env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION")), ("deployment.environment", "production")])).with(ErrorLayer::default()).init();` — file appender via `tracing_appender::rolling::daily({data_dir}/logs, "agent-latest.jsonl")` returning a `non_blocking_file` writer.
    d. Install panic hook: `std::panic::set_hook(Box::new(|info| { tracing::error!(target: "app.panic.fatal", panic_message = %info, location = ?info.location(), spantrace = ?tracing_error::SpanTrace::capture()); }));`.
    e. Capture process start time: `static APP_START: OnceLock<Instant> = OnceLock::new(); APP_START.set(Instant::now()).ok();` — `health` procedure reads it for `uptime_ms`.
    f. Resolve PID file path via `strict-path`: `{data_dir}/run/andromeda-pulse.pid` (matches scripts' fallback location; XDG_RUNTIME_DIR primary deferred per research §Open question 4). Write `std::process::id().to_string()` to file at the canonicalized path (assert canonical path lives under data_dir).
    g. Build TauRPC router: `let health_router = ui_bridge::health::Router::default();` (or whatever `taurpc::procedures` derive generates — verify pattern), pass to `tauri::Builder::default().plugin(tauri_plugin_updater::Builder::new().build()).invoke_handler(taurpc::create_ipc_handler!(health_router)).run(generate_context!())`.
    h. On graceful shutdown: ensure PID file removed (Tauri's app exit hook OR Drop guard).

8. **Update `pulse-app/capabilities/default.json`** — add `"health"` (or per-`taurpc` permission shape — verify at implementation; likely just the bare procedure name) to the `"permissions"` array. Refresh description to drop the "populated as TauRPC routers land via xtask capability-drift gate (route#22)" forward-pointer; replace with "Default capability for compact widget + main dashboard webviews; permits the cross-cutting envelope procedures (`health` + future `app_info`/`ready`/`get_settings`/`update_settings`) per arch §Standard Contracts."

9. **Expand `xtask/Cargo.toml`** — add `anyhow.workspace = true`, `clap = { workspace = true, features = ["derive"] }`, `tauri = { workspace = true, features = ["test"] }`, `taurpc.workspace = true`, `serde_json.workspace = true`, `ui-bridge = { path = "../crates/ui-bridge" }`, `tokio = { workspace = true, features = ["macros", "rt-multi-thread"] }`.

10. **Rewrite `xtask/src/main.rs`** — replace placeholder with `clap`-based dispatcher (target ~40-70 lines):
    a. Parse `clap` derive: subcommand `harness` with sub-sub `status` (extensible to add `boot` / `cleanup` later if scripts migrate).
    b. `harness:status` body — async (tokio main): build `tauri::test::mock_builder()` with the same `taurpc::create_ipc_handler!` chain as `pulse-app/src/main.rs`; call `get_ipc_response::<HealthEnvelope>("health", ())` async; print result as `serde_json::to_string_pretty(&envelope)?` to stdout; exit code 0 on `envelope.status == HealthStatus::Ok`, exit 1 otherwise.
    c. Top-level error handling: `anyhow::Result<()>` boundary; `?` operator throughout; `eprintln!("xtask error: {:?}", e)` on bail.

11. **Run validation**: `cargo build --workspace` (regenerates Cargo.lock); `cargo deny check bans` (likely needs deny.toml skip-list extension if `taurpc` brings new transitive duplicates — extend per session-handoff Tier-2 pattern); `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings`; `cargo fmt --check`; `cargo nextest run --workspace --profile ci --no-tests=pass`; `bash scripts/agent-run.sh boot && bash scripts/agent-run.sh status | jq -e '.status == "ok"' && bash scripts/agent-run.sh cleanup` end-to-end roundtrip.
- `crates/ui-bridge/src/health.rs` — `HealthEnvelope` + `SubsystemStatuses` + `health` TauRPC procedure with placeholder subsystem values per tests-plan §3 placeholder constraint.
- `Cargo.toml` (workspace root) — `[workspace.dependencies]` += `taurpc` + `strict-path` + `chrono` + `clap`.
- `crates/ui-bridge/Cargo.toml` — `[dependencies]` += `serde.workspace = true` + `taurpc.workspace = true` + `tauri.workspace = true` + `chrono.workspace = true`.
- `crates/ui-bridge/src/contract.rs` — replace `Error::Placeholder` with canonical `AppError` enum (6 variants per arch §Conventions).
- `crates/ui-bridge/src/lib.rs` — add `pub mod health;` + re-exports (`pub use contract::AppError;` + `pub use health::HealthEnvelope;`).

- `pulse-app/Cargo.toml` — `[dependencies]` += `tracing-subscriber.workspace = true` + `tracing-appender.workspace = true` + `tracing-error.workspace = true` + `taurpc.workspace = true` + `strict-path.workspace = true` + `ui-bridge = { path = "../crates/ui-bridge" }`.

- `pulse-app/src/main.rs` — significant expansion: data-dir resolution + JSON subscriber init + panic hook + process start `OnceLock` + PID file write + TauRPC handler registration. Net new ~40-70 lines on top of the current 6.
- `pulse-app/capabilities/default.json` — `"permissions"` += `"health"` (or `taurpc`-specific shape); description refreshed.
- `xtask/Cargo.toml` — significant expansion: `[dependencies]` += `anyhow` + `clap` + `tauri` (with `test` feature) + `taurpc` + `serde_json` + `ui-bridge` + `tokio`.
- `xtask/src/main.rs` — rewrite from placeholder to `clap` dispatcher with `harness:status` body. Net new ~40-70 lines.
- `Cargo.lock` (auto-regenerated by `cargo build`; committed).
- (conditional) `deny.toml` — extend `[bans] skip` list if `taurpc` 0.6+ brings new known-benign transitive duplicates per session-learnings.md cargo-deny pattern.
- `scripts/agent-run.sh` + `scripts/agent-run.ps1` — bodies are already correct; chunk #4 just makes `cargo xtask harness:status` work (the gap they currently call into).
- `pulse-app/build.rs` — Tauri 2's `tauri-build` discovers plugin permissions automatically from capability JSON; no `build.rs` edits needed.

- All `crates/{ingest,buffer,viz,snapshot,workspace-detector,plugins,mcp-server}/*` — no library crate other than `ui-bridge` is touched. The other crates' subsystem state contributes to `health` only when their actual implementation lands (chunks #15-#18 + later).
- `pulse-app/capabilities/{tray,notification,updater,plugin-fs}.json` — only `default.json` modified.
- `.github/workflows/` — directory absent; CI workflow lands at route#5. This chunk introduces NO workflow files.

- `.andromeda/architecture.md` — the canonical envelope extension (`pid` + `uptime_ms`) over arch's `{ status, checked_at, subsystems }` is a tests + obs canonical addition; future arch.md edit may surface as clarification (out-of-scope for /implement; user can re-run /andromeda-arch later if desired).
Per tests-plan §3 5-command discipline + chunk-specific tests. Tests must pass for /implement к exit fix loop с success.

```bash
# Workspace check (incremental; new deps may trigger fresh fetch)
cargo check --workspace --message-format=short

# Format / lint gate
cargo fmt --check
cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings

# Test suite (no regressions; --no-tests=pass for Epoch 1 zero-tests state)

# 5-command harness end-to-end (the binding contract gate)
```

body: **Constraints across domains:**

- (security C1) No `pulse:default` capability widening. TanStack Router + Cmd+K palette MUST NOT introduce new TauRPC procedures unless paired with `pulse-app/capabilities/` JSON entry AND `/andromeda-scope-arch` registration (per security plan §API Security TauRPC capability authorization + .claude/rules/security.md Session Additions 2026-05-09 first entry).

- (security C2) CSP MUST remain `script-src 'self'`. TanStack Router + palette JS load from bundled webview origin only; never `'unsafe-inline'` (per security plan §API Security CSP row + §Anti-Patterns API).

- (security C3) `style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'` is the conscious risk acceptance ceiling — new tab UI / palette MUST NOT introduce dynamically-generated styles from telemetry-sourced input (per security plan §API Security CSP row).

- (security C4) Cmd+K palette MUST NOT log/persist OTLP attribute values; palette telemetry uses `palette.match_count` (numeric) + `palette.result_kind` enum only (per security plan §Logging & Monitoring + §Anti-Patterns Logging).

- (security C5) New npm dependencies (TanStack Router, palette library) MUST be pinned in `pulse-app/ui/package.json` lockfile. **Open: specialist plan §Dependency Security is silent on webview/npm posture; orchestrator may need to surface to user whether `npm audit` lands alongside `cargo audit`.**

- (security C6) Capability-drift gate must remain at chunk #32 baseline (4 D3 carry-over extras) — no new TauRPC procedures (per .claude/rules/security.md Session Additions 2026-05-09 + session-handoff Priority 3).

- (design) Full dashboard chrome MUST consume tokens from `@theme` block in `pulse-app/ui/`: page bg `--color-base`, tab bar `--color-raised-1`, popover `--color-raised-2`, modal/palette `--color-raised-3` (per design plan §Color Palette Surface Scale + §Surface: desktop-webview Tokens).

- (design) Active/hover/focus tab states use Border Progression: subtle `rgba(74,144,226,0.1)`, emphasis `rgba(74,144,226,0.6)`, focus rings 3-4px outset `#4A90E2` via box-shadow with `rgba(74,144,226,0.2)` halo (per design plan §Border Progression + §Surface: desktop-webview Focus / Keyboard Navigation).

- (design) Typography splits IBM Plex Sans for chrome (Label 12px/500 tab labels, Heading 20px/600, Display 32px/600) and JetBrains Mono reserved for telemetry data (not chrome) (per design plan §Typography + §Anti-Patterns Universal Bans monospace-vs-sans split).

- (design) Custom titlebar 32px frameless via Tauri `decorations: false` reused from chunk #30; full dashboard adds platform-specific window controls (right-aligned Win/Linux, traffic lights left for macOS) + 20px aperture icon for settings opener (per design plan §Component Patterns Navigation/App Shell + §Surface: desktop-webview Platform-Specific Notes).

- (design) Cmd+K palette overlay uses `--color-raised-3` bg, 1px subtle/emphasis border, `--radius-lg` (8px), 200ms ease-out fade — NO scale-bounce, NO entrance staggering (per design plan §Motion duration scale + Hard limits + §Border Radius modal usage).

- (design) Tab + route transitions 200ms ease-out fade (Expression 0.35), degrade to instant under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` (per design plan §Motion Hard limits + §Accessibility motion override).

- (layouts) Full dashboard window resizable (default 2/3 to full-screen width); custom frameless titlebar identical chrome to compact widget for cross-surface visual cohesion (per layout-templates.md §Wireframe — Full dashboard + §Decisions Log).

title: Phase 30 Plan — chunk route#33: "Full dashboard shell + tab nav — TanStack Router routable views, Cmd+K palette"

data.head: # Phase 30 Plan — chunk route#33: "Full dashboard shell + tab nav — TanStack Router routable views, Cmd+K palette"

body: _Generated by /andromeda-phase Phase 4. Read by /andromeda-implement. Manual edits between runs are fine; do not edit during /implement run._
- **Phase number:** 30

- **Route chunks covered:**
  - route#33 "Full dashboard shell + tab nav — resizable window, tabs for Traces/Metrics/Logs/Snapshots/Settings, TanStack Router routable views, Cmd+K palette"
- **Epoch:** Epoch 5 — Visualization surfaces

Introduce the full dashboard shell on the existing pre-configured `main` Tauri window (1280×800, decorations:false, resizable) — a webview-only frontend chunk that wraps the current `Dashboard.tsx` content with TanStack Router (5 routes mapping 1:1 to tab labels: Traces / Metrics / Logs / Snapshots / Settings), a 5-entry tablist using React Aria Components, a Cmd+K command palette with focus trap + combobox + listbox patterns, plus a skip-to-main link and a polite live region announcing route changes. The existing `CanvasContainer` + `HaloCanvas` peer composition relocates into the Traces tabpanel; the other 4 tabpanels are empty-state placeholders that subsequent chunks (#34/#35/#38) fill. Reuses the cross-surface `<Titlebar>` (with view-suffixed title), the established skip-to-main `<main id="main-content" tabIndex={-1}>` target, and the visually-hidden `<div role="status" aria-live="polite" id="shell-status">` live region. Adds ZERO new TauRPC procedures (preserving the chunk #32 capability-drift baseline of 4 D3 carry-over extras), keeps CSP `script-src 'self'` byte-identical, and respects `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` on every transition (200ms → 0ms via `motion-reduce:` Tailwind variants + `useReducedMotion` from motion/react 12). Delivers the navigation foundation for chunks #34/#35 (Traces / Metrics / Logs content), #36 (tray icon dashboard expansion), #37 (Modal primitive scaffolding), and #38 (Settings form).

Per security plan §API Security CSP + §Anti-Patterns Logging + .claude/rules/security.md Session Additions 2026-05-09; per design plan §Surface: desktop-webview Tokens + §Component Patterns Navigation/App Shell + §Motion Hard limits; per layout-templates.md §Wireframe — Full dashboard + §Component — Primary navigation + §IA notes "Keyboard shortcuts"; per a11y-plan §4 ARIA Patterns Tabs + §4 Combobox + §5 Skip links + §5 Focus restoration + §6 Focus ring tokens + §11 Anti-patterns; per obs-plan §3 Frontend bridge + §11 Logs anti-patterns; per arch §Cross-cutting Patterns Webview IPC capability policy + §Standard Contracts.

Add `@tanstack/react-router` to `pulse-app/ui/package.json` under `dependencies`. Pin to a specific minor version (e.g., `^1.x` resolved by lockfile). Run `npm install` in `pulse-app/ui/` to update `package-lock.json` and `node_modules/`. Use the manual createRouter API (no Vite plugin) — 5 routes only; defer codegen complexity per Open Question Q3 in research.md.

Create `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/router.tsx` defining 5 routes (`/traces`, `/metrics`, `/logs`, `/snapshots`, `/settings`) mapped to the 5 route components. Default route: `/traces`. Use `createRouter({ routeTree, history })` with browser history for the production webview and memory history for tests (`createMemoryHistory({ initialEntries: ['/traces'] })`). Export `Router` instance + `<RouterOutlet>` consumer hook for Dashboard.tsx integration.

Create `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/routes/{TracesRoute,MetricsRoute,LogsRoute,SnapshotsRoute,SettingsRoute}.tsx`. Each renders `<section aria-label="...">` (implicit `role="region"` per a11y rule Session Additions 2026-05-09 — do NOT write explicit `role="region"`) + `<h1>` matching tab label + content. TracesRoute receives `haloInput` via Router context and renders the existing `CanvasContainer` + `HaloCanvas` peers (relocated from Dashboard.tsx per research.md Open Question Q2). Other 4 routes render the empty-state pattern: centered `telescope` icon (24px, `--color-text-tertiary`) + tone-appropriate message ("No metrics yet — chunk #35 fills this view" / similar). All inline styles consume design tokens — NO hex literals.

Create `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/TabNav.tsx` using React Aria Components `Tabs`/`TabList`/`Tab` (NOT Headless UI per a11y-plan §11). Wrap in `<nav aria-label="Dashboard sections">`. 5 tabs in fixed order: Traces / Metrics / Logs / Snapshots / Settings. Active tab gets bottom border emphasis (`rgba(74,144,226,0.6)`) + font-weight 600 + filled-icon variant — at least 2 distinct visual cues per design AC + a11y not-color-alone (SC 1.4.1). Tab labels include custom Observatory icons (`telescope` for Traces, `aperture` for Settings; design plan §Iconography); generic Lucide fallback only if no domain glyph fits. On tab activation, navigate to corresponding route via TanStack Router `useNavigate`. Single tab stop into tablist with arrow-key navigation among tabs (React Aria handles roving tabindex automatically).

Create `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/SkipToMain.tsx` rendering `Skip to main content` styled with Tailwind v4 utility classes hidden until `:focus-visible` (visually-hidden via `clip-path: rect(0,0,0,0)` + position absolute + 1px size; appears on focus via the standard CSS pattern). Mounted as the first focusable element in Dashboard shell per a11y AC + a11y-plan §5 Skip links / WCAG SC 2.4.1.

Create `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/CommandPalette.tsx` using React Aria Components `Dialog` + `ComboBox` + `ListBox` inside `<FocusTrap escapeDeactivates returnFocusOnDeactivate>` (focus-trap-react 12). Bounded `palette_action_kind` enum: `open-tab` (one entry per route — 5 entries) initially; future kinds (`open-snapshot-modal`, `toggle-mcp`, `quit-app`) added in later chunks. NEVER use `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` for result rendering (security AC-S3); React's default text rendering escapes user input automatically. Palette mounted controlled-open via state lifted to Dashboard shell. Closes on Escape, restores focus to trigger. Overlay uses `--color-raised-3` background + `--radius-lg` (8px) + 1px subtle/emphasis border + 200ms ease-out fade (degrades to instant under reduced motion).

title: Step 7 — Create global keyboard shortcut hook

data.head: ### Step 7 — Create global keyboard shortcut hook

body: Create `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/use-keyboard-shortcuts.ts`. Listens for: Cmd+K / Ctrl+K → toggle palette open state (lifted to Dashboard shell); Cmd+Shift+P / Ctrl+Shift+P → compact↔full toggle by calling `getAllWebviewWindows()` then invoking `.show()` on the inactive window + `.hide()` on the current window (no new TauRPC procedure; Tauri 2 webview API covered by `core:default` per research.md default.json read); Esc → close palette if open (otherwise no-op — the modal close discipline lives in palette's own Escape handler when other modals stack later). All listeners detached on unmount.

Create `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/FooterStatusBar.tsx` per layout-templates.md §Component — Footer "Full dashboard": flex row, `var(--spacing-sm)` height, `0 var(--spacing-md)` padding, `var(--spacing-md)` gap, 1px subtle top border (`rgba(74,144,226,0.1)`). Empty content slot in chunk #33 (control population in #34/#35); render an empty `<div>` with the layout dimensions reserved so the dashboard frame is structurally complete.

Create `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/StatusLiveRegion.tsx` extracting the existing inline `<div role="status" aria-live="polite" id="shell-status">` from `Dashboard.tsx` into a named component with React Context exposing `announce(message: string)`. Wire into TanStack Router subscriber — on route change, call `announce(`Now viewing ${routeName}`)` where `routeName` comes from the activated route's metadata. Stay polite (non-blocking); MUST NOT steal focus per WCAG SC 2.1.1 stability + a11y AC.

title: Step 10 — Refactor Dashboard.tsx into the shell

data.head: ### Step 10 — Refactor Dashboard.tsx into the shell

body: Refactor `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/Dashboard.tsx` from current single-screen layout to the new shell shape:

```
<>
```

data.head: ### Per route#33: "Full dashboard shell + tab nav — TanStack Router routable views, Cmd+K palette"

body: **Architecture / placement:**

- (arch) Dashboard webview source lives under `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/`; no new workspace crate added. `cargo metadata --format-version 1 | jq '.workspace_members | length'` returns 10 (unchanged from chunk #32 baseline).
- (arch) Dashboard window assignment uses an existing reserved capability identifier (`pulse:default`); `pulse-app/capabilities/default.json` `windows` array unchanged.
- (arch) Dashboard close-to-tray behavior preserved — close handler invokes window-hide, not process termination (verified via boot-smoke).
**Security / capability gate:**

- (security) `cargo xtask capability-drift` exits with the chunk #32 baseline (4 D3 extras). NO new TauRPC procedures introduced. Verifiable via xtask exit code + diff of `pulse-app/ui/src/bindings/index.ts` ARGS_MAP unchanged from chunk #32.
- (security) `pulse-app/tauri.conf.json` `app.security.csp` is byte-identical to chunk #32 baseline. Verifiable via `git diff` empty for tauri.conf.json security block.

- (security) No `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` introduced anywhere in the new dashboard / palette / route code. Verifiable via `grep -r dangerouslySetInnerHTML pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/` returning empty.

- (security) No `tracing::*!` macro invocations in new dashboard / palette code paths emit OTLP attribute values, palette query strings, or palette result text content as event fields (chunk #33 has no new Rust code emitting tracing events; trivially satisfied).
- (security) `cargo audit` + `cargo deny check bans licenses sources` pass at chunk #32 baseline (no new Rust deps introduced; only npm dep TanStack Router added).

- (security) `npm install` adds TanStack Router with pinned version in `package-lock.json`; no transitive vulnerabilities flagged at `npm audit --audit-level=high` (best-effort; npm-audit gate is not currently CI-enforced per security-extract C5 open question).
**Layout / IA:**
- (layouts) Top-level tab nav exposes exactly 5 tabs in this order: Traces / Metrics / Logs / Snapshots / Settings.
- (layouts) Routable views map 1:1 to tab labels: `/traces`, `/metrics`, `/logs`, `/snapshots`, `/settings`. Default route `/traces`.
- (layouts) Active tab indicator combines border-emphasis (`rgba(74,144,226,0.6)`) AND a non-color cue (font-weight 600 + filled-icon variant) — at least 2 distinct visual properties.
- (layouts) Custom frameless titlebar reuses chunk #30 Titlebar with view-suffixed title `"andromeda-pulse — ${activeView}"` (e.g., "andromeda-pulse — Traces").
- (layouts) Cmd+K (macOS) / Ctrl+K (Win/Linux) opens command palette overlay; Cmd+Shift+P / Ctrl+Shift+P toggles compact↔full window visibility; Esc closes palette + restores focus to trigger.
- (layouts) Three-region frame [Titlebar / RouterOutlet (with main content) / FooterStatusBar] established. Footer status bar slot rendered (empty content; populated in #34/#35).
**Design / tokens:**

- (design) Full dashboard chrome uses only tokens from `pulse-app/ui/src/styles/tokens.css` `@theme` block. `grep -E '#[0-9A-Fa-f]{3,6}|[0-9]+px' pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/` returns no hex literals or hardcoded pixel values outside Tailwind utility class names + WebGPU-spec-constant hex bitfields.

- (design) Tab transition + Cmd+K palette emergence respect `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` — instant degradation verified via Playwright `page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: 'reduce' })` in the a11y test suite (or unit-level via mock-reduced-motion utility).
- (design) Tab icons sourced from custom Observatory glyph set where domain-specific glyph fits (`telescope` for Traces, `aperture` for Settings).
**Tests / quality gates:**

- (tests) `cd pulse-app/ui && npm run test` exits 0 with all new co-located `*.test.tsx` files passing; webview test count grows from 302 (chunk #32 baseline) by the per-component test count of chunk #33.
- (tests) Coverage gate (chunk #25 baseline): line ≥75% / branch ≥70% / function ≥85% for new code under `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/`.

- (tests) Boot-smoke gate passes: `cd pulse-app && npx @tauri-apps/cli dev` runs for ≥8 seconds without panic; stdout shows boot-completion signals before SIGTERM. NO `app.panic.fatal` line in `~/.andromeda-pulse/logs/agent-latest.jsonl` during boot window.
- (tests) `cargo nextest run --workspace --profile ci` passes (302 webview + 427 Rust = 729 baseline preserved or grows by chunk #33's added tests; no regressions).
- (tests) Zero flakiness on new router + tablist + palette tests across 3 consecutive `npm run test` runs.
**Observability / SLO:**

- (obs) WebGPU frame metric continues to emit during dashboard runtime: after exercising tab navigation across all 5 tabs (TracesRoute mounts the existing CanvasContainer + HaloCanvas), `jq 'select(.target == "metric.webgpu.frame_duration_ms")' ~/.andromeda-pulse/logs/agent-latest.jsonl` returns ≥1 line.
- (obs) Heartbeat-gap CI gate continues passing: max consecutive-tick delta ≤45000ms for each of `ingest.tick` / `buffer.tick` / `viz.tick` / `plugins.tick` during the dashboard-open boot-smoke run.
- (obs) Zero-unlogged-panics holds: `jq 'select(.level == "ERROR" and .target == "app.panic.fatal")'` returns empty after exercising the dashboard shell smoke flow.
- (obs) Frame p99 SLO does not regress: post-test p99 of `metric.webgpu.frame_duration_ms` ≤33 ms on chunk #33 dashboard smoke flow.

- (obs) No raw user-typed Cmd+K palette query text logged anywhere — trivially satisfied because chunk #33 introduces NO `tracing::*!` invocations from new code (palette telemetry deferred to a future chunk if desired).
**A11y / WCAG:**
- (a11y) `npm run lint` (eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y) passes for new dashboard files with zero critical violations.
- (a11y) Skip-to-main link is the first focusable element in the dashboard; visually-hidden until `:focus-visible`; activating it focuses `#main-content`.
- (a11y) Tablist follows WAI-ARIA pattern: `role="tablist"` + `role="tab"` items + `aria-controls` to `role="tabpanel"` + `aria-selected="true"` on active + roving tabindex (single `tabindex="0"`).

- (a11y) Tab keyboard contract: Arrow Left/Right cycles tabs (with Home/End jumping ends); Tab key moves focus OUT of tablist into tabpanel (single tab stop into tablist); Enter/Space activates a focused tab.
- (a11y) Cmd+K palette: `role="dialog"` + `aria-modal="true"` + focus trap activates on open + Escape closes + restores focus to trigger; combobox + listbox pattern with `aria-activedescendant`.
- (a11y) Route change moves focus to new route's `<main>` and announces via `aria-live="polite"` status region; live region MUST NOT steal focus.
- (a11y) Active-tab state conveyed by `aria-selected="true"` AND a non-color cue (font-weight 600 + filled-icon variant) — verified via DOM inspection in TabNav.test.tsx.
- (a11y) `<section aria-label="...">` landmark per route — NO explicit `role="region"` (per a11y rule Session Additions 2026-05-09 redundant-roles ban).
