Files inspected referenced in this plan:
- `pulse-app/tauri.conf.json` — referenced as windows config + CSP baseline + capability assignment
- `pulse-app/src/main.rs` — referenced as Rust boot path (out of scope for chunk #33)
- `pulse-app/ui/package.json` — referenced as dep manifest (TanStack Router added; existing libs reused)
- `pulse-app/ui/src/main.tsx` — referenced as root render (no change)
- `pulse-app/ui/src/App.tsx` — referenced as window-label fork (no behavioral change to widget branch; Dashboard import target shape changes)
- `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/Dashboard.tsx` — referenced as the file being refactored to shell shape
- `pulse-app/ui/src/widget/CompactWidget.tsx` — referenced as the cross-surface model for Titlebar reuse + skip-to-main pattern
- `pulse-app/ui/src/components/Titlebar.tsx` — referenced as the reusable titlebar with optional title + onSettingsClick props
- `pulse-app/ui/src/hooks/use-window-label.ts` — referenced as the existing window-label routing pattern
- `pulse-app/ui/vite.config.mjs` — referenced as Vite config (no change for chunk #33)
- `pulse-app/capabilities/default.json` — referenced as the existing pulse:default capability covering core webview + window APIs needed for compact↔full toggle
- `pulse-app/ui/src/bindings/index.ts` — referenced as auto-emitted Specta bindings (regenerates byte-identical)
- `xtask/src/main.rs` — referenced for EXPECTED_PROCEDURES (out of scope for chunk #33; D3 carry-over remediation is separate concern)

- **Order of file creation:** create the leaf components first (SkipToMain, FooterStatusBar, StatusLiveRegion, TabNav, CommandPalette, route stubs), then the router setup, then refactor Dashboard.tsx last so all imports resolve.

- **Test-first within each component:** establish the DOM-shape contract test alongside the component implementation; React Aria Components handle most ARIA wiring out-of-the-box, so tests primarily assert the React Aria component is correctly wired (not re-testing React Aria internals).

- **Ordering of `Cmd+Shift+P` window toggle implementation:** per Open Question Q1 in research.md, the keyboard shortcut handler lands in chunk #33 (the global keydown listener belongs at the dashboard shell layer). The Settings modal toggle UI (chunk #38) provides a SECOND entry point but is out of scope here.

- **Boot-smoke duration:** per Open Question Q4 reconciliation, this plan's Acceptance Criteria pick **≥8 seconds** (the authoritative tests-plan §12 amendment 2026-05-09 value). The combined.md cross-domain rot warning noted security AC-S6's "≥5s" is an inclusive subset.

- **Empty-state placeholders for non-Traces routes:** the 4 placeholder routes (Metrics / Logs / Snapshots / Settings) MUST render NON-TRIVIAL empty-state UI (centered telescope icon + tone-appropriate message) — NOT blank `<section />`. This satisfies the design plan §Component Patterns Loading / Empty States baseline AND prevents a11y from flagging missing landmark content.

- **TracesRoute haloInput propagation:** the existing `haloInput` synthetic data flows from App.tsx → Dashboard → TracesRoute via Router context (TanStack Router's loader / context API), preserving the chunk #31 synthetic data flow without shape change.

- **No persistence for "remember last opened tab" in chunk #33:** the Settings struct extension pattern (per security extract Pattern + chunk #30 verification) is the SECURITY-recommended path BUT is deferred to keep chunk scope focused. URL state handles tab selection within the session.

- **Route-change focus restoration timing:** TanStack Router `useNavigate` resolves synchronously; focus restoration to `<main>` + live-region announcement should fire AFTER the route renders. Use TanStack Router's subscribers (`onResolved` / `subscribe`) to attach the focus + announce side-effect.

- **Shell-status live region migration:** the existing inline `<div role="status" aria-live="polite" id="shell-status">` in Dashboard.tsx becomes the StatusLiveRegion.Sink; the announce() context API replaces direct DOM manipulation. Existing chunk #31 baseline test for the live-region presence updates correspondingly.
_Generated by /andromeda-phase Phase 3 from targeted reads informed by combined.md._
- **Research depth:** moderate (chunk extends a maturing webview surface — many existing primitives to reuse, several NEW pieces to introduce, no greenfield)

- **Reads performed:** 13 (full files: tauri.conf.json / main.rs / package.json / App.tsx / main.tsx / Dashboard.tsx / CompactWidget.tsx / Titlebar.tsx / use-window-label.ts / vite.config.mjs / default.json capability + bindings/index.ts header)
- **Globs / Greps:** 5 (ui/src/ tree + ui/src/components/ + ui/src/dashboard/ + ui/src/widget/ + ui/src/hooks/ + xtask EXPECTED_PROCEDURES)
- **Parallel batches:** 4 (initial discovery + structure + key files + xtask spot-check)

- `pulse-app/tauri.conf.json` (full) — two windows already configured: `compact-widget` (480×270, alwaysOnTop, decorations:false, visible:false) AND `main` (1280×800, decorations:false, resizable:true, visible:false). CSP `default-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; worker-src 'self' blob:`. Bundle id `com.andromeda.pulse`.

- `pulse-app/src/main.rs` (full) — fn main() now establishes a multi-thread tokio runtime + `tauri::async_runtime::set(Handle::current())` BEFORE `taurpc::Router::new()` (commit 860199d this session, fixed the chunk #25 carry-over panic). 6 routers merged: IntrospectionApi, TracesApi, MetricsApi, LogsApi, StreamsApi, TelemetryApi (when buffer init OK). `setup` closure shows `compact-widget` window via `window::show_compact_widget(app)` + `apply_widget_settings(app, &settings)`. NO show of the `main` window in the setup closure — main window stays hidden (visible:false in tauri.conf) until something explicitly shows it. **Implementation note:** chunk #33 needs to either (a) show `main` window on first launch alongside compact-widget, (b) leave main hidden and have the dashboard appear only when expanded from widget Settings (per layouts §IA notes "Cross-surface launcher pattern"), or (c) flip the boot-default to show main and hide compact-widget. **Recommendation:** keep current "compact-widget shows on boot, main hidden" — chunk #33 implements the dashboard SHELL but the surface is reachable only by showing the existing `main` window (subsequent chunk that wires the Settings toggle for compact↔full will trigger `main` window show; the shell renders correctly when the window IS shown, e.g. via dev tools or when chunk #38 lands).

- `pulse-app/ui/package.json` (full) — current React 19.2 / Tailwind v4.1 / vitest 3.0 / motion 12 / react-aria-components 1.17 / focus-trap-react 12 / tabbable 6.4 / @tauri-apps/api 2.0 already in deps. NEW dep needed for chunk #33: `@tanstack/react-router` (no router currently in deps; only React + the four a11y libs).
- `pulse-app/ui/src/main.tsx` (full) — single `createRoot(...).render(<StrictMode><App /></StrictMode>)`. No router provider mounted; `App` directly branches on window-label.

- `pulse-app/ui/src/App.tsx` (full) — window-label router pattern: `if (windowLabel === 'compact-widget') return <CompactWidget metrics={...} />; return <Dashboard haloInput={...} />;`. The synthetic data simulators run at App level; both surfaces consume their respective shapes. **Implementation note:** chunk #33 modifies the `Dashboard` branch — TanStack Router setup wraps the existing Dashboard content; the window-label fork itself stays.

- `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/Dashboard.tsx` (full) — simple `<Titlebar /><main id="main-content" tabIndex={-1}>...</main><div role="status" aria-live="polite" id="shell-status">` shell with CanvasContainer + HaloCanvas children. The `shell-status` polite live region already exists (chunk #31). Skip-to-main target `id="main-content"` already on `<main>`. **Implementation note:** chunk #33 substantially refactors this file — the existing CanvasContainer/HaloCanvas content gets relocated INTO the Traces tabpanel content (or kept as a hero region rendered above Router outlet, depending on layout decision); the shell becomes Titlebar + skip-link + tablist + Router outlet + footer + status-live-region.

- `pulse-app/ui/src/widget/CompactWidget.tsx` (full) — analog of Dashboard.tsx for compact widget. Shows the existing `<Titlebar /><main id="main-content"...>` pattern that should be mirrored on the dashboard side; also confirms the cross-surface visual cohesion mandate (same Titlebar component, different `main` content).

- `pulse-app/ui/src/components/Titlebar.tsx` (full) — frameless custom titlebar at 32px height with `data-tauri-drag-region`. Accepts optional `title` prop (defaults to "andromeda-pulse"; chunk #31 comment hints at view-suffixed title) + optional `onSettingsClick`. Uses Icon glyph "constellation-grid" (16px) + "aperture" (20px settings opener) + WindowControls. **Implementation note:** chunk #33 passes `title={\`andromeda-pulse — ${activeView}\`}` to Titlebar from the dashboard shell where `activeView` is the current TanStack Router route's display name (Traces / Metrics / Logs / Snapshots / Settings).
- `pulse-app/ui/src/hooks/use-window-label.ts` (full) — confirmed bounded-enum pattern + try/catch fallback to `"unknown"` for jsdom. Detection runs once via lazy `useState(() => ...)` initializer.

- `pulse-app/ui/vite.config.mjs` (full) — minimal Vite config with `react()` plugin + `outDir: "dist"` + `emptyOutDir: false` (the dual-build chain with Tailwind per chunk #11). **Implementation note:** TanStack Router has an optional Vite plugin (`@tanstack/router-vite-plugin`) that auto-generates type-safe route definitions; chunk #33 can adopt it OR use the manual `createRoute`/`RouterProvider` API. Recommendation: use the **manual API** (no Vite plugin) for chunk #33 — fewer moving pieces, easier to test, and the route count is small (5).

- `pulse-app/capabilities/default.json` (full) — `windows: ["compact-widget", "main"]` + `permissions: ["core:default", "updater:default"]`. The `core:default` permission group covers core webview + window APIs by default (Tauri 2 grouping). **Implementation note:** the `Cmd+Shift+P` compact↔full toggle (per layouts §IA notes) requires showing the `main` window and hiding `compact-widget` (or vice versa). Tauri 2's `getAllWebviewWindows()` + `webview.show()` / `webview.hide()` falls under `core:default` — no new capability JSON entry needed.

- `pulse-app/ui/src/bindings/index.ts` (header) — Specta-generated TauRPC bindings; current ARGS_MAP enumerates the chunk #32 procedure set (top-level envelope + traces.* + metrics.* + logs.* + streams.subscribe_* + telemetry.frontend.record_frame_ms). chunk #33 introduces ZERO new TauRPC procedures so this file should regenerate identically (or with a stale-mtime no-op diff).

- `xtask/src/main.rs` (lines 369-413 spot-check) — `EXPECTED_PROCEDURES` static slice currently hardcodes the procedure list. Per session-handoff Priority 3: this list is missing 4 entries (3× `streams.subscribe_*` + `telemetry.frontend.record_frame_ms`) — the carry-over D3 drift. Chunk #33 SHOULD NOT add new entries; if any incidental procedure addition occurs, the rule (per security.md Session Additions 2026-05-09) is `/andromeda-scope-arch` first.

- (additional listing) `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/Dashboard.test.tsx` exists — chunk #31 baseline test for Dashboard mount + skip-link target + status live region. Chunk #33 needs to update this test for the new shell shape (tablist visible / Cmd+K opens palette / route changes / skip-link first focusable / focus trap on palette).

- **Window-label routing pattern** (App.tsx + use-window-label.ts) — bounded enum sanitized with try/catch jsdom fallback. Lazy-init `useState(() => ...)` so detection runs once. Chunk #33 keeps this; the dashboard branch wraps with TanStack RouterProvider.

- **Custom-titlebar pattern** (Titlebar.tsx) — `<header data-tauri-drag-region>` with `[app-icon | title | grow | settings | window-controls]` segments at 32px height, 1px subtle Earth-Blue bottom border. Designed for cross-surface reuse with optional `title` + `onSettingsClick` props.

- **Skip-to-main + status live region pattern** (Dashboard.tsx + CompactWidget.tsx) — both surfaces use `<main id="main-content" tabIndex={-1}>` plus a visually-hidden `<div role="status" aria-live="polite" id="shell-status">` for SR announcements. Chunk #33 reuses verbatim.

- **Token-only styling pattern** (everywhere in ui/src/) — inline styles consume `var(--color-*)` / `var(--spacing-*)` / `var(--font-*)` / `var(--duration-*)`. NO hex literals in JSX/TSX outside icon SVG content. Chunk #33 follows.

- **WebGPU constants inlined-as-numeric-literals pattern** (HaloCanvas.tsx per testing.md Session Additions 2026-05-09) — `GPUBufferUsage.UNIFORM | COPY_DST` baked as `0x40 | 0x08` in module scope to sidestep jsdom flakiness. Chunk #33 doesn't introduce new WebGPU code so this doesn't apply directly, but any new shader-bearing tabpanel content (deferred to #34/#35) will need to.

- **Reduced-motion pattern** (`use-reduced-motion.ts` + Tailwind v4 `motion-reduce:*` variants) — single source of truth via the hook + Tailwind utility variants on transitions. Chunk #33 applies to tab transitions + Cmd+K palette emergence + any TanStack Router transition.

- **TauRPC bindings consumption pattern** (App.tsx test mocks + ui/src/bindings/index.ts auto-emitted) — webview imports from `./bindings` ONLY; never re-declare procedure types. Chunk #33 doesn't add new procedures.

- **Vitest test setup pattern** (test-setup.ts + per-test `vi.mock("@tauri-apps/api/webviewWindow", ...)` + `afterEach(() => vi.unstubAllGlobals())`) — established at chunks #28-#32. Chunk #33's tab nav + palette tests follow the same shape; vi.mock TanStack Router ONLY for routes that genuinely need stubbing (per tests-extract anti-pattern: prefer `createMemoryHistory` + `createRouter` test helpers).

- **Co-located `*.test.tsx` next to source** under `pulse-app/ui/src/` — vitest discovery via `include: ["src/**/*.{test,spec}.{ts,tsx}"]` + `setupFiles: ["./src/test-setup.ts"]`. Chunk #33 adds `Dashboard.test.tsx` updates + new `dashboard/CommandPalette.test.tsx` + new per-route test files.

- **DOM-shape contract assertions only** — `aria-*` / `role` / `data-testid` / focus state. NO visual diff. Chunk #33: assert `role="tablist"` + 5 `role="tab"` items + `aria-selected="true"` on active + `aria-controls` wired to tabpanels + `role="dialog"` on palette + `aria-modal="true"` + first focusable is skip-link.
- **Builder factories for synthesized data** — palette items, route fixtures. NO raw object literals in tests. Chunk #33 adds factory for `CommandPaletteItem` shape (matching the production type).

- **Inline styles consume CSS custom properties** — `style={{ background: "var(--color-base)", ... }}`; NO hex literals; design-tokens.md §Self-Validation Token Test enforces. Chunk #33 follows verbatim.

- **Reduced-motion via hook + Tailwind variants** — `useReducedMotion` from motion/react 12 OR `motion-reduce:*` Tailwind utilities. Chunk #33: tab indicator slide + Cmd+K fade gated on `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`.

- **Boot-smoke gate** (per testing.md Session Additions 2026-05-09 boot-smoke discipline + tests extract AC) — chunks touching `pulse-app/ui/src/main.tsx` OR `App.tsx` MUST include `npx @tauri-apps/cli dev` (60s timeout, watch for `Local:` / `ready in` / `Compiled successfully` boot-completion) in the chunk's Test Commands. Chunk #33 modifies `App.tsx` (the window-label fork's Dashboard branch becomes a Router-wrapped subtree) — boot-smoke MUST run.

- **Section role implicit-from-aria-label** (per a11y.md Session Additions 2026-05-09) — `<section aria-label="...">` automatically takes implicit `role="region"`; do NOT write explicit `role="region"` (eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y `no-redundant-roles` violation). Chunk #33: tablist container is `<nav aria-label="Dashboard sections">` + `<ul role="tablist">`; tabpanels are `<section aria-label="...">` (NOT `role="region"`).

Per layouts §Wireframe — Full dashboard, the wireframe places the hero canvas region INSIDE each tab's content area. **Recommendation:** move CanvasContainer + HaloCanvas into the Traces tabpanel (matching layouts wireframe); the dashboard root chrome becomes [Titlebar / tablist / RouterOutlet / footer]; each tab's content includes its hero canvas region. Other tabs (Metrics, Logs, Snapshots, Settings) start with empty-state placeholders that subsequent chunks fill.

Tab → route mapping via tab-id enum. Default route `/traces`.

- `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/TabNav.tsx` — `
    ...
` using React Aria Components `Tabs`/`TabList`/`Tab` (handles roving tabindex + arrow keys + Home/End out of the box). Maps tab id (TraceId / MetricId / LogId / SnapshotId / SettingId) to route path. Active state: bottom border emphasis (`rgba(74,144,226,0.6)`) + font-weight 600 + filled-icon variant — ≥2 distinct visual properties (per design AC + a11y not-color-alone).

- `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/TabNav.test.tsx` — assert `role="tablist"` + 5 `role="tab"` items + `aria-selected` toggling on click/arrow + Tab key moves focus OUT of tablist into tabpanel (single tab stop) + Home/End jumps + Enter/Space activates.
- `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/SkipToMain.tsx` — visually-hidden `<a href="#main-content">` that appears on focus per WCAG SC 2.4.1 Bypass Blocks (per a11y AC + a11y-plan §5).

body: _Generated by /andromeda-phase Phase 4. Read by /andromeda-implement. Manual edits between runs are fine; do not edit during /implement run._
- **Phase number:** 31

- **Route chunks covered:**
  - route#34 "Trace timeline + per-service constellation — sortable trace data table (Trace ID/Service/Latency/Error), constellation map with per-service Halo dots"
- **Epoch:** Visualization surfaces (epoch 5)

Fill the TracesRoute placeholder (currently a chunk #31 side-by-side composition of the substrate `<CanvasContainer>` + chunk #31 `<HaloCanvas>`) with the wireframe-mandated three-region stack: a per-service constellation map in the hero region, a sortable trace data table in the main region, and (deferred to a later chunk) a footer status bar. The constellation extends chunk #31's single-service Halo State Pulse to N services rendered on a single WebGPU canvas (per layout-templates §Decisions Log "Signature placement strategy"), each dot pulsing independently at clamped 0.8–2.4 Hz with LCH Earth Blue ↔ Alert Burgundy hue per error rate. The trace data table is a semantic `<table>` with `<th scope="col">` + `<button aria-sort>` keyboard-activatable sortable columns (Trace ID / Service / Latency / Error), data cells in JetBrains Mono tabular numerals, error column pairing color with text+icon (per design Decisions Log 2026-05-03 lift-accent classification + WCAG SC 1.4.1).

The chunk is webview-mostly with two small Rust touch points: extending the `TraceRow` struct in the `viz` crate to add `service: String, duration_ms: u64, error_count: u32` (the table needs columns the current 3-field shape doesn't carry), and extending `xtask/src/main.rs::EXPECTED_PROCEDURES` to clear the persistent D3 capability-drift carry-over from chunks #23/#29 (per session-handoff Priority 3 — coupling D3 cleanup with chunk #34 since #34 consumes those procedures heavily). No new TauRPC procedure namespace is introduced; capability JSON is unchanged.

Per security plan §Input Validation + §Logging anti-patterns: any new sort/filter parameter shape must use `serde`-deserialized argument structs with bounded enums (no free-form `String` flowing into DuckDB), and any tracing instrumentation in the rendering pipeline must NEVER interpolate raw OTLP attribute values (`service.name`, error messages) into log fields. Per obs plan §10: the per-frame `metric.webgpu.frame_duration_ms` p99 ≤ 33ms SLO must hold across multi-service rendering load, achieved by reusing chunk #31's `recordFrameMs(...)` bridge + a single WebGPU canvas with N draw calls per frame (rather than N independent canvases). Per a11y plan §3 Critical Paths P1+P4: live-row updates from `streams.subscribe_spans` MUST NOT steal focus from the current keyboard target.

1. **Locate TraceRow definition + traces.query resolver** — grep `crates/viz/src/` for `TraceRow` struct + `#[taurpc::resolvers]` impl (likely in `contract.rs` + `query.rs` per the chunk #25 pattern; `lib.rs` re-exports). Confirm DuckDB query path uses `Connection::prepare` + `?` placeholders (per security plan §Input Validation row "DuckDB query parameters").

2. **Extend TraceRow struct (Rust, viz crate)** — add 3 fields with `serde::Serialize, Deserialize` derives + `#[cfg_attr(feature = "taurpc-runtime", derive(specta::Type))]`:
   - `service: String` (from `spans.service_name` DuckDB column)
   - `duration_ms: u64` (computed from `(end_time_unix_nano - start_time_unix_nano) / 1_000_000` of the root span per trace, OR from existing aggregation column if one exists in `crates/buffer/src/schema.rs`)
   - `error_count: u32` (count of spans within the trace where `status_code == ERROR`, per OTLP spec)
   Update the `traces.query` SELECT to populate the new fields via prepared statement extension. Add `#[test]` round-trip serde assertions in same crate.

3. **Auto-regenerate TauRPC bindings** — `cargo build` (or `cargo check`) runs the taurpc derive macro which regenerates `pulse-app/ui/src/bindings/index.ts`. Verify `TraceRow` TypeScript shape now reflects the 6-field struct (not 3); ARGS_MAP unchanged.

4. **Extend xtask EXPECTED_PROCEDURES (D3 cleanup)** — add 4 entries to `xtask/src/main.rs:376-390`:
   - `streams.subscribe_logs`
   - `streams.subscribe_metrics`
   - `streams.subscribe_spans`
   - `telemetry.frontend.record_frame_ms`
   Sorted alphabetically per existing convention. Verify `cargo xtask capability-drift` exits 0 with 0 extras after the change.

5. **Create sort module** — `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/routes/traces/sort.ts`: bounded enums `SortColumn` (`"trace_id" | "service" | "latency_ms" | "error"`) + `SortDirection` (`"asc" | "desc" | "none"`); pure `sortRows(rows: TraceRow[], column: SortColumn, direction: SortDirection): TraceRow[]` returning sorted copy (no mutation; insertion order preserved when direction === "none"). Co-located `sort.test.ts` covering all 4 columns × 2 directions + unsorted path.

6. **Create `useTraces` hook** — `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/routes/traces/use-traces.ts`: calls `proxy.traces.query({ time_window_seconds: 60, limit: 100, cursor: null })` on mount; returns `{ rows: TraceRow[], isLoading: boolean, error: AppError | null }` state. Uses `useState` + `useEffect` (no TanStack Query yet — defer to a future chunk if cache invalidation grows complex). Co-located test mocks the bindings module via `vi.mock` + `vi.hoisted` per `.claude/rules/testing.md` 2026-05-09.

7. **Create `useConstellationData` hook** — `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/routes/traces/use-constellation-data.ts`: takes `TraceRow[]` + window seconds; returns `Array<{ serviceName, throughputHz, errorRate, position: { x, y } }>`. Aggregation: group by `service`, compute throughput as `count / window_seconds`, errorRate as `error_count_sum / count`. Position computation: simple radial layout — service N of K placed at `{ x: cos(2πN/K), y: sin(2πN/K) }` in normalized [-1, 1] canvas space (deterministic, per-render stable). Co-located test asserts aggregation correctness + position determinism.

8. **Create `TraceTable` component** — `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/routes/traces/TraceTable.tsx`: semantic `<table>` / `<thead>` / `<tbody>` / `<tr>` / `<th scope="col">` / `<td>` markup (NO `<div role="table">`). Each `<th scope="col">` contains a `<button aria-sort={...}>` child for keyboard activation (per a11y-plan §4 ARIA Patterns Button + WAI-ARIA APG). Sort cycle: click cycles `none → asc → desc → none`; `aria-sort` toggles `"ascending" | "descending" | "none"`; visual caret indicator in `var(--color-primary)`; sort change calls `useStatusAnnouncer().announce("Sorted by {column}, {direction}")`. Data cells: trace_id (font-code 12px tabular-nums; truncated display), service (font-body 12px), duration_ms (font-code tabular-nums right-aligned; "{n} ms" formatting), error_count (font-body + `<Icon glyph="..." />` only when `error_count > 0` — pairing color with icon per design Decisions Log 2026-05-03 + WCAG SC 1.4.1). Hover state: row bg `rgba(74,144,226,0.1)` instant change (no transition per layouts `0.35` budget). Empty state: telescope icon at 24px + "No traces yet" text in `var(--color-text-tertiary)`. ALL styling via `var(--*)` tokens; zero hardcoded hex/px/duration values.

9. **Create `ConstellationCanvas` component** — `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/routes/traces/ConstellationCanvas.tsx`: `<section aria-label="Service constellation">` wrapper (NO explicit `role="region"` per a11y.md Session Additions 2026-05-09) + `<canvas>` + WebGPU pipeline. Reuse imports from `pulse-app/ui/src/halo/`: `lchInterpolate`, `errorRateToBlur`, `throughputToHz`, `createHaloPipeline`. Reuse imports from `pulse-app/ui/src/canvas/`: `requestWebGPUAdapter`, `createFrameLoop`, `Fallback`, `recordFrameMs`, `normalizeWgpuBackend`, `detectWebviewBackend`. Reuse `useReducedMotion` from `pulse-app/ui/src/hooks/`. Multi-service rendering: per frame, write each service's `(color, blurTarget, pulsePhase, position)` to a per-instance uniform/storage buffer; issue a single `pass.draw(6, services.length)` instanced draw call (or N `pass.draw(6)` calls if instancing complicates the pipeline). Per-service refs (similar to chunk #31 `throughputHzRef` / `errorRateRef` pattern) hold latest aggregated data so the long-lived rAF loop reads fresh values without pipeline teardown. Reduced-motion: degrades each dot to static glow (rhythm freezes; hue still updates via the secondary effect that re-invokes one render per data change). WebGPU fallback: render `<Fallback />` when `adapter.kind === "unavailable"`. Inline `UNIFORM_BUFFER_USAGE = 0x40 | 0x08` per WebGPU spec (jsdom workaround per `.claude/rules/testing.md` 2026-05-09).

10. **Refactor TracesRoute layout** — `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/routes/TracesRoute.tsx`: REPLACE current side-by-side `` + `` composition with the wireframe stack. New shape: ```

Traces

// hero region (full-width) // main region (full-width)
``` `useTraces()` provides rows; `useConstellationData(rows)` derives service aggregates; `useHaloInput()` (chunk #31 sim) is no longer the data source — actual aggregated service data drives the constellation. Outer `
` keeps the existing chunk #33 styling (`var(--spacing-md)` padding, flex column, gap `var(--spacing-md)`).

11. **Extend TracesRoute test** — `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/routes/TracesRoute.test.tsx`: replace current CanvasContainer + HaloCanvas mocks with ConstellationCanvas + TraceTable mocks (data-testid stubs). Assert: route-traces section + h1 heading still present; ConstellationCanvas renders ABOVE TraceTable in DOM order; both stubs receive expected props (services array length matches input row aggregation; rows array forwarded verbatim to TraceTable).

12. **Verify tests + lint + typecheck** — `cd pulse-app/ui && npm test && npm run lint && npm run typecheck`. Then `cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && cargo nextest run --workspace --profile ci`.

13. **Verify capability-drift cleared** — `cargo xtask capability-drift` exits 0 with NO extras (down from chunk #32's 4 carry-over extras; arch §Occupied Resources already legitimized all 4 per Type 6 amendments archived 2026-05-09T11:55:00Z).

Watch for `Local:` / `ready in` / `Compiled successfully` stdout markers; verify zero `app.panic.fatal` events in `~/.andromeda-pulse/logs/agent-latest.jsonl` during the boot window. title: Phase 32 Plan — chunk route#35: "Metrics charts + logs stream"

data.head: # Phase 32 Plan — chunk route#35: "Metrics charts + logs stream"

body: _Generated by /andromeda-phase Phase 4. Read by /andromeda-implement. Manual edits between runs are fine; do not edit during /implement run._
- **Phase number:** 32

- **Route chunks covered:**
  - route#35 "Metrics charts + logs stream — time-series WebGPU compute aggregation, log stream with span correlation + severity colors + search/filter UI"
- **Epoch:** Epoch 5 — Visualization surfaces

Fill chunk #33's stub `MetricsRoute` and `LogsRoute` with real telemetry surfaces inside the Full dashboard (desktop-webview): a WebGPU time-series chart for the Metrics tab driven by data from the existing `metrics.query` TauRPC router, and a sortable severity-color-coded log table with span correlation + client-side search/filter UI for the Logs tab driven by the existing `logs.query` router. Both routes reuse chunk #33's header + tab nav skeleton, follow chunk #34's three-region wireframe stack precedent (header → hero → table), and consume chunk #29's `telemetry.frontend.record_frame_ms` bridge for WebGPU frame budget instrumentation — NO new TauRPC procedure namespaces are introduced at the chunk-#35 level.

The route's stated capability "log stream with span correlation + severity colors" requires `trace_id` and `severity_text` columns on `LogRow` that do not exist today (current `LogRow` is 3 fields: `ts_unix_nano` / `resource_hash` / `severity_number`). Similarly, "time-series WebGPU compute aggregation" benefits from a `value` column on `MetricRow` that does not exist today (current `MetricRow` is 3 fields: `metric_name` / `ts_unix_nano` / `resource_hash`). Following chunk #34's buffer-schema-extension precedent (cross-crate ripple buffer/schema → buffer/appender → buffer/retention → viz/query → webview row decoder + tests), this plan defaults to **Path B (full schema extension)** to preserve the route's stated capability end-to-end. **Path A (UI shell only with placeholder data)** is preserved as a Phase 6 opt-out for users who want to defer the buffer ripple to a follow-up chunk; the implementation path will be confirmed at Phase 6 review before /andromeda-implement runs.

Cross-cutting discipline: prepared statements only for any extended SELECT_*/COUNT_* (per security plan §Input Validation row 5 + universal CLAUDE.md); tracing instrumentation already wired in `viz.query.metrics` / `viz.query.logs` handlers stays PII-scrubbed (`query_id` + `param_count` + `param_types` only — never raw filter/search input strings or row body content); WebGPU canvas wrapped in `<section aria-label="...">` with implicit `role="region"`; live log region uses `role="log" aria-live="polite"`; severity tri-channel signal (color border + icon + text label) preserves SC 1.4.1 not-color-alone discipline; reduced-motion path emits frame metric with `duration_ms: 0` per chunk #34 ConstellationCanvas precedent.
(Path B — default. If Phase 6 selects Path A, skip steps 1–4 and proceed directly to step 5; UI builds against existing 3-field MetricRow / LogRow shapes.)

Edit `crates/buffer/src/schema.rs`: extend `CREATE_METRICS_POINTS` const + `SCHEMA_DDL` concat with `value DOUBLE NOT NULL` and `data_point_kind INTEGER NOT NULL` (Gauge=0/Sum=1/Histogram=2/ExponentialHistogram=3/Summary=4 per OTLP `metric::Data` enum encoding). Extend `CREATE_LOG_RECORDS` const + `SCHEMA_DDL` concat with `body VARCHAR NOT NULL DEFAULT ''`, `severity_text VARCHAR NOT NULL DEFAULT ''`, `trace_id BLOB NOT NULL DEFAULT X''`, `span_id BLOB NOT NULL DEFAULT X''`.

3. Update existing `each_reserved_table_has_ts_and_ts_unix_nano_columns` rstest cases (no change to expected columns; the new columns extend tables but ts/ts_unix_nano remain). No new test required at schema level beyond the spot-check sync.

1. Edit `crates/buffer/src/appender.rs`:
   - Extend `build_metrics_record_batch` Arrow Schema fields (4→6): add `value: Float64` and `data_point_kind: Int32`. Update `collect_metric_points` + `push_metric_row` to thread through `value: f64` (extracted via new `extract_data_point_value(p: &NumberDataPoint) -> f64` helper that reads `Some(number_data_point::Value::AsInt(i))` → `i as f64`, `Some(AsDouble(d))` → `d`, None → `0.0`) AND `data_point_kind: i32` (Gauge=0, Sum=1, Histogram=2, ExponentialHistogram=3, Summary=4 — matched at the `metric::Data::*` arm). Histogram/ExponentialHistogram/Summary data points have no scalar `value` shape; encode `value = 0.0` for them in v1 (future scope: extend Histogram bucket counts).

Per-row extraction: `extract_log_body(body: Option<&AnyValue>) -> String` (flatten `Some(any_value::Value::StringValue(s))` → `s.clone()`, all other variants → `String::new()`; matches OTLP body-as-string convention); `LogRecord::severity_text.clone()`; `LogRecord::trace_id.clone()` (16 bytes per OTLP) and `LogRecord::span_id.clone()` (8 bytes per OTLP — invariants enforced by ingest receivers).

title: Path A only (placeholder data — no Rust changes)

data.head: ### Path A only (placeholder data — no Rust changes)

body: - (No Rust changes. MetricsChart renders chart from time bucketed counts of `MetricRow` (using existing `metric_name` + `ts_unix_nano` + `resource_hash`) treating "metric activity" as the displayed series; LogTable shows `ts_unix_nano`, `resource_hash`, `severity_number` only. Body / severity_text / trace_id / value are not displayed because they don't exist in the Row shape. UI ships with this limitation; future chunks expand.)

- **Path A vs Path B at Phase 6:** the user chose Path B for chunk #34 (full schema extension). For chunk #35, the equivalent Path B doubles the cross-crate ripple (metrics_points + log_records, vs chunk #34's spans only). Path A preserves UI shell quickly but ships placeholder log content (no body, no trace_id correlation possible — undermining the "log stream with span correlation" route description). **Recommendation:** surface Path B as preferred (preserves the chunk's stated capability "span correlation + severity colors" — the trace_id is required for span correlation; severity_text is the natural label paired with severity_number for not-color-alone signaling), with Path A as opt-out if the user wants to defer.

- **Metrics chart aggregation model**: pure client-side aggregation over query result rows (sum/count/avg per bucket) vs server-side `viz.query.metrics.aggregated` route returning bucketed series. v1 chunk #35 preference is client-side (no new TauRPC procedure → no triple-binding cost); server-side aggregation is a future scope (chunk #35+) when query result row counts exceed reasonable client-side aggregation budget.

- **Log search/filter implementation**: client-side filter over loaded rows (simpler, scales to LIMIT_DEFAULT=100 / LIMIT_MAX=1000) vs server-side `LogsQueryArgs` extension with `body_search: Option<String>` + `severity_filter: Vec<i32>` (more capable, requires LogsQueryArgs extension + SELECT_LOGS query extension + tests). v1 chunk #35 preference is client-side. If user wants server-side, that requires extending `LogsQueryArgs` (no new TauRPC procedure name, just args struct extension — but TauRPC bindings auto-regenerate; still backward-compatible).

- **Log severity tier mapping**: OTLP `severity_number` ranges 1-24 (TRACE 1-4, DEBUG 5-8, INFO 9-12, WARN 13-16, ERROR 17-20, FATAL 21-24). chunk #35 severity-color mapping needs design decision on how to bucket: 6 tiers? 4 tiers (TRACE+DEBUG → muted, INFO → primary, WARN → border-only-accent, ERROR+FATAL → accent text)? Combined.md design extract suggests ERROR/FATAL → accent + WARN → accent border + INFO → primary + DEBUG/TRACE → tertiary; that's 4 visual tiers. Recommend explicitly adopting 4-tier mapping at plan.md level; chart fixture/test seeds use the boundary values.

- **`--color-secondary / --color-base` contrast pair gap**: a11y plan §11 flagged this pair as undefined in design tokens. If WARN severity uses `--color-secondary` (Stellar Indigo), the contrast must be defined first OR fall back to `--color-text-primary` paired with `--color-accent` border for WARN. Recommend the latter (preserves locked palette + matches design extract's "WARN → `#C7556A` border + `#E8EEF7` text" guidance).

- **Server-pushed live log stream subscription**: chunk #23 substrate provides `streams.subscribe_logs` for Arrow IPC live stream. v1 chunk #35 can ship with periodic polling (refetch on TIME_WINDOW_SECONDS interval) for simpler test surface; live subscription is a defer-to-chunk-#36+ option. Combined.md obs extract notes "Log stream tail-mode level discipline" assuming the live path; document as deferred from v1 if polling is chosen.

title: Chunk route#36: "Tray icon + native menu — monochrome SVG glyph (NSStatusItem/NotifyIcon/AppIndicator), unified Halo overlay, OS-native menu Open/Snapshot/MCP/Quit"

data.head: ### Chunk route#36: "Tray icon + native menu — monochrome SVG glyph (NSStatusItem/NotifyIcon/AppIndicator), unified Halo overlay, OS-native menu Open/Snapshot/MCP/Quit"

body: **Constraints across domains:**

- (arch) Tray code MUST live in the `pulse-app` binary crate, not in a library crate — the tray surface is a Tauri-app-level concern (window lifecycle, native shell APIs, OS-bundle identity `com.andromeda.pulse`); no library crate may depend on Tauri primitives that own window/tray state (per architecture.md §Cross-cutting Patterns "Module dependency direction" + §Inherited Defaults "Module boundaries").

- (arch) Tray surface MUST gate behind capability identifier `pulse:tray` (reserved at arch level) with concrete capability JSON file under `pulse-app/capabilities/`; `pulse:tray` is one of the 5 reserved capability identifiers and cannot be re-purposed (per architecture.md §Occupied Resources "Tauri capability identifiers" + §Cross-cutting Patterns "Webview IPC capability policy").

- (arch) Tray menu items MUST cover the policy-mandated minimum: open/focus main window, ingest summary (spans/sec + retention used), toggle MCP server (only when `--features mcp-server` is built AND the `mcp-server` crate is loaded), generate snapshot (invokes existing reserved `snapshot.generate`), quit. Window-close-button behavior MUST minimize to tray rather than terminate the process; only the explicit "Quit" menu item or OS-level kill terminates (per architecture.md §Cross-cutting Patterns "Tray icon policy").

- (arch) MCP toggle in tray menu MUST honor double-gate: compile-time `--features mcp-server` AND runtime `ANDROMEDA_PULSE_MCP_ENABLED` — if the binary was built without the feature, the toggle is hidden or shown disabled; the runtime path goes through the reserved `mcp.status` / `mcp.start` / `mcp.stop` TauRPC procedures rather than re-implementing MCP lifecycle (per architecture.md §Established Decisions "[MCP Server Surface]" + §Occupied Resources Tauri IPC routes).

- (arch) Any NEW TauRPC namespace introduced for tray-side IPC re-entry (e.g. `tray.menu_clicked`, `tray.update_glyph`) MUST be both (a) registered in `pulse-app/capabilities/` JSON AND (b) added to arch §Occupied Resources Tauri IPC routes via `/andromeda-scope-arch` BEFORE merge; dotted-namespace shape `<router>.<verb>` is the only authorized form, both segments `snake_case` (per architecture.md §Cross-cutting Patterns "Webview IPC capability policy" + §Conventions "Endpoint naming").

- (arch) Tray surface that subscribes to live ingest data (for the "ingest summary" menu item) MUST consume the existing `tokio::sync::broadcast` fan-out — arch §Established Decisions explicitly enumerates "tray icon" as one of the legitimate broadcast subscribers; do NOT introduce a parallel data path (per architecture.md §Established Decisions "[In-Process Channel Architecture]").

- (arch) Process identity is fixed: tray belongs to the single Tauri process with bundle identifier `com.andromeda.pulse` and binary name `andromeda-pulse[.exe]`; tray code does NOT spawn a subprocess (per architecture.md §Occupied Resources "Process / service identity").

- (security) Tray menu input handlers (Open / Snapshot / MCP toggle / Quit) MUST NOT widen `pulse:tray` beyond outbound-only emit calls — any incoming-event handler that re-enters Rust with payloads MUST go through a separately-named capability with stated rationale (per security plan §Security Anti-Patterns § API "NEVER widen `pulse:tray` (tray icon) beyond outbound-only emit calls" + §Threat Model Summary).

- (security) Every NEW TauRPC procedure routed from a tray menu item MUST have BOTH (a) router registration AND (b) matching `pulse-app/capabilities/` JSON entry — capability-drift enforced by `xtask capability-drift` (per security plan §API Security row "TauRPC capability authorization" + CLAUDE.md security.md Session Additions 2026-05-09 entry on §Occupied Resources update via `/andromeda-scope-arch` BEFORE merge).

- (security) Menu state that fits the `Settings` shape (e.g., `mcp_enabled`, `tray_visible` boolean, `start_minimized`) SHOULD extend `crates/ui-bridge/src/contract.rs::Settings` and flow through existing `get_settings`/`update_settings` rather than introducing a new TauRPC namespace — sidesteps the security ↔ tests/CI ↔ arch capability-drift triple binding (per CLAUDE.md security.md Session Additions 2026-05-09 second entry, verified at chunk #30 with `always_on_top`).

- (security) "Toggle MCP" menu item MUST preserve the compile-time `--features mcp-server` AND runtime `ANDROMEDA_PULSE_MCP_ENABLED=true` double-gate — the menu setting toggle path MUST NOT spawn or signal-start the rmcp sidecar without verifying both gates; the graceful-degrade `warn` when env var set against a binary built without the feature MUST be preserved (per security plan §API Security row "MCP feature double-gate" + §Security Anti-Patterns § Code Patterns).

- (security) "Snapshot" tray menu item invocation path that ultimately writes the curated markdown / clipboard MUST emit a `pulse://stream/snapshot-progress` event at clipboard-write time — the tray surface MUST NOT bypass the clipboard-hygiene contract (per security plan §Logging & Monitoring "Snapshot / clipboard / MCP-tool-response hygiene" load-bearing bullet).

- (security) AppError enum unchanged for tray menu paths: any new procedure called from the tray returns `Result<T, AppError>` with `Validation { field, reason }` / `Internal { message }` sanitized one-liners — NEVER serialize `anyhow::Error` directly across the bridge from tray-routed handlers; NEVER expose stack traces / file paths / library versions / Rust struct names (per security plan §Error Handling + §Security Anti-Patterns § Logging).

- (security) Tray icon glyph asset is first-party SVG at build time — MUST NOT load icon resources from user-overridable paths, MUST NOT accept icon overrides via env-var paths without `strict-path` canonicalize-and-confine (per security plan §Security Anti-Patterns § Input).

- (design) Tray icon MUST be a single monochrome SVG, 16-22 px (platform-dependent), styled as a stylized pulsar / constellation star with circular outline (aperture metaphor) — no animation in the glyph itself; rendering uses macOS template-image flag, Windows + Linux render same SVG with system status-bar tint (per design-system §Surface: desktop-native → Component Patterns → Tray Icon).

- (design) Halo overlay around the tray icon MUST encode the same two dimensions as the desktop-webview Halo: throughput rhythm via pulsing frequency 0.8-2.4 Hz AND error rate via LCH hue interpolation Earth Blue (#4A90E2) ↔ Alert Burgundy (#C7556A); composited as a secondary WebGPU canvas layer (per design-system §Brand Identity Signature element + §Surface: desktop-native → Tray Icon).

- (design) If WebGPU is unavailable in tray context, SVG-filter fallback is permitted ONLY when it meets the visual-equivalence criteria: blur radius 4-16 px per pulse cycle, LCH color interpolation fidelity ≥95% of the Earth Blue ↔ Alert Burgundy shift, opacity 0.6-1.0 envelope matching WebGPU baseline (per design-system §Surface: desktop-native → Tray Icon visual equivalence).

- (design) Tray menu MUST be flat hierarchy with dividers; menu items in canonical order: "Open andromeda-pulse" → divider → read-only summary line "Ingest: {spans/sec} | Error: {%} | Retention: {min} used" → divider → "Generate Snapshot", "Toggle MCP Server" (only when `--features mcp-server`; checkbox-marked when enabled), "Open Settings" → divider → "Quit" (per design-system §Surface: desktop-native → Tray Menu).

- (design) Menu label tone MUST be contemplative / observational voice — "Generate Snapshot" not "Export Data"; "Toggle MCP Server" not "Enable AI Integration"; "Open andromeda-pulse" not "Show Window"; "Quit" not "Exit" (per design-system §Surface: desktop-native → Tray Menu Tone + §Brand Identity contemplative voice).

- (design) Tray menu MUST use OS-native chrome only — no custom styling, no web-style cards/shadows/rounded corners, system font (system-ui), OS-controlled padding / icon sizing / label positioning (per design-system §Surface: desktop-native → Tokens system theme integration).

- (design) Motion at desktop-native surface is constrained to expression level 0.2: only the Halo State Pulse glyph may animate per its data-driven rules (canvas exemption); ALL other state changes are instant per OS convention; tray icon glyph itself draws once at startup + updates on state changes, no real-time animation in the SVG (per design-system §Motion → Expression level 0.2 desktop-native).

- (layouts) Tray icon = single monochrome SVG glyph (aperture / constellation-star motif) rendered as the OS template image; ALL motion / colour encoding lives in a SEPARATE secondary Halo State Pulse layer composited behind/around the glyph (per layout-templates §Surface: desktop-native → Wireframe — Tray icon notes + §Component — Tray icon → Design).

- (layouts) Summary line is a non-clickable read-only menu item (`font-label`, `color-text-tertiary`) showing live "Ingest: {spans/sec} | Error: {%} | {min} used" — updates via short-interval polling (1–2 second suggested) or IPC subscription (per §Component — Tray menu (OS-native) → Structure).

- (layouts) SVG glyph construction is line-based only (no fills / gradients / shadows): outer circle (1px stroke) + inner star or aperture cross (4–6 strokes); ViewBox sized for crisp rendering at small platform sizes (per §Component — Tray icon → SVG construction).

- (layouts) Halo State Pulse on the tray surface is UNIFIED (single halo encoding aggregated health + ingest), NOT per-service — visual contract identical to compact widget badge halo, NOT to full-dashboard constellation per-service halos (per §Component — Tray icon → Halo State Pulse + §Cross-surface coordination).

- (layouts) Halo composition uses Option A (WebGPU click-through always-on-top transparent overlay window hosting `<canvas>` running same shader as desktop-webview) preferred; Option B (inline SVG with `<feColorMatrix>` + CSS animation) is the fallback when WebGPU is unavailable, with visual equivalence ≥95% (per §Component — Tray icon → Halo State Pulse → Option A/B).

- (tests) Test tier is Standard; webview React unit tests use `vitest` 3.x + `jsdom` 26 + `@testing-library/react` 16, Rust unit tests use `cargo test` (libtest 1.85+) + `cargo-nextest` 0.9.x with per-process isolation (per test-plan §1 Tier + §4 Frameworks).
- (tests) Coverage gate for new code: ≥75% line / ≥70% branch / ≥85% function (per test-plan §10 Quality Gates Standard tier). Excludes generated TauRPC `bindings/index.ts` and any `prost` stubs.

- (tests) **Boot-smoke discipline (mandatory for this chunk):** chunks touching `pulse-app/src/main.rs`, `crates/ui-bridge/src/`, `pulse-app/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json`, OR `pulse-app/capabilities/*.json` MUST include `npx @tauri-apps/cli dev` (60s timeout, watching for `Local:` / `ready in` / `Compiled successfully` boot-completion signals before SIGTERM) in their Test Commands (per test-plan §12 Decisions Log 2026-05-09 amendment + §3 Test Harness Contract).

- (tests) Platform-specific tests for tray/notification/window behavior MUST be gated via `#[cfg(target_os = "macos")] / "windows" / "linux"` (per test-plan §1 Test Organization). Cross-platform unit tests must compile and run on all 3 matrix runners.

- (tests) Critical path P5 (widget ↔ dashboard ↔ tray visibility toggle) is **DEFERRED** at agent-driven harness level — full GUI tray automation requires `tauri-driver` headful mode. Agent-driven surrogate: assert tray subsystem state via TauRPC `health` response shape; assert menu callback IPC contract via in-process `tauri::test::mock_builder()` (per test-plan §6 Scenario P5 Status).

- (tests) Self-bootstrapping fixture rule: any tests staging tray menu state must drive via TauRPC IPC or builder factories (e.g., extend `Settings` with tray-related boolean/enum if introducing new persisted state); no pre-baked tray state files (per test-plan §7 Self-Bootstrapping Requirement + §11 Test Data anti-pattern).

- (tests) If chunk #36 introduces a NEW TauRPC procedure namespace, the `xtask capability-drift` check MUST pass: namespace appears in `xtask/src/main.rs::EXPECTED_PROCEDURES`, `pulse-app/capabilities/*.json`, AND arch.md §Occupied Resources via `/andromeda-scope-arch` PRE-merge (per test-plan §1 trigger "Tauri IPC capability gating").

- (obs) Tray emits boundary events ONLY — no native OS internals (notification-center machinery, NSStatusItem timer threads, NotifyIcon message-pump events) are instrumented; emit on the operations the host code actually invokes (visibility toggle, menu interaction, notification dismiss, notification action) (per obs-plan §1 Telemetry surfaces row "desktop-native" + §4 instrumentation table).

- (obs) Tray spans MUST ride the same `tracing-subscriber` JSON sink as the rest of the app — no separate file, no platform-specific log path; events land in `~/.andromeda-pulse/logs/agent-latest.jsonl` via the shared subscriber (per obs-plan §1 desktop-native row).

- (obs) `app.boot.tray.init` MUST tag the resolved tray API as `tray_api ∈ {"NSStatusItem", "NotifyIcon", "AppIndicator"}` — bounded enumerated label (no OS-version strings, no platform-detection error messages) (per obs-plan §5 metric label cardinality discipline + §1 multi-platform-exporter-compat trigger row).

- (obs) Service identity defaults (`service.name = "com.andromeda.pulse"`, `service.version = env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION")`, `deployment.environment = "production"`) flow automatically via `Layer::with_default_fields` — tray emit sites do NOT repeat them (per obs-plan §3 Service identity).

- (obs) Menu-item taxonomy MUST be enumerated for the `menu_item` field on `tray.menu.interaction` — bound to `{"open", "snapshot", "mcp_toggle", "quit"}` so cardinality stays bounded and `jq` aggregation is cheap (per obs-plan §11 Metrics anti-pattern "NEVER use unbounded label cardinality").

- (obs) Trace-context propagation: when a tray menu interaction triggers a downstream IPC call, the originating tray boundary span must produce / forward an opaque `traceparent` plain string field so the downstream TauRPC handler's `#[tracing::instrument(skip_all, fields(traceparent = %tp))]` can inherit (per obs-plan §3 Trace context propagation: IPC boundaries).

- (obs) Tray instrumentation MUST NOT widen the per-target field allowlist (`pulse-app/src/observability.rs::AllowList`) beyond the four documented sets `["tray_api"]` / `["tray_visible"]` / `["menu_item"]` / `["notification_id"]` / `["notification_id","action"]` already provisioned (per obs-plan §8 default-deny scrubbing + §11 NEVER hardcode scrubbing rules in a single location).

- (a11y) Tray menu uses OS-native `menu` / `menuitem` semantics with Arrow-key navigation and Return/Space activation; Escape closes the menu — items must be authored via Tauri's tray menu API (which delegates to NSStatusItem / NotifyIcon / AppIndicator), NEVER as a custom webview-rendered popup (per a11y-plan §1 desktop-native row + §3 Keyboard Test Harness + §4 ARIA Patterns Menu row + §5 Keyboard Navigation tray-menu line).

- (a11y) Each menu item ("Open / Snapshot / MCP toggle / Quit") must carry an accessible name string at the OS API layer — string content authored in code becomes the accessible name announced by NVDA / VoiceOver / Orca; the MCP toggle item must additionally convey checked state via the OS native menu's checkmark/checked attribute, satisfying SC 4.1.2 (per a11y-plan §1 Tray icon status display row + §3 Critical paths P3 row).

- (a11y) Focus restoration: tray icon click that re-expands the compact widget MUST return keyboard focus to the compact-widget on restore; conversely Esc-minimize from compact widget returns focus to the tray icon — bidirectional anchor for Critical Path P5 (per a11y-plan §3 Critical paths P5 row + §5 Keyboard Navigation Focus restoration).

- (a11y) Tray icon glyph + Halo overlay are non-text content carrying state; non-text contrast must meet SC 1.4.11 ≥3:1 against the OS tray-bar background — the monochrome SVG glyph and the unified Halo overlay must remain distinguishable in light-mode and dark-mode OS themes (per a11y-plan §6 Color contrast pairs `--color-primary` / `--color-accent` non-text rows).

- (a11y) Halo overlay on the tray icon MUST respect `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` — the Halo pulse degrades to a static-glow under reduced-motion, with state still conveyed via hue (color) + the SVG glyph (icon) so the channel is not motion-alone (per a11y-plan §6 Motion tokens + §11 Motion bans + SC 2.3.3 AAA + SC 1.4.1 Use of Color).

- (a11y) Tray icon + glyph + Halo overlay state MUST NOT be conveyed by color alone — pair with SVG glyph (icon channel) and OS-level menu item or tooltip text describing app state (per a11y-plan §6 State color tokens + SC 1.4.1).
**Patterns to follow:**

- (arch) **Settings-extension preferred over new TauRPC namespace** when the new tray-related capability fits a get/set shape — extending `Settings` (e.g. `start_minimized: bool`, `tray_enabled: bool`) flows through established `get_settings` / `update_settings` envelope without forcing a `/andromeda-scope-arch` run, mirroring the chunk #30 `always_on_top` precedent (per architecture.md §Standard Contracts top-level envelope).

- (arch) **Rust-side-only emit pattern** when tray events drive existing TauRPC procedures — wiring tray menu clicks directly to `snapshot.generate` / `mcp.start` / `mcp.stop` invocations from the Rust side (no webview round-trip) sidesteps introducing a new `tray.*` namespace entirely (per architecture.md §Cross-cutting Patterns "Webview IPC capability policy").

- (arch) **Capability identifier separation** — `pulse:tray` is the outbound surface; any input-event capability for tray menu IPC re-entry from webview JavaScript requires its own capability identifier per the same separation arch applies к `pulse:notification` (per architecture.md §Occupied Resources "Tauri capability identifiers").

- (arch) **OS notification reuse** — when tray-driven snapshot completion fires, the existing `pulse://stream/snapshot-progress` event + `tauri-plugin-notification` + `pulse:notification` capability are the contract; do NOT introduce a separate tray-only notification path (per architecture.md §Cross-cutting Patterns "OS notification policy").

- (arch) **Per-crate template applies к pulse-app** — public contract module (the only `pub` surface in `pulse-app` for tray exports), `pub(crate)` internals, `thiserror`-derived error enum if tray needs typed errors, with conversion at the bridge via `From` impls into `AppError` if any IPC path returns errors (per architecture.md §Project Intent + §Established Decisions).

- (security) **Settings-extension shortcut pattern from chunk #30** — added `always_on_top: bool` to `Settings` + `Settings::load_from_data_dir()` boot helper + `apply_widget_settings()`. Apply same shape for tray-related state — zero new TauRPC procedures, zero new capability JSON, zero `EXPECTED_PROCEDURES` expansion (per CLAUDE.md security.md Session Additions 2026-05-09 second entry).

- (security) **D3 capability-drift cleanup coupled with consuming chunk** — if chunk #36 introduces a new `tray.*` namespace, include the `xtask EXPECTED_PROCEDURES` extension AND the `/andromeda-scope-arch` arch §Occupied Resources update in the same chunk-#36 commit; couple > standalone housekeeping (per CLAUDE.md security.md Session Additions 2026-05-10 + chunk #34 precedent).

- (security) **Capability JSON router-level granularity (NOT per-procedure)** — TauRPC integrates at IPC channel level via `taurpc::create_ipc_handler`. Capability JSON `permissions` array contains `core:default` + plugin-level perms, NOT per-procedure entries (per CLAUDE.md security.md Session Additions 2026-05-03 second entry + chunk #27 implementation reality).

- (security) **Outbound-only tray emit pattern** — tray UI updates flow OUT from Rust to the OS tray API (Tauri's `TrayIconBuilder` / `MenuBuilder`); user clicks on menu items handled by Tauri-internal event loop and SHOULD route to existing typed procedures rather than custom string-keyed dispatch (per security plan §Security Anti-Patterns § API).

- (security) **AppError-at-bridge pattern** — tray-triggered handlers convert module-internal `thiserror` enums to `AppError` via existing `From` impls; reuse the `Validation { field, reason }` / `Plugin { plugin_id, message }` / `Storage { message }` variants (per security plan §Error Handling).

- (design) **Halo State Pulse on tray follows the same data → visual mapping as chunk #31** — frequency clamped 0.8-2.4 Hz from `throughput_hz / 1000`, blur 4-16 px per cycle, 0.6-1.2 s per breath, LCH interpolation between #4A90E2 and #C7556A (per design-system §Brand Identity Signature element).

- (design) **Iconography follows the custom domain-specific SVG set** — prefer `circular-pulse` glyph (compact widget / tray surface toggle metaphor) or a stylized aperture / pulsar variant from the same family — registered as React component at `<Root>/src/components/icons/`, monochrome with #E8EEF7 default (per design-system §Iconography Primary custom set).

- (design) **Reduced-motion accessibility pattern matches the desktop-webview Halo** — `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` degrades the tray Halo to a static glow (no pulsing rhythm, hue still updates per error rate); other state changes become instant 0 ms (per design-system §Motion Accessibility).

- (design) **Notification format on snapshot completion** — established 2-lines-max / terse template "Snapshot ready | 2.5k tokens, 42 spans" with optional OS action button "View" or "Copy to Clipboard"; small app-icon attached (per design-system §Surface: desktop-native → Notifications).

- (design) **Native dialogs MUST use OS-native primitives** — NSOpenPanel / IFileDialog / zenity; never custom file browser; respect platform button-ordering convention (per design-system §Surface: desktop-native → Dialog).

- (layouts) **Three-surface Halo coherence** — tray unified halo shares the same WGSL shader logic + frequency clamping + LCH hue interpolation as the compact widget unified halo + full-dashboard per-service halos — visual consistency maintained because all three subscribe to `pulse://stream/spans` (per §IA notes → Cross-surface coordination + Decisions Log).

- (layouts) **Data-driven state variants for halo** — Healthy = `color-primary` smooth pulse; Degraded = intermediate LCH hue, faster pulse; Unhealthy = `color-accent` clamped-max pulse; Silent (zero throughput) = dim low-end opacity, minimum pulse rate (per §Component — Tray icon → State variants).

- (layouts) **Left-click vs right-click separation** — left-click on tray icon focuses/restores the compact widget (single primary action); right-click opens the menu (per §IA notes → Navigation model).

- (layouts) **Notification-hooks-into-tray-surface pattern** — snapshot generation, MCP state changes, updater state transitions ALL fire OS-native toasts via `tauri-plugin-notification`; user opt-out via `notifications_enabled` boolean in `~/.andromeda-pulse/config.toml` (default true) (per §Component — Notifications).

- (tests) **Co-located unit tests + JUnit XML output** — Rust `#[cfg(test)] mod tests { … }` flat-function blocks adjacent to source; webview `*.test.tsx` adjacent to source; both emit JUnit XML (`target/nextest/junit.xml` + `target/junit-ui.xml`) for CI agent parsing (per test-plan §4 Conventions).
- (tests) **`rstest` 0.26.1 fixture composition** — for any tray-state factory, use `#[fixture]` for reusable builders rather than ad-hoc inline construction (per test-plan §4 Fixture pattern + §7).

- (tests) **TauRPC IPC contract testing in-process** — use `tauri::test::mock_builder()` + `get_ipc_response(InvokePayload { … })` for tray menu IPC procedure unit tests; assert `Result<T, AppError>` JSON shape (per test-plan §5 Boundary types covered + §6).

- (tests) **Platform-conditional test gating** — wrap macOS / Windows / Linux-specific logic in `#[cfg(target_os = "...")]` modules, with cross-platform shared helpers (menu definition, glyph SVG resolution) tested without conditional gating (per test-plan §1 Test Organization).

- (tests) **Settings struct extension as low-cost path** — if tray exposes new persistable state, extend `Settings` struct in `crates/ui-bridge/src/contract.rs` rather than adding a new TauRPC namespace (per test-plan §1 trigger applied via security 2026-05-09 decision pattern).

- (tests) **Webview tray-icon glyph component testing pattern** — DOM-shape assertions on `viewBox` / `aria-*` / `currentColor` propagation / banned-element grep (no `<animate>` / gradient / filter), `aria-hidden="true"` default flipping to `role="img"` when `aria-label` provided (per test-plan §4 unit-test pattern for icons).

- (obs) **Existing emission template** — `tracing::info!(target: "tray.{event}", field = ..., "human-readable summary")` for boundary events; pre-existing scrubber tests at `pulse-app/src/observability.rs:2607-2649` pin the four targets `tray.visibility.toggle` / `tray.menu.interaction` / `tray.notification.dismiss` / `tray.notification.action` plus the boot-time `app.boot.tray.init` (per obs-plan §1 desktop-native row + §4).

- (obs) **Boot-tag pattern** — `app.boot.tray.init` emits exactly once at boot per platform with `tray_api` set; mirrors `app.boot.webview.init` / `app.boot.gpu.check` triple already documented (per obs-plan §1 trigger row "multi-platform-exporter-compat").

- (obs) **Boundary-only span discipline** — wrap host-side menu callback / icon callback handlers with `#[tracing::instrument(skip_all, fields(menu_item = %item))]` style attributes; do not add spans to OS-thread message pumps or per-frame icon refresh paths (per obs-plan §11 "NEVER over-instrument hot paths").

- (obs) **Single sink for backend + tray + webview-bridged events** — `tracing-subscriber` registry composition unchanged; tray emission sites just `use tracing::info` (per obs-plan §3 Logging stack).

- (a11y) **OS-native menu role pattern** — author menu via Tauri's tray API surfacing `menu` / `menuitem` roles so OS-native a11y APIs (UIA / NSAccessibility / ATK) expose them; arrow-up/down navigates items, Return/Space activates, Escape closes — no custom keyboard handling required (per a11y-plan §4 + §5).

- (a11y) **Switch / toggle state pattern for "MCP toggle" menu item** — use the OS-native menu's checked-item facility (NSMenuItem.state / NotifyIcon checked attribute / AppIndicator radio-or-check group) so SR announces "checked"/"unchecked" (per a11y-plan §3 Critical paths P3 + §4 Switch ARIA pattern row).

- (a11y) **Focus-restoration pattern for tray ↔ compact-widget transitions** — Esc minimizes compact-widget to tray then OS focuses tray icon; tray "Open" menu item activation re-expands compact-widget then focuses the widget's first focusable element. Bidirectional restoration matches `focus-trap-react` `returnFocusOnDeactivate: true` (per a11y-plan §5).

- (a11y) **Manual SR test pattern for tray surface (supplemental)** — automated reach is limited; manual pass per platform required: NVDA + Windows tray, VoiceOver + macOS menu bar, Orca + Linux indicator panel; verify menu role announcement, item label announcement, MCP toggle state announcement, and Esc-close announcement (per a11y-plan §3 Screen Reader Test Pattern + §1 desktop-native row).

- (a11y) **Halo motion respects motion/react `useReducedMotion` AND CSS `motion-reduce:`** — for the webview-side Halo, the same hooks should drive the tray-overlay rendering when the overlay is composited via offscreen canvas / WebGPU before being handed to the OS tray API (per a11y-plan §6 Motion tokens verification + §11 Motion ban).
**Anti-patterns to avoid:**

- (arch) Do NOT add a non-`pulse-app` library crate dependency on Tauri's `tray-icon` / `system-tray` primitives — library crates have no direct Tauri window/tray dependency per the DAG-toward-`pulse-app` rule (arch §Cross-cutting Patterns "Module dependency direction").

- (arch) Do NOT widen `pulse:default` capability to grant tray APIs to the webview — `pulse:tray` is the dedicated capability and must remain outbound-emit-only unless an explicitly-named separate capability for input-event handlers is added with stated rationale (arch §Cross-cutting Patterns).

- (arch) Do NOT introduce a `tray.*` TauRPC namespace ad-hoc — if needed, run `/andromeda-scope-arch` BEFORE the chunk merges; otherwise extend `Settings` for static get/set or use Rust-side-only emit for action triggers. Do NOT extend `xtask EXPECTED_PROCEDURES` standalone-housekeeping-style; couple with consuming code (per the 2026-05-09 + 2026-05-10 .claude/rules/security.md Session Additions).

- (arch) Do NOT make window-close terminate the process — that violates the tray policy "closing the main window minimizes to tray rather than terminating the process; process termination requires the explicit Quit menu item or OS-level kill" (arch §Cross-cutting Patterns "Tray icon policy").

- (arch) Do NOT add a new env var for tray configuration outside the reserved `ANDROMEDA_PULSE_*` namespace — tray-specific knobs (e.g. tray-enabled boolean) belong in `~/.andromeda-pulse/config.toml` via `Settings` (arch §Occupied Resources "Environment variables").

- (security) NEVER widen `pulse:tray` capability JSON to include input-event handlers — converts the outbound-only tray surface into a phishing / IPC-abuse vector (per security plan §Security Anti-Patterns § API).

- (security) NEVER toggle MCP from the tray menu by directly invoking `mcp.start` / `mcp.stop` without the compile-time-feature-flag check — single-gate spawning is a regression of the architecture-declared double-gate (per security plan §Security Anti-Patterns § Code Patterns + §API Security row "MCP feature double-gate").

- (security) NEVER add a `tray.*` TauRPC namespace AND ship chunk #36 without (a) the `pulse-app/capabilities/` JSON entry AND (b) the `/andromeda-scope-arch` update to arch §Occupied Resources Tauri IPC routes — silent capability-drift D3 will compound and the bridge will reject calls at runtime (per CLAUDE.md security.md Session Additions 2026-05-09 first entry + 2026-05-10 entry).

- (design) NEVER apply web-style design language (cards, shadows, rounded corners, custom typography) inside the tray menu — clashes with OS chrome (per design-system §Anti-Patterns Per-Surface Bans desktop-native item 1).

- (design) NEVER fight the system font in menu items and notifications — use OS-native labels; brand personality at this surface is expressed through icon design + menu tone + notification copy style (per design-system §Anti-Patterns Per-Surface Bans desktop-native item 3 + §Typography).

- (design) NEVER use uniform monochrome status icons (green check / red X) for tray state — Halo State Pulse encodes two independent dimensions (throughput rhythm + error hue); collapsing to a single boolean indicator is a rejected default (per design-system §Anti-Patterns Rejected Defaults item 1).

- (design) NEVER use web notification libraries in place of OS-native notifications; NEVER block the UI thread with dialogs (per design-system §Anti-Patterns Per-Surface Bans desktop-native items 4-5).
- (layouts) Do NOT render a custom file browser inside the app for snapshot export — always invoke the OS-native file picker (per §Component — File picker).

- (layouts) Do NOT add nested submenus to the tray menu, do NOT add global hotkeys at the tray level, and do NOT include deep-navigation entries (Traces / Metrics / Logs) in the tray menu (per §Component — Tray menu (OS-native) → Structure + §IA notes).

- (layouts) Do NOT animate the SVG glyph itself or add custom emergence chrome to the menu — tray menu emergence is OS-native and instant; the `0.2` desktop-native expression level forbids custom chrome animation (per §Surface: desktop-native → Expression level).

- (tests) NEVER include manual verification / human-in-loop checkpoints in tray tests — agent-driven discipline forbids visual regression with human review (per test-plan §11 Universal anti-patterns + §1 trigger).

- (tests) NEVER use `sleep(N)` for synchronization between tray menu click → IPC handler → state mutation — use Channel event subscription or `health` status polling for explicit signal (per test-plan §11 E2E anti-patterns).

- (tests) NEVER add a TauRPC procedure for tray without matching capability JSON entry AND matching `xtask EXPECTED_PROCEDURES` entry AND arch §Occupied Resources legitimization — silent runtime IPC rejection at first menu click otherwise (per test-plan §1 trigger + §11 anti-pattern).
- (obs) NEVER instrument inside the OS message pump / NSRunLoop / GTK main loop — per-tick events flood the JSON file and break agent-readable triage (per obs-plan §11).

- (obs) NEVER include user-visible menu text / localized strings / arbitrary OS notification body content in tray spans — emit the bounded `menu_item` enum + `notification_id` opaque handle only (per obs-plan §11).
- (obs) NEVER `println!` / `dbg!` from any tray callback when the binary is running as the rmcp stdio sidecar — stdout corruption silently disconnects the MCP client (per obs-plan §11).

- (a11y) NEVER replace the OS-native tray menu with a custom webview-rendered popup window — would forfeit OS-native a11y tree exposure, break SR announcement contracts, and require re-implementing the entire `menu` / `menuitem` keyboard contract by hand (per a11y-plan §1 + §11 ARIA bans).
- (a11y) NEVER convey tray icon state by Halo color alone — every state hue must be paired with the SVG glyph and ideally a menu item or tooltip text channel (per a11y-plan §11 Visual bans).
- (a11y) NEVER autoplay the Halo motion on the tray overlay without reduced-motion respect (per a11y-plan §11 Motion bans + SC 2.3.3 AAA).

- (a11y) NEVER omit accessible-name strings on menu items — every "Open / Snapshot / MCP toggle / Quit" item must have a non-empty label string at the Tauri tray menu API surface (per a11y-plan §11 Screen Reader bans + §3 SC 4.1.2).
**Contract bindings:**

- **arch ↔ design**: tray icon glyphs + per-locale menu labels owned by design specialist; arch reserves the surface (`pulse:tray` capability + Tray icon policy menu items) but defers visual assets to design plan §Iconography registry. **Reciprocated** — design extract acknowledges "design ↔ arch (capability scoping, ack only)".

- **arch ↔ a11y**: tray menu accessibility (keyboard navigation, screen-reader labels, OS-native a11y APIs) owned by a11y specialist; arch's contribution is policy-enforcement that menu items exist + minimize-to-tray semantics. **Reciprocated** — a11y extract acknowledges "a11y ↔ design" + "a11y ↔ security".

- **arch ↔ security**: any new TauRPC namespace requires bidirectional pairing — `pulse-app/capabilities/` JSON entry AND arch §Occupied Resources update via `/andromeda-scope-arch`. The xtask `capability-drift` gate parses TauRPC bindings against an xtask-side EXPECTED_PROCEDURES list — couple any EXPECTED_PROCEDURES extension in the same commit as the consuming code. **Reciprocated** — security extract has explicit "Security ↔ tests" capability widening binding.

- **arch ↔ obs**: tray menu actions invoking `snapshot.generate` / `mcp.start` / `mcp.stop` propagate through the same tracing instrumentation those procedures already carry; tray itself emits its own `tracing` spans via the self-observation runtime (no OTel SDK) per arch §Cross-cutting Patterns "Self-observation discipline". **Reciprocated** — obs extract acknowledges single-sink `tracing-subscriber` discipline.

- **arch ↔ tests**: tray surface tests inject events through the same tray TauRPC contract (or the Rust-side handler if no IPC contract is added) — no test-mode tray bypass per arch §Cross-cutting Patterns "Test-time telemetry injection" general rule. **Reciprocated** — tests extract acknowledges "tests ↔ arch (occupied-resources legitimization)".

- **security ↔ tests** (capability widening static analysis + capability JSON sync): chunk #36 acceptance includes `cargo xtask capability-drift` clean — binding to tests' CI gate per security plan §Bootstrap phases `dep-security-ci-gate`. If chunk #36 introduces `tray.*` namespace, BOTH `xtask EXPECTED_PROCEDURES` extension AND `pulse-app/capabilities/` JSON update AND arch §Occupied Resources update must land in the same commit. **Reciprocated bilaterally** — both extracts cite the binding identically; tests references `pulse:tray` is one of 3 NEVER-widen capabilities per test-plan §12 Decisions Log 2026-05-08 amendment "Document missing capability-widening static analysis tests" (gap is documented as pending coverage trigger; chunk #36 inherits that gap rather than introducing fresh test coverage).

- **security ↔ obs**: "MCP toggle" tray menu state changes are operationally relevant security events — a state transition to `mcp_enabled=true` SHOULD log via the `tracing` JSON formatter at `info` level with module identity but WITHOUT logging the env-var value verbatim. Snapshot generate from tray binds to the same `pulse://stream/snapshot-progress` clipboard-write event contract. **Reciprocated** — obs extract acknowledges security PII redaction binding (§Logging vectors 1-6).

- **security ↔ a11y**: tray menu accessibility owned by a11y; security side enforces NOT regressing to a custom-rendered (non-OS-native) menu, because that bypasses the OS accessibility tree AND introduces a webview-attached input surface that would require widening `pulse:tray`. **Reciprocated** — a11y extract acknowledges "a11y ↔ security" pulse:tray outbound-emit-only constraint.

- **security ↔ design**: tray glyphs + menu labels owned by design; security side enforces glyph assets ship as build-time first-party resources (icon registry from chunk #1 Foundation), NOT loaded from user-overridable paths. The unified Halo overlay technique (data-driven from same broadcast as widget Halo) flows through existing `pulse://stream/spans` subscriber path; no new MCP-side or plugin-side trust boundary is opened. **Reciprocated implicitly** — design extract cites design-system §Iconography registry.

- **design ↔ a11y (motion)**: tray Halo MUST honor `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` (degrade pulse rhythm to static glow; hue still updates per error rate). a11y owns SC 2.3.3 verification; design provides static-glow fallback semantics. **Reciprocated** — a11y extract has matching "a11y ↔ design" binding.

- **design ↔ a11y (use of color)**: tray-icon Halo color carries error-rate state; per design §Color Palette anti-pattern + a11y SC 1.4.1 not-color-alone, the tray menu's read-only summary line is the textual companion that pairs with color signal — keep summary line in chunk #36 scope. **Reciprocated** — a11y extract reinforces SC 1.4.1 in Constraints.

- **design ↔ obs**: tray Halo pulse cycles emit the same observability hooks as desktop-webview Halo — log clamped pulse frequency (Hz) and Halo color state per cycle. Reuse existing chunk #31 measurement-intent path. **Reciprocated** — obs extract confirms boundary-only span discipline at canvas surface.

- **layouts ↔ a11y**: tray menu keyboard navigation MUST follow OS-native conventions — arrow keys cycle items, Return/Space selects, Escape closes. Layouts owns structural ordering (flat hierarchy, divider placement, read-only summary line); a11y owns focus / screen-reader announcement. The read-only summary line being non-clickable is also an a11y contract (skipped during arrow navigation on macOS/Windows; dimmed text on Linux). **Reciprocated** — a11y extract has matching keyboard navigation binding.

- **layouts ↔ a11y (reduced-motion)**: layouts plan specifies static-glow-with-hue-update behavior at `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`; a11y owns SC 2.3.3 AAA verification of degradation. Both halo composition paths (Option A WebGPU + Option B SVG-filter fallback) MUST honor the same reduced-motion contract. **Reciprocated**.

- **layouts ↔ design-tokens**: tray glyph color uses `color-text-primary` default fill on Windows/Linux; macOS uses OS template-image flag. Halo overlay uses `color-primary` ↔ `color-accent` LCH interpolation per error rate identically to compact widget signature spec. **Bilateral** — token IDs owned by design; placement / state-variant mapping by layouts.

- **layouts ↔ arch (capability/IPC + notifications)**: tray menu items wire to existing TauRPC procedures (`snapshot.generate`, `mcp.start`/`mcp.stop`, focus-window action); `pulse:tray` is the gating capability identifier. Snapshot-completion / MCP state / updater notifications fire via `tauri-plugin-notification`; layouts commits trigger events + format; arch owns capability gating (`pulse:notification`). **Reciprocated** — arch extract acknowledges OS notification reuse pattern.

- **tests ↔ obs (5-command harness)**: chunk #36 boot-smoke gate (`npx @tauri-apps/cli dev` 60s timeout) consumes obs-plan log format (JSON-line `tracing-subscriber::fmt().json()` to `~/.andromeda-pulse/logs/agent-latest.jsonl`); `health` TauRPC subsystems response shape MAY need to gain a `tray` subsystem entry if tray init is gated as a top-level subsystem. zero-`app.panic.fatal` discipline at boot smoke is the obs-plan binding. **Reciprocated bilaterally** — both extracts cite identical contract.

- **tests ↔ a11y**: Critical Path P5 (compact-widget ↔ dashboard ↔ tray) is jointly owned. A11y contributes focus-restoration + Esc-close + tray-menu manual-SR assertions; tests harness owns the Playwright-driven webview side. Tests records the manual-pass outcome via `tests::a11y_p5_manual_tray_*` JSON artifact. **Reciprocated** — a11y extract has explicit "a11y ↔ tests" P5 jointness.

- **obs ↔ a11y violation JSON**: a11y axe violations and Lighthouse / pa11y emissions ride the same `tracing-subscriber` JSON sink; chunk #36 must NOT introduce a tray-specific log file or alternate JSON schema. Tray events and a11y violation events coexist as different `target` values with disjoint allowlist entries. **Reciprocated** — a11y extract has matching "a11y ↔ obs" violation JSON binding.
