data.head: # Phase 33 Plan — chunks route#36: "Tray icon + native menu"

body: _Generated by /andromeda-phase Phase 4. Read by /andromeda-implement. Manual edits between runs are fine; do not edit during /implement run._
- **Phase number:** 33

- **Route chunks covered:**
  - route#36 "Tray icon + native menu — monochrome SVG glyph (NSStatusItem/NotifyIcon/AppIndicator), unified Halo overlay, OS-native menu Open/Snapshot/MCP/Quit"
- **Epoch:** Epoch 5 — Visualization surfaces

Chunk #36 lands the OS-native tray surface — the third home of the Halo State Pulse signature element after compact widget (chunk #31) and full dashboard (chunks #33-#34). The tray icon registers via Tauri 2's built-in `TrayIconBuilder` API in `pulse-app/src/main.rs::main()` setup closure, displaying a monochrome SVG glyph (line-based aperture/pulsar motif coherent with existing `pulse-app/ui/src/components/icons/` family). Right-click opens a flat OS-native menu with canonical labels per design plan §Surface: desktop-native: "Open andromeda-pulse" → divider → read-only summary line "Ingest: {spans/sec} | Error: {%} | Retention: {min} used" → divider → "Generate Snapshot" + "Toggle MCP Server" (cfg-feature gated) + "Open Settings" → divider → "Quit". Menu click handlers wire to existing infrastructure (window focus for Open / Open Settings, `Settings.mcp_server_enabled` flip via existing `update_settings` for Toggle MCP, `app.exit(0)` for Quit) or emit `tray.menu.interaction` placeholders for handlers awaiting their epochs (Generate Snapshot defers to epoch 6's `snapshot.generate` per combined.md Pattern 2 rot warning).

The chunk inherits 7 specialist constraint clusters: (security) outbound-emit-only `pulse:tray` capability + MCP feature double-gate preservation + clipboard-hygiene event emission discipline (deferred to actual snapshot epoch); (design) monochrome SVG line-based glyph + Halo dual-encoding (throughput + error rate) + contemplative menu tone; (layouts) flat menu hierarchy + 4-state Halo variants + left-click vs right-click separation + notification format placeholder; (tests) co-located vitest + cargo-nextest + boot-smoke gate (mandatory for boot-path-touching chunks per test-plan §3 amendment 2026-05-09); (obs) boundary-only spans at 5 pre-allocated `tray.*` targets + bounded `menu_item` enum + service identity inheritance; (a11y) OS-native menu/menuitem semantics + accessible-name strings + checked attribute for MCP toggle + Critical Path P5 focus restoration + SC 1.4.11 non-text contrast; (arch) `pulse-app/` binary crate placement + `pulse:tray` capability gate + capability identifier separation + DAG-toward-pulse-app dependency direction.

The Settings-extension shortcut sidesteps the security ↔ tests/CI ↔ arch capability-drift triple binding (no new TauRPC namespace) — `mcp_server_enabled` and `notifications_enabled` already exist in `Settings` (chunk #27) and chunk #36 reuses both verbatim. Window-close-to-tray policy from chunk #24 is preserved — close button hides window, tray icon stays alive, only "Quit" menu item terminates the process. This chunk closes a major epoch-5 surface gap and unlocks operational UX (tray menu opens main window, eliminating chunk #35's `tauri.conf.json` `visible: false → true` workaround).

1. **Verify Tauri 2.11 tray-icon feature availability** — check whether `pulse-app/Cargo.toml` needs `tauri = { workspace = true, features = ["tray-icon"] }` for `tauri::tray::TrayIconBuilder` to be in scope (Q5 implementation check). If required, add the feature; do NOT change workspace `tauri = "2.11"` pin.

2. **Create monochrome SVG glyph** — extract aperture/pulsar SVG markup from existing `pulse-app/ui/src/components/icons/Aperture.tsx` (or `CircularPulse.tsx`) and save as `pulse-app/icons/tray-glyph.svg`. Line-based: outer circle (1px stroke) + inner cross/star (4-6 strokes); no fills, no gradients, no shadows; `currentColor` fill for OS-tray-bar adaptation. data.head: ### Chunk route#37: "Modal primitive scaffold — overlay card layout (color-raised-3 bg + subtle border + radius-lg padding), close button, focus trap + aria-busy/aria-live hooks"

body: **Constraints across domains:**

- (security) Modal MUST NOT add a new TauRPC procedure to satisfy persistence or open/close state — extending existing `Settings` struct + reusing `get_settings`/`update_settings` is the lower-cost path that sidesteps the security ↔ tests/CI ↔ arch capability-drift triple binding (per security plan §API Security TauRPC capability authorization + .claude/rules/security.md Session Additions 2026-05-09).

- (security) IF a new TauRPC procedure is introduced, all 4 sync steps required: (a) router registration, (b) `pulse-app/capabilities/` JSON entry, (c) `xtask/src/main.rs::EXPECTED_PROCEDURES` update, (d) `/andromeda-scope-arch` for arch §Occupied Resources (per security plan §API Security + .claude/rules/security.md Session Additions 2026-05-09).
- (security) Webview CSP per `pulse-app/tauri.conf.json` MUST remain unchanged; `script-src` MUST NOT acquire `'unsafe-inline'` (per security plan §API Security CSP row).
- (security) Any new npm dep added must be pinned by exact version (not `^` range), captured in `package-lock.json` (per security plan §Dependency Security spirit).

- (security) AppError sanitization in scope IF modal surfaces IPC errors: only `AppError::Validation { field, reason }` and `AppError::Internal { message }` displayed; never stack traces / file paths / library versions / Rust struct names (per security plan §Error Handling + §Logging anti-pattern).
- (security) Modal MUST NOT log raw form-field values via `telemetry.frontend.*`; metric counters + bounded enum strings only (per security plan §Logging & Monitoring NEVER-log list).

- (design) Modal background MUST be `--color-raised-3` (#343A45) — maximum-elevation surface reserved for modals/dialogs (per design-system.md §Depth Strategy Modal elevation + §Color Palette Surface Scale).

- (design) Modal border MUST be 1px solid; default `rgba(74, 144, 226, 0.3)` (Subtle, Earth Blue 30%); NO box-shadow elevation (per design-system.md §Border Progression Subtle row + §Depth Strategy borders-only).
- (design) Modal radius MUST be `--radius-lg` (8px) per design-system.md §Border Radius.
- (design) Internal padding MUST use spacing scale tokens (`--spacing-md` 16px / `--spacing-lg` 24px); no magic-number pixel values (per design-system.md §Spacing + §Anti-Patterns Token Test).

- (design) Close button MUST follow Secondary button pattern OR icon-only button using existing icon registry (16-20px glyph, 8px padding) per design-system.md §Component Patterns Buttons + §Iconography.
- (design) Focus ring MUST be 3-4px outset, color `#4A90E2`, via `box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(74, 144, 226, 0.2)` or `outline: 3px solid #4A90E2` per design-system.md §Border Progression Focus row.

- (design) Modal entrance animation MUST cap at 200ms ease-out fade (chrome budget for 0.35 webview surface); MUST respect `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` and degrade to instant 0ms per design-system.md §Motion Transitions + Hard Limits. **(See ⚠ Cross-domain rot warning below — layouts treats modal entrance as supporting-moment exempt from this 200ms ceiling.)**

- (layouts) Modal primitive MUST render an inner card with `background: color-raised-3`, 1px subtle border, `radius: radius-lg`, `padding: space-md` (per layout-templates.md §Component Investigation modal Layout + §Component Settings modal Layout sharing the same overlay+card structure).
- (layouts) Inner card max-width and max-height capped to ~80% of viewport, with scrollable overflow on the content region (per layout-templates.md §Component Investigation modal Layout 4th bullet).
- (layouts) Modal MUST be wrapped in a high `z-index` semi-opaque overlay backdrop covering the parent viewport (per layout-templates.md §Component Investigation modal Layout 1st bullet).

- (layouts) Close button MUST live in the top-right corner with `✕` glyph, base color `color-text-secondary`, hover `color-text-primary`, transition `duration-fast` ease-out (per layout-templates.md §Component Investigation modal Layout final bullet).
- (layouts) Modal title slot renders in `font-heading` with `color-text-primary` — title is a slot, not a fixed string (per layout-templates.md §Component Investigation modal Layout Title row).

- (layouts) Modal entrance MUST honour Investigation Capture Collapse supporting-moment motion budget (`0.35` webview expression, scale + opacity ease-out, exempt from the 200ms hard limit) per layout-templates.md §Component Investigation modal Motion + §Decisions Log "Motion trigger placement". **(See ⚠ Cross-domain rot warning below.)**

- (layouts) Modal dismissal via Escape closes the modal back to the desktop-webview surface state (per layout-templates.md §IA notes Keyboard shortcuts Esc row + §Surface desktop-webview Keyboard navigation).

- (tests) Co-located webview tests required: `pulse-app/ui/src/components/<modal-name>/<Modal>.test.tsx` adjacent to source. `npm run test --prefix pulse-app/ui` MUST exit 0; output JUnit XML to `target/junit-ui.xml` per agent-driven discipline (per test-plan §4 framework row + .claude/rules/testing.md File-placement).

- (tests) Agent-driven discipline: deterministic exit signal only — no visual regression, no Percy/Chromatic/Applitools, no canvas pixel inspection (per test-plan §11 Universal anti-patterns + §6 P2/P5 contract-only surrogate).
- (tests) No `sleep(N)` for sync — wait for explicit signals via `waitFor`/`findByRole`/`userEvent` (per test-plan §11 E2E + Synchronization).

- (tests) Reduced-motion behavior MUST be tested via `mockReducedMotion(true)` + module-global state reset in `beforeEach` (per test-plan §11 Universal + .claude/rules/a11y.md Motion + Session Additions 2026-05-04).
- (tests) `focus-trap-react` 12 jsdom workaround required: `focusTrapOptions: { tabbableOptions: { displayCheck: 'none' } }` (per .claude/rules/testing.md Session Additions 2026-05-09 last entry).
- (tests) No new TauRPC procedures, no new capability JSON entries — `xtask capability-drift` baseline must remain clean (0 missing, 0 extra).
- (obs) No new instrumentation surface required for chrome primitive (per obs-plan §1 instrumentability table — UI components are not in the entity list except where they bridge frontend telemetry).

- (obs) Anti-bridge constraint: do NOT add `telemetry.frontend.record_modal_open` or similar TauRPC bridge (per obs-plan §11 NEVER over-instrument hot paths + §3 Frontend bridge — bridge events reserved for perf-budget metrics like `metric.webgpu.frame_duration_ms`).
- (obs) Reduced-motion respect inside the primitive is a chrome-transition concern (per obs-plan §4 + CLAUDE.md Critical Warnings).
- (obs) PII discipline: primitive renders arbitrary children but MUST NOT log child content / aria-label values / accessible-name values (per obs-plan §8 PII Scrubbing default-deny posture).
- (obs) No new module / no new heartbeat tick — modal is React component, not long-running task (per obs-plan §3 Heartbeat ticks).

- (a11y) Modal MUST use `dialog` ARIA role with `aria-modal="true"` and `aria-labelledby` pointing to the modal title heading; prefer native `<dialog>` element OR React Aria Components `Dialog` (per a11y plan §4 ARIA Patterns Dialog row + §12 Decisions Log).

- (a11y) Focus trap entry MUST move focus to modal title (via `aria-labelledby`) OR first interactive element on open; Tab cycles within trap; Tab on last wraps to first (per a11y plan §5 Keyboard Navigation Focus trap + §4 Dialog row).
- (a11y) Escape key MUST close modal AND restore focus to triggering element (per a11y plan §5 Focus restoration + SC 2.1.2 No Keyboard Trap).
- (a11y) `aria-busy="true"` MUST set on modal during async operations; `aria-busy="false"` once ready (per a11y plan §3 Critical paths P2 + §4 ARIA Patterns Button row).

- (a11y) Status messages within modal MUST use `aria-live="polite"` for non-blocking, `aria-live="assertive"` (or `role="alert"`) for blocking/critical (per a11y plan §7 Live regions + §3 Critical paths P2/P6).

- (a11y) Focus ring on close button MUST display `--border-focus` token outline on `:focus-visible` and meet ≥3:1 non-text contrast against background (per a11y plan §6 Focus ring tokens + SC 2.4.7 + SC 1.4.11).
- (a11y) Close button (✕ glyph) MUST have an accessible name via `aria-label="Close"` (icon-only buttons require `aria-label`) per a11y plan §7 Form labels + SC 4.1.2.
- (a11y) Close button MUST meet `--target-button-min` (≥44×44 CSS px platform-native OR ≥24×24 minimum) per a11y plan §6 Target size tokens + SC 2.5.8.

- (a11y) Background overlay color contrast (color-raised-3 bg) against text inside modal MUST meet `--color-text-primary / --color-base` 4.5:1 minimum — verified via colorjs.io harness (per a11y plan §6 Color contrast pairs + SC 1.4.3).
- (a11y) Reduced-motion: any open/close animation MUST degrade to instant under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` (per a11y plan §6 Motion tokens + SC 2.3.3 AAA + CLAUDE.md Critical Warnings).

- (arch) Modal primitive source files MUST live under `pulse-app/ui/src/` (webview source root); component files conventionally land alongside existing `pulse-app/ui/src/components/{WindowControls,Titlebar}.tsx` (per arch §Project Directory Structure).

- (arch) Modal primitive MUST NOT introduce a new TauRPC procedure or Tauri capability — persistence flows through `get_settings`/`update_settings` envelope (per arch §Standard Contracts top-level introspection envelope + §Cross-cutting Patterns Webview IPC capability policy).

- (arch) Modal close-button + focus-trap interactions are pure-webview state (React local state + focus-trap-react); MUST NOT round-trip through IPC bridge (per arch §Cross-cutting Patterns Real-time push contract).
- (arch) The chunk MUST respect `pulse:default` capability scope; no `fs`, `shell`, `dialog`, or `http` core API access from the modal primitive.

- (arch) Modal primitive MUST be feature-flag-agnostic (no `--features mcp-server` / `otap-ingest` gating in webview shell layer); consumer Settings modal handles MCP-toggle visibility via persisted `mcp_server_enabled` Settings field.
**Patterns to follow:**

- (security) **Webview IPC capability policy**: main webview window runs under `pulse:default`; modal primitive lives inside that window and inherits that capability. Same shape as chunks #33 (TanStack Router shell) + #36 (tray menu) which added zero new procedures.

- (security) **Settings-extension over new namespace** (validated at chunks #30 + #36): if modal needs to persist new flag/enum/numeric setting, extend `crates/ui-bridge/src/contract.rs::Settings` rather than introduce new TauRPC namespace.

- (security) **AppError boundary sanitization**: render `AppError::Validation { field, reason }` (field-scoped form errors) or `AppError::Internal { message }` (generic toast). Never serialize `anyhow::Error` directly.

- (security) **CSP-stable styling discipline**: design-token classes (Tailwind v4 `@theme` NASA palette) are statically resolved at build time; modal overlay should compose from existing token classes, not inject runtime-computed style strings.

- (design) Surface-elevation pattern: modals lift content from card (Raised-1 #262A33) up to dialog (Raised-3 #343A45) via background lightness only — NO shadows, NO gradients (per §Depth Strategy + §Anti-Patterns).

- (design) Component composition pattern: modals reuse existing Card pattern semantics (1px border + radius + token padding) but at larger Raised-3 surface (per §Component Patterns Cards/Panels baseline composed up).
- (design) Title typography pattern: modal headers use existing Heading role (IBM Plex Sans 600 / 20px); Body role (IBM Plex Sans 400 / 14px) for descriptive paragraphs (per §Typography table).
- (design) Close button glyph pattern: inline "X" close glyph fits existing Iconography vocabulary (Lucide/Heroicons fallback acceptable per §Iconography "Secondary library") at 16-20px.
- (design) Native dialog ban pattern: modal primitive in webview React (not OS-native dialogs) per §Anti-Patterns desktop-webview "NEVER use alert/confirm/prompt".

- (layouts) Two existing modal layouts (Investigation, Settings) share exact same outer structure; primitive consolidates these into a single component shape (per layout-templates.md §Component Investigation modal Layout + §Component Settings modal Layout).
- (layouts) Form-section stacking with `gap: space-lg` is established pattern for modal content regions when content is form-shaped (per layout-templates.md §Component Settings modal Layout).
- (layouts) Title + scrollable content + close button is established three-region split inside inner card (per layout-templates.md §Component Investigation modal Layout).

- (layouts) Live region (aria-live) and busy-state signaling (aria-busy) at modal level support Investigation Capture Collapse supporting moment + future status-bearing modals — primitive surfaces these as opt-in hooks rather than always-on (per route.md §2 chunk #37 + layout-templates.md §Surface desktop-webview Expression level).

- (tests) Vitest co-located test file pattern: `<ComponentName>.test.tsx` adjacent to `<ComponentName>.tsx` matches existing `CommandPalette.test.tsx` / `SettingsRoute.test.tsx` / `Titlebar.test.tsx` patterns (per test-plan §4 + .claude/rules/testing.md File-placement).

- (tests) DOM-shape contract assertions: `role="dialog"` + `aria-modal="true"` + `aria-label`/`aria-labelledby` presence; `aria-busy` toggle via prop; `aria-live` region presence + level; close button is `<button aria-label="Close">` reachable via Tab.

- (tests) Focus-trap lifecycle assertions: on open → focus to first focusable child (or `initialFocus` ref); Tab cycles within trap; Esc deactivates and returns focus to triggering element. Use `tabbable(dialogElement)` to enumerate trap contents.

- (tests) Vi.mock hoisting + `vi.hoisted` pattern: wrap mock factory's external references in `vi.hoisted(() => ({ ... }))`; do NOT use bare `const showFn = vi.fn()` outside hoist (per .claude/rules/testing.md Session Additions 2026-05-09 vi.hoisted entry).
- (tests) `vi.unstubAllGlobals()` discipline: if test stubs `navigator`/`localStorage`/`matchMedia`, MUST call `vi.unstubAllGlobals()` in `afterEach` block (per Session Additions 2026-05-08).
- (tests) AAA pattern: one assertion concept per test; `describe` block per scenario family.

- (obs) Frontend instrumentation bridge convention preserved BUT NOT exercised in chunk #37 — pattern is `telemetry.frontend.record_*` TauRPC command → backend `tracing::info!(target: "metric.{module}.{measure}", ...)` (per obs-plan §3 Frontend bridge).

- (a11y) **Compose aria-live region as a child of the modal** (not the trigger) so screen readers announce status changes within modal's aria-context.

- (a11y) **Apply Tailwind v4 `motion-reduce:duration-0 motion-reduce:transition-none` variants** to any open/close transition CSS; use `useReducedMotion` hook from `motion/react` for any JS-driven open/close animation.
- (a11y) **Initial focus anchor**: focus modal title (element pointed to by `aria-labelledby`) OR first form control OR close button — choose per consumer's spec.

- (arch) Webview component placement under `pulse-app/ui/src/components/` matches existing `WindowControls.tsx` + `Titlebar.tsx` + `icons/*.tsx` layout. Test file co-location with `.test.tsx` suffix matches `WindowControls.test.tsx` / `Titlebar.test.tsx` patterns.

- (arch) Errors crossing back from any IPC consumer (when chunk #38 wires `update_settings`) MUST surface as `AppError` enum variants, NOT raw error strings (per arch §Standard Contracts).
**Anti-patterns to avoid:**
- (security) NEVER add a new TauRPC procedure (e.g., `modal.show`, `dialog.open`) to expose the modal primitive — modal open/close is webview-side React state, NOT cross-bridge IPC.
- (security) NEVER add `'unsafe-inline'` to `script-src` in `pulse-app/tauri.conf.json` to satisfy a third-party modal/portal library.
- (security) NEVER widen `pulse:default` to include `core:dialog` / `core:fs` / `core:shell` to support the modal.
- (design) NEVER add box-shadow / drop-shadow / glow for modal elevation — depth strategy is borders-only; Halo State Pulse is the ONLY exempted decorative blur surface.
- (design) NEVER use spring physics, bounce easing, scale-and-overshoot entrance, or staggered reveal of modal contents (per §Motion Hard Limits).
- (design) NEVER inline hex values, magic-number paddings, or one-off radii inside the modal component — every visual value must trace back to `@theme` token block.
- (layouts) Do NOT bake the Investigation modal's "Investigate {trace-id}" title or the Settings modal's specific form sections into the primitive — those are consumer-supplied content.
- (layouts) Do NOT introduce a custom file browser-style internal navigation inside the modal primitive — when modal content needs file selection, layout-templates.md mandates OS-native file picker.

- (layouts) Do NOT animate the modal entrance with a chrome-budget motion that competes with Halo State Pulse rendering loop — modal entrance is a supporting-moment motion bounded by `0.35` webview expression budget.
- (tests) NEVER use `sleep(N)` or arbitrary timers for synchronization — wait for explicit DOM state.
- (tests) NEVER assert against hashed CSS class names or implementation-detail selectors — use ARIA role + accessible-name selectors.
- (tests) NEVER use `toHaveBeenCalledTimes(N)` for useEffect-driven mocks in React 19 (relax to `toHaveBeenCalled()` ≥1 call per Session Additions 2026-05-08).
- (obs) NEVER over-instrument the modal primitive — modal open/close transitions can fire 60Hz during animation if naively wired. Chrome primitive lifecycle is NOT a perf-budget surface.
- (obs) NEVER log modal child content to the JSON file sink — primitive is a black box to obs.
- (obs) NEVER add unstructured `console.log` in the modal lifecycle — agent-readable surface is the JSON file, not browser console.

- (obs) NEVER instrument focus-trap activation/deactivation as a `tracing` event — fires on every modal open/close; bridging adds JSON volume without signal value. axe-core / Lighthouse / pa11y is right consumption path.
- (obs) NEVER add a new heartbeat tick for modal "is-open" gauge — heartbeat ticks are for long-running async subsystems.
- (obs) NEVER conflate modal-rendered Investigate snapshot preview text with self-observation logs — snapshot markdown lives in `~/.andromeda-pulse/snapshots/`, NOT a self-observation log line.
- (a11y) NEVER omit Escape close handler — keyboard trap is SC 2.1.2 violation.
- (a11y) NEVER use `tabindex > 0` on any modal element — creates non-natural focus order.
- (a11y) NEVER apply `:focus { outline: none }` without an alternative focus indicator (`--border-focus` token).
- (a11y) NEVER add ARIA roles to elements that already inherit them (e.g., `role="dialog"` on `<dialog>`) — eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y catches this.
- (a11y) NEVER hide essential content from assistive tech via `aria-hidden="true"` on focusable elements (axe-core `aria-hidden-focus` rule catches this).
- (a11y) NEVER set `aria-live` on a region that doesn't update OR omit it from a region that does.
- (arch) Do NOT add a new TauRPC router namespace (`modal.*` / `dialog.*`) for modal lifecycle — pre-#34 D3 capability-drift carry-over demonstrated the cost of the triple-binding.
- (arch) Do NOT widen `pulse:default` capability JSON to add `dialog:default` (or any tauri-plugin-dialog permission) — primitive is HTML-overlay-based, not OS-native.

- (arch) Do NOT touch any of the 5 existing capability JSON files (`default.json`, `tray.json`, `notification.json`, `plugin-fs.json`, `updater.json`) — capability JSON surface is invariant for this chunk.
**Contract bindings:**

The primitive will be the substrate for chunk #38 (Settings modal form, P3/P7 a11y critical paths) AND epoch 6 chunk #41 (Investigate trigger + Capture Collapse, P2/P6 critical paths) — both consumers compose this primitive without re-implementing focus-trap / role="dialog" / overlay-backdrop / close-button / reduced-motion semantics.

- **FocusTrap + role="dialog" + inline-token-style overlay** (`pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/CommandPalette.tsx:117-264`): the canonical project pattern for any modal-class overlay. Two-layer DOM (outer overlay backdrop with `position: fixed; inset: 0; zIndex` + inner card with token-styled background/border/radius/padding) wrapped in `<FocusTrap>` with the standard `focusTrapOptions` (escapeDeactivates / clickOutsideDeactivates / returnFocusOnDeactivate / onDeactivate / tabbableOptions.displayCheck="none"). Modal primitive lifts this 1:1.

- **Inline `style={{...}}` instead of Tailwind classes** for token-bound surface chrome (`CommandPalette.tsx:132-263`, `SettingsRoute.tsx:13-67`, `StatusLiveRegion.tsx:51-67`). Pattern: token classes (e.g., `var(--color-raised-3)`) consumed via `style` prop's CSS variable interpolation; Tailwind `motion-reduce:` variants applied via `className` for the reduced-motion override (since matchMedia-driven state isn't a CSS-variable concern). Tradeoff acknowledged: inline styles bypass `tailwindcss/no-custom-classname` lint warnings AND give full IDE autocomplete via React's CSSProperties type. NEVER hardcode hex literals — always `var(--token)`.

- **`triggerRef` + `onDeactivate` focus restoration contract** (`CommandPalette.tsx:24, 109-112`): consumers pass a `React.RefObject<HTMLElement | null>` for the element that triggered the modal; primitive's `FocusTrap` `onDeactivate` calls `triggerRef.current?.focus()` to restore focus on Esc/click-outside/programmatic close. Avoids consumer needing to manually re-focus.

- **`vi.unstubAllGlobals()` per-file `afterEach` discipline** (`CommandPalette.test.tsx:34-36`, also covered in testing.md Session Additions 2026-05-08): tests stubbing `navigator`/`matchMedia`/etc. MUST clean up; global `test-setup.ts` only invokes `cleanup()`. Apply to Modal tests if they stub `matchMedia` for reduced-motion testing.

- **`vi.hoisted` for vi.mock factory references** (testing.md Session Additions 2026-05-09): if Modal mocks any module that needs external references in the factory closure (e.g., `vi.mock("@tauri-apps/api/window", ...)` to test backdrop-click → window-close interactions), wrap external refs in `vi.hoisted(() => ({ ... }))`.

- **`<section aria-label="...">` implicit `role="region"`** (a11y.md Session Additions 2026-05-09 first entry; visible in `SettingsRoute.tsx:9-19`): NEVER add explicit `role="region"` on `<section aria-label>` — `eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y` 6.10's `no-redundant-roles` rule flags it. Modal primitive should put `role="dialog"` on a `<div>` (since `<dialog>` HTML element + `showModal()` would create CSS / native styling collisions — the project chose div+role per CommandPalette precedent).

- **Inline numeric WebGPU constants** (testing.md Session Additions 2026-05-09 jsdom WebGPU constants entry): irrelevant for chunk #37 (no WebGPU usage in modal primitive); referenced for completeness as pattern context.

- **`focus-trap-react` `displayCheck: 'none'` jsdom workaround** (testing.md Session Additions 2026-05-09 last entry; CommandPalette.tsx:126): standard test-time-only option needed to bypass jsdom's zero `getBoundingClientRect`. Modal primitive's tests MUST include this.

- **Reduced-motion test pattern** (`pulse-app/ui/src/hooks/mock-reduced-motion.ts` + testing.md Session Additions 2026-05-04): `mockReducedMotion(true)` flips `window.matchMedia` deterministically; `motion-dom` module-global state reset in `beforeEach` to prevent cross-test bleed.

- **No new TauRPC procedures = capability-drift baseline preserved** (xtask/src/main.rs:376-394; combined.md security/arch/tests acceptance criteria): chunk #37 webview-only scope = `EXPECTED_PROCEDURES` UNCHANGED + 5 capability JSON files byte-identical pre/post chunk.

- **Component file naming + placement**: PascalCase `<ComponentName>.tsx` adjacent test `<ComponentName>.test.tsx` under `pulse-app/ui/src/components/` (matches WindowControls.tsx + Titlebar.tsx + icons/) OR under a dashboard sub-tree like `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/CommandPalette.tsx` if dashboard-scoped. Modal primitive should live at `pulse-app/ui/src/components/Modal.tsx` since it's a generic primitive consumed by multiple surfaces (Settings modal at chunk #38, Investigation modal at epoch 6 chunk #41), not dashboard-scoped.

- **Inline style discipline**: every visual value via `style={{...}}` referencing `var(--token)` — no hardcoded hex / px / ms literals; Tailwind `motion-reduce:` variants via `className` (per design-tokens.md + frontend.md).

- **Test fixture style**: `Harness` component pattern (per CommandPalette.test.tsx) wraps the primitive with a `triggerRef` button, exposes `open`/`onClose`/etc. as props for per-test driving. Tests exercise via `render(<Harness open={true} onClose={...}/>)` + `screen.getByRole("dialog")` + synthetic `KeyboardEvent` dispatch.

- **No-console discipline**: Modal primitive MUST NOT include `console.log`/`console.warn`/`console.error` debug output (per obs-plan + observability.md). All useful state observability is via React DevTools + accessibility tree inspection.

- **Tab-order assertion**: use `tabbable(container)` from the `tabbable` package to enumerate focusable elements; assert against expected count + element identity (per CompactWidget.test.tsx pattern + a11y plan §3 Focus management).

- `pulse-app/ui/src/components/Modal.tsx` — Modal primitive component. Props: `{ open: boolean; onClose: () => void; triggerRef: React.RefObject<HTMLElement | null>; titleId: string; title: string; children: React.ReactNode; busy?: boolean; liveRegionLevel?: 'polite' | 'assertive'; liveMessage?: string; clickOutsideDeactivates?: boolean }` (initial draft; refined at Phase 4). Renders overlay backdrop + inner card with token-styled chrome + close button (aria-label="Close") + optional aria-busy on dialog + optional aria-live region as child. Uses `<FocusTrap>` with the standard `focusTrapOptions` shape, `initialFocus` defaulting to the close button or first focusable.

- `pulse-app/ui/src/components/Modal.test.tsx` — co-located Vitest test file. Coverage: open/close lifecycle (renders nothing when `open=false`; renders dialog with aria-modal + aria-labelledby when `open=true`); close button triggers `onClose`; Esc key triggers `onClose` AND restores focus to `triggerRef.current`; Tab cycles within trap (assert via `tabbable(dialog)` ⊂ rendered focusable set); aria-busy prop reflects on dialog when `busy=true`; aria-live region renders + reflects `liveMessage` when `liveMessage` set; reduced-motion pathway (`mockReducedMotion(true)` → entrance transition collapses to 0ms or `motion-reduce:` Tailwind variant resolves); semantic structure (`role="dialog"` + `aria-modal="true"` + `aria-labelledby` referencing the heading + close button has accessible name).

(None expected for chunk #37's webview-only scope. Chunk #38 will be the first consumer; chunk #37 ships the standalone primitive + tests only. SettingsRoute remains the empty-state placeholder; chunk #38 swaps it OR composes the Modal as a route-level overlay.)

- **Motion budget reconciliation** (Pattern 3 rot warning in combined.md): orchestrator's recommendation in Phase 4 plan: default to chrome-budget 200ms ease-out fade for the BASE primitive (matching design-system.md §Motion Hard Limits + design-tokens.md "duration-standard 200ms" + the chrome-default of CommandPalette which uses `motion-reduce:transition-none motion-reduce:duration-0` on a CSS transition). Investigation modal (chunk #41) and Settings modal (chunk #38) can each opt into the supporting-moment longer duration via prop if needed. Rationale: per design-tokens.md "Investigation Capture Collapse 250–350ms (supporting moment, EXEMPT from 200ms hard limit)" — exemption is per-instance, not the primitive default. Consumers exercise the exemption explicitly when the consumer's UX is a supporting moment (Investigation Capture Collapse), not by default. This resolves the conflict in favor of design's chrome-default while preserving layouts' supporting-moment exemption as an opt-in.

- **Close-button glyph source**: design extract says "inline 'X' close glyph fits the existing Iconography vocabulary (Lucide/Heroicons fallback acceptable per §Iconography Secondary library)". Existing icon registry at `pulse-app/ui/src/components/icons/` has 5 custom SVGs (aperture / telescope / constellation-grid / star / circular-pulse) + a generic `Icon` dispatcher (`pulse-app/ui/src/components/icons/Icon.tsx`). NO existing "close" / "X" / "dismiss" glyph. Two paths: (a) add a 6th SVG `Close.tsx` to the icon registry (extends the Observatory vocabulary with a generic close glyph — minor scope creep but cleanest); (b) inline the "X" Unicode glyph directly in the close button text content (matches CommandPalette which inlines text content; layout-templates.md says "✕ glyph"). Path (b) is the lower-cost match to layouts §Component Investigation modal "Close button: top-right corner, ✕ glyph". Choosing (b) for chunk #37; future chunk can promote to icon registry if usage grows.

- **`role="dialog"` vs native `<dialog>` element**: a11y extract notes both options. Project pattern (CommandPalette) uses `<div role="dialog" aria-modal="true">` — chosen over native `<dialog>` because (a) native `<dialog>` `showModal()` adds a top-layer + ::backdrop pseudo-element with browser-default styling that fights the project's borders-only depth strategy; (b) the project's `inline-style + design-token` discipline composes more cleanly on a `<div>`; (c) consistency with CommandPalette precedent. Choose `<div role="dialog">` for chunk #37.

- **`aria-live` slot wiring** — should the modal's `aria-live` region be rendered always (with `aria-live="polite"` default + empty `liveMessage`) or only when `liveMessage` is non-empty? Always-rendering is the safer pattern for screen-reader consistency (otherwise SR misses initial mount); this matches StatusLiveRegion's always-mount pattern. Phase 4 plan goes with always-render + opt-in level via prop.

- **`react-aria-components` `Modal`/`Dialog` adoption**: a11y extract recommends "Prefer react-aria-components ... `Modal` + `Dialog` + `Heading`" OR native `<dialog>`. Project pattern (CommandPalette) does NOT use react-aria-components — uses focus-trap-react directly. Switching the modal primitive to react-aria-components would create a precedent split across the project (CommandPalette uses focus-trap-react; Modal would use react-aria-components). Per frontend.md "react-aria-components 1.17.x (preferred) OR @headlessui/react 2.2.x — pick ONE; mixing causes style/behavior conflicts" — but focus-trap-react is NOT a react-aria-components alternative, it's a single-purpose library. focus-trap-react and react-aria-components can coexist. Choosing focus-trap-react for chunk #37 per CommandPalette precedent (lower risk + zero additional integration work + matches the test pattern that already exists for the focus-trap library).
1. ✓ Read CommandPalette.tsx (precedent for combined.md "Files to follow" pattern).
2. ✓ All "Patterns detected" cite `file:line` locations.
3. ✓ "New files to create" paths consistent with arch §Project Directory Structure (`pulse-app/ui/src/components/`).
4. ✓ "Files to modify" is empty (chunk webview-only / standalone primitive).

**Constraints across domains:**

- (security) Theme picker and widget-position MUST use `serde`-friendly enum types, not raw strings (per security plan §Input Validation).
- (security) `update_settings` returns `Result<T, AppError>` — validation failures MUST surface as `AppError::Validation { field, reason }` (per security plan §Error Sanitization at IPC Boundaries).

- (security) MCP-toggle in form controls runtime gate only; compile-time `--features mcp-server` gate independent and MUST NOT be bypassed by form persistence; graceful-degrade `warn` path preserved (per security plan §MCP Feature Double-Gate).

- (security) Zero new `pulse-app/capabilities/` JSON entries needed — Settings extension flows through existing `get_settings`/`update_settings` (per `.claude/rules/security.md` Session Additions 2026-05-09 second entry).

- (arch) Settings struct extension MUST live in `crates/ui-bridge`; webview consumes only TauRPC-generated `.ts` bindings (per arch §Established Decisions [TauRPC IPC Bridge — Surface 2] + §Inherited Defaults).

- (arch) All Settings fields MUST be `serde::Serialize` + `serde::Deserialize`; enum variants MUST use `snake_case` tags; new types use `UpperCamelCase` type names (per arch §Conventions variable/function naming).

- (arch) `mcp_enabled` in Settings and `ANDROMEDA_PULSE_MCP_ENABLED` env var MUST respect precedence: env > config.toml > defaults (per arch §Cross-cutting Patterns Config management + §Occupied Resources environment variables).
- (arch) `retention_seconds` MUST use integer + `TryFrom` range validation (300–600 default range per arch §Occupied Resources, §Conventions "Configuration units").

- (arch) Plugin-manager UI MUST invoke existing `plugins.list` + `plugins.reload` IPC procedures only — no new TauRPC namespace (per arch §Occupied Resources Tauri IPC routes + §Cross-cutting Patterns Webview IPC capability policy).

- (arch) `pulse-app/src/main.rs` Tray "Open Settings" wiring is in `pulse-app` binary crate only — library crates do NOT depend on the binary crate (per arch §Infrastructure Patterns + §Inherited Defaults).

- (tests) Standard tier full gate set unconditional: `cargo fmt --check` + `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` + `cargo nextest run --workspace --profile ci` + `cargo xtask capability-drift` + `npm run lint --prefix pulse-app/ui` + `npm run typecheck --prefix pulse-app/ui` + `npm run test --prefix pulse-app/ui` (per test-plan §12 Decisions Log `2026-05-10-mandate-standard-chunk-gates`).

- (tests) Boot-smoke gate required: `npx @tauri-apps/cli dev` 60s timeout watching for `Compiled successfully`/`ready in`/`Local:` — chunk #38 touches `pulse-app/src/main.rs` (per test-plan §12 Decisions Log `2026-05-09-boot-smoke-coverage`).

- (tests) Vitest unit tests for SettingsModal use `@testing-library/react` 16 + `userEvent`, `vi.mock("@tauri-apps/api/*")` for TauRPC bindings, `focus-trap-react` `tabbableOptions: { displayCheck: 'none' }` for jsdom (per test-plan §4 + testing.md Session Additions 2026-05-09).

- (tests) Rust unit tests in `crates/ui-bridge/src/contract.rs` co-located `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` for each new field — round-trip serialize/deserialize + `TryFrom<u16>` validation for numeric ranges (per test-plan §4 unit test coverage of ui-bridge).

- (tests) Settings persistence integration test: `get_settings`/`update_settings` TauRPC roundtrip via `tauri::test::mock_builder()` + `get_ipc_response()` (per test-plan §5 Integration Test boundary `viz → ui-bridge` pattern).
- (tests) Pre-existing `MetricsChart.test.tsx:27,49` tsc errors deferred carry-over from chunk #35; not touched by chunk #38 but `npm run typecheck` must still run per standard-gate baseline.

- (obs) `update_settings` MUST follow `#[tracing::instrument(skip_all, fields(traceparent = %tp))]` pattern already in place for other TauRPC router methods (per obs-plan §4 "IPC-internal (TauRPC)" surface row).

- (obs) Log emission for `update_settings` MUST use `ui-bridge` allowlist: `method_name`, `argument_digest` (hash, not content), `result_type`, `latency_ms` — Settings field values MUST NOT appear verbatim in log fields (per obs-plan §8 `ui-bridge` allowlist + security plan Vector 5).
- (obs) Plugin-manager listing — `plugins.list` handler MUST emit `plugin_path_basename` only (per obs-plan §8 `plugin` allowlist + security plan Vector 3).

- (obs) Frontend settings-change instrumentation MUST bridge through TauRPC `telemetry.frontend.*` → backend `tracing::info!` — NO direct browser console logging (per obs-plan §1 desktop-webview surface row).
- (obs) Chunk introduces NO new `metric.*` tracing targets (per obs-plan §5 cardinality discipline + §11 "NEVER over-instrument").

- (a11y) Settings modal MUST use `role="dialog"` + `aria-modal="true"` + `aria-labelledby`; Tab cycles within focus trap; Esc closes + restores focus to triggering button (per a11y-plan §5 Focus trap; WCAG SC 2.1.2, SC 2.4.3).
- (a11y) Every form control MUST have programmatically associated label — `<label htmlFor="…">` preferred; `aria-describedby` links errors (per a11y-plan §7 Form labels; WCAG SC 3.3.2, SC 4.1.2).

- (a11y) Theme/widget-position pickers = `radiogroup`+`radio`; MCP toggle = `role="switch"` + `aria-checked`; snapshot-preset+budget = `combobox`/`select` or `radiogroup`; retention = `<input type="number">` with `min`/`max` + `aria-label` (per a11y-plan §4 Per-component pattern catalog; WCAG SC 4.1.2).

- (a11y) Validation errors set `aria-invalid="true"` + `aria-describedby` error span; save-success = `role="status" aria-live="polite"`; validation error = `role="alert"`/`aria-live="assertive"` (per a11y-plan §7 Live regions; WCAG SC 3.3.1, SC 4.1.3).

- (a11y) Focus order: theme → widget-position → retention → MCP switch → snapshot-preset → budget → format → plugin-manager → Save → Cancel; Tab on Cancel wraps to theme (per a11y-plan §5 settings-modal focus order; WCAG SC 2.4.3).
- (a11y) All interactive elements render `--border-focus` token on `:focus-visible` ≥3:1 non-text contrast vs modal background (per a11y-plan §6 Focus ring tokens; WCAG SC 2.4.7, SC 1.4.11).

- (a11y) Modal entry/exit transition MUST degrade to `transition-duration: 0s` under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` via Tailwind `motion-reduce:` variants (per a11y-plan §6 Motion tokens; WCAG AAA SC 2.3.3).
- (design) Modal surface uses `--color-raised-3` (#343A45) background + 1px border `rgba(74,144,226,0.3)` + no shadow (per design-system §Depth Strategy + §Color Palette Surface Scale Raised-3).

- (design) Input fields use `--color-inset` (#0F1117) background + 1px subtle border at rest, `#4A90E2` + 3px focus glow on focus, `rgba(199,85,106,0.5)` border on error (per §Surface: desktop-webview Component Patterns Input Fields).

- (design) Form labels = IBM Plex Sans 500/12px (`--font-body` Label role); body/desc = IBM Plex Sans 400/14px; numeric values (retention, budget count) = JetBrains Mono 400/12px tabular-nums (per §Typography Label + Data rows).
- (design) Spacing tokens only: `--spacing-sm` (8px) input padding, `--spacing-md` (16px) section padding, `--spacing-lg` (24px) section separation (per §Spacing table).
- (design) Toggles use `--radius-full`; number inputs/selects use `--radius-sm` (4px); modal container uses `--radius-lg` (8px) inherited from chunk #37 (per §Border Radius).
- (design) Form transitions ≤ `--duration-fast` 150ms ease-out; no scroll/stagger/spring physics (per §Motion Hard Limits + Duration scale; webview expression level 0.35).

- (design) Save button = `--color-primary` bg + `--color-base` text + `--radius-sm` + `--spacing-sm` padding; Cancel = `--color-raised-1` bg + `--color-text-primary` text + 1px subtle border (per §Surface: desktop-webview Component Patterns Buttons).

- (layouts) Settings modal uses same overlay-card structure as Investigation modal: `color-raised-3` bg + 1px subtle border + `radius-lg` + `padding: space-md`, max-width/height ~80% viewport, scrollable overflow (per layout-templates.md §Component — Investigation modal).
- (layouts) Form sections stacked vertically with `gap: space-lg`; no horizontal multi-column layout (per layout-templates.md §Component — Settings modal (form)).

- (layouts) Modal triggered from titlebar aperture icon (compact widget + full dashboard) AND tray "Open Settings" menu — renders over whichever surface is active (per layout-templates.md §Component — Custom titlebar, §Component — Tray menu).

- (layouts) Save (primary) + Cancel (secondary) buttons present as terminal interactive elements; styling per design tokens (per layout-templates.md §Component — Settings modal (form) Submit buttons).
- (layouts) MCP server toggle conditionally rendered — visible only when `mcp-server` Cargo feature is built (per layout-templates.md §Component — Settings modal (form) Form controls).
- (layouts) Panel open/close transition uses `duration-standard` within 0.35 webview expression budget (per layout-templates.md §Decisions Log Motion trigger placement).
- (layouts) Widget snap position control = 3×3 radio-button grid (corners + edges + center) with visual preview (per layout-templates.md §Component — Settings modal (form) Form controls).
**Patterns to follow:**
- (security) Serde-enum validation pattern from existing `crates/ui-bridge/src/contract.rs` Settings struct (per security plan §Input Validation).
- (security) AppError Validation variant via `From` impl pattern in `ui-bridge` (per security plan §Error Sanitization).

- (security) Capability-drift coupling discipline: `cargo xtask capability-drift` exits 0 after touching `pulse-app/src/main.rs` or `crates/ui-bridge/src/` (per `.claude/rules/security.md` Session Additions 2026-05-10).

- (arch) Settings extension via existing `get_settings`/`update_settings` (chunk #30 `always_on_top` precedent — avoids capability-drift triple binding) (per arch §Cross-cutting Patterns Webview IPC capability policy).
- (arch) `pub`/`pub(crate)` visibility discipline + cross-bridge data shape (everything that crosses TauRPC = `serde::Serialize`) (per arch §Conventions module visibility + §Cross-cutting Patterns).

- (tests) Existing Modal test pattern at `pulse-app/ui/src/components/Modal.test.tsx` — `Harness` wrapper component with `triggerRef`/`open`/`onClose` props, `describe` blocks for lifecycle/Esc/focus-trap/aria-busy/aria-live/reduced-motion, `tabbable(dialog, { displayCheck: 'none' })` for focus order (per test-plan §4 Webview unit test conventions).
- (tests) Existing `SettingsRoute.test.tsx` stub — extend with form-rendering + keyboard-nav `describe` blocks rather than replace (per test-plan §4).
- (tests) Existing `crates/ui-bridge/src/contract.rs` flat `#[test] fn test_<entity>_<scenario>()` naming convention for new Settings field tests (per test-plan §4 Test function naming).
- (tests) `tracing::subscriber::set_default(subscriber)` (NOT `with_default`) in `#[tokio::test]` async tests (per testing.md Session Additions 2026-05-09).
- (tests) `vi.hoisted(() => ({ fn: vi.fn() }))` for variables referenced inside `vi.mock` factory closures (per testing.md Session Additions 2026-05-09).

- (obs) Existing `update_settings` `tracing::warn!` at `AppError` conversion boundary (every `From<E> for AppError` impl already emits) — extend pattern for new field validation failures (per obs-plan §6 `warn` use case).

- (obs) Existing `health.rs` `tracing::info!` pattern on TauRPC procedure summaries — `info!` on command entry/exit with `method_name` + `latency_ms` (per obs-plan §6 "TauRPC invocation" boundary-call wrapper row).
- (obs) `tracing::enabled!(Level::INFO)` guard before heavy field construction — same as `crates/ui-bridge/src/telemetry.rs` chunk #29 frame bridge (per obs-plan §11).
- (obs) `argument_digest` hashing convention from `ui-bridge` allowlist for write-occurred-without-exposing-values logging (per obs-plan §8).

- (a11y) Focus trap reuse from chunk #37 — `focus-trap-react@12.x` with `escapeDeactivates: true` + `returnFocusOnDeactivate: true`; chunk #38 supplies `autoFocus` initial target (per a11y-plan §5 Focus trap).

- (a11y) `<div role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true">` status container at top of form for save success without focus theft (per a11y-plan §7 Live regions SC 4.1.3).
- (a11y) `tabbable(container)` ground-truth assertion in Playwright focus-order tests (per a11y-plan §3 Focus management test harness).
- (a11y) `eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y` compile-time gate already in place — catches missing labels + ARIA on non-semantic + missing required attrs (per a11y-plan §3 A11y testing tool pick).

- (design) Modal-content composition: chunk #37 primitive provides `--color-raised-3` card surface + close button + focus-trap; chunk #38 fills with form controls (per §Anti-Patterns Universal Bans differentiated content type).
- (design) Input Field/Form Controls pattern: inset bg + subtle border + focus emphasis + error border + placeholder muted italic (per §Surface: desktop-webview Component Patterns).

- (design) Focus ring 3-4px outset `#4A90E2` `:focus-visible` always-shown; all form controls Tab-navigable (per §Surface: desktop-webview Focus / Keyboard Navigation + §Downstream Readiness a11y handoff).

- (design) Semantic color + label pairing: MCP On/Off pairs Earth Blue with text label; error indicators pair `--color-accent` with text copy (per §Color Palette anti-pattern + §Design Decisions Log 2026-05-03).
- (design) Aperture icon as canonical "settings" trigger glyph (per §Iconography Primary custom set).

**Anti-patterns to avoid:**
- (security) NEVER add `theme: String` or `widget_position: String` to Settings — MUST be typed enums (per security plan §Input Validation).
- (security) NEVER validate `retention_seconds` bounds via `format!`-interpolated check or string comparison; integer comparison after typed deserialization (per security plan §Input Validation).
- (security) NEVER return `anyhow::Error` or `thiserror`-derived module errors directly from `update_settings` — convert at bridge via `From` impls (per security plan §Error Sanitization).
- (security) NEVER wire MCP-toggle to bypass compile-time feature gate — Settings toggle is runtime gate only (per security plan §MCP Feature Double-Gate).
- (security) NEVER log raw settings field values at debug/trace level — log field names + types only (per security plan §Logging & Redaction).

- (arch) Do NOT add new TauRPC procedure or router namespace for Settings form — `get_settings`/`update_settings` cover get/set; new namespace = capability-drift triple binding (per arch §Cross-cutting Patterns + §Occupied Resources).
- (arch) Do NOT let Settings UI toggle for `mcp_enabled` bypass arch double-gate; env var stays authoritative over config.toml (per arch §Established Decisions [MCP feature double-gate]).
- (arch) Do NOT add raw `format!`-string SQL or filesystem access outside `strict-path` canonicalization for any config.toml writes (per arch §Occupied Resources Filesystem locations).
- (tests) NEVER use `sleep(N)` for Settings persistence sync — use explicit TauRPC `get_settings` round-trip as sync signal (per test-plan §11 + testing.md §Synchronization).
- (tests) NEVER mock `tauri::test::mock_builder()`'s DuckDB or Settings backend at integration level — use real in-process Settings + in-memory DuckDB (per test-plan §8 + §11).
- (tests) NEVER share mutable Settings state across parallel tests — fresh env vars + `tempfile::TempDir` for `ANDROMEDA_PULSE_DATA_DIR` isolation (per test-plan §11).
- (obs) NEVER log Settings field values verbatim — apply argument_digest or field-name-only logging (per obs-plan §11 Logs + §8 `ui-bridge` allowlist).
- (obs) NEVER emit full plugin paths in plugin-manager events — basename-only (per obs-plan §11 Spans Vector 3).
- (obs) NEVER add a new `metric.*` tracing target for settings-change frequency (per obs-plan §5 + §11).
- (a11y) `outline: none` without replacement focus indicator violates SC 2.4.7 (a11y-plan §11 Anti-patterns).
- (a11y) Conveying form field state by color alone — error/success colors MUST be supplemented with icon or text label (per a11y-plan §6 + WCAG SC 1.4.1).
- (a11y) Adding `role="dialog"` on a `<div>` without `aria-modal` + trapped focus — always compose inside chunk #37 Modal primitive (per a11y-plan §4 Dialog pattern).
- (design) NEVER hardcode hex values or magic pixel values — every value traces to `@theme` block (per §Self-Validation Protocol Token Test + §Anti-Patterns Universal Bans).
- (design) NEVER apply gradient overlays, glassmorphic effects, or shadow-based elevation; modal elevation is bg + border only (per §Depth Strategy + §Anti-Patterns Universal Bans).
- (design) NEVER use color as sole state indicator for toggle/select — pair color change with label or icon (per §Design Decisions Log 2026-05-03 + §Anti-Patterns Universal Bans).
- (layouts) Do NOT render Settings as full route/page navigation — designated as modal triggered from titlebar + tray (per layout-templates.md §IA notes Deep-link convention).
- (layouts) Do NOT introduce horizontal multi-column side-by-side form layouts — vertical stacking with `gap: space-lg` (per layout-templates.md §Component — Settings modal (form)).
- (layouts) Do NOT apply custom animation timings other than `duration-standard` for modal panel open/close (per layout-templates.md §Decisions Log Motion trigger placement).
**Contract bindings:**
- **AppError ↔ TauRPC bridge** (security ↔ arch): `update_settings` returns `Result<Settings, AppError>` — AppError must be `Serialize`; compile-time TauRPC derive macro binding.
- **MCP double-gate ↔ mcp-server crate** (security ↔ arch): MCP-toggle persisted via Settings feeds runtime half of double-gate; compile-time gate stays in `mcp-server`.
- **Capability-drift xtask gate** (security ↔ tests): `cargo xtask capability-drift` exits 0 — required gate for any commit touching `pulse-app/src/main.rs` or `crates/ui-bridge/src/`.
- **Settings persistence ↔ existing IPC** (arch ↔ tests): `get_settings`/`update_settings` roundtrip exercised in tests using established TauRPC test surface, not in-process mock bypass.

- **Tests harness ↔ obs log format** (tests ↔ obs): test consumes `agent-latest.jsonl` and asserts `method_name` field present + Settings field values absent; TauRPC invocation boundary-call wrapper row contract honored both sides.
- **Plugin-manager ↔ basename discipline** (obs ↔ security): obs allowlist + security Vector 3 path canonicalization both land in same `plugins.list` handler — implementation MUST satisfy both.

- **A11y violation JSON ↔ obs structured log** (a11y ↔ obs): a11y violations emit to `~/.andromeda-pulse/logs/a11y-axe-core-results.jsonl` with `wcag_criterion`/`violation_type`/`severity`/`surface: "desktop-webview"`/`selector`/`remediation`/`tool`/`tool_result_id` fields; obs cross-correlates via `service.name: "com.andromeda.pulse"`.

- **A11y CI gate ↔ tests CI** (a11y ↔ tests): `npm run test:a11y` Playwright suite (axe-core + focus-order + keyboard) in same `ci.yml` E2E stage as Rust nextest; PR cannot merge if axe-core reports critical/serious or Lighthouse a11y < 90 or focus order assertion fails.

- **Design tokens contrast ↔ a11y SC 1.4.3 / 1.4.11** (design ↔ a11y): `--color-text-primary` (#E8EEF7) on `--color-raised-3` (#343A45) ≥4.5:1 normal text; `--color-accent` (#C7556A) non-text border/icon ≥3:1; verified via colorjs.io 0.6.x token-pair harness.

- **Motion tokens ↔ a11y SC 2.3.3** (design ↔ a11y): all form transitions degrade to 0ms under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` via Tailwind `motion-reduce:` variants; verified by Playwright `emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: 'reduce' })`.
- **State color + label pairing ↔ a11y SC 1.4.1** (design ↔ a11y): MCP toggle / theme-selected / preset-selected MUST pair color change with text label or icon change.

- **Layouts focus order ↔ a11y SC 2.4.3** (layouts ↔ a11y): canonical Tab sequence authored in a11y-plan §5 + layout-templates.md §settings-modal; chunk #38 implementation MUST match exactly via `tabbable(container)` Playwright harness.
- **Layouts modal trap ↔ a11y modal pattern** (layouts ↔ a11y): focus trap within modal binds to a11y modal focus-trap requirement; Esc dismiss binds to keyboard operability.

- **Layouts/IPC ↔ Settings struct** (layouts ↔ arch): form's Save action binds to existing `update_settings` TauRPC procedure; widget-position/retention/MCP-toggle fields map to existing Settings struct.

- **P7 keyboard nav surrogate** (tests ↔ a11y): vitest focus-trap test using `tabbable(dialog, { displayCheck: 'none' })` is the agent-driven surrogate for P7 keyboard nav (per test-plan §6 P5 IPC contract surrogate precedent applied to P7).
**Acceptance criteria contributions:**

- (security) All new enum-typed Settings fields fail `serde` deserialization on invalid variant strings; `update_settings` returns `AppError::Validation { field, reason }` rather than panicking or accepting invalid value (per security plan §Input Validation).

- (security) `update_settings` called with `retention_seconds` outside valid range (300–600 default per arch) returns `AppError::Validation { field: "retention_seconds", reason: "..." }`, not `AppError::Internal` or `Ok` (per security plan §Input Validation).

- (security) MCP-toggle set true + persisted but binary built without `--features mcp-server` → app logs warn-level message naming missing feature flag and MCP stdio surface does NOT start; graceful-degrade verified (per security plan §MCP Feature Double-Gate).

- (security) `cargo xtask capability-drift` exits 0 after merge — no new entries added to `pulse-app/capabilities/` JSON; confirms Settings-extension path used (per `.claude/rules/security.md` Session Additions 2026-05-09).

- (security) `update_settings` error responses at webview IPC boundary contain no stack traces, Rust struct names, file paths, or library versions; verified by inspecting AppError JSON serialization (per security plan §Error Sanitization).

- (arch) All new Settings fields reside in `crates/ui-bridge` — no Settings-related logic in sibling library crates or in `pulse-app/src/` beyond `apply_widget_settings()`-style hooks; verified by `cargo check --workspace` (per arch §Inherited Defaults).
- (arch) `cargo xtask capability-drift` exits 0; `plugins.list` and `plugins.reload` remain only plugin-manager IPC surface (per arch §Occupied Resources).

- (arch) `mcp_enabled` in config.toml does NOT override `ANDROMEDA_PULSE_MCP_ENABLED` env var at runtime; env-var wins per precedence chain; verified by unit test on layering logic (per arch §Cross-cutting Patterns Config management).

- (arch) All new enum and struct types crossing TauRPC bridge compile with `serde::Serialize + serde::Deserialize` derive; `tsc --noEmit` on generated bindings passes clean (per arch §Cross-cutting Patterns cross-bridge data shape).

- (tests) `cargo nextest run --workspace --profile ci` passes with new `crates/ui-bridge/src/contract.rs` unit tests covering all new Settings fields: serialize/deserialize round-trip + `TryFrom` for `retention_seconds` range + enum variants for each typed field (per test-plan §10 ≥75% line / ≥70% branch / ≥85% function Standard tier).

- (tests) `npm run test --prefix pulse-app/ui` passes with extended `SettingsRoute.test.tsx` and new `SettingsModal.test.tsx`: (a) dialog renders `role="dialog"` + `aria-modal="true"` + `aria-labelledby`; (b) Esc triggers `onClose`; (c) `tabbable(dialog, { displayCheck: 'none' })` enumerates fields in spec'd Tab order — P7 keyboard-nav agent surrogate (per test-plan §6 P7 + a11y plan §3 P7).
- (tests) `npm run typecheck --prefix pulse-app/ui` exits 0; pre-existing `MetricsChart.test.tsx:27,49` tsc errors documented as carry-over deferred or fixed inline (decision recorded in plan).
- (tests) Boot smoke gate: `npx @tauri-apps/cli dev` 60s timeout exits without `panic` in stdout/stderr; `Compiled successfully`/`ready in` signal observed (per test-plan §12 `boot-smoke-coverage`).
- (tests) `cargo xtask capability-drift` exits 0; no new TauRPC procedures introduced (Settings-extension path verified) (per test-plan §1 `security-vector-coverage: Tauri IPC capability gating`).

- (obs) `update_settings` handler emits `tracing::info!` with `method_name = "update_settings"`, `latency_ms`, `result_type` and NO Settings field values; verified by `grep`-ing `agent-latest.jsonl` for field names returning empty (per obs-plan §8).
- (obs) Plugin-manager panel `plugins.list` emits `plugin_path_basename` only; verified by asserting no `/`/`\` separators in basename log values (per obs-plan §8 + security plan Vector 3).
- (obs) No new `metric.*` tracing target introduced; verified by `grep 'metric\.' agent-latest.jsonl` returning only pre-existing `metric.webgpu.frame_duration_ms` entries (per obs-plan §5 + §11).

- (a11y) `@axe-core/playwright` scan reports zero critical/serious WCAG 2.1 AA violations (`wcag2a`, `wcag2aa`, `wcag21aa` tags); result emitted to `a11y-axe-core-results.jsonl` (per a11y-plan §3 + WCAG SC 2.1.2/2.4.3).

- (a11y) Playwright Tab-sequence test: `tabbable(settingsModalRoot)` matches `document.activeElement` across spec'd order; Shift+Tab reverses; Esc closes + restores focus to triggering "Settings" button (per a11y-plan §3 + WCAG SC 2.1.2/2.4.3).

- (a11y) MCP toggle Space-key test: `page.keyboard.press('Space')` toggles `aria-checked` between `"true"`/`"false"` without focus loss; save-success announced via `role="status" aria-live="polite"` (per a11y-plan §4 + §7 + WCAG SC 4.1.2/4.1.3).

- (a11y) Reduced-motion: `page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: 'reduce' })` → modal open/close `transition-duration: 0s`; field state still distinguishable via token + paired icon/text (per a11y-plan §6 + WCAG AAA SC 2.3.3 + SC 1.4.1).

- (design) All form control colors/spacing/border-radius values trace to named CSS custom properties from `@theme` block; no hardcoded hex or magic pixel values in component source (per §Self-Validation Protocol Token Test).

- (design) Toggle controls (MCP-enable, theme-mode) pair `--color-primary` active-state color with visible "On"/"Off" text label — state never communicated by color alone (per §Color Palette anti-pattern + §Design Decisions Log 2026-05-03).

- (design) All form control transitions use `--duration-fast` (150ms) or `--duration-standard` (200ms) ease-out; none exceed 200ms; all degrade to 0ms under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` (per §Motion Accessibility).

- (design) Modal surface uses `--color-raised-3` background + 1px `rgba(74,144,226,0.3)` border + `--radius-lg` (8px) corners; no shadow or gradient overlay on modal chrome (per §Depth Strategy + §Color Palette Surface Scale Raised-3).

- (layouts) Settings modal renders as overlay card (`color-raised-3` bg + `radius-lg` + `padding: space-md`) over active surface using chunk #37 Modal primitive as structural shell with close button top-right (per layout-templates.md §Component — Settings modal (form)).
- (layouts) Form sections stacked vertically with `gap: space-lg`; no horizontal multi-column layout present (per layout-templates.md §Component — Settings modal (form)).

- (layouts) Tab order traverses fields in spec'd sequence: theme → widget-position grid → retention → MCP-toggle → snapshot-preset → budget → format → plugin-manager → Save → Cancel; focus does not escape modal boundary while open (per layout-templates.md §Component — Settings modal (form) + §Keyboard navigation).
- (layouts) Widget snap position renders as 3×3 radio-button grid (corners + edges + center) with visual preview (per layout-templates.md §Component — Settings modal (form) Form controls).

title: Phase 35 Plan — chunk route#38: "Settings modal form"

data.head: # Phase 35 Plan — chunk route#38: "Settings modal form"

body: _Generated by /andromeda-phase Phase 4. Read by /andromeda-implement. Manual edits between runs are fine; do not edit during /implement run._
- **Phase number:** 35

- **Route chunks covered:**
  - route#38 "Settings modal form — theme/widget-position/retention/MCP-toggle/snapshot-preset+budget+format/plugin-manager + keyboard nav + focus trap"
- **Epoch:** Epoch 5 — Visualization surfaces (closes the epoch)

Close epoch 5 by composing the chunk #37 Modal primitive (`pulse-app/ui/src/components/Modal.tsx`) with a Settings form that surfaces every persistable user preference: theme picker, widget position, retention seconds, MCP server toggle, snapshot preset, snapshot format, and a read-only plugin-manager listing. The form persists state via the existing `update_settings` TauRPC procedure (no new IPC namespace per `.claude/rules/security.md` Session Additions 2026-05-09 second entry — extending `Settings` struct sidesteps the security ↔ tests/CI ↔ arch capability-drift triple binding entirely; verified via combined.md §security + §arch). The form satisfies a11y plan §3 P7 keyboard navigation (Tab cycle theme→position→retention→MCP→preset→format→Save→Cancel; Esc closes), reuses chunk #37's `focus-trap-react@12` configuration, and degrades motion under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` per design-system §Motion + WCAG AAA SC 2.3.3.

The Settings struct in `crates/ui-bridge/src/contract.rs` already carries 6 of the 7 form fields (`theme`/`widget_position`/`retention_seconds`/`mcp_server_enabled`/`notifications_enabled`/`always_on_top`); chunk #38 adds 2 new fields (`snapshot_preset: SnapshotPreset` enum + `snapshot_format: SnapshotFormat` enum) and replaces the empty-state stub at `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/routes/SettingsRoute.tsx` with the form rendered inside the Modal primitive. The route is the trigger: navigating to `/settings` opens the modal; closing the modal (Esc, close button, Save success, Cancel) navigates back to `/traces` (default tab). Plugin-manager UI invokes the existing `plugins.list` IPC procedure (already in arch §Occupied Resources) — no new TauRPC procedures.

Chunk #38 closes epoch 5 — Visualization surfaces. Successor chunk #39 starts Epoch 6 (Snapshot & Investigate) where the snapshot-preset/format settings persisted here become inputs to the snapshot generator.

1. **Add 2 new enum types + 2 new fields to `Settings` struct** in `crates/ui-bridge/src/contract.rs`:
   - Define `SnapshotPreset { Conservative, Balanced, Detailed }` enum with `#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, Default, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq)]` + `#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]`; `#[default] Balanced` per arch §Established Decisions snapshot curation default.
   - Define `SnapshotFormat { Markdown, Json }` enum with same derives + `#[serde(rename_all = "lowercase")]`; `#[default] Markdown`.
   - Both types `#[cfg_attr(feature = "taurpc-runtime", derive(specta::Type))]`.
   - Add fields to `Settings`: `#[serde(default)] pub snapshot_preset: SnapshotPreset` and `#[serde(default)] pub snapshot_format: SnapshotFormat`.
   - Update `Settings::default()` to include the new defaults.
   - Add co-located unit tests: `settings_default_snapshot_preset_is_balanced`, `settings_default_snapshot_format_is_markdown`, `snapshot_preset_serializes_snake_case`, `snapshot_format_serializes_lowercase`, `settings_round_trips_through_serde_with_snapshot_fields`. Pattern matches the existing `Theme`/`WidgetPosition` test cluster at lines 1015-1077.

2. **Create `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/routes/SettingsModalForm.tsx`** that composes Modal primitive with form content: - Component props: `{ open: boolean, onClose: () => void, triggerRef: RefObject }`. (Internal management of form state + IPC.) - On mount: invoke `taurpc.get_settings()` to fetch current Settings; populate local state (`useState`). - Render `` wrapping form content. - Form fields (Tab order matches a11y §5 spec): 1. Theme: `` with `Dark` / `Light` / `Auto` radios (or native `` if `react-aria-components` not yet installed — verify in pre-step; see Open question Q4). 2. Widget position: `` with 4 corner radios (`top-left`/`top-right`/`bottom-left`/`bottom-right`); current implementation supports 4 corners only (per `crates/ui-bridge/src/contract.rs:74-82` + `pulse-app/src/window.rs::compute_snap_position`); the 3×3 grid mentioned in layout-templates.md §Component — Settings modal is aspirational/future and out of chunk #38 scope. 3. Retention seconds: `` + `Range 60-86400 (1 minute to 24 hours)`. Validates client-side; backend re-validates via `Settings::validate()`. 4. MCP server toggle: `` — invokes `taurpc.plugins.list()` for population (currently returns placeholder per `crates/plugins`); no editing UI in chunk #38. 8. Save button: primary button at form bottom; on click calls `taurpc.update_settings(formState)`, sets `busy=true` during call, on success sets `liveMessage="Settings saved"` + closes modal after 600ms; on `AppError::Validation` displays per-field error + sets `aria-invalid="true"` on offending input via `aria-describedby`-linked error span. 9. Cancel button: secondary button; on click discards changes + calls `onClose()`. - Include reduced-motion respect via `motion-reduce:transition-none` Tailwind variant on any field-state transitions. - All design tokens via inline `style={{ background: "var(--color-X)", ... }}` per Modal.tsx + SettingsRoute.tsx existing convention.

3. **Create `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/routes/SettingsModalForm.test.tsx`** Vitest unit tests:
   - `vi.hoisted(() => ({ getSettings: vi.fn(), updateSettings: vi.fn(), pluginsList: vi.fn() }))` for TauRPC mocks; `vi.mock("../../bindings", () => ({ createTauRPCProxy: () => ({ get_settings: getSettings, update_settings: updateSettings, plugins: { list: pluginsList } }) }))`.
   - `Harness` wrapper with `triggerRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>` + `<button ref={triggerRef}>open</button>` + `<SettingsModalForm open onClose={onClose} triggerRef={triggerRef} />` — pattern from `Modal.test.tsx`.
   - `beforeEach`: `hasReducedMotionListener.current = false; prefersReducedMotion.current = null` + `getSettings.mockResolvedValue({ theme: "dark", widget_position: "top-right", retention_seconds: 600, mcp_server_enabled: false, notifications_enabled: true, always_on_top: true, snapshot_preset: "balanced", snapshot_format: "markdown" })`.
   - `afterEach`: `vi.unstubAllGlobals()`.
   - Test cases:
     - `renders dialog with role="dialog" + aria-modal="true" + aria-labelledby="settings-modal-title"` (via Modal primitive).
     - `renders all form fields with programmatically associated labels`.
     - `Tab order matches spec` — `tabbable(modalRoot, { displayCheck: 'none' })` enumerates fields in expected sequence: theme→widget-position→retention→MCP→snapshot-preset→snapshot-format→plugin-manager-reload→Save→Cancel.
     - `Esc triggers onClose` — `userEvent.keyboard("{Escape}")`.
     - `MCP toggle Space-key flips aria-checked` — `userEvent.keyboard(" ")` while switch focused.
     - `Save invokes update_settings with form state` — `userEvent.click(saveButton)` → asserts `updateSettings` called with current state shape.
     - `Save success announces via aria-live="polite" status region` — assert `liveMessage` content "Settings saved" appears in modal status region.
     - `AppError::Validation surfaces as field-level error message` — mock `updateSettings.mockRejectedValue({ kind: "validation", field: "retention_seconds", reason: "out of range" })`; assert error span text + `aria-invalid="true"` on input.
     - `Cancel discards changes + closes` — change a field → click Cancel → assert `onClose` called and changed-state not persisted.

4. **Update `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/routes/SettingsRoute.tsx`**: - Replace `` with ` navigate({ to: "/traces" })} triggerRef={triggerRef} />`. - Import `useNavigate` from `@tanstack/react-router`; `triggerRef = useRef(null)` (no actual trigger button in route — `triggerRef` empty ref is acceptable for FocusTrap's `returnFocusOnDeactivate` since modal closes via `navigate` which unmounts the component). - Preserve existing `
` wrapper + visible `

Settings

` heading (Modal primitive's own `

` shows inside the dialog; route-level h1 stays for the tab panel structure). - Drop the now-unused `EmptyState` component + `` import if no longer referenced.

5. **Update `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/routes/SettingsRoute.test.tsx`**:
   - Keep `renders <section> with id='tabpanel-settings' + aria-labelledby heading` assertion (preserve existing).
   - Replace `renders empty-state placeholder pointing to chunk #38` with `renders SettingsModalForm component` (assert by `screen.getByRole("dialog", { name: "Settings" })` — modal is open by default in route).
   - Keep `includes a single h1 heading with route label` (route-level `<h1>` preserved).
   - Mock TauRPC bindings the same way `SettingsModalForm.test.tsx` does (DRY violation acceptable since two test files have different test scopes).

6. **Wire tray "Open Settings" → /settings navigation** in `pulse-app/src/tray.rs`:
   - Update `MENU_ID_OPEN_SETTINGS` handler at line 213-218: after `focus_or_show_window(app, MAIN_WINDOW_LABEL)`, emit a Tauri event `app.emit("tray://open-settings", ())` so the webview navigates to `/settings` route. Add `use tauri::Manager` if not already imported (it is).
   - Update top comment to remove the "chunk #38 (Settings modal) replaces the /settings stub route" pending wording — replace with "Tray emits `tray://open-settings`; webview listens via `@tauri-apps/api/event::listen` and navigates to /settings (chunk #38 wiring complete)".
