data.head: # Codebase Research — phase-35: chunk route#38 "Settings modal form"

body: _Generated by /andromeda-phase Phase 3 from targeted reads informed by combined.md._
- **Research depth:** deep (mature codebase; multi-domain chunk; substantial existing Settings + Modal infrastructure to compose against)
- **Reads performed:** 12 full files
- **Globs / Greps:** 5 (4 globs for crate/webview structure + 1 capability dir glob)
- **Parallel batches:** 3

- `crates/ui-bridge/src/contract.rs` (full, 1184 lines) — `AppError` (6 variants), `Settings` struct already has 6 fields (`theme`/`widget_position`/`retention_seconds`/`mcp_server_enabled`/`notifications_enabled`/`always_on_top`), `Theme` (Dark/Light/Auto, lowercase serde), `WidgetPosition` (4 corners only, kebab-case serde), `Settings::validate()` checks `RETENTION_SECONDS_MIN=60..=RETENTION_SECONDS_MAX=86_400`, `Settings::load_from_data_dir()` boot helper (silent fallback to default on file-not-found OR parse error), 30+ co-located unit tests including settings round-trip + validate range tests + theme/widget-position serde wire format tests; `CapturingSubscriber` test helper for tracing-event assertions.

- `crates/ui-bridge/src/health.rs` (300 lines partial) — `IntrospectionApi` trait at line 291 with `#[taurpc::procedures(export_to = "ui/src/bindings/index.ts")]` macro; trait methods include `get_settings() -> Result<Settings, AppError>` + `update_settings(settings: Settings) -> Result<(), AppError>`; `HEARTBEAT_STATE` global; `current_health()` builds `HealthEnvelope` with subsystem rollup.

- `pulse-app/ui/src/components/Modal.tsx` (218 lines, full) — Modal primitive from chunk #37: props `{open, onClose, triggerRef, titleId, title, children, busy?, liveRegionLevel?, liveMessage?, clickOutsideDeactivates?, initialFocus?}`. Wires `FocusTrap` from `focus-trap-react@12` with `escapeDeactivates: true`, `returnFocusOnDeactivate: true`, `tabbableOptions: { displayCheck: 'none' }`. Uses inline style with `var(--color-raised-3)` etc. — NOT Tailwind classes. Renders `role="dialog"` + `aria-modal="true"` + `aria-labelledby={titleId}` + `aria-busy={busy}` + status region `role="status" aria-live={liveRegionLevel}` (visually-hidden via clip rect). Close button ✕ glyph in header; click-outside via document-level `mousedown` listener (NOT inline `onClick` per a11y rules 2026-05-10 entry).

- `pulse-app/ui/src/components/Modal.test.tsx` (231 lines, full) — Test pattern: `Harness` wrapper with `triggerRef = useRef`; describe blocks for open/close lifecycle / close button / Esc key / focus trap / aria-busy / aria-live / reduced-motion / click-outside dismissal. Uses `tabbable(dialog, { displayCheck: 'none' })` for focus enumeration. Resets motion-dom globals in `beforeEach`. `vi.unstubAllGlobals()` in `afterEach`.

- `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/routes/SettingsRoute.tsx` (68 lines, full) — Currently empty-state stub; renders `
` with `

Settings

` + ``. Uses `` for empty-state visual. Inline style with `var(--spacing-md)` etc.
- `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/routes/SettingsRoute.test.tsx` (25 lines, full) — Currently 3 tests: section markup + empty-state placeholder + h1 heading.

- `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/router.tsx` (206 lines, full) — TanStack Router with 5 child routes (`/traces` (default), `/metrics`, `/logs`, `/snapshots`, `/settings`). `pathnameToTabId()` derives active tab. `DashboardShell` wraps `Titlebar` + `SkipToMain` + `TabNav` + `<Outlet />` + `FooterStatusBar` + `CommandPalette`. Cmd+K palette + Esc shortcuts wired via `useKeyboardShortcuts`.
- `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/Dashboard.tsx` (29 lines, full) — Root entry creates router via `createDashboardRouter()` + wraps in `HaloInputProvider`.
- `pulse-app/ui/src/App.tsx` (30 lines, full) — Window-label router: `windowLabel === "compact-widget"` → `<CompactWidget />`; otherwise `<Dashboard haloInput={syntheticHaloInput} />`.

- `pulse-app/ui/src/bindings/index.ts` (68 lines, full) — Specta-generated. Confirms `Settings` TS shape: `{ theme?: Theme; widget_position?: WidgetPosition; retention_seconds?: number; mcp_server_enabled?: boolean; notifications_enabled?: boolean; always_on_top?: boolean }`. ARGS_MAP shows top-level procedures `{app_info, get_settings, health, ready, update_settings}` + sub-routers `{logs, metrics, streams, telemetry.frontend, traces}`. `update_settings(settings: Settings) => Promise<null>`. Theme = `"dark" | "light" | "auto"`. WidgetPosition = `"top-left" | "top-right" | "bottom-left" | "bottom-right"`.

- `pulse-app/src/main.rs` (671 lines, full) — `main()` builds tokio runtime, calls `observability::init`, then `Settings::load_from_data_dir(&data_dir)` at setup-closure, then `window::apply_widget_settings(app, &settings)` inside Tauri setup. Tray registered via `tray::setup_tray`. `IntrospectionApiImpl::new(data_dir.clone(), features, Some(Arc::clone(&broadcast_senders)))` is the resolver. Bindings emission test `emit_taurpc_bindings` verifies bindings file is written.

- `pulse-app/src/tray.rs` (433 lines, full) — Tray menu has `MENU_ID_OPEN_SETTINGS = "open_settings"` item. Handler `MENU_ID_OPEN_SETTINGS => focus_or_show_window(app, MAIN_WINDOW_LABEL)` — currently focuses main window without navigation. Comment explicitly says: "Chunk #38 (Settings modal) replaces the /settings stub route with the actual form. For chunk #36 we focus the main window; navigation to /settings happens webview-side via TanStack Router based on the URL fragment / chunk #33's router stub."

- `pulse-app/src/window.rs` (372 lines, full) — `apply_widget_settings(app, settings)` applies `widget_position` (snap to 4 corners via `compute_snap_position()`) + `always_on_top` flag. `widget_position_label()` bounded enum sanitizer. Detection helpers `detect_webview_backend()`, `detect_tray_api()`, `detect_wgpu_backend()`.

- `pulse-app/capabilities/default.json` (12 lines) — Permissions `["core:default", "updater:default"]`. Comment explains TauRPC dispatches all routes through single invoke handler — per-procedure granularity not enforced at capability level. **Confirms chunk #38 needs ZERO capability changes** (no new TauRPC procedures introduced).

- **Inline-token style pattern** (`pulse-app/ui/src/components/Modal.tsx:103-216`, `SettingsRoute.tsx:9-31`, `dashboard/router.tsx:118-128`): React components use inline `style={{ background: "var(--color-raised-3)", ... }}` with CSS custom property references rather than Tailwind utility classes. Tailwind v4 `motion-reduce:` variants applied via `className` (e.g., `Modal.tsx:105 "motion-reduce:transition-none motion-reduce:duration-0"`). All design tokens flow through `var(--token-name)`.

- **Modal primitive composition** (`Modal.tsx`): expects parent to manage `open` boolean state + `triggerRef` for focus restoration; children render arbitrary form content. The Modal already wires focus trap + Esc + close button + ARIA + reduced-motion overlay class. Consumers just supply `titleId`, `title`, and `children`.

- **Settings extension pattern** (`crates/ui-bridge/src/contract.rs:84-127`): each new field added with `#[serde(default = "default_X")]` or `#[serde(default)]` annotation enabling partial deserialization (missing fields fall back to defaults — verified by `settings_partial_deserialize_uses_defaults_for_missing_fields` test). New enum types follow `#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, Default, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq)]` + `#[serde(rename_all = "lowercase"|"kebab-case"|"snake_case")]` per existing `Theme` (lowercase) + `WidgetPosition` (kebab-case) precedent.

- **Co-located test pattern** (`crates/ui-bridge/src/contract.rs:367-1183`): each Settings field has dedicated tests for serde round-trip + default value + validate (where bounds apply). body: _Generated by /andromeda-phase Phase 4. Read by /andromeda-implement. Manual edits between runs are fine; do not edit during /implement run._
- **Phase number:** 36

- **Route chunks covered:**
  - route#39 "Curation primitives — dedupe identical spans, anomaly highlight (latency outliers / error correlation / cardinality spikes), critical-path extraction"
- **Epoch:** Epoch 6 — Snapshot & Investigate (opens the epoch; first of 5 chunks #39-#43)

Lay the algorithmic substrate for the snapshot pipeline by lifting the `crates/snapshot` crate from its Foundation-era stub (`Error::Placeholder` only) to a working curation surface that downstream chunks #40-#43 (and the future MCP `generate_snapshot` tool, chunks #46-#47) consume. Introduce three pure-function curation primitives — dedupe over OTLP-native span identity, anomaly highlighting across three sub-detectors (latency outliers via z-score, error correlation by service-clustered Status.code=Error spans, cardinality spikes vs baseline attribute keyspace), and critical-path extraction over the parent-span-id graph — plus a public `pub fn curate(spans: &[SpanRecord]) -> Result<CurationOutput, Error>` orchestrator that runs them in deterministic order. Per arch §Design Philosophy "Token-efficient curation as a first-class output", these primitives ARE the differentiator: they reduce raw OTLP-attribute-bearing rows into severity-ranked anomaly markers + dedup'd unique-span set + critical-path step list that chunk #41's markdown formatter rasterizes within token budgets and chunk #43's IPC + clipboard surfaces deliver to the user. No new TauRPC procedure introduced (curation is internal Rust API only); the `snapshot.*` namespace remains pre-reserved per arch §Occupied Resources for chunks #41/#43 to wire up. Discipline floors per security plan §Logging + obs plan §3 + tests-plan §10: zero raw OTLP attribute values in tracing emissions; default-deny field allowlist via `pulse-app/src/observability.rs::AllowList::production()` extension; deterministic outputs (no `HashMap` iteration without sort, no `Instant::now()` without injection); coverage ≥75% line / ≥70% branch / ≥85% function; full standard chunk-gate baseline. Per security extract: zero new TauRPC procedures → `cargo xtask capability-drift` exits 0 by-construction → no `/andromeda-scope-arch` invocation needed.

title: From route#39: "Curation primitives — dedupe identical spans, anomaly highlight (latency outliers / error correlation / cardinality spikes), critical-path extraction"

data.head: ### From route#39: "Curation primitives — dedupe identical spans, anomaly highlight (latency outliers / error correlation / cardinality spikes), critical-path extraction"

body: 1. **Extend `crates/snapshot/Cargo.toml` `[dependencies]`** with `serde.workspace = true` (with derive feature already configured workspace-side), `tracing.workspace = true`, `chrono.workspace = true`. Add `[dev-dependencies]` block with `rstest.workspace = true`, `proptest.workspace = true`. Keep existing `thiserror.workspace = true`. Verify no new third-party crate added (no `statrs`/`hdrhistogram`/`quantogram`) — percentile / outlier math is pure Rust.

2. **Update `crates/snapshot/src/lib.rs`** from single-line `pub mod contract;` to declare three new `pub(crate) mod` siblings: `pub(crate) mod dedupe;`, `pub(crate) mod anomaly;`, `pub(crate) mod critical_path;`. (Flat sibling layout per research.md Q2 recommendation; matches `crates/ingest/` pattern.)

3. **Replace `crates/snapshot/src/contract.rs` placeholder with real curation surface.** Define:
   - Public input shape `pub struct SpanRecord` with OTLP-native composite ID fields (`trace_id: [u8; 16]`, `span_id: [u8; 8]`, `parent_span_id: Option<[u8; 8]>`), `service_name: String`, `name: String`, `start_time_unix_nano: i64`, `end_time_unix_nano: i64`, `status_code: u8` (0=Unset, 1=Ok, 2=Error per OTLP Status spec).
   - Public output shape `pub struct CurationOutput { pub unique_spans: Vec<SpanRecord>, pub dedup_count: usize, pub anomaly_markers: Vec<AnomalyMarker>, pub critical_path: Vec<CriticalPathStep>, pub input_row_count: usize, pub output_row_count: usize }`.
   - Public taxonomy `pub enum AnomalyKind { LatencyOutlier, ErrorCorrelation, CardinalitySpike }` with `#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]` (per design extract: domain-stable, no inline color tokens or hex).
   - Public marker `pub struct AnomalyMarker { pub kind: AnomalyKind, pub severity: u8, pub rationale: String, pub affected_span_ids: Vec<[u8; 8]> }` — severity 0-100 scalar for ranking; rationale string is terse factual observational form (no exclamatory framing per design constraint).
   - Public step `pub struct CriticalPathStep { pub span_id: [u8; 8], pub duration_ms: u64 }`.
   - All public types derive `Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize` (no `specta::Type` at chunk #39 — that derives at chunk #41 when output crosses the TauRPC bridge; snapshot crate stays pre-bridge per arch §Cross-cutting Patterns).
   - Replace `Error::Placeholder` with `pub enum Error { EmptyInput, InvalidSpanRecord { kind: &'static str }, OrphanParentSpan { parent: [u8; 8] }, LatencyDistributionDegenerate { reason: &'static str } }` (or equivalent; final variant set decided at /implement based on what each primitive surfaces as failure). Use `&'static str` kind tags or typed-primitive payloads only — NEVER `String` carrying OTLP attribute values per security plan §Error Handling boundary sanitization preparation.
   - Top-level orchestrator `pub fn curate(spans: &[SpanRecord]) -> Result<CurationOutput, Error>` runs `dedupe_spans` → `detect_anomalies(unique_spans)` → `extract_critical_path(unique_spans)` in deterministic order; emits `snapshot.curate.full_pipeline` parent span via `#[tracing::instrument(skip_all, fields(input_row_count, output_row_count, dedup_count, anomaly_markers_count, critical_path_span_count, duration_ms))]`.

4. **Author `crates/snapshot/src/dedupe.rs`** — `pub(crate) fn dedupe_spans(spans: &[SpanRecord]) -> DedupResult` keyed off OTLP-native `span_id` (literal duplicates) AND a composite hash of (service_name, name, duration_bucket_ms) for "logically identical" collapse (decide bucket granularity at /implement based on what reduces noise without losing signal — likely 10ms or 100ms buckets). Returns `DedupResult { unique_spans: Vec<SpanRecord>, dedup_count: usize, input_row_count: usize, output_row_count: usize }`. One `#[tracing::instrument(skip_all, fields(input_row_count, output_row_count, dedup_count, duration_ms))]` boundary span; no per-row events (per obs extract anti-pattern). Sort `unique_spans` deterministically by (service_name, name, span_id bytes) before return so downstream output is reproducible.

5. **Author `crates/snapshot/src/anomaly.rs`** — three sub-detectors plus orchestrator:
   - `pub(crate) fn detect_latency_outliers(spans: &[SpanRecord], z_threshold: f64) -> Vec<AnomalyMarker>` — z-score on `duration_ms = (end_time_unix_nano - start_time_unix_nano) / 1_000_000`; flag spans where `(duration - mean) / std_dev > z_threshold`. Default `z_threshold = 3.0` as `pub(crate) const LATENCY_OUTLIER_Z_THRESHOLD: f64 = 3.0`. Severity scaled from z-score (e.g., `((z * 25.0).clamp(0.0, 100.0)) as u8`). Rationale string: `"p99 exceeded baseline by {:.1}σ"`.
   - `pub(crate) fn detect_error_correlation(spans: &[SpanRecord]) -> Vec<AnomalyMarker>` — group spans where `status_code == 2` (OTLP Error) by `service_name` (categorical bucket only — service name LENGTH/ENUM emitted as `service_count` field in tracing; the per-call value in the marker is fine because it goes to the OUTPUT structure not to tracing fields). Emit one marker per service-cluster with ≥3 errors in input; severity scaled from error-rate-percent. Rationale string: `"Error-cluster: {} errors of {} spans for service"` (count + total + service).
   - `pub(crate) fn detect_cardinality_spikes(spans: &[SpanRecord]) -> Vec<AnomalyMarker>` — count unique attribute keyspace per service (using span_name + service_name only at chunk #39 since SpanRecord doesn't yet expose attribute Vec; if attribute count is needed, add `attribute_keys_count: usize` to SpanRecord and document the simplification — full attribute key inspection is chunk #40 territory). Flag service buckets where keyspace exceeds 95th-percentile-of-services threshold. Severity scaled from spike magnitude. Rationale: `"Cardinality spike: {} unique span names vs {} median"`.

data.head: # Phase 37 Plan — chunk route#40: "Aggregation + low-signal drop"

body: _Generated by /andromeda-phase Phase 4. Read by /andromeda-implement. Manual edits between runs are fine; do not edit during /implement run._
- **Phase number:** 37

- **Route chunks covered:**
  - route#40 "Aggregation + low-signal drop — p50/p95/p99/max metric aggregation, drop verbose attributes (keep service.name/request_id/error)"
- **Epoch:** Epoch 6 — Snapshot & Investigate

Chunk #40 extends the chunk #39 algorithmic-substrate scaffold (`crates/snapshot/src/{dedupe,anomaly,critical_path}.rs`) with two new pre-bridge pure-function primitives: (1) **percentile aggregation** computing per-service + global p50/p95/p99/max latency over `&[SpanRecord]` inputs, producing a deterministic `AggregationResult`; (2) **low-signal attribute filter** dropping verbose OTLP attribute keys with an explicit allowlist (`service.name`, `request_id`, `error`, `error.type`, `error.message`) and bounded per-value length. Both primitives stay call-site-agnostic (zero `taurpc::*` / `tauri::*` / `rmcp::*` / `specta::Type` imports in `crates/snapshot/src/`) so the downstream chunk #41 markdown formatter, chunk #43 clipboard surface, and Epoch 7 MCP `generate_snapshot` tool consume the same redacted output via shared substrate (per session 47 algorithmic-substrate pattern, chunk #39 precedent).

Per security plan §Logging Vector 1, the attribute filter IS the active redaction defense for OTLP attribute leakage at the Investigate workflow + MCP egress surfaces — its allowlist-keep semantics + per-value length cap (256 bytes) are the primary defense (NOT token-budget truncation, which arrives at chunk #41). Per arch §Established Decisions Snapshot Curation Default, the percentile contract is locked at p50/p95/p99/max — no alternative quantiles introduced. Per obs-plan §3, new tracing fields land at the existing `snapshot` allowlist entry in `pulse-app/src/observability.rs:181` via `split('.').next()` fall-through resolution; chunk #39's positive + negative-canary test pattern extends to cover `snapshot.curate.aggregate` (+ `snapshot.curate.attribute_filter` if separated) targets.

The `From<SnapshotError> for AppError` boundary in `crates/ui-bridge/src/contract.rs` is touched only if chunk #40 introduces new `Error` variants — per Q5 resolution below, this chunk does NOT add new variants (degenerate / empty inputs return zero-valued `AggregationResult` rather than error, mirroring chunk #39's `curate(empty)` semantics). The standard chunk-gate baseline (cargo fmt / clippy / nextest / xtask capability-drift / cargo deny / cargo audit) gates per test-plan §12 amendment 2026-05-10. Boot-smoke gate is NOT required (chunk #40 modifies neither `pulse-app/src/main.rs` nor `crates/ui-bridge/src/health.rs` nor capability JSON).

1. **Extend `crates/snapshot/src/contract.rs` with new public types** (per Q1+Q2 resolutions):
   - Extend `SpanRecord` with `pub attributes: Vec<(String, String)>` field, defaulting to empty via `#[serde(default)]` so chunk #39 test fixtures and downstream callers without attribute data continue to compile/round-trip.
   - Add `pub const MAX_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE_BYTES: usize = 256;` and `pub const MAX_ATTRIBUTES_PER_SPAN: usize = 32;` per security plan §Input Validation post-prost row (attribute keys/values bounded).
   - Add public types: `pub struct ServicePercentiles { pub p50_ms: u64, pub p95_ms: u64, pub p99_ms: u64, pub max_ms: u64, pub sample_count: usize }` and `pub struct AggregationResult { pub per_service: BTreeMap<String, ServicePercentiles>, pub global: ServicePercentiles }` (using `BTreeMap` for deterministic iteration order). Both derive `Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize`.
   - Add public type: `pub struct AttributeFilterResult { pub spans: Vec<SpanRecord>, pub kept_attribute_count: usize, pub dropped_attribute_count: usize }` with same derives.
   - Do NOT add new `Error` variants (per Q5 resolution — degenerate inputs return zero-valued outputs).

2. **Create `crates/snapshot/src/aggregation.rs`** (new sibling file):
   - `pub(crate) fn aggregate_metrics(spans: &[SpanRecord]) -> AggregationResult`.
   - Pure-Rust percentile computation: collect `duration_ms` values via `(end_time_unix_nano - start_time_unix_nano) / 1_000_000`; sort ascending; index at `floor(0.5 * n)`, `floor(0.95 * n)`, `floor(0.99 * n)`, `n - 1` (clamped). Per-service breakdown via `BTreeMap<String, Vec<u64>>` accumulator → percentile per bucket. Global aggregate over all spans.
   - Empty input → `AggregationResult { per_service: BTreeMap::new(), global: ServicePercentiles { all-zero, sample_count: 0 } }` (no error).
   - `#[tracing::instrument(skip_all, fields(metric_input_count = spans.len(), metric_output_count = field::Empty, service_count = field::Empty, p50_ms = field::Empty, p95_ms = field::Empty, p99_ms = field::Empty, max_ms = field::Empty, duration_ms = field::Empty))]` with `Span::current().record(...)` at function exit (incl. early-return).
   - Co-located `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` with ≥9 cases: empty input zero values; single-span global = first; two-span p50 = first / max = second; uniform distribution (all values equal); skewed with single p99 outlier; 100-element distribution with known percentile indices; per-service breakdown with 2 services; per-service deterministic ordering (alphabetical service iteration); proptest property `p50 ≤ p95 ≤ p99 ≤ max` over ≥1000 random inputs.

3. **Create `crates/snapshot/src/attribute_filter.rs`** (new sibling file):
   - `pub(crate) const KEPT_ATTRIBUTE_KEYS: &[&str] = &["service.name", "request_id", "error", "error.type", "error.message"];`
   - `pub(crate) fn filter_attributes(spans: &[SpanRecord]) -> AttributeFilterResult`.
   - Per-span: filter `attributes` field keeping only `KEPT_ATTRIBUTE_KEYS` keys (exact-match `==` comparison); truncate kept-key VALUE bytes to ≤`MAX_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE_BYTES` (256) using `value.chars().take_while(byte_count_under_cap)` to stay valid UTF-8; append `…` (U+2026) sentinel if truncated.
   - Track counts: increment `dropped_attribute_count` per dropped key; `kept_attribute_count` per kept (post-truncation) key.
   - Output: clone of input spans with filtered+truncated attributes; counts in result.
   - `#[tracing::instrument(skip_all, fields(input_row_count = spans.len(), output_row_count = field::Empty, kept_attribute_count = field::Empty, dropped_attribute_count = field::Empty, duration_ms = field::Empty))]` with `Span::current().record(...)` at function exit.
   - Co-located `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` with ≥9 cases: empty input; spans with no attributes (zero counts); spans with only allowlisted keys (all kept); spans with only verbose keys (all dropped); mixed; exact-key vs near-match (e.g., `service_name_v2` does NOT match `service.name`); 1 MB error message value truncated to 256 bytes + ellipsis; UTF-8 boundary at byte 256 (truncation respects char boundary); count accuracy across multi-span input.

4. **Wire new modules into `crates/snapshot/src/lib.rs`**:
   - Append `pub(crate) mod aggregation;` and `pub(crate) mod attribute_filter;` to the existing 4-line module declarations.

5. **Extend `pulse-app/src/observability.rs::AllowList::production()` `snapshot` entry** (lines 181-202):
   - Append new fields: `metric_input_count`, `metric_output_count`, `service_count`, `kept_attribute_count`, `dropped_attribute_count`, `p50_ms`, `p95_ms`, `p99_ms`, `max_ms`. (`duration_ms`, `input_row_count`, `output_row_count` already present from chunk #39.)
   - Verify exact-key fall-through: `for_target("snapshot.curate.aggregate")` and `for_target("snapshot.curate.attribute_filter")` resolve via `split('.').next() = "snapshot"`.

6. **Extend allowlist regression tests in `pulse-app/src/observability.rs`** (lines 1592-1665):
   - Add new dotted targets `snapshot.curate.aggregate` and `snapshot.curate.attribute_filter` to `allowlist_for_target_resolves_snapshot_curate_field_set` rstest target list (now 6 targets × per-field assertions); append new fields to the `for required in [...]` list per `for_target` resolution: `metric_input_count`, `metric_output_count`, `service_count`, `kept_attribute_count`, `dropped_attribute_count`, `p50_ms`, `p95_ms`, `p99_ms`, `max_ms`.
   - Add new sibling negative-canary test `scrubber_redacts_non_allowlisted_snapshot_aggregate_field` mirroring `scrubber_redacts_non_allowlisted_snapshot_curate_field`: emit `tracing::warn!` at `snapshot.curate.aggregate` with allowed (`p99_ms = 42_u64`) + forbidden (`attribute_value = "secret-token"`, `attribute_key = "user.id"`) fields; assert forbidden values reduce to `"<redacted>"` sentinel.

7. **Verify `crates/ui-bridge/src/contract.rs:321-349` `From<SnapshotError> for AppError` impl unchanged** (per Q5 — no new Error variants this chunk):
   - Confirm 4 existing match arms still cover all `SnapshotError` variants exhaustively (compiler enforces).
   - No changes to `crates/ui-bridge/src/contract.rs` per-variant tests at lines 813-877.
8. **Run standard chunk-gate baseline** + verify acceptance criteria. (See Test Commands below.)

- `crates/snapshot/src/{dedupe,anomaly,critical_path}.rs` — chunk #39 primitives stable.

- `crates/viz/` — viz crate owns DuckDB query path; no SQL construction in snapshot crate.

- `pulse-app/capabilities/*.json` — no new TauRPC procedure introduced.

- (design) NEVER drop anomaly evidence to fit budget BEFORE dropping low-signal verbose attributes / aggregated p50 detail — Halo signature semantics demand anomalies survive every truncation tier (per design-system.md §Brand Identity Signature element).

- (tests) NEVER dump raw OTLP JSON as snapshot output — formatter MUST evidence dedup_count > 0, p50/p95/p99 aggregates, and anomaly markers in the markdown body; assertions on output regex `⚠|🔴|critical.*path` plus p50/p95/p99 numeric-line presence are the contract (per test-plan §11 Project-specific anti-patterns + §6 P2 step 5/8).

- (tests) NEVER add retry-once policies for flaky markdown-formatter tests; if a test flakes, quarantine + root-cause (per test-plan §10 Zero-flakiness budget).

- (tests) NEVER use real time without injection in formatter tests — use deterministic seeds for proptest and `tokio::time::pause()` for any async paths (per test-plan §11 Universal agent-driven row).

- (obs) NEVER emit the rendered markdown body as a span/event field (Vectors 1+4) — emit only `markdown_size_bytes`, `section_count`, `token_count_actual`, kind-only `anomaly_markers` array (per obs-plan §11 Logs ban).

- (obs) NEVER use unbounded label cardinality on the metric event — `service_name` (unbounded by external clients) belongs in markdown body via citation anchor, not in metric event field set (per obs-plan §11 Metrics + §5 cardinality discipline).

- (obs) NEVER format expensive payloads inside `tracing::info!` macro args without level-gating — use `if tracing::enabled!(Level::DEBUG) { ... }` (per obs-plan §11 Metrics + `.claude/rules/observability.md` line 74).

- (obs) NEVER add OTel SDK crates (`opentelemetry`, `opentelemetry_sdk`, `opentelemetry-otlp`) to the snapshot crate — recursion-free-by-construction architectural invariant (per obs-plan §1 + §11 Universal bullet 4).

- (obs) NEVER skip `budget_exceeded = true` `tracing::error!` emission when formatted output would exceed budget — SLO CI gate (post-test `jq` over `metric.snapshot.token_count_ms` events) needs the error event to detect violations (per obs-plan §5 + §10 CI gate).

- (a11y) NEVER convey budget-exceeded or truncation state via formatting/color alone in the produced markdown — must include textual label paired with any visual cue per SC 1.4.1 Use of Color (per a11y plan §11 Visual anti-patterns).

- (a11y) NEVER emit dynamic state changes from the formatter without a typed signal — string-matching log lines is brittle and bypasses SC 4.1.3 Status Messages contract (per a11y plan §11 SLO anti-patterns).

- (arch) Do NOT add a new env var like `ANDROMEDA_PULSE_TOKEN_BUDGET` — arch §Occupied Resources environment variables are reserved at arch level; adding requires `/andromeda-scope-arch`.

- (arch) Do NOT add a sibling `crates/snapshot-markdown/` crate or rename the snapshot crate — Arch §Occupied Resources Cargo workspace crate names is LOCKED. Chunk #41 extends `crates/snapshot/` in place.
- (arch) Do NOT introduce a `pub use` re-export across crate boundaries per §Conventions "Module visibility discipline" — only the explicit `contract` module is the public surface of each crate.

data.head: # Phase 38 Plan — chunks route#41: "Markdown formatter + token budget"

body: _Generated by /andromeda-phase Phase 4. Read by /andromeda-implement. Manual edits between runs are fine; do not edit during /implement run._
- **Phase number:** 38

- **Route chunks covered:**
  - route#41 "Markdown formatter + token budget — hierarchical markdown with citation anchors, 10k/25k/50k budget enforcement, smart truncation prioritizing anomalies"
- **Epoch:** Epoch 6 — Snapshot & Investigate

Land a hierarchical markdown formatter as a pure-Rust algorithmic substrate inside the `snapshot` crate that consumes the `CurationOutput` produced by `curate()` (chunks #39 + #40 combined) and renders an observation-log markdown string sized to a 3-tier token budget (Conservative=10k / Balanced=25k default / Detailed=50k tokens). Smart truncation prioritizes anomaly evidence (latency outliers / error correlation / cardinality spikes from chunk #39's `detect_anomalies`) — when the budget binds, low-signal verbose attribute detail and aggregated percentile rows drop FIRST, anomalies survive last. Markdown structure follows a stable hierarchical shape (one H1 page title → H2 section bands → H3 per-service / per-anomaly subsections) so citation anchors remain stable across budget-preset re-runs. The formatter is a NEW PUBLIC CONSUMER that wraps `curate()`'s output rather than extending its body — per session-handoff Tier 3 entry "primitives EXTEND curate() vs new consumers WRAP its output". Per security plan §Logging & Monitoring, OTLP-derived attribute values are user-controlled content: every value interpolation goes through an escape helper backslash-escaping markdown structural characters and enforcing the 256-byte cap from chunk #40's `MAX_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE_BYTES`. Per obs-plan §3 + §10, the formatter emits two new tracing spans (`snapshot.render.markdown` + `snapshot.token.count.validate`) and one perf-budget metric event (`metric.snapshot.token_count_ms`) into the existing JSON file sink, all default-deny field-allowlisted at `pulse-app/src/observability.rs::AllowList::production()` mirroring chunk #40's `snapshot.curate.aggregate` precedent. Chunk stays pure-substrate: no new TauRPC procedure, no new env var, no AppError conversion — the eventual `snapshot.generate` IPC wiring lands at a later chunk and will reuse the same formatter substrate, as will chunk #46's MCP `generate_snapshot` tool method per arch §Established Decisions [MCP Server Surface].

1. Create `crates/snapshot/src/token_budget.rs` defining `pub enum TokenBudget { Conservative, #[default] Balanced, Detailed }` with `#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize, Default)]` + `#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]`. Add `impl TokenBudget { pub const fn as_token_count(self) -> usize { match self { Self::Conservative => 10_000, Self::Balanced => 25_000, Self::Detailed => 50_000 } } }`. Naming matches `ui-bridge::contract::SnapshotPreset` already shipped at chunk #38 for cross-readability. Co-located `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` covers serde round-trip + as_token_count constants.

2. Create `crates/snapshot/src/markdown.rs` with the formatter implementation. The module surface is `pub(crate) fn format_markdown(curated: &CurationOutput, budget: TokenBudget) -> Result<MarkdownReport, FormatError>`, re-exported through `contract.rs`. Internal helpers (all `fn`, not `pub(crate)`):
   - `count_tokens(s: &str) -> usize` — char-count heuristic `ceil(s.len() / 4)` (matches GPT-style approximation; std-only, avoids new workspace dep per chunk #40 precedent).
   - `escape_attribute_value(s: &str) -> String` — backslash-escape `[ ] ( ) `` ` `` characters; truncate to `MAX_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE_BYTES` (256) at UTF-8 char boundary with U+2026 ellipsis sentinel; matches the chunk #40 `attribute_filter::truncate_to_utf8_boundary` helper if it exists, otherwise reimplement standalone (keep `MAX_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE_BYTES` source-of-truth in `contract.rs`).

   - Phase A (always emit): H1 title `# andromeda-pulse — Observation log {ISO-timestamp from curated.input_row_count derivation OR placeholder}` + H2 "Anomaly observations" (full content) + H2 "Critical path" (full content). These are the always-survive tier.

- **Phase D fail-closed semantic:** the formatter's `BudgetExceeded` Err return is reserved for the genuinely-degenerate case where Phase A content (always-survive: anomaly observations + critical path) alone exceeds the budget. Phases B + C (drop attribute detail then drop low-signal spans) are expected to bring all "normal" inputs under any budget tier. Phase D firing is informative — surfaces to chunk #42 UI as `role="alert"` per a11y constraint.

- **Token-counting algorithm note:** char-count heuristic (`ceil(byte_len / 4)`) chosen for chunk #41 to avoid new workspace dep per chunk #40 precedent. Real tokenizer (e.g., tiktoken-rs / tokenizers) tracks GPT/Claude tokenization more accurately but is a 5-10MB dep with C dependencies. The proptest invariant `report.token_count <= budget.as_token_count()` is independent of tokenization algorithm correctness; future chunk MAY swap to a real tokenizer behind a feature flag without breaking the contract.

- **Smart-truncation determinism:** order is `dedup → critical_path → aggregation → unique_spans (with attributes) → unique_spans (sans attributes) → fail-closed`. Identical inputs MUST produce byte-identical markdown for `agent diffs across runs become meaningful` (per obs-plan §1 agent-driven invariant). The `BTreeMap` iteration in aggregation already gives deterministic order; the unique_spans Vec iteration follows insertion order from `dedupe` which is itself deterministic per chunk #39's `output_ordering_is_deterministic_across_invocations` test.

- **The `kept_attribute_count` / `dropped_attribute_count` from chunk #40** are READ from `CurationOutput` for telemetry purposes (recorded on `snapshot.render.markdown` span) but NOT for truncation decisions — the chunk #40 attribute filter has already removed verbose attributes; chunk #41 only further-truncates the kept set if budget binds (Phase B). The `kept_attribute_count` from chunk #40 is the input ceiling; chunk #41's `truncated_attribute_count` records additional drops applied by the formatter.

- (security) Stub procedure errors MUST return `Result<T, AppError>` using existing variants (`Validation { field, reason }` / `NotFound { resource }` / `Internal { message }`); "not yet wired" failure mode collapses to `AppError::Internal { message: <sanitized one-liner> }` (per security plan §Error Handling + Conventions Error response schema).

data.head: # Phase 39 Plan — chunks route#42: "Investigate trigger + capture collapse"

body:
_Generated by /andromeda-phase Phase 4. Read by /andromeda-implement.
Manual edits between runs are fine; do not edit during /implement run._
- **Phase number:** 39

- **Route chunks covered:**
  - route#42 "Investigate trigger + capture collapse — button on widget/main/context-menu/trace-row + 350ms scale+opacity supporting moment + aria-busy/aria-live"
- **Epoch:** Epoch 6 — Snapshot & Investigate (4 of 5 chunks; #39/#40/#41 substrate complete; #43 final)

Chunk #42 wires the Investigate UI entry-point to the curation pipeline that chunks #39/#40/#41 already deliver as substrate. Four trigger placements — a Primary "Investigate" button in the main dashboard Traces header, an icon button in the compact widget titlebar, a right-click context-menu item on each trace row, and an inline icon-button action column on each trace row — all open the same Investigation modal. The modal composes the chunk #37 Modal primitive (FocusTrap + aria-busy + aria-live) with a 350ms scale+opacity supporting moment (the canonical "Capture Collapse" of the design system) that degrades to instant under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`. During the supporting moment the trigger and the modal carry `aria-busy="true"` and the modal's `role="status"` live region announces "Investigation snapshot capturing"; on completion the live region transitions to "Investigation snapshot ready" (or for chunk #42 specifically: "Investigation not yet wired — lands chunk #43"). Focus restores to the originating trigger when the modal closes, per a11y-plan §5.

The actual `snapshot.generate` TauRPC procedure lands at chunk #43 with workspace.detect + clipboard + dual `.json`/`.md` write. Chunk #42 introduces the procedure as a real registered placeholder (per security plan + arch — not a webview-only no-op) so capability gating, AppError sanitization, and the AllowList registry all land together; chunk #43 swaps the placeholder body for the wired implementation without changing the signature. The chunk follows chunk #38's plugin-manager placeholder discipline (per session-learnings 2026-05-10 — Plan-vs-IPC reality check) but elevates it to a real IPC stub because chunk #42 needs the trigger to "do something" (call IPC + display result), whereas chunk #38's plugin-manager was a static informational caption. The placeholder body returns `Err(AppError::Internal { message: "Investigate not yet wired (lands chunk #43)" })` after the 350ms supporting-moment delay; the modal renders the error as the live-region announcement plus a visible role="alert" region (mirroring SettingsModalForm.tsx:201-213 error pattern).

Per security plan §API Security + .claude/rules/security.md Session Additions 2026-05-09, adding the first `snapshot.*` procedure does NOT require `/andromeda-scope-arch` first because arch §Occupied Resources already reserves the `snapshot.{generate,list_recent,copy_to_clipboard}` namespace; the chunk's responsibilities are limited to (a) implementing the placeholder in `crates/snapshot/src/ipc.rs`, (b) merging the router in `pulse-app/src/main.rs` (3 branches), (c) extending `xtask/src/main.rs::EXPECTED_PROCEDURES` to uncomment `"snapshot.generate"` and couple the change in the same commit per security.md Session Additions 2026-05-10, and (d) extending `pulse-app/src/observability.rs::AllowList::production()` with the per-leaf `snapshot.generate.request` entry plus positive resolver + negative-canary tests per testing.md Session Addition 2026-05-10 + observability.md Session Addition 2026-05-07.

1. **Extend snapshot crate Cargo.toml** with `taurpc-runtime` feature flag mirroring `crates/ui-bridge/Cargo.toml`. Add optional `taurpc` + `specta` dependencies; gate via `[features] taurpc-runtime = ["dep:taurpc", "specta/derive"]`. Verify exact shape against ui-bridge precedent at implementation time — names/versions must match workspace.dependencies entries to avoid duplicate-version `cargo deny check bans` failures.

2. **Add `crates/snapshot/src/ipc.rs`** (new file, ~80 lines) mirroring `crates/ui-bridge/src/telemetry.rs:93-134` shape:
   - `#[cfg(feature = "taurpc-runtime")] mod runtime { ... }` outer gate
   - `#[taurpc::procedures(path = "snapshot")] pub trait SnapshotApi` with single method `async fn generate(self, budget: TokenBudget) -> Result<MarkdownReport, AppError>`
   - `#[derive(Clone, Default)] pub struct SnapshotApiImpl;` resolver struct
   - `#[taurpc::resolvers] impl SnapshotApi for SnapshotApiImpl` with placeholder body. Body decorator: `#[tracing::instrument(skip_all, fields(budget = ?budget, result_kind = tracing::field::Empty, duration_ms = tracing::field::Empty))]`. Body: record `result_kind = "placeholder"` + `duration_ms`; emit `tracing::warn!(target: "snapshot.generate.request", budget = ?budget, "Investigate trigger reached placeholder; lands chunk #43");` ; return `Err(AppError::Internal { message: "Investigate not yet wired (lands chunk #43)".to_string() })`.
   - `#[cfg(feature = "taurpc-runtime")] pub use runtime::{SnapshotApi, SnapshotApiImpl};` re-export.
   - Tests within `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` using `CapturingSubscriber` pattern from `crates/ui-bridge/src/telemetry.rs:147-178`: assert placeholder emits the `snapshot.generate.request` tracing event at WARN level; assert returned error is `AppError::Internal` with sanitized message (no path / no stack / no struct name).
3. **Extend `crates/snapshot/src/lib.rs`** by adding `pub mod ipc;` line. (1 new line; preserves existing pure-substrate module list.)
4. **Update `pulse-app/Cargo.toml`** so `snapshot` dependency has `features = ["taurpc-runtime"]` (parallels ui-bridge's existing pattern).

5. **Update `pulse-app/src/main.rs`** in 3 places (verify all branches at implementation):
   - Add `use snapshot::ipc::{SnapshotApi, SnapshotApiImpl};` import alongside `use ui_bridge::telemetry::{TelemetryApi, TelemetryApiImpl};` (line ~19).
   - Append `.merge(SnapshotApiImpl::new().into_handler())` to the production router chain (~line 263).
   - Append `.merge(SnapshotApiImpl::new().into_handler())` to the dev-fallback router chain (~line 268).
   - Append `.merge(SnapshotApiImpl::new().into_handler())` to the test-branch router chain (~line 658).

6. **Update `pulse-app/src/observability.rs::AllowList::production()`** with new per-leaf entry `by_target.insert("snapshot.generate.request", ["budget", "result_kind", "duration_ms", "message"].into_iter().collect());`. Verify field set against actual instrument decorator fields at implementation.

7. **Add positive-resolver + negative-canary tests** to `pulse-app/src/observability.rs` mirroring chunk #41 pattern:
   - `#[test] fn allowlist_for_target_resolves_snapshot_generate_request_field_set()` — assert `for_target("snapshot.generate.request")` returns Some(set) containing `"budget"`, `"result_kind"`, `"duration_ms"`, `"message"`.
   - `#[test] fn scrubber_redacts_non_allowlisted_snapshot_generate_request_field()` — explicit fn (NOT for-loop) because `tracing::warn!(target: "snapshot.generate.request", ...)` requires `&'static str` literal per testing.md Session Addition 2026-05-10 chunk #41.

8. **Update `xtask/src/main.rs::EXPECTED_PROCEDURES`** at line ~390: uncomment `"snapshot.generate"` (move from comment to const string list). Leave `snapshot.list_recent` and `snapshot.copy_to_clipboard` commented (chunk #43 territory). Per security.md Session Additions 2026-05-10, couple this in the same commit as the consuming code.

CSS-side: outer `<div>` enters with `transform: scale(0.95)` → `scale(1.0)` + `opacity: 0 → 1` over 350ms; `className="motion-reduce:transition-none motion-reduce:duration-0"` ensures reduced-motion path. `__setProxyForTest()` seam for vi.mocked TauRPC client. Default token budget hardcoded to `'balanced'` for chunk #42 (per arch §Established Decisions Snapshot Curation Default); chunk #43 may add UI for budget selection.
