data.head: ### Chunk route#5: "Base CI workflow — matrix Linux/macOS/Windows + harden-runner SHA-pinned + cargo-nextest + cargo-llvm-cov coverage gate (≥75% line / ≥70% branch / ≥85% function)"

body: **Constraints across domains:**

- (security) `step-security/harden-runner` MUST be the FIRST step of every job in `ci.yml`, pinned by 40-char commit SHA in form `step-security/harden-runner@<40-char-SHA> # vX.Y.Z`; `egress-policy: audit` initially, promote to `block` after clean audit window (per security plan §Bootstrap phases `dep-security-ci-gate` + §API Security CI integration).

- (security) Every third-party GitHub Action MUST be pinned by 40-char commit SHA, NEVER by `@v2` / floating tag — applies to `actions/checkout`, `EmbarkStudios/cargo-deny-action`, `actions-rust-lang/audit`, matrix-runner setup actions, secret-scanning Action (per security plan §Anti-Patterns § Secrets — `tj-actions/changed-files` CVE-2025-30066 anchor).

- (security) `permissions:` MUST be set at workflow level to `contents: read`; per-job elevation reserved for publish step (chunk #46) and MUST NOT appear in `ci.yml` (per security plan §Anti-Patterns § Secrets + §Secret Management GitHub Environment scoping).

- (arch) Workspace member set LOCKED at exactly ten crate names — `ingest`, `buffer`, `viz`, `ui-bridge`, `snapshot`, `workspace-detector`, `plugins`, `mcp-server`, `pulse-app`, `xtask` — CI matrix MUST exercise via `--workspace`, never enumerate crate names per-job (per arch §Occupied Resources + §Project Intent reserved-names rule).

- (arch) Rust toolchain pin MUST honor `rust-toolchain.toml` at rustc 1.84+ Edition 2024 — every CI job resolves toolchain via the file, no workflow-level `rust-version` override (per arch §Stack and Technologies + route §Foundation chunk #1).

- (arch) CI command surface MUST be `cargo xtask <task>` — all shared CI logic that needs Rust lives in xtask so contributors run identical commands locally (per arch §Infrastructure Patterns CI/CD final paragraph).

- (arch) `ci.yml` canonical step order: `cargo fmt --check` → `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` → `cargo xtask test` → `cargo build --workspace` (release profile smoke); clippy `-D warnings` fails the build (per arch §Infrastructure Patterns CI/CD `ci.yml`).

- (arch) Module dependency direction MUST flow toward `pulse-app`; CI MUST NOT permit library crate to depend on binary; DAG with `pulse-app` as only root (per arch §Cross-cutting Patterns "Module dependency direction").

- (arch) Feature flag default-off baseline preserved by CI build matrix — `--features mcp-server` / `--features otap-ingest` enter build graph only when enabled; small-binary baseline AND feature-gated path both compile (per arch §Cross-cutting Patterns "Feature-gate hygiene").

- (tests) CI lint stage MUST run `cargo fmt --check` + `cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings`; unit/integration/E2E test stages MUST run `cargo nextest run --workspace --profile ci` with `--message-format libtest-json` for machine-parseable consumption (per test-plan §9 Pipeline structure).

- (tests) Coverage stage MUST emit `lcov.info` via `cargo llvm-cov nextest --workspace --lcov --output-path lcov.info --summary-only`; Quality Gates stage MUST parse it and fail when line<75% OR branch<70% OR function<85% (per test-plan §10 Coverage thresholds Standard tier).

- (tests) CI matrix MUST cover `[ubuntu-22.04, macos-latest, windows-latest]` × `rust: [stable]` with platform-specific includes (xvfb-run wrapper for Linux tauri-driver, aarch64+x86_64 Apple, x86_64-pc-windows-msvc); CI must respect `rust-toolchain.toml` pin (per test-plan §9 Matrix builds).

- (tests) Generated code (prost protobuf stubs, taurpc IPC bindings) and test fixtures MUST be excluded from coverage measurement via `cargo llvm-cov --exclude-files` (per test-plan §10 Cumulative across workspace).

- (tests) Build failure conditions MUST cause `exit != 0` for ALL of: any test failure, coverage below threshold, perf-budget regression (deferred to chunk #46), flaky test observed, lint/typecheck failure, `cargo deny check` violations (per test-plan §10 Build failure conditions + §11).

- (tests) Zero-flakiness is a HARD gate: no `--retries` flag, no auto-retry policy; first flake triggers immediate `#[ignore]` quarantine + root-cause investigation (per test-plan §10 Zero-flakiness budget + §11).

- (obs) CI matrix jobs MUST upload `~/.andromeda-pulse/logs/agent-latest.jsonl` as CI artifact (14-day GitHub default retention) on every job — fmt, clippy, `xtask test`, release build (per obs-plan §9 Telemetry artifact handling). Loss = agent-driven debugging blocked.

- (obs) CI subscriber init MUST attach default fields via `tracing_subscriber::fmt::Layer::with_default_fields([service.name, service.version, deployment.environment, ci.run.id, git.commit.sha])` where `deployment.environment` is `"dev"`/`"staging"`/`"production"`; `ci.run.id`=`$GITHUB_RUN_ID`; `git.commit.sha`=`$GITHUB_SHA` (per obs-plan §9 CI-specific default fields).

- (obs) CI workflow MUST include four obs SLO gates: (a) zero-spans gate — `xtask test` produces non-empty spans; (b) zero-panic gate — no `app.panic.fatal` span via jq; (c) heartbeat-gap gate — no >45s gap between consecutive `{ingest|buffer|viz|plugins}.tick` events (script at `xtask/ci/heartbeat-gap-check.sh`); (d) perf-budget p99 gates (snapshot ≤500ms, frame ≤33ms, buffer mem ≤512MB) (per obs-plan §10 CI gates).
- (obs) CI artifact retention MUST preserve curated snapshot markdown on test failure — uploads BOTH `agent-latest.jsonl` AND `~/.andromeda-pulse/snapshots/{ts}.md` if generated (per obs-plan §9).
- (obs) `cargo audit` + `cargo deny` step output is structured stderr via GitHub Actions `::error::` annotations — MUST NOT be wrapped into `tracing` JSON subscriber (per obs-plan §9 fmt/clippy row).

- (obs) Criterion bench JSON artifact (`target/criterion/<bench>/new/estimates.json`) upload step scaffolded for SLO regression detection — `xtask bench` output, sequenced before but does not replace coverage gate (per obs-plan §9 + §10).
- (a11y) ci.yml workflow file MUST remain single integration point so future `a11y-ci-gate-wire` (chunk #51) attaches without forking the pipeline (per a11y plan §9 CI Integration).

- (a11y) ci.yml job step structure MUST reuse the same `boot/run/status/cleanup/logs` 5-command harness contract that tests E2E owns — a11y assertions piggyback on that driver; no parallel a11y-only harness invocation in chunk #5 (per a11y plan §3 Focus Management Test Harness binding + §9).

- (a11y) Artifact upload step naming reserves room for future a11y artifact names (`a11y-axe-core-results.jsonl` / `a11y-lighthouse-results.json` / `a11y-pa11y-results.json` / `a11y-keyboard-focus-results.jsonl` / `a11y-violations-summary.json`); chunk #5 uses `actions/upload-artifact@v4` SHA-pinned for chunk #51 reuse without action-version drift (per a11y plan §3 CI Integration).

- (a11y) Per-PR regression detection plumbing for `a11y-violations-base` artifact via `actions/download-artifact@v4` SHA-pinned MUST be unblocked by chunk #5 workflow shape — allow PR-vs-base diff steps to slot in (per a11y plan §3 Per-PR regression detection).

- (a11y) CI-specific resource attributes MUST be settable via env in ci.yml: `service.name="com.andromeda.pulse"`, `deployment.environment="production"`, `ci.run.id=$GITHUB_RUN_ID`, `git.commit.sha=$GITHUB_SHA` — workflow-level or job env, since future a11y violation JSON tags with same attributes for cross-correlation (per a11y plan §9).

- (a11y) Performance budget for future a11y CI run is "Total a11y CI run + tests E2E < 10 min" (typical GitHub Actions budget) — chunk #5's tests/coverage gate must not consume the entire budget at matrix level (per a11y plan §10 Performance budget).
**Patterns to follow:**

- (security) SHA-pinning convention `<owner>/<repo>@<40-char-SHA> # vX.Y.Z` for every third-party Action — version comment alongside SHA so Dependabot bumps both atomically (per security plan §Bootstrap phases `dep-security-ci-gate`).
- (security) `egress-policy: audit` → `block` promotion ladder for `step-security/harden-runner` (per security plan §Bootstrap phases + §API Security harden-runner reference).

- (arch) **xtask as single CI task entry point**: release / sign / notarize / changelog / capability-drift are Rust binaries in same workspace; `ci.yml` invokes via `cargo xtask <task>` rather than re-implementing in YAML (per arch §Established Decisions [CI Task Runner] + existing `.cargo/config.toml` alias).

- (arch) **Release profile smoke in CI**: workspace default release profile is `lto = "thin"`, `codegen-units = 1`, `strip = true`; CI smoke build invokes this to catch profile-specific link errors before tag-time (per arch §Infrastructure Patterns Build system).

- (arch) **Two-workflow split with completion-trigger**: `release.yml` builds + signs + notarizes + publishes; `update-channels.yml` triggers on completion of `release.yml`; `ci.yml` is independent of those (per arch §Infrastructure Patterns CI/CD).

- (tests) JUnit XML report output: `cargo nextest --message-format junit --output-file target/nextest/junit.xml` consumed by `dorny/test-reporter` action for inline PR annotations (per test-plan §9 Test report format).
- (tests) Cache strategy: cache rust deps + rustup toolchain + webdriver per-stage with key `${{ runner.os }}-cargo` (per test-plan §9 Pipeline structure Cache column).

- (tests) Test profile separation by filter expressions: `--filter-expr 'not (integration or e2e)'` for unit, `--filter-expr 'integration'` for integration, `--filter-expr 'e2e'` for E2E — enables parallel CI stage execution with per-process isolation (per test-plan §9).

- (tests) nextest profile-driven config: `--profile ci` reads `nextest.toml` for retry/timeout/parallelism (zero retries, 60s default timeout); committed at `.config/nextest.toml` (per test-plan §10 + §3 Bootstrap phases).

- (tests) Existing `scripts/agent-run.{sh,ps1}` 5-command harness (chunk #4) — CI integration tests invoke this same harness for boot/run/status/cleanup/logs lifecycle; CI MUST NOT bypass with "test-only" alternative (per test-plan §3).

- (obs) **CI default-field pattern:** at CI subscriber init, extend workspace's standard `tracing-subscriber::fmt::Layer::with_default_fields([...])` with CI tuple — every emitted JSON line carries `ci.run.id`, `git.commit.sha`, env-aware `deployment.environment` without per-call boilerplate (per obs-plan §9 + §3).

- (obs) **Artifact triage workflow:** test failure → upload artifact → `gh run download <run_id> -n logs` → `jq '.[] | select(.level == "error")' logs/agent-latest.jsonl` → paste excerpt to LLM. Route#5 produces uploads compatible with this flow (per obs-plan §9 CI failure → artifact triage workflow).

- (obs) **Existing 5-command harness pattern**: CI invokes the same 5 commands devs use locally; CI's `xtask test` exit code validation enforces zero-spans gate (per obs-plan §10 first CI gate + existing `scripts/agent-run.sh`).

- (obs) **Per-job harden-runner first step + artifact-upload composition**: harden-runner egress-policy `audit` mode does NOT block `actions/upload-artifact` (SHA-pinned, GitHub-internal egress) (per obs-plan §11 CI ban "NEVER lose telemetry artifacts").

- (a11y) SHA-pinned third-party action references throughout ci.yml — when chunk #13 wires `@axe-core/playwright` and chunk #51 wires the a11y audit, SHA-pinning convention already in place; aligns with `.claude/rules/security.md` "Pin every third-party GitHub Action by 40-char commit SHA" (per a11y plan §10 Always-required SLO + project security rules).

- (a11y) Matrix `[linux, macos, windows]` lines up with a11y plan §1 SR per-platform expectation (NVDA Windows / VoiceOver macOS / Orca Linux); platform matrix lets future automated a11y assertions run on each Tauri-webview host (per a11y plan §1).

- (a11y) JSON-structured artifact emission shares format-discipline with future a11y violation JSON `{wcag_criterion, violation_type, severity, surface, selector, remediation, tool, tool_result_id}`; keep `upload-artifact` block generic (per a11y plan §3 Structured Violation JSON Schema + §9).
**Anti-patterns to avoid:**

- (security) NEVER reference any third-party GitHub Action by `@v2` / `@latest` / floating tag — pin by 40-char commit SHA only (per security plan §Anti-Patterns § Secrets; `tj-actions/changed-files` CVE-2025-30066 — 23k repos affected).

- (security) NEVER set `permissions: { contents: write }` at workflow level in `ci.yml` — workflow level is `contents: read`; write is per-job, publish-step only (per security plan §Anti-Patterns § Secrets).
- (arch) Do NOT rename, retire, or repurpose any of the ten reserved workspace crate names in `ci.yml` jobs/matrix entries (per arch §Design Philosophy + §Occupied Resources).

- (arch) Do NOT bind `cargo nextest run` or `cargo llvm-cov` to a hand-rolled cross-OS matrix that skips macOS or Windows — deployment model is Windows/macOS/Linux ONLY (per arch §Stack + §Infrastructure Patterns).

- (arch) Do NOT introduce a Node-side or non-cargo lint gate в `ci.yml` for the eight Rust library crates — `cargo fmt`/`cargo clippy` is the locked Code quality row; webview TypeScript lint is a separate path (per arch §Stack).
- (arch) Do NOT execute `cargo tauri build` in `ci.yml` — that's `release.yml`'s tag-driven scope (per arch §Infrastructure Patterns CI/CD `ci.yml` vs `release.yml` split).

- (tests) NEVER reference third-party GitHub Actions by floating tag — pin by 40-char commit SHA with version-tag comment trailer (per test-plan §11 CI; parallel to security plan's tj-actions anchor).

- (tests) NEVER set `--test-threads=1` or otherwise disable parallel test execution in CI; tests rely on cargo-nextest per-process isolation for port-binding integration tests (per test-plan §11 CI + §2).
- (tests) NEVER lower coverage thresholds in CI config to make a build pass — raise code quality instead; 75/70/85 numbers are the contract (per test-plan §11 + §10).

- (obs) NEVER use colored terminal output for CI parsing — CI artifacts MUST be structured (JSON) + machine-readable; `cargo test` default human output replaced with `cargo nextest --message-format json` (per obs-plan §11 CI anti-pattern row 4).

- (obs) NEVER use human-review-gated log analysis without machine-parseable export — blocks agent-driven debugging; CI failure triage MUST go through JSON artifact + `jq` pipeline (per obs-plan §11 Universal + §11 CI).
- (obs) NEVER skip snapshot generation on integration test failure (deferred to integration-test introduction chunk; route#5 lays artifact-upload primitive) (per obs-plan §11 CI row 3).
- (obs) NEVER define soft SLO budgets (no enforcement) — formal SLOs MUST trigger build/deploy failure when exhausted; the four §10 CI gates are hard fails (per obs-plan §11 SLO).

- (a11y) NEVER define a "soft" a11y CI gate at chunk #5 setup time — workflow defaults must allow chunk #51 to wire FAIL-fast a11y gates; do not introduce `continue-on-error: true` patterns at matrix level (per a11y plan §11 CI anti-patterns).

- (a11y) NEVER restrict ci.yml workflow `permissions:` so tightly at workflow level that PR-vs-base artifact comparison can't run — `contents: read` workflow-level + per-job elevation is the compliant shape (per a11y plan §3 + project security rules).
**Contract bindings:**

- **security ↔ tests**: CI security gate (cargo-audit/cargo-deny/cargo-auditable/gitleaks) shares `ci.yml` with cargo-nextest + cargo-llvm-cov coverage gate; both add steps to same matrix workflow. Tests owns nextest invocation + coverage gate; security owns supply-chain + secret-scanning + harden-runner first-step + workflow-level `permissions: contents: read`. Both depend on same SHA-pinning convention applied to every Action across the workflow.

- **arch ↔ tests**: ci.yml `cargo nextest run` MUST honor test-plan harness 5-command discipline; xtask wraps harness commands so CI and local development share invocation surface (per arch §Established Decisions [CI Task Runner]).

- **arch ↔ obs**: self-observation runtime is `tracing` ecosystem ONLY (no OTel SDK); CI builds verify "no OTel SDK linked into pulse-app" as workspace constraint that supply-chain gate enforces transitively (per arch §Established Decisions [Self-Observation]).

- **obs ↔ tests harness contract**: route#5 `cargo nextest` step is the runtime that emits the JSON log lines; verbatim 5-field schema `{timestamp, level, target, message, fields}` consumed by both — neither can drift unilaterally. Existing `xtask harness:status` (chunk #4) emits canonical health envelope; CI must validate schema didn't drift via `jq '.status == "ok" and .subsystems.{4 keys}'` assertion (existing harness:status shape gate elevates from local to CI-enforced).

- **obs ↔ tests SLO gates**: route#5 coverage gate (≥75% line / ≥70% branch / ≥85% function) is tests-domain threshold; obs gates (zero-panic / heartbeat-gap / perf-budget p99) are obs-domain — both fail CI build, both compose into same job graph. `xtask` invocation surface unifies them: `xtask ci-gates` (or per-gate subcommands) emits structured exit codes consumed by GitHub Actions step.

- **obs ↔ arch CI/CD**: arch §Infrastructure Patterns "matrix over Linux/macOS/Windows" + §Standard Contracts "binding contract" flow into route#5 — same JSON schema must serialize identically across all three OS runners; cross-platform schema parity verified (a test failing on macOS but not Linux due to subscriber-format drift = obs regression, not test regression).

- **a11y ↔ tests**: ci.yml shape established by chunk #5 must host both `cargo nextest` test gate AND future `npm run test:a11y` gate on same workflow, sharing 5-command harness — a11y assertions reuse tests' E2E driver (per a11y plan §3 + §9). Chunks #5/#6 own the workflow shell; chunk #13 wires the deps; chunk #51 wires the gate.

- **a11y ↔ obs**: a11y violation JSON emissions tag same resource attributes as obs traces (`service.name`, `deployment.environment`, `ci.run.id`, `git.commit.sha`); chunk #5 ci.yml sets these as workflow/job env so future a11y emitter and chunk #7 tracing harness consume same source-of-truth (per a11y plan §9 CI-specific resource attributes "set via CI env per obs Section 3 binding").
**Acceptance criteria contributions:**

- (security) `ci.yml` workflow-level `permissions:` block contains exactly `contents: read` with no other entries — `grep -E "^permissions:" .github/workflows/ci.yml` followed by `yq .permissions.contents .github/workflows/ci.yml` returns `read`.

- (security) Every third-party Action in `.github/workflows/*.yml` is pinned by 40-char SHA — `grep -E "^\s+uses:\s+[^@]+@[a-f0-9]{40}\s+#" .github/workflows/*.yml` matches every `uses:` line; inverse `grep -E "^\s+uses:\s+[^@]+@v[0-9]+\s*$" .github/workflows/*.yml` returns empty.

- (security) `step-security/harden-runner` is the first non-`uses: actions/checkout` step in every job — verified by parsing `jobs.<name>.steps[]` arrays (harden-runner appears at index 0 OR 1 if checkout precedes).

- (arch) `ci.yml` matrix runs the locked 4-step sequence `cargo fmt --check` → `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` → `cargo xtask test` → `cargo build --workspace --release` against Linux + macOS + Windows runners on every PR and push to main, with clippy `-D warnings` failing the build (per arch §Infrastructure Patterns `ci.yml`).

- (arch) All Rust-side CI commands MUST go through `cargo xtask <task>` (xtask binary in workspace), not raw cargo invocations distinct from local-dev — verifiable: `grep -E '^\s*cargo (audit|deny|nextest|llvm-cov)' .github/workflows/ci.yml` finds each only inside xtask invocation OR documents deviation in plan.

- (arch) Workspace boundary discipline holds: no library crate transitively depends on `pulse-app`; DAG with `pulse-app` as only root — verifiable: `cargo tree --workspace --invert -p pulse-app` returns only direct workspace consumers.

- (arch) CI build smoke uses default features (mcp-server / otap-ingest OFF) on at least one matrix entry per OS, AND `--features mcp-server` ON on at least one Linux entry — small-binary baseline AND feature-gated path both compile.

- (tests) `cargo nextest run --workspace --profile ci` runs successfully on all three matrix runners (ubuntu-22.04 / macos-latest / windows-latest) with exit code 0; CI artifact `target/nextest/junit.xml` is uploaded.

- (tests) `cargo llvm-cov nextest --workspace --lcov --output-path lcov.info --summary-only` emits `lcov.info`; Quality Gates stage parses it and fails the build when line<75% OR branch<70% OR function<85% (Standard tier per §10). At chunk #5 land time the Foundation epoch may not yet hit thresholds — gate enforcement MUST NOT be relaxed (warn-only mode permissible only if explicitly documented as deferred-to-route#X gate-flip).

- (tests) Zero CI workflow files reference any third-party action by floating tag — `grep -E "uses: [^/]+/[^@]+@v[0-9]+$" .github/workflows/` returns empty; every external action pinned by 40-char SHA with `# vX.Y.Z` comment trailer.

- (tests) CI cache hit on dependent rerun (cargo registry + rustup + cargo-nextest binary cache); first-run cold build measured; cache key `${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}` reused across stages.

- (tests) `cargo nextest --no-tests=pass` is honored at chunk #5 land time (Foundation epoch has 0 tests); workflow does not fail just because no tests exist yet — but gate flips to `--no-tests=fail` once chunk #15 (first OTLP receiver tests) lands.

- (obs) CI matrix jobs upload `agent-latest.jsonl` as artifact named `logs-{os}` on every run — verifiable: `gh run download {run_id} -n logs-linux` returns non-empty JSON file with valid 5-field schema.

- (obs) CI subscriber init attaches `ci.run.id` + `git.commit.sha` + env-aware `deployment.environment` as default fields — verifiable: `jq -e 'all(.fields | has("ci.run.id") and has("git.commit.sha") and has("deployment.environment"))' agent-latest.jsonl` returns true.
- (obs) Zero-panic gate enforced — `jq '.[] | select(.level == "ERROR" and .target == "app.panic.fatal")' agent-latest.jsonl | grep -q .` exits 1 (no match), CI step fails build if exits 0.

- (obs) Heartbeat-gap gate scaffolded at `xtask/ci/heartbeat-gap-check.sh` (or `.ps1`) — script parses `timestamp` field of `{ingest|buffer|viz|plugins}.tick` events, asserts max consecutive delta ≤45000ms; gate INACTIVE in route#5 (no subsystems yet); script + CI step skeleton lands here.

- (obs) Zero-spans gate — `xtask test` step exit code = 0 only if `agent-latest.jsonl` contains ≥1 line; empty log file fails CI build. At chunk #5 with no tests yet, validates harness scaffold itself emits boot-time spans (`app.boot` minimum).

- (a11y) ci.yml workflow file from chunk #5 contains workflow-level env block setting `service.name`, `deployment.environment="production"`, `ci.run.id`, `git.commit.sha` — verifiable via `grep -E 'service\.name|deployment\.environment|ci\.run\.id|git\.commit\.sha' .github/workflows/ci.yml` returning all 4 keys.

- (a11y) ci.yml workflow `permissions:` block sets `contents: read` at workflow level and chunk #6 `production-release` Environment does NOT gate PR-time CI artifact upload — verifiable by inspecting workflow YAML (workflow-level `permissions: contents: read`; release Environment scoped only to release.yml/release-job, not per-PR ci.yml jobs).

- (a11y) ci.yml uses `actions/upload-artifact@<40-char-SHA>` and `actions/download-artifact@<40-char-SHA>` SHA-pinned so chunk #51 can reuse without action-version drift — verifiable: `grep -E 'actions/(upload|download)-artifact@[0-9a-f]{40}' .github/workflows/ci.yml` matching SHA-pinned references.

title: Chunk route#6: "Supply-chain CI gates + secret-scanning — cargo-audit/deny/auditable + Dependabot + gitleaks + GitHub Environment production-release"

data.head: ### Chunk route#6: "Supply-chain CI gates + secret-scanning — cargo-audit/deny/auditable + Dependabot + gitleaks + GitHub Environment production-release"

body: **Constraints across domains:**

- (security) `cargo-audit` 0.22.1 + `cargo-deny` 0.19.4 + `cargo-auditable` 0.7.4 wired as CI steps; `deny.toml` at workspace root MUST include `[bans] multiple-versions = "deny"` + `[licenses]` SPDX allowlist + `[sources]` restricted to `crates-io` (no git or registry overrides) (per security plan §Bootstrap phases `dep-audit-tooling-install` — load-bearing: without `multiple-versions = "deny"`, `cargo deny check bans` does NOT detect documented `tonic 0.14↔opentelemetry-otlp 0.31` duplicate).

- (security) `cargo deny check bans licenses sources` failure on `tonic 0.14↔0.13` duplicate MUST stay enforced — explicit `[[bans.deny]]` entry naming `tonic` until Inherited Defaults reconciliation lands; this duplicate-version check is canary for OTLP-receiver/opentelemetry-otlp duplicate (per security plan §Anti-Patterns § Universal + §Dependency Security Pinning).

- (security) `.github/dependabot.yml` MUST configure BOTH `cargo` and `github-actions` ecosystems against `main` so Dependabot bumps third-party Action SHAs + version comments together with crate updates (per security plan §Dependency Security Update policy + §Bootstrap phases).

- (security) Secret-scanning step MUST run pre-commit (via `.pre-commit-config.yaml` pinned tool release) AND per-PR (CI step in `ci.yml`); chosen tool (gitleaks per route signal) referenced by 40-char commit SHA; `.gitignore` MUST cover `*.p12`, `*.pem`, `*.cer`, `.env*`, `*.key`, `~/.tauri/*.key`; build fails on detected secret (per security plan §Bootstrap phases `secret-scanning-ci-gate` + §Secret Management).

- (security) All code-signing secrets (Azure Key Vault federation creds, Apple Developer ID creds, Tauri updater Minisign private key, Homebrew tap / Scoop bucket push tokens) MUST live in GitHub Environment named `production-release` with manual approval gate — NEVER as plain repository secrets (per security plan §Secret Management + §Anti-Patterns § Secrets).

- (security) `cargo-auditable` wraps `tauri-action` build in chunk #46; in this chunk group, install + verify availability so post-release CVE-disclosure scans can identify exact crate versions per release (per security plan §Dependency Security Supply chain integrity Minimal-tier).

- (security) Critical CVE response SLA: 72h from public advisory disclosure to Dependabot PR merge + tagged patch release; CI infrastructure landed in #5/#6 must support this cadence (per security plan §Dependency Security Critical CVE response SLA).

- (arch) Supply-chain duplicate-detection MUST surface `tonic 0.14↔tonic 0.13 (via opentelemetry-otlp 0.31)` mismatch as CI failure — `cargo deny check bans` is the enforcement vehicle and the canary for OTLP-receiver/opentelemetry-otlp duplicate (per arch §Established Decisions [Backend Framework — OTLP receiver] caveat + §Inherited Defaults open-question paragraph).

- (arch) `cargo-deny` rules added at supply-chain gate — `bans` rules added when boundary actually breached, not from day 1 — but the gate MUST be wired now so future breaches FAIL the build (per arch §Established Decisions [Module Boundaries] deferral note).

- (arch) Code-signing secrets and Apple Developer ID credentials MUST live ONLY in GitHub Actions encrypted secrets and Azure Key Vault — never in repo, never in non-production-release Environment scope (per arch §Cross-cutting Patterns "Config management" final clause).

- (tests) `cargo deny check bans` MUST run in CI on every PR — `tonic 0.14↔opentelemetry-otlp 0.31 (pinned 0.13)` duplicate is documented canary the bans rule catches (per test-plan §9 Cargo deny enforcement + §11 "NEVER skip cargo deny check bans").

- (obs) Secret-scanning configuration (gitleaks step) MUST NOT log scanner findings verbatim into JSON log file — secret patterns matched in source code are themselves secrets; gitleaks output redirects to separate scoped artifact, not into `agent-latest.jsonl` (per obs-plan §11 PII Scrubbing universal "default-deny" + §8 environment variable convention).

- (obs) Criterion bench JSON artifact upload step `target/criterion/` scaffolded in ci.yml as non-blocking step; active enforcement deferred until first criterion bench lands (Epoch 6 snapshot or Epoch 5 webgpu) (per obs-plan §9 + §10 perf-budget budgets table).

- (a11y) Dependabot config MUST include a `npm` ecosystem entry alongside `cargo` and `github-actions` — webview at `pulse-app/ui/` will host a11y dev stack (chunk #13); per a11y plan §3.5 Bootstrap phases all 9 a11y bootstrap items are npm-installed; without Dependabot npm watcher, a11y deps drift unsupervised between security advisories.

- (a11y) GitHub Environment `production-release` MUST NOT gate a11y CI artifact upload; a11y artifacts are PR-time CI gates (not release-time) and run on every PR pre-merge with `permissions: contents: read` only (per a11y plan §10 Build / deploy failure conditions + §3 CI gate).
**Patterns to follow:**

- (security) `cargo audit` invocation via `actions-rust-lang/audit` (SHA-pinned); `cargo deny check bans licenses sources` invocation via `EmbarkStudios/cargo-deny-action` (SHA-pinned); both fail build on any finding above warning severity (per security plan §Dependency Security CI integration).

- (security) `deny.toml` skip-list pattern (from session learnings): each Tauri major+minor bump introduces transitive duplicates — one-line provenance comments under `[bans] skip`; do NOT relax `multiple-versions = "deny"`; `tonic 0.14↔0.13` MUST stay outside skip list (per `.claude/rules/security.md` §Session Additions 2026-05-03).

- (security) Existing session-handoff record shows `deny.toml skip-list +4: ctor + windows-core + windows-result + windows-strings` — pattern continues for #6: every duplicate added by Tauri/plugin minor-version bump gets one-line provenance comment, never relaxes deny rule.

- (arch) **GitHub Environment + manual approval gate**: signing secrets, Apple Developer ID, Tauri updater Minisign private key MUST be in GitHub Environment `production-release`; non-release-tag CI workflows MUST NOT request the environment, so secrets cannot leak through PR checks (per arch §Cross-cutting Patterns "Config management" + route §Foundation chunk #6 explicit reference).

- (arch) **Cargo workspace lockfile + cargo-deny pairing**: arch §Established Decisions [Module Boundaries] defers `cargo-deny` `bans` rules until breach, but `cargo audit` + `cargo deny check bans licenses sources` is the named pattern for supply-chain gates; existing `deny.toml` with multi-version skip-list (ctor / windows-core / windows-result / windows-strings) is the precedent.
**Anti-patterns to avoid:**

- (security) NEVER store the Azure Key Vault service principal as long-lived GitHub Actions secret — GitHub OIDC federation only; this constraint shapes how `production-release` Environment is configured (per security plan §Anti-Patterns § Secrets + §Secret Management Storage).

- (security) NEVER place Azure Key Vault credentials, Apple Developer ID credentials, or Tauri updater Minisign private key outside `production-release` Environment with manual approval gate — even when actual signing automation lands in chunk #46, Environment + secret scaffolding MUST be set up correctly here (per security plan §Anti-Patterns § Secrets).

- (security) NEVER relax `[bans] multiple-versions = "deny"` in `deny.toml` to absorb a duplicate — add one-line skip-list entry with provenance comment, OR fix upstream duplicate; unconditional setting is what catches `tonic 0.14↔0.13` (per `.claude/rules/security.md` §Session Additions 2026-05-03).

- (arch) Do NOT add a `cargo-deny` `multiple-versions = "deny"` rule that exempts `tonic 0.14↔0.13` duplicate — that pair is the canary for OTLP-receiver/opentelemetry-otlp version mismatch and MUST stay outside skip list (per arch §Established Decisions + §Inherited Defaults + existing `.claude/rules/security.md` Session Additions).

- (tests) NEVER skip `cargo deny check bans` in the CI workflow — duplicate-version detection is the only line of defense against tonic 0.14↔0.13 transitive duplicate that breaks OTLP receiver build (per test-plan §11 + §9).

- (a11y) NEVER scope cargo-audit/cargo-deny/gitleaks so they treat future `pulse-app/ui/package.json` lockfile as banned vendor dep — npm-side a11y tooling lives there starting chunk #13; supply-chain gates must allow node_modules audit (e.g., via `npm audit` step or Dependabot npm ecosystem) without conflicting with cargo-deny `bans` rules (per a11y plan §3.5 Bootstrap phases).
**Contract bindings:**

- **security ↔ obs**: per security plan §Bootstrap phases ordering, `error-sanitization-wire` + `logging-redaction-wire` follow `dep-security-ci-gate`; chunks #7 (tracing self-observation) + #8 (PII scrubbing) consume JSON log subscriber landed in chunk #4 and apply §Logging & Monitoring NEVER-log list. CI gate landed in #6 enforces `cargo deny check bans` before #7's `tracing` deps land — duplicate prevention happens at supply-chain level, not at obs runtime layer.

- **security ↔ arch**: `production-release` Environment + Azure Key Vault federation + Tauri updater Minisign keypair scaffolding from chunk #3 (already complete — ACTIVE scope) sets up secret custody model that #6 wires into `ci.yml`/`release.yml`/`update-channels.yml`; DEFERRED items (paid Azure Key Vault Premium SKU, EV cert, Apple Developer ID enrollment, GitHub OIDC federation trust) become release blockers but `production-release` Environment scaffolding still lands in #6 (per route Decisions Log 2026-05-03 chunk #3 scope split).

- **arch ↔ security**: supply-chain gates wire security plan's bootstrap phases (dep-audit-tooling-install / dep-security-ci-gate); arch contributes workspace shape these gates traverse (10 crates, default-off feature flags, locked module boundary direction). Both depend on `cargo deny check bans licenses sources` being named enforcement vehicle for LOCKED `tonic` version pair.

- **tests ↔ security (chunk #6)**: `cargo deny check` runs in BOTH tests Quality Gates stage (build failure condition per §9) AND security supply-chain stage (chunk #6 primary scope) — same command, single invocation point preferred to avoid double-failure obscuring root cause.

- **obs ↔ security PII scrubbing**: gitleaks output and `cargo audit` output ARE potential PII surfaces (matched secrets, vulnerable-version package names that may correspond to internal forks); `*_SECRET / *_TOKEN / *_KEY` redaction convention (obs-plan §8 row 6) MUST extend to scanner output paths — scanner artifacts scoped to ephemeral CI logs, not durable `agent-latest.jsonl`.

- **a11y ↔ supply-chain (chunk #6)**: Dependabot npm ecosystem MUST be configured so 9 a11y npm dev-deps from a11y plan §3.5 Bootstrap phases (`@axe-core/playwright`, `lighthouse`, `pa11y`, `pa11y-ci`, `colorjs.io`, `focus-trap-react`, `tabbable`, `react-aria-components`, `motion`, `eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y`) get auto-PR'd on advisory; cargo-audit/deny remain Rust-only and do not gate npm a11y deps.
**Acceptance criteria contributions:**
- (security) `cargo deny check bans licenses sources` passes on a clean checkout — exits 0 on PR.
- (security) `cargo audit` passes on a clean checkout — exits 0 on PR; any finding above warning severity blocks the build.

- (security) `deny.toml` contains `[bans]` with `multiple-versions = "deny"` AND explicit `[[bans.deny]]` entry naming `tonic` (or equivalent until 0.14↔0.13 duplicate lands) — `tomlq '.bans["multiple-versions"]' deny.toml` returns `"deny"`.

- (security) `.gitignore` covers `*.p12`, `*.pem`, `*.cer`, `.env*`, `*.key`, `~/.tauri/*.key` — `for p in '*.p12' '*.pem' '*.cer' '.env*' '*.key'; do grep -F "$p" .gitignore || exit 1; done` returns 0.
- (security) `gitleaks` (or chosen scanner) runs as CI step pinned by 40-char SHA AND as pre-commit hook in `.pre-commit-config.yaml` — both invocations resolve to same tool release.

- (security) `.github/dependabot.yml` configures both `cargo` and `github-actions` ecosystems against `main` — `yq '.updates[].package-ecosystem' .github/dependabot.yml` returns set `{cargo, github-actions}`.

- (security) GitHub Environment `production-release` exists with manual approval gate — verified via `gh api repos/:owner/:repo/environments` returning named environment with `protection_rules` containing `required_reviewers` rule. (Scaffolding only at this chunk; population with paid Azure Key Vault / EV cert / Apple Dev ID secrets is DEFERRED per chunk #3 scope split.)
- (security) `cargo-auditable` 0.7.4 is installed and available in CI; verified via `cargo auditable --version` step output before build step.

- (arch) `cargo deny check bans licenses sources` runs on every PR and surfaces ANY `tonic 0.14↔0.13` duplicate as build failure — duplicate canary is NOT in `deny.toml` skip-list (verifiable: `cargo deny check bans` output contains zero `tonic` lines OR fails build with expected canary message).

- (arch) `production-release` GitHub Environment is referenced exclusively from `release.yml` and `update-channels.yml` (tag-triggered) — `ci.yml` jobs do NOT request the environment, so signing secrets cannot enter PR check execution (verifiable: `grep -l "environment: production-release" .github/workflows/` returns only release.yml / update-channels.yml).
- (tests) `cargo deny check bans licenses sources` runs in CI on every PR and exit code 0; banned-crate violation (including documented tonic 0.14↔0.13 duplicate) fails build (per §9 + §10).

- (obs) Gitleaks output + cargo-audit + cargo-deny output do NOT leak into `agent-latest.jsonl` artifact (verifiable: `jq -e 'select(.fields.message | test("password|token|api_key|.*_SECRET"; "i"))' agent-latest.jsonl` returns empty per obs-plan §8 PII Scrubbing default-deny + §11).
- (obs) Criterion bench artifact upload step `target/criterion/` scaffolded in `ci.yml` as non-blocking step (per obs-plan §9 row 3); active enforcement deferred until first criterion bench lands.

- (a11y) Dependabot `dependabot.yml` includes `package-ecosystem: "npm"` entry pointing at `pulse-app/ui/` (or webview package.json directory) — verifiable by `grep -A3 'package-ecosystem: "npm"' .github/dependabot.yml` matching directory under webview source root (per a11y plan §3.5 Bootstrap phases).
| Domain | Chunks covered | Extract size |
| security | route#5, route#6 | 58 lines |
| arch | route#5, route#6 | 52 lines |
| tests | route#5 (fully), route#6 (partially via cargo-deny binding) | 49 lines |
| obs | route#5 (fully), route#6 (gitleaks + criterion artifact) | 50 lines |
| a11y | route#5 (workflow-shell seams), route#6 (Dependabot npm) | 45 lines |
| design | none (out-of-domain) | 17 lines |
| layouts | none (out-of-domain) | 18 lines |
Out-of-domain count: 2 / 7 (within sanity threshold per phase-1/validation.md Check 1.B ≤3).
Aggregated bindings spanning chunks; reciprocity status from per-extract Contract bindings sections.

- **obs ↔ tests harness contract** (chunk #5): both extracts acknowledge — obs binds to `cargo nextest` JSON log emission + 5-field schema; tests binds to obs §3 status endpoint + log format. **Reciprocal — consistent**.

- **security ↔ tests CI gate** (chunks #5 + #6): both extracts acknowledge — security owns supply-chain steps + harden-runner + workflow-level permissions; tests acknowledges `cargo deny check` shared invocation point and SHA-pinning convention. **Reciprocal — consistent**.

- **arch ↔ tests xtask invocation** (chunk #5): arch owns `cargo xtask <task>` as CI command surface; tests acknowledges via `cargo xtask test` resolving to harness 5-command discipline. **Reciprocal — consistent**.

- **arch ↔ obs self-observation** (chunk #5): arch declares "no OTel SDK in pulse-app" workspace constraint; obs binds CI artifact emission to `tracing` ecosystem ONLY (no OTel SDK). **Reciprocal — consistent**.

- **a11y ↔ tests harness sharing** (chunk #5): a11y declares ci.yml shape must host both `cargo nextest` AND future `npm run test:a11y` on same workflow sharing 5-command harness; tests extract mentions "a11y CI gate (axe-core/Lighthouse/pa11y) shares the CI workflow runner from chunk #5 but lands per route#46 — chunk #5 must structure stages so a11y assertions can be added as additional matrix job without rewiring harness contract". **Reciprocal — consistent**.

- **a11y ↔ obs CI resource attributes** (chunk #5): a11y declares CI-specific resource attributes set via env (`service.name`, `deployment.environment`, `ci.run.id`, `git.commit.sha`); obs declares same default fields at subscriber init. **Reciprocal — consistent**.

- **a11y ↔ supply-chain Dependabot npm** (chunk #6): a11y mandates Dependabot `package-ecosystem: "npm"` for future a11y dev-deps; security extract mandates `cargo` + `github-actions` ecosystems but is silent on npm. **Unilateral — a11y-only**; orchestrator notes for plan.md: include npm in dependabot.yml per a11y binding (compatible with security ecosystems list — additive, not in conflict).

- **obs ↔ security PII scrubbing for scanner output** (chunk #6): obs declares gitleaks/cargo-audit/cargo-deny output MUST NOT leak into `agent-latest.jsonl`; security plan §Logging & Monitoring NEVER-log list provides the underlying redaction discipline. **Reciprocal — consistent** (obs binds to security's logging discipline).

- **security ↔ arch GitHub Environment** (chunk #6): both extracts cite `production-release` Environment with manual approval gate; security adds OIDC federation + Apple Developer ID specifics. **Reciprocal — consistent**.

data.head: # Phase 4 Plan — chunks route#5..route#6: "Base CI workflow + Supply-chain CI gates / secret-scanning"

body: _Generated by /andromeda-phase Phase 4. Read by /andromeda-implement. Manual edits between runs are fine; do not edit during /implement run._
- **Phase number:** 4

- **Route chunks covered:**
  - route#5 "Base CI workflow — matrix Linux/macOS/Windows + harden-runner SHA-pinned + cargo-nextest + cargo-llvm-cov coverage gate (≥75% line / ≥70% branch / ≥85% function)"
  - route#6 "Supply-chain CI gates + secret-scanning — cargo-audit/deny/auditable + Dependabot + gitleaks + GitHub Environment production-release"
- **Epoch:** Foundation (epoch 1 of 8)

These two chunks materialize the project's CI substrate from cold-start: `.github/workflows/ci.yml` with a Linux/macOS/Windows matrix that runs the locked `cargo fmt → cargo clippy → cargo xtask test → cargo build --release` sequence on every PR and push to main, plus a coverage gate via `cargo-llvm-cov nextest` at the Standard tier (≥75% line / ≥70% branch / ≥85% function), plus the four supply-chain gates (`cargo-audit`, `cargo-deny check bans licenses sources`, `cargo-auditable`, `gitleaks` secret-scanning) wired into the same workflow with `step-security/harden-runner` as the first step of every job, every third-party Action SHA-pinned by 40-char commit, workflow-level `permissions: contents: read`, and `.github/dependabot.yml` configuring `cargo` + `github-actions` + `npm` ecosystems.

The chunks share a single workflow file because they're install-style with a shared milestone — chunk #5 lays the matrix shell + nextest + coverage gate + obs SLO scaffolding; chunk #6 layers in the supply-chain steps + Dependabot + gitleaks (per-PR + pre-commit) + GitHub Environment `production-release` scaffolding. The Environment is created as a named container with manual approval gate; population with paid components (Azure Key Vault Premium SKU, EV cert, Apple Developer ID enrollment, GitHub OIDC federation trust) remains DEFERRED per the chunk #3 scope split (see `docs/runbooks/production-release-environment.md` runbook landing in this phase).

Everything Rust-touching goes through `cargo xtask <task>` per arch §Infrastructure Patterns CI/CD ("All shared CI logic that needs Rust lives in the xtask crate so contributors can run identical commands locally"); the workflow YAML invokes `cargo xtask test` / `cargo xtask audit` / `cargo xtask deny-bans` / `cargo xtask ci-gates` rather than inlining cargo invocations. The obs zero-panic + zero-spans CI gates ride on the existing `tracing` JSON subscriber landed in chunk #4 (no new subscriber wiring at this phase — `with_default_fields([service.name, service.version, deployment.environment, ci.run.id, git.commit.sha])` is deferred to chunk #7 Tracing self-observation harness; chunk #5 only sets the workflow-level env so chunk #7 can read them).

1. Create `.github/workflows/ci.yml` with:
   - `name: ci` + `on: { pull_request: {}, push: { branches: [main] } }`
   - Workflow-level `permissions: { contents: read }` (per security plan §Anti-Patterns § Secrets — no other permission entries).
   - Workflow-level `env:` with `ANDROMEDA_PULSE_DATA_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/andromeda-pulse-ci-data`, `SERVICE_NAME: com.andromeda.pulse`, `DEPLOYMENT_ENVIRONMENT: production`, `CI_RUN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}`, `GIT_COMMIT_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}` (per a11y extract §9 CI-specific resource attributes — chunk #5 lays env, chunk #7 wires consumption).
   - One `lint-test-build` job × matrix `[ubuntu-22.04, macos-latest, windows-latest]` with `runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}`.
   - First job step: `step-security/harden-runner@<40-char-SHA> # vX.Y.Z` with `egress-policy: audit` (promote to `block` after clean window per security plan §Bootstrap phases `dep-security-ci-gate`).
   - Subsequent steps in canonical order: `actions/checkout@<40-char-SHA>` → `dtolnay/rust-toolchain@<40-char-SHA>` (respects `rust-toolchain.toml`'s 1.95.0 pin — no `rust-version` workflow override) → `Swatinem/rust-cache@<40-char-SHA>` (cache key `${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}`) → `taiki-e/install-action@<40-char-SHA>` (or equivalent SHA-pinned installer) for `cargo-nextest` 0.9.x + `cargo-llvm-cov` 0.8.x → `cargo fmt --check` → `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` → `cargo xtask test` → `cargo build --workspace --release`.
   - Linux-only matrix entry adds a second build with `--features mcp-server` to verify feature-gated path (per arch §Cross-cutting Patterns "Feature-gate hygiene").
   - Coverage step (Linux-only — single host suffices for line/branch/function metrics): `cargo xtask test:coverage` (wraps `cargo llvm-cov nextest --workspace --lcov --output-path lcov.info --summary-only --no-tests=pass --exclude-files "target/**" --exclude-files "**/build.rs"`) followed by a parsing step that reads `lcov.info` and fails when line<75% OR branch<70% OR function<85%. With 0 tests in the workspace today, `--no-tests=pass` ensures the gate is structurally active but trivially passing; the gate becomes binding when first tests land in chunk #15.
   - Obs CI gate steps after `xtask test`: `cargo xtask ci-gates` (composite invocation) — runs zero-panic gate (`! jq -e '.[] | select(.level == "ERROR" and .target == "app.panic.fatal")' agent-latest.jsonl | grep -q .`); zero-spans gate (`agent-latest.jsonl` non-empty); heartbeat-gap gate (calls `xtask/ci/heartbeat-gap-check.{sh,ps1}`, INACTIVE no-op until first subsystem ticks at chunk #16+); perf-budget no-op until first criterion bench. All gates fail the build on violation.
   - Artifact upload steps: `actions/upload-artifact@<40-char-SHA>` uploads `${{ env.ANDROMEDA_PULSE_DATA_DIR }}/logs/agent-latest.jsonl` as `logs-${{ runner.os }}` (always); `target/nextest/junit.xml` as `nextest-${{ runner.os }}` (always); `lcov.info` as `coverage-linux` (Linux only); placeholder for `target/criterion/` (per obs extract — non-blocking, deferred enforcement).

2. Modify `.config/nextest.toml` to extend `[profile.ci]`:
   - Add `retries = 0` (per test-plan §10 Zero-flakiness HARD gate — first flake triggers `#[ignore]` quarantine, NOT auto-retry).
   - Add `slow-timeout = { period = "60s", terminate-after = 3 }` for cross-OS reliability.
   - Add `final-status-level = "all"` for machine-parseable agent consumption (per tests extract §9 Pipeline structure).
   - Preserve existing `fail-fast = false`.

3. Modify `xtask/src/main.rs` to extend the `Cmd` enum with new variants following the existing `harness:status` kebab-or-colon naming convention (per research.md §Patterns detected):
   - `Cmd::Test` — `#[command(name = "test")]` — wraps `cargo nextest run --workspace --profile ci --no-tests=pass --message-format libtest-json`.
   - `Cmd::TestCoverage` — `#[command(name = "test:coverage")]` — wraps `cargo llvm-cov nextest --workspace --lcov --output-path lcov.info --summary-only --no-tests=pass`.
   - `Cmd::CiGates` — `#[command(name = "ci-gates")]` — composite zero-panic + zero-spans + heartbeat-gap + perf-budget verification; reads `agent-latest.jsonl` via `serde_json` (already a workspace dep) for in-process parsing (cross-OS — Windows runners may not ship `jq`).
   - Each new variant uses `tokio::process::Command` to shell out to cargo subcommands; forwards stdout/stderr; returns `ExitCode` matching child exit.

4. Create `xtask/ci/heartbeat-gap-check.sh` (POSIX) + `xtask/ci/heartbeat-gap-check.ps1` (PowerShell) per the verification-harness rule binding. Both scripts:
   - Read `agent-latest.jsonl` from `$ANDROMEDA_PULSE_DATA_DIR/logs/` or fallback path.
   - Parse `timestamp` field of records matching `target == "{ingest|buffer|viz|plugins}.tick"`.
   - Compute consecutive timestamp deltas; assert max ≤45000ms.
   - Exit 0 if no tick records found (INACTIVE state — chunk #5 has no subsystems emitting ticks yet); exit 1 if any gap >45s.
   - Per obs extract: "gate is INACTIVE in route#5 (no subsystems exist yet at chunk #5; activated when ingest crate ships in Epoch 2) but the script + CI step skeleton lands here."

1. Create `.github/dependabot.yml` with three ecosystems:
   - `package-ecosystem: "cargo"` directory `/`, schedule weekly Mondays, `open-pull-requests-limit: 10`, `commit-message: { prefix: "chore(deps)" }`.
   - `package-ecosystem: "github-actions"` directory `/`, same cadence/limit.
   - `package-ecosystem: "npm"` directory `/pulse-app/ui`, same cadence/limit (pre-stub for chunk #13 a11y dev stack — per a11y extract §3.5 Bootstrap phases binding).

2. Add supply-chain steps to `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (single-job-per-OS matrix, after the build steps from chunk #5):
   - `cargo xtask audit` step — wraps `cargo audit` (any finding above warning severity blocks the build).
   - `cargo xtask deny-bans` step — wraps `cargo deny check bans licenses sources` (catches `tonic 0.14↔0.13` duplicate when ingest body lands in chunk #16+).
   - `cargo auditable build --workspace --release` invocation in the release-build smoke step (replaces vanilla `cargo build` per security extract §Dependency Security Supply chain integrity Minimal-tier — `cargo-auditable` 0.7.4 wraps the build to embed dep-tree as JSON section in binary).
   - Output for both audit + deny goes to GitHub Annotations via `::error::` syntax (per obs extract §9 fmt/clippy row pattern); MUST NOT wrap into the `tracing` JSON subscriber.
   - Place these steps before `actions/upload-artifact` so failures fast-fail before artifact emission.

3. Modify `xtask/src/main.rs` to add supply-chain wrappers (continuing from step #3 above):
   - `Cmd::Audit` — `#[command(name = "audit")]` — wraps `cargo audit` against RustSec advisory DB.
   - `Cmd::DenyBans` — `#[command(name = "deny-bans")]` — wraps `cargo deny check bans licenses sources`.
   - Each shells out via `tokio::process::Command` with stdout/stderr passthrough.

4. Modify `deny.toml` per research.md §Files к modify open question #1 resolution (option b):
   - Add `[[bans.deny]]` entry: `{ name = "tonic", version = "<0.14" }` with provenance comment naming the OTLP-receiver/opentelemetry-otlp duplicate canary (per security plan §Anti-Patterns § Universal + §Dependency Security Pinning + the existing comment lines 32-35 of deny.toml).
   - Preserve the existing `[bans] multiple-versions = "deny"` and skip-list (no entries removed).
   - Comment shape: `# canary: catch tonic <0.14 transitive duplicate (opentelemetry-otlp 0.31's pinned 0.13)` per arch §Established Decisions [Backend Framework — OTLP receiver] caveat.

5. Create gitleaks integration:
   - **Option A — single workflow file:** `.github/workflows/secret-scan.yml` with `gitleaks/gitleaks-action@<40-char-SHA> # vX.Y.Z` running on PR. This is the recommended option (separates secret-scan permissions/runtime from main CI matrix; no need to run gitleaks 3× across OS matrix).
   - **Option B — step in ci.yml:** add a single-OS gitleaks step (Linux only) inside the existing `lint-test-build` job; minimal new file count but couples gitleaks runtime to per-OS matrix execution. Plan picks **Option A** because per-OS gitleaks has no value (source files are identical across runners) and a separate workflow is cleaner per security extract "secret-scanning step MUST run pre-commit AND per-PR".

6. Create `.pre-commit-config.yaml` with a single gitleaks hook pinned to the same gitleaks release the CI step uses (per security AC: "both invocations resolve to the same tool release"). Use `pre-commit` framework's `repo: https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks` with explicit `rev: vX.Y.Z` matching the action SHA's underlying release.

7. Verify `.gitignore` covers `*.p12`, `*.pem`, `*.cer`, `.env*`, `*.key`, `~/.tauri/*.key`, `*.pfx` per security AC. Existing `.gitignore` already covers all six patterns (research.md §Files к modify confirms) — no edit required, but `/implement` should run the verification grep loop and add any missing pattern explicitly.

8. Create `docs/runbooks/production-release-environment.md` per research.md open question #3 resolution. Runbook describes:
   - The `gh api repos/:owner/:repo/environments/production-release -f wait_timer=0` POST to create the named Environment.
   - `gh api repos/:owner/:repo/environments/production-release -f deployment_branch_policy='{"protected_branches":true,"custom_branch_policies":false}' -X PUT` to restrict deployments to protected branches only.
   - The required `protection_rules` containing `required_reviewers` (manual approval gate per security extract §Secret Management GitHub Environment scoping).
   - DEFERRED secret population checklist (Azure Key Vault federation creds, Apple Developer ID creds, Tauri updater Minisign private key, Homebrew tap / Scoop bucket push tokens) tracked as pre-v0.1.0 release blockers per chunk #3 scope split (route Decisions Log 2026-05-03).
   - Verification command: `gh api repos/:owner/:repo/environments` returning the named environment with `protection_rules.required_reviewers` rule.

- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` — main CI workflow: matrix Linux/macOS/Windows + harden-runner first step + canonical 4-step `cargo fmt → clippy → xtask test → cargo build --release` + coverage gate (Linux) + obs CI gates + artifact upload + supply-chain steps (after chunk #6 layering).
- `.github/workflows/secret-scan.yml` — dedicated gitleaks workflow per-PR (Option A from step 5; cleanest separation of concerns).
- `.github/dependabot.yml` — Dependabot config covering `cargo` + `github-actions` + `npm` ecosystems.
- `.pre-commit-config.yaml` — pre-commit framework config with gitleaks hook (matches CI step's release).
- `xtask/ci/heartbeat-gap-check.sh` — POSIX heartbeat-gap script (INACTIVE skeleton until subsystems ship).
- `xtask/ci/heartbeat-gap-check.ps1` — PowerShell heartbeat-gap script (Windows runner equivalent).

- `docs/runbooks/production-release-environment.md` — runbook for creating + populating the GitHub Environment (active scope: create the Environment with manual approval gate; DEFERRED: paid component secrets per chunk #3 split).
- `xtask/src/main.rs` — extend `Cmd` enum with `Test`, `TestCoverage`, `Audit`, `DenyBans`, `CiGates` variants; each shells out via `tokio::process::Command` with passthrough exit code.

- `xtask/Cargo.toml` — add `serde = { workspace = true }` if `xtask ci-gates` parses JSON in-process (recommended over shelling to `jq` for cross-OS reliability — Windows runners may not have `jq` pre-installed).
- `.config/nextest.toml` — extend `[profile.ci]` with `retries = 0` + `slow-timeout = { period = "60s", terminate-after = 3 }` + `final-status-level = "all"`; preserve existing `fail-fast = false`.
- `deny.toml` — add `[[bans.deny]]` entry `{ name = "tonic", version = "<0.14" }` with canary provenance comment; preserve existing `multiple-versions = "deny"` + skip-list.
- `.gitignore` — existing patterns already cover all six security-AC entries (`*.p12`, `*.pem`, `*.cer`, `.env*`, `*.key`, `~/.tauri/*.key`); /implement should verify but no change anticipated.
- `Cargo.toml` — no new workspace deps anticipated; `clap`, `serde_json`, `tokio` already present.

- `pulse-app/src/main.rs` — `with_default_fields` extension for CI tracing fields is DEFERRED to chunk #7 (Tracing self-observation harness) per research.md open question #2 resolution; chunk #5 only sets workflow env so chunk #7 can read.
- `rust-toolchain.toml` — pin already at 1.95.0 (above the 1.85 minimum); CI workflow respects via `dtolnay/rust-toolchain` with no override.
- `scripts/agent-run.{sh,ps1}` — existing 5-command harness is what CI integration tests will invoke at later chunks (#15+ when integration tests land); no edits at chunk #5/#6.
Per test-plan §3 5-command discipline + chunk-specific tests:

```bash
# Lint gate (all platforms)
cargo fmt --check
cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings

# Unit / integration tests (no tests yet at chunk #5; --no-tests=pass)
cargo xtask test
# Equivalent to: cargo nextest run --workspace --profile ci --no-tests=pass --message-format libtest-json

# Coverage gate (Linux dev surface; CI runs same)
cargo xtask test:coverage
# Verify lcov.info emitted; thresholds enforced by CI parsing step

# Supply-chain gates
cargo xtask audit
cargo xtask deny-bans

# Composite CI gate verification
cargo xtask ci-gates

# Smoke check (existing 5-command harness from chunk #4)
bash scripts/agent-run.sh status
# Returns canonical envelope JSON; verifies harness still operational

# Release-profile smoke build
cargo build --workspace --release

# Feature-gated build smoke (Linux entry)
cargo build --workspace --release --features mcp-server
```
GitHub Actions workflow validation (local):

```bash
# YAML lint
yamllint .github/workflows/ci.yml .github/workflows/secret-scan.yml .github/dependabot.yml

# Action SHA verification (no floating tags)
grep -E "^\s+uses:\s+[^@]+@v[0-9]+\s*$" .github/workflows/*.yml  # MUST return empty
grep -E "^\s+uses:\s+[^@]+@[a-f0-9]{40}\s+#" .github/workflows/*.yml  # MUST match every external `uses:` line
```
Each criterion verifiable; trace to combined.md per-domain contributions.
- (security) `.github/workflows/ci.yml` workflow-level `permissions:` block contains exactly `contents: read` with no other entries (per combined.md §Per-chunk extracts route#5 Constraints).

- (security) Every third-party Action in `.github/workflows/*.yml` is pinned by 40-char SHA — `grep -E "^\s+uses:\s+[^@]+@[a-f0-9]{40}\s+#" .github/workflows/*.yml` matches every `uses:` line; inverse pattern returns empty (per combined.md §Per-chunk extracts route#5 Constraints).

- (security) `step-security/harden-runner` is the first step of every job (or first non-`actions/checkout` step) — verified by parsing `jobs.<name>.steps[]` arrays (per combined.md §Per-chunk extracts route#5 Constraints).

- (arch) `ci.yml` matrix runs the locked 4-step sequence `cargo fmt --check` → `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` → `cargo xtask test` → `cargo build --workspace --release` against Linux + macOS + Windows runners on every PR and push to main (per combined.md §Per-chunk extracts route#5 Acceptance criteria contributions).

- (arch) All Rust-side CI commands go through `cargo xtask <task>` — `grep -E '^\s*cargo (audit|deny|nextest|llvm-cov)' .github/workflows/ci.yml` finds each only inside xtask invocation OR documents deviation.

- (arch) CI build smoke uses default features (mcp-server / otap-ingest OFF) on at least one matrix entry per OS; `--features mcp-server` ON on at least one Linux entry (small-binary baseline AND feature-gated path both compile).

- (tests) `cargo nextest run --workspace --profile ci --no-tests=pass` runs successfully on all three matrix runners with exit code 0; `target/nextest/junit.xml` artifact uploaded as `nextest-${{ runner.os }}`.

- (tests) `cargo llvm-cov nextest --workspace --lcov --output-path lcov.info --summary-only --no-tests=pass` emits `lcov.info`; Quality Gates parsing step fails the build when line<75% OR branch<70% OR function<85% (with 0 tests at chunk #5 land time, gate is structurally active but trivially passing — flips to binding when first tests land in chunk #15).
- (tests) Zero CI workflow files reference any third-party action by floating tag.
- (tests) CI cache key `${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}` reused across stages; cache hit on dependent rerun.
- (tests) `.config/nextest.toml [profile.ci]` contains `retries = 0` + `fail-fast = false` (preserved).
- (obs) CI matrix jobs upload `agent-latest.jsonl` as artifact named `logs-${{ runner.os }}` on every run.
- (obs) Zero-panic gate enforced — `cargo xtask ci-gates` exits 0 only when no `app.panic.fatal` span is found in `agent-latest.jsonl`.

- (obs) Zero-spans gate scaffolded — `cargo xtask ci-gates` validates `agent-latest.jsonl` non-empty after `xtask test` (with 0 tests at chunk #5, validates harness scaffold itself emits `app.boot.tracing.init` from chunk #4 — verified empirically by smoke test in new-session).
- (obs) `xtask/ci/heartbeat-gap-check.{sh,ps1}` script + CI step skeleton landed (INACTIVE — exits 0 when no tick records present; activated when first subsystem ships in Epoch 2).

- (a11y) ci.yml workflow file contains workflow-level env block setting `SERVICE_NAME`, `DEPLOYMENT_ENVIRONMENT="production"`, `CI_RUN_ID`, `GIT_COMMIT_SHA` — `grep -E 'SERVICE_NAME|DEPLOYMENT_ENVIRONMENT|CI_RUN_ID|GIT_COMMIT_SHA' .github/workflows/ci.yml` returns all 4 keys.

- (a11y) ci.yml uses `actions/upload-artifact@<40-char-SHA>` and `actions/download-artifact@<40-char-SHA>` (download wired into base scaffold even if no current step uses it — chunk #51 a11y audit reuses without action-version drift).
- (security) `cargo deny check bans licenses sources` passes on a clean checkout — `cargo xtask deny-bans` exits 0.
- (security) `cargo audit` passes on a clean checkout — `cargo xtask audit` exits 0.

- (security) `deny.toml` contains `[bans] multiple-versions = "deny"` AND explicit `[[bans.deny]]` entry for `tonic` version `<0.14` — `tomlq '.bans["multiple-versions"]' deny.toml` returns `"deny"`; entry has provenance comment naming the OTLP-receiver canary.

- (security) `.gitignore` covers `*.p12`, `*.pem`, `*.cer`, `.env*`, `*.key`, `~/.tauri/*.key` — `for p in '*.p12' '*.pem' '*.cer' '.env*' '*.key'; do grep -F "$p" .gitignore || exit 1; done` returns 0.
- (security) gitleaks runs as CI step in `.github/workflows/secret-scan.yml` (SHA-pinned) AND as pre-commit hook in `.pre-commit-config.yaml`; both invocations resolve to the same gitleaks release.

- (security) `.github/dependabot.yml` configures `cargo` AND `github-actions` ecosystems against `main` — `yq '.updates[].package-ecosystem' .github/dependabot.yml` returns the set `{cargo, github-actions, npm}` (npm added per a11y binding).
- (security) `cargo-auditable` 0.7.4 is installed and available in CI; `cargo auditable --version` step output before build step.

- (security) GitHub Environment `production-release` exists with manual approval gate — `gh api repos/:owner/:repo/environments` returns the named environment with `protection_rules` containing `required_reviewers` (scaffolding only — paid components remain DEFERRED per chunk #3 scope split, tracked in `docs/runbooks/production-release-environment.md`).

(At chunk #5/#6 release.yml does not exist yet — the negative AC is "no `environment: production-release` in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` or secret-scan.yml".)
- (tests) `cargo deny check bans licenses sources` runs in CI on every PR with exit code 0; banned-crate violation fails build.

- (obs) Gitleaks output + cargo-audit + cargo-deny output do NOT leak into `agent-latest.jsonl` artifact — `jq -e 'select(.fields.message | test("password|token|api_key|.*_SECRET"; "i"))' agent-latest.jsonl` returns empty.

- (a11y) `.github/dependabot.yml` includes `package-ecosystem: "npm"` entry pointing at `pulse-app/ui/` (or webview package.json directory) — `grep -A3 'package-ecosystem: "npm"' .github/dependabot.yml` matches.

- (arch) Workspace boundary discipline holds: no library crate transitively depends on `pulse-app`; DAG with `pulse-app` as only root — `cargo tree --workspace --invert -p pulse-app` returns only direct workspace consumers (verifiable locally; CI builds enforce by compiling the workspace).
