data.head: ### Chunk route#43: "Workspace path detection + clipboard + notification — workspace.detect (.andromeda/ marker) + dual .json/.md + 4 preset prompts + 'Snapshot ready' toast"

body: **Constraints across domains:**

- (security) All path inputs to `workspace-detector` (workspace root candidate, `.andromeda/` marker probe, snapshot output dir) MUST canonicalize via `strict-path` and assert resolved paths live under explicit base before use; `ANDROMEDA_PULSE_DATA_DIR` override semantics MUST honor the same canonicalize-and-confine primitive (per security plan §Input Validation row 6 + §Anti-Patterns Input row 4 CWE-22 class).

- (security) The new `workspace.*` and any refined `snapshot.*` procedures MUST land with BOTH (a) router registration in owning crate AND (b) matching `pulse-app/capabilities/` JSON entry AND (c) `xtask/src/main.rs::EXPECTED_PROCEDURES` extension in the SAME commit that consumes them — drift is silent runtime rejection (per §API Security TauRPC capability authorization + Session Additions 2026-05-09 / 2026-05-10).

- (security) `pulse:notification` capability JSON MUST list ONLY outbound-emit subset of `tauri-plugin-notification` permissions; NEVER add incoming notification-action handler (per §Anti-Patterns API row 6 — outbound surface MUST NOT become a phishing / IPC-abuse vector).

- (security) The clipboard-write step MUST emit a `pulse://stream/snapshot-progress` event at write time so the UI renders a non-suppressible "X bytes copied" visible signal — load-bearing user-trust requirement (per §Logging & Monitoring snapshot/clipboard hygiene bullet 2).

- (security) New tracing emission targets MUST scrub: NEVER log raw snapshot file contents / clipboard contents / full snapshot file path (basename only) / `.andromeda/` marker absolute path / VCS metadata content — apply allowlist at observability `AllowList::production()` scrubber (per §Anti-Patterns Logging rows 1-2).

- (security) Refined `snapshot.generate` IPC return type (replacing chunk #42's `Result<(), AppError>` placeholder) MUST cross the bridge as `serde::Serialize` shape; error variants do NOT leak filesystem paths, Rust struct names, library versions, or stack traces (per §Error Handling TauRPC bridge + §Anti-Patterns Logging row 4).

- (security) Both `tauri-plugin-clipboard-manager` and `tauri-plugin-notification` (or chosen equivalents) MUST clear `cargo deny check bans licenses sources` + `cargo audit`; new transitive duplicates documented in `deny.toml [bans] skip` with provenance comment per Session Additions 2026-05-03 — `multiple-versions = "deny"` MUST stay (per §Dependency Security CI integration).

- (design) OS-native notification copy MUST be terse, 2 lines maximum; format follows contemplative observational voice (e.g., "Snapshot ready | 2.5k tokens, 42 spans"; NOT "Export complete!") (per design-system.md §Surface: desktop-native → Component Patterns → Notifications).

- (design) Notification trigger semantics: snapshot generation completion is THE listed `tauri-plugin-notification` trigger; action button (if OS supports) MUST be either "View" or "Copy to Clipboard" — no other action labels (per design-system.md §Surface: desktop-native → Notifications).

- (design) All InvestigationModalForm result-state UI MUST consume Tailwind v4 `@theme` CSS custom properties (`--color-feedback-success`, `--color-text-primary/secondary`, `--color-accent`, `--color-raised-3`, `--font-code`, `--font-body`) — NEVER hardcoded hex (per design-system.md §Surface: desktop-webview → Tokens + §Color Palette → Semantic Colors).

- (design) Preset prompt list items rendered as Secondary-button-pattern controls (background `--color-raised-1`, text `--color-text-primary`, 1px subtle border `rgba(74,144,226,0.3)`, hover border emphasis, focus 3px outset `#4A90E2`), `space-sm` H + `space-xs` V padding, `radius-sm`, labels in IBM Plex Sans 12px weight 500 Label role (per design-system.md §Component Patterns → Buttons + §Typography Label row).

- (design) File-path display strings (`.json` and `.md` paths) MUST render in JetBrains Mono 12px (`--font-code`) per Typography Code role; preset prompt labels in IBM Plex Sans 12px weight 500 (Label role) (per design-system.md §Typography table → Code + Label rows).

- (design) Clipboard-write confirmation surface (visible "Copied to clipboard" indicator) MUST use Feedback Cyan `#17B3A3` for success badge — encodes confirmation semantics (per design-system.md §Color Palette → Semantic Colors note).

- (layouts) Investigation modal result content lives INSIDE the existing modal card (`background: color-raised-3`, 1px subtle border, `radius-lg`, `padding: space-md`, max-width/height ~80% viewport, scrollable overflow); the 4 preset prompts and dual file paths render WITHIN this scrollable region — NOT a second modal layer or sibling popover (per layout-templates.md §Component — Investigation modal).

- (layouts) "Snapshot ready" toast is OS-native — fired through `tauri-plugin-notification` with title 1–2 words, body 2 lines max, app icon, optional "View" / "Copy to Clipboard" action button when OS supports; NEVER reimplement as webview-rendered toast (per layout-templates.md §Component — Notifications (OS-native)).

- (layouts) Notifications honor the `notifications_enabled` boolean in `~/.andromeda-pulse/config.toml` (default `true`) — when disabled, snapshot generation completes but toast is suppressed; modal result region is the always-visible confirmation surface (per layout-templates.md §Component — Notifications implementation).
- (layouts) Tray menu summary line is unchanged for chunk #43 — no recent-snapshots counter introduced into tray (per layout-templates.md §Wireframe — Tray menu).

- (layouts) Modal close button stays at top-right corner (`✕` glyph, `color-text-secondary` → `color-text-primary` hover, `duration-fast` ease-out); preset prompts MUST NOT push close button off-screen at small viewports (per layout-templates.md §Component — Investigation modal layout).

- (tests) The `workspace-detector` activation MUST land tests with `rstest` 0.26.1 fixtures + `tempfile::TempDir` + `assert_fs` for `.andromeda/`-marker negative/positive scenarios; path canonicalization MUST be tested for traversal-escape rejection (per test-plan §5 boundary table + §1 coverage trigger "Path canonicalization + confinement").

- (tests) The refined `snapshot_ipc::generate` resolver MUST gain integration coverage: pre-stage spans in DuckDB → invoke IPC → assert `response.token_count <= budget` + `dedup_count > 0` + anomaly markers present in markdown (per test-plan §6 Scenario P2 steps 5-8 + §1 perf-budget).

- (tests) Logging hygiene: snapshot/clipboard contents NEVER appear verbatim in `tracing` events — assert via in-process `CapturingSubscriber` pattern; `snapshot.copy_to_clipboard` MUST emit `pulse://stream/snapshot-progress` event at clipboard-write time and the test asserts the event without leaking content (per test-plan §3 + Pending coverage trigger).

- (tests) New `notification` capability JSON entry MUST have a matching `xtask capability-drift` clean run (per test-plan §1 trigger + Session Addition 2026-05-09 capability-drift-coupling-with-consuming-chunk).

- (tests) All NEW unit/integration tests co-located `#[cfg(test)] mod tests {}` per Rust crate + adjacent `*.test.tsx` per webview component; `MockTraceSpan::builder()` factories drive buffer seeding — no `.sql` scripts (per test-plan §4 Conventions + §7 Self-bootstrapping).

- (tests) `tracing::warn!(target: ...)` for any new target literal (e.g., `snapshot.workspace.detect.*`, `snapshot.clipboard.write.*`, `snapshot.notification.emit.*`) requires per-target negative-canary unrolled `#[test]` fns — NOT a for-loop (per Session Addition 2026-05-10 `&'static str` literal requirement).

- (tests) Webview tests for refined `InvestigationModalForm` result-state MUST follow real-timer `waitFor(..., { timeout: 2000 })` rather than fake-timer `vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync` for setTimeout-spawned async-rejected/resolved promise transitions (per session-handoff.md Deferred learning #2 + chunk #42 precedent).

- (obs) workspace-detector activation MUST emit P7 must-trace span chain `app.boot.workspace.detect` → `filesystem.scan.gitroot` → `workspace.marker.check` → `workspace.identity.resolve` with required attributes `workspace.root_path` (canonicalized), `workspace.project_name`, `vcs_type`, `vcs_root`, `marker_present`, `detection_latency_ms` (per obs-plan §4 Scenario P7 + §8 default-deny allowlist `workspace-detector` row).

- (obs) `snapshot.generate.request` allowlist entry MUST be extended for the success-path fields shipping in this chunk (`token_count`, `dual_file_paths_basenames`, `preset_prompts_count`) coupled with consuming-code commit per security.md Session Addition 2026-05-10 D3 cleanup discipline (per obs-plan §6 boundary-call wrappers row).

- (obs) New per-leaf entries required for clipboard-write + notification-dispatch targets: emitting `tracing::info!(target: "snapshot.clipboard.write", byte_count = N, success = bool)` and `tracing::info!(target: "snapshot.notification.dispatch", notification_kind = "snapshot_ready")` requires explicit per-leaf `AllowList::production()` entries because `for_target` resolver order would silently fall back to the `snapshot` crate-level entry (per observability.md Session Addition 2026-05-07).

- (obs) Workspace path values, VCS commit messages, snapshot file contents, clipboard contents MUST NEVER appear verbatim in `agent-latest.jsonl` — `workspace.root_path` is canonicalized + low-PII; raw `.andromeda/` marker file contents / VCS-derived strings MUST be excluded via `#[instrument(skip(...))]` at source (per obs-plan §8 PII Vector 1 + §11 Logs row 5).

- (obs) Notification dispatch path MUST NOT log notification body text — span emits `notification_kind` enum + `dispatch_success: bool` only; UI string "Snapshot ready" is UI-vocabulary (per obs-plan §12 2026-05-04 PII grep heuristic UI-vocabulary exemption).

- (obs) Workspace-detector is one-shot per IPC call — does NOT need a `workspace.tick` heartbeat per obs-plan §3 Heartbeat ticks (which scopes to long-running subsystems); detection latency captured via `detection_latency_ms` field instead.

- (a11y) Each preset-prompt element MUST be a semantic native `<button>` with accessible name via visible label (preferred) or `aria-label`; never `role="button"` on `<div>` (per a11y-plan §11 ARIA anti-patterns + §4 Button pattern).

- (a11y) Preset-prompt buttons MUST honor SC 2.1.1 Keyboard via Enter/Space activation and SC 2.4.3 Focus Order — Tab sequence inside modal extends from chunk #42's existing order; `tabindex > 0` is banned (per a11y-plan §11 + §5 investigation-modal focus order).
- (a11y) Preset-prompt buttons MUST meet SC 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum) ≥ 24×24 CSS px via `--target-button-min` token (per a11y-plan §6 Target size tokens).

- (a11y) Status announcements for "Copied to clipboard" + "Snapshot ready ({N} tokens)" MUST use `aria-live="polite"` per SC 4.1.3 Status Messages; error states (clipboard-write fail, workspace-detect fail) MUST use `role="alert"` or `aria-live="assertive"` (per a11y-plan §7 Live regions + Critical Path P6).

- (a11y) File-path display MUST be selectable text with sufficient contrast `--color-text-primary / --color-base` ≥ 4.5:1 per SC 1.4.3; `--font-code` family appropriate for path strings (per a11y-plan §6 Color contrast pairs + §6 Typography tokens).

- (a11y) Focus restoration on modal close MUST return focus to originating "Investigate" trigger button per chunk #42's focus-trap-react `returnFocusOnDeactivate: true` (per a11y-plan §5 Focus restoration + SC 2.1.2 + SC 2.4.3).

- (a11y) Result-state arrival MUST shift focus to a meaningful landmark (modal title / close button / first preset-prompt) — NOT silently leave focus on the now-removed "capturing" indicator (per a11y-plan §5 + SC 2.4.3).

- (a11y) Any new transitions on result-state arrival MUST degrade per `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` via Tailwind `motion-reduce:` variants OR `useReducedMotion` from motion/react; assert state still conveyed via color/text/icon, not motion alone (per a11y-plan §6 Motion tokens + SC 2.3.3 AAA).

- (a11y) Clipboard-write success/failure indicator + 4 preset-prompt visual states MUST NOT rely on color alone — pair `--color-feedback-success` (clipboard ok) with checkmark icon + text label; pair `--color-accent` (clipboard error) with icon + text label per SC 1.4.1 (per a11y-plan §6 + §11).

- (arch) **Crate placement is locked** — `workspace-detector` is reserved in arch §Inherited Defaults workspace member list (10 workspace members); chunk #43 activates the stub at `crates/workspace-detector/src/{lib.rs,contract.rs}` and MUST NOT introduce a new crate (per arch §Occupied Resources Cargo workspace crate names).

- (arch) **TauRPC namespace shape is locked** — `workspace.detect` and `workspace.list` MUST follow `<router>.<verb>` dotted snake_case shape; chunk #43 MAY implement `workspace.detect` only and defer `workspace.list` (per arch §Conventions Endpoint naming + §Occupied Resources Tauri IPC routes).

- (arch) **AppError serde envelope at the bridge** — every new `#[taurpc::procedure]` returns `Result<T, AppError>`; module-internal `thiserror`-derived errors convert at the bridge via `From` impls (per arch §Established Decisions Error Handling Pattern + §Conventions Error response schema).

- (arch) **Snapshot output filesystem location is reserved** — generated `.json`/`.md` files MUST land under resolved `snapshots/` subpath of data dir per arch §Occupied Resources Filesystem locations.

- (arch) **Tauri capability JSON registration is mandatory** — `pulse:notification` already reserved at arch level and only needs the JSON file population. `pulse:clipboard` is NOT in reserved list — adding it counts as the "explicit per-feature capability addition with stated rationale" the policy permits, and SHOULD land via §Architecture Registry Updates Path B (mirrors 2026-05-09 streams.* + telemetry.* additive precedent) rather than full /andromeda-scope-arch.

- (arch) **Specta type-derive on every IPC-crossing type** — refined `snapshot.generate` return shape and `workspace.detect` return shape MUST derive `serde::Serialize` AND `specta::Type` so TauRPC bindings emit them (per arch §Cross-cutting Patterns Cross-bridge data shape).

- (arch) **OS notification policy gates "Snapshot ready" toast** — fires on completion of `pulse://stream/snapshot-progress` (per arch §Cross-cutting Patterns OS notification policy); user opt-out via `notifications_enabled` boolean in `~/.andromeda-pulse/config.toml` (default `true`).
**Patterns to follow:**

- (security) TauRPC namespace registration triple-binding pattern: arch §Occupied Resources update + `pulse-app/capabilities/` JSON addition + `xtask EXPECTED_PROCEDURES` const extension — couple all three in consuming commit per Session Additions 2026-05-09 + 2026-05-10. Chunk #34 + chunk #42 are recent precedents.

- (security) AllowList scrubber per-leaf entry pattern: every new `tracing::warn!(target: "X.Y.Z.event", ...)` call site needs matching entry in `pulse-app/src/observability.rs::AllowList::production()` with bounded field names + paired tests (positive resolver fn + negative canary fn) — chunk #41 + chunk #42 establish the unrolled-explicit-fn shape.

- (security) Sanitized `AppError::Internal { message }` From-impl pattern: module-internal `thiserror` 2.x enums in workspace-detector + extended snapshot errors collapse to `AppError::{Internal, NotFound, Storage}` at the bridge; impl strips file paths / Rust struct names / library versions.

- (security) Settings-as-default-for-state extension pattern: if chunk #43 needs persistable state (e.g., `notifications_enabled` first-run flag, snapshot output dir override), prefer extending `crates/ui-bridge/src/contract.rs::Settings` over introducing a new TauRPC namespace per Session Additions 2026-05-09.

- (security) `strict-path` canonicalize-and-confine pattern: same primitive used for `ANDROMEDA_PULSE_*_PATH` / `*_DIR` env vars is the right primitive for workspace-root candidate paths; verify resolved path before any filesystem read.

- (design) Result-state UI inside InvestigationModalForm follows existing modal scaffold: layered at Raised-3 background + 1px subtle border + `radius-lg` — chunk #38 Modal primitive + chunk #42 InvestigationModalForm establish this; chunk #43 only evolves the inner result-state cluster.
- (design) Spacing for the 4-preset list block: stack with `space-sm` (8px) gap between preset items, `space-md` (16px) gap separating from sibling clusters; modal outer padding `space-md` inherited.
- (design) Telescope icon usage in result-state success cluster: `<Icon glyph="telescope" />` at 20px (telescope is the registered investigate glyph; contextually correct domain anchor).
- (design) Aperture icon for any preset-selector "view settings"-flavored chip — DO NOT default to generic Lucide `Filter` or `Settings` glyph when an in-domain glyph exists.

- (design) Loading + error state visual consistency: skeleton pulse pattern from chunk #28 if generation in-flight; error state uses `--color-accent` border + sanitized message text on one or two lines.

- (layouts) Modal-result-region scrollable overflow pattern: structured trace detail is the established precedent — preset prompt list + file path callouts follow same vertical-stack-inside-scroll-region pattern.
- (layouts) OS-native notification trigger pattern: chunk #43's "Snapshot ready" toast is canonical first user of the Snapshot generation completion trigger event.

- (layouts) Action button on notification (when OS supports): prefer "Copy to Clipboard" (direct action without opening app) over "View" since chunk #43 already auto-writes to clipboard inside the IPC body — toast action is re-copy convenience.

- (layouts) Preset prompt placement inside modal: stack 4 selectable prompts vertically as labeled list/section inside scrollable result region, after file-path callouts and before close button area; matches Settings modal "Form sections stacked vertically, `gap: space-lg`" pattern.

- (tests) `CapturingSubscriber` in-process tracing assertion (`Arc<Mutex<Vec<(String, Level)>>>` + `tracing::subscriber::set_default(subscriber)` returning `DefaultGuard` for `#[tokio::test]` async resolvers) — reference: `crates/ui-bridge/src/telemetry.rs::tests::record_frame_ms_emits_tracing_info_at_metric_target_on_success` and chunk #42 `crates/ui-bridge/src/snapshot_ipc.rs::tests`.

- (tests) `rstest` fixture composition for parametric coverage: `#[fixture] fn workspace_with_marker(tmpdir: TempDir) -> WorkspaceCandidate { ... }` + `#[rstest]` test fns asserting positive/negative detection.

- (tests) Tauri webview API mock pattern: `vi.mock("@tauri-apps/plugin-clipboard-manager", () => ({ writeText: vi.fn() }))` and `vi.mock("@tauri-apps/plugin-notification", () => ({ sendNotification: vi.fn() }))` at top of `InvestigationModalForm.test.tsx` with `vi.hoisted` if cross-referencing test-fn-scoped mock state.

- (tests) Provider-context wrap audit: when chunk #43 augments `InvestigationProvider` (e.g., adds `snapshotResult` state), audit existing test files rendering downstream consumers AND wrap each render in the augmented provider (per Session Addition 2026-05-10 chunk #42 precedent).
- (tests) Per-test isolation via `tempfile::TempDir` + `ANDROMEDA_PULSE_DATA_DIR=$TMPDIR/test-$$` for any test exercising `workspace::detect()` against real filesystem layout.

- (tests) E2E P2 closure: `tonic` 0.14.5 client populates buffer → IPC test client invokes `snapshot.generate` → assert markdown anomaly markers regex `⚠|🔴|critical.*path` + token_count strict ≤ budget + dedup_count > 0 + p50/p95/p99 aggregates present.

- (obs) AllowList per-leaf entry shape: `by_target.insert("target.subtarget", ["field1", "field2"].iter().copied().collect());` with comment block citing chunk number — replicate chunk #42 placeholder pattern at `pulse-app/src/observability.rs:828-840`.

- (obs) Test pair per allowlist entry: positive resolver `allowlist_for_target_resolves_<target>_field_set` + negative canary `scrubber_redacts_non_allowlisted_<target>_field`; unroll explicit `#[test]` fns per Session Addition 2026-05-10.

- (obs) Workspace.detect IPC instrumentation: `#[tracing::instrument(skip_all, fields(traceparent = %tp))]` on TauRPC router method; emit child span `workspace.detect` with attributes per pre-registered allowlist field set.

- (obs) Snapshot-progress channel emission per security plan §Logging clipboard hygiene: `pulse://stream/snapshot-progress` event MUST fire at clipboard-write time so UI shows non-suppressible "X bytes copied" toast — emission site is `tauri::Emitter` call wrapped in `tracing::info!(target: "snapshot.clipboard.write", ...)` event with `byte_count` field.

- (obs) In-process `CapturingSubscriber` pattern for unit tests: `tracing::subscriber::set_default(subscriber)` returns `DefaultGuard` scoped to current thread; use for `#[tokio::test]` async resolver tests asserting tracing events.

- (a11y) Investigation modal pattern with `dialog` + `aria-modal="true"` + `aria-labelledby` (modal title) + `aria-describedby` (description) — chunk #42's Modal primitive substrate already provides; chunk #43 only extends modal contents.

- (a11y) Preset-prompt list as row of native `<button>` elements with individual `aria-label="Insert prompt: {name}"` semantics (use this for "click → copy prompt to clipboard" UX pattern: each button is its own action).

- (a11y) Live region for clipboard-write confirmation: existing chunk #42 `aria-live="polite"` status region — append "{N} characters copied to clipboard" message; do NOT introduce a second concurrent live region.
- (a11y) Focus-visible discipline on every preset-prompt button: `--border-focus` token outline on `:focus-visible` per SC 2.4.7 + SC 1.4.11 ≥ 3:1 non-text contrast.

- (a11y) OS notification text: "Snapshot ready ({N} tokens)" with meaningful body string — content carries success state via OS-native a11y APIs; do NOT rely on icon alone — text body required for SR readability.

- (arch) **Router-in-ui-bridge convention** — TauRPC routers live in `crates/ui-bridge/`; substrate crates (`workspace-detector`, `snapshot`) stay free of taurpc + specta dependencies. Apply same convention to new `workspace.detect` resolver: place in `crates/ui-bridge/src/workspace_ipc.rs`. Substrate exposes plain Rust contract; ui-bridge resolver wraps it, converts errors via `From<DetectError> for AppError`, and derives specta::Type on parallel IPC type if substrate purity preserved.

- (arch) **Standard Contracts non-list response shape** — `snapshot.generate` and `workspace.detect` are single-result operations, return direct shape `Result<T, AppError>` rather than `{items, total, next_cursor}` paginated envelope.

- (arch) **Tauri Channel API for streaming progress** — `pulse://stream/snapshot-progress` events use Tauri 2 IPC `Channel` with binary payloads (or JSON for low-frequency progress events) per arch §Standard Contracts Real-time push contract.

- (arch) **Module dependency direction enforcement** — `workspace-detector` must not depend on `pulse-app`, must not depend on `ui-bridge`; ui-bridge depends on workspace-detector contract via `Cargo.toml`; snapshot crate similarly does not depend on workspace-detector — ui-bridge resolver composes both.

- (arch) **Config layering for `notifications_enabled`** — extend `Settings` struct (per chunk #30 precedent) with `notifications_enabled: bool` (default `true`) if not already present; layered config precedence env vars > `~/.andromeda-pulse/config.toml` > built-in defaults.
**Anti-patterns to avoid:**

- (security) NEVER `tokio::process::Command::new(...).arg(user_input)` against any string sourced from workspace-detector output (e.g., spawning `git` against detected workspace path) — live MCP STDIO command-injection cluster (CVE-2025-49596 / 54994 / 54136 / 2026-22252). Prefer pure-Rust git crates (e.g., `gix`) over subprocess invocation.

- (security) NEVER widen `pulse:notification` capability JSON to include input-event handlers (notification click callbacks, action button payloads) — outbound emit subset only. The "Snapshot ready" toast is one-way emission.
- (security) NEVER log full paths of detected workspace root, `.andromeda/` marker location, VCS metadata, snapshot file destination, or clipboard payload — log basenames only.
- (security) NEVER write snapshot files to a path constructed from workspace-detector output without canonicalize-and-confine via `strict-path` against resolved data dir — CWE-22 traversal class.
- (design) NEVER use web notification libraries (browser `Notification` API, react-toastify) for "Snapshot ready" trigger — MUST use OS-native via `tauri-plugin-notification`.
- (design) NEVER use `alert()` / `confirm()` / `prompt()` for in-modal "Copied to clipboard" confirmation or any error-acknowledge flow — use the InvestigationModalForm scaffold.
- (design) NEVER convey clipboard-write success or error state through color alone — `#17B3A3` MUST pair with text label or icon glyph; `#C7556A` MUST pair with sanitized message text.
- (design) NEVER ship generic stock notification copy like "Action completed successfully" — contemplative observational voice mandates "Snapshot ready" framing with data-driven counts.

- (layouts) Do NOT render the "Snapshot ready" notification as a webview-internal banner / floating card — OS-native toast is the spec'd surface; webview-internal banner duplicates signal and breaks `notifications_enabled` opt-out contract.
- (layouts) Do NOT add nested submenus to the tray menu to expose the 4 preset prompts — tray menu is "Flat hierarchy, no nested submenus" by spec.
- (layouts) Do NOT introduce a custom in-app toast / snackbar component to confirm "clipboard written" — modal result region itself is the confirmation surface.
- (tests) NEVER assert raw OTLP protobuf bytes or raw markdown content equality — assert on decoded fields + structural markers (anomaly emoji/regex / aggregate presence / dedup_count > 0).
- (tests) NEVER use `sleep(N)` for synchronization across IPC → clipboard → notification chain — wait for explicit `pulse://stream/snapshot-progress` event or `health` state poll.
- (tests) NEVER skip `cargo xtask capability-drift` after registering new `notification` capability JSON entry.

- (tests) NEVER pre-populate workspace fixtures via committed `.andromeda/` directory in `tests/fixtures/` — generate at runtime via `tempfile::TempDir` + `assert_fs::TempDir::child(".andromeda").create_dir_all()`.

- (obs) NEVER emit `tracing::info!(target: "snapshot.clipboard.write", clipboard_content = %text, ...)` — clipboard payload is exactly the security plan §Logging vector that demanded the non-suppressible toast event; only `byte_count` + `success` + (optional) `dual_file_paths_basenames` get emitted.

- (obs) NEVER widen `snapshot` crate-level allowlist to include `byte_count` / `notification_kind` — those field names belong on per-leaf targets so they stay scoped; widening parent leaks them onto unrelated sub-events through `for_target` fallback chain.

- (obs) NEVER log full canonicalized snapshot file paths or `.andromeda/` marker absolute paths — basename-only emission via `path.file_name().and_then(|s| s.to_str())`; the `dual_file_paths_basenames` field is plural-array of basenames.
- (a11y) NEVER make a preset-prompt clickable on a non-semantic element (`<div onClick>` or `<a>` without `href`) — semantic `<button type="button">` only.

- (a11y) NEVER omit focus restoration when modal closes from result state — chunk #42's focus-trap-react `returnFocusOnDeactivate: true` covers this; do NOT add custom close handlers that bypass focus restoration.
- (a11y) NEVER convey clipboard-write success purely via color change on a button — must include icon + text "Copied" announcement; pair with aria-live update.
- (a11y) NEVER add motion (preset-prompt hover scale, success-state fade-in on file-path reveal) without `motion-reduce:` Tailwind variant + `useReducedMotion` respect.
- (a11y) NEVER nest a focusable element inside the preset-prompt button — flatten the hierarchy.

- (arch) Do NOT bind the snapshot router or workspace router to a non-`ui-bridge` crate — adding taurpc + specta dependencies to `crates/snapshot` or `crates/workspace-detector` pollutes substrate crates and contradicts chunk #42 router-location convention.

- (arch) Do NOT skip `/andromeda-evolve --allow-arch-registry` for `pulse:clipboard` capability addition — leaving the new capability identifier unlegitimized in arch leaves a D3 capability-drift carry-over.
- (arch) Do NOT introduce a new env var beyond the `ANDROMEDA_PULSE_*` namespace for workspace detection — new env vars require /andromeda-scope-arch or §Architecture Registry Update.
**Contract bindings:**

- **security ↔ obs (PII/secret scrubbing for new tracing targets)** — every new `tracing::warn!(target: ...)` call site this chunk introduces (`workspace.detect.*`, `snapshot.clipboard.write`, `snapshot.notification.dispatch`, refined `snapshot.generate.request` success-path fields) needs an `AllowList::production()` per-leaf entry with bounded field names; chunk #41 + chunk #42 establish the convention. **Reciprocates:** both security and obs extracts mention this binding consistently.

- **security ↔ tests (capability-drift CI gate)** — `cargo xtask capability-drift` MUST pass after new procedures land; xtask EXPECTED_PROCEDURES const extension is the test-side enforcement of the security-side capability JSON binding. **Reciprocates:** tests extract has matching acceptance criterion.

- **Route chunks covered:**
  - route#43 "Workspace path detection + clipboard + notification — workspace.detect (.andromeda/ marker) + dual .json/.md + 4 preset prompts + 'Snapshot ready' toast"
- **Epoch:** Epoch 6 — Snapshot & Investigate (FINAL chunk; transitions to Epoch 7 — Plugin runtime + MCP server)

Chunk #43 closes Epoch 6 by replacing chunk #42's placeholder `snapshot.generate` IPC body with the real Investigate flow: workspace detection → curated snapshot → dual `.json` + `.md` persistence → clipboard write → OS-native "Snapshot ready" toast → 4 preset prompt UI for paste-to-AI workflows. Activates the `workspace-detector` workspace member (currently a `pub mod contract;` stub) for the first time, registers the `pulse:notification` capability JSON (currently empty `permissions: []` stub) with real outbound-emit permissions, and adds a NEW `pulse:clipboard` capability (additive arch §Architecture Registry Update Path B per the streams.* + telemetry.* 2026-05-09 precedent). Substrate purity preserved per session-learnings 2026-05-10 router-in-ui-bridge convention: `crates/workspace-detector/` stays free of taurpc + specta deps; `crates/ui-bridge/src/workspace_ipc.rs` (new) is the resolver wrapper; `crates/ui-bridge/src/snapshot_ipc.rs` (chunk #42 placeholder) gets refined return type from `Result<(), AppError>` to `Result<SnapshotResultDto, AppError>`. End-to-end this closes test-plan §6 critical paths P2 (snapshot generation closure) and P7 (workspace detection); per security plan §Logging clipboard hygiene the clipboard-write step emits a non-suppressible `pulse://stream/snapshot-progress` event so the UI surfaces an "X bytes copied" visible signal. Notifications honor the existing `Settings::notifications_enabled` boolean (default `true`; persisted via `~/.andromeda-pulse/config.toml`) — when disabled, snapshot generation completes but the OS toast is suppressed.

1. **Workspace + plugin dependency wire-up.** Add `tauri-plugin-clipboard-manager = "2"` and `tauri-plugin-notification = "2"` to workspace-root `Cargo.toml` `[workspace.dependencies]`. Add path deps `snapshot = { path = "../crates/snapshot" }` and `workspace-detector = { path = "../crates/workspace-detector" }` to BOTH `pulse-app/Cargo.toml` and `crates/ui-bridge/Cargo.toml`. Add the two `tauri-plugin-*` deps to `pulse-app/Cargo.toml` only. data.head: ### Chunk route#44: "Snapshot.generate runtime + result-state UI — AppHandle injection for clipboard/notification/event-emit + InvestigationModalForm result UI + PresetPromptList + PII negative-canary E2E (chunk #43 follow-up)"

body: **Constraints across domains:**

- (arch) Snapshot runtime code lives in `crates/snapshot/` per workspace crate name reservation; TauRPC resolver glue + AppHandle binding live in `pulse-app/` binary crate (the only crate permitted to depend on Tauri runtime per arch §Cross-cutting Patterns Module dependency direction); UI consumer code lives in `pulse-app/ui/` consuming TauRPC-generated bindings only (per arch §Conventions Workspace API style).

- (arch) TauRPC resolvers for `snapshot.generate` / `snapshot.list_recent` / `snapshot.copy_to_clipboard` MUST return `Result<T, AppError>` with sanitized variants — Validation/NotFound/Internal/Plugin/Storage/Ingest — converted from internal `thiserror`-derived enums via `From` impls at the bridge; NEVER serialize `anyhow::Error` directly (per arch §Conventions Error response schema Tauri IPC).

- (arch) `pulse://stream/snapshot-progress` Tauri event is the canonical real-time push surface for snapshot completion; `app_handle.emit("pulse://stream/snapshot-progress", ...)` MUST be the emit name (per arch §Standard Contracts Real-time push contract).

- (arch) OS notification dispatch ("Snapshot ready" toast) MUST honor the `notifications_enabled` boolean from `~/.andromeda-pulse/config.toml`; when disabled the snapshot generation still completes and the snapshot-progress event still fires, only the OS-level toast is suppressed (per arch §Cross-cutting Patterns OS notification policy).

- (arch) Clipboard write uses `pulse:clipboard` capability (write-only, `clipboard-manager:allow-write-text` scope) already registered in `pulse-app/capabilities/clipboard.json` per chunk #43 substrate; notification dispatch uses `pulse:notification` already registered; NO new capability identifier introduced by chunk #44 (per arch §Occupied Resources Tauri capability identifiers + §Architecture Registry Updates 2026-05-11).

- (arch) All types crossing the TauRPC bridge (SnapshotResultDto, preset prompt list items, workspace-detect output) MUST derive `serde::Serialize` — enforced at compile time by TauRPC derive macros (per arch §Cross-cutting Patterns Cross-bridge data shape).
- (arch) Snapshot files MUST be written under the resolved snapshots subpath honoring `ANDROMEDA_PULSE_DATA_DIR` override (per arch §Occupied Resources Filesystem locations).

- (arch) NO new TauRPC procedure namespace introduced — `snapshot.{generate,list_recent,copy_to_clipboard}` + `workspace.detect` already reserved in arch §Occupied Resources Tauri IPC routes; chunk #44 fills resolver bodies only.

- (security) `snapshot.generate` resolver implementation MUST be backed by a corresponding entry under `pulse-app/capabilities/` (chunk #43 substrate added `clipboard.json` + `notification.json`); xtask `EXPECTED_PROCEDURES` MUST include `snapshot.generate` + `snapshot.copy_to_clipboard` + `workspace.detect` to keep capability-drift gate green (per security plan §API Security TauRPC capability authorization + §Anti-Patterns API row 3).

- (security) `pulse:clipboard` MUST stay scoped to `clipboard-manager:allow-write-text` only — NEVER `allow-read-text` (clipboard read is exfiltration surface per security plan §Anti-Patterns API row 6 + arch §Architecture Registry Updates 2026-05-11 marker rationale).

- (security) `pulse:notification` is outbound-emit-only; chunk #44 runtime MUST invoke notification dispatch as fire-and-forget out-channel (no `on_action` callback wiring re-entering Rust with arbitrary payload) per security plan §Anti-Patterns API row 6.

- (security) `snapshot.copy_to_clipboard` MUST emit a `pulse://stream/snapshot-progress` event at clipboard-write time so the UI can show a non-suppressible "X bytes copied" toast (visible signal that data left the app's address space) per security plan §Logging & Monitoring snapshot/clipboard/MCP-tool-response hygiene bullet 2.

- (security) Chunk #44 snapshot.generate resolver MUST NOT log snapshot file contents, clipboard payload, raw OTLP attribute values, or full plugin/workspace file paths (basename only); notification title/body MUST use `bytes_written` / `services_count` / `snapshot_id` keys only (per security plan §Logging & Monitoring "What NEVER to log" bullets 1-5 + §Anti-Patterns Logging rows 1-2).

- (security) `workspace.detect` resolver MUST canonicalize via `strict-path` and assert resolved path lives under resolved data dir (CWE-22 defense); basename-only is the logged form (per security plan §Input Validation row 4 + §Anti-Patterns Input row 4 + §Code Patterns row 2).

- (security) All failure paths through `snapshot.generate` runtime MUST collapse to `AppError::{Internal, Storage, Validation}` variants with sanitized one-line messages — NO stack traces, NO Rust struct names, NO library versions, NO absolute file paths in `message` field; convert at `From<thiserror::Error> for AppError` impl (per security plan §Error Handling TauRPC bridge + §Anti-Patterns Logging row 4).

- (tests) Chunk MUST exercise P2 critical path end-to-end: `response.markdown` contains anomaly markers (regex `⚠|🔴|critical.*path`) + `response.token_count <= budget` + `response.dedup_count > 0` + p50/p95/p99 aggregates present + `pulse://stream/snapshot-progress` completion event received within timeout + notification event emitted with `token_count` field (per test-plan §6 P2 Scenario steps 5–10).

- (tests) Chunk plan `## Test Commands` MUST include FULL standard gate baseline: `cargo fmt --check` + `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` + `cargo nextest run --workspace --profile ci` + `cargo xtask capability-drift` + (webview gates) `npm run lint --prefix pulse-app/ui` + `npm run typecheck --prefix pulse-app/ui` + `npm run test --prefix pulse-app/ui` (per test-plan §12 Decisions Log 2026-05-10 `chunk-gate-baseline-coverage`).

- (tests) Chunk plan MUST include `npx @tauri-apps/cli dev` (60s timeout, watch stdout for `Local:` / `ready in` / `Compiled successfully`) because AppHandle injection modifies boot wiring — boot-smoke gate required for changes touching `pulse-app/src/main.rs` OR `crates/ui-bridge/src/` OR `crates/snapshot/src/` resolver bindings (per test-plan §12 Decisions Log 2026-05-09 `boot-smoke-coverage`).

- (tests) Webview unit tests for `InvestigationModalForm` result-state + `PresetPromptList` MUST be co-located `*.test.tsx` adjacent to source under `pulse-app/ui/src/` and emit JUnit XML to `target/junit-ui.xml` (per test-plan §4 webview unit framework).

- (tests) PII negative-canary integration test MUST follow `security-vector-coverage: AppError sanitization` / `MCP response body redaction` shape: after invoking `snapshot.generate` with payload containing simulated secret-bearing OTLP attributes, assert snapshot markdown / clipboard content / `agent-latest.jsonl` does NOT contain secret values (per test-plan §11 §Project-specific bans).

- (tests) Tauri runtime API mocks (clipboard write / notification dispatch / event emit) MUST use `vi.mock("@tauri-apps/api/...")` at top-of-file + `vi.hoisted(() => ({ ... }))` for mock function references + `afterEach(() => { vi.unstubAllGlobals(); })` per testing.md §Session Additions 2026-05-09 / 2026-05-08.

- (tests) Snapshot result-state UI tests MUST NOT use `sleep(N)` for async coordination; wait for explicit `pulse://stream/snapshot-progress` events OR `findByLabelText(...)` + `waitFor(...)` confirming TauRPC fetch resolved (per testing.md §Synchronization).

- (obs) The `snapshot.generate` TauRPC handler MUST be wrapped with `#[tracing::instrument(skip_all, fields(traceparent = %tp, token_budget, time_range_start, time_range_end, service_filter))]` per must-trace path P2; parent span `session.snapshot` with child spans `duckdb.query.aggregation`, `snapshot.render.markdown`, `snapshot.token.count.validate` (per obs-plan §4 Scenario P2).

- (obs) Clipboard write MUST emit `pulse://stream/snapshot-progress` event AND a corresponding `tracing::info!(target: "snapshot.clipboard.written", bytes_copied = N, snapshot_id = ...)` log line — clipboard writes are a security-sensitive boundary requiring audit trail (per obs-plan §11 Project-specific row 4 + security plan §Logging snapshot/clipboard hygiene).

- (obs) OS notification dispatch MUST emit `tracing::info!(target: "snapshot.notification.dispatched", token_count, snapshot_id, ...)` — boundary-only instrumentation per obs-plan §1 OS notifications row. NEVER include snapshot file contents or preset-prompt text in log fields. _Note: phase-40/plan.md used target name `snapshot.notification.dispatch` (Open Q1 resolution); see rot warnings._

- (obs) `snapshot.generate` span MUST emit `metric.snapshot.token_count_ms` per obs-plan §5 metric event row: `tracing::info!(target: "metric.snapshot.token_count_ms", duration_ms, token_budget, time_range_minutes, token_count_actual, dedup_count, budget_exceeded)`.

- (obs) AppError sanitization MUST use `tracing-error` SpanTrace for error chain capture (user-defined spans only); NEVER serialize `anyhow::Error` direct chain across bridge (per obs-plan §11 Spans row 5 + §7 Error → span correlation).

- (obs) PII allowlist for `snapshot` module emits only `token_budget`, `token_count_actual`, `dedup_count`, `time_range_start`, `time_range_end`; NEVER emit raw markdown content, anomaly bodies, clipboard contents, or preset prompt selections (per obs-plan §8 Default-deny posture whitelist + §11 Logs row 5).

- (obs) `workspace.detect` IPC path MUST log only `workspace.root_path`, `workspace.project_name`, `vcs_type`, `vcs_root`, `marker_present`, `detection_latency_ms` (per obs-plan §8 whitelist + §4 Scenario P7).

- (a11y) A11y tier = Standard (1) → WCAG 2.1 AA + AAA SC 2.3.3 escalation; chunk's new UI surfaces MUST emit machine-verifiable violation JSON aligned to obs §6 schema (per a11y plan §1 + §3 Structured Violation JSON Schema).

- (a11y) `PresetPromptList` MUST render as native semantic `<button>` elements (one per preset prompt) — never `role="button"` on `<div>` / `<a>`; semantic HTML first, ARIA only where insufficient (per a11y plan §11 ARIA anti-patterns + §4 Button row).

- (a11y) `InvestigationModalForm` result-state announcements MUST use `aria-live="polite"` for non-blocking completion / clipboard-write status and `role="alert"` (or `aria-live="assertive"`) for sanitized failure messages (per a11y plan §7 Live regions + §4 Status / Alert pattern + Critical Path P6).

- (a11y) snapshot.generate IPC call MUST set `aria-busy="true"` on Generate trigger / modal region during async lifetime and clear to `aria-busy="false"` on settle; focus MUST remain inside the modal across the round-trip (per a11y plan §3 Critical Path P6 + §4 Button row).

- (a11y) All new text/icon pairs MUST satisfy SC 1.4.3 4.5:1 for text + SC 1.4.11 3:1 for non-text; tokens consumed verbatim — `--color-text-primary / --color-base`, `--color-feedback-success / --color-inset`, `--color-accent / --color-base`, `--border-focus` (per a11y plan §6 Color contrast pairs table).

- (a11y) Any state transition introduced by result-state surface MUST respect `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` via Tailwind v4 `motion-reduce:` variants AND `useReducedMotion` hook from `motion/react` 12.x — state change still conveyed via color + text + focus ring under reduced motion (per a11y plan §6 Motion tokens + SC 2.3.3 AAA).
- (a11y) Each preset-prompt button MUST meet `--target-button-min` 24×24 CSS px minimum (SC 2.5.8 AA) measured on computed width/height including padding (per a11y plan §6 Target size tokens).

- (a11y) `eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y` `'plugin:jsx-a11y/recommended'` compile-time gate MUST pass on new `PresetPromptList.tsx` + modified `InvestigationModalForm.tsx` (per a11y plan §3 a11y-linting + §11 anti-patterns).

- (a11y) OS notification content MUST be screen-reader-readable via the OS notification API — no manual fallback "in-app toast only"; the OS native a11y surface announces to NVDA / VoiceOver / Orca (per a11y plan §1 Notification entity + §3 Critical Path P6).

- (design) Result-state UI (InvestigationModalForm post-`snapshot.generate`) MUST use only `@theme` tokens — `--color-raised-3` (#343A45) modal background, 1px subtle/emphasis border per Border Progression, `--radius-lg` (8px) container, `--spacing-md` (16px) padding (per design-system.md §Depth Strategy Modal elevation + §Component Patterns Cards/Panels + §Border Radius radius-lg).

- (design) PresetPromptList MUST render preset prompt buttons using Secondary button pattern (`--color-raised-1` background, `--color-text-primary`, 1px subtle border, `--radius-sm` 4px) — NOT Primary (Primary `#4A90E2` reserved for "Investigate" action itself) (per design-system.md §Component Patterns Buttons + §Color Palette Primary usage row).
- (design) Result-state success MUST use Feedback Cyan `#17B3A3` as border + accent; success state is sparingly-used confirmation (per design-system.md §Color Palette Semantic Colors).

- (design) Investigation Capture Collapse supporting moment MUST be preserved across result-state transition — the 350ms scale+opacity ease is the visual handshake for `snapshot.generate` invocation; result-state UI emerges INSIDE that collapsed object (per design-system.md §Motion High-impact moments + §Decisions Log 2026-05-02).

- (design) ALL motion MUST respect `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` — collapse 350ms → 0ms; button hover 150ms → 0ms; no spring/bounce easing (per design-system.md §Motion Accessibility + Hard limits).

- (design) Error-state surface MUST use Alert Burgundy `#C7556A` border at 50% opacity + error message text in `--color-text-primary` (accent is non-text-token classification per Decisions Log 2026-05-03) (per design-system.md §Surface: desktop-webview Input Fields Error state).

- (design) Notification copy ("Snapshot ready | X tokens, N spans") MUST be terse, 2 lines max, contemplative observational voice — NOT "Snapshot exported successfully!" or marketing tone (per design-system.md §Surface: desktop-native Notifications + Tray Menu Tone).

- (layouts) Investigation modal MUST preserve existing layout structure: high `z-index` semi-opaque overlay backdrop + inner card with `background: color-raised-3`, 1px subtle border, `radius: radius-lg`, `padding: space-md`, max-width and max-height capped to roughly 80% of viewport, scrollable overflow (per layout-templates.md §Component — Investigation modal Layout).

- (layouts) Modal title remains `font-heading` `color-text-primary`; close button top-right corner with `✕` glyph in `color-text-secondary`, hover → `color-text-primary` over `duration-fast` ease-out — these existing slots MUST remain (per layout-templates.md §Component — Investigation modal Layout).

- (layouts) Content region inside the modal is the only mutable area — result-state UI (success / preset prompts / copy feedback) MUST stay within this scrollable container (per layout-templates.md §Component — Investigation modal Layout).

- (layouts) Investigation Capture Collapse motion (scale + opacity ease-out, supporting moment) MUST remain the entry transition for the modal; result-state UI rendering must not introduce competing entry motion within the `0.35` webview expression budget (per layout-templates.md §Component — Investigation modal Motion).

- (layouts) OS-native notification format MUST follow §Component — Notifications: terse title (1–2 words), body 2 lines max with token + span counts, app icon, optional "View" / "Copy to Clipboard" action button (per layout-templates.md §Component — Notifications Notification format).

- (layouts) Notifications opt-out MUST be honored: `notifications_enabled` boolean in `~/.andromeda-pulse/config.toml` (default true) suppresses toast even when snapshot generation completes (per layout-templates.md §Component — Notifications Implementation).
**Patterns to follow:**

data.head: # Phase 41 Plan — chunk route#44: "Snapshot.generate runtime + result-state UI"

body: _Generated by /andromeda-phase Phase 4. Read by /andromeda-implement. Manual edits between runs are fine; do not edit during /implement run._
- **Phase number:** 41

- **Route chunks covered:**
  - route#44 "Snapshot.generate runtime + result-state UI — AppHandle injection for clipboard/notification/event-emit + InvestigationModalForm result UI + PresetPromptList + PII negative-canary E2E (chunk #43 follow-up)"
- **Epoch:** Epoch 6 — Snapshot & Investigate (FINAL chunk; transitions to Epoch 7 — Plugin runtime + MCP server)

Chunk #44 closes Epoch 6 by replacing the chunk #43 substrate placeholder `SnapshotApiImpl::generate` body (which returns hardcoded-zero `SnapshotResultDto` while emitting 3 canonical tracing targets) with the real runtime that loads spans from the buffer, composes `snapshot::curate(spans)` + `snapshot::format_markdown(curated, budget)` (chunk #39-#41 pub API), writes dual `.json` + `.md` files under `~/.andromeda-pulse/snapshots/`, writes markdown to the clipboard via `tauri-plugin-clipboard-manager`, emits `pulse://stream/snapshot-progress` Tauri event at clipboard-write time per security plan §Logging snapshot/clipboard hygiene mandate, and dispatches an OS "Snapshot ready" toast via `tauri-plugin-notification` honoring the `Settings::notifications_enabled` opt-out (default true). Tracing emissions at the established `snapshot.generate.request` / `snapshot.clipboard.write` / `snapshot.notification.dispatch` targets MUST conform to the chunk #43 substrate AllowList field sets verbatim (no new target names; `.dispatch` is the canonical spelling). Webview side: `InvestigationModalForm` consumes the now-real `SnapshotResultDto` (currently discarded at line 90), renders success-state UI inside the existing Modal primitive with telescope icon + `--color-feedback-success` badge + file-path callouts (JetBrains Mono on `--color-raised-3`) + new `PresetPromptList` (4 buttons per chunk #43 `PRESET_PROMPT_DEFINITIONS` ids) + clipboard-write `aria-live="polite"` confirmation, all preserving the chunk #42 350ms supporting-moment + `useReducedMotion` gating. A standalone PII negative-canary integration test (deferred from phase-40 step 14) seeds synthetic OTLP spans with API-key/JWT/password-shape canary attributes, invokes the resolver, and asserts ZERO canary substring presence across the rendered markdown / clipboard payload / `agent-latest.jsonl` log file via CapturingSubscriber + `grep -F`. Architecturally chunk #44 relocates `SnapshotApiImpl` from `crates/ui-bridge/src/snapshot_ipc.rs` to `pulse-app/src/snapshot_runtime.rs` to match the existing `pulse-app/src/viz_routers.rs` precedent for resolvers that need buffer `Arc<Mutex<Connection>>` + `AppHandle` access (cleaner than adding buffer/viz/duckdb deps to ui-bridge); the `pulse:clipboard` + `pulse:notification` capability JSON files + xtask `EXPECTED_PROCEDURES` + `AllowList::production` registrations are unchanged.

1. **Relocate SnapshotApi trait + impl from ui-bridge to pulse-app.** Delete the `#[cfg(feature = "taurpc-runtime")] mod runtime` block from `crates/ui-bridge/src/snapshot_ipc.rs` (lines 32-105) including the `pub use runtime::{SnapshotApi, SnapshotApiImpl}` re-export (line 108). Keep `PRESET_PROMPT_DEFINITIONS` + `preset_prompts()` + `preset_label()` helpers as pub items (used by the relocated impl). Keep the existing 4 unit tests by moving them along with the impl. Update `crates/ui-bridge/src/lib.rs` to either remove `pub mod snapshot_ipc;` entirely OR reduce it to a types-only module. Create new file `pulse-app/src/snapshot_runtime.rs` holding the relocated `#[taurpc::procedures(path = "snapshot")]` trait definition + `SnapshotApiImpl` struct with new fields: `conn: Arc<Mutex<Connection>>, viz_state: Arc<VizState>, app_handle: AppHandle, data_dir: PathBuf`.

2. **Implement real `SnapshotApiImpl::generate` body.** Replace the chunk #43 placeholder (lines 65-104 of current `snapshot_ipc.rs`) with the real flow inside `pulse-app/src/snapshot_runtime.rs`:
   - (a) Resolve workspace via `workspace_root.map_or_else(|| std::env::current_dir(), |s| Ok(PathBuf::from(s)))` + `workspace_detector::detect()` for context fields (best-effort; non-fatal if detection fails — log basename-only and continue with a default project name).
   - (b) Load spans from `self.conn` via a `viz` crate query — recommend `viz::query::load_recent_spans(&conn, retention_seconds)` returning `Vec<snapshot::SpanRecord>` (verify exact signature at implement; if no such fn exists, add it as a thin wrapper around existing `traces.query` materialization keeping the SpanRecord shape per `crates/snapshot/src/contract.rs:32` byte-identity).
   - (c) Call `snapshot::curate(&spans)?` then `snapshot::format_markdown(&curated, TokenBudget::from(preset))?` (verify `From<SnapshotPreset> for TokenBudget` exists; if not, match-map inline).
   - (d) Generate ISO-timestamp `snapshot_id` (e.g., `chrono::Utc::now().format("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ").to_string()`); compose dual file paths `data_dir/snapshots/{snapshot_id}.md` + `.../{snapshot_id}.json`; canonicalize via `strict-path` and assert resolved paths live under `data_dir/snapshots/` per security plan §Input Validation row 4.
   - (e) `std::fs::create_dir_all` the snapshots/ subdir if missing; write `.md` (markdown body) and `.json` (serialized CurationOutput) atomically (`.tmp` + rename pattern matching `pulse-app/src/main.rs::write_pid_file` precedent line 178-184).
   - (f) Call `self.app_handle.clipboard().write_text(&markdown_report.body)` (sanitized AppError on failure via `From<tauri_plugin_clipboard_manager::Error> for AppError` impl — add to `crates/ui-bridge/src/contract.rs` mirroring existing `From<BufferError>` shape with constant message `"Clipboard write failed"` + warn-target `ui-bridge.error.internal`).
   - (g) Emit `self.app_handle.emit("pulse://stream/snapshot-progress", &serde_json::json!({"stage": "clipboard_written", "byte_count": markdown_byte_count, "snapshot_id": &snapshot_id}))` per arch §Standard Contracts Real-time push contract.
   - (h) Reload `Settings::load_from_data_dir(&self.data_dir)` (cheap I/O; alternative: cache + invalidate on update_settings — defer optimization until /implement profile shows it's needed); if `settings.notifications_enabled` is true, dispatch `self.app_handle.notification().builder().title("Snapshot ready").body(&format!("{} tokens, {} spans", curated.unique_spans.len(), curated.output_row_count)).show()` (sanitized AppError on dispatch failure — same `From` pattern).
   - (i) Compose `SnapshotResultDto { token_count: markdown_report.token_count_actual, markdown_path_basename: format!("{}.md", snapshot_id), json_path_basename: format!("{}.json", snapshot_id), preset_prompts: preset_prompts(), byte_count: markdown_byte_count, dedup_count: curated.dedup_count as u64 }`.
   - (j) Emit the 3 canonical tracing events with success-path values: `target: "snapshot.generate.request"` (fields: budget, result_kind="success", token_count, dual_file_paths_basenames=`format!("[{},{}]", md_basename, json_basename)`, preset_prompts_count=4), `target: "snapshot.clipboard.write"` (byte_count, success=true, dual_file_paths_basenames), `target: "snapshot.notification.dispatch"` (notification_kind="snapshot_ready", dispatch_success per gate-and-actual outcome). All emissions use `&'static str` literal targets per testing.md Session Addition 2026-05-10.
   - Return `Ok(dto)`.

3. **Wire AppHandle + buffer connection injection in `pulse-app/src/main.rs`.** Replace `use ui_bridge::snapshot_ipc::{SnapshotApi, SnapshotApiImpl};` (line 19) with `mod snapshot_runtime;` declaration (add to mod list near line 24-29) + `use snapshot_runtime::{SnapshotApi, SnapshotApiImpl};`. Move SnapshotApiImpl construction from router-build block (lines 266, 273) into the `.setup(move |app| { ... })` closure so `app.handle().clone()` is available. Use a pre-built Router builder + late `.merge(...)` inside setup OR an `Arc<OnceCell<AppHandle>>` pattern populated in setup. Either pattern lands cleanly; choose at /implement based on local Tauri 2 router-build API ergonomics. Dev-fallback `None` branch (line 268-275): SnapshotApiImpl is still merged, but the resolver returns `AppError::Storage { message: "buffer unavailable" }` early when called without a buffer connection (matches the existing degrade pattern for the ingest channel drain at line 309-313).

4. **Add `From<tauri_plugin_clipboard_manager::Error> for AppError` + `From<tauri_plugin_notification::Error> for AppError` impls in `crates/ui-bridge/src/contract.rs`.** Mirror existing `From<BufferError>` shape (sanitized constant message + `tracing::warn!(target: "ui-bridge.error.internal", error_category, source_kind, source_crate, "{message}")` + `AppError::Internal { message }`). Sanitization tests verify no struct names / paths / library versions / stack traces leak through the wire JSON. Add 2 paired tests (one positive resolver / one negative canary per plugin error variant) using the rstest precedent at line 1031-1080.

5. **Webview `preset-prompts.ts` (NEW file).** Create `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/preset-prompts.ts` exporting `PRESET_PROMPTS: ReadonlyArray<{id: string, label: string, template: string}>` with 4 entries matching Rust `PRESET_PROMPT_DEFINITIONS` ids: `"diagnose-latency-outlier"`, `"find-error-correlation"`, `"trace-failed-request"`, `"summarize-service-health"`. Template prose is short LLM-prompt-suffix text (e.g., `"Diagnose the latency outlier shown in the snapshot above. Identify the slowest service and its critical path."` for the first id) authored at /implement time per design extract contemplative observational voice. Templates are paste-to-LLM clipboard payloads — keep terse (≤200 chars) and observational.

6. **Webview `PresetPromptList.tsx` + test (NEW files).** Create `pulse-app/ui/src/components/PresetPromptList.tsx` rendering `
    ` with 4 `
    • ` items. Secondary button pattern per design extract: `bg-[var(--color-raised-1)] text-[var(--color-text-primary)] border border-[color:var(--border-subtle)] rounded-[var(--radius-sm)] px-[var(--spacing-sm)] py-[var(--spacing-xs)] min-w-[var(--target-button-min)] min-h-[var(--target-button-min)] focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-[var(--border-focus)] motion-reduce:transition-none`. `onPick(prompt: PresetPrompt)` callback prop. Create `pulse-app/ui/src/components/PresetPromptList.test.tsx` with 6 tests: native `

7. **Refine `InvestigationModalForm.tsx` result-state UI.** Modify `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/InvestigationModalForm.tsx` lines 88-101 to CAPTURE the `SnapshotResultDto` from `getClient().snapshot.generate(preset, null)` (currently discarded — assign to local state `setResult(dto)`). Add `const [result, setResult] = useState(null);` to component state (import type from bindings). Replace placeholder `

Snapshot ready.

` block (lines 172-184) with the real result UI: success badge `
Snapshot ready
` + file-path callout block (`{result.markdown_path_basename}` and `{result.json_path_basename}` rendered in `var(--font-code)` 12px tabular-nums on `var(--color-text-secondary)`) + `` mounted below + clipboard-write `aria-live="polite"` status region "Snapshot copied to clipboard ({result.byte_count} characters)" rendered once result is non-null. Implement `handlePresetPick` to concatenate `prompt.template + "\n\n" + markdown-from-clipboard-snapshot` and write to clipboard via `writeText(...)` from `@tauri-apps/plugin-clipboard-manager`, then update aria-live with "Prompt '{label}' copied to clipboard". On result arrival shift focus to the modal title heading (`document.getElementById('investigation-modal-title')?.focus()`) per a11y SC 2.4.3. Preserve 350ms supporting moment + `useReducedMotion` from existing line 71.

8. **Extend `InvestigationModalForm.test.tsx`.** Add 6 new tests to the existing test file: (a) success-path renders file-path callouts with correct basenames after IPC mock returns `SnapshotResultDto`; (b) success-path renders 4 PresetPromptList buttons; (c) aria-live `"Snapshot copied to clipboard ({N} characters)"` fires once result lands; (d) clicking a preset-prompt button writes prompt template + snapshot to clipboard (via `vi.mocked(writeText)` assertion); (e) focus shifts to modal title heading on result arrival; (f) error-state preserves existing sanitized AppError message rendering (regression coverage). Use `vi.hoisted(() => ({ writeText: vi.fn() }))` + `vi.mock("@tauri-apps/plugin-clipboard-manager", () => ({ writeText }))` pattern + `afterEach(() => vi.unstubAllGlobals())` per testing.md Session Additions. Real-timer `waitFor(..., {timeout: 2000})` for the 350ms supporting moment + IPC round-trip.

9. **PII negative-canary integration test.** Add to `pulse-app/src/snapshot_runtime.rs::tests` module (relocated alongside the impl). Test name: `generate_does_not_log_snapshot_or_clipboard_or_workspace_path_canaries`. Seed buffer via direct `Connection::execute("INSERT INTO spans ...", ...)` with synthetic spans containing canary strings in 3 surfaces: (a) attribute value `("api_key", "secret-canary-API-key-12345")`; (b) service_name `"service-with-pii_canary_token_value-suffix"`; (c) workspace path that includes the substring `/should-not-appear-in-logs/`. Run snapshot.generate end-to-end with a mock AppHandle (use `tauri::test::mock_app()` or equivalent if available; otherwise structure the test to bypass AppHandle via dependency injection on the adapter trait). Use CapturingSubscriber to capture ALL events on `snapshot.*` + `workspace.*` targets. Assert: ZERO `event.fields_str()` contains any canary substring; ZERO `event.message()` contains any canary substring; verify the `markdown` output of `snapshot::curate()` + `format_markdown()` (the would-be clipboard payload) ALSO does not echo the canary attribute value verbatim (the attribute_filter chunk #40 keeps only allowlisted attribute keys — verify allowlist excludes `api_key`).

10. **Bindings regeneration.** Run `cargo nextest run -p pulse-app --test emit_taurpc_bindings` after Rust changes land. Since chunk #44 introduces no new procedure or DTO shape (SnapshotResultDto + PresetPromptDto + WorkspaceContextDto already exist in chunk #43 substrate), the regenerated `pulse-app/ui/src/bindings/index.ts` should be a no-op delta — but commit any regeneration produced by the build.

11. **Boot-smoke gate execution.** Run `npx @tauri-apps/cli dev` with 60s timeout after Rust changes land; watch stdout for `Local:` / `ready in` / `Compiled successfully` markers; SIGTERM the process cleanly. Record smoke status (success / failure / skipped-headless / skipped-no-cli) in commit message body per testing.md Session Addition 2026-05-09 `boot-smoke-coverage`. Chunk #44 modifies `pulse-app/src/main.rs` (router setup + new module decl) — direct boot-touching surface area.

- `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/preset-prompts.ts` — `PRESET_PROMPTS` const with 4 preset prompt entries (id + label + template).
- `pulse-app/ui/src/components/PresetPromptList.tsx` — Semantic-button-list component with aria-label / target-size / focus-visible / motion-reduce; `onPick` callback.
- `pulse-app/ui/src/components/PresetPromptList.test.tsx` — 6 tests covering semantic / aria / keyboard / target-size / onPick / nested-focusable validation.

1. **SnapshotApiImpl location: stay in `ui-bridge` or relocate to `pulse-app/src/snapshot_runtime.rs`?**
   - **Stay in ui-bridge**: requires adding `buffer` + `viz` deps to `crates/ui-bridge/Cargo.toml` (or wiring through a trait abstraction with a small adapter); requires deferred-AppHandle pattern (`Arc<OnceCell<AppHandle>>`) since SnapshotApiImpl is currently constructed before setup closure. **Pro**: minimal `main.rs` churn. **Con**: ui-bridge gains heavyweight deps (buffer pulls duckdb, viz pulls query infrastructure) — increases the substrate-crate footprint contrary to its role.
   - **Relocate to pulse-app**: mirrors `viz_routers.rs` + `streams.rs` precedent; `SnapshotApiImpl::new(Arc::clone(conn), Arc::clone(&viz_state), app_handle)` constructable inside setup closure with all needed handles; ui-bridge reduces back to trait-only (or drops `snapshot_ipc` entirely if pulse-app provides the trait via its own module). **Pro**: matches existing convention, keeps ui-bridge substrate-pure, AppHandle injection straightforward. **Con**: larger `main.rs` patch (`use ui_bridge::snapshot_ipc::...` → `mod snapshot_runtime;`); requires re-exporting `SnapshotApi` trait from `pulse-app/src/snapshot_runtime.rs` to satisfy `#[taurpc::procedures(path = "snapshot")]` macro placement constraints.

2. **Should `InvestigationContext` be extended with `snapshotResult` state, OR should `InvestigationModalForm` hold result state locally?**

3. **Span-load entry point for snapshot.generate runtime body**: query DuckDB directly via the held `Arc<Mutex<Connection>>`, OR call into the existing `viz` crate's query functions?
   - **Direct DuckDB**: simpler one-shot SQL query `SELECT * FROM spans WHERE ts > now() - INTERVAL '{retention} minutes'`; requires duplicating Row → SpanRecord materialization that the viz crate already does.
   - **Via viz crate**: reuses existing materialization (trace row → SpanRecord); adds dep on viz from snapshot resolver code (already imported by pulse-app at line 22 `use viz::VizState`).
   - **Recommendation**: Via viz crate (lower duplication; existing battle-tested SQL + materialization).

4. **PresetPrompt template content**: phase-40/plan.md step 10 lists 4 ids + labels but does not specify `template` text strings. Where does the prompt template prose live — `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/preset-prompts.ts` (TS-only) OR mirror in Rust at `crates/snapshot/src/preset_prompts.rs` for SSR / E2E test access?
   - **Recommendation**: TS-only initially (the templates are paste-to-LLM clipboard payloads, never rendered server-side); cite phase-40/plan.md step 10 as the source of truth for ids; user defines specific template prose at /implement time. Document the 4 ids inline in preset-prompts.ts.

5. **Notification permission permission name verification**: chunk #43 substrate landed `notification:allow-notify` + `notification:allow-show` + `notification:allow-is-permission-granted` + `notification:allow-request-permission`. Per phase-40/plan.md Implementation note "verify against installed crate docs at /implement step 7" — does the Rust API call `app.notification().builder().title(...).body(...).show()` succeed with these 4 permissions, OR does it require additional `notification:allow-builder`-style permission?

body: _Generated by /andromeda-phase Phase 4. Read by /andromeda-implement. Manual edits between runs are fine; do not edit during /implement run._
- **Phase number:** 42

- **Route chunks covered:**
  - route#45 "wasmtime Component Model + WIT — wasmtime 25+ Cranelift-on-x86_64, 3 plugin categories (custom-dashboard/data-transform/snapshot-template), epoch_interruption"
- **Epoch:** 7 — Plugin runtime + MCP server (OPENER)

Establish the wasmtime 25+ Component Model + WIT substrate inside `crates/plugins/` (one of 8 reserved library crates per arch §Occupied Resources). Chunk #45 is the Epoch 7 opener: it introduces the `wasmtime::Config` posture (Cranelift backend on x86_64, `epoch_interruption(true)`, `max_wasm_http_fields_size` bound) per security plan §API Security "Plugin host capability sandbox" + §Anti-Patterns Data Protection row 1 (April 2026 CVE cluster); creates 3 WIT interface schemas (`custom-dashboard.wit` / `data-transform.wit` / `snapshot-template.wit`) under `crates/plugins/wit/` per arch §Conventions File naming + §Infrastructure Patterns project directory structure; and lays the foundation for chunks #46 (capability sandbox + ResourceLimiter) and #47 (plugin loader + `plugins.*` TauRPC routers) to extend without retroactive Engine reconstruction.

This chunk is **substrate-only**. No plugin loader is wired (chunk #47); no TauRPC procedure is registered (`plugins.list` / `plugins.reload` / `plugins.invoke` are chunk #47); no `pulse-app/capabilities/` JSON entry is added; no `xtask/src/main.rs::EXPECTED_PROCEDURES` extension is needed. No webview surface is touched (design + layouts returned `## No domain coverage`). The chunk's host-side runtime is library code only; testing happens via unit tests co-located in `crates/plugins/src/`. The a11y domain contributes WIT-doc-comment obligations on the `custom-dashboard.wit` contract (semantic-HTML-first / reduced-motion respect / no `host.force-motion()` import) so downstream plugin authors inherit the host's WCAG 2.1 AA + SC 2.3.3 AAA discipline at the boundary contract — without requiring runtime enforcement in this chunk.

The obs domain contributes the canonical `#[tracing::instrument(skip(input, output))]` pattern on host-side wasmtime wrappers (mirrored from `crates/workspace-detector/src/detect.rs:20-49`), with basename-only path logging per security plan §Logging Vector 3. Heartbeat task (`plugins.tick`) is deferred to chunk #47 when loader state exists — see §Implementation notes for rationale.
Add to root `Cargo.toml` `[workspace.dependencies]` block (near line 90-95, alongside existing receiver/buffer deps):
- `wasmtime = { version = "25", features = ["component-model"] }` — Component Model runtime; Cranelift is default on x86_64 so no explicit feature.

- `wasmtime-wasi = { version = "25" }` — OPTIONAL; include only if any of the 3 WIT categories needs `wasi:io` / `wasi:logging` / similar standard WASI imports. Default to NOT including unless one of the WIT contracts demands it.

Pin discipline: verify chosen version remediates April 2026 advisory cluster (CVE-2026-27572 / CVE-2026-34941 / CVE-2026-35195) via `cargo audit` — if 25.0.x is unpatched, bump to 25.1.x or later. Confirm at /implement Phase 2 gate run.
Update `crates/plugins/Cargo.toml`:
- `[dependencies]` block: add `wasmtime.workspace = true` + `tracing.workspace = true`; keep existing `thiserror.workspace = true`. Add `wasmtime-wasi.workspace = true` ONLY if Step 1 includes it.

- Add a new `[dev-dependencies]` block: `tempfile.workspace = true`, `rstest.workspace = true`. `proptest.workspace = true` is OPTIONAL (only if WIT-parser property-based tests are pursued per tests extract).

title: Step 3 — Create crates/plugins/wit/ directory with 3 WIT schemas + README

data.head: ### Step 3 — Create crates/plugins/wit/ directory with 3 WIT schemas + README

body: Create `crates/plugins/wit/custom-dashboard.wit`:
- WIT `world` declaration enumerating ONLY host imports a custom-dashboard plugin author needs (host imports define the capability surface; minimal set per security extract).

- Doc-comment block at the world level (or interface level) enumerating a11y obligations a plugin author MUST honor (semantic HTML first / ARIA roles / focus management / contrast / reduced-motion per a11y extract §11 Anti-Patterns + §6 Motion tokens). The doc-comment is informational at this chunk — downstream chunks/plugin-authors are expected to honor.
- NO `host.disable-reduced-motion()` / `host.force-motion()` / `host.override-animation-preference()` exposed (per a11y acceptance criterion).

- Categories not yet returning UI output (e.g., a render-callback shape returning structured records) MAY be sketched as v1 contracts; richer DOM-emission protocols deferred to plugin-author-facing chunks beyond #49.
Create `crates/plugins/wit/data-transform.wit`:
- WIT `world` with non-UI host imports only (e.g., data-mapping callbacks, Arrow-style record-batch transforms). NO DOM-emission imports.
- Header doc-comment explicitly documenting this as a non-UI category (per a11y acceptance criterion).
Create `crates/plugins/wit/snapshot-template.wit`:
- WIT `world` with non-UI host imports only (e.g., markdown formatting hooks). NO DOM-emission imports.
- Header doc-comment explicitly documenting this as a non-UI category (per a11y acceptance criterion).
Create `crates/plugins/wit/README.md`:

- Brief enumeration of the 3 categories, their host import sets, and rationale per security extract ("3 WIT interface categories MUST declare ONLY host imports the guest needs ... documented in `crates/plugins/wit/` README"). 1-2 paragraphs per category sufficient.
Files use `kebab-case.wit` per arch §Conventions File naming.

title: Step 4 — Create crates/plugins/src/engine.rs (substrate config + Engine builder)

data.head: ### Step 4 — Create crates/plugins/src/engine.rs (substrate config + Engine builder)

body: Implement `crates/plugins/src/engine.rs` mirroring the `crates/buffer/src/schema.rs:1-186` centralized-substrate pattern:
- Module-level doc-comment naming the chunk + purpose.

- Pub fn `build_engine() -> Result<Engine, Error>` returning a configured `wasmtime::Engine`:
  - `Config::epoch_interruption(true)` — REQUIRED; the architecture-declared timeout mechanism (per security extract Constraint #1).
  - `Config::max_wasm_http_fields_size(<bounded value>)` — REQUIRED; anchors CVE-2026-27572. Choose conservative bound (e.g., 64 KB or smaller; matches buffer-style 8 MB cap from arch §Inherited Defaults but for HTTP fields specifically — `wasmtime` default may already be conservative; verify and document the chosen bound).
  - Cranelift backend implicit (no explicit `Config::strategy(Strategy::Winch)` — security extract Anti-Pattern #1).

- `#[tracing::instrument(skip_all, fields(...))]` on `build_engine()` — fields `cranelift_enabled`, `epoch_interruption_enabled`, `max_wasm_http_fields_size_bytes`, `duration_ms`; mirror the `Span::current().record(...)` post-fact pattern from `crates/workspace-detector/src/detect.rs:20-49`.

- `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` with at minimum: `engine_builds_with_epoch_interruption_enabled`, `engine_builds_with_max_wasm_http_fields_size_set`, `engine_uses_cranelift_backend_on_x86_64` (build-time / config-introspection assertion).

title: Step 5 — Create crates/plugins/src/wit_loader.rs (or equivalent — WIT parsing + Component instantiation helpers)

data.head: ### Step 5 — Create crates/plugins/src/wit_loader.rs (or equivalent — WIT parsing + Component instantiation helpers)

body: Implement `crates/plugins/src/wit_loader.rs`:

- Either invoke `wasmtime::component::bindgen!(...)` macro for the 3 WIT category schemas (generates Rust types from WIT), OR use `wit-parser` crate for runtime WIT loading. Decide at /implement Phase 1 based on what the chunk's API surface needs. Recommendation: use `bindgen!` for type safety + ergonomics; the generated code is excluded from coverage (per tests acceptance criterion).
- Pub fn `parse_wit_world(category: &PluginCategory) -> Result<WitWorld, Error>` — loads WIT schema for one of 3 categories.

- Pub fn `load_component(bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<Component, Error>` — wraps `wasmtime::component::Component::from_binary(...)` with the chunk's `Engine` + size-limit check; emits `wasmtime.instantiate` span per obs extract.

- Pub fn `instantiate_component_with_linker(engine: &Engine, component: &Component, linker: &ComponentLinker<T>) -> Result<Instance, Error>` — wraps Component instantiation; emits `plugin.engine.init` style span.

- `Linker` (or `ComponentLinker`) construction sites in this file MUST contain NO `func_wrap` / `define_*` calls outside what each WIT contract declares — host imports are determined by WIT world declarations, not by ad-hoc host-side wiring (per security extract Anti-Pattern #2).
- `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` with rstest parametric WIT parse-tree tests across the 3 categories (`#[case("custom-dashboard")]` / `#[case("data-transform")]` / `#[case("snapshot-template")]`).
Update the `Error` enum in `crates/plugins/src/contract.rs`:
- Keep `Placeholder` variant (referenced by existing `From<PluginsError> for AppError` impl in `crates/ui-bridge/src/contract.rs:389` — removing breaks compile).

- Add new substrate-specific variants:
  - `EngineInit { reason: String }` — wasmtime Engine construction failure.
  - `WitLoad { plugin_id: String, reason: String }` — WIT schema load / parse failure.
  - `ComponentInstantiate { plugin_id: String, reason: String }` — Component instantiation / link failure.
- Optionally add a `PluginCategory` enum (`CustomDashboard` / `DataTransform` / `SnapshotTemplate`) if `wit_loader.rs` uses one.
- Maintain `#[derive(Debug, Error)]` + `#[error("...")]` attributes per arch §Conventions Error response schema.
Update module declarations:
- Keep `pub mod contract;`.
- Add `pub mod engine;` (Step 4 substrate module).
- Add `pub mod wit_loader;` (Step 5 — or whatever name lands).
- DO NOT add `pub use wasmtime::Engine` or any `pub use` re-export of external wasmtime types (per arch extract Anti-Pattern #2 + security extract Patterns §wasmtime Config builder isolated).

data.head: ### Chunk route#46: "Capability sandbox + ResourceLimiter — per-Store memory cap 64MB / table / instance, capability-scoped WIT host imports, basename-only path logging"

body: **Constraints across domains:**

- (security) Per-Store `wasmtime::ResourceLimiter` MUST cap memory at 64 MB plus tables and instances on every Store created for guest invocation (per security-plan §API Security row "Plugin host capability sandbox" + §Threat Model Summary "plugin host" trust boundary + §Security Decisions Log 2026-05-02 wasmtime resource-bounds reasoning).
