- (security) SHA-pin every third-party Action introduced by this chunk: `<owner>/<repo>@<40-char-SHA> # vX.Y.Z`; NEVER `@v2` / `@latest` (per security plan §Bootstrap phases `dep-security-ci-gate` + §Anti-Patterns §Secrets row 3; chunk #53 precedent 11/11 SHA-pinned).

- (security) Workflow-level `permissions: contents: read` default + per-job elevation only on baseline-publish step (per security plan §Secret Management §GitHub Environment scoping + §Anti-Patterns §Secrets row 4).
- (security) `step-security/harden-runner` SHA-pinned MUST be first step of every new CI job with `egress-policy: audit` initially (per security plan §Bootstrap phases `dep-security-ci-gate`).

- (security) Perf SLO load generator MUST speak OTLP via `:4317`/`:4318`; NO in-process test-mode bypass; synthetic spans MUST pass post-`prost` invariants + 8MB size caps (per security plan §Input Validation rows 1-2 + §Anti-Patterns §Input rows 1+3+5).

- (security) Violation-JSON regression baseline artifacts MUST NOT contain OTLP attribute values or DuckDB query parameter values (per security plan §Logging & Monitoring + §Anti-Patterns §Logging rows 1+3).

- (security) NO new TauRPC procedure / capability identifier without quadruple binding (router + capability JSON + `EXPECTED_PROCEDURES` + `emit_taurpc_bindings` test) (per security.md §Session Additions 2026-05-12); preferred lower-cost alternative: extend `Settings` (per security.md 2026-05-09).
- (security) NO secret-equivalent material in violation-JSON or criterion-bench artifacts checked into repo (per security plan §Secret Management + §Anti-Patterns §Secrets row 1).

- (design) Motion gate MUST verify `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` degrades chrome (200ms fade → 0ms; 150ms hover → 0ms) AND Halo State Pulse degrades to static glow с hue still updating per error rate (per design-system.md §Motion accessibility row + §Motion hard limits).

- (design) Audit MUST enforce 7 motion hard-limit bans: NO parallax / scroll animations / spring physics / staggered reveals / 3D transforms / canvas-WebGL outside Halo / opacity fades >200ms (per design-system.md §Motion hard limits + §Downstream Readiness).

- (design) Perf SLO threshold (10k spans/sec ≥30 fps) MUST measure ONLY Halo State Pulse / Latency River canvas layer; data-driven canvas motion is separate dimension from chrome budget (per design-system.md §Motion preamble + §Decisions Log 2026-05-02).

- (design) Contrast verification honors chunk #12 revision: `accent/base` is non-text token с target 3.0:1 SC 1.4.11 (NOT 4.5:1); body-size error message TEXT uses `--color-text-primary` paired с `--color-accent` border + icon (per design-system.md §Decisions Log 2026-05-03 + §Color Palette Text Hierarchy).

- (design) Per-surface tuple regression baseline MUST cover all three Halo touchpoints (full dashboard / compact widget / tray icon static-glow fallback acceptable when WebGPU absent) (per design-system.md §Self-Validation Protocol Signature Test).

- (design) Audit assertions reference only locked token set: NASA palette colors + JetBrains Mono + IBM Plex Sans + 4px spacing + radius (sm/md/lg/full) + motion duration (150/200/250/350ms); banned-fonts regression includes Inter/Roboto/Arial/Helvetica/Open Sans/Lato/system-ui-default/Space Grotesk (per design-system.md §Anti-Patterns Universal Bans).

- (layouts) Per-surface tuple regression baselines MUST enumerate canonical surface set: compact widget, full dashboard (Traces / Metrics / Logs / Snapshots / Settings sub-screens), tray icon (per layout-templates.md §Surface: desktop-webview + §Surface: desktop-native Primary screens).

- (layouts) WebGPU frame-rate budget measured against TWO canvas-bearing contexts: (a) compact widget unified halo, (b) full dashboard Traces view per-service halos; tray icon halo NOT subject to webview budget (per layout-templates.md §Wireframe — Compact widget + §Wireframe — Full dashboard).

- (layouts) Reduced-motion verification exercises both Halo rendering contexts AND chrome transitions; canonical degradation: static glow, no rhythm, hue still updates (per layout-templates.md §Component — Halo State Pulse canvas Reduced motion).

- (layouts) Modal layout contexts in scope for focus-trap + Escape-dismiss audit: Investigation modal + Settings modal (same overlay-card pattern; restore focus к trigger on close) (per layout-templates.md §Component — Investigation modal + §Component — Settings modal).

- (layouts) OS-native tray menu OUT-OF-SCOPE for axe/Lighthouse/pa11y DOM audits (NSMenu/ContextMenuStrip/GTK — not DOM tree); covered by Foundation chunk #14 manual SR test spec (per layout-templates.md §Component — Tray menu).
- (tests) Standard-tier coverage thresholds remain ≥75% line / ≥70% branch / ≥85% function via `cargo-llvm-cov` 0.8.5 (per test-plan §10 Quality Gates + Standard tier).

- (tests) WebGPU 10k spans/sec perf budget agent-driven at throughput layer only: assert buffer ingests 100k spans in 10s without dropping + memory bounded; frame-rate ≥30 fps frame-buffer inspection deferred к tauri-driver headful (per test-plan §1 `performance-budget: WebGPU canvas throughput`).

- (tests) Performance budget table: `WebGPU 10k spans/sec — p50 ≥30 fps / p95 ≥25 fps / p99 ≥20 fps` (test-plan §10); Snapshot p99 ≤500ms + OTLP gRPC p99 ≤100ms + DuckDB appender p99 ≤50ms remain in scope.
- (tests) Zero-flakiness budget: any a11y violation or frame-rate flake → immediate quarantine (`#[ignore]` + issue); NO retry-once / auto-retry policies (per test-plan §10).

- (tests) Tuple regression detection structure must be agent-parseable (exit code + structured JSON/log line); no human review of axe/Lighthouse/pa11y reports (per test-plan §2 Agent-runnable invariants).

- (tests) Standard gate baseline includes `cargo fmt --check` + `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` + `cargo nextest run --workspace --profile ci` + `cargo xtask capability-drift` + webview gates (per test-plan §12 Decisions Log 2026-05-10 + testing.md `chunk-gate-baseline-coverage`).

- (tests) Boot smoke gate conditional: only required if chunk touches `pulse-app/src/main.rs` / `crates/ui-bridge/src/` / `pulse-app/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json` / `pulse-app/capabilities/*.json` (per testing.md `boot-smoke-coverage` 2026-05-09); verify at plan time.

- (obs) §10 Performance budget — WebGPU canvas frame: p50 16ms, p95 20ms, **p99 ≤33ms** (30 fps target); backed by `tracing` events at `metric.webgpu.frame_duration_ms`; SLO enforced via CI post-test `jq` p99 aggregation.

- (obs) §10 Performance budget — buffer memory bounded: p99 ≤512 MB at 10k spans/sec over 10-min window; backed by `tracing` at `metric.buffer.memory_bytes` per heartbeat tick; CI tail-and-max post-test.

- (obs) §5 Metric event naming: `metric.webgpu.frame_duration_ms` Distribution unit ms with `wgpu_backend` + `webview_backend` + `timing_method` labels; throughput target `metric.buffer.ingest_throughput_spans_per_sec` с `spans_per_sec` + `dropped_span_count`.
- (obs) §10 Zero-unlogged-panics invariant applies to any new audit harness path; panic hook captures + structured backtrace logged.
- (obs) §9 Criterion bench JSON on perf-budget regression: `target/criterion/<bench>/new/estimates.json` uploaded as CI artifact + parsed for stable-hardware regression detection.
- (obs) §9 CI-specific default fields: any new `tracing-subscriber` setup must extend `with_default_fields([service.name, service.version, deployment.environment, ci.run.id, git.commit.sha])`.

- (obs) §8 Default-deny allowlist: violation-JSON tests MUST NOT log raw violation `html` / DOM `outerHTML` strings; emit `wcag_criterion` + `selector` + `severity` + `surface` only (binding к a11y violation schema).

- (obs) §Decisions Log 2026-05-04 PII grep heuristic UI-vocab exemption: literal secret-format regexes (`Bearer [a-zA-Z0-9]{40,}`, `password=[^\s]+`, `api_key=[^\s]+`, `AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}`, `sk-[a-zA-Z0-9]{40,}`, `ghp_[a-zA-Z0-9]{36}`, `xox[baprs]-[0-9a-zA-Z-]{10,}`) — NOT bare words "token"/"password"/"auth"/"key".

- (a11y) Standard tier WCAG 2.1 AA full sweep с axe-core `runOnly: { type: 'tag', values: ['wcag2a', 'wcag2aa', 'wcag21aa', 'wcag22aa'] }`; `wcag22aa` mandatory (SC 2.5.8) (per a11y plan §3 + §3.5 a11y-tooling-install).

- (a11y) AAA escalation SC 2.3.3 Animation from Interactions enforced via Lighthouse 12.x + Playwright `page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: 'reduce' })` — verifies `--duration-*` → 0ms, Halo degrades, state still conveyed via color + text + focus (per a11y plan §3 Trigger-pulled AAA + §6 Motion tokens).

- (a11y) Per-PR tuple regression gate: `{surface, wcag_criterion, selector, severity}` tuple diff vs base-branch `a11y-violations-summary.json`; fail PR on any new tuple NOT in baseline (per a11y plan §3 CI Integration + §10 "Zero new violations per PR").

- (a11y) Critical paths P1-P7 each have at least one axe-core/Lighthouse/pa11y JSON run covering universal trio (SC 2.1.1 Keyboard + SC 2.4.3 Focus Order + SC 4.1.2 Name/Role/Value) plus path-specific SCs (per a11y plan §3 Critical paths).

- (a11y) Manual SR/keyboard/contrast FORBIDDEN as sole evidence; every WCAG SC has machine-verifiable path (axe/pa11y/Lighthouse JSON OR Playwright structured JSON OR colorjs.io numeric) (per a11y plan §Agent-driven invariant + §11 Universal anti-patterns).

- (a11y) Violation JSON schema required fields: `wcag_criterion`, `violation_type`, `severity`, `surface`, `selector`, `remediation`, `tool`, `tool_result_id` (per a11y plan §3 Structured violation JSON schema).

- (a11y) Perf SLO (10k spans/sec ≥30 fps) MUST coexist с reduced-motion respect — perf gate cannot pass by disabling motion (per a11y plan §10 SLO Invariants + §6 Motion tokens reduced-motion override).

- (arch) A11y + perf gate scripts and CI workflow logic live in `xtask/` OR `.github/workflows/ci.yml` extensions — NEVER a new top-level crate; 10 reserved workspace crate names LOCKED (per arch §Occupied Resources Cargo workspace crate names).

- (arch) Perf SLO measurement of `metric.webgpu.frame_duration_ms` consumes existing `telemetry.frontend.record_frame_ms` TauRPC procedure (ui-bridge crate, chunk #29); NO new procedure (per arch §Occupied Resources + §Architecture Registry Updates 2026-05-09).

- (arch) 10k spans/sec synthetic injection drives OTLP `:4317`/`:4318` on `127.0.0.1` only — same surface as production SDKs; no in-process test bypass (per arch §Cross-cutting Patterns Test-time telemetry injection).

- (arch) Webview a11y harness scripts sit under `pulse-app/ui/` (or invoke against built bundle); NOT inside any `crates/*` library crate (per arch §Infrastructure Patterns Project directory structure).

- (arch) Audit artifacts resolve via existing `ANDROMEDA_PULSE_DATA_DIR` OR `target/` or `pulse-app/ui/test-results/`; do NOT invent new `ANDROMEDA_PULSE_*` env var (per arch §Occupied Resources Environment variables).
- (arch) Single-process modular monolith constraint: one `pulse-app` binary serves ingest + buffer + viz; NO out-of-process orchestrator spawning multiple instances (per arch §Design Philosophy).
**Patterns к follow:**

- (security) Chunk #53 `pulse-app/tests/distribution_manifests.rs` shape for workflow self-lint regression — pure file-read + substring/pattern assertion (mirror for `pulse-app/tests/a11y_perf_workflow.rs` if introduced).
- (security) Existing chunk #18-#21 OTLP receiver discipline — perf load-gen reuses production receiver path; rate limiting + Host-header allowlist + CORS deny stay active.
- (security) Existing `xtask capability-drift` gate (chunk #27) — couple `EXPECTED_PROCEDURES` extension with consuming chunk if new procedures added (per security.md 2026-05-10).
- (security) Existing AppError sanitization at TauRPC bridge — perf SLO failures surfaced to webview carry sanitized one-liners (no struct names / paths / library versions / panic chains).

- (design) Violation-JSON regression baseline shape: extend chunk #12 contrast harness output pattern (`pulse-app/ui/dist/contrast-report.json`) per-pair `{usage, target_ratio, wcag_criterion, current_ratio, status}` — extend с `{wcag_criterion, selector, severity}` per chunk #54 title.
- (design) Focus ring assertion target: 3–4px outset color `#4A90E2`, `box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(74,144,226,0.2)` OR `outline: 3px solid #4A90E2`; all interactives Tab-navigable с `:focus-visible`.
- (design) Reduced-motion degradation pattern for Halo: hue continues per error rate (LCH interpolation preserved), rhythm (0.8–2.4 Hz / 4–16px blur) becomes static — NOT canvas freeze.
- (design) Skeleton loader motion respects expression-0.35: discrete 50ms on/off opacity pulse (NOT smooth fade); reduced-motion degrades к static skeleton.
- (layouts) Per-surface enumeration pattern: violation-JSON baseline mirrors authoritative surface inventory as top-level keys for diagnostic per-surface diffs.
- (layouts) Halo State Pulse cross-surface coordination: same shader, same `pulse://stream/spans` feed; perf gate measures shared shader path к catch regressions in shared pipeline.
- (layouts) Modal pattern reuse: Investigation + Settings share overlay structure — single focus-trap audit shape applies к both.
- (layouts) Custom titlebar `data-tauri-drag-region` non-focusable by design; axe/pa11y should not flag as "missing accessible name".
- (tests) Per-surface tuple baseline: violation JSON tuples per surface compared to checked-in baseline; pattern mirrors `proptest-regressions/` from test-plan §7.

- (tests) Self-bootstrapping perf-test data: `tonic` gRPC client custom load-driver into live `:4317`; NO external tool (k6/vegeta) per test-plan §12; `MockTraceSpan::builder()` fixture factories; `tempfile::TempDir` per-test isolation.
- (tests) JUnit XML output: `target/junit-{name}.xml` matching `cargo-nextest --message-format junit` shape for `dorny/test-reporter` surfacing.

- (tests) Test command discipline for headful-deferred chunks: per-surface a11y assertions as agent-driven static analysis (`@axe-core/playwright` against jsdom-rendered React tree OR Lighthouse CLI against built bundle); NOT tauri-driver headful (per testing.md 2026-05-13).
- (tests) CapturingSubscriber + FieldCollector pattern (testing.md 2026-05-11): if violation-JSON emits via `tracing` events, reuse in-process subscriber for negative-canary assertions.
- (obs) §5 Metric emission convention: `tracing::info!(target: "metric.{module}.{measure}", value = N, ...)` — NO OTel Meter / Histogram / Counter; agent computes p99 via `jq`-style tail aggregation.
- (obs) §10 CI gates pattern: `xtask bench` produces criterion JSON + post-bench p99 assertion via `jq` over `metric.*` events; build fails on p99 > 33ms.

- (obs) §10 Heartbeat-gap CI gate pattern (`xtask/ci/heartbeat-gap-check.sh`): perf SLO regression detector mirrors shape — parse `timestamp` per event, compute deltas per surface, aggregate p99, assert SLO or exit 1.
- (obs) §9 Pipeline integration: violation-JSON tuple baselines + current-run JSON uploaded as third sibling artifact class к logs + curated-snapshot.

- (obs) §3 Snapshot integration self-observation: agent reads `~/.andromeda-pulse/logs/agent-latest.jsonl` for triage; per-surface tuple regression artifact uploaded alongside log file mirroring criterion JSON pattern.
- (a11y) Tagged axe-core ruleset: `runOnly: { type: 'tag', values: ['wcag2a', 'wcag2aa', 'wcag21aa', 'wcag22aa'] }` (Standard tier baseline).

- (a11y) Per-PR regression via artifact diff: download base-branch `a11y-violations-summary.json` via `actions/download-artifact@v4` (name `a11y-violations-base`) + jq-style tuple filter + emit `regression-set.json` audit artifact.

- (a11y) Reduced-motion test pattern: Playwright `page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: 'reduce' })` → verify computed `transition-duration: 0s` / `animation-duration: 0s` per `motion-reduce:` Tailwind variants.
- (a11y) Contrast dual-tool: axe-core color-contrast rule + colorjs.io 0.6.x `getComputedStyle().getPropertyValue('--color-token-name')` for token-binding verification.

- (a11y) JSON artifact layout: emit к `~/.andromeda-pulse/logs/` 5 canonical files: `a11y-axe-core-results.jsonl`, `a11y-lighthouse-results.json`, `a11y-pa11y-results.json`, `a11y-keyboard-focus-results.jsonl`, `a11y-violations-summary.json`.
- (a11y) Reuse tests' 5-command harness: `npm run test:a11y` OR `cargo xtask test:a11y` reuses `boot` / `run` / `status` / `cleanup` / `logs` driver.
- (arch) xtask harness pattern: new audit subcommand (e.g., `cargo xtask audit-a11y` / `cargo xtask perf-slo`) mirrors chunk #51 `cargo xtask smoke` shape for machine-parseable output.
- (arch) Reuse existing `health` + `ready` introspection as perf-harness gates ("await ready before injecting 10k spans/sec") rather than reinventing.
- (arch) Reuse Tauri Channel API `pulse://stream/spans` + `pulse://stream/metrics` for live observation during perf runs; no new event names.
- (arch) Self-observation file exporter: `tracing` JSON logs under `~/.andromeda-pulse/logs/` provide structured audit-time observability without OTel SDK.
- (arch) Per-surface frame-budget via existing `metric.webgpu.frame_duration_ms` emitted by `telemetry.frontend.record_frame_ms` (no sibling capture path).
**Anti-patterns к avoid:**
- (security) NEVER `@v2` / floating-tag any new a11y/perf CI Action (per §Anti-Patterns §Secrets row 3); workflow self-lint grep returns zero matches.
- (security) NEVER `tokio::process::Command::new(...).arg(user_input)` in perf SLO harness or a11y audit driver (MCP STDIO command-injection cluster anchor; per §Anti-Patterns §Code Patterns row 1).
- (security) NEVER bind perf SLO test infrastructure to `0.0.0.0` — loopback only (per §Anti-Patterns §API row 8).
- (security) NEVER bypass post-`prost`-decode invariants in load generator (per §Anti-Patterns §Input row 3).
- (security) NEVER widen `permissions:` to workflow-level `contents: write` (per §Anti-Patterns §Secrets row 4).
- (security) NEVER check in violation-JSON baselines or criterion-bench artifacts containing raw OTLP attribute values or DuckDB query parameter values (per §Anti-Patterns §Logging rows 1+3).

- (design) NEVER let audit assertion set drift toward "delightful" motion tolerance — bounce easing, spring physics, 500ms+ chrome durations remain banned; Investigation Capture Collapse 250–350ms is the documented exception.
- (design) NEVER baseline-quarantine violations by widening design token set к accommodate non-palette hex — audit must fail-hard.
- (design) NEVER assert state via color alone — every "Use of Color" violation paired с text label or icon.
- (layouts) Do NOT collapse surface inventory for baseline (e.g., "full dashboard" as single tuple-key); Traces / Metrics / Logs / Snapshots / Settings each have distinct DOM trees.
- (layouts) Do NOT measure 30 fps perf budget against tray icon halo (separate OS-native overlay window, not webview frame_duration_ms stream).

- (layouts) Do NOT test reduced-motion compliance by asserting "no canvas frames rendered" — Halo degrades к static glow that STILL updates hue per error rate; verification is "frequency envelope absent" + "hue still data-driven", not "canvas idle".
- (tests) NEVER include visual regression with human review (Percy/Chromatic/Applitools); agent-driven discipline prohibits human screenshot approval.
- (tests) NEVER use `sleep(N)` for synchronization in perf-test load drivers; wait for explicit signal via `health` polling or `tokio::time::pause()` + `advance()`.
- (tests) NEVER lower coverage / perf-budget thresholds to pass build (raise code quality instead).
- (tests) NEVER auto-retry flaky a11y or perf tests (single flake = quarantine + root-cause).

- (tests) NEVER use real-time `chrono::Utc::now()` / `std::time::Instant::now()` for perf-budget windows without injection; `start_paused = true` incompatible с `flavor = "multi_thread"` (testing.md 2026-05-06).
- (obs) §11 NEVER define soft SLO budgets — perf SLO p99 ≤33ms MUST trigger build failure.
- (obs) §11 NEVER defer error budget decisions к humans — agent-driven SLO + machine-decidable tuple diff.
- (obs) §11 NEVER skip zero-unlogged-panics invariant in audit harness code itself.
- (obs) §11 NEVER skip p50/p95/p99 coverage on perf-budget metrics — emit raw `value`, agent computes percentiles.
- (obs) §11 NEVER use unstructured `println!` in `xtask perf-audit` / `xtask a11y-audit`; JSON-per-line via `tracing-subscriber` dual-sink.
- (obs) §11 NEVER include PII в logs — violation JSON emits `wcag_criterion`/`selector`/`severity`/`surface` only, NOT `html`/DOM snippet content.
- (obs) §11 NEVER lose telemetry artifacts — violation-JSON + criterion bench + log file uploaded as CI artifacts с 14-day retention.
- (obs) §11 NEVER link OTel SDK into self-observation runtime — all audit harness telemetry flows through existing `tracing` events.
- (obs) §11 NEVER add retry-once policies for panic handling.
- (a11y) NEVER skip a11y CI on failure — fail-fast gate, not warning; PR cannot merge с violations; no soft gates / "fix in follow-up".
- (a11y) NEVER use retry-once policy for a11y violations — quarantine via `#[ignore]` / skip, investigate, fix or delete.
- (a11y) NEVER omit per-PR diff regression detection at Standard+ tier.
- (a11y) NEVER claim WCAG conformance from lint-only (`eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y`); runtime axe-core/pa11y/Lighthouse MUST run.
- (a11y) NEVER pass perf SLO by globally disabling motion in test config — masks SC 2.3.3 regressions; perf + reduced-motion gates run independently.
- (arch) Do NOT introduce new workspace crate (e.g., `crates/a11y-audit`) — 10 reserved names LOCKED; use `xtask` + `pulse-app/ui/`.
- (arch) Do NOT introduce new TauRPC procedure or namespace for audit instrumentation; reuse existing `health` / `ready` / `streams.*` / `telemetry.frontend.*`.
- (arch) Do NOT add new Tauri capability identifier — 6 reserved sufficient.
- (arch) Do NOT bind OTLP load injection to `0.0.0.0` or add non-loopback path.
**Contract bindings:**

- **security ↔ tests (CI gate addition к ci.yml)**: a11y audit gate + perf SLO gate become new CI jobs; binds к security §Dependency Security CI integration + §Bootstrap `dep-security-ci-gate` for SHA-pin discipline + harden-runner-first-step. Tests owns gate plumbing; security owns SHA-pin discipline.

- **security ↔ obs (criterion bench artifacts)**: perf SLO chunk lays substrate that chunk #56 enforces in CI; criterion bench artifact paths follow same secret-redaction discipline as snapshot files (binary blobs of execution traces MUST NOT contain raw user-controlled attribute values).

- **security ↔ a11y (violation-JSON content scrub)**: violation-JSON baselines MUST NOT capture OTLP attribute values from live data layer if surface displays ingested telemetry; security flags secret-disclosure risk in baseline contents.

- **design ↔ a11y**: design supplies contrast target ratios + motion accessibility spec + focus ring tokens; a11y owns WCAG 2.1 AA derivation + SC 2.3.3 AAA gate + harness wiring. Audit tuple shape is a11y's contract.

- **design ↔ obs**: Halo perf SLO measures WebGPU canvas frame loop (NOT chrome transitions); obs owns `metric.webgpu.frame_duration_ms` surface (chunk #29 bridge); design owns perf-budget rationale + canvas-vs-chrome taxonomy.
- **design ↔ tests**: tests owns lint-target enumeration (banned fonts / motion / palette regression); design provides source-of-truth tables referenced by lint baselines.
- **layouts ↔ a11y (per-surface tuples)**: layouts owns canonical surface enumeration (top-level baseline keys); a11y owns `{wcag_criterion, selector, severity}` tuple schema.
- **layouts ↔ obs (canvas perf)**: layouts identifies canvas-bearing surfaces (compact widget + dashboard Traces); obs owns `frame_duration_ms` metric measured there.
- **layouts ↔ a11y (modal focus)**: layouts owns overlay-card modal structure; a11y owns focus-trap audit (focus enters card / Tab cycles / Escape dismisses / focus restores к trigger).
- **layouts ↔ a11y (reduced-motion)**: layouts defines "static glow, hue still updates" degradation contract; a11y AAA gate verifies.
- **tests ↔ a11y**: a11y owns WCAG criteria + axe/Lighthouse/pa11y harness; tests owns CI-gate plumbing (failure modes, JUnit emission, zero-flakiness, perf-budget regression detector).

- **tests ↔ obs (harness 5-command discipline)**: tests harness consumes obs structured log format + status endpoint; perf-budget gate writes timing samples through same log channel obs defines; violation-JSON regression detector consumes log lines per agent-driven discipline.
- **tests ↔ security (SHA-pin CI Actions)**: any new Actions added к workflow files SHA-pinned by 40-char commit SHA per security CI rule.
- **tests ↔ design (Halo motion tokens)**: frame-rate measurement under reduced-motion respect MUST NOT include human verification per agent-driven invariant.

- **obs ↔ a11y (violation JSON → structured log)**: a11y emits per-surface `{wcag_criterion, selector, severity, surface}` tuples as `tracing::info!(target: "a11y.violation", ...)` events into `agent-latest.jsonl` + sibling per-surface JSON artifact for diff regression; obs provides structured-log target convention + PII redaction; a11y owns WCAG criterion enumeration.
- **obs ↔ tests (Standard tier match)**: obs tier matches tests tier; criterion JSON regression detection is obs/tests joint contract.

- **obs ↔ security (PII scrubbing in violation reporter)**: a11y violation grep heuristics use literal secret-format regexes; UI vocabulary words ("token budget" / "API key field" as labels) exempt per Decisions Log 2026-05-04.

- **obs ↔ design (frontend bridge contract)**: WebGPU frame-time crosses TauRPC bridge via `telemetry.frontend.record_frame_ms` → backend `tracing::info!(target: "metric.webgpu.frame_duration_ms", ...)`; chunk #54 consumes as-is, no new bridge contract.

- **obs ↔ tests (heartbeat ticks vs health command semantics per Decisions Log 2026-05-08)**: perf SLO regression gate consumes tick stream (retroactive analysis from log file), NOT `health` IPC (active probe); the two remain distinct.

- **a11y ↔ obs §6 structured log schema**: violation JSON emissions tag с CI resource attributes (`service.name="com.andromeda.pulse"`, `deployment.environment="production"`, `ci.run.id=$GITHUB_RUN_ID`, `git.commit.sha=$GITHUB_SHA`) for cross-correlation с obs traces.
- **a11y ↔ tests harness 5-command discipline**: `test:a11y` reuses tests' E2E `boot`/`run`/`status`/`cleanup`/`logs` driver; Playwright session attaches к same Tauri instance.
- **a11y ↔ design tokens contrast pairs**: contrast verification reads VERBATIM token names from design system via `getComputedStyle()`; colorjs.io 0.6.x asserts ratios per design's pair definitions.

- **a11y ↔ design tokens motion-reduce variants**: reduced-motion assertion verifies Tailwind v4 `motion-reduce:` variant application on duration tokens AND `useReducedMotion` hook gating on canvas frame loop.

- **a11y ↔ perf SLO (obs/tests shared)**: reduced-motion respect enforced UNDER 10k spans/sec sustained load — perf budget gate runs с reduced-motion variant emulated separately from baseline (neither gate masks the other).
- **a11y ↔ GitHub Actions ci.yml**: a11y CI integrates into same pipeline as tests E2E; SHA-pinned `actions/upload-artifact` + `actions/download-artifact` per security supply chain.
- **arch ↔ obs**: perf SLO consumes `metric.webgpu.frame_duration_ms` via existing `telemetry.frontend.record_frame_ms` bridge; harness assertion needs arch-locked IPC + obs-locked event schema.
- **arch ↔ tests**: synthetic 10k spans/sec uses OTLP `:4317`/`:4318` on `127.0.0.1` per Cross-cutting Test-time telemetry injection; binding к tests chunk #50 P1-P7 fixtures.
- **arch ↔ a11y**: WCAG audit surfaces sit on `pulse-app/ui/` webview per arch directory structure; per-surface consumption against 3 visualization surfaces.

body:
_Generated by /andromeda-phase Phase 4. Read by /andromeda-implement.
Manual edits between runs are fine; do not edit during /implement run._
- **Phase number:** 51

- **Route chunks covered:**
  - route#54 "A11y audit + perf SLO + violation-JSON regression — WCAG 2.1 AA (axe/Lighthouse/pa11y) + SC 2.3.3 AAA prefers-reduced-motion + 10k spans/sec ≥30 fps + per-surface tuple regression"
- **Epoch:** Epoch 8 — Polish & ship

Chunk #54 is Epoch 8's flagship a11y CI integration moment: it activates the long-deferred axe-core + Lighthouse + pa11y harness against the now-mature webview surface, wires the SC 2.3.3 AAA prefers-reduced-motion enforcement across all chrome + Halo State Pulse rendering contexts, and ships а per-PR tuple regression gate (`{surface, wcag_criterion, selector, severity}` diff vs base-branch baseline). Simultaneously, it activates the long-deferred WebGPU frame-budget perf SLO gate (p99 `metric.webgpu.frame_duration_ms` ≤33ms = 30 fps minimum) over а 10k spans/sec sustained-load test window, plus а buffer-memory bound gate (≤512MB at the 10-min retention window).

The chunk's primary character is ACTIVATION, not greenfield wiring: every dev-dep is already installed (chunk #13 a11y dev stack), every emission point already exists (chunks #25 + #26 frame_duration_ms; chunk #29 telemetry.frontend.record_frame_ms bridge; chunk #12 contrast harness; pulse-app/src/heartbeat.rs buffer.tick), and the placeholder `xtask test:a11y` subcommand has been a stub since chunk #13. Chunk #54 replaces the stub with а full orchestrator chain, extends `.github/workflows/ci.yml` in place (per arch constraint — no new top-level workflow), introduces 7 new Playwright + axe per-surface specs covering critical paths P1-P7, ships а Lighthouse runner + pa11y-ci config + aggregator + regression-detector, and adds а Rust-side 10k spans/sec load test (`pulse-app/tests/perf_slo_10k_spans.rs`) mirroring chunk #50's P1 OTLP load pattern. Workflow self-lint mirrors chunk #53's `pulse-app/tests/distribution_manifests.rs` shape.

Per arch §Occupied Resources + §Architecture Registry Updates 2026-05-09: NO new TauRPC procedure / capability identifier / env var / reserved table / workspace crate name introduced — the chunk consumes existing `telemetry.frontend.record_frame_ms` + `metric.webgpu.frame_duration_ms` + `metric.buffer.memory_bytes` event streams, the existing `pulse-app/ui/` webview source root, the existing `xtask` task runner surface, and the existing `ci.yml` extension pattern. EXPECTED_PROCEDURES in xtask/src/main.rs is unchanged.

1. **Activate `xtask test:a11y` subcommand** (`xtask/src/main.rs`): replace `test_a11y_placeholder()` (line 686-691) with а real impl that delegates к `npm run test:a11y --prefix pulse-app/ui` via the existing `run_npm_script("test:a11y", extra)` helper (line 359-383). Preserve the existing `Cmd::TestA11y { extra }` clap binding so `cargo xtask test:a11y -- --watch` etc. work for local dev. Status output к stderr matches `run_ci_gates` convention.

2. **Add new `xtask perf:slo-load` subcommand** (`xtask/src/main.rs`): new `Cmd::PerfSloLoad` clap variant. Impl invokes `cargo nextest run --test perf_slo_10k_spans --profile ci --no-tests=pass` via subprocess (re-using `run_cargo_nextest` shape), then post-test invokes the new `xtask/ci/perf-slo-check.{sh,ps1}` script via the existing `invoke_*` shell-out pattern (mirroring `invoke_heartbeat_check` at line 320-357) с the log file path arg. Script asserts `metric.webgpu.frame_duration_ms` p99 ≤33ms AND `metric.buffer.memory_bytes` max ≤512_000_000.

3. **Update `xtask::run_ci_gates`** (`xtask/src/main.rs:199-273`): replace the `perf-budget DEFERRED (no criterion bench yet)` line (line 210 + 271) с а real `invoke_perf_slo_check(&log_files).await` call mirroring `invoke_heartbeat_check`. Exit 1 on perf-budget violation.
4. **Activate `npm run test:a11y` script** (`pulse-app/ui/package.json:15`): replace placeholder с the full orchestrator chain (run each step; any non-zero exit fails the chain):

```
   npm run build && npm run verify:contrast && playwright test --config=playwright-a11y.config.ts && node tests-a11y/lighthouse/lighthouse-runner.mjs && pa11y-ci --config tests-a11y/pa11y/pa11y-ci-config.json && node tests-a11y/aggregator.mjs && node tests-a11y/regression-detector.mjs
   ```
No new npm install (all devDeps already installed per chunk #13).

5. **Create `pulse-app/ui/playwright-a11y.config.ts`**: separate Playwright config for а11y tests. Sets `testDir: "./tests-a11y/axe"` + `testMatch: ["**/*.spec.ts"]`, browser project Chromium only (Lighthouse + pa11y both use Chrome/Chromium-driven runners), JSON reporter к `../../target/playwright-a11y-report/results.json`, `webServer: { command: 'npx http-server dist -p 4173 --silent', port: 4173, reuseExistingServer: !process.env.CI }`. Leave existing `playwright.config.ts` unchanged (it stays disabled-by-`testIgnore` for future tauri-driver E2E).

6. **Create 7 critical-path Playwright + axe specs** under `pulse-app/ui/tests-a11y/axe/`: one per P1-P7. Each spec uses `@axe-core/playwright` `AxeBuilder().withTags(['wcag2a', 'wcag2aa', 'wcag21aa', 'wcag22aa']).analyze()`; asserts zero critical/serious violations; emits per-violation JSON lines к `~/.andromeda-pulse/logs/a11y-axe-core-results.jsonl` conforming к obs §6 schema (target=`a11y::axe-core`, fields per chunk #12 contrast harness convention). Use `tabbable` for focus-order assertions. Use `page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: 'reduce' })` in the `p7-settings-form.spec.ts` AND in а separate `tests-a11y/reduced-motion.spec.ts` that runs across all 7 surfaces.

7. **Create Lighthouse runner** (`pulse-app/ui/tests-a11y/lighthouse/lighthouse-runner.mjs`): Node 22 ESM. Use the `lighthouse` API (NOT CLI binary — avoids subshell discipline + lets us inject Tauri-IPC mocks via `page.addInitScript` если needed in а future iteration). Audit URLs: `http://localhost:4173/` (compact widget OR dashboard depending on window-label mock), `http://localhost:4173/#/traces`, `http://localhost:4173/#/metrics`, `http://localhost:4173/#/logs`, `http://localhost:4173/#/snapshots`, `http://localhost:4173/#/settings`. Categories: `accessibility` only (NOT performance/seo/etc. — keep audit time bounded). Threshold: a11y score ≥90. Emit к `~/.andromeda-pulse/logs/a11y-lighthouse-results.json`.

8. **Create pa11y-ci config** (`pulse-app/ui/tests-a11y/pa11y/pa11y-ci-config.json`): pa11y-ci 4.x config с the same 7 surface URLs as Lighthouse, runner `axe`, standard `WCAG2AA`, viewport 1280×720, timeout 30000ms, reporter JSON к `~/.andromeda-pulse/logs/a11y-pa11y-results.json`. Threshold: zero errors.

9. **Create aggregator** (`pulse-app/ui/tests-a11y/aggregator.mjs`): Node ESM. Read the 4 source artifacts (`a11y-axe-core-results.jsonl` + `a11y-lighthouse-results.json` + `a11y-pa11y-results.json` + `dist/contrast-report.json`), normalize each violation к `{surface, wcag_criterion, selector, severity, tool, remediation, tool_result_id}` tuple, group by surface, sort within group для stable diff. Write `~/.andromeda-pulse/logs/a11y-violations-summary.json` с schema `{schema_version: 1, generated_at, per_surface: {compact-widget: [...], dashboard-traces: [...], ...}, total_tuple_count}`.

10. **Create regression detector** (`pulse-app/ui/tests-a11y/regression-detector.mjs`): Node ESM. Read fresh `a11y-violations-summary.json` AND base-branch baseline (path passed via `--baseline` arg; default `tests-a11y/baselines/a11y-violations-summary.json`). Compute set-diff per surface (`fresh - baseline`); emit `tests-a11y/regression-set.json` с the diff payload. Exit non-zero (`process.exit(1)`) if diff is non-empty.

11. **Create initial baseline** (`pulse-app/ui/tests-a11y/baselines/a11y-violations-summary.json`): empty per-surface tuple lists (`{schema_version: 1, generated_at: <committed-at>, per_surface: {compact-widget: [], dashboard-traces: [], dashboard-metrics: [], dashboard-logs: [], dashboard-snapshots: [], dashboard-settings: [], tray-icon-halo: []}, total_tuple_count: 0}`). First CI run after merge establishes ground-truth baseline content via а follow-up commit OR maintainer-curated update (open question #4 в research.md — recommend manually-curated for v0.1.0).

12. **Create Rust-side 10k spans/sec load test** (`pulse-app/tests/perf_slo_10k_spans.rs`): mirror chunk #50 P1 pattern. `#[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread", worker_threads = 4)]`. Bootstrap in-process `:memory:` DuckDB + `BufferState` + `IngestState` + `BroadcastSenders` + `VizState` + `build_channel()`. Spawn `run_consumer(...)` task. Start tonic server on ephemeral loopback port via `start_test_grpc_server` helper. Open `TraceServiceClient`. Inject 100k spans across 100 export requests (1000 spans per request) within а 10s window using `tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(100)).between` per batch. Assert `wait_for_rows(state, 100_000, Duration::from_secs(12))` returns `true`. Buffer-memory + WebGPU frame-budget assertions are POST-TEST (CI gate via `xtask/ci/perf-slo-check.{sh,ps1}` reading agent-latest.jsonl), NOT in-test.

13. **Create perf SLO check scripts** (`xtask/ci/perf-slo-check.sh` + `.ps1`): POSIX + PowerShell. Each takes the log file path as arg. Compute `jq '. | select(.target == "metric.webgpu.frame_duration_ms") | .fields.duration_ms' < log | sort -n` then percentile (p99 = element at idx `floor(0.99 * len)`); assert ≤33 ms OR exit 1. Sibling check `metric.buffer.memory_bytes` max ≤512_000_000 OR exit 1. Print PASS/FAIL summary к stdout.

14. **Create workflow self-lint test** (`pulse-app/tests/a11y_perf_workflow.rs`): mirror `distribution_manifests.rs` shape. 6 tests asserting on `.github/workflows/ci.yml` post-extension: (a) every new `uses:` line (added in this chunk) SHA-pinned by 40-char hex с `# vX.Y.Z` provenance; (b) every new CI job step uses `actions/upload-artifact@<existing SHA from chunk #53> # v4` for а11y violation summary + playwright report artifacts; (c) workflow-level `permissions: contents: read` preserved (no widening); (d) `harden-runner` first step of every job unchanged; (e) new `npm run build --prefix pulse-app/ui` step exists before any test:a11y step; (f) Linux-only conditional on `cargo xtask perf:slo-load` step (mirrors existing `if: runner.os == 'Linux'` pattern for headful-deferred paths).

15. **Extend `.github/workflows/ci.yml`** in place (NOT а new top-level workflow): add steps in the existing `lint-test-build` job (Linux-only branches conditional on `if: runner.os == 'Linux'` per existing convention) AFTER the `cargo xtask test` step:
    - Step: `npm run build --prefix pulse-app/ui` (Vite build для Lighthouse/Playwright targets)
    - Step: `cargo xtask test:a11y` (orchestrator chain)
    - Step (Linux-only): `cargo xtask perf:slo-load`
    - Step (PR-only): `actions/download-artifact@<SHA pinned to v4 SHA already in workflow> # v4` to fetch base-branch baseline (name: `a11y-violations-base`)
    - Step: `actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4` upload `a11y-violations-${{ runner.os }}` (path: `${{ env.ANDROMEDA_PULSE_DATA_DIR }}/logs/a11y-*.json*` + `pulse-app/ui/dist/contrast-report.json` + `pulse-app/ui/tests-a11y/regression-set.json`; retention 14 days; `if-no-files-found: ignore`)
    - Step: `actions/upload-artifact@<same SHA> # v4` upload `playwright-a11y-report-${{ runner.os }}` (path: `target/playwright-a11y-report/`; retention 14 days)

16. **Add `.taurignore` entries** if any audit output is written within `pulse-app/ui/src/**` (none expected per file plan — all output under `pulse-app/ui/tests-a11y/`, `pulse-app/ui/dist/`, `~/.andromeda-pulse/logs/`, `target/`). Confirm at /implement time AND skip this step if no in-source-tree generation occurs.

title: Chunk route#55: "Flakiness quarantine + quality gate enforcement — zero-flake retry policy, coverage regression block, perf budget regression block, lint/typecheck gate"

data.head: ### Chunk route#55: "Flakiness quarantine + quality gate enforcement — zero-flake retry policy, coverage regression block, perf budget regression block, lint/typecheck gate"

body: **Constraints across domains:**
- (security C1) Workflow-level `permissions:` MUST be `contents: read` in `ci.yml`; per-job elevation only on specific publish/upload steps (per security plan §Secrets Anti-Patterns).

- (security C2) New third-party GitHub Actions invoked from `ci.yml` MUST be pinned by 40-char commit SHA with `# vX.Y.Z` comment; NEVER `@v2`/floating tag (per security plan §Bootstrap phases `dep-security-ci-gate` + §Secrets Anti-Patterns; tj-actions/changed-files CVE-2025-30066 anchor).

- (security C5) Coverage baseline downloads MUST use SHA-pinned `actions/download-artifact` (mirroring chunk #54 PR-only baseline pattern); baseline JSON is untrusted-relative-to-CI-process — `xtask/ci/*` consumers MUST validate before merging into thresholds (no `eval`-equivalent parsing) (per security plan §Bootstrap `dep-security-ci-gate`).

- (security C7) Lint/typecheck gate MUST preserve `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` posture; `-D warnings` cannot be downgraded to `-W warnings` (per security plan §Dependency Security CI integration + CLAUDE.md §Workflow).

- (tests) Zero-flakiness budget is absolute — flake-once = immediate quarantine via `#[ignore]` + open issue + root-cause fix; NEVER auto-retry; build fails on observed flake (per test-plan §10 Quality Gates "Zero-flakiness budget" + §11 Quality "NEVER add retry-once policies for flaky tests").

- (tests) Coverage gate thresholds Standard tier: line ≥75% / branch ≥70% / function ≥85% via `cargo-llvm-cov` 0.8.5 LCOV output (per test-plan §10 Quality Gates table + §4 Unit Test Strategy Coverage target).

- (tests) Build failure conditions list defines the chunk #55 gate set: any unit/integration/E2E failure; coverage below threshold; p99 latency > threshold; observed flake; lint/typecheck/`cargo deny` failure (per test-plan §10 Build failure conditions + §9 Pipeline Build failure conditions).

- (tests) Excluded code from coverage gate: generated `prost` stubs, generated `taurpc` IPC bindings, test fixtures, mock implementations — enforced via `cargo-llvm-cov --exclude-files` (per test-plan §10 "Cumulative across workspace").

- (tests) Standard chunk gate baseline (test-plan §12 Decisions Log 2026-05-10) is unconditional: `cargo fmt --check` + `cargo clippy ... -D warnings` + `cargo nextest run --workspace --profile ci` + `cargo xtask capability-drift` + (when webview touched) webview gates — chunk #55 encodes this discipline at CI workflow scope.

- (obs) Zero-flake retry policy MUST NOT apply to panic handling — retry-once on panic masks zero-unlogged-panics invariant; parallel to tests' zero-flakiness invariant (per obs-plan §11 Obs Anti-Patterns → SLO row 2).

- (a11y) A11y CI gate MUST be hard-fail on regression and MUST NOT participate in any retry-once / quarantine-and-skip-by-default policy applied к flaky tests (per a11y plan §11 SLO "NEVER use retry-once policy for a11y violations" + §10 "Zero new violations per PR").

- (a11y) Lint gate MUST keep `eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y` 6.10.x `plugin:jsx-a11y/recommended` rules enabled at error-level — compile-time a11y gate complements runtime axe-core/Lighthouse/pa11y gates landed in chunk #54 (per a11y plan §3 a11y-linting-install + §9 Lint stage row).

- (a11y) Per-PR regression block MUST preserve a11y's per-PR `regression-set.json` artifact pattern from chunk #54 — same `{surface, wcag_criterion, selector, severity}` tuple-diff against base branch with NO "fix in follow-up" path (per a11y plan §3 Per-PR regression detection + §11 CI "NEVER defer a11y to post-merge").

- (arch) CI gate scripts MUST live in `xtask/` crate (not new workspace member); extend `xtask/src/main.rs` clap subcommand surface (precedent: chunk #54 `Cmd::PerfSloLoad`) (per arch §Established Decisions [CI Task Runner] + §Occupied Resources workspace crate names).

- (arch) CI workflow extends `.github/workflows/ci.yml` in-place (not a new workflow file); three workflows (`ci.yml` / `release.yml` / `update-channels.yml`) is the canonical set (per arch §Infrastructure Patterns + CLAUDE.md).

- (arch) CI gates MUST NOT introduce new env vars beyond `ANDROMEDA_PULSE_*` namespace; gate tunables (retry count / coverage delta / lint threshold) as xtask CLI flags or hardcoded consts (per arch §Occupied Resources Environment variables).

- (arch) Module dependency direction preserved: `xtask` invokes library crates only as test orchestration consumer via `cargo nextest`, not via Cargo `[dependencies]` edges (per arch §Cross-cutting Patterns Module dependency direction).
**Patterns к follow:**

- (security P1) SHA-pinned third-party Actions with version comment: `<owner>/<repo>@<40-char-SHA> # vX.Y.Z` — chunk #54 established for `actions/download-artifact` + `actions/upload-artifact` in a11y/perf gate steps.
- (security P2) `step-security/harden-runner` SHA-pinned as first step of every job — existing `ci.yml` already has this; new steps land WITHIN existing harden-runner-protected jobs.

- (security P4) Workflow self-lint via Rust integration test mirroring chunk #54 `pulse-app/tests/a11y_perf_workflow.rs` precedent — assert SHA-pin + workflow-level `permissions: contents: read` + harden-runner presence + new gate steps present.

- (tests) CI workflow extension in-place mirrors chunk #54: extend existing `lint-test-build` job rather than spawning new workflows; preserve workflow-level `permissions: contents: read`; preserve harden-runner first-step discipline (per test-plan §9 CI Integration + Pipeline structure table).

- (tests) Quality-gate-config-emit Bootstrap phase 8 pattern (per test-plan §3 Bootstrap phases): GitHub Actions workflow enforces line/branch/function thresholds + zero-flakiness + perf-budget; chunk #55 materializes this bootstrap phase per Polish & ship epoch closure.

- (tests) Per-process test isolation via `cargo-nextest` 0.9.x JUnit XML output + `dorny/test-reporter` SHA-pinned action — build-failure parsing keys off JUnit XML at `target/nextest/junit.xml` not stdout regex (per test-plan §9 Test report format).
- (a11y) Hard-fail gate, no soft warnings: every CI gate follows a11y's "PR cannot merge if violation" pattern from chunk #54 (per a11y plan §3 CI gate list + §11 CI "NEVER skip a11y on CI failure").

- (a11y) Per-PR base-branch artifact diff: chunk #54 landed `actions/download-artifact@v4` (SHA-pinned) for downloading base-branch baseline + `jq`-style tuple comparator emitting `regression-set.json`; chunk #55 coverage-regression-block should mirror this artifact-diff pattern (per a11y plan §3 Per-PR regression detection).

- (a11y) Compile-time gate complements runtime gate: lint/typecheck step keeps `plugin:jsx-a11y/recommended` ESLint rules + native `<button>` / `<label>` / `<dialog>` semantic-HTML-first checks (per a11y plan §11 ARIA + §9 Lint row).

- (arch) `xtask` clap subcommand pattern: chunk #54 added `Cmd::PerfSloLoad` clap variant + `run_perf_slo_load()` + `invoke_perf_slo_check()` helpers; chunks #55 add similar `Cmd::{FlakinessCheck, CoverageCheck, ...}` variants delegating к respective shell scripts.

- (arch) CI job-step ordering pattern per arch §Infrastructure Patterns: `cargo fmt --check` → `cargo clippy ... -D warnings` → `cargo xtask test` → `cargo build --workspace` is canonical; chunk #55 lint/typecheck gates MUST preserve this order; coverage regression appends AFTER `cargo build` step.
**Anti-patterns к avoid:**
- (security A1) NEVER `permissions: { contents: write }` at workflow level — even for "convenience" of uploading test baseline artifacts. Per-job elevation only.
- (security A2) NEVER reference a CI Action by `@latest` or `@v2` floating tag — tj-actions/changed-files CVE-2025-30066 anchor.

data.head: ### Chunk route#56: "Obs CI gates + log aggregation — zero-panic verification, heartbeat-stall detection (>45s gap), perf-budget p99 (snapshot ≤500ms / frame ≤33ms), criterion bench artifacts"

body: **Constraints across domains:**

- (security C3) Heartbeat-stall detection log parser MUST NOT log raw `tracing` log line contents — parser emits only `{module}.tick` timestamps + heartbeat-stall identifiers + tick-gap counters; raw log bodies stay out of gate's stdout/stderr (per security plan §Logging & Monitoring NEVER-log list).

- (security C4) Criterion bench artifacts uploaded via `upload-artifact` MUST NOT include `~/.andromeda-pulse/logs/` or `~/.andromeda-pulse/snapshots/` contents — confined to `target/criterion/` only; artifact path globs require explicit allowlist (per security plan §Logging & Monitoring NEVER-log list).

- (security C6) Any new xtask CI script MUST NOT spawn subprocesses with user-controlled arguments — heartbeat-stall log parser MUST treat log file paths as fixed constants from `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` / `%APPDATA%` resolution, not from CLI args; perf-budget threshold script consumes static thresholds (per security plan §Code Patterns Anti-Patterns).

- (tests) Performance budget table is the canonical p99 source for chunk #56 gate values (per test-plan §10 Performance budgets): Snapshot generation p99 ≤500ms; WebGPU 10k spans/sec sustained p99 frame-rate ≥20 fps (test-plan threshold; chunk #56 uses STRICTER obs-plan ≤33ms per session-handoff `Key Decisions This Session` 2026-05-14 alignment note).

- (tests) Log format binding к §3 Log format: `tracing-subscriber::fmt().json()` NDJSON per-line with required fields `timestamp` / `level` / `target` / `message` / `fields` — chunk #56 log-aggregation + heartbeat-stall detection MUST parse this canonical shape.

- (obs) Zero unlogged panics invariant MUST be enforced as build-fail CI gate by post-test scan of `~/.andromeda-pulse/logs/agent-latest.jsonl` for `app.panic.fatal` spans; ANY match exits non-zero (per obs-plan §10 SLO Invariants → "Zero unlogged panics" + §10 CI gates row 2).

- (obs) Heartbeat-stall detection MUST verify max consecutive gap ≤45s for each of `ingest.tick` / `buffer.tick` / `viz.tick` / `plugins.tick` targets across CI test run (per obs-plan §10 CI gates row 3 + §3 Heartbeat ticks).

- (obs) Snapshot generation p99 SLO MUST be enforced ≤500ms for 25k-token budget via `jq` aggregation over `metric.snapshot.token_count_ms` `tracing` events (per obs-plan §10 Performance budgets row 1 + §10 CI gates row 5).

- (obs) WebGPU frame p99 SLO MUST be enforced ≤33ms (30 fps minimum) via `jq` aggregation over `metric.webgpu.frame_duration_ms` events; offline criterion bench provides regression detection on stable estimators (per obs-plan §10 Performance budgets row 2 + §10 CI gates row 4).

- (obs) Buffer memory SLO MUST be enforced ≤512MB for 10-min retention window via tail-and-max over `metric.buffer.memory_bytes` events per heartbeat tick (per obs-plan §10 Performance budgets row 3).

- (obs) Criterion bench JSON artifacts (`target/criterion/<bench>/new/estimates.json`) MUST be uploaded as CI artifact for perf-budget regression detection (per obs-plan §9 CI Integration + §10 CI gates row 4 "criterion regression detection on stable estimators (median + slope)").

- (obs) Log file artifact (`logs/agent-latest.jsonl`) MUST be uploaded as CI artifact with default 14-day retention so agent can `gh run download <run_id> -n logs` + `jq` for triage (per obs-plan §9 CI failure → artifact triage workflow).

- (obs) CI subscriber MUST register additional default fields (`ci.run.id` from `$GITHUB_RUN_ID`, `git.commit.sha` from `$GITHUB_SHA`, `deployment.environment` per build context) via `Layer::with_default_fields(...)` so every JSON line in CI carries triage identity (per obs-plan §9 CI-specific default fields).
- (obs) Build MUST fail if `xtask test` produces zero spans in the log file — indicates instrumentation gap, not empty test run (per obs-plan §10 CI gates row 1).

- (a11y) Frame p99 ≤33ms budget enforcement MUST NOT regress under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` — motion-as-data state changes still convey via color / text / focus ring, so budget assertion runs on the same code path Lighthouse + Playwright `emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: 'reduce' })` exercises (per a11y plan §1 motion-sensitive AAA escalation SC 2.3.3 + §11 Motion).

- (a11y) Obs aggregation MUST keep a11y violation JSON records (`target: "a11y::assertion"`) classified under the same obs Section 6 structured-log schema as zero-panic / heartbeat-stall records so the aggregator can ingest а11y violations + obs-runtime violations from a unified jsonl stream (per a11y plan §3 Structured violation JSON schema + §9 Aggregation row).

- (a11y) A11y CI duration budget MUST hold: axe-core <30s per surface, Lighthouse a11y audit <15s per URL, total a11y + tests E2E <10 min (per a11y plan §10 Performance budget); criterion-bench-artifacts step must not push combined CI run over 10-min ceiling.

- (arch) Self-observation discipline preserved: chunk #56 zero-panic verification + heartbeat-stall detection consume the existing tracing JSON file sink in `~/.andromeda-pulse/logs/` (or equivalent xtask-test-time path); MUST NOT introduce a new exporter or self-OTLP loop (per arch §Cross-cutting Patterns Self-observation discipline).

- (arch) Criterion bench artifacts MUST upload via GitHub Actions `upload-artifact` SHA-pinned per supply-chain invariant (per arch §Infrastructure Patterns CI/CD approach + CLAUDE.md Pin-every-third-party-action invariant).
**Patterns к follow:**

- (security P3) `xtask/ci/*-check.{sh,ps1}` cross-platform pair per chunk #54 `perf-slo-check.{sh,ps1}` precedent — both scripts NEUTRAL on empty event streams (do not fail-on-empty during initial baselining); both bound input filesystem reads to fixed `~/.andromeda-pulse/logs/agent-latest.jsonl` (no path env-var input).

- (security P5) `cargo deny check bans licenses sources` + `cargo audit` already-gated — if either chunk's tooling adds dependencies (e.g., criterion baseline-compare crate), `deny.toml` `[bans]` posture (`multiple-versions = "deny"`) catches transitive duplicates; tonic 0.14 ↔ 0.13 canary stays outside skip list.

- (tests) Criterion bench artifact emission as CI artifact pattern follows chunk #54's upload-artifact step shape: SHA-pinned `actions/upload-artifact` invocation; artifact name suffixed с `${runner.os}`; baseline diff via base-branch artifact download on PR.

- (obs) POSIX `.sh` + PowerShell `.ps1` paired CI scripts under `xtask/ci/` mirroring chunk #54's `perf-slo-check.sh` / `perf-slo-check.ps1` precedent; same shape applies for `heartbeat-gap-check.sh`/`.ps1`, `zero-panic-check.sh`/`.ps1`, `criterion-regression.sh`/`.ps1`.

- (obs) `jq`-based aggregation over JSON-per-line `agent-latest.jsonl` for percentile computation; concrete pattern: `jq -s 'map(select(.target == "metric.snapshot.token_count_ms") | .fields.duration_ms) | sort | .[(length * 0.99 | floor)]' agent-latest.jsonl`.

- (obs) `xtask` subcommand split per CI domain (mirroring chunk #54's `test:a11y` + `perf:slo-load` split); chunk #56 adds new subcommands (e.g., `xtask ci:obs-gates` umbrella OR per-gate subcommands like `xtask ci:zero-panic`, `xtask ci:heartbeat-gap`, `xtask ci:perf-budget-p99`).

- (obs) Criterion 0.5 bench harness in `xtask benches/` for offline stable-estimator regression detection on perf-critical paths (snapshot generation, WebGPU frame); CI uploads `target/criterion/<bench>/new/estimates.json` (per obs-plan §9 telemetry artifact table row 3 + §10 Performance budgets row 1).

- (obs) `.github/workflows/ci.yml` extension in-place mirroring chunk #54's pattern; chunk #56 adds new steps for obs-gate enforcement (download log artifact + run `xtask ci:obs-gates` + upload criterion bench artifacts).

- (obs) Default subscriber field extension at boot via `tracing_subscriber::fmt::Layer::with_default_fields([service.name, service.version, deployment.environment, ci.run.id, git.commit.sha])` for CI runs.

- (a11y) Structured violation JSON aligned к obs Section 6 schema: chunk #56's log aggregation reuses the same `{timestamp, level, target, message, fields:{...}}` envelope the a11y aggregator already consumes for `a11y-axe-core-results.jsonl` + `a11y-violations-summary.json` (per a11y plan §3 Structured violation JSON + §9 CI artifacts table).

- (arch) `xtask/ci/{name}-check.{sh,ps1}` POSIX/PowerShell pair pattern: chunks #55 + #56 follow same dual-script shape for new gates (e.g., `xtask/ci/zero-panic-check.{sh,ps1}`, `xtask/ci/heartbeat-stall-check.{sh,ps1}`).

- (arch) Workflow-level `permissions: contents: read` with per-job elevation pattern (preserved by chunk #54); chunk #56 criterion bench artifact upload step inherits `contents: read` (sufficient для `upload-artifact`); no per-job permission elevation needed.
**Anti-patterns к avoid:**

- (security A3) NEVER log raw `tracing` event bodies or `{module}.tick` payload fields in the heartbeat-stall gate's stdout — tick events may include cardinality counters that incidentally embed OTLP attribute fragments; emit only structural metadata (timestamps, gap durations, module IDs).

- (security A4) NEVER spawn `tokio::process::Command::new(...).arg(user_input)` or shell equivalents with arguments sourced from log file contents — arguments come from fixed constants or validated test-id allowlists, never from log line contents.

- (tests) NEVER use real-time signals (`std::time::Instant::now()` / wall-clock) for heartbeat-stall gap detection — log timestamps come from `tracing` which uses injectable clock; detector parses NDJSON `timestamp` field per record.
- (obs) NEVER define soft SLO budgets without enforcement — formal SLOs MUST trigger build failure when exhausted; "team will review monthly" is forbidden (per obs-plan §11 SLO row 3 + row 4).

- (obs) NEVER use human-review-gated log analysis without machine-parseable export — CI artifacts MUST be structured JSON, machine-readable, agent-consumable (per obs-plan §11 CI row 2 + Universal row 3).
- (obs) NEVER lose telemetry artifacts (log file + snapshot on failure) — CI artifact upload with retention is mandatory (per obs-plan §11 CI row 1).
- (obs) NEVER use vendor-lock APM as ONLY exporter (Datadog/NewRelic/AppDynamics) — vendor schemas break paste-to-AI workflows (per obs-plan §11 Universal row 1 + §11 Telemetry Strategy row 4).

- (obs) NEVER skip criterion regression detection on perf-budget metrics — relying solely on per-run `jq` p99 misses gradual regression drift on stable hardware (per obs-plan §10 Performance budgets row 1).

- (arch) Do NOT introduce a new self-observation exporter for chunk #56 obs gates — tracing JSON file sink is the ONLY observation surface; gate scripts consume the existing sink output (would violate "no OTel SDK linked into self-observation runtime").
**Contract bindings:**

- (security ↔ obs CB2) log aggregation surface intersects §Logging & Monitoring redaction discipline: heartbeat-stall detector parses `tracing-subscriber` JSON output at `~/.andromeda-pulse/logs/agent-latest.jsonl` per obs-plan §12 Phase 3.5 pivot (no OTel SDK in self-runtime). Security redaction layer is upstream of detector — detector consumes already-scrubbed records. If chunk #56 ever extends redaction subscriber, new field MUST pass §Logging NEVER-log review.

- (security ↔ tests CB3) criterion bench artifact upload binds к test-plan §10 perf budgets: criterion JSON output to `target/criterion/` must include only synthetic-fixture-driven measurements (per `.claude/rules/testing.md` Session Addition 2026-05-14 DuckDB composite PK collision) — fixtures generated from deterministic seeds, no real-host telemetry replay; upload-artifact globs MUST exclude any path under `~/.andromeda-pulse/`.

- (obs ↔ tests) 5-command harness contract: tests consume obs's JSON log format (verbatim schema per obs-plan §3 Log format JSON schema) + status endpoint (`health` IPC command exposes liveness per obs-plan §3 Heartbeat ticks). Chunk #56's heartbeat-stall CI gate exercises the same `{module}.tick` events tests harness validates at smoke-test time.

- (obs ↔ tests harness) log-aggregation gate runs against the canonical `~/.andromeda-pulse/logs/` location declared in tests-plan §3 logs command + obs §3 file sink path; CI override via `ANDROMEDA_PULSE_LOG_DIR=$PWD/.test-logs/`; chunk #56's aggregator must respect both paths.

- (obs ↔ tests flake retry policy) chunk #55's zero-flake retry policy is а tests-domain decision but obs constrains the scope — retries apply к test-step transient failures, NEVER к panic propagation. Obs gate in #56 (zero-panic check on `app.panic.fatal` spans) acts as a post-retry safety net detecting any panic that occurred during the retry window.

- (obs ↔ security) PII scrubbing at logger config persists through CI gates — chunk #56 obs-gate scripts MUST NOT log raw OTLP attribute values / `AppError` stack traces / plugin full paths / MCP response bodies / DuckDB query params even when surfacing failed-gate diagnostics. CI gate failure messages emit `query_id` + `param_count` style metadata only.

- (obs ↔ a11y) chunk #54 substrate emitted a11y violation records к `~/.andromeda-pulse/logs/a11y-axe-core-results.jsonl` per obs §6 log format conformance; chunk #56's log-aggregation step MAY include a11y JSONL file aggregation alongside `agent-latest.jsonl` for unified CI artifact.

- (obs ↔ arch) zero new TauRPC procedures / capability JSON entries / arch §Occupied Resources changes expected — both chunks operate in CI tooling layer (xtask + .github/workflows/ci.yml) with no runtime IPC surface additions. The `health` IPC command (existing) is the active liveness probe shape obs-gate scripts may exercise.

- (a11y ↔ obs) a11y violation JSON records emitted by chunk #54's aggregator MUST flow through chunk #56's log-aggregation step using the same obs Section 6 schema; obs side aggregates `target: "a11y::assertion"` records alongside `target: "panic::handler"` / `target: "heartbeat::tick"` records without schema translation.

- (a11y ↔ design) chunk #56's WebGPU frame p99 ≤33ms perf gate MUST hold under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` emulation; reduced-motion code path conveys state via color/text/focus tokens — perf gate covers both motion-on and motion-off paths to avoid regressing AAA escalation.

- (arch ↔ obs) chunk #56 perf-budget p99 thresholds (snapshot ≤500ms / frame ≤33ms) MUST match obs plan §SLO invariants surface area exactly; arch supplies workflow extension + xtask surface, obs supplies canonical p99 thresholds + tracing JSON event schema. Heartbeat-stall window (>45s gap) cross-references obs plan §Heartbeat ticks mechanism.

**Acceptance criteria contributions:**

- (security AC3) New `xtask/ci/*-check.{sh,ps1}` scripts do NOT emit any line from `~/.andromeda-pulse/logs/agent-latest.jsonl` content (raw log body) or `~/.andromeda-pulse/snapshots/*` to stdout/stderr — verified by integration test parsing script output against fixture with known sentinel values (per §Logging & Monitoring NEVER-log list).

title: Phase 53 Plan — chunk route#57: "Widget real-data binding"

data.head: # Phase 53 Plan — chunk route#57: "Widget real-data binding"

body:
_Generated by /andromeda-phase Phase 4. Read by /andromeda-implement.
Manual edits between runs are fine; do not edit during /implement run._
- **Phase number:** 53

- **Route chunks covered:**
  - route#57 "Widget real-data binding — delete use-synthetic-widget-metrics.ts; wire CompactWidget.tsx + FooterBand.tsx to real streams.subscribe_metrics; Halo retains errorRate/throughputHz shape (refactored in chunk #81)"
- **Epoch:** Epoch 9 — Foundation v0.2.0 (NEW; created session 67 via /andromeda-evolve --allow-route-append Form 2)

Delete the synthetic widget data simulator (`pulse-app/ui/src/hooks/use-synthetic-widget-metrics.ts` + its co-located test) and replace its single callsite at `pulse-app/ui/src/App.tsx:20` with a real-data hook that subscribes to the EXISTING `streams.subscribe_metrics` TauRPC procedure (chunk #23 substrate at `pulse-app/src/streams.rs:17`, already acknowledged in arch §Architecture Registry Updates 2026-05-09). The new hook produces the same `WidgetMetrics` shape (`serviceCount` / `throughputHz` / `errorRate` / `retentionUsedSeconds` / `retentionMaxSeconds`) so CompactWidget + FooterBand + Halo consumers are byte-for-byte untouched downstream — the route entry explicitly notes "Halo retains errorRate/throughputHz shape (refactored in chunk #81)." This is the first webview consumer of any `streams.*` Channel API procedure; the chunk validates the consumer-side Arrow IPC binding pattern that subsequent v0.2.0 chunks (#58+) will reuse.

Scope is deliberately minimal per route §3 Decisions Log 2026-05-16 motivation: validate Proposal 4 Form 2 dogfood + remove the synthetic simulator that survived past chunks #34/#35 deferred wiring per `.andromeda/scope-validation/widget-state-validation-report-2026-05-14.md`. NO new TauRPC procedure / capability JSON edit / arch §Occupied Resources amendment is permitted (per arch + security extracts). The chunk lives entirely in `pulse-app/ui/` (per arch §Infrastructure Patterns directory structure + tests-plan boot-smoke-coverage scope) and bypasses the boot-smoke gate.

title: Step 1 — Create the new real-data hook

data.head: ### Step 1 — Create the new real-data hook

body: Add `pulse-app/ui/src/hooks/use-widget-metrics.ts` exporting a `useWidgetMetrics(): WidgetMetrics` hook that:
1. Imports `createTauRPCProxy` from `../bindings/index` and `Channel` from `@tauri-apps/api/core`.

2. Maintains `useState<WidgetMetrics>` with sane initial defaults (e.g., zero throughput, zero errorRate, zero service count, zero retentionUsedSeconds, configured retention max). Pre-first-frame state should look like an empty system rather than synthetic-feel placeholders.

3. In a `useEffect` (with empty dep array): creates a `Channel<number[]>` instance; calls `proxy.streams.subscribe_metrics(channel)`; on each `onmessage` callback decodes the `Vec<u8>` payload as Arrow IPC + aggregates into a windowed rolling state that recomputes `WidgetMetrics` fields. Use a `useRef` for the aggregation window so async updates don't churn state on every payload.
4. On unmount, signal subscription teardown (Tauri Channel disposes when the JS Channel reference is dropped + the backend forward_loop receiver exits when `channel.send` errors).

5. Aggregation semantics (per research.md Open question 1): minimal scope — `throughputHz` from rolling count of metric points per second over a ~1s window; `errorRate` from a heuristic on the payload's metric_name field (e.g., counting points whose `metric_name` contains "error" / "exception" / "failed" divided by total) OR a fixed 0 fallback until chunk #81's refactor; `serviceCount` from distinct `service.name` resource attributes in the rolling window; `retentionUsedSeconds` + `retentionMaxSeconds` queryable via the existing `ready` TauRPC procedure's `subsystems.buffer` fields OR computed locally from the rolling window timestamps. Document the deferred-to-chunk-#81 contract in the hook's module doc comment.

6. NEVER call `console.*` with decoded service.name / metric_name / attribute values in any path (security extract). If a debug-only diagnostic is needed during development, route via the existing `telemetry.frontend.record_frame_ms` pattern at `crates/ui-bridge/src/telemetry.rs:99` (out of chunk #57 scope unless absolutely needed).

7. Errors crossing the bridge surface as `AppError` enum variants (per arch extract); the hook's state may include a discriminated optional `lastError: AppError | null` for future surfacing, but minimum scope keeps just the metrics shape returned + silent failure (the FooterBand stays read-only; failure mode is the empty-state visual).

body: `CompactWidget.test.tsx` + `FooterBand.test.tsx` mock direct prop input (not the hook) — they should pass unmodified. Verify via the standard gate baseline; no edits expected.
