- **Route chunks covered:** route#58 "Curation crate extraction — Create `crates/curation/`, move `dedupe`, `anomaly` (latency outliers / error correlation / cardinality spikes), `critical_path`, `aggregation` modules from snapshot; pub-ify primitives via `curation::contract` re-exports; snapshot crate's external surface unchanged"
- **Epoch:** 9 — Foundation v0.2.0

- **Group reason:** single-substantial — crate extraction crosses module boundaries (touches snapshot crate + new `crates/curation/` + workspace `Cargo.toml` + downstream dependents); only registered chunk in Epoch 9 after chunk #57 completed.
**Constraints across domains:**

- (arch) The new `curation` crate MUST be added to the Cargo workspace manifest (`Cargo.toml` `[workspace] members`); its name `curation` joins the reserved crate name list in arch §Occupied Resources "Cargo workspace crate names" — this requires a `/andromeda-evolve --allow-arch-registry` amendment before or alongside the chunk merge (per arch §Occupied Resources + §Architecture Registry Updates pattern 2026-05-09).

- (arch) Module visibility discipline: `crates/curation/` MUST expose only its public contract via `pub` (the `curation::contract` re-export module); cross-crate utilities use `pub(crate)`; no `pub use` re-exports across crate boundaries except in the explicit contract module (per arch §Conventions "Module visibility discipline").

- (arch) Dependency direction: `snapshot` may depend on `curation` but `curation` MUST NOT depend on `snapshot` or `pulse-app` — the DAG flows toward `pulse-app` as the only root (per arch §Cross-cutting Patterns "Module dependency direction").

- (arch) Error handling: if `curation` exposes fallible operations, it MUST use `thiserror` 2.x for its module-internal error enum; conversion к `AppError` at the TauRPC bridge (in `snapshot`) continues via `From` impls (per arch §Inherited Defaults "Error handling").

- (arch) This is a refactor-only chunk — no new TauRPC procedures, no new capability JSON entries, no new env vars; `snapshot` crate's external TauRPC surface (`snapshot.generate`, `snapshot.list_recent`, `snapshot.copy_to_clipboard`) MUST remain unchanged (per arch §Occupied Resources + chunk description invariant).

- (security) The new `crates/curation/Cargo.toml` MUST NOT introduce dependencies that fail `cargo deny check bans licenses sources` — any crate added must be in the existing SPDX allowlist and must not be a banned duplicate (per security plan §Dependency Security CI integration).

- (security) The `curation::contract` re-export surface MUST scope public visibility to only the primitives declared in the module's public contract (`pub`); internal modules MUST remain `pub(crate)` — over-exposing curation internals creates accidental API surface (per arch Conventions §Module visibility discipline; security plan §Threat Model Summary IPC trust boundary).

- (security) Curation modules process OTLP telemetry attribute values — any new `tracing::event!` / `tracing::debug!` / `tracing::info!` spans introduced in moved modules MUST NOT log OTLP attribute values or raw telemetry field content verbatim (per security plan §Logging & Monitoring "What NEVER to log").

- (security) If curation modules introduce new DuckDB query paths, those paths MUST use `Connection::prepare` + `?` placeholders — NEVER format-string SQL (per security plan §Input Validation "DuckDB query parameters" + §Security Anti-Patterns §Input; 2026 DuckDB CVE cluster). Specialist plan silent on whether current snapshot curation modules call DuckDB directly or receive pre-queried Arrow data; orchestrator should verify during Phase 3 codebase research.

- (tests) All existing unit tests for moved modules (`dedupe`, `anomaly`, `critical_path`, `aggregation`) MUST migrate co-located into `crates/curation/src/` — project convention is co-located `#[cfg(test)] mod tests { … }` (per test-plan §4 Unit Test Strategy).
- (tests) The new `curation` crate MUST meet coverage gates: ≥75% line, ≥70% branch, ≥85% function (Standard tier); gate applies immediately at this chunk's CI run (per test-plan §10 Quality Gates).

- (tests) `snapshot` crate's external IPC contract tests MUST still pass unchanged — `snapshot.*` TauRPC behavior is unchanged and verified by existing integration-level contract tests (per test-plan §5 Integration Test Strategy).

- (tests) Standard gate baseline is UNCONDITIONAL regardless of refactor scope: `cargo fmt --check` + `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` + `cargo nextest run --workspace --profile ci` + `cargo xtask capability-drift` MUST all pass (per test-plan §12 Decisions Log 2026-05-10 "chunk-gate-baseline-coverage").

- (tests) This chunk touches `Cargo.toml` (workspace manifest + new crate) but NOT `pulse-app/src/main.rs` / `crates/ui-bridge/src/` / `pulse-app/capabilities/` — boot-smoke gate is NOT triggered (per test-plan §12 Decisions Log 2026-05-10).

- (obs) All `#[tracing::instrument]` decorators in `dedupe`, `anomaly`, `critical_path`, and `aggregation` modules MUST be preserved verbatim through the move; removal or drift constitutes instrumentation regression against must-trace path P2 (per obs-plan §4 Span/Trace Coverage, Scenario P2).

- (obs) Structured log `target` strings in moved modules encode the module path (e.g., `snapshot::dedupe`) → MUST be updated to reflect the new crate identity (e.g., `curation::dedupe`) so the JSON log file continues to be agent-greppable by module path (per obs-plan §6 Log Coverage per-module log levels table).

- (obs) Snapshot-curation metric events (`metric.snapshot.token_count_ms`, `dedup_count`, `anomaly_markers` fields) emitted by curation pipeline functions MUST survive the refactor — silent loss breaks the p99 ≤ 500ms SLO CI gate (per obs-plan §10 SLO Invariants).

- (obs) The new `curation` crate's internal boundary calls must log at `info` (summary) / `debug` (pipeline detail) per the level discipline established for curation-adjacent logic (per obs-plan §6 per-module log levels).

- (obs) PII scrubbing constraints unchanged. The moved `aggregation` module queries DuckDB results; MUST continue emitting `query_id` + `param_count` (NOT raw query parameter values) per logging-sensitive Vector 5 (per obs-plan §8 PII Scrubbing + §11 Anti-Patterns Logs).
**Patterns к follow:**

- (arch) Single-crate-per-module pattern: `crates/curation/` follows the same shape as peer crates — `src/lib.rs` with a public contract module (e.g., `pub mod contract`), `pub(crate)` internals, `thiserror`-derived error enum (per arch §Project Intent + §Conventions).

- (arch) `pub`-ification via a dedicated `contract` re-export module mirrors the existing convention in crates such as `ui-bridge` (`crates/ui-bridge/src/contract.rs`); moved modules are re-exported through `curation::contract` so downstream consumers reference one stable namespace (per arch §Conventions).
- (arch) Cargo workspace member naming: crate directory name `curation` = package name `curation` = `snake_case` consistent with existing 9 workspace members (per arch §Conventions "File naming").

- (arch) `snapshot` crate's `Cargo.toml` gains `curation = { path = "../../crates/curation" }` as a workspace-path dependency — dependency arrow points snapshot → curation, matching established library-crate DAG pattern (per arch §Cross-cutting Patterns).

- (security) **Cargo workspace new crate follows existing workspace member shape**: each library crate has a `Cargo.toml` with minimal `[dependencies]` + `[lib]`; `deny.toml [bans]` skip list extended only if known-benign duplicates introduced (per security plan §Dependency Security + `.claude/rules/security.md` Session Addition 2026-05-03).

- (security) **Logging redaction applies at the subscriber layer**: curation modules emitting `tracing` spans use structured field names without raw OTLP content — follow the pattern from `snapshot` / `viz` crate instrumentation where field names are `query_id`, `param_count`, `service_count`, not `attribute_value` (per security plan §Logging & Monitoring).

- (security) **`pub(crate)` default for internals, `pub` only for contract re-exports** — mirrors the existing `snapshot` crate's visibility structure (per arch §Conventions §Module visibility discipline).

- (tests) Co-located test migration: each moved module's `#[cfg(test)] mod tests { … }` block moves verbatim into `crates/curation/src/{module}.rs` alongside its implementation. No test code stays in old `snapshot` crate for logic that has moved (per test-plan §4).

- (tests) `rstest` fixture composition: if existing snapshot unit tests use `#[fixture]` builders, those builder factories remain owned by originating crates (`ingest`, `buffer`); curation tests compose via `rstest` fixture arguments (per test-plan §4).
- (tests) Test function naming convention preserved through migration: `#[test] fn test_<entity>_<scenario>()` — no rename on move (per test-plan §4).

- (tests) Integration-level snapshot contract test for P2 critical path remains in `snapshot` crate — not relocated to `curation` — because it exercises snapshot's public surface (per test-plan §6 P2).

- (obs) Span naming convention `{module}.{operation}` applies to the new crate: internal operations should use `curation.dedupe`, `curation.anomaly.detect`, `curation.critical_path.extract`, `curation.aggregation.compute` span names (per obs-plan §4 + §2 Naming conventions).

- (obs) `info` log level for boundary-call summaries (dedup count result, anomaly marker count), `debug` for internal pipeline detail (per-record processing) — consistent with existing snapshot pattern (per obs-plan §6).

- (obs) Default subscriber fields (`service.name`, `service.version`, `deployment.environment`) registered once at subscriber init — new `curation` crate inherits with no boilerplate (per obs-plan §3 Service identity).

- (obs) `snapshot` crate's P2 must-trace boundary spans (`snapshot.generate.request`, `snapshot.token.count.validate`) remain in `snapshot`; child spans for moved operations become `curation.*` spans that inherit context via `tracing::Span::current()` — established cross-crate span propagation pattern (per obs-plan §3 Trace context propagation).
**Anti-patterns к avoid:**

- (arch) Do NOT introduce `curation` as a sub-module inside the `snapshot` crate (e.g., `snapshot::curation::dedupe`) — defeats workspace-level boundary enforcement and blocks future consumers (capabilities P-010/P-012/P-018) from depending on `curation` without pulling in `snapshot` (per arch §Established Decisions "Module Boundaries").

- (arch) Do NOT add a `tokio` direct runtime dependency to `curation` beyond `tokio::sync` primitives if needed — `curation` is a pure library crate; async runtime ownership belongs to `pulse-app` (per arch §Inherited Defaults).

- (arch) Do NOT register new TauRPC procedures or capability JSON entries for `curation` — refactor-only; IPC surface belongs к `snapshot`; new IPC would require arch §Occupied Resources amendment and capability-drift xtask update (per arch §Occupied Resources + §Cross-cutting Patterns).

- (security) NEVER expose curation internals (`dedupe`, `anomaly`, `critical_path`, `aggregation` implementation functions beyond declared `curation::contract` re-export) as `pub` in `crates/curation/src/lib.rs` — silently widens API surface, creates accidental dependency surface bypassing module-boundary DAG (per security plan §Security Anti-Patterns §Code Patterns; arch §Conventions).

- (security) NEVER add a new `tracing::event!` in curation modules including raw OTLP-derived content as a field value (span names, attribute values, metric label values) — anomaly detection and dedup modules process OTLP attribute content which may contain incidentally captured secrets (per security plan §Logging & Monitoring; §Threat Model Summary Data classification).

- (security) NEVER add a net-new external dependency (crate not already in `Cargo.lock`) to `crates/curation/Cargo.toml` without first verifying `cargo deny check bans licenses sources` passes — refactor-only means re-declare existing workspace-internal deps only (per security plan §Dependency Security; `.claude/rules/security.md` Session Addition 2026-05-03).

- (tests) NEVER leave moved module unit tests orphaned in `snapshot` crate while logic moves to `curation` — orphaned tests would pass against empty bodies giving false coverage credit (per test-plan §11 Anti-Patterns Unit).

- (tests) NEVER lower the coverage threshold to pass build after migration — Standard tier thresholds apply immediately; add tests rather than adjusting the gate (per test-plan §11 Anti-Patterns Quality).

- (tests) NEVER mock the `curation` crate's pure-function output when testing `snapshot` integration — the point of `curation::contract` re-exports is that `snapshot` calls real implementations; integration tests verify full call chain (per test-plan §11 Anti-Patterns Mocking + §8 "What NOT to mock").

- (obs) NEVER silently drop `#[tracing::instrument(skip(...))]` decorators during module moves — missing `skip(...)` on pipeline functions receiving DuckDB result rows or anomaly-detected attribute values would cause PII (raw OTLP attribute values) to appear in span fields (per obs-plan §11 Anti-Patterns Spans/Traces).

- (obs) NEVER leave stale `target` strings in moved modules (e.g., keeping `target: "snapshot::dedupe"` after relocating to `crates/curation/`) — stale targets break agent `jq`-filter grep-ability of the JSON log file (per obs-plan §11 Anti-Patterns Universal).

- (obs) NEVER add `tracing` instrumentation to per-record tight-loop paths inside `dedupe` or `aggregation` during this refactor — over-instrumentation of hot paths contradicts "profile before adding spans to tight loops" (per obs-plan §11 Anti-Patterns Telemetry Strategy).

body:
_Generated by /andromeda-phase Phase 4. Read by /andromeda-implement.
Manual edits between runs are fine; do not edit during /implement run._
- **Phase number:** 54

- **Route chunks covered:**
  - route#58 "Curation crate extraction — Create `crates/curation/`, move `dedupe`, `anomaly` (latency outliers / error correlation / cardinality spikes), `critical_path`, `aggregation` modules from snapshot; pub-ify primitives via `curation::contract` re-exports; snapshot crate's external surface unchanged"
- **Epoch:** 9 — Foundation v0.2.0

Chunk #58 is a refactor-only extraction that lifts the four curation primitives (`dedupe`, `anomaly`, `critical_path`, `aggregation`) out of the `snapshot` crate into a new workspace crate `crates/curation/`, exposing them through `curation::contract` as the public surface. The motivation is pulse v0.2.0 evolution per `docs/v0_2_0/pulse-v0_2_0-route.md`: capabilities P-010 / P-012 / P-018 (algorithmic detection across L1a and L2 distillation levels) need to depend on curation primitives without pulling in the entire `snapshot` crate (markdown generation, token budget, attribute filter) which is L3-snapshot-specific. The refactor preserves snapshot's external Rust-API surface (`snapshot::contract::*` import paths) AND its TauRPC surface (`snapshot.generate`, `snapshot.list_recent`, `snapshot.copy_to_clipboard` procedures unchanged) by re-exporting from `snapshot::contract` whatever was relocated to `curation::contract`. The chunk introduces zero new TauRPC procedures, zero new capability JSON entries, zero new env vars; the only architectural registry change is the new `curation` crate name added to arch §Occupied Resources via `/andromeda-evolve --allow-arch-registry` Type 6 amendment (mirroring 2026-05-09 `streams.*` and 2026-05-11 `pulse:clipboard` precedents).

Critical-path provenance per combined.md §Chunk route#58 Constraints: the four primitive modules MUST move together because they share types (`SpanRecord`, `AnomalyMarker`, `AnomalyKind`, `CriticalPathStep`, `CurationOutput`, `ServicePercentiles`, `AggregationResult`) that snapshot::contract currently defines; the shared types follow the primitives into curation::contract to avoid creating a curation → snapshot reverse-dependency (would violate arch §Cross-cutting Patterns "Module dependency direction" DAG invariant per arch extract). All `#[tracing::instrument]` decorators preserve verbatim through the move; log targets rename from `snapshot::{module}` to `curation::{module}` per obs extract constraint; the existing P2 critical-path instrumentation (`metric.snapshot.token_count_ms`, `dedup_count`, `anomaly_markers` fields per obs constraints) survives because the orchestrator (`snapshot::contract` higher-level entry point) still lives in `snapshot` — only the called helpers move.

1. **Pre-flight arch registry permit.** Run `/andromeda-evolve --allow-arch-registry` to add `curation` to arch §Occupied Resources "Cargo workspace crate names" (currently lists `ingest`, `buffer`, `viz`, `ui-bridge`, `snapshot`, `workspace-detector`, `plugins`, `mcp-server`, `pulse-app`, `xtask` — chunk adds eleventh entry). Type 6 amendment; pattern mirrors 2026-05-11 `pulse:clipboard` and 2026-05-09 `streams.*` precedents. Alternative: defer к /implement Phase 3 if D3 drift surfaces there (both paths are valid per established lifecycle).

2. **Map complete shared-type set.** Read `crates/snapshot/src/contract.rs` in full (442 lines; research only inspected lines 1-100) to enumerate the exhaustive list of shared types + constants used by the 4 moved modules vs snapshot-only types. title: Phase 55 Plan — chunk route#59: "Connection state machine"

data.head: # Phase 55 Plan — chunk route#59: "Connection state machine"

body:
_Generated by /andromeda-phase Phase 4. Read by /andromeda-implement.
Manual edits between runs are fine; do not edit during /implement run._
- **Phase number:** 55

- **Route chunks covered:**
  - route#59 "Connection state machine — LastIngestTracker atomic in ingest hot path; 1-2s poller emits Listening/Receiving/Idle/Stalled/ReceiverFailed states to pulse://stream/connection-state; connection.current_state TauRPC; receiver panic-hook wired (capabilities P-001 through P-004)"

- **Epoch:** Foundation v0.2.0 (Epoch 9 — pulse v0.2.0 evolution; chunk #59 = third chunk; implements Phase 1 "Connection awareness" capabilities P-001 / P-002 / P-003 / P-004 per `docs/v0_2_0/pulse-v0_2_0-route.md`)

Chunk #59 substrate's the orthogonal "connection health" domain (capability P-004) decoupled from the existing throughput/error rate visualization. The implementation extends `IngestState` with a single new atomic timestamp (`last_ingest_at_nanos`) updated by the existing `record_spans` / `record_log_records` / `record_metric_data_points` hot-path methods (zero new touch points in `crates/ingest/src/grpc.rs` or `http.rs`). A new `crates/ingest/src/connection` module defines the 5-state FSM (`Listening` / `Receiving` / `Idle` / `Stalled` / `ReceiverFailed`), a `tokio::sync::broadcast` topic carrying `ConnectionStatePayload` events on state changes only (NEVER per-tick — preserves future webview `aria-live` discipline per a11y plan §11), and a 1-2s `tokio::time::interval` poller that reads the atomic + checks bind-status + transitions state accordingly. A new `pulse-app/src/connection_router.rs` exposes the `connection.current_state` TauRPC procedure (point query returning current state; sanitized `Result<ConnectionStatePayload, AppError>` per arch §Conventions Error response schema). The heartbeat task gains a 5th sibling `run_connection` at the standard 15s cadence (matching `ingest.tick` / `buffer.tick` / `viz.tick` / `plugins.tick` per obs-plan §3) emitting `connection.tick` with current state + last_span_ago_ms — separate from the 1-2s FSM detector loop's transition events.

Receiver-task panic detection rides the existing `std::panic::set_hook → app.panic.fatal` infrastructure (per CLAUDE.md observability rules) + the existing `HeartbeatState::otlp_{grpc,http}_bind = Failed` flag — no new panic hooks installed. The FSM poller transitions to `ReceiverFailed` when EITHER bind-status is Failed OR last-ingest staleness exceeds the threshold while bind-status is Failed; otherwise stale ingest with healthy bind status maps to `Stalled`. This combined heuristic preserves arch §Cross-cutting Patterns "Self-observation discipline" (tracing-only, no OTel SDK) and security plan §Anti-Patterns §Logging row 1 (no raw panic payloads in state broadcast — the `ReceiverFailureReason` enum closes the failure-reason field set).

The four-place TauRPC binding discipline (router registration + capability JSON entry + `xtask EXPECTED_PROCEDURES` + `emit_taurpc_bindings` test) applies per `.claude/rules/security.md` Session Additions 2026-05-12. Capability JSON requires NO edit (default.json uses `core:default` per chunk-#22 router-level granularity rule); `EXPECTED_PROCEDURES` gains one entry; `emit_taurpc_bindings` test merges the new `ConnectionApiImpl`. Implementation order ensures the consuming code (xtask EXPECTED_PROCEDURES extension) lands in the same commit as the new namespace per security.md 2026-05-10 cleanup-with-consuming-chunk pattern.

1. **Extend `IngestState` with last-ingest atomic timestamp.** Modify `crates/ingest/src/state.rs`: add `last_ingest_at_nanos: AtomicI64` field (Default = 0); add `pub fn last_ingest_at_nanos(&self) -> i64` reader; extend each of the existing `record_spans` / `record_log_records` / `record_metric_data_points` methods to call `self.last_ingest_at_nanos.store(Utc::now().timestamp_nanos_opt().unwrap_or(0), Ordering::Relaxed)`. Extend `IngestStateSnapshot` with the new field. Co-locate unit tests in the existing `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` (constructor returns 0; record-* methods advance the value; concurrent receivers preserve monotonic semantics under `Relaxed` because each record_* call is a write-only store + the reader uses load semantics).

2. **Add `chrono.workspace = true` dependency to ingest crate.** Modify `crates/ingest/Cargo.toml`: add `chrono.workspace = true` to `[dependencies]` (required by step 1's `Utc::now().timestamp_nanos_opt()`). The chrono dep already exists at workspace level (per pulse-app/src/heartbeat.rs:7 `use chrono::Utc;`).

3. **Add `tokio = { workspace = true, features = ["test-util"] }` dev-dependency to ingest crate** (per testing.md 2026-05-03). Modify `crates/ingest/Cargo.toml` `[dev-dependencies]`: add the entry. Required for `tokio::time::pause()` / `advance(Duration)` in FSM transition tests. ALSO add `tracing-subscriber.workspace = true` if FSM event-emission tests live in connection.rs (per testing.md 2026-05-07 in-process CapturingSubscriber pattern).

4. **Create `crates/ingest/src/connection.rs`.** New module exposing:
   - `pub const STREAM_NAME_CONNECTION_STATE: &str = "pulse://stream/connection-state";`
   - `pub enum ConnectionState` with 5 variants (`Listening`, `Receiving`, `Idle`, `Stalled`, `ReceiverFailed`) — derives `Debug`, `Clone`, `Copy`, `PartialEq`, `Eq`, `Serialize`, `Deserialize` with `#[serde(tag = "state")]` discriminator (mirrors `AppError`'s `#[serde(tag = "kind")]` per `crates/ui-bridge/src/contract.rs:14-15`). NO color-named / icon-named variants per design extract.
   - `pub enum Severity { Info, Warning, Critical }` — populated by FSM mapping (`Receiving`/`Listening` → Info, `Idle` → Info, `Stalled` → Warning, `ReceiverFailed` → Critical). Satisfies a11y extract requirement for `severity` hint enabling future `aria-live` polite/assertive selection.
   - `pub enum ReceiverFailureReason { BindFailed, StaleHeartbeat, ReceiverPanicked }` — closed enum carrying NO file-path / line-number / library-version / Rust-struct-name content. Satisfies security extract anti-pattern row 1 + a11y extract `ReceiverFailed` message-field sanitization criterion.
   - `pub struct ConnectionStatePayload { pub state: ConnectionState, pub last_span_ago_ms: u64, pub message: Option<String>, pub severity: Severity, pub reason: Option<ReceiverFailureReason> }` — derives `Debug`, `Clone`, `Serialize`, `Deserialize`. `message` populated only for `Stalled`/`ReceiverFailed` from a fixed string template (e.g., `"no spans received in {N}s"` for Stalled; `"OTLP receiver unavailable: {reason_label}"` for ReceiverFailed). NO `displayColor` / `iconGlyph` / `cssClass` fields per design extract anti-pattern.
   - `pub struct ConnectionBroadcast { sender: tokio::sync::broadcast::Sender<ConnectionStatePayload> }` + `pub fn new() -> Self` (channel capacity ≈ 32 per `streams.rs` pattern) + `pub fn subscribe(&self) -> broadcast::Receiver<ConnectionStatePayload>` + `pub fn sender(&self) -> &broadcast::Sender<ConnectionStatePayload>`.
   - `pub fn compute_state(last_ingest_at_nanos: i64, now_nanos: i64, grpc_bind_failed: bool, http_bind_failed: bool, current: ConnectionState) -> ConnectionState` — pure FSM transition function for rstest matrix tests. Thresholds: Idle after 5s no ingest (5_000_000_000 ns), Stalled after 30s no ingest (30_000_000_000 ns; proactively below the 45s heartbeat-gap CI alarm per obs-plan §10), ReceiverFailed when EITHER bind failed flag is true (or `Stalled` + both bind flags failed). Initial state = `Listening` (no ingest seen yet but bind OK).
   - `pub async fn start_poller(ingest_state: Arc<IngestState>, heartbeat_state: Arc<HeartbeatState>, broadcast: Arc<ConnectionBroadcast>)` — 1-2s `tokio::time::interval(Duration::from_secs(1))` loop. Each tick: read atomic + bind status; call `compute_state`; if state changed from prior tick, send `ConnectionStatePayload` to broadcast + emit `tracing::info!(target: "connection.state.transition", from_state=..., to_state=..., last_span_ago_ms=..., trigger_reason=..., severity=..., "transition")` (or `tracing::error!` for ReceiverFailed-via-panic transition per obs-plan §6 + obs extract). NEVER emit per-tick when state unchanged (a11y extract anti-pattern).
5. **Register the new module.** Modify `crates/ingest/src/lib.rs`: add `pub mod connection;` (1 line).

6. **Create `pulse-app/src/connection_router.rs`.** New TauRPC router file mirroring `mcp_router.rs` structure:
   - `#[taurpc::procedures(path = "connection")] pub trait ConnectionApi { async fn current_state() -> Result<ConnectionStatePayload, AppError>; }`
   - `pub struct ConnectionApiImpl { ingest_state: Arc<IngestState>, heartbeat_state: Arc<HeartbeatState> }` + `pub fn new(...) -> Self` constructor + `#[derive(Clone)]`
   - `#[taurpc::resolvers] impl ConnectionApi for ConnectionApiImpl` with `current_state` resolver: `#[tracing::instrument(skip_all, fields(traceparent = tracing::field::Empty, state = tracing::field::Empty))]`; reads atomic via `compute_state` + builds + returns `ConnectionStatePayload`. Error path: poisoned-mutex / unreadable-state → `AppError::Internal { message: "connection state unavailable".to_string() }` per security extract.
   - Re-export connection types from ingest crate (`pub use ingest::connection::{ConnectionState, ConnectionStatePayload, Severity, ReceiverFailureReason};`).
7. **Register the router module.** Modify `pulse-app/src/lib.rs`: add `pub mod connection_router;` (1 line, per pulse-app's [lib]+[[bin]] hybrid pattern from chunk #50).

8. **Wire the router + poller into main.** Modify `pulse-app/src/main.rs`:
   - Add `use pulse_app::connection_router::{ConnectionApi, ConnectionApiImpl};` to the import block (line ~30).
   - Add `use ingest::connection::{self, ConnectionBroadcast};` to the import block (line ~10).
   - Construct `let connection_broadcast = Arc::new(ConnectionBroadcast::new());` near other Arc state inits (around line ~229).
   - Construct `let connection_impl = ConnectionApiImpl::new(Arc::clone(&ingest_state), Arc::clone(&heartbeat_state));` near other API impl inits (around line ~273-323).
   - Add `.merge(connection_impl.clone().into_handler())` to the `invoke_router` chain in BOTH match arms (`Some(buffer_conn)` arm at line ~327-337 + `None` arm at line ~343-353).
   - Add `tauri::async_runtime::spawn(connection::start_poller(Arc::clone(&ingest_state), Arc::clone(&heartbeat_state), Arc::clone(&connection_broadcast)));` in the setup closure (after the existing receiver-spawn blocks around line ~441-483).
   - **emit_taurpc_bindings test extension** (line ~737+): mirror the same construction + `.merge(connection_impl.clone().into_handler())` in the test router. Test stub for IngestState/HeartbeatState construction matches existing test patterns (use default `IngestState::new()` + `HeartbeatState::new()`).

9. **Add `connection.tick` heartbeat (5th sibling task).** Modify `pulse-app/src/heartbeat.rs`:
   - Extend `pub fn spawn(...)` signature with `ingest_state: Arc<IngestState>` already present + add `connection_broadcast: Arc<ConnectionBroadcast>` IF tick payload needs broadcast subscriber count (otherwise the existing ingest_state + heartbeat_state inputs suffice — no broadcast dep needed for the tick).
   - Add 5th task: `async fn run_connection(state: Arc<HeartbeatState>, ingest_state: Arc<IngestState>, heartbeat_state: Arc<HeartbeatState>)` running at `TICK_INTERVAL_SECS = 15` (NOT 1-2s — that's the FSM detector loop, SEPARATE).
   - Add `fn emit_connection_tick(state: &HeartbeatState, ingest_state: &IngestState, heartbeat_state: &HeartbeatState)` computing current state via `connection::compute_state(...)` + emitting `tracing::info!(target: "connection.tick", state=<label>, last_span_ago_ms=N, "heartbeat")`. Co-located test using existing `capture_lines` pattern (lines 211-247) — assert target + fields + cadence.
   - Update `spawn()` return Vec from 4 to 5 handles; update `spawn_returns_four_handles_and_aborts_cleanly` test name + assertion to `spawn_returns_five_handles_and_aborts_cleanly` + assertion `assert_eq!(handles.len(), 5)`.

10. **Extend AllowList for new tracing targets.** Modify `pulse-app/src/observability.rs` `AllowList::production()` (lines 107+). Add explicit per-leaf entries (per testing.md 2026-05-07 dotted-target resolver rule):
    - `"connection"` — covers `connection.tick` heartbeat events (via `.tick` suffix-strip resolver); allowlist fields: `state`, `last_span_ago_ms`, `severity`
    - `"connection.state.transition"` — explicit per-leaf entry for state-change events (resolver does NOT fall back from sub-namespace to crate-name); allowlist fields: `from_state`, `to_state`, `last_span_ago_ms`, `trigger_reason`, `severity`
    - The existing `"tauri.channel.emit"` entry covers `pulse://stream/connection-state` payload emit boundary span (mirrors streams.rs forward_loop pattern; no change needed if a forward_loop is added later)
    - The existing `"ui-bridge.*"` resolver covers the `connection.current_state` TauRPC handler instrument span IF the span target is `ui-bridge.{something}`; otherwise add `"connection.current_state.request"` explicit entry. (Per mcp_router.rs precedent — `mcp.start.request` / `mcp.stop.request` are likely already on the allowlist; check + mirror naming.)

11. **Extend EXPECTED_PROCEDURES.** Modify `xtask/src/main.rs` `EXPECTED_PROCEDURES` const (lines 655-679): add `"connection.current_state",` entry. Add `expected_procedures_includes_connection_namespace_at_chunk_59` test in `capability_drift_tests` mod (mirrors chunk-47 + chunk-49 precedents at lines 904-924).

12. **Sanity restore bindings.ts before capability-drift check (per testing.md 2026-05-13).** During /implement Phase 2 + before commit: any default-features `cargo nextest` run in this session will overwrite `pulse-app/ui/src/bindings/index.ts` (dropping cfg-gated mcp.* procedures). Restore via `git checkout HEAD -- pulse-app/ui/src/bindings/index.ts` BEFORE running `cargo xtask capability-drift` AND BEFORE staging files for commit. Update post-restore to include the new `connection.current_state` procedure: run `cargo nextest run -p pulse-app emit_taurpc_bindings --features mcp-server` (mcp-server feature enabled so the emission includes the full procedure set) to regenerate bindings.ts canonically + stage the updated file.

13. **Co-locate FSM unit tests in `crates/ingest/src/connection.rs::tests`.** Cover (per tests extract patterns):
    - 5×N rstest matrix on `compute_state(last_ingest_at_nanos, now_nanos, grpc_failed, http_failed, current_state)` — assert each (current_state × time × bind-status) → next_state transition matches spec
    - `#[tokio::test(flavor = "current_thread", start_paused = true)] async fn start_poller_transitions_listening_to_receiving_on_first_span` — drive `IngestState::record_spans(1)` via the live atomic write; `tokio::time::advance` past the 1-2s poller tick; subscribe broadcast; assert state-change event received
    - `#[tokio::test] async fn start_poller_emits_only_on_state_change` — drive poller through 5 ticks with stable state; assert subscriber received 0 messages (per a11y anti-pattern: NEVER emit "still in state X" tick on broadcast topic)
    - `#[tokio::test] async fn start_poller_transitions_to_receiver_failed_on_bind_failure` — set `HeartbeatState::record_otlp_grpc_bind(BindStatus::Failed("test".into()))`; advance poller; assert state transitions to `ReceiverFailed` with reason `BindFailed`
    - `#[test] fn payload_sanitization_no_path_or_line_pattern` — synthesize a `ReceiverFailureReason` triggered by panic; assert serialized payload `message` field passes regex bans `[^/\\]+` (no path fragments) AND `[^:]\\d+:\\d+` (no line:column patterns) per a11y extract criterion
    - `#[test] fn payload_serialization_includes_state_discriminator` — round-trip `serde_json::to_string` + assert JSON contains `"state":"ReceiverFailed"` literal per a11y extract criterion

14. **Add integration test for live OTLP loopback → state transition** (optional — colocated `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` OR `crates/ingest/tests/connection_integration.rs`). Subscribe to `ConnectionBroadcast`; send synthetic span via tonic loopback `:4317` (use chunk-#18 fixture `tests/grpc_loopback.rs` `start_test_grpc_server` helper); assert broadcast event with state = `Receiving` within 3s.

15. **Document deferred subscribe-method scope.** Add a comment in `pulse-app/src/connection_router.rs` (or plan-track in `docs/v0_2_0/`) noting: the broadcast topic `pulse://stream/connection-state` is implemented at this chunk but the WEBVIEW SUBSCRIBE TauRPC method (`connection.subscribe_state` or `streams.subscribe_connection_state` mirroring streams.subscribe_spans pattern) is DEFERRED. Webview UI integration in a later chunk #60+ either adds the subscribe method OR consumes `connection.current_state` via 1-2s polling. The broadcast remains useful in-process for heartbeat + tests + future consumers. This decision preserves chunk #59 scope to the route-text contract.

Empty implementations only; no behavior change at scaffold stage.

The chunk is pure infrastructure (parallel-safe with chunks #57/#58/#59) and mirrors the chunk #58 `curation::contract` re-export precedent (`crates/curation/src/lib.rs` 5-line shape + `crates/curation/src/contract.rs` serde-conformant types + co-located `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` round-trip pattern). Per arch §Project Intent "each library crate follows the same shape — a public contract module (the only `pub` surface), `pub(crate)` internals, `thiserror`-derived error enum." Per security plan §Logging "What NEVER to log": narrative-content fields (`Incident.title`, `Incident.detail`, `Digest`-payload strings) carry inline doc-comments forbidding raw OTLP attribute population so subsequent chunks #61+ inherit the redaction discipline at the type-shape level. 1. **Create `crates/triage/Cargo.toml`** mirroring `crates/curation/Cargo.toml`:

   - `[dev-dependencies]` with `proptest.workspace = true` + `rstest.workspace = true` + `serde_json.workspace = true` (round-trip test infrastructure).

2. **Create `crates/triage/src/lib.rs`** mirroring `crates/curation/src/lib.rs` shape:

3. **Create `crates/triage/src/contract.rs`** defining all 10 contract types:
   - Imports: `use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};` (no other deps needed at scaffold stage).
   - `pub enum CueKind` — `#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)] #[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]`. Bounded variants only (no `Other(String)`). Variant naming per P-021 paradigm + pulse v0.2.0 plan: `ErrorRateSpike`, `LatencyRegression`, `RestartEvent`, `ServiceWentSilent`, `RetryStorm` (initial set; future chunks may extend). All variants surface as `"error_rate_spike"` / `"latency_regression"` / etc. in JSON.
   - `pub enum CueScope` — same derive shape. Bounded variants distinguishing the cue's affected unit: `Service`, `Operation`, `Global`.
   - `pub enum PriorityTier` — same derive shape. Three variants per P-019 + capability spec: `Autonomous`, `Suggested`, `Curious`. Variants serialize as `"autonomous"` / `"suggested"` / `"curious"`.
   - `pub enum Severity` — same derive shape. Bounded log-level-like variants: `Info`, `Warn`, `Error`, `Critical` (mirrors `tracing::Level` ordering for future `tracing` event integration per obs extract).
   - `pub enum IncidentStatus` — same derive shape. Bounded lifecycle states: `Active`, `Acknowledged`, `Resolved`.
   - `pub enum DigestKind` — same derive shape. Bounded payload type indicators: `Snapshot`, `IncidentSummary`, `BaselineState`, `AttentionCueDigest` (placeholder set; future chunks may extend).
   - `pub struct EvidenceRefs` — `#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]`. Fields: `trace_id: Option<[u8; 16]>`, `span_ids: Vec<[u8; 8]>`, `fingerprint_hashes: Vec<String>`, `timestamps_unix_nano: Vec<i64>`. Raw bytes per OTLP spec mirror `curation::contract::SpanRecord` shape (Q2 resolved: raw bytes; hex conversion happens at emission site).
   - `pub struct AttentionCue` — `#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]`. Fields per P-021 + P-057 spec: `kind: CueKind`, `scope: CueScope`, `scope_id: Option<String>` (service.name or operation.name; bounded by OTLP cardinality discipline at emission site), `magnitude: f64` (multiplier vs baseline), `absolute_value: f64`, `persistence_seconds: u64`, `confidence: f64` (0.0–1.0), `priority_tier: PriorityTier`, `suppression_bypassed: bool` (per P-057 dual-condition bypass).
   - `pub struct Incident` — `#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]`. Fields: `id: String` (uuid-shaped; not validated at type level), `fingerprint: String` (anonymized hash per P-047 / security extract redaction-by-construction), `title: String` + doc-comment forbidding raw OTLP attribute population, `detail: String` + same doc-comment, `status: IncidentStatus`, `severity: Severity`, `priority_tier: PriorityTier`, `evidence_refs: EvidenceRefs`, `opened_at_unix_nano: i64`, `resolved_at_unix_nano: Option<i64>`.
   - `pub struct Digest` — `#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]`. Fields keeping narrative separable from enumerated metadata per obs extract: `kind: DigestKind`, `token_count: usize`, `payload_summary: String` + doc-comment forbidding raw OTLP attribute population, `incident_refs: Vec<String>` (incident.id references), `generated_at_unix_nano: i64`.
   - Co-located `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` block with:
     - Per-enum `<enum>_serializes_snake_case` test verifying serialization shape (`assert_eq!(serde_json::to_string(&CueKind::ErrorRateSpike).unwrap(), "\"error_rate_spike\"")`).
     - Per-type `<type>_round_trips_through_serde` test (serialize → deserialize → assert_eq).
     - Optional `<type>_default` test if `Default` impl is derived (chunk #60 does NOT need defaults — keep tests minimal).
     - 10 round-trip tests covering all public types per tests extract acceptance criterion 5.
     - Test helper fns (e.g., `sample_attention_cue()`, `sample_incident()`) following curation `span_for_test` pattern.

4. **Create 7 empty module skeleton files** (`crates/triage/src/baseline.rs`, `crates/triage/src/cue.rs`, `crates/triage/src/digest.rs`, `crates/triage/src/incident.rs`, `crates/triage/src/interpretation.rs`, `crates/triage/src/lifecycle.rs`, `crates/triage/src/pattern.rs`). Each file contains a single module-level `//!` doc comment naming the future chunk that will populate it. Example for `baseline.rs`:

body: **Constraints across domains:**

- (security) New workspace deps `tdigest`, `dashmap`, `bincode` MUST pass `cargo audit` + `cargo deny check bans licenses sources`; transitive duplicate conflicts surfaced by `multiple-versions = "deny"` posture resolve via `deny.toml [bans] skip` entries with one-line provenance comments OR upstream resolution before chunk merges (per security plan §Dependency Security CI integration + CLAUDE.md Session Additions 2026-05-03).

- (security) Corpus state file path MUST canonicalize via `strict-path` and assert resolved path lives under `ANDROMEDA_PULSE_DATA_DIR` (or per-platform default) before read/write — CWE-22 path-traversal defense (per security plan §Input Validation CLI/env var inputs row + §Anti-Patterns § Input row 4).

- (security) `bincode::deserialize` on the corpus state file at startup MUST treat the bytes as untrusted input — max file-size cap on read (e.g., 1 MB), max service-count cap on deserialized map, reject malformed/truncated payloads via fall-through to fresh bootstrap (no panic, no allocation amplification) (per security plan §Input Validation boundary discipline + §Anti-Patterns § Code Patterns).

- (security) The corpus state file MUST NOT contain raw OTLP attribute values, span/log/metric content payloads, or full operation_name strings sourced from user telemetry — store statistical aggregates only, keyed by `service.name` + operation_name hash/identity (per security plan §Anti-Patterns § Logging row 1 + §Data Protection at-rest "incidentally captured secrets" classification).

- (security) Aggregate `tracing::warn!(target: "triage.service_id_missing")` per tick MUST be cardinality-bounded (one event per tick) and MUST NOT include OTLP attribute values, span_id, trace_id, or operation name — emit count integer only (per security plan §Logging & Monitoring NEVER-log list + §Anti-Patterns § Logging row 3).

- (security) Service identity drop on empty `service.name` MUST happen at the ingest→triage boundary BEFORE values flow into trackers — post-`prost`-decode invariant-check pattern (per security plan §Input Validation OTLP/gRPC row + §Anti-Patterns § Input row 3).

- (security) The new `crates/triage/baseline` module MUST NOT introduce new TauRPC procedures, new capability JSON entries, or new `pulse-app/capabilities/` modifications — chunk scope is internal trackers + corpus file; no IPC surface (per CLAUDE.md Session Additions 2026-05-12).

- (tests) Tests MUST run via `cargo nextest run -p triage --profile ci` (Standard tier framework) — per-process isolation required because corpus-persistence integration tests touch `tempfile::TempDir` paths and global tokio time may be paused (per test-plan §3 Bootstrap phase 1 `test-runner-install` + §4 Unit Test Strategy Framework).

- (tests) Workspace coverage gate ≥ 75% line / ≥ 70% branch / ≥ 85% function applies to `crates/triage/baseline`; generated bincode/serde derives may be excluded via `cargo llvm-cov --exclude-files` only if pure-derive (per test-plan §10 Quality Gates).

- (tests) Property-based proptest cases MUST be seeded deterministically with `proptest-regressions/` committed under `crates/triage/proptest-regressions/` — no flaky reruns; flakes are quarantine + fix, never retry-once (per test-plan §11 Quality + §7 Randomized data row).

- (tests) Time-sensitive tests (5-min EWMA window, 60s corpus persist tick, swap-on-tick t-digest rotation) MUST use `tokio::time::pause()` + `tokio::time::advance(Duration)` — never `std::time::Instant::now()` or sleep (per test-plan §8 Time row + §11 Universal "NEVER use real time").
- (tests) Corpus persistence integration tests MUST use `tempfile::TempDir` + drop-on-test-exit cleanup; no shared mutable state across parallel tests (per test-plan §7 lifecycle + §11 Test Data).

- (tests) Service-identity drop test MUST assert structured tracing event via `tracing-subscriber::fmt::TestWriter` capture; assertion MUST grep on event field shape, never on raw OTLP attribute payloads (per test-plan §11 Universal + CLAUDE.md critical warning).

- (obs) New code emits structured JSON via shared `tracing-subscriber` JSON formatter to `~/.andromeda-pulse/logs/agent-latest.jsonl`; no separate sink, no `println!`, no stdout (per obs-plan §3 Logging stack + §11 Universal anti-pattern row 8).

- (obs) Metric events use `metric.{module}.{measure}` target convention emitted via `tracing::info!` with numeric `value` field + enumerated label fields (per obs-plan §5). For chunk #61: `metric.baseline.ewma_short_window_size` (gauge per tick), `pipeline.l1b.persist_count_total` (counter per persist), `pipeline.l1b.bootstrap_count_total{kind}` (counter with enumerated `kind` label).

- (obs) Service identity drop MUST emit **aggregate** `tracing::warn!(target: "triage.service_id_missing", dropped_count = N, ...)` per heartbeat tick, NOT per-span (per route §3 chunk #61 mandate + obs-plan §11 Metrics row 1 unbounded-label ban).

- (obs) `triage.baseline.tick` heartbeat MUST fire every 15s (or 60s aligned with persist cycle) via `tokio::time::interval`; absence > 45s = stall signal in CI (per obs-plan §3 Heartbeat ticks + §10 CI gates row 3).

- (obs) Span-overhead discipline on hot path: NO `#[tracing::instrument]` on per-span update fn (`EwmaTracker::update()` / `TDigest::insert()` / `RollingWindow::push()`); instrument at per-tick aggregation / per-persist boundary only (per obs-plan §11 Telemetry Strategy row 1).

- (arch) Code MUST live in existing `crates/triage/` workspace member; chunk does NOT introduce a new workspace crate (per arch §Inherited Defaults "Module boundaries" + 2026-05-16 amendment session 74 registration).

- (arch) Module dependency direction MUST flow toward `pulse-app`; `triage` crate MUST NOT depend on `pulse-app` or sibling crates beyond declared contract (per arch §Cross-cutting Patterns "Module dependency direction"). New `tdigest` / `dashmap` / `bincode` deps live in `crates/triage/Cargo.toml` only.

- (arch) All persistence I/O MUST resolve paths via existing `ANDROMEDA_PULSE_DATA_DIR` envelope + canonicalize via `strict-path` + assert resolved path lives under data dir before write (per arch §Occupied Resources Environment variables + CLAUDE.md Critical Warnings). Corpus file at subpath under resolved root (e.g., `<data-dir>/triage/baseline-corpus.bin`); do NOT introduce a new top-level env var.

- (arch) Persisted state types MUST be `serde::Serialize` + `serde::Deserialize`; types MUST be self-versioned (embed `schema_version: u32` or equivalent) so future schema migrations don't corrupt load (per arch §Conventions "Validation surface" + §Inherited Defaults "Validation library").

- (arch) Error surface inside the crate MUST use `thiserror` 2.x-derived enum; errors crossing later to `pulse-app` or webview convert via `From` impls to `AppError::Storage { message }` (corpus IO) or `AppError::Internal { message }` (tracker invariants) — strip stack traces, file paths, library versions (per arch §Established Decisions [Error Handling Pattern] + CLAUDE.md Critical Warnings).

- (arch) The `triage` crate exposes only public contract via `pub` re-exports through `triage::contract`; cross-module utilities use `pub(crate)`; no `pub use` re-exports outside `triage::contract` (per arch §Conventions "Module visibility discipline"; mirrors `curation::contract` precedent from chunk #58).
**Patterns к follow:**

- (security) Strict-path canonicalization for corpus file path mirrors `ANDROMEDA_PULSE_DATA_DIR` / `ANDROMEDA_PULSE_PLUGIN_DIR` / `ANDROMEDA_PULSE_CONFIG_PATH` resolution (per security plan §Bootstrap phases `input-validation-library-install` + §Input Validation CLI/env var inputs row).

- (security) Bounded size caps follow the OTLP receiver pattern (`DefaultBodyLimit::max(8 * 1024 * 1024)` for HTTP; `.max_decoding_message_size(8 * 1024 * 1024)` for gRPC) — apply analogous bounded read к corpus state file before deserialize (per security plan §Input Validation row 1+2 + §API Security request-size-limit row).

- (security) Error sanitization at the persistence boundary: I/O errors collapse to internal `tracing` log + graceful bootstrap-fresh fall-through, no raw `std::io::Error` paths or `bincode::Error` details outward (per security plan §Error Handling TauRPC bridge + §Anti-Patterns § Logging row 4).

- (tests) Rust `#[cfg(test)] mod tests { ... }` co-located inside `crates/triage/src/baseline/*.rs`; `#[fixture] fn ...` decorators via `rstest` 0.26.1 for builder reuse (per test-plan §4 Unit Test Strategy Conventions + Fixture pattern).

- (tests) `MockTraceSpan::builder()` from `ingest` crate is the canonical synthetic-span fixture — chunk #61 baseline tests consume `Vec<TraceSpan>` streams via this builder for EWMA + t-digest convergence assertions; do NOT introduce a parallel synthetic-span builder under `crates/triage/` (per test-plan §3 Test data bootstrap + §7 Persistent data row).

- (tests) Property-based tests use `proptest` 1.10.0 with `proptest! { ... }` macro + bounded strategies (`prop::collection::vec(span_strategy(), 0..10_000)`) — assert invariants such as "p50 ≤ p95 ≤ p99 always", "EWMA bounded within observed min/max", "RollingWindow length ≤ capacity" (per test-plan §2 Test pyramid Property-based row + §7).

- (tests) State round-trip serialization tests follow encode→decode→assert-eq pattern with `bincode::serialize` + `bincode::deserialize`; assert structural equivalence on corpus struct's public contract, not internal flag bits (per test-plan §11 Unit "test contracts, not implementation details").

- (tests) Integration tests for persist-every-60s use `#[tokio::test(start_paused = true)]` + `tokio::time::advance(Duration::from_secs(60))` to deterministically trigger persist boundaries (per test-plan §5 Setup/teardown lifecycle + §11 Universal).

- (obs) Per-tick metric emission at heartbeat boundary: emit `tracing::info!(target: "metric.baseline.ewma_short_window_size", value = N, service_id_count = N, ...)` once per tick inside `triage.baseline.tick` span body (per obs-plan §3 Heartbeat ticks + §5 Buffer-memory gauge template).

- (obs) Per-event counter emission at persist boundary: emit `tracing::info!(target: "pipeline.l1b.persist_count_total", value = 1, duration_ms = N, persist_kind = "periodic" | "shutdown", state_size_bytes = N)` once per persist completion (per obs-plan §5 Counter pattern).

- (obs) Bootstrap counter with enumerated `kind` label: emit `tracing::info!(target: "pipeline.l1b.bootstrap_count_total", value = 1, kind = "cold_start" | "resume_from_corpus" | "corpus_corrupt_reset", ...)` once per bootstrap path (per obs-plan §5 Metric label cardinality discipline).

- (obs) Error capture at persist failure boundary: `tracing::warn!` or `tracing::error!(target: "triage.baseline.persist.error", error_category = "io" | "serialize" | "permission", duration_ms = N)` — no raw path, no `error.source()` chain (per obs-plan §6 + §7 + Vector 2 stack-trace sanitization).

- (obs) Span-attribute scrubber pattern: corpus persistence span `triage.baseline.persist` uses `#[tracing::instrument(skip(corpus_state), fields(service_id_count, state_size_bytes, duration_ms))]` — `corpus_state` never enters span fields (per obs-plan §8 At-source scrubbing + §11 Spans row 1).

- (arch) Single-binary modular monolith: baseline trackers run inside `pulse-app` process tokio runtime; ingest-channel feed uses existing `tokio::sync::mpsc` + `tokio::sync::broadcast` for span-stream tap; mirrors chunk #59 `connection.current_state` poller pattern threaded via `Arc<dyn Trait>` constructor injection (per arch §Established Decisions [In-Process Channel Architecture] + CLAUDE.md security.md Session Additions 2026-05-16).

- (arch) `serde`-friendly state container shape: primitive types live in module files (`baseline.rs` / `lifecycle.rs`); re-export public-API surface via `triage::contract` so downstream consumers (chunks #62 attention cue emitter, #63 restart event detector) import one shape (per arch §Conventions + chunks #58/#60 precedent).

- (arch) Per-platform path resolution: corpus file under resolved data root with identical subpath layout on all 3 OSes (Linux `~/.andromeda-pulse/triage/`, macOS `~/Library/Application Support/com.andromeda.pulse/triage/`, Windows `%APPDATA%\andromeda-pulse\triage\`); honor `ANDROMEDA_PULSE_DATA_DIR` override identically (per arch §Occupied Resources Filesystem locations).

- (arch / security) `cargo deny` skip-list pattern for transitive duplicates: when `tdigest` / `dashmap` / `bincode` surface benign duplicate transitive deps, add one-line provenance entries to `deny.toml [bans] skip` rather than relaxing the deny posture (per CLAUDE.md security.md Session Additions 2026-05-03; precedented at Tauri 2.10 upgrade).

- (tests) NEVER mock `tdigest` or `dashmap` — they are units under test; use real implementations with deterministic seeding (per test-plan §8 What NOT to mock + §11 Mocking).

- (obs) NEVER emit `service.name` as a high-cardinality field on per-span `tracing::warn!` for missing-service-identity cases — aggregate by tick, emit count + sample-N (per obs-plan §11 Metrics row 1 + explicit route §3 chunk #61 mandate).

- (obs) NEVER add `#[tracing::instrument]` to `EwmaTracker::update()` / `TDigest::insert()` / `RollingWindow::push()` — these run inside the ingest hot path on every span; span construction overhead destroys throughput budget (per obs-plan §11 Telemetry Strategy row 1). - (obs) NEVER log corpus file path verbatim — emit `corpus_basename` only (e.g., `"baselines.bin"`), never `/home/user/.andromeda-pulse/baselines.bin` (per obs-plan §11 Spans row 6 Vector 3 + §8 path scrubbing).

- (arch) Do NOT introduce a new workspace crate — chunk uses existing `crates/triage/` member. Adding a new crate beyond the 12 reserved names requires `/andromeda-evolve --allow-arch-registry` (per arch §Occupied Resources reservation discipline).

- (arch) Do NOT add a new env var (e.g., `ANDROMEDA_PULSE_BASELINE_PATH`) — corpus file uses existing `ANDROMEDA_PULSE_DATA_DIR` envelope with a subpath, mirroring `config.toml` / `plugins/` / `snapshots/` / `logs/` siblings (per arch §Occupied Resources Environment variables).

data.head: # Phase 57 Plan — chunk route#61: "Streaming baseline trackers + corpus persistence"

body: _Generated by /andromeda-phase Phase 4. Read by /andromeda-implement. Manual edits between runs are fine; do not edit during /implement run._
- **Phase number:** 57

- **Route chunks covered:**
  - route#61 "Streaming baseline trackers + corpus persistence — EwmaTracker per service (5-min window) + per-operation t-digest pair (current/previous, swap-on-tick) for streaming p50/p95/p99 + per-service RollingWindow<u32>; corpus persist every 60s + on-shutdown; service identity drop on empty service.name; capabilities P-009 + P-011; workspace deps: +tdigest +dashmap +bincode"
- **Epoch:** 9 — Foundation v0.2.0

Chunk #61 implements the L1b streaming distillation foundation inside `crates/triage/baseline` per the chunk #60 scaffold + pulse v0.2.0 plan Phase 2. The deliverable is three callable + testable algorithm primitives (`EwmaTracker` per service for 5-min-window error-rate baselines, `TDigestPair` per operation with swap-on-tick rotation for streaming p50/p95/p99 latency baselines, `RollingWindow<u32>` per service for activity tracking) plus a `BaselineState` aggregator backed by `DashMap` for concurrent observe-by-multiple-tasks access, plus a corpus persistence layer that flushes to a `bincode`-serialized file under `<data-dir>/triage/` every 60s and on graceful shutdown — with load-on-startup that applies a state-age check (<1h → adjusted alpha; else fresh bootstrap). The chunk also formalizes the service-identity-drop discipline on empty `service.name` (drop pre-tracker, emit aggregate `tracing::warn!(target: "triage.service_id_missing")` per tick with count-only payload) and adds 7 new tracing emission targets к the `pulse-app/src/observability.rs::AllowList::production()` registry so the default-deny `JsonFieldVisitor` doesn't redact field content. Capabilities enabled: P-009 (Per-Service Error Rate Baseline including state persistence) + P-011 (Per-Operation Latency Baseline). Per arch §Module dependency direction, code stays inside `crates/triage/` with workspace-dep additions (`tdigest`, `dashmap`, `bincode`); deny.toml `multiple-versions = "deny"` posture is preserved (new transitive duplicates land in `[bans] skip` with one-line provenance comments).

Out of scope for chunk #61: boot wiring (spawning the persist loop + threading observe_span() into the ingest hot path). Per `docs/v0_2_0/pulse-v0_2_0-route.md` §Phase 2 the actual span-stream tap + tick-loop spawn is deferred to chunk #62 (attention cue emitter) which consumes baseline output. Chunk #61 delivers the consumable primitives + persistence layer + their tests; chunk #62 will own the integration cost.

Provenance: combined.md §Chunk route#61 cross-domain merges per security plan §Dependency Security + §Input Validation + §Anti-Patterns Code Patterns + §Logging; test-plan §3 + §4 + §10 + §11 + §12; obs-plan §3 + §5 + §6 + §8 + §10 + §11; architecture.md §Inherited Defaults + §Conventions + §Established Decisions + §Occupied Resources + §Cross-cutting Patterns + §Existing Scopes (`pulse-v0_2_0-route`).

1. **Workspace dependency additions.** Add three `[workspace.dependencies]` entries to root `Cargo.toml`:
   - `tdigest` — MnO2's streaming t-digest implementation (version pinned at /implement Phase 2 after `cargo audit` survey; route §3 says "0.x", likely 0.2.x latest stable).
   - `dashmap` — concurrent map for per-service / per-operation state without contention on the hot observe path (version pinned at /implement Phase 2; 6.x is current).
   - `bincode` — corpus state serialization (1.x preferred for ecosystem compat; defer final pin to /implement Phase 2 cargo-deny survey).
   Apply in alphabetical order or grouped under a comment like `# Triage baseline (route#61 — Epoch 9 Foundation v0.2.0 fifth chunk)` mirroring the existing per-epoch grouping comments.

2. **Triage crate `[dependencies]` additions.** In `crates/triage/Cargo.toml`, add to `[dependencies]`:
   - `tdigest.workspace = true`
   - `dashmap.workspace = true`
   - `bincode.workspace = true`
   - `strict-path.workspace = true` (for corpus path canonicalization + confine; already a workspace dep per root `Cargo.toml:45`)
   - `tokio.workspace = true` (needed for `tokio::time::interval` in the persist loop future; not currently in triage's deps because contract-only scaffold needed none)
   Add to `[dev-dependencies]`:
   - `tempfile.workspace = true` (for `TempDir` in integration tests)

3. **deny.toml skip-list extension (after cargo deny survey).** After step 2 lands, run `cargo deny check bans licenses sources` and observe any new duplicate-version flags from `tdigest` / `dashmap` / `bincode` transitive trees. For each, add an entry under `[bans] skip = [ ... ]` in `deny.toml` with a one-line provenance comment in the established format (line 49-134 precedent). DO NOT relax `multiple-versions = "deny"` posture. The `tonic 0.14 ↔ 0.13` canary at line 42 stays unchanged.

4. **Replace `crates/triage/src/baseline.rs` stub.** Either rewrite as a single file OR convert to a directory module `crates/triage/src/baseline/` with submodules per Phase 3 research "Sub-divided baseline module" question. Recommended structure:
   - `crates/triage/src/baseline/mod.rs` — exports + `BaselineState` aggregator + `observe_span()` entry point + `run_persist_loop()` future + module-scope const for schema_version + AllowList tracing target constants
   - `crates/triage/src/baseline/ewma.rs` — `EwmaTracker` struct (state: `current_value: f64`, `last_update_nanos: i64`, `alpha: f64`); fn `new(alpha_for_5min_window) -> Self`, `observe(value: f64, now_nanos: i64) -> f64`, accessor `value() -> f64`; derive `Serialize + Deserialize` for bincode round-trip.
   - `crates/triage/src/baseline/tdigest_pair.rs` — `TDigestPair` struct holding `(current: TDigest, previous: TDigest, last_swap_nanos: i64)`; fn `new() -> Self`, `insert(value: f64)`, `swap_on_tick(now_nanos: i64) -> bool` (rotates current→previous when window elapsed; returns true if rotation happened), `percentile(q: f64) -> Option<f64>` (queries previous + current for stable result over rotation boundary). Derive `Serialize + Deserialize`; t-digest centroid count is part of serialized state.
   - `crates/triage/src/baseline/rolling_window.rs` — `RollingWindow<u32>` fixed-capacity circular buffer; fn `with_capacity(cap: usize) -> Self`, `push(value: u32)`, `len() -> usize`, `sum() -> u64`, `mean() -> f64`. Derive `Serialize + Deserialize`.
   - `crates/triage/src/baseline/corpus.rs` — corpus persistence: `resolve_corpus_path(data_dir: &Path) -> Result<PathBuf, BaselineError>` (strict-path canonicalize + assert under data_dir; creates `<data-dir>/triage/` subdir if absent), `persist_state(path: &Path, state: &BaselineState) -> Result<PersistStats, BaselineError>` (bincode serialize + write via `tempfile + rename` for atomicity), `load_state(path: &Path, max_size_bytes: u64) -> Result<BootstrapResult, BaselineError>` (size-cap bounded read + bincode deserialize + schema_version check + service-count sanity cap; on any failure: returns `BootstrapResult::Fresh` + emits sanitized `tracing::warn` + the caller increments `pipeline.l1b.bootstrap_count_total{kind = "corpus_corrupt_reset"}`).
   - `crates/triage/src/baseline/error.rs` — `thiserror::Error`-derived `BaselineError` enum: `Io { kind: io::ErrorKind }`, `Serialize`, `Deserialize`, `SchemaVersionMismatch { expected, got }`, `SizeCapExceeded { actual, max }`, `ServiceCountCapExceeded { count, max }`, `PathTraversal`, `PathCanonicalize { kind: io::ErrorKind }`. No raw `std::io::Error` content in any variant — only `io::ErrorKind` (which is a closed enum, no PII).

5. **Service-identity-drop discipline.** In `mod.rs` `observe_span()` entry point: if `service_name.is_empty()`, increment an `AtomicU32 drops_since_last_tick` counter on `BaselineState` (no per-span warn emission); the per-tick loop in `run_persist_loop()` reads + resets the counter and emits `tracing::warn!(target: "triage.service_id_missing", dropped_count = N, "service.name empty; spans dropped this tick")` exactly once per tick when `N > 0`. Field set MUST be `dropped_count` only — no `service_name`, no `span_id`, no `trace_id`, no `operation_name`.

6. **Public surface via `triage::contract`.** In `crates/triage/src/contract.rs`, add re-exports for the public-API types: `pub use crate::baseline::{BaselineState, BaselineError, BootstrapResult, PersistStats}`. Do NOT re-export the per-algorithm primitives (`EwmaTracker` / `TDigestPair` / `RollingWindow`) unless future chunks need cross-crate access (chunk #62 emitter only needs `BaselineState` query methods — keep algorithms `pub(crate)`).
7. **Tracing target constants.** Define module-scope `const` strings for each tracing target in `crates/triage/src/baseline/mod.rs`:

These act as compile-time `&'static str` literals safe for the `tracing::warn!(target: ...)` macro (per CLAUDE.md testing.md Session Additions 2026-05-10 entry on macro-time literal requirement; the const-string identifier IS a literal at expansion).

8. **AllowList::production() registry entries.** In `pulse-app/src/observability.rs::AllowList::production()` (around lines 99-145; current entries include `"buffer"` at 145, `"snapshot"` at 181), add 7 `by_target.insert(target, fields_hash_set)` entries for the chunk #61 targets — one per constant above. Field sets per combined.md + obs research:
   - `triage.baseline.tick` — fields: `value`, `service_id_count`, `tdigest_centroid_count`, `dropped_count`
   - `triage.baseline.persist` — fields: `service_id_count`, `state_size_bytes`, `duration_ms`, `persist_kind`, `corpus_basename`
   - `triage.baseline.persist.error` — fields: `error_category`, `duration_ms`
   - `triage.service_id_missing` — fields: `dropped_count`
   - `metric.baseline.ewma_short_window_size` — fields: `value`, `service_id_count`
   - `pipeline.l1b.persist_count_total` — fields: `value`, `duration_ms`, `persist_kind`, `state_size_bytes`
   - `pipeline.l1b.bootstrap_count_total` — fields: `value`, `kind`
   Follow the existing pattern: `["field1", "field2", ...].iter().copied().collect()`. Insertion order doesn't matter (HashMap), but keep grouped together with a banner comment like `// Chunk #61 — triage baseline trackers + corpus persistence (Epoch 9 Foundation v0.2.0 fifth chunk)`.
9. **Run-persist-loop future.** In `crates/triage/src/baseline/mod.rs`, implement:

Body: `tokio::time::interval(interval)` loop; each tick: (a) swap-on-tick rotation on all t-digest pairs, (b) emit `metric.baseline.ewma_short_window_size` per tick with current `service_id_count` + `tdigest_centroid_count`, (c) flush corpus state via `persist_state()` and emit `pipeline.l1b.persist_count_total` (or `triage.baseline.persist.error` on failure), (d) emit `triage.service_id_missing` if drops counter > 0 (reset counter). The function is `pub` so chunk #62 can spawn it from boot.

10. **Graceful shutdown helper.** Provide a `pub fn persist_on_shutdown(state: &BaselineState, corpus_path: &Path) -> Result<PersistStats, BaselineError>` synchronous (or `pub async fn ...`) function callable from a Tauri shutdown hook in a future wiring chunk. Emits `pipeline.l1b.persist_count_total{persist_kind = "shutdown"}` on success. Chunk #61 does NOT wire this к Tauri shutdown — chunk #62 will.

11. **Bootstrap on startup helper.** Provide `pub fn bootstrap_from_corpus(corpus_path: &Path, max_size_bytes: u64, service_count_cap: usize) -> BaselineState`. Logic: call `load_state()`; on success with state-age <1h adjust alpha; on age ≥1h OR load failure emit `pipeline.l1b.bootstrap_count_total{kind}` where `kind ∈ {"cold_start", "resume_from_corpus", "resume_with_adjusted_alpha", "corpus_corrupt_reset", "schema_mismatch", "size_cap_exceeded"}`; return fresh or loaded `BaselineState`. Size cap default constant: 1 MB. Service-count cap default constant: 1024.

12. **Property-based tests under `crates/triage/src/baseline/{module}.rs::tests`.** Cover:
    - EWMA convergence: synthetic stream → EWMA value converges within bounds of observed min/max (proptest invariant).
    - t-digest percentile monotonicity: for any value stream of ≥256 elements, `p50 ≤ p95 ≤ p99 ≤ max` (proptest invariant).
    - RollingWindow capacity invariant: `len() ≤ capacity` always (proptest invariant).
    - Swap-on-tick rotation: after swap, query returns combined current+previous; before swap, only current (proptest unit on time advance).
    - Service-identity-drop: synthetic stream with N empty-service spans → exactly 1 warn event per tick with `dropped_count = N` (in-process subscriber assertion).
    - State round-trip: `persist_state(state) → load_state(path) → assert_eq!(reloaded.contract_view(), state.contract_view())` (integration with `tempfile::TempDir` + `tokio::time::pause()`).
    - Malformed-bytes graceful bootstrap: write truncated / oversize / wrong-schema_version payload → `bootstrap_from_corpus` returns Fresh + emits sanitized warn + counter increments (negative-canary tests).
    - PII-on-disk negative-canary: synthetic state with `service_name = "secret-canary-API-key-12345-service"`; after persist, the on-disk bincode bytes are scanned via `grep` for known PII patterns. Per combined.md obs Acceptance Criteria, the on-disk file CAN contain `service_name` length-prefixed (it's the identity key); the JSON LOG file MUST NOT contain it verbatim. Test asserts log file clean; on-disk file is excluded from the grep scope.
    Commit `crates/triage/proptest-regressions/baseline-*.txt` if any regressions surface during /implement.

13. **Self-check: no boot wiring this chunk.** Verify by `git diff pulse-app/src/main.rs` returning empty AND `git diff pulse-app/src/heartbeat.rs` returning empty AND `git diff pulse-app/src/connection_router.rs` returning empty. Boot integration is chunk #62 territory.

- `crates/triage/src/baseline/mod.rs` — module root with `BaselineState` aggregator + `observe_span()` entry + `run_persist_loop()` future + `bootstrap_from_corpus()` + tracing-target constants + tests
- `crates/triage/src/baseline/ewma.rs` — `EwmaTracker` algorithm + Serialize/Deserialize + tests
- `crates/triage/src/baseline/tdigest_pair.rs` — `TDigestPair` with swap-on-tick + Serialize/Deserialize + tests
- `crates/triage/src/baseline/rolling_window.rs` — `RollingWindow<u32>` circular buffer + Serialize/Deserialize + tests
- `crates/triage/src/baseline/corpus.rs` — corpus path resolution + persist/load with size + service-count caps + atomic write + tests
- `crates/triage/src/baseline/error.rs` — `BaselineError` thiserror enum
- `crates/triage/proptest-regressions/baseline-*.txt` — committed proptest regression files (created if regressions fire during /implement; otherwise omitted)
(Single-file alternative: `crates/triage/src/baseline.rs` consolidates all of the above into one file if total size stays under ~600 lines. Either shape passes acceptance criteria.)
- `Cargo.toml` (workspace root) — add `[workspace.dependencies]` entries for `tdigest`, `dashmap`, `bincode` (3 new lines + 1 banner comment)
- `crates/triage/Cargo.toml` — add 4 `[dependencies]` entries (`tdigest`, `dashmap`, `bincode`, `strict-path`, `tokio`) + 1 `[dev-dependencies]` entry (`tempfile`)
- `deny.toml` — extend `[bans] skip = [ ... ]` with one-line provenance comments for each new transitive duplicate (count TBD at /implement after `cargo deny check`)
- `crates/triage/src/lib.rs` — no change (already declares `pub(crate) mod baseline; pub mod contract`)
- `crates/triage/src/baseline.rs` — replaced (deleted if subdividing into `baseline/` directory module; or rewritten)

- `crates/triage/src/contract.rs` — add `pub use crate::baseline::{BaselineState, BaselineError, BootstrapResult, PersistStats}` re-exports (4 new lines near existing `pub use` block if any, OR new lines at module top)
- `pulse-app/src/observability.rs` — add 7 `by_target.insert(...)` entries in `AllowList::production()` (+ a banner comment delimiter)
- `pulse-app/src/main.rs` — boot wiring (spawn persist loop, thread `observe_span()` к ingest hot path) is chunk #62 territory; chunk #61 plan does NOT touch main.rs

data.head: ### Per route#61: "Streaming baseline trackers + corpus persistence"

body: - (security) `cargo audit` passes with no advisory-severity-above-warning findings against the new `Cargo.lock` containing `tdigest`, `dashmap`, `bincode` (per combined.md §Acceptance criteria contributions security row 1).

- (security) `cargo deny check bans licenses sources` passes; any new transitive-duplicate flagged by `multiple-versions = "deny"` is either upstream-resolved OR added к `deny.toml [bans] skip` with a one-line provenance comment; `multiple-versions = "deny"` posture preserved; `tonic 0.14 ↔ 0.13` canary stays out of skip (per combined.md security row 2).

- (security) Corpus state file path canonicalizes via `strict-path` and resolves under the resolved `ANDROMEDA_PULSE_DATA_DIR` — verified by unit test asserting a `../../etc/passwd`-style path-traversal attempt under any future override env var is rejected (per combined.md security row 3).

- (security) Corpus deserialize on startup applies a size cap on the file read (default 1 MB) AND a sanity-check on the deserialized service-count (default cap 1024); malformed/truncated/oversized inputs fall through to fresh bootstrap with a sanitized `tracing::warn` (no `bincode::Error` raw chain leaked) — verified by unit test injecting a truncated / oversize-amplified payload (per combined.md security row 4).

- (security) `grep -rE '(span_id|trace_id|attribute_value|operation_name)' <hex-dump-of-serialized-corpus>` on a round-trip fixture returns empty — corpus state contains only statistical aggregates + service identity, no OTLP attribute leakage on disk (per combined.md security row 5).

- (security) `tracing::warn!(target: "triage.service_id_missing")` emission is bounded к one event per tick with count-only payload; verified by in-process subscriber test asserting N drops within a single tick window produce exactly 1 warn event with `dropped_count: N` field and zero OTLP attribute fields (per combined.md security row 6).

- (arch) New workspace deps (`tdigest`, `dashmap`, `bincode`) declared in `crates/triage/Cargo.toml` only (NOT в other crates' Cargo.toml); `cargo deny check bans licenses sources` passes under `multiple-versions = "deny"` posture (per combined.md arch row 1).
- (arch) Code lives in existing `crates/triage/` workspace member; no new crate added; no new env var added beyond reserved `ANDROMEDA_PULSE_DATA_DIR` envelope (per combined.md arch row 2).

- (arch) Corpus persistence path resolves via `ANDROMEDA_PULSE_DATA_DIR` (defaulting to per-platform root per arch §Occupied Resources Filesystem locations) + canonicalizes through `strict-path` + asserts under resolved data root before any write — CWE-22 defense (per combined.md arch row 3).

- (arch) `triage` crate exposes baseline tracker public API only via `triage::contract` re-export module; internals are `pub(crate)`; no `pub use` re-exports outside `triage::contract`; error type is `thiserror` 2.x-derived; persisted state types embed `schema_version: u32` self-versioning field (per combined.md arch row 4 + research.md `serde`-friendly state container shape pattern).

- (tests) `cargo nextest run -p triage --profile ci` exits 0 with all new baseline + corpus tests green; existing 16/16 triage smoke tests (per session-handoff "triage smoke 16/16 0.038s") remain passing (per combined.md tests row 1).

- (tests) `cargo nextest run --workspace --profile ci` exits 0 across the workspace; standard gate baseline (fmt + clippy -D warnings + nextest + xtask capability-drift; no webview gates since chunk #61 touches zero `pulse-app/ui/**` paths) (per combined.md tests row 2).
- (tests) `cargo llvm-cov nextest -p triage --lcov` reports ≥ 75% line / ≥ 70% branch / ≥ 85% function coverage for new `crates/triage/src/baseline/**` source (per combined.md tests row 3).

- (tests) Property-based proptest suite executes ≥ 256 generated cases across EWMA convergence + t-digest p50/p95/p99 monotonicity + RollingWindow capacity invariant + service-identity-drop on empty `service.name`, with zero flakes; any regressions discovered persist to `crates/triage/proptest-regressions/baseline-*.txt` and replay green (per combined.md tests row 4).

- (tests) Corpus round-trip integration test: `persist_state(state) → load_state(path) → assert_eq!(reloaded.contract_view(), state.contract_view())` passes; uses `tempfile::TempDir` + (if needed) `tokio::time::pause()` + `advance(Duration::from_secs(60))` к deterministically exercise the 60s persist tick semantics; `#[tokio::test]` flavor `current_thread` per CLAUDE.md testing.md Session Additions 2026-05-06 (paused-clock incompatible with multi_thread) (per combined.md tests row 5).

- (tests) `cargo deny check bans licenses sources` exits 0 with `tdigest` / `dashmap` / `bincode` cleared; any duplicate-version collision added to `deny.toml [bans] skip` with one-line provenance comment; `tonic 0.14 ↔ 0.13` canary preserved outside the skip list (per combined.md tests row 6).

- (obs) Seven new metric event targets present in `AllowList::production()` registry: `triage.baseline.tick`, `triage.baseline.persist`, `triage.baseline.persist.error`, `triage.service_id_missing`, `metric.baseline.ewma_short_window_size`, `pipeline.l1b.persist_count_total`, `pipeline.l1b.bootstrap_count_total` — verified by in-process subscriber tests asserting field content is NOT redacted by default-deny `JsonFieldVisitor` (per combined.md obs Acceptance Criteria + research.md `pulse-app/src/observability.rs` finding).

- (obs) `metric.baseline.ewma_short_window_size` (gauge per tick) + `pipeline.l1b.persist_count_total` (counter per persist) + `pipeline.l1b.bootstrap_count_total{kind}` (counter with bounded enum label) emit via `tracing::info!` with `metric.{module}.{measure}` / `pipeline.{layer}.{action}_total` target naming convention per obs-plan §5 (per combined.md obs Constraints row 2).
