Apply same archive-vs-delete decision к `spike_mistralrs_strict_schema.rs` at plan time — author's call but explicitly documented either way.
**Anti-patterns к avoid:**

- (security) NEVER `tokio::process::Command::new(...).arg(user_input)` against ANY string sourced from the digest payload, OTLP attribute values, or any field reaching the inference runner from the broadcast subscriber on `pulse://stream/digests` (per security plan §Security Anti-Patterns §Code Patterns; canonical 2025–2026 CVE class).

- (security) NEVER skip any of the four subprocess bounds (`kill_on_drop` + `-n` + `-st` + outer `tokio::time::timeout`) — single-gate is a regression of the chunk's explicit defense-in-depth design (per arch §Established Decisions + CLAUDE.md Tier 2 session learning 2026-05-25).

- (security, obs) NEVER log the LLM-generated stdout content verbatim, the rendered prompt verbatim, or full subprocess command-line strings (binary path + CUDA flags + model path) at info level — compound (a) §Logging "MCP tool response bodies" NEVER-log rule transitively + (b) §Logging "full plugin file paths" basename-only rule generalized to binary paths.

- (obs) NEVER emit a subprocess-spawn span per L4 generation without `level-gating` — at 1-4 invocations/min the per-spawn telemetry IS proportional, but a future cadence-floor tightening could explode log volume; wrap any per-spawn debug-level emission in `if tracing::enabled!(Level::DEBUG) { ... }` (per `.claude/rules/observability.md` §Metrics convention).

- (obs) NEVER use `panic_message` field inside the panic-hook AllowList entry for ANY new subprocess panic surface — `PanicInfo::Display` carries raw `panic!()` literal verbatim. Safe surfaces are `location` + `spantrace` only (per `.claude/rules/observability.md` Session Additions 2026-05-21).

- (arch) Do NOT add `mistralrs`, `llama-cpp-2`, `llama-cpp-sys-2`, `bindgen`, OR any in-process LLM binding dep к the workspace graph — subprocess D1 is the explicit decision; in-process bindings documented as future swap path (b) (per arch §Established Decisions [LLM Inference Runtime] three-documented-swap-paths paragraph).

- (arch) Do NOT add a `use mistralrs::*` / `use llama_cpp::*` / `use llama_cli::*` import к `crates/interpretation/` under any circumstance — bus-factor invariant: NO direct runtime orchestration logic at crate level. Subprocess orchestration (Command building, arg assembly, stdout parsing) lives only в the binary-boundary `LlamaCliInference` impl (per arch §Cross-cutting Patterns Module dependency direction).

- (arch) Do NOT modify the `LlmInferenceRunner` trait signature or the `ModelTier`/`ModelStatus`/`ModelIdentity`/`ModelLoadEvent`/`InferenceError` contract types — would invalidate the "sibling-impl swap" design intent. Concrete impl absorbs runtime-side deltas без trait redesign (per CLAUDE.md §Session Learnings 2026-05-24 stub-first concrete-impl entry).

- (tests) NEVER mock the `LlmInferenceRunner` trait via runtime monkey-patching — use `Arc<dyn LlmInferenceRunner>` constructor injection (per test-plan §8 "Anti-monkey-patching"). Mocks `MockLlmInferenceRunner` go в `pulse-app/tests/` integration test module, not production code.

- (tests) NEVER use `sleep(N)` for synchronization with subprocess readiness (per test-plan §11 E2E anti-pattern). For subprocess tests waiting on token emission, use streamed-chunk + flush-per-chunk + outer `tokio::time::timeout` pattern (per `.claude/rules/testing.md` 2026-05-24 sustained-CPU-zero-output entry).

- (tests) NEVER ship the chunk without removing `mistralrs = "=0.8.0"` from `Cargo.toml [workspace.dependencies]` AND `pulse-app/Cargo.toml [dependencies]` simultaneously — half-removal leaves а compile-time poison footprint (issue-#1134 CPU deadlock binary remains a possible link target). Verify via `cargo tree -p mistralrs 2>/dev/null || echo "OK absent"`.
**Contract bindings:**

- **security ↔ obs** (L4 inference path emits tracing spans that MUST follow obs's AllowList discipline; new spans for `llama_cli_spawn` / `llama_cli_complete` / `llama_cli_timeout` belong on the obs AllowList; subprocess stdout content is excluded by §Logging "MCP tool response bodies" NEVER-log rule). Both extracts acknowledge — consistent.

- **security ↔ tests** (subprocess discipline four bounds need negative-path test coverage — timeout-fires + malformed-output + path-traversal-rejected). Both extracts acknowledge; tests contributes criterion (a). Consistent.

- **security ↔ arch** (prebuilt-binary distribution decision pending — bundle vs xtask-download vs env-var; both flag it for chunk #84 plan to decide whether env-var-pointer is the final dev pattern OR if a future capability-scope widening surfaces). Consistent.

- **obs ↔ tests** (subprocess lifecycle spans emit through pulse://stream/digests path; tests verify span structure + redaction via grep canary patterns; obs owns field names + redaction policy). Both extracts acknowledge — consistent.

- **tests ↔ obs (boot-smoke)** (chunk #84 touches main.rs → 60s `cargo build -p pulse-app --features mcp-server` non-UI smoke in Test Commands per CLAUDE.md 2026-05-19 boot-smoke-coverage trigger). Tests articulates this — consistent.
- **arch ↔ obs** (subprocess lifecycle events flow through `tracing`; NO raw stderr/stdout payload contents logged verbatim per §Critical Warnings). Consistent.

- **arch ↔ security** (env vars MUST canonicalize via `strict-path` + validate regular file before spawn; the env var names do NOT name `_PATH` / `_DIR` suffix — chunk #84 plan should decide rename for convention adherence OR document deviation). Consistent.

- **arch ↔ tests** (no new TauRPC procedure → no capability-drift extension + no EXPECTED_PROCEDURES update; chunk #82 5-place wiring pattern stays at chunk #82's footprint; subprocess-bounded-execution discipline needs test fixture). Consistent.

- **arch ↔ deployment** (flagged-pending binary distribution decision parallel к the model-file distribution decision; chunk #84 plan may defer production decision к follow-up chunk while keeping dev env-var pattern). Consistent — note: "deployment" isn't a sub-agent; this is internal к arch.
**Acceptance criteria contributions:**

Missing any single bound fails the chunk.

- (security) `cargo audit` + `cargo deny check bans licenses sources` exit clean after the dep swap.

- (arch) Concrete `LlamaCliInference` struct lives at `pulse-app/src/llamacli_inference.rs` (binary boundary), implements `interpretation::contract::LlmInferenceRunner`; `grep -rE 'use (mistralrs|llama_cpp|llama_cli)' crates/interpretation/` returns empty.

- (arch) Workspace dep cleanup verified: `cargo tree --workspace -i mistralrs` returns "package not found" AND root `Cargo.toml [workspace.dependencies]` contains no `mistralrs` entry AND `pulse-app/Cargo.toml [dependencies]` contains no `mistralrs.workspace = true` line.

- (arch) Subprocess bound triple verified at `LlamaCliInference` call site: invocation includes `-n {max_tokens}` arg + `-st` (single-turn) flag + outer `tokio::time::timeout(...)` wrap + `Command::kill_on_drop(true)` — all four signals present.

- (arch) `LlmInferenceRunner` trait signature in `crates/interpretation/src/contract.rs` is byte-identical к chunk #82 substrate (no `diff` against chunk #82 landing commit cf6686b for the trait declaration block) — confirms sibling-impl swap pattern.

- (tests) `cargo nextest run --workspace --profile ci` passes; new `pulse-app/tests/unit_llamacli_inference.rs` covers (a) spawn-arg vector contains all four defenses, (b) tier routing maps all 4 `HardwareProfile` variants к correct binary + `-ngl` flag, (c) env-var-missing path returns `InferenceError::ModelNotConfigured` (no panic), (d) path-traversal env-var rejected before spawn.
- (tests) `cargo nextest run -p pulse-app --features mcp-server -E 'test(emit_taurpc_bindings)'` passes AND post-test `grep -c '"mcp":' pulse-app/ui/src/bindings/index.ts` returns ≥1.
- (tests) `cargo deny check bans licenses sources` passes after `mistralrs` workspace + per-crate dep removal; no orphaned `[bans] skip` entries referencing the removed crate.
- (tests) Standard tier coverage thresholds preserved per test-plan §10: line ≥75% / branch ≥70% / function ≥85% on `pulse-app/src/llamacli_inference.rs`.
- (tests) `cargo xtask capability-drift` exits 0.

- (tests) Chunk plan EXPLICITLY decides preserved-vs-deleted disposition for `pulse-app/tests/spike_mistralrs_strict_schema.rs` + `pulse-app/tests/spike_diagnostic_staged_ladder.rs`; if preserved, both remain `#[ignore]`-gated archived diagnostic harness; if deleted, plan documents the deletion rationale.

- (obs) `pulse-app/src/observability.rs::AllowList::production()` `interpretation.inference.error` entry MUST permit `error_category` values `"spawn_failed"` + `"exit_nonzero"` + `"binary_not_found"` (or equivalent enumerated subprocess-failure variants); negative test asserts new enum values pass the production AllowList round-trip OR the entry is extended for chunk #84.

- (obs) Subprocess discipline assertion: `tokio::time::timeout` wall-clock guard + `kill_on_drop(true)` verified by integration test simulating a slow-spawn binary that exceeds timeout; assert no orphan process remains AND the emitted `interpretation.inference.error` event carries `error_category = "timeout"` + bounded `recovery_action` enum.

- (obs) Workspace dep cleanup: removal of `mistralrs = "=0.8.0"` and per-crate `mistralrs.workspace = true` MUST NOT introduce any new `opentelemetry*` transitive dep — verify via `cargo tree -p pulse-app | grep opentelemetry` returns only `opentelemetry-proto` and zero `opentelemetry_sdk` / `opentelemetry-otlp` entries.

title: Phase 81 Plan — chunks route#84: "L4 LLM runtime swap (mistralrs → llama.cpp subprocess D1)"

data.head: # Phase 81 Plan — chunks route#84: "L4 LLM runtime swap (mistralrs → llama.cpp subprocess D1)"

body:
_Generated by /andromeda-phase Phase 4. Read by /andromeda-implement.
Manual edits between runs are fine; do not edit during /implement run._
- **Phase number:** 81

- **Route chunks covered:**
  - route#84 "L4 LLM runtime swap — replace MistralRsInference impl с LlamaCliInference subprocess (llama.cpp b9305 D1); wire prebuilt llama-cli per chunk #80 HardwareProfileSource tier."
- **Epoch:** Foundation v0.2.0 (Epoch 9)

Replace the in-process `MistralRsInference` concrete impl (chunk #82/#83 substrate) with a subprocess-spawn `LlamaCliInference` sibling impl behind the unchanged `LlmInferenceRunner` trait surface (`crates/interpretation/src/contract.rs`). The trait + supporting types (`ModelTier` / `ModelStatus` / `ModelIdentity` / `ModelLoadEvent` / `InferenceError`) stay byte-identical — only the binary-boundary concrete impl swaps from in-process `mistralrs = "=0.8.0"` to per-generation `tokio::process::Command` invocation of prebuilt `llama-cli.exe` binaries (CUDA build for GPU profiles, CPU build for CPU profiles, both pinned to llama.cpp build tag `b9305`). The swap closes a definitive empirical gap: upstream mistralrs issue #1134 (CPU sampler deadlock — load-then-zero-tokens; open since 2025-02-12; multi-model spans) was confirmed root cause for session 142's "120× SLO" measurement (session 143 staged-ladder diagnostic invalidated the prior conclusion; session 144's llama.cpp cross-check on the same host + GGUF produced 28.2/231.2/122.3 tok/sec). Subprocess D1 (spawn-per-generation) is chosen over in-process bindings (Windows libclang+cmake+MSVC toolchain cost not justified at 1-4 invocations/min cadence) and over D2 persistent `llama-server` (lifecycle complexity + 4.5GB RAM + 2GB VRAM idle cost not justified at the same rate). The chunk also removes the `mistralrs` workspace dep and its per-crate consumer in the same commit (load-bearing for `cargo deny check bans` posture; leaving a dead heavy dep in the lockfile compounds dependency-closure risk).

The implementation is bounded by а four-defense subprocess discipline (`kill_on_drop(true)` + `-n {max_tokens}` cap + `-st` single-turn flag + outer `tokio::time::timeout` wall-clock guard) per arch §Established Decisions [LLM Inference Runtime — L4 interpretation layer] subprocess invocation paragraph + CLAUDE.md Tier 2 session learning 2026-05-25. Tier routing follows chunk #80 `HardwareProfileSource` output (GPU-primary/GPU-fallback → CUDA binary + `-ngl 99`; CPU-primary/CPU-fallback → CPU binary + `-ngl 0`). Binary paths source from two new env vars (`ANDROMEDA_PULSE_LLAMA_CUDA_BIN_PATH` + `ANDROMEDA_PULSE_LLAMA_CPU_BIN_PATH`, conforming to arch §Conventions `_PATH` suffix discipline) canonicalized via `Path::canonicalize()` + `metadata().is_file()` assert before any `Command::new()` invocation (CWE-22 defense per arch §Critical Warnings + security plan §Input Validation env var canonicalization rule). Production binary distribution (Tauri bundle vs `xtask` download vs the current env-var-pointer dev pattern) is **explicitly deferred** to а follow-up chunk per arch §Established Decisions [LLM Inference Runtime] §Caveat-к-verify paragraph; this chunk lands the dev-mode env-var pattern + registers the two new env vars in arch.md §Occupied Resources via а Type 6 `/andromeda-evolve --allow-arch-registry` amendment in the same wrap session (mirror chunk #82 session 140 precedent). Existing `model.current_profile` TauRPC procedure + `pulse://stream/model-status` broadcast topic + the L4 inference subscriber on `pulse://stream/digests` (chunk #83) require zero modification — the runtime swap is invisible to all three. No new TauRPC procedures + no new broadcast topics + no new webview surface; design / layouts / a11y plans are out of domain for this chunk.
1. **Add new module к pulse-app library**. Edit `pulse-app/src/lib.rs`: replace `pub mod mistralrs_inference;` (locate via grep) with `pub mod llamacli_inference;`. Single-line edit.

2. **Create `pulse-app/src/llamacli_inference.rs`** implementing `LlmInferenceRunner` for the subprocess D1 strategy. Structure:
   - Module-level constants: `ENV_LLAMA_CUDA_BIN_PATH: &str = "ANDROMEDA_PULSE_LLAMA_CUDA_BIN_PATH"`; `ENV_LLAMA_CPU_BIN_PATH: &str = "ANDROMEDA_PULSE_LLAMA_CPU_BIN_PATH"`; `LLAMA_CLI_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(60)` (default wall-clock per research.md open-question resolution); `LLAMA_CLI_MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES: usize` (reuse `interpretation::schema::L4_OUTPUT_MAX_BYTES`); `ENV_MODEL_PATH: &str = "ANDROMEDA_PULSE_MODEL_PATH"` (preserve existing env var name from chunk #82 substrate for backward compat).
   - `LlamaCliInference` struct: `tier: ModelTier`, `state: Arc<RwLock<InferenceState>>` (mirror chunk #82 `MistralRsInference::InferenceState { status, identity }`), `broadcast: ModelStatusBroadcast`, `profile: HardwareProfile`, `binary_path: Option<PathBuf>` (resolved at constructor based on profile + env vars), `model_path: Option<PathBuf>` (resolved at constructor от `ANDROMEDA_PULSE_MODEL_PATH`), `ngl: u32` (99 for GPU profiles, 0 for CPU).
   - `LlamaCliInference::new(tier, profile, broadcast)` constructor: reads env vars based on profile (GpuPrimary/GpuFallback → cuda env var; CpuPrimary/CpuFallback → cpu env var; Unknown → cpu env var as safe-default since `tier_for_profile` already maps Unknown → Primary); canonicalizes the binary path via `canonicalize_binary_path()` (returns `Err(InferenceError::InvalidModelPath)` if missing OR canonicalize fails OR not а regular file); resolves the GGUF model path from `ANDROMEDA_PULSE_MODEL_PATH` (same fallback semantics as chunk #82 `MistralRsInference::configured_model_path`); constructs in `ModelStatus::Error` state с identity `None` if any required path is missing (graceful-degraded mode).
   - `canonicalize_binary_path(raw: &Path) -> Result<PathBuf, InferenceError>` helper: `path.canonicalize().map_err(|_| InferenceError::InvalidModelPath)?` then `metadata.is_file() == true` assert OR return `InferenceError::InvalidModelPath`. Uses std `Path::canonicalize` (resolves symlinks + `..` segments per CWE-22 defense). Does NOT require а bounded confinement root — binary paths are intentionally user-managed in dev mode per research.md open-question resolution.
   - `binary_path_for_profile(profile) -> Option<&'static str>` helper: maps HardwareProfile к env var name (returns ENV name string; caller reads the env). Returns `Some(ENV_LLAMA_CUDA_BIN_PATH)` for GpuPrimary/GpuFallback; `Some(ENV_LLAMA_CPU_BIN_PATH)` for CpuPrimary/CpuFallback/Unknown.
   - Lifecycle methods: `mark_loading()`, `mark_loaded(identity: ModelIdentity)`, `mark_error(sanitized_reason: String)` — mirror chunk #82 `MistralRsInference` lifecycle shape; emit `ModelLoadEvent` on the `pulse://stream/model-status` broadcast topic (same payload + same redaction discipline).
   - `load_from_env_if_configured(&self) -> Result<(), InferenceError>`: validates the configured binary + model paths exist + are files (cheap shell-out via `std::fs::metadata`); transitions Loading→Loaded if both present (no actual model load — subprocess D1 loads per-generation). NOTE: differs от chunk #82 semantics where load triggered actual GGUF mmap; subprocess D1 has nothing к "pre-load" at boot, so Loaded transition is а readiness assertion not а load completion. Emits `ModelIdentity { semantic_name: <basename file_stem of model_path> }` on success per chunk #82 pattern (no path leak — only file stem).
   - `LlmInferenceRunner` impl: `current_status()` reads state.status; `identity()` reads state.identity; `tier()` returns tier; `generate_constrained<'a>(&'a self, prompt: &'a str, schema_json: &'a str) -> InferenceFuture<'a, String>`:
     - Fast-fail: if status != Loaded OR binary_path/model_path are None, return `Err(InferenceError::ModelNotConfigured)`.
     - Parse `schema_json` to validate (per chunk #82 pattern — а malformed schema is а pipeline bug); persist к а temp file `tokio::fs::NamedTempFile::new()?` for `--json-schema-file` arg path. `kill_on_drop` invariant requires the temp file outlives the child — hold it in а variable bound с lifetime spanning the await.
     - Build `tokio::process::Command::new(&self.binary_path)` с args: `["-m", model_path.to_str(), "-n", max_tokens.to_string(), "-st", "--simple-io", "--no-display-prompt", "--json-schema-file", schema_file.path().to_str(), "-ngl", self.ngl.to_string(), "-p", prompt]`. Set `.kill_on_drop(true)` + `.stdin(Stdio::null())` + `.stdout(Stdio::piped())` + `.stderr(Stdio::piped())`. Note: per security extract, the `prompt` flows through `-p` arg (NOT command injection: the arg is а single-string positional arg, no shell interpolation; `tokio::process::Command::arg` quotes safely on all platforms). Alternative: pipe via stdin if prompt size exceeds OS arg-length limit (Windows ~32KB) — chunk plan default keeps `-p` arg + adds а defensive `if prompt.len() > 30_000 { use stdin path }` branch.
     - Wrap the full `.spawn()? + .wait_with_output().await?` chain in `tokio::time::timeout(LLAMA_CLI_TIMEOUT, ...)`. On timeout, return `Err(InferenceError::InferenceFailed { reason: "timeout".to_string() })`; the dropped Child triggers kill_on_drop automatically.
     - On successful exit (status.success() == true): extract stdout bytes; assert `stdout_bytes.len() <= LLAMA_CLI_MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES` else return `OutputTooLarge`; convert к UTF-8 string OR return `Err(InferenceFailed { reason: "stdout_utf8_invalid" })`; return `Ok(stdout_string)`.
     - On non-zero exit: extract stderr first line (bounded); classify via `classify_subprocess_failure(exit_code, stderr_first_line)` returning а bounded `&'static str` enum tag; return `Err(InferenceFailed { reason: <tag>.to_string() })`.
   - `classify_subprocess_failure(exit_code: Option<i32>, stderr_first_line: &str) -> &'static str`: bounded enum function returning one of `["binary_not_found", "spawn_failed", "exit_nonzero_with_stderr", "exit_nonzero_silent", "stdout_utf8_invalid", "schema_invalid"]`. Implementation: `exit_code = None && stderr.contains("not found") || stderr.contains("No such file")` → `binary_not_found`; `exit_code = None` → `spawn_failed`; `exit_code = Some(non-zero) && !stderr.is_empty()` → `exit_nonzero_with_stderr`; `exit_code = Some(non-zero) && stderr.is_empty()` → `exit_nonzero_silent`.
   - Tracing: `#[tracing::instrument(skip(self, prompt, schema_json), fields(model_tier, hardware_profile, binary_kind))]` on the `generate_constrained` entry; in-body `tracing::info!(target: "interpretation.constrained.generate", model_tier=..., hardware_profile=..., duration_ms=..., success=true_or_false)` on completion; `tracing::warn!(target: "interpretation.inference.error", model_tier=..., hardware_profile=..., error_category=<classify result>, recovery_action="skip_digest")` on error paths. All targets + fields ALREADY permitted by the chunk #83 AllowList entries in `pulse-app/src/observability.rs:1796-1828` — no AllowList modification needed.

4. **Remove `mistralrs` workspace dep**. Edit `Cargo.toml`: delete lines 207-226 (the 19-line `# LLM inference runtime (route#82 — Epoch 9 ...` comment block + the `mistralrs = "=0.8.0"` line itself). Preserve surrounding tokenizers + ureq + sha2 entries (lines 195-205) and `[profile.release]` section (line 228+).
5. **Remove per-crate `mistralrs` dep**. Edit `pulse-app/Cargo.toml`: delete line 51 (`mistralrs.workspace = true`). Verify via grep no other consumer exists.

- **Phase number:** 82

- **Route chunks covered:**
  - route#85 "Fallback model tier support"
- **Epoch:** Epoch 9 — Foundation v0.2.0 (terminal chunk in route §2)

Chunk #85 closes the L4 LLM interpretation pipeline by adding the fallback tier prompt + reduced-quality output contract for hardware-constrained tiers (3-4B class models on CPU-fallback profiles). The work is scoped entirely к `crates/interpretation/` (per chunk spec "Crates touched") + the L4 inference subscriber in `pulse-app/src/inference_runtime.rs` (binary boundary tier-dispatch). The fallback prompt occupies а ~500-700 token system budget vs primary's ~800-1000 + instructs the model к emit а single hypothesis instead of а ranked list + up to 2 investigation steps instead of 5. The `model_tier: "fallback"` discriminator embedded in the L4 output JSON enables downstream consumers (future Report UI per P-053; obs aggregation queries today) к stratify primary vs fallback inference outputs. Capability P-053 (Fallback Model Tier — full) reaches "full" status with this chunk; no new TauRPC procedures, no new broadcast topics, no new workspace deps, no new env vars, no arch registry changes — pure additive extension of the existing chunk #82/#83/#84 substrate per arch §Established Decisions [LLM Inference Runtime — L4 interpretation layer] bus-factor discipline.

The implementation reuses the existing `LlmInferenceRunner` trait surface (chunk #82) + `LlamaCliInference` concrete subprocess impl (chunk #84) + `L4_OUTPUT_JSON_SCHEMA` JSON schema (chunk #83) unchanged. Fallback tier dispatch happens at the L4 subscriber (`pulse-app/src/inference_runtime.rs::handle_digest`) which currently always calls `build_primary_tier_prompt`; chunk #85 branches on `runner.tier()` к select primary vs fallback prompt builder. Defense-in-depth: post-parse validation in `crates/interpretation/src/schema.rs::validate` is extended to enforce tier-specific bounds (1-hypothesis / ≤2-step cap when `model_tier == "fallback"`) on top of the prompt-level constraint. Per security plan §Anti-Patterns Code Patterns + obs plan §11 cardinality discipline, no new fields are admitted к the observability AllowList — all `interpretation.*` + `metric.pipeline.l4.*` targets already permit `model_tier` field values from chunks #82/#83.

1. **Add fallback prompt constants in `crates/interpretation/src/prompt.rs`.** Define `ROLE_DEFINITION_FALLBACK: &str` (~80-100 tokens; emphasizes single-hypothesis output, no ranked list, reduced specificity) + `OUTPUT_REMINDER_FALLBACK: &str` (~100-150 tokens; explicitly instructs "exactly ONE hypothesis", "up to 2 investigation steps", "fewer fields"). Reuse existing `CONVENTIONS_SNIPPET` unchanged (decision/severity vocabulary is tier-agnostic). Reuse existing section markers (`DIGEST_OPEN/CLOSE_MARKER`, `PROJECT_OPEN/CLOSE_MARKER`, `CORPUS_OPEN/CLOSE_MARKER`) unchanged. The fallback prompt structure mirrors primary's: Role → Conventions → Schema → Project Context → Current Digest → [Corpus Retrieval if non-empty] → Output Instructions.

2. **Add `build_fallback_tier_prompt` fn in `crates/interpretation/src/prompt.rs`.** Sibling of `build_primary_tier_prompt`, same signature: `pub fn build_fallback_tier_prompt(digest_payload: &str, project_context: &str, corpus_retrieval: &str) -> String`. Same section-by-section assembly + same markers; differs only by substituting `ROLE_DEFINITION_FALLBACK` + `OUTPUT_REMINDER_FALLBACK` + emitting `PROMPT_VERSION_FALLBACK` instead of `PROMPT_VERSION_PRIMARY` in the version metadata block. Total token budget ~500-700 tokens (asserted via length proxy in tests).

3. **Add fallback constants in `crates/interpretation/src/schema.rs`.** Define `pub const PROMPT_VERSION_FALLBACK: &str = "v1.0-fallback"` (initial pin; bump if fallback prompt shape evolves). Define `pub const FALLBACK_HYPOTHESES_MAX: usize = 1` + `pub const FALLBACK_INVESTIGATION_STEPS_MAX: usize = 2` reflecting P-053 reduced-quality contract. Schema constants documentation should cite "(chunk #85 — fallback tier)" alongside the chunk #83 primary-tier constants для audit clarity.

4. **Extend `validate()` in `crates/interpretation/src/schema.rs` с tier-conditional bounds.** After the existing `match output.model_tier.as_str()` block (line ~238), when `output.model_tier == "fallback"`, additionally enforce: `output.hypotheses.len() <= FALLBACK_HYPOTHESES_MAX` + `output.investigation_steps.len() <= FALLBACK_INVESTIGATION_STEPS_MAX`. Return `InferenceError::SchemaViolation { reason: ... }` с а bounded reason string ("fallback tier hypotheses count {N} exceeds FALLBACK_HYPOTHESES_MAX" / similar). Order: place the tier-conditional check AFTER the existing tier-label validation but BEFORE the `hardware_profile` validation, so failures surface in а stable order for test fixtures.

5. **Modify `pulse-app/src/inference_runtime.rs::handle_digest()` к branch on tier.** Add imports: `use interpretation::prompt::build_fallback_tier_prompt;` + `use interpretation::contract::ModelTier;` + `use interpretation::schema::PROMPT_VERSION_FALLBACK;`. Replace the unconditional `let prompt = build_primary_tier_prompt(&digest.payload_summary, &project_context, "");` (line 150) with а tier-conditional binding: `let (prompt, prompt_version_label): (String, &'static str) = match tier { ModelTier::Primary => (build_primary_tier_prompt(&digest.payload_summary, &project_context, ""), interpretation::schema::PROMPT_VERSION_PRIMARY), ModelTier::Fallback => (build_fallback_tier_prompt(&digest.payload_summary, &project_context, ""), PROMPT_VERSION_FALLBACK) };`. Update the `tracing::info!` emission at line ~154 к pass `prompt_version = prompt_version_label` instead of the hardcoded `interpretation::schema::PROMPT_VERSION_PRIMARY` reference. The downstream `runner.generate_constrained(&prompt, L4_OUTPUT_JSON_SCHEMA).await` call at line ~163 stays unchanged (same schema document for both tiers per research finding).

6. **Extend `crates/interpretation/src/prompt.rs::tests` с fallback prompt tests.** Add (mirroring primary coverage where applicable):
   - `fallback_prompt_embeds_schema_string` — verify `L4_OUTPUT_JSON_SCHEMA` substring present.
   - `fallback_prompt_embeds_reduced_role_definition` — verify "single hypothesis" + "severity classifier" substrings present (the fallback role definition asserts both).
   - `fallback_prompt_embeds_conventions_snippet` — verify reused conventions snippet substrings (`"surface"` / `"dismiss"` / `"watch"` / `"autonomous"` etc.) present.
   - `fallback_prompt_emits_reduced_output_reminder` — verify "exactly ONE hypothesis" + "up to 2 investigation steps" substrings present.
   - `fallback_prompt_wraps_digest_in_markers` — verify `DIGEST_OPEN_MARKER` / `DIGEST_CLOSE_MARKER` wrap the digest body.
   - `fallback_prompt_wraps_project_context_in_markers` — verify `PROJECT_OPEN_MARKER` / `PROJECT_CLOSE_MARKER` wrap the project context.
   - `fallback_prompt_omits_corpus_section_when_empty` + `fallback_prompt_includes_corpus_section_when_present` — mirror primary corpus handling.
   - `fallback_prompt_embeds_versioning_metadata` — verify `SCHEMA_VERSION` + `PROMPT_VERSION_FALLBACK` substrings present.
   - `fallback_prompt_section_ordering_is_stable` — assert Role → Conventions → Schema → Project Context → Current Digest → Corpus Retrieval → Output Instructions order.
   - `fallback_prompt_token_count_within_budget` — assert `prompt.len() < 2500` bytes (approximation of 700-token upper bound; ~3.5 bytes/token).
   - `fallback_prompt_does_not_leak_internal_field_names_outside_schema` — mirror primary OTLP-field-name negative-canary test (`span_id` / `trace_id` / `parent_span_id` / `ts_unix_nano` absent outside the embedded schema region).

7. **Extend `crates/interpretation/src/schema.rs::tests` с fallback validation tests.** Add:
   - `validate_accepts_fallback_with_single_hypothesis` — `model_tier = "fallback"` + `hypotheses.len() == 1` + `investigation_steps.len() <= 2` → Ok.
   - `validate_accepts_fallback_with_two_investigation_steps` — `model_tier = "fallback"` + `hypotheses.len() == 1` + `investigation_steps.len() == 2` → Ok.
   - `validate_rejects_fallback_with_too_many_hypotheses` — `model_tier = "fallback"` + `hypotheses.len() == 2` → `SchemaViolation`, reason contains "fallback" + "hypotheses".
   - `validate_rejects_fallback_with_too_many_investigation_steps` — `model_tier = "fallback"` + `investigation_steps.len() == 3` → `SchemaViolation`, reason contains "fallback" + "investigation_steps".
   - `validate_accepts_primary_with_five_hypotheses` — sanity check that the tier-conditional check does NOT regress primary behavior (`model_tier = "primary"` + `hypotheses.len() == 5` → Ok).
   - `parse_bounded_rejects_fallback_with_too_many_hypotheses` — full round-trip parse + validation; oversized fallback output rejected at the size cap OR at the bounds check.

8. **Extend `pulse-app/tests/unit_inference_runtime.rs` с tier-routing tests.** Add (using а stub `LlmInferenceRunner` impl that records the prompt passed к `generate_constrained` + records the tier):
   - `handle_digest_selects_primary_prompt_when_runner_tier_is_primary` — stub returns `ModelTier::Primary`; assert recorded prompt contains primary's ROLE_DEFINITION substring ("severity classifier") + does NOT contain fallback-specific marker text ("exactly ONE hypothesis" should NOT be present in а primary prompt).
   - `handle_digest_selects_fallback_prompt_when_runner_tier_is_fallback` — stub returns `ModelTier::Fallback`; assert recorded prompt contains fallback-specific marker text + is within the ~700-token budget proxy (length < 2500 bytes).
   - `handle_digest_emits_prompt_version_field_for_primary_tier` — uses а CapturingSubscriber pattern (per CLAUDE.md testing.md 2026-05-09 `set_default` async-test pattern) to capture `interpretation.prompt.assemble` event field-set; assert `prompt_version == "v2.1"` (PROMPT_VERSION_PRIMARY).
   - `handle_digest_emits_prompt_version_field_for_fallback_tier` — same CapturingSubscriber pattern; assert `prompt_version == "v1.0-fallback"` (PROMPT_VERSION_FALLBACK) when stub tier is Fallback.
   - `handle_digest_emits_model_tier_fallback_in_inference_request_target` — uses CapturingSubscriber к verify the `interpretation.inference.request` event (success path) carries `model_tier = "fallback"`.

Typical English тext is ~3.5 chars/token, so 500-700 tokens ≈ 1750-2450 bytes. **Plan default:** assert `prompt.len() < 2500` bytes for fallback as а pragmatic lower-cost proxy; precise tokenizer-based assertion deferred until tokenizer dep lands at chunk #81+ if applicable.

- **Fallback prompt corpus retrieval section behavior:** primary's `build_primary_tier_prompt` conditionally includes the corpus retrieval section if non-empty. Should fallback also support corpus retrieval, OR drop the corpus section entirely к conserve token budget? **Plan default:** mirror primary's conditional inclusion (preserve consistency); fallback callers can pass empty corpus_retrieval string к suppress the section.

body:
_Generated by /andromeda-phase Phase 4. Read by /andromeda-implement.
Manual edits between runs are fine; do not edit during /implement run._
- **Phase number:** 83

- **Route chunks covered:**
  - route#86 "JSON parse failure handling + backoff + resolution summary"
- **Epoch:** Epoch 9 — Foundation v0.2.0 (terminal chunk; closes L4 LLM interpretation surfaces)

Chunk #86 closes the L4 LLM interpretation pipeline started at chunk #82 (interpretation crate substrate + LlmInferenceRunner trait), implemented at chunk #83 (primary tier inference), runtime-swapped at chunk #84 (LlamaCliInference subprocess D1), and extended at chunk #85 (fallback tier). Two responsibilities land in this chunk:

1. **Failure handling + degraded-mode FSM + exponential backoff** — wraps the existing parse-failure arm at `pulse-app/src/inference_runtime.rs::handle_parse` line 288 with а graceful-degradation finite state machine. Single `InferenceError::JsonParseFailed` dismisses the current incident cycle + increments а consecutive-failure counter; three consecutive failures within 5 minutes transition the L4 subscriber into degraded mode with exponential backoff (2 min → 5 min → 10 min capped); successful parse exits degraded mode immediately. Manual override via а new `diagnostics.retry_interpretation()` TauRPC procedure invoked from Settings → Diagnostics "Retry interpretation now" button. Three new observability metrics surface the degraded-mode state for CI + UI consumers per obs-plan §5. Capability P-020 graceful degradation reaches "full" implementation status (P-020 was "partial" through chunks #82-#85 because the model-error pathway lacked retry orchestration).

2. **Resolution summary attachment** — extends the existing `crates/triage/incident::IncidentRegistry` trait (from chunk #78) with а new `attach_resolution_summary` method. When an incident transitions to Resolved (auto-resolution per chunk #78 P-022 OR explicit user mark_resolved), the L4 subscriber receives а `Digest { kind: DigestKind::ResolutionSummary, ... }` (the variant already exists at `crates/triage/src/contract.rs::DigestKind`), invokes inference с `is_resolution_summary: true` framing, parses the resulting L4Output, and attaches the summary text к the incident record's BLOB payload (no new SQLite column; backward-compatible via `#[serde(default)] Option<String>` on the `Incident` struct). The attachment path SUPPRESSES а `pulse://stream/incidents` re-emission per chunk detail spec "attach to incident record without new surface notification" — implemented as either а silent `attach_resolution_summary` (no broadcast) OR а new `IncidentLifecycleEvent::ResolutionSummaryAttached` variant that the chunk-#86-era webview consumer chooses to ignore. Capabilities P-022 (resolution summary attachment) + P-059 (resolution summary generation) reach "full" implementation status.
Anchors: per combined.md §Chunk route#86 (all per-domain extracts) + research.md §Files inspected (concrete file:line anchors for every modification site).

1. **Workspace dep audit** — verify chunk's "Workspace deps delta: none" invariant holds. Confirm `crates/interpretation/Cargo.toml [dev-dependencies]` includes (or workspace tokio has) `test-util` feature; if NOT, choose between (a) extending dev-deps locally OR (b) using injected-Clock trait pattern для backoff progression tests (more invasive but no workspace touch — discuss с user at /implement Phase 1 if material). Default-pick: (a) extend `crates/interpretation/Cargo.toml [dev-dependencies]` с `tokio = { workspace = true, features = ["test-util"] }` — minimal blast radius, dev-only.
2. **Extend triage contract — `Incident.resolution_summary_text`** at `crates/triage/src/contract.rs` line 318. Add field:

```text
   pub resolution_summary_text: Option<String>,  // #[serde(default)]
   ```

Add 1 unit test asserting backward-compat: deserialize а pre-chunk-#86 Incident JSON (without the new field) → `resolution_summary_text == None`. Bincode payload schema stays backward-compatible — corpus PRAGMA `user_version` unchanged.
3. **Extend triage IncidentRegistry trait** at `crates/triage/src/incident/registry.rs:64`. Add method:

Implement в `InMemoryIncidentRegistry`. Mutates the in-memory Incident's `resolution_summary_text` + `updated_at_unix_nano` fields; returns updated snapshot. Add 2 unit tests:
   - **happy path:** seed Resolved incident → `attach_resolution_summary("summary text", now)` → assert returned Incident has `resolution_summary_text == Some("summary text")` + `updated_at_unix_nano == now`.
   - **error path:** seed Active (NOT Resolved) incident → `attach_resolution_summary(...)` returns `Err(IncidentRegistryError::InvalidTransition)` (the contract is "only attach к Resolved incidents"). OR if chunk #86 allows attaching while Active for future flexibility, document.

4. **Wire IncidentPersistence write path for resolution summaries.** Read `crates/triage/src/incident/persistence.rs` lines 100+. The existing `update_incident` (or similar full-BLOB-rewrite method) likely covers the resolution-summary update transparently because the payload IS the serialized Incident. Verify; if the chunk #78 persistence trait does NOT expose а "rewrite full row" method, ADD `fn update_incident(&self, id: i64, payload: IncidentRecordPayload) -> Result<(), IncidentError>;` к the `IncidentPersistence` trait.
5. **Create degraded-mode FSM substrate** in `crates/interpretation/src/degraded_mode.rs` (new file). Surface:

Plus const constants per chunk detail spec: `FAILURE_WINDOW_SECS = 300` (5 min), `FAILURE_THRESHOLD = 3`, `BACKOFF_PROGRESSION_SECS = [120, 300, 600]` (2/5/10 min capped). All bounded values exposed для test reach. The trait stays GLOBAL (one FSM per L4 subscriber per research.md "Open question" recommendation; per-tuple granularity defers).

6. **Concrete impl `LocalDegradedModeStatus`** in new file `pulse-app/src/degraded_mode_runtime.rs`. Holds `Arc<Mutex<BackoffState>>` (std::sync::Mutex — no workspace dep add); `BackoffState { state: DegradedModeState, consecutive_failures: u32, last_failure_unix_nano: Option<i64>, next_retry_at_unix_nano: Option<i64>, current_backoff_secs: u64 }`. Implements all 5 trait methods + emits `tracing::warn!(target: "interpretation.degraded.enter", consecutive_failures, window_seconds = 300, backoff_seconds = N, ...)` on transition Active → Degraded; emits `tracing::info!(target: "interpretation.degraded.exit", consecutive_successes = 1, duration_seconds = N, ...)` on transition Degraded → Active. Plus the free-fn `pub fn interpretation_retry_error_to_app_error(err: InferenceError) -> AppError` (orphan-rule resolution per CLAUDE.md 2026-05-18).

7. **Modify L4 subscriber to consume DegradedModeStatus** at `pulse-app/src/inference_runtime.rs`:
   - extend `spawn_l4_inference_subscriber(...)` signature accepting `degraded_mode: Arc<dyn DegradedModeStatus>` + `incident_registry: Arc<dyn IncidentRegistry>` (or similar) parameters
   - extend `handle_digest` (line 143) к check `degraded_mode.is_in_backoff(now)` at top of fn; if true, emit а dropped-digest event (`tracing::info!(target: "interpretation.inference.skipped", reason = "backoff_active", ...)`) + return early WITHOUT invoking the runner (avoids burning а subprocess invocation while в cool-down)
   - extend `handle_parse` (line 220) Err arms к call `degraded_mode.record_failure(now)` for `InferenceError::JsonParseFailed` + `InferenceError::SchemaViolation` + `InferenceError::OutputTooLarge`; the returned `BackoffSnapshot` informs subsequent metric emission
   - extend `handle_parse` Ok arm к call `degraded_mode.record_success(now)` after а successful parse (resets backoff state)
   - branch on `digest.kind == DigestKind::ResolutionSummary` BEFORE invoking the standard generate-parse path; if а resolution-summary digest, invoke а new `handle_resolution_summary_digest(...)` that (a) invokes generation, (b) parses, (c) attaches к incident record via `incident_registry.attach_resolution_summary(...)` (no broadcast emission), (d) emits the standard `interpretation.inference.request` event с `digest_kind = "resolution_summary"` (REUSES chunk #83 AllowList entry — no new target needed per combined.md obs constraint).

9. **Extend boot wiring** at `pulse-app/src/main.rs`:
   - construct one `Arc<LocalDegradedModeStatus>` instance pre-subscriber-spawn
   - thread the Arc into `DiagnosticsApiImpl::new(miner, degraded_mode.clone())`
   - thread the Arc into `spawn_l4_inference_subscriber(broadcast, runner, degraded_mode.clone(), incident_registry.clone())` (note: existing `spawn_l4_inference_subscriber` signature already takes `Arc<dyn LlmInferenceRunner>`; chunk #86 extends с 2 more deps)
   - spawn а new tokio interval task at 15s cadence emitting `metric.pipeline.l4.backoff_remaining_seconds` gauge fed from `degraded_mode.current_snapshot().backoff_seconds_remaining`. Mirrors chunk #83 `spawn_l4_queue_depth_heartbeat` shape from `pulse-app/src/inference_runtime.rs:119`.

11. **Update capability JSON description** at `pulse-app/capabilities/default.json`. Extend the `description` string с а new sentence: `"Per chunk #86 also covers diagnostics.retry_interpretation (manual L4 interpretation retry override during exponential backoff cool-down per capability P-020 graceful degradation reaching full; backoff progression 2→5→10 min capped resets immediately on successful parse OR manual retry; resolution summaries attach k incident BLOB without surface notification per capabilities P-022 + P-059)."`. The `permissions` array stays `["core:default", "updater:default"]` per chunk #82 precedent (TauRPC dispatch single-handler model per CLAUDE.md 2026-05-03).

12. **Extend `xtask EXPECTED_PROCEDURES`** at `xtask/src/main.rs:661`. Add `"diagnostics.retry_interpretation"` к the slice. Add new test `expected_procedures_includes_diagnostics_retry_interpretation_at_chunk_86` mirroring chunk #69 `expected_procedures_includes_diagnostics_namespace_at_chunk_69` shape (line 1117-1122) asserting the new procedure presence.

13. **Add unit tests in `crates/interpretation/src/degraded_mode.rs`** (source-level `mod tests` block works in this crate — `[lib] test = false` only applies к `pulse-app/`):
    - `record_failure_below_threshold_keeps_active_state` — 2 failures within window → state stays Active
    - `record_failure_at_threshold_transitions_to_degraded` — 3rd failure within 5min window → state = Degraded + backoff = 2min
    - `record_failure_advances_backoff_progression` — `tokio::time::pause()` + `advance(120s)` + simulate 4th failure → backoff = 5min; advance(300s) + 5th → 10min; advance(600s) + 6th → 10min (capped)
    - `record_success_after_degraded_resets_state` — Degraded → record_success → state = Active + consecutive_failures = 0 + next_retry_at = None
    - `record_failure_outside_window_resets_counter` — 2 failures separated by >5min → counter at 1 (not 3); state stays Active
    - `trigger_manual_retry_resets_backoff_immediately` — Degraded + 8min into backoff → trigger_manual_retry → state = Active + consecutive_failures = 0 (manual override per chunk detail spec "Settings → Diagnostics 'Retry interpretation now' button" semantics)
    - `is_in_backoff_returns_false_when_active` — initial Active state → returns false для any timestamp
    - `is_in_backoff_returns_true_when_degraded_and_before_next_retry` — Degraded с next_retry_at = now+120s → is_in_backoff(now) → true; is_in_backoff(now+121s) → false
    - `degraded_mode_state_label_is_bounded` — verifies both label fn variants

- **Epoch:** Epoch 9 — Foundation v0.2.0 (terminal chunk)

Chunk #87 surfaces the first user-facing v0.2.0 widget extension that consumes the L4 LLM interpretation pipeline (chunks #82-#86) + incident records (chunk #78) + digest broadcast (chunk #81): а compact circular counter showing the number of unread active incidents in the current workspace, attached к the compact widget below the Halo State Pulse canvas; clicking the counter expands а severity-sorted dropdown of unread incident rows; а "Mark all as read" footer action clears all unread incidents in the workspace. Hidden when count is zero — the counter is the SOLE findings discovery surface per P-030 invariant ("No interrupting notifications" — no OS toasts, no modals).

The implementation extends а single TauRPC procedure (`incidents.mark_all_read`) к the existing chunk #78 `incidents.*` namespace; all other behavior wires consumer-side к existing infrastructure (`incidents.list_active` for derivation pull, `pulse://stream/incidents` for live updates, `IncidentRegistry::mark_read` already exists from chunk #78 for the per-incident mutation). New webview components live under `pulse-app/ui/src/widget/` (FindingsCounter + FindingsDropdown + findings-types + use-findings hook). Per arch §Cross-cutting Module dependency direction DAG, the bulk semantic `IncidentRegistry::mark_all_read(workspace, now) -> Result<Vec<i64>, _>` belongs in `crates/triage` (lower crate); resolver wires the call + emits а single aggregate `incident.broadcast.bulk_acknowledged` event preserving cardinality discipline (per CLAUDE.md obs 2026-05-17 aggregate-only mandate + chunk #82/#86 AllowList precedent).

Quadruple-binding discipline per CLAUDE.md 2026-05-12 + 2026-05-25 entries: (1) router trait + impl extension; (2) capability JSON router-level coverage already established chunk #78 (description block extended in-place); (3) xtask EXPECTED_PROCEDURES + sibling chunk-87 test; (4) emit_taurpc_bindings test merge already wired chunk #78 (verify post-edit). Post-impl Type 6 arch-registry amendment expected mirroring chunk #86 `diagnostics.retry_interpretation` precedent.

1. **Extend `IncidentRegistry` trait + impl с `mark_all_read`** — edit `crates/triage/src/incident/registry.rs`. Add trait method `fn mark_all_read(&self, workspace: &str, now_unix_nano: i64) -> Result<Vec<i64>, IncidentRegistryError>;` (returns Vec<i64> of incident ids that transitioned from unread to read so the caller can emit broadcast + drive per-incident persistence updates). Add `InMemoryIncidentRegistry::mark_all_read` impl iterating `incidents.iter_mut()`, filtering к workspace + `status != Resolved` + `read_at_unix_nano.is_none()`, mutating `read_at_unix_nano = Some(now)` + `updated_at_unix_nano = now`, collecting ids. Add 4 colocated tests per chunk #86 precedent: empty workspace returns empty Vec; 3 unread → marks all + returns 3 ids; already-read incidents are skipped + not re-included; Resolved incidents skipped.

2. **Add 4th TauRPC procedure `incidents.mark_all_read` к `IncidentsApi` trait** — edit `pulse-app/src/incidents_router.rs`. Place `//` doc comment block BEFORE the `#[taurpc::procedures(path = "incidents")]` macro describing the bulk semantic + cardinality discipline + persist-failure-non-fatal posture per CLAUDE.md 2026-05-25 entry. Add `async fn mark_all_read() -> Result<MarkAllReadPayload, AppError>;` к trait body. Add `MarkAllReadPayload { affected_count: usize, marked_at_unix_nano: i64 }` struct с `Serialize + Deserialize + PartialEq + Eq + specta::Type` derives.

3. **Implement `mark_all_read` resolver** — same file. Pattern mirrors chunk #78 `acknowledge` + chunk #86 `retry_interpretation`: `#[tracing::instrument(skip_all, fields(affected_count = tracing::field::Empty, outcome = tracing::field::Empty, duration_ms = tracing::field::Empty))]` + capture `start = Instant::now()` + `now = current_unix_nanos()`; call `self.registry.mark_all_read(&self.workspace_root, now)`; iterate returned ids and call `self.persistence.update_incident_status(id, &updated)` per id (warn + continue on persist failure per chunk #78 precedent at lines 144-150); emit ONE `IncidentLifecycleEvent::BulkAcknowledged` (or appropriate variant per `crates/triage/src/incident/broadcast.rs`) via `self.broadcast.sender().send(...)`; `tracing::Span::current().record("affected_count", ...)` + `record("outcome", "succeeded")` + `record("duration_ms", ...)`; final `tracing::info!(target: "incidents.mark_all_read.request", ...)` boundary log; return `MarkAllReadPayload`.

4. **Wire bulk-acknowledged broadcast event variant** — edit `crates/triage/src/incident/broadcast.rs` (file not pre-read; /implement inspects). Add `BulkAcknowledged { workspace_hash: String, affected_count: usize, marked_at_unix_nano: i64 }` variant к `IncidentLifecycleEvent` enum (or sibling type). The `workspace_hash` field IS а bounded hash of the workspace string (e.g., first 8 hex chars of `sha256(workspace_root)`) to preserve cardinality discipline per CLAUDE.md obs 2026-05-17 session 84 mandate; the raw workspace string IS NOT serialized into the broadcast payload. Update existing event-handling tests in chunk #78 broadcast tests к assert the new variant doesn't break existing routing.

5. **Extend observability AllowList** — edit `pulse-app/src/observability.rs` (after the chunk #86 block at line ~1902): add 2 `by_target.insert(...)` calls for `incidents.mark_all_read.request` (fields: `affected_count, traceparent, latency_ms, outcome, duration_ms`) and `incident.broadcast.bulk_acknowledged` (fields: `affected_count, workspace_hash`). Inline a comment block referencing chunk #87 + capabilities P-028/P-029/P-030 + obs aggregate-only discipline.

Insert `"incidents.mark_all_read",` between line 671 (`incidents.list_active`) and line 672 (`incidents.mark_resolved`) preserving alphabetical order. Write `pulse-app/ui/src/widget/FindingsCounter.test.tsx` (vitest: hidden-when-zero conditional render check; severity-color class application; accessible name; aria-expanded state transitions; click triggers callback; reduced-motion override).

body: _Generated by /andromeda-phase Phase 3 from targeted reads informed by combined.md._

- **Research depth:** moderate (mature codebase; chunk extends existing chunk #78 `incidents.*` substrate + chunk #82/#86 widget integration patterns; combined.md complexity signals 7 domains all relevant)
- **Reads performed:** 11 files (full / partial)
- **Globs / Greps:** 14 (parallel Glob batch + targeted greps for AllowList / capability JSON / EXPECTED_PROCEDURES)
- **Parallel batches:** 3

- `pulse-app/src/incidents_router.rs` (full, 282 lines) — existing `IncidentsApi` trait + `IncidentsApiImpl` from chunk #78; THIS is the file extended with the 4th procedure `mark_all_read`. The trait has `list_active() / acknowledge(id) / mark_resolved(id)`; impl wires registry + broadcast + persistence + workspace_root + cooldown_secs. Standard instrumentation pattern: `#[tracing::instrument(skip_all, fields(outcome = tracing::field::Empty))]` with mid-method `span.record(...)`. AppError mapping: `AppError::NotFound { resource }` / `AppError::Validation { field, reason }`; no `AppError::Storage` variant currently used (persist failures only `tracing::warn!` then proceed). The `IncidentRecord` payload struct already exists; `IncidentsListPayload { items, total, next_cursor }` envelope shape established.

- `crates/triage/src/incident/registry.rs` (full, 681 lines) — `IncidentRegistry` trait + `InMemoryIncidentRegistry` impl. CRITICAL FINDING: `IncidentRegistry::mark_read(id, now)` ALREADY EXISTS (line 99-101: "chunk #78 schema supports the column but chunk #87+ wires the UI trigger" docstring); reads `Incident.read_at_unix_nano: Option<i64>` field. So chunk #87 has TWO options для "Mark all as read": (a) add new trait method `mark_all_read(workspace, now) -> Result<usize, IncidentRegistryError>` that bulk-marks all workspace unread incidents read in one atomic operation; (b) compose at resolver level by iterating `list_active(workspace)` and calling per-incident `mark_read(id, now)`. Plan recommends (a) for atomic semantic + single broadcast event + cardinality discipline.

- `pulse-app/capabilities/default.json` (full, 12 lines) — single capability JSON listing `core:default` + `updater:default` only (NO per-procedure entries per the 2026-05-03 router-level coverage convention). Adding `incidents.mark_all_read` does NOT require a new permission line item; the new TauRPC procedure flows through existing `core:default` IPC handler permission grant. The description block IS the audit trail and SHOULD be extended с a sentence noting chunk #87 adds `incidents.mark_all_read` per the established pattern (chunk #47 plugins / chunk #49 mcp / chunk #68 storage / chunk #69 diagnostics / chunk #78 incidents / chunk #82 model / chunk #86 diagnostics.retry_interpretation all extended the description block).

- `xtask/src/main.rs` lines 668-672 + 1130-1132 — `EXPECTED_PROCEDURES` constant lists existing `incidents.{list_active, acknowledge, mark_resolved}` alphabetically (between `diagnostics.*` and `mcp.*`). Add `incidents.mark_all_read` between `incidents.list_active` and `incidents.mark_resolved` к preserve alphabetical order. Per the chunk #78 test pattern at line 1130-1133, there is `expected_procedures_includes_incidents_namespace` test which asserts the 3 chunk #78 procedures present; chunk #87 adds а sibling `expected_procedures_includes_mark_all_read_at_chunk_87` test (mirrors chunk #86's `expected_procedures_includes_retry_interpretation_at_chunk_86` at line 1154).

- `pulse-app/src/main.rs` lines 660-685 — boot wiring для chunk #78 incidents. `incident_registry: Arc<dyn IncidentRegistry>` constructed via `InMemoryIncidentRegistry::from_persisted(restored_incidents)` (chunk #78 rehydration); `incidents_impl = incident_persistence.as_ref().map(|p| IncidentsApiImpl::new(Arc::clone(&incident_registry), Arc::clone(&incident_broadcast), Arc::clone(p), incident_workspace_key.clone()))` — Option<IncidentsApiImpl> because incident_persistence is Option<Arc<...>> (corpus optional). Lines 859, 884, 1626-1694 — the `incidents_impl` Option is mounted via `match incidents_impl.as_ref() { Some(impl) => base.merge(impl.clone().into_handler()), None => base }` pattern in 3 places (default-features router, mcp-server-features router, `emit_taurpc_bindings` test). Chunk #87 needs NO new boot wiring — the new `mark_all_read` method lives on the existing `IncidentsApi` trait + `IncidentsApiImpl` struct, so the existing Option-merge wiring covers it automatically.

- `pulse-app/src/diagnostics_router.rs` (full, 446 lines) — CHUNK #86 PRECEDENT для adding а new procedure к а TauRPC trait. Pattern (mirror exactly for chunk #87): (1) module-level `//` comment block BEFORE the `#[taurpc::procedures(path = "diagnostics")]` macro (per CLAUDE.md 2026-05-25 entry — multi-line `///` in trait body fails compile); (2) async resolver method с `#[tracing::instrument(skip_all, fields(...))]` + `start = std::time::Instant::now()` + computing `duration_ms` + `tracing::Span::current().record(...)` + `tracing::info!(target: "diagnostics.retry_interpretation.request", ..., "human-readable summary")`; (3) `current_unix_nanos()` helper for timestamp; (4) `<NamePayload>` struct с `Serialize + Deserialize + PartialEq + Eq + specta::Type` derives + scalar/bounded fields only.

- `pulse-app/tests/unit_diagnostics_router_retry_interpretation.rs` (lines 1-100 inspected) — CHUNK #86 PRECEDENT для resolver test placement. Tests live in `pulse-app/tests/` (integration test crate) per CLAUDE.md 2026-05-13 + 2026-05-20 entries (`[lib] test = false` makes source-level `mod tests` dead). Pattern: `make_impl(dm: Arc<dyn DegradedModeStatus>) -> DiagnosticsApiImpl` factory + `#[tokio::test] async fn diagnostics_retry_interpretation_*()` per scenario + serde round-trip + PII-field exclusion grep test. Chunk #87 mirrors this exactly with а `make_impl(registry, broadcast, persistence, workspace) -> IncidentsApiImpl` factory + per-scenario tests + serde + PII negative-canary.

- `pulse-app/src/incident_persistence.rs` (lines 1-80 inspected) — `CorpusIncidentPersistence` adapter implementing `IncidentPersistence` trait via `CorpusWriter`. Per-row INSERT/UPDATE pattern; `update_incident_status(id, status_label, updated_at_unix_nano, resolved_at_unix_nano, payload_bytes)` is the canonical write surface chunk #87 reuses (called per-incident for each unread incident marked read; bulk count is bounded by workspace's unread set — small N). NO bulk update method exists at `CorpusWriter` level; iterating per-incident `update_incident_status` is the chunk-scope-safe choice (future perf chunk can add `bulk_update_incident_read_at(workspace, ids, read_at)` к `CorpusWriter`).

- `pulse-app/ui/src/widget/CompactWidget.tsx` (full, 72 lines) — three-band wireframe: `<Titlebar>` + `<main>` with `<AggregatedBadgeCanvas>` (flex: 1 minHeight: 0) + `<FooterBand>` + `<InvestigationModalForm>`. Chunk #87 inserts FindingsCounter as a 4th band between canvas and footer (or as overlay anchored к canvas bottom-right per layouts extract). Existing flex-column structure accommodates either. Plan recommends: insert FindingsCounter as а new `<div>` band between canvas wrapper and `<FooterBand>` — preserves Halo State Pulse canvas viewport bounds (counter hidden→shown does not shift canvas size if counter band reserves space via min-height OR is absolute-positioned overlay).

- `pulse-app/ui/src/widget/FooterBand.tsx` (full, 165 lines) — pattern для compact-widget band components: `<footer role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-label="..." data-testid="..."` styled с `borderTop: "1px solid rgba(74, 144, 226, 0.3)"` + `padding: "var(--spacing-sm) var(--spacing-md)"` + `background: "transparent"`. Mirrors the read-only-status-band pattern from layouts extract. FindingsCounter band component will follow this convention.

- `pulse-app/ui/src/widget/CompactWidget.test.tsx` (full, 115 lines) — test pattern для CompactWidget с stubbed children. Pattern: `vi.mock("./AggregatedBadgeCanvas", () => ({ AggregatedBadgeCanvas: (props) => <div data-testid="..." data-X={...}/> }))` for each child. Chunk #87 extends c `vi.mock("./FindingsCounter", () => ({ FindingsCounter: (props) => <div data-testid="findings-counter-stub" data-count={...} /> }))` + updates the "DOM order" test к assert titlebar / main / findings-counter / footer order. The 109-114 lines focus-order test `expect(focusables).toEqual([])` — chunk #87 INTRODUCES а focusable counter button (per a11y extract), so this test must update к expect ≥1 focusable (the counter trigger) OR be gated с а CompactWidget-stub mock that omits the counter for the no-counter-rendered case (when unread count is zero).

- `pulse-app/ui/src/widget/widget-types.ts` (full, 70 lines) — `WidgetMetrics` interface + pure-function formatters (`formatSpansPerSec`, `formatErrorRatePercent`, `formatRetentionMinutes`, `formatServiceCount`, `formatBadgeAriaLabel`) + threshold constants. Chunk #87 adds either а sibling `findings-types.ts` для FindingsRecord / FindingsRow / severityLabel / formatRelativeTime helpers OR extends this file. Plan recommends new file `findings-types.ts` к keep the existing widget-types narrow к the chunk #57 widget-real-data-binding scope.

- `pulse-app/src/observability.rs` lines 1843-1902 — chunk #86 AllowList block precedent для adding а new TauRPC procedure event. Pattern (mirror for chunk #87): `by_target.insert("incidents.mark_all_read.request", ["triggered", "affected_count", "traceparent", "latency_ms", "outcome"].iter().copied().collect());` + `by_target.insert("incident.broadcast.bulk_acknowledged", ["affected_count", "workspace_hash"].iter().copied().collect());` (the latter mirrors chunk #78's incident.broadcast.* event family с aggregate fields; workspace_hash is а bounded hash, NOT raw workspace string, к sidestep PII per security.md NEVER-log rule). NOTE: incidents.list_active.request + incidents.acknowledge.request + incidents.mark_resolved.request entries from chunk #78 do NOT appear to exist в the AllowList (greps returned zero matches) — а possibly latent regression where chunk #78 event fields are silently redacted. OUT OF SCOPE для chunk #87 (don't bundle unrelated fixes); chunk #87 adds ITS OWN entry conforming к the chunk #86 precedent, and the chunk #78 latent gap is left for а future obs-audit chunk OR а post-impl Type 6 amendment.

- **Quadruple-binding for new TauRPC procedure** (`pulse-app/src/diagnostics_router.rs` + `pulse-app/capabilities/default.json` + `xtask/src/main.rs::EXPECTED_PROCEDURES` + `pulse-app/src/main.rs::tests::emit_taurpc_bindings`) — chunk #86 precedent demonstrates clean single-chunk closure; chunk #87 mirrors. Chunk #87 `mark_all_read` resolver returns `AppError::Storage` if corpus bulk-mark-read writes fail (mid-iteration); persist failures inside the loop log+continue per chunk #78 `acknowledge` precedent (lines 144-150 `tracing::warn!(target: "triage.incident.persist.error", ...)`).

Chunk #87 adds `incident.broadcast.bulk_acknowledged` (or `bulk_marked_read`) as а new variant on chunk #78's `pulse://stream/incidents` topic. NOTE: the actual broadcast event type variant must be added к `triage::contract::IncidentLifecycleEvent` (or а sibling event type) — exact placement requires reading `crates/triage/src/incident/broadcast.rs`; plan defers that detail к /implement.

- (layouts) **Sectioned form-style stack pattern**: mirror Settings modal section stacking with `gap: space-lg` between sections + `font-heading` section titles + collapsible content regions.

- (layouts) **Status feedback after action pattern**: copy-markdown success feedback follows OS-notification precedent (terse 1-2 word title, 2-line max body — "Report copied", "{N} sections, {M} bytes").
- (layouts) **Reduced-motion graceful degradation**: section collapse/expand animation respects `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` per project-wide invariant.

- (a11y) Dialog/modal pattern: reuse existing investigation-modal precedent (`role="dialog"` + `aria-modal="true"` + `aria-labelledby` + focus moves к modal title or close button on open; Esc closes; focus restores к triggering row in Findings dropdown); use `focus-trap-react` 12.x с `escapeDeactivates: true` + `returnFocusOnDeactivate: true`.

- (a11y) Six-section structure: use semantic landmarks + heading hierarchy — `<main>` (or `<section>` if inside dialog) wrapping а single `<h1>` (Report title) followed by six `<section>` blocks each headed by `<h2>`.
- (a11y) "Previously seen" cross-incident subsection (P-036): nested `<h3>` under the relevant `<h2>` section per а11y plan §7; if rendered as expandable disclosure, follow the Disclosure pattern.
- (a11y) Copy-markdown button: native `<button>` (semantic HTML first); Enter/Space activates; ≥ 24×24 CSS px target size per `--target-button-min` token (SC 2.5.8 AA).
- (a11y) Status announcement on copy success: use `<div role="status" aria-live="polite">` per a11y plan §7 Live regions + §4 Status/Alert row.
- (a11y) Telemetry excerpts (P-035 anonymized): render in `<pre><code>` semantic blocks (preserving structure per SC 1.3.1).

- (tests) `rstest` 0.26.1 builder-fixture pattern for `Incident` + `Interpretation` test inputs (mirror `MockTraceSpan::builder()` shape) — feeds markdown serializer с structured fixtures rather than hand-built JSON literals.

- (tests) Co-located `#[cfg(test)] mod tests { ... }` for `crates/interpretation/markdown.rs` Rust unit tests; Vitest co-located `*.test.tsx` adjacent к `pulse-app/ui/report/Report.tsx` + `ReportRenderer.tsx` using `vitest` 3.x + `jsdom` 26 + `@testing-library/react` 16.

- (tests) Integration test pattern for `incidents.get_report(id)` resolver: stage а populated Incident + LLM-interpretation in а stub corpus → invoke procedure via `tauri::test::mock_builder()` → assert response shape includes `markdown: String` field + six-section content.
- (tests) Negative test pattern для `incidents.get_report(missing_id)` → assert `AppError::NotFound { resource }` variant.

- (tests) Degraded-mode test pattern: build interpretation fixture where `hypotheses: None` + `investigation_steps: None` → assert markdown output contains explicit notice string AND omits the two sections.

- (obs) TauRPC router span wrapping per chunk #78 `incidents.list_active` / `incidents.acknowledge` / `incidents.mark_resolved` precedent (`pulse-app/src/incidents_router.rs`): same `#[tracing::instrument(skip_all, fields(traceparent = %tp))]` shape + AppError mapping at the resolver boundary.

- (obs) Markdown serialization wrapper span follows the existing `snapshot.render.markdown` precedent в obs-plan §4 P2 must-trace spans — adapted к incident reports as `report.render.markdown` с `section_count = 6`.

- (obs) Default-deny PII allowlist per obs-plan §8 — extend the existing per-module whitelist с а new `interpretation` entry covering `incident_id`, `report_section_count`, `markdown_size_bytes`, `degraded_mode`, etc.
- (obs) Heartbeat-tick discipline does NOT apply к а one-shot report-render path; emit а single boundary span per invocation.
**Anti-patterns к avoid:**

- (security) NEVER log the Report markdown payload (clipboard contents) per security plan §Anti-Patterns §Logging "NEVER log … clipboard contents, MCP tool response bodies" — incident IDs + section names + sizes acceptable; full markdown body NOT.
- (security) NEVER serialize an `anyhow::Error` directly across `incidents.get_report(id)` — convert to `AppError` first per CLAUDE.md.

- (security) NEVER `format!("… WHERE id = '{}'")` against the corpus when fetching the Report's underlying `IncidentRecord` / cross-incident matches — corpus is SQLite + the same prepared-statement discipline applies (universal SQL injection ban).

- (security) NEVER grant `pulse:default` permission к `fs`, `shell`, `dialog`, `http` core APIs for "writing the report к disk" or "opening а separate window" — the existing Tauri window-creation flow MUST be used.

- (security) NEVER skip the PII scrubber on the "evidence" section's telemetry excerpts — raw OTLP excerpts displayed alongside the LLM output per P-035 are а NEW egress path that MUST be scrubbed at `markdown.rs` serialization time.
- (design) NEVER introduce gradients, glassmorphism, or shadows on the Report panel chrome — flat matte surfaces only с borders-only depth strategy.
- (design) NEVER use color alone к convey severity / state on Report sections — every semantic-color application MUST be paired с а text label or icon.
- (design) NEVER use banned generic fonts (Inter / Roboto / Arial / Helvetica / Open Sans / Lato / system-ui / Space Grotesk).
- (design) NEVER use `alert()` / `confirm()` / `prompt()` for "report ready" / "report copied" / "no incident selected" surfaces.
- (design) NEVER apply opacity fades > 200ms on chrome — section reveal/collapse capped at 200ms standard fade.
- (layouts) DO NOT render Report content inside the compact widget surface — compact widget is fixed quarter-screen glance-only с "no other navigation".
- (layouts) DO NOT introduce nested submenus, third-level section hierarchy, or "drill-down" navigation within the Report — six sections are flat siblings.
- (layouts) DO NOT use OS-native file picker for "save Report к file" without explicit downstream decision — Report copy-to-clipboard is the in-scope export action.
- (a11y) NEVER convey degraded mode purely via color — pair the state с icon + text label per SC 1.4.1 + a11y plan §11.
- (a11y) NEVER omit `aria-label` / accessible name on the icon-only copy-markdown button — use visible text label "Copy markdown" preferred.
- (a11y) NEVER skip heading levels (no `<h1>` → `<h3>` jump across six sections).
- (a11y) NEVER autoplay panel open / section collapse motion without `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` respect — Tailwind v4 `motion-reduce:duration-0 motion-reduce:transition-none` MUST apply.
- (a11y) NEVER add `role="dialog"` on а `<div>` without `aria-modal="true"` + `aria-labelledby`.
- (a11y) NEVER trap focus inside the Report dialog without Esc-escape path (focus-trap-react `escapeDeactivates: true` MUST be set).
- (tests) NEVER assert on full raw markdown string equality — assert on regex / line-presence / section-count contracts.
- (tests) NEVER include visual / pixel-inspection in `Report.tsx` tests; section-collapse assertions use `aria-expanded` attribute, not rendered-CSS inspection.
- (tests) NEVER skip per-procedure quadruple-binding update (capability JSON / EXPECTED_PROCEDURES / emit_taurpc_bindings test merge / router).
- (tests) NEVER assert on `format!`-string-built SQL when reading the corpus для report assembly — corpus reads MUST use prepared statements.

- (obs) NEVER log report markdown body / hypotheses text / evidence excerpts / symptom text / investigation step text in any `tracing` event — these are user-controlled OTLP-derived content (Vector 1 + Vector 4 hygiene).
- (obs) NEVER include а full corpus file path / SQLite database path in а tracing event — basename-only discipline applies.
- (obs) NEVER emit `tracing::info!` inside the per-row React render loop of ReportRenderer.tsx — frontend telemetry bridges only on render-complete boundaries.
- (arch) DO NOT introduce a new TauRPC namespace `report.*` or `diagnostics.report.*` — the procedure belongs in the existing `incidents.*` namespace per chunk #86/#87 precedents.

- (arch) DO NOT add `Report` / `Incident` / supporting types as new entries в `crates/triage::contract` solely к make them serde-derivable — assemble the cross-bridge `Report` payload type at the binary boundary in `pulse-app/src/incidents_router.rs`.
- (arch) DO NOT add a new env var like `ANDROMEDA_PULSE_REPORT_FORMAT` per §Occupied Resources Environment variables discipline.
- (arch) DO NOT bypass the corpus PII scrubber when assembling telemetry excerpts per P-035.
- (arch) DO NOT expose internal-only Rust struct names / file paths / library versions through the `incidents.get_report(id)` error path.
**Contract bindings:**

- **security ↔ obs (PII scrubber)**: PII scrubber coverage extends к the new markdown serialization path (`crates/interpretation/markdown.rs`) per chunk #72 uniform-coverage invariant; obs domain's `tracing-subscriber` Layer redaction discipline and security's scrubber primitive share the SAME `scrub_attribute` API; markdown.rs binds к this shared primitive. Both sides reciprocate.

- **security ↔ tests (clipboard hygiene + PII negative-canary)**: chunk #88 acceptance includes verification that "copy Report к clipboard emits visible clipboard-write event" — binds к tests domain's E2E surface (test drives copy-shortcut + asserts toast event); tests authors the negative-canary test asserting clipboard payload does NOT contain pre-defined PII seeds (mirrors chunks #43/#44/#72). Both sides reciprocate.

- **security ↔ a11y (clipboard visible event + aria-live)**: the visible clipboard-write toast (security invariant) + the toast's `aria-live` polite role (a11y invariant) are the same UI element with two domain owners — single emission both announces к SR users AND honors the security visibility requirement. Both sides reciprocate explicitly.

- **security ↔ arch (arch registry amendment)**: the +1 TauRPC procedure `incidents.get_report(id)` requires arch §Occupied Resources Tauri IPC routes amendment via `/andromeda-evolve --allow-arch-registry` per the CLAUDE.md §Session Additions 2026-05-09 / 2026-05-18 single-coordinated single-item amendment precedent. Both sides reciprocate (arch acknowledges; security explicitly cites canonical-source-of-truth rule).

- **design ↔ a11y (contrast / motion / not-color-alone / focus)**: every Report-surface text-on-surface pair MUST satisfy WCAG SC 1.4.3 + 1.4.11; section-collapse + copy-markdown + degraded-notice transitions bind к SC 2.3.3; severity badges + state pills bind к SC 1.4.1; focus rings on every interactive element bind к design-system §Focus / Keyboard Navigation 3-4px outset `#4A90E2` discipline. a11y verifies via axe-core + pa11y + Lighthouse + colorjs.io harness. Both sides reciprocate.

- **design ↔ security (PII scrub)**: P-035 Anonymized Telemetry Excerpts surface MUST render only scrubbed strings (per chunk #72); design typography choice (JetBrains Mono for excerpt rows + Tertiary `#7D8697` for "(redacted)" placeholder) signals immutable telemetry fact + de-emphasized metadata.

- **design ↔ arch (markdown serialization equivalence)**: markdown serialization in `crates/interpretation/markdown.rs` MUST be identical к MCP delivery (planned chunk #92); section ordering + heading levels (h1 incident / h2 six sections / h3 subsections like "Previously seen") map к the in-app section hierarchy + collapse boundaries. Both sides reciprocate.

- **layouts ↔ a11y (focus order + modal pattern)**: Section-collapse controls (chevron toggle buttons) introduce focusable elements — focus order discipline binds к a11y plan §Focus Order SC 2.4.3; modal/panel pattern (Option A) binds к a11y modal focus trap (Escape dismiss + restore focus к trigger row in Findings dropdown). Both sides reciprocate.

- **layouts ↔ arch (TauRPC consumer)**: New TauRPC procedure `incidents.get_report(id)` returns Report content + markdown serialization; layout commits к consuming this via the standard chunk #87 Findings → row-click trigger pattern.

- **obs ↔ tests (harness contract + SLO assertions)**: report render emits а single boundary span `report.render.markdown` per `incidents.get_report(id)` invocation that the tests harness can grep from `agent-latest.jsonl`; JSON log format is exact match к tests excerpt; degraded-mode path emits а distinct event; any p99 latency budget on report generation must be expressed as а `tracing::info!(target: "metric.report.render_ms", duration_ms, ...)` event. Both sides reciprocate.

- **obs ↔ security (PII scrubbing default-deny)**: report markdown contains scrubbed telemetry excerpts (P-035 anonymized via chunk #72 at persistence boundary); obs adds defense-in-depth by NEVER logging the markdown body itself — only safe metadata fields per the §8 default-deny allowlist; cross-incident corpus lookup follows the §8 row "DuckDB query parameters [...] `query_id` + `param_count` emitted, NOT `params` list". Both sides reciprocate.

- **tests ↔ a11y (DOM-shape + WCAG)**: Report component tests at DOM-shape level (`aria-expanded` / `role="button"` / focus-trap on copy-action confirmation) bind к a11y-plan's keyboard-nav + section-anchor assertions; tests-side asserts contract, a11y-CI gate asserts WCAG. Both sides reciprocate.

- **tests ↔ design (markdown determinism)**: copy-markdown output format is shared with future chunk #92 MCP delivery; tests assert deterministic serializer output so chunk #92 can re-use the same fn — binding к design's single-source-of-truth-for-markdown policy.

- **a11y ↔ obs (violation JSON schema)**: Report-surface violations emit structured JSON aligned к obs §6 schema with `wcag_criterion` / `violation_type` / `severity` / `surface: "desktop-webview"` / `selector` / `remediation` / `tool` / `tool_result_id` fields per a11y plan §3 Structured Violation JSON Schema; tagged с `service.name = "com.andromeda.pulse"` + `deployment.environment = "production"`.

- (security) Visible clipboard-write event observed: triggering Copy Report fires the documented `pulse://stream/snapshot-progress` topic (or the chunk-specific equivalent) с а non-suppressible "{N} bytes copied" payload — verify via Tauri Channel API event capture in an E2E test.
- (security) `cargo audit` + `cargo deny check bans licenses sources` pass against the chunk #88 diff.
- (security) Sanitized `AppError`: grep for stack-trace / path / library-version patterns in error payload after triggering а deliberate failure path returns empty.

- (arch) `cargo check --workspace` AND `cargo check --workspace --no-default-features` AND `cargo check --workspace --all-features` all pass; module dependency graph unchanged at the workspace `Cargo.toml [workspace.dependencies]` level.

- Co-located `#[cfg(test)] mod tests`: six-section markers present; degraded-mode notice when hypotheses/investigation_steps empty; resolution_summary section when populated; "Previously seen" subsection when matches non-empty; determinism (two identical inputs produce byte-identical output via `assert_eq!(serialize_report(&r), serialize_report(&r))`); PII pass-through (pre-scrubbed input strings survive verbatim — no re-scrubbing); empty optional sections omitted cleanly (no `## Resolution Summary\n\n` blank-body).
