title: Step 3 — Extend IncidentsApi trait + IncidentsApiImpl с get_report

data.head: ### Step 3 — Extend IncidentsApi trait + IncidentsApiImpl с get_report

body: Edit `pulse-app/src/incidents_router.rs`:
- Add trait method к `IncidentsApi`:

Insert AFTER `mark_all_read` (preserving alphabetical group: ack / list / mark_all_read / mark_resolved). Doc comment in regular `// ...` block BEFORE the `#[taurpc::procedures]` attribute (per CLAUDE.md 2026-05-25 chunk #86 doc-comment discipline) — describe chunk #88 (assembles incident + L4 output + previously-seen matches via corpus; returns six-section structured payload + serialized markdown).
- Add `ReportPayload` cross-bridge struct (serde+specta derive) с fields mirroring the markdown `Report` struct PLUS а `markdown: String` field carrying the serialized form:

```rust
  #[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq, specta::Type)]
  pub struct ReportPayload {
      pub incident_id: i64,
      pub title: String,
      pub workspace: String,
      pub opened_at_unix_nano: i64,
      pub status: IncidentStatus,
      pub severity: Severity,
      pub symptom: String,
      pub timeline: String,
      pub hypotheses: Vec<HypothesisView>,
      pub investigation_steps: Vec<InvestigationStepView>,
      pub evidence_refs: Vec<String>,
      pub project_context: String,
      pub degraded_mode: bool,
      pub resolution_summary: Option<String>,
      pub previously_seen: Vec<PreviouslySeenMatch>,
      pub markdown: String,
  }
  ```

- Extend `IncidentsApiImpl` с `corpus_reader: Arc<dyn CorpusReader>` + `llm_output_reader: Arc<dyn LlmOutputReader>` + extend `IncidentsApiImpl::new(...)` ctor signature accordingly. Add free-fn `llm_output_error_to_app_error(err: LlmOutputReaderError) -> AppError` per the 2026-05-18 cross-crate-error free-fn pattern.

- Resolver impl `get_report(self, id: i64)`:
  1. `#[tracing::instrument(skip_all, fields(outcome = tracing::field::Empty, item_id = id, section_count = tracing::field::Empty, markdown_size_bytes = tracing::field::Empty, degraded_mode = tracing::field::Empty, previously_seen_corpus_match_count = tracing::field::Empty, duration_ms = tracing::field::Empty))]`.
  2. Fetch Incident from `self.registry.get_by_id(id)` (extend `IncidentRegistry` trait с this method if it doesn't already exist — single-method extension per the 2026-05-25 chunk #87 `mark_read` precedent on the lower-crate side; in-memory + corpus impls).
  3. If `None` → return `Err(AppError::NotFound { resource: "incident".to_string() })`.
  4. Fetch L4Output via `self.llm_output_reader.get_by_incident_id(id)` → `Option<L4Output>`.
  5. Determine `degraded_mode` from `incident.severity == Severity::Curious && l4_output.is_none()` OR from а dedicated field if chunk #86 added one (Phase 4 plan tolerates either; concrete impl during /implement adapts based on Step 1 finding).
  6. Fetch "Previously seen" cross-incident matches via `self.corpus_reader.find_matches_by_fingerprint(&incident.fingerprint, exclude_id = id, limit = 5)` (extend `CorpusReader` trait с this method if absent — same lower-crate-extension pattern). Limit к 5 entries; oldest-first OR most-recent-first decision pinned to "most-recent-first" к surface latest matches.
  7. Source project context: from existing `workspace_detector` cache OR by reading `service_registry` corpus table (lifecycle states + active service list) — bounded к а short summary string (≤500 chars per security/log size discipline).
  8. Assemble the `interpretation::markdown::Report` struct via field projection (`From<&Incident> + ... for Report` or а free-fn `assemble_report(incident, l4_output, previously_seen, project_context) -> Report`).
  9. Invoke scrubber on user-facing text fields BEFORE serialization: each of `symptom, timeline, hypotheses[*].title, hypotheses[*].description, investigation_steps[*].title, investigation_steps[*].description, evidence_refs[*], project_context, resolution_summary, previously_seen[*].title` routed through `security::scrubber::scrub_attribute` per chunk #72 uniform-coverage discipline + combined.md §security ↔ obs PII binding. Pulse-app introduces а helper `scrub_report(&mut Report)` mutating the Report's strings in-place (single-site invocation — keeps the markdown serializer а pure function).
  10. Serialize markdown: `let markdown = interpretation::markdown::serialize_report(&report);`.
  11. Build `ReportPayload` from `Report` + the serialized `markdown` string.
  12. Emit `tracing::info!(target: "report.render.markdown", incident_id, report_section_count = 6, markdown_size_bytes, degraded_mode, previously_seen_corpus_match_count, duration_ms, "report markdown serialized")` (per obs allowlist + ZERO markdown body field).
  13. Record span fields + emit `incidents.get_report.request` info event.
  14. Return `Ok(ReportPayload)`.

- On any read failure (corpus read failure / L4Output read failure):
  - `Err(LlmOutputReaderError::NotFound)` collapses to `Err(AppError::NotFound { resource: "incident_l4_output".to_string() })` (graceful: incident exists но no L4Output — Report renders с degraded notice instead. ALTERNATIVELY return Ok с degraded_mode=true и empty hypotheses/investigation_steps; choose this path for clean degraded UX).
  - Other corpus errors → `Err(AppError::Storage { message: <sanitized one-liner> })` via free-fn map_err.

data.head: ### Step 8 — Create webview Report surface (Report.tsx + ReportRenderer.tsx + use-report.ts + report-types.ts)

body: Create `pulse-app/ui/src/report/` directory с following files:
**`report-types.ts`** — shared TypeScript types:
Co-located test asserts shape conformance + bounded enum string sets.
**`use-report.ts`** — fetch + clipboard write + telemetry hook:
- `useReport(incidentId: number | null): { report, loading, error, copyMarkdown, copyState }`.
- Fetches via `proxy.incidents.get_report(incidentId)` when `incidentId !== null`.

- `copyMarkdown(): Promise<void>` calls `@tauri-apps/plugin-clipboard-manager.writeText(report.markdown)` + manages copyState transitions: `idle → copying → copied | error`. `copied` state auto-resets к `idle` after 2 seconds. Records frame timing via existing `telemetry.frontend.record_frame_ms` бridge? **Decision: do NOT thread report-render timing through frame-bridge** — it's not а WebGPU frame; record via а separate dedicated tracing event from the resolver side (per Step 3 step 12). Webview side records copy duration ONLY: emits via the existing `telemetry.frontend.record_clipboard_write` if exists, else не emits (resolver-side `ui.report.clipboard_write` tracing event suffices for SLO assertion).
**`ReportRenderer.tsx`** — visual six-section renderer:
- Props: `{ report: ReportContent, onCopyMarkdown: () => Promise<void>, copyState: "idle" | "copying" | "copied" | "error" }`.

- Layout:
  - `<h1>` Report title (e.g., "Diagnostic Report: {report.title}")
  - Metadata block: workspace + ISO opened-at + status pill + severity pill (severity uses semantic color + text label per a11y not-color-alone discipline)
  - If `report.degradedMode === true`: render Warning shape banner (`<aside aria-label="Degraded mode notice">` с design-token bg + border + text "Interpretation degraded — hypotheses and investigation steps omitted. See diagnostics for retry options."). Pair с custom telescope/aperture icon + visible text.
  - Six `<section>` blocks each c `<h2>` heading + `<button aria-expanded aria-controls>` chevron disclosure toggling section visibility (default expanded). Sections render in fixed order: Symptom / Timeline / Hypotheses / Investigation Steps / Evidence / Project Context.
    - Symptom + Timeline + Project Context: simple text body.
    - Hypotheses: bulleted list (per-hypothesis card с `({likelihood}) {title}` + description body). Skip if degradedMode.
    - Investigation Steps: numbered list (per-step card с `{N}. {title}` + description). Skip if degradedMode.
    - Evidence: bulleted list of pre-scrubbed evidence refs (JetBrains Mono font for span IDs / trace IDs / fingerprint hashes per design typography rationale).
  - If `report.resolutionSummary !== null`: render а seventh `<section>` "Resolution Summary" с the summary text body (semantic h2 within the same heading hierarchy; "Previously seen" subsection-style nesting OR top-level — pick top-level for visibility).
  - If `report.previouslySeen.length > 0`: render an `<aside>` или nested `<h3>` subsection inside Symptom OR Hypotheses (consistent с combined.md "P-036 'Previously seen' subsection nests inside the symptom or hypotheses section"). Disclosure pattern с `aria-expanded` initially collapsed.
  - Copy markdown button: `<button>` с visible text "Copy markdown" + icon (custom telescope OR Lucide fallback Clipboard glyph), `disabled` while `copyState === "copying"`, focus ring `--border-focus` 3px outset. On click → `onCopyMarkdown()`.
  - Copy success status: `<div role="status" aria-live="polite">` updates с `"Report copied к clipboard ({markdownBytes} bytes)"` for 2 seconds when `copyState === "copied"`; empty string otherwise (avoids stale announcements). The status region is sr-only-but-visually-revealed-on-success (per Modal's existing live region pattern).
- Token discipline: every `style` value resolves к `var(--color-X)` / `var(--spacing-X)` / `var(--radius-X)` / `var(--duration-X)` / `var(--font-X)` — NO inline hex literals; NO magic pixel numbers.

- Motion discipline: section-collapse transitions use `transitionDuration: var(--duration-standard)` + Tailwind v4 `motion-reduce:transition-none` class OR per CLAUDE.md design 2026-05-08 — actually use the existing CSS @media `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` override that wires `--duration-standard` к 0ms per design plan §Motion Accessibility (chunks #87 FindingsDropdown precedent).

- Co-located test asserts: six section headings render; chevron toggles aria-expanded; copy button click invokes mock; degraded-mode renders banner + omits hypotheses + investigation steps; resolution_summary appears when prop populated; previously_seen disclosure renders when prop non-empty; design tokens used (no hex literals via DOM inspection or token grep test).
**`Report.tsx`** — top-level container:
- Props: `{ isOpen: boolean, onClose: () => void, incidentId: number | null, triggerRef: RefObject<HTMLElement | null> }`.
- Uses `useReport(incidentId)` hook к fetch report content.

- Composes `<Modal open={isOpen} onClose={onClose} triggerRef={triggerRef} titleId="diagnostic-report-title" title={loading ? "Loading report..." : `Diagnostic Report: ${report?.title ?? ""}`} busy={loading} liveRegionLevel="polite" liveMessage={copyStateMessage(copyState)}>`.

- Inside Modal children:
  - If `loading` → skeleton placeholder (Raised-1 background + opacity pulse animation per design Loading/Empty pattern).
  - If `error !== null` → error state с `var(--color-accent)` border + icon + error text (sanitized — no internal struct names; uses the AppError-mapped human-friendly message).
  - If `report !== null` → render `<ReportRenderer report={report} onCopyMarkdown={copyMarkdown} copyState={copyState} />`.

- Co-located test asserts: panel opens when isOpen+incidentId set; fetch invoked once; ReportRenderer mounted с fetched data; Esc closes via Modal escapeDeactivates; focus restores к triggerRef on close.

title: Chunk route#89: "Header redesign: connection dot + chrome cleanup"

data.head: ### Chunk route#89: "Header redesign: connection dot + chrome cleanup"

body: Summary (from project-doc §88): Remove the `Ingest 200/s` / `Error 4.2%` / `Retention 3m / 10m` footer band ENTIRELY (dashboard-mindset; violates P-024 ambient invariant). Add a 6–8px connection-state dot near the app icon (color encodes connection state). Keep the existing expand-to-dashboard / settings affordance. Tooltip on dot hover (+ focus) shows current connection state + last-span-ago. Files: `pulse-app/ui/components/Titlebar.tsx`, `pulse-app/ui/widget/FooterBand.tsx`, `pulse-app/ui/widget/CompactWidget.tsx`. Consumer-side: subscribes to the EXISTING `pulse://stream/connection-state` / `connection.current_state` (chunk #59). Capabilities P-001 (connection visual signal) + P-024 (Widget Ambient Surface — chrome cleanup invariant).
**Constraints across domains:**

- (arch) All chunk code lives under `pulse-app/ui/`; no `crates/*` library-crate edits — the 3 named `.tsx` files are all webview source (per arch §Infrastructure Patterns project directory structure + §Conventions File naming).

- (arch) Connection-state data MUST be sourced ONLY from the existing `connection.current_state` TauRPC (`ConnectionApiImpl` → `ConnectionStatePayload`) and/or the `pulse://stream/connection-state` broadcast — both already in §Occupied Resources (chunk #59, Registry Update 2026-05-16). No new query path (per arch §Occupied Resources + §Standard Contracts Real-time push).

- (arch) The dot encodes the FSM-fixed state set Listening / Receiving / Idle / Stalled / ReceiverFailed (chunk #59 contract); color mapping is design-domain but the ENUM is arch-fixed (per arch §Occupied Resources broadcast entry + route §2 Epoch 9).

- (arch / security) MUST NOT add a new TauRPC procedure, broadcast topic, Tauri capability identifier, env var, or workspace crate — §Occupied Resources is negative-default; chunk detail confirms "Arch registry delta: none". The webview runs under `pulse:default`; `connection.current_state` is already permitted, so no `pulse-app/capabilities/` change (per arch §Cross-cutting Webview IPC capability policy + security plan §API Security TauRPC capability authorization).

- (arch) The `streams.subscribe_metrics` subscription feeding the Halo (chunk #57, errorRate/throughputHz shape) MUST NOT be disturbed by removing the FooterBand's metric display — it is a presentation change only (per arch §Occupied Resources `streams.*` namespace; chunk #57 landed invariant).

- (security) The dot + tooltip MUST NOT render raw OTLP attribute values — display only the bounded connection-state enum label + the derived "last-span-ago" duration; never a service name, span name, or attribute string from instrumented telemetry (per security plan §Logging & Monitoring NEVER-log list + §Data Protection — OTLP attributes are user-controlled content that may carry incidentally captured secrets).

- (security) Any new webview asset (glyph, tooltip styling) MUST be first-party + bundled-local — no remote/CDN source that would force a CSP `'self'`-posture relaxation (per security plan §API Security CSP row).

- (security) Footer-band removal is pure subtraction; it MUST NOT remove/alter the `pulse://stream/snapshot-progress` clipboard-write toast (a separate load-bearing visible signal) (per security plan §Logging & Monitoring snapshot/clipboard hygiene).

- (design) Dot color from the NASA Deep Space palette semantic mapping, not arbitrary hex: healthy (Listening/Receiving/Idle) → `--color-primary` (#4A90E2 Earth Blue); Stalled (Severity::Warning) + ReceiverFailed (Severity::Critical) → `--color-accent` (#C7556A Alert Burgundy). No new hex without a Decisions Log entry (per design-system §Color Palette + §Semantic Colors).
- (design) Dot is a round status badge → `radius-full`; 6–8px fits the badge size class (per design-system §Border Radius mixed strategy).

- (design) Tooltip surface uses `--color-raised-2` (#2D3139) bg (designated for "dropdowns, popovers, tooltips") + 1px subtle border `rgba(74,144,226,0.1)` (borders-only, NO shadow) + `--radius-md` (per design-system §Surface Scale + §Depth Strategy).

- (design) Typography split: state label/prose in `--font-body` (IBM Plex Sans); the "last span <ago>" duration in `--font-code` (JetBrains Mono) tabular-nums — the existing FooterBand `NUMERIC_STYLE` is the precedent (per design-system §Typography).
- (design) All placement/gap/padding via 4px-base spacing tokens (`--spacing-micro|xs|sm`); dot-to-icon gap mirrors the existing titlebar `gap: var(--spacing-sm)` (per design-system §Spacing).

- (layouts) Titlebar is a flex row `[app-icon + title | grow | settings-button | window-controls]`, `height: space-lg`, `padding: 0 space-sm`, `gap: space-sm`; the dot inserts in the left segment near the app icon without disrupting the flex segments or drag region (per layout-templates.md §Custom titlebar Layout).
- (layouts) The dot MUST be excluded from the `data-tauri-drag-region` (same as buttons) so hover/focus tooltip pointer events fire (per layout-templates.md §Custom titlebar Drag region).

- (layouts) FooterBand ("Ingest"/"Error"/"Retention") is removed ENTIRELY — the band + its border-top become deleted layout; the Halo canvas (`height: 100%`) reflows to fill the freed viewport (per layout-templates.md §Footer + §Halo State Pulse canvas Layout).

- (layouts) The app-icon click affordance (focus main window) and the settings/expand-to-dashboard affordance are preserved; settings + window-controls segments unchanged (per layout-templates.md §Custom titlebar Components).

- (a11y) Connection state MUST NOT be conveyed by dot COLOR alone — the accessible name carries the state word (e.g. `aria-label="Connection: <state> — last span <ago>"`); color-only fails SC 1.4.1 (per a11y-plan §6 + §11 Visual).
- (a11y) Dot color MUST meet SC 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast ≥3:1 against the titlebar `--color-base` (graphical indicator) (per a11y-plan §6 contrast pairs + §11).

- (a11y) If interactive (focusable, hover/focus tooltip): native `<button>`, Tab-reachable, Enter/Space-activatable, `--border-focus` on `:focus-visible` — never `outline:none` without replacement; Investigate/Settings buttons are the reference (per a11y-plan §4 + §6 + §11 Keyboard).

- (a11y) Tooltip content MUST be available on BOTH hover AND keyboard focus + remain dismissable per SC 1.4.13 Content on Hover or Focus. **NOTE:** a11y-plan §1 currently marks SC 1.4.13 "not applicable"; this chunk introduces the first tooltip → SC 1.4.13 becomes applicable (plan is silent — orchestrator surfaces to user; see Open questions / rot warnings).

- (a11y) Removing `<footer role="status" aria-live="polite">` removes a live region (SC 4.1.3) — acceptable (deliberate metric discard) but any `getByRole("status")` / `getByTestId("footer-band")` test MUST be updated (per a11y-plan §7 + §11).

- (a11y / design) Any dot color-transition or tooltip animation MUST respect `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` (degrade to instant) — state still conveyed by color + accessible-name text; titlebar buttons' `motion-reduce:transition-none motion-reduce:duration-0` is the reference (per a11y-plan §6 + §11 Motion / SC 2.3.3 AAA; design-system §Motion Accessibility).

- (tests) Webview component tests use vitest 3.x + jsdom 26 + @testing-library/react 16, co-located `*.test.tsx` under `pulse-app/ui/src/`; FooterBand removal MUST delete/retarget `FooterBand.test.tsx`; Titlebar/CompactWidget tests MUST cover the new dot + chrome cleanup (per test-plan §4 + §Surfaces-under-test).

- (tests) DOM-shape assertions ONLY — no visual diff/pixel/screenshot (per test-plan §4 + §11 agent-driven bans). Footer removal is a NEGATIVE-presence assertion: test MUST assert "Ingest"/"Error"/"Retention" are NOT rendered (the P-024 proof) plus the dot IS rendered.

- (tests) Standard chunk-gate baseline (webview gates IN scope — chunk touches `pulse-app/ui/**`): cargo fmt/clippy/nextest/capability-drift + `npm run lint|typecheck|test --prefix pulse-app/ui` (per test-plan §12 2026-05-10 chunk-gate-baseline).

- (obs) The `telemetry.frontend.record_frame_ms` → `metric.webgpu.frame_duration_ms` bridge MUST remain intact; it lives in the WebGPU canvas surfaces (`pulse-app/ui/src/canvas/frame-loop.ts` etc.), NOT in FooterBand — FooterBand carries zero frame telemetry; removing it MUST NOT break the frame-timing path (per obs plan §3 Frontend bridge + §5).

- (obs) Self-observation surface separation holds: removing a metric DISPLAY does not change the `~/.andromeda-pulse/logs/agent-latest.jsonl` surface; expected new telemetry from this chunk = NONE (per obs plan §3 + §2).
**Patterns к follow:**

- (arch) Real-time push consumption via Tauri 2 IPC `Channel` API on `pulse://stream/*` event names — reuse the subscribe-to-existing-topic wiring chunk #57 used for `streams.subscribe_metrics` (per arch §Standard Contracts Real-time push).

- (arch) Consume-don't-add discipline: consuming an already-registered procedure/topic incurs ZERO new bindings — no capability JSON, no `xtask EXPECTED_PROCEDURES`, no `/andromeda-scope-arch` (per CLAUDE.md 2026-05-09 + arch §Cross-cutting capability policy).

- (design) Custom Observatory glyphs over stock icons; the titlebar app icon already uses `<Icon glyph="constellation-grid" size={16} />` — a simple round element / custom glyph for the dot, never a Lucide/Heroicons stock status glyph (per design-system §Iconography + §Rejected Defaults).

- (design) State-via-color-AND-text (not color alone): the existing FooterBand error-value pattern pairs `--color-accent` border with `--color-text-primary` + the numeric meaning (`FooterBand.tsx` 56-57,110-122) — the dot carries state via tooltip/aria-label, not hue alone (per design-system §Anti-Patterns + §Decisions Log 2026-05-03).

- (design / a11y) Reduced-motion-aware transitions: existing titlebar buttons carry `motion-reduce:transition-none motion-reduce:duration-0` + `transitionDuration: var(--duration-fast)` (Titlebar.tsx 97/107-108/118/127-128) — any dot/tooltip transition follows the same `--duration-fast` (150ms) ease-out + `motion-reduce:` variant.

- (layouts) Titlebar segment order `[app-icon + title | grow | settings | window-controls]`; dot inserts within the app-icon left cluster; titlebar bottom 1px subtle border retained; hover-driven affordance follows the settings-button hover model (per layout-templates.md §Custom titlebar).

- (a11y) Native `<button>` + `aria-label` + 24×24 min target + decorative inner glyph `aria-hidden="true"` (accessible name on the button) — Investigate/Settings buttons (Titlebar.tsx 91-132) are the exact reference shape (per a11y-plan §4 + §6).

- (a11y / layouts) Focus order matches visual left-to-right placement (SC 2.4.3): dot near the app-icon → first/second focusable titlebar element; `tabbable(container)` is the ground-truth assertion (per a11y-plan §5 + layout-templates.md focus order).

- (tests) Reuse the existing FooterBand/Titlebar test shape (`render` + `screen.getByRole/getByText/getByTestId` + assert `tagName`/`aria-*`/`data-testid`/inline `style.*`); mock the taurpc proxy/Channel callback + capture it for synthetic state-event injection (no live network) (per test-plan §4 + testing.md 2026-05-16 callback-shape).

- (obs) Frontend-telemetry-via-TauRPC-bridge: if the dot ever surfaces a metric, route `JS callback → telemetry.frontend.record_* → backend tracing::info!(target:"metric.{name}")` — never a browser OTel SDK (per obs plan §3 + §4).
**Anti-patterns к avoid:**

- (security / arch) NEVER add a new TauRPC procedure / broadcast topic / capability grant / env var / crate to satisfy this consumer-side chunk — if implementation seems to need a new IPC name, the redesign has drifted out of "subscribes to existing topic" scope (per security plan §Anti-Patterns §API + arch §Occupied Resources).

- (security) NEVER render raw OTLP attribute/span/service-supplied strings into the dot tooltip or any header element — the payload derives from the OTLP boundary; display only the bounded label + last-span-ago (per security plan §Anti-Patterns §Logging + §Logging & Monitoring NEVER-log list).
- (security) NEVER introduce remote/CDN-sourced fonts/icons/styles for the dot/tooltip (would force a CSP relaxation) (per security plan §API Security CSP row).
- (design) NEVER use a uniform monochrome status icon (green ✓ / red ✗) — explicitly Rejected Default; encode via NASA-palette hue taxonomy (per design-system §Rejected Defaults).
- (design) NEVER add shadow/gradient/glassmorphism to the tooltip — depth is borders-only on dark surfaces (Halo is the only gradient/blur exception) (per design-system §Depth Strategy).

- (design) NEVER use a tooltip opacity fade >200ms or spring/bounce easing — chrome motion capped at 150–200ms ease-out; never hardcode the dot size/color as raw px/hex (per design-system §Motion Hard limits + §Self-Validation Token Test).

- (a11y) NEVER encode state by dot color alone with no text/aria supplement (SC 1.4.1); NEVER use `<div role="button">`/non-focusable `<span>` with click/hover handlers (trips eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y `no-static-element-interactions`); NEVER ship a hover-only tooltip with no keyboard-focus equivalent (SC 1.4.13) (per a11y-plan §11).

- (layouts) Do NOT place the dot inside `data-tauri-drag-region` without exclusion (swallows pointer events); do NOT relocate the removed footer metrics elsewhere in chrome (violates P-024 cleanup intent); do NOT leave a dead/empty footer container or residual border-top (canvas must reflow) (per layout-templates.md §Footer + §Halo canvas).

- (obs) NEVER repurpose/remove the `telemetry.frontend.record_frame_ms` → `metric.webgpu.frame_duration_ms` bridge while removing the footer (underpins the p99 frame ≤33ms SLO; independent of the footer's metric display); NEVER add an OTel SDK / browser exporter (per obs plan §11 + §5).
**Contract bindings:**

- **arch ↔ design**: arch fixes the 5-state ENUM (Listening/Receiving/Idle/Stalled/ReceiverFailed) + data source; design owns per-state palette + tooltip styling. The dot MUST color-map all 5 states (no missing-state gap).
- **design ↔ a11y (not-color-alone, SC 1.4.1)**: design supplies palette tokens; a11y asserts each state is paired with the state word in the accessible name (tooltip + aria-label satisfy it).

- **design ↔ a11y (contrast, SC 1.4.11 / 1.4.3)**: dot ≥3:1 non-text vs `--color-base`; tooltip body 4.5:1 vs `--color-raised-2`. `--color-accent` (#C7556A) is ~3.8:1 non-text — clears the 3:1 dot threshold but is BELOW 4.5:1 for text, so any Stalled/ReceiverFailed text label uses `--color-text-primary`, not accent-colored text.
- **design ↔ a11y (motion, SC 2.3.3 AAA)**: design supplies the `motion-reduce:` token pattern; a11y verifies via Playwright `emulateMedia({reducedMotion:'reduce'})`.

- **layouts ↔ a11y (focus order, SC 2.4.3)**: layouts owns DOM placement near the app icon; a11y owns whether the dot is focusable + its tab position (must match visual left-of-Investigate placement).
- **layouts ↔ design (dot geometry)**: layouts owns region/placement within the titlebar flex; design owns the 6–8px size class + color + tooltip styling.

title: Phase 86 Plan — chunk route#89: "Header redesign: connection dot + chrome cleanup"

data.head: # Phase 86 Plan — chunk route#89: "Header redesign: connection dot + chrome cleanup"

body: _Generated by /andromeda-phase Phase 4. Read by /andromeda-implement. Manual edits between runs are fine; do not edit during /implement run._
- **Phase number:** 86

- **Route chunks covered:**
  - route#89 "Header redesign: connection dot + chrome cleanup" (FINAL chunk of the route)
- **Epoch:** Epoch 9 — Foundation v0.2.0

Replace the compact widget's dashboard-mindset footer band with an ambient connection-state signal. Two moves: (1) **remove** the `Ingest / Error / Retention` `FooterBand` entirely (it violates the P-024 Widget Ambient Surface invariant — a glance widget should not be a metrics dashboard); (2) **add** a small (6–8px) connection-state dot near the app icon in the titlebar, color-encoded per the chunk #59 connection FSM state, with a hover tooltip showing the current state + last-span-ago. The dot is the first webview consumer of connection-state: it polls the existing `connection.current_state()` TauRPC (per arch §Occupied Resources, chunk #59) — no new TauRPC procedure, broadcast topic, capability, env var, or crate (arch-registry delta: none; consumer-side only). This is purely webview work under `pulse-app/ui/`, satisfying capabilities P-001 (connection visual signal) + P-024 (chrome cleanup), per arch §Standard Contracts Real-time push + the design-system NASA palette + a11y not-color-alone (SC 1.4.1) / non-text contrast (SC 1.4.11) disciplines.
Mirror the `use-findings.ts` (chunk #87) + `use-widget-metrics.ts` (chunk #57) precedents:

- `createTauRPCProxy()`; poll `proxy.connection.current_state()` on mount, on a `window.setInterval(~1000ms)`, and on `window` `focus`. Each call wrapped in `.catch(() => {})` (jsdom / pre-init Tauri context → keep last/default state silently, no console noise).
- Return `ConnectionStatePayload | null` (null until the first successful poll; consumers treat null as a neutral "connecting…" default).
- Cleanup: clear the interval + remove the focus listener on unmount.
- Emit ZERO `tracing`/`console.*` per poll (cardinality discipline; the backend already logs connection-state transitions).
- Consume `useConnectionState()` internally (self-contained — no new Titlebar data prop).

- Render a `role="img"` element (NOT a `<button>` — the dot is a non-actionable ambient status indicator) carrying `aria-label="Connection: <state-label> — last span <ago>"` (always-present accessible name → satisfies SC 1.4.1 not-color-alone without relying on the visual tooltip).

- Visual: a round dot, size from spacing tokens (≈6–8px → `var(--spacing-sm)`-class), `borderRadius: var(--radius-full)`, `background` from the state→token map. The dot element does NOT carry `data-tauri-drag-region` (so hover works inside the drag-region header).

- Hover tooltip: `onMouseEnter`/`onMouseLeave` toggles an `aria-hidden` popover (`background: var(--color-raised-2)`, 1px `rgba(74,144,226,0.1)` border, `borderRadius: var(--radius-md)`, NO box-shadow). State label in `var(--font-body)`; the last-span-ago value in `var(--font-code)` with `fontVariantNumeric: "tabular-nums"`. Tooltip appears instantly (no fade) — trivially reduced-motion-safe; if a fade is added it MUST be ≤150ms `var(--easing-out)` with `motion-reduce:transition-none motion-reduce:duration-0`. `data-testid="connection-dot"` on the dot, `data-testid="connection-tooltip"` on the popover.

- Export pure helpers for direct unit testing:
  - `connectionStateLabel(state: ConnectionState): string` — "Listening" / "Receiving" / "Idle" / "Stalled" / "Receiver failed" (humanize the discriminator; append the sanitized `reason`/`message` for ReceiverFailed when present).
  - `connectionColorToken(state: ConnectionState): string` — exhaustive 5-way switch: `Listening | Receiving | Idle → "var(--color-primary)"`; `Stalled | ReceiverFailed → "var(--color-accent)"` (matches design extract verbatim).
  - `formatLastSpanAgo(ms: number): string` — "just now" / "<N>s ago" / "<N>m ago" (relative-time precedent from FindingsDropdown).
- Display ONLY the bounded state label + last-span-ago (+ the already-sanitized `message`/`reason`); NEVER interpolate raw OTLP attribute/span/service strings (security plan §Logging & Monitoring).

- `ConnectionDot.test.tsx`: mock `../hooks/use-connection-state` (per testing.md 2026-05-09 webview-API mock + per-test `mockReturnValue`); assert per-state color token + aria-label for all 5 states; aria-label includes the last-span-ago string; ReceiverFailed surfaces its reason; tooltip toggles on `mouseEnter`/`mouseLeave`; dot is non-focusable (`tabbable(container)` excludes it); helper unit tests (label/color/format) imported directly. DOM-shape assertions only (no visual diff).

- `use-connection-state.test.ts`: mock `createTauRPCProxy` (capture the `connection.current_state` callback); assert poll-on-mount, re-poll on `window` `focus`, rejected-proxy → null (jsdom-safe, no throw), interval cleared on unmount. Deterministic — no `sleep()`.

title: Phase 87 Plan — chunks route#90: "Halo formula refactor"

data.head: # Phase 87 Plan — chunks route#90: "Halo formula refactor"

body:
_Generated by /andromeda-phase Phase 4. Read by /andromeda-implement.
Manual edits between runs are fine; do not edit during /implement run._
- **Phase number:** 87

- **Route chunks covered:**
  - route#90 "Halo formula refactor"
- **Epoch:** Epoch 9 — Foundation v0.2.0 (terminal chunk)

Refactor the Halo State Pulse signature element so its visual encoding is driven by the v0.2.0 distillation pipeline's real signals instead of the legacy rule-based `(errorRate, throughputHz)` simulator. The Halo gains a **three-axis** model: (1) **hue + blur** ← cumulative incident attention (LCH-interpolated Earth Blue → Alert Burgundy via `lch.ts`); (2) **saturation/grayout** ← `connectionState` (P-004 orthogonal health axis); (3) **breathing pace** ← a new `activityState` (telemetry-flow tier). `HaloCanvas`'s prop surface changes from `(ariaLabel, throughputHz, errorRate)` to `(ariaLabel, connectionState, cumulativeSeverity, activityState)`; the legacy mapping helpers `error-rate-to-blur.ts` + `throughput-to-hz.ts` are deleted. Per design-system §Motion + §Color Palette (LCH + opacity/blur-only, NEVER scale — P-026), a11y-plan §6/§11 (reduced-motion static glow + SC 1.4.11 non-text contrast), obs-plan §5 (preserve the `record_frame_ms` SLO bridge), and security plan §API/§Logging (CSP unchanged, no new logging). Per **two user decisions at Phase 6 pre-planning** (Phase 3 research surfaced both): (Q1) `activityState` is built as a **real third axis** — there is no `ActivityState` type or source in the codebase today, so the plan introduces it webview-side, derived from the existing throughput signal, keeping arch §Occupied Resources delta = none; (Q2) breathing adopts the calmer **4–5 s quiet / ~2 s active** cadence, which **changes the locked design-system 0.8–2.4 Hz motion token** — a design-system specialist-plan edit (route §90 declared "Specialist plan touches: design-system") that is the one action exceeding pure consumer-side scope.

2. `.claude/rules/design-tokens.md` §Motion (the rule mirror) — update the matching "Halo State Pulse 0.8–2.4 Hz" line to the new cadence so the path-scoped rule stays consistent with design-system.md.

title: Step 2 — Define the new Halo input contract types

data.head: ### Step 2 — Define the new Halo input contract types

body: In `pulse-app/ui/src/halo/halo-types.ts`:

1. Replace `HaloInput { throughputHz, errorRate }` with `HaloInput { connectionState: ConnectionState; cumulativeSeverity: PriorityTier | null; activityState: ActivityState }` (import `ConnectionState` + `PriorityTier` from `../bindings/index`; use `IncidentSeverity` ONLY if Step 4's mapping is re-decided to severity — see Implementation notes OQ3).

2. Add the new `ActivityState` type: `export type ActivityState = "active" | "quiet" | "idle";` (telemetry-flow tier; webview-owned — no Rust/bindings counterpart needed for the webview-derived approach).
3. Keep `MotionMode = "animated" | "static_glow"`.

title: Step 3 — Add the activity derivation (the new third axis)

data.head: ### Step 3 — Add the activity derivation (the new third axis)

body: 1. New pure helper `pulse-app/ui/src/halo/activity-state.ts`: `throughputToActivityState(throughputHz: number): ActivityState` with documented thresholds (e.g., `>= ACTIVE_HZ → "active"`, `> 0 → "quiet"`, `~0/non-finite → "idle"`); define `ACTIVE_HZ` etc. as module consts. Pure + deterministic; co-located `activity-state.test.ts`.
2. Activity stays **independent of `connectionState`** (P-004 orthogonality): it derives from the flow rate (`use-widget-metrics().throughputHz`, already wired #57), NOT from the connection FSM.

title: Step 4 — Replace the legacy mappers with severity-driven mappers

data.head: ### Step 4 — Replace the legacy mappers with severity-driven mappers

body:
1. New pure module `pulse-app/ui/src/halo/severity-to-halo.ts` (replaces the two deleted helpers):
   - `severityToBlurPx(tier: PriorityTier | null): number` → None(null)→4, Curious→8, Suggested→12, Autonomous→16 (per project-doc §89 blur table; matches `use-findings.severityMax` PriorityTier vocabulary — see Implementation notes OQ3).
   - `severityToHueFraction(tier: PriorityTier | null): number` → 0..1 fraction for `lchInterpolate` (None/lowest→0 Earth Blue … highest→1 Alert Burgundy).
   - `activityStateToBreathingPeriodMs(state: ActivityState): number` → active→~2000 ms, quiet→~3500 ms, idle→~4500 ms (within the Step 1 cadence band); HaloCanvas converts period→`pulse_phase` rate.
   - `connectionStateToDim(state: ConnectionState): number` → saturation/opacity factor (Receiving/Listening/Idle→1.0 full; Stalled→~0.5 dimmed; ReceiverFailed→~0.25 most grayed). Separate axis from severity.
   - Co-located `severity-to-halo.test.ts`.
2. `pulse-app/ui/src/halo/lch.ts`: rename the `errorRate` parameter to a severity-derived `t` (keep the LCH `colorjs.io` logic + `clampUnit` intact); update `lch.test.ts` references.

title: Step 5 — Extend the WGSL shader for the connection + opacity axes

data.head: ### Step 5 — Extend the WGSL shader for the connection + opacity axes

body: In `pulse-app/ui/src/halo/shaders/halo.wgsl`:

1. Add `connection_dim: f32` and `opacity_target: f32` to `HaloUniforms` using the existing `_pad0`/`_pad1` slots — keep `UNIFORM_BUFFER_SIZE = 32` (atomic struct/JS-write change; per arch ↔ design binding in combined.md).

2. In `fs_main`: apply `connection_dim` as a saturation/dim multiplier on the resolved color (separate axis), and fold `opacity_target` into the final alpha alongside the existing blur-sweep alpha-falloff. **Keep breathing as blur + opacity modulation only — no scale** (P-026). No inline color literals (CSSOM-sourced colors per design-tokens.md 2026-05-08).

title: Step 6 — Rewire HaloCanvas to the new contract

data.head: ### Step 6 — Rewire HaloCanvas to the new contract

body: In `pulse-app/ui/src/halo/HaloCanvas.tsx`:

1. Change `HaloCanvasProps` to `{ ariaLabel, connectionState, cumulativeSeverity, activityState }`; replace `throughputHzRef`/`errorRateRef` with `connectionStateRef`/`cumulativeSeverityRef`/`activityStateRef` (preserve the prop-ref forwarding pattern).

2. In `writeUniforms`: `lchInterpolate(severityToHueFraction(cumulativeSeverityRef.current), primaryHex, accentHex)` for color; `severityToBlurPx(...)` for `blur_target`; write `connectionStateToDim(connectionStateRef.current)` → `connection_dim` and an opacity target → `opacity_target`.

3. In `onFrame`: derive the pulse rate from `activityStateToBreathingPeriodMs(activityStateRef.current)` (replace `throughputToHz`). **Preserve** the `recordFrameMs(...)` call after `onSubmittedWorkDone()` (obs SLO bridge) AND in `onReducedMotionFrame`.

4. **Preserve** the two-path loop (animated vs `onReducedMotionFrame`), the CSSOM `readDesignToken` reads, the `<section aria-label>` wrapper (implicit region — no explicit `role`), and the reduced-motion repaint effect (re-key it on the new props so hue still updates under reduced motion).

title: Step 7 — Wire real data into the single consumer

- `pulse-app/ui/src/canvas/frame-loop.ts` — reduced-motion two-path contract (reused unchanged).
- `pulse-app/ui/src/widget/AggregatedBadgeCanvas.tsx` — the single production `<HaloCanvas>` mount + rewire target.
- `pulse-app/ui/src/hooks/use-connection-state.ts` — `connectionState` source (#89).
- `pulse-app/ui/src/hooks/use-findings.ts` — `severityMax: PriorityTier | null` source (#87).
- `pulse-app/ui/src/hooks/use-widget-metrics.ts` — `throughputHz` source for the activity derivation (#57).
- `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/halo-input-context.tsx` + `pulse-app/ui/src/hooks/use-synthetic-halo-input.ts` — legacy synthetic path (retire/retype).
- `pulse-app/ui/src/bindings/index.ts` — `ConnectionState` / `IncidentSeverity` / `PriorityTier` / `IncidentRecord` (no `ActivityState`).

- **Decision Q1 (ActivityState, user-chosen "Extend"):** `activityState` is built as a real third axis. The plan sources it **webview-side** from the existing throughput signal (`use-widget-metrics().throughputHz`, #57) so it adds a first-class `ActivityState` type + derivation WITHOUT a new TauRPC procedure/broadcast — arch §Occupied Resources stays clean and `capability-drift` passes. **Upgrade path (documented, not in this chunk):** if `activityState` should be backend-authoritative (an aggregate of triage/baseline activity or service-lifecycle from #67), that needs a new TauRPC surface (or to ride an existing one like `services.list_with_states`) + an `/andromeda-evolve --allow-arch-registry` amendment FIRST — at which point route §90's "arch registry delta: none" line would need updating. Flag this trade-off at Phase 6; the webview-derived path is the shippable default.

- **Decision Q2 (breathing band, user-chosen "4–5 s / 2 s"):** Step 1 edits the locked design-system motion token. This is the single action beyond pure consumer-side scope. If you'd rather NOT change the locked token, the fallback is to keep 0.8–2.4 Hz and only re-map the rate driver — but the user explicitly chose the slower cadence, so Step 1 proceeds. Coordinate so code + design-system.md + design-tokens.md land in the same chunk commit (avoids D4 plan-to-plan drift).

- **OQ3 (severity signal, defaulted — not asked):** the plan uses `PriorityTier` (from the ready `use-findings.severityMax`) for the hue+blur axis because (a) the project-doc §89 blur table uses PriorityTier names (Autonomous/Suggested/Curious/None) and (b) it needs no extra derivation. If strict `IncidentSeverity` (info/warn/error/critical) is preferred (the prop is *named* `cumulativeSeverity`), derive `max(IncidentRecord.severity)` over active incidents instead and adjust the mapper + `halo-types.ts` type to `IncidentSeverity | null`. Cheap to swap; surfaced for Phase 6.

- **WGSL buffer:** the 2 spare pad floats (`_pad0`/`_pad1`) fit `connection_dim` + `opacity_target` with NO `UNIFORM_BUFFER_SIZE` change — preferred. Only resize (and bump the const + JS `Float32Array` together) if a 3rd new scalar is needed.

- **jsdom discipline:** keep `UNIFORM_BUFFER_USAGE` as an inlined numeric literal (testing.md 2026-05-09); use `as never` for overloaded DOM-method mocks (2026-05-14); `vi.useFakeTimers()` for any breathing-timing test (no `sleep`).

- **Reduced-motion repaint:** re-key the static-glow repaint effect on `[connectionState, cumulativeSeverity, activityState, reducedMotion]` so hue/grayout still update while motion stays suppressed (preserve the existing pattern, new deps).

data.head: # Codebase Research — phase-87: chunk route#90 "Halo formula refactor"

body: _Generated by /andromeda-phase Phase 3 from targeted reads informed by combined.md._

- **Research depth:** deep (mature webview surface; the Halo subsystem + its consumers + the two candidate data-source hooks were read in full to ground a prop-surface refactor that the route doc describes only abstractly).
- **Reads performed:** 16 (15 full files + 1 partial bindings.ts)
- **Globs / Greps:** 5 (HaloCanvas/HaloInput usage; ActivityState in crates/ + ui; bindings types; connection/findings hooks; `<HaloCanvas` mount sites)
- **Parallel batches:** 4

- `pulse-app/ui/src/halo/HaloCanvas.tsx` (full) — the Halo component. Props `{ ariaLabel, throughputHz, errorRate }` (line 34-38). Uses `throughputHzRef`/`errorRateRef` prop-ref forwarding (63-70); `useReducedMotion()` (61); `createFrameLoop({ onFrame, prefersReducedMotion, onReducedMotionFrame })` (160-188); `readDesignToken("--color-primary"/"--color-accent", ...)` via CSSOM (51-55, 107-108); `lchInterpolate(currentErrorRate, primaryHex, accentHex)` + `errorRateToBlur(currentErrorRate)` + `throughputToHz(throughputHzRef.current)` (124-164); `UNIFORM_BUFFER_SIZE = 32` (44); `recordFrameMs(...)` after `onSubmittedWorkDone()` (167-175) AND in `onReducedMotionFrame` (181-186); `<section aria-label={ariaLabel}>` wrapper (212). The reduced-motion repaint effect re-invokes `restartLoopRef` on `[throughputHz, errorRate, reducedMotion]` change (202-206).

- `pulse-app/ui/src/halo/halo-pipeline.ts` (full) — `createHaloPipeline(device, format)` GPU **pipeline factory** (not the frame loop); imports `./shaders/halo.wgsl?raw`; tagged-union `{kind:"created"|"failed"}`. The frame loop lives in `../canvas/frame-loop`, not here.
- `pulse-app/ui/src/halo/halo-types.ts` (full) — `HaloInput { throughputHz: number; errorRate: number }` + `MotionMode = "animated" | "static_glow"`. The type to replace.

- `pulse-app/ui/src/halo/lch.ts` (full) — `lchInterpolate(errorRate: number, primaryHex, accentHex): RgbaFloat`; clamps `errorRate` to `t ∈ [0,1]`; `colorjs.io` `.range(accent, {space:"lch"})(t)` → sRGB float quad. The `errorRate` param is really a 0..1 interpolation fraction — rename to severity-derived `t`.
- `pulse-app/ui/src/halo/error-rate-to-blur.ts` (full) — `errorRateToBlur(errorRate): number` → 4..16 px envelope. **DELETE** (+ `.test.ts`).
- `pulse-app/ui/src/halo/throughput-to-hz.ts` (full) — `throughputToHz(throughputHz): number` → clamp `throughputHz/1000` to **0.8..2.4 Hz**. **DELETE** (+ `.test.ts`).

- `pulse-app/ui/src/halo/shaders/halo.wgsl` (full) — `HaloUniforms { color: vec4<f32>, blur_target: f32, pulse_phase: f32, _pad0: f32, _pad1: f32 }` (24-30). Breathing = `pulse_envelope = 0.5 + 0.5*sin(pulse_phase)` → `current_blur = blur_target * pulse_envelope` → `smoothstep` alpha-falloff (55-63). **Already P-026-compliant**: breathing modulates blur (alpha-falloff radius), NO scale. **Has 2 spare pad floats** — `_pad0`/`_pad1` can host new uniforms (e.g., `connection_dim`, `opacity_target`) WITHOUT changing `UNIFORM_BUFFER_SIZE = 32`.

- `pulse-app/ui/src/canvas/frame-loop.ts` (full) — `createFrameLoop`: when `prefersReducedMotion`, calls `onReducedMotionFrame` once on `start()` and schedules no rAF. The reduced-motion contract is already here; the refactor reuses it unchanged.

- `pulse-app/ui/src/widget/AggregatedBadgeCanvas.tsx` (full) — **the single production `<HaloCanvas>` mount** (line 44-48); passes `throughputHz`/`errorRate` straight from its own props (33-37). Badge overlay rides above with `pointer-events:none`. This is the one consumer to rewire.

- `pulse-app/ui/src/widget/CompactWidget.tsx` (full) — renders `<AggregatedBadgeCanvas serviceCount throughputHz errorRate />` (75-79) from `metrics: WidgetMetrics`. Already calls `useFindings()` (39) for the FindingsCounter (`findings.severityMax`, `findings.count`). Does NOT currently call `useConnectionState()` (that lives in the Titlebar/ConnectionDot).

- `pulse-app/ui/src/hooks/use-widget-metrics.ts` (full) — `WidgetMetrics` from `streams.subscribe_metrics`; `throughputHz` = payload-count/sec proxy; `errorRate`/`serviceCount` = 0 pre-#81. The legacy Halo data source (via AggregatedBadgeCanvas).

- `pulse-app/ui/src/hooks/use-connection-state.ts` (full) — `useConnectionState(): ConnectionStatePayload | null`; polls `connection.current_state()` (1 s + on focus). **READY** data source for `connectionState`.

- `pulse-app/ui/src/hooks/use-findings.ts` (full) — `useFindings(): { rows, count, severityMax: PriorityTier | null, markAllRead, refetch, lastAnnouncement }`; `severityMax = maxPriorityTier(rows)` over active unread incidents (line 31, 83). **Exposes PriorityTier, NOT IncidentSeverity** — see OQ3.

- `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/halo-input-context.tsx` (full) — `HaloInputProvider`/`useHaloInput()` context; default `{ throughputHz: 0, errorRate: 0 }`. Legacy synthetic-input bridge; refactor target (retype or retire).

- `pulse-app/ui/src/hooks/use-synthetic-halo-input.ts` (full) — 250 ms sine-wave simulator producing `{ throughputHz, errorRate }`. Legacy synthetic data path; should be replaced by real severity/connection data (candidate deletion — verify App.tsx usage at implement time).

- `pulse-app/ui/src/bindings/index.ts` (partial: lines 17, 26, 68, 75-80, 205, 320) — `ConnectionState` (5 variants Listening/Receiving/Idle/Stalled/ReceiverFailed), `ConnectionStatePayload { state, last_span_ago_ms, severity, message, reason }`, `IncidentRecord { … severity: IncidentSeverity; priority_tier: PriorityTier; … }`, `IncidentSeverity = "info"|"warn"|"error"|"critical"` (with the documented rename-from-`Severity` comment at 75-80). **No `ActivityState` type** anywhere in bindings.

- **Prop-ref forwarding for long-lived rAF loop** (`HaloCanvas.tsx:63-70`): props mirrored into refs so `createFrameLoop`'s `onFrame` reads fresh data without pipeline teardown. New props follow the same `xxxRef` shape.

- **Two-path frame loop** (`canvas/frame-loop.ts:19-26` + `HaloCanvas.tsx:160-206`): animated rAF vs `onReducedMotionFrame` single-paint; reduced-motion repaint effect re-invokes the loop on data change so hue updates while motion stays suppressed. Reuse unchanged for the new inputs.

- **CSSOM design-token → WGSL uniform** (`HaloCanvas.tsx:51-55,107-108,124-138`): hex read via `getComputedStyle` at pipeline init, passed to `lchInterpolate`, written into the uniform buffer; no color literals in the shader (enforced by design-tokens.md 2026-05-08).

- **32-byte uniform with spare capacity** (`halo.wgsl:24-30` + `HaloCanvas.tsx:41-44,128-137`): `color(16) + blur_target(4) + pulse_phase(4) + 2×pad(8) = 32`. New scalar uniforms (connection-dim, opacity-target) fit the 2 pad slots with no buffer resize.

- **PULL-only real-data hooks** (`use-connection-state.ts`, `use-findings.ts`): both poll their TauRPC procedure on mount + window focus, `.catch(()=>{})` for jsdom; no Channel subscriber yet. The Halo's new inputs read from these (no new IPC).
- **Single Halo mount + composition-over-extension** (`AggregatedBadgeCanvas.tsx`): the badge overlays HaloCanvas as a sibling; only the canvas's prop contract changes.

- **`IncidentSeverity` import, never bare `Severity`** — bindings.ts:75-80 documents the rename; bare `Severity` is the connection-domain enum (`info/warning/critical`). (session-learnings 2026-05-26)

- **Inline WebGPU spec constants as numeric literals** — `UNIFORM_BUFFER_USAGE = 0x40 | 0x08` (HaloCanvas.tsx:49) sidesteps jsdom's missing `GPUBufferUsage`. Any new buffer-flag use follows this. (testing.md 2026-05-09)
- **`<section aria-label>` implicit region** — never add explicit `role="region"` (eslint `no-redundant-roles`). (a11y.md 2026-05-09)
- **Co-located vitest, `as never` for overloaded DOM-method mocks, `vi.useFakeTimers()` not `sleep`** — per testing.md 2026-05-10/05-14.
- **jsdom WebGPU-constant fragility** — prefer module-level numeric literals over `vi.stubGlobal("GPUBufferUsage", …)`. (testing.md 2026-05-09)
- **Halo continuous animation exempt from chrome duration tokens** — do not apply `--duration-fast/standard`. (design-tokens.md §Motion)

- `pulse-app/ui/src/halo/severity-to-halo.ts` (working name) — pure mapper(s) replacing the deleted helpers: cumulative-attention signal (PriorityTier or IncidentSeverity per OQ3) → `{ blurTargetPx, hueFraction }`; connection state → `grayout/saturation` factor; activity/connection → breathing-rate (within OQ2's chosen band). Co-located `severity-to-halo.test.ts`. (Exact split of functions decided in plan per OQ answers.)
- `pulse-app/ui/src/halo/halo-types.ts` — replace `HaloInput { throughputHz, errorRate }` with the new prop surface (per OQ1 outcome); import bindings types.

- `pulse-app/ui/src/halo/HaloCanvas.tsx` — swap props + refs; replace `lchInterpolate(errorRate,…)`/`errorRateToBlur`/`throughputToHz` call sites with the new mapper(s); add connection-grayout + opacity uniform writes (using the 2 spare pad floats); preserve `recordFrameMs` + the two-path loop + CSSOM token reads + `<section aria-label>`.
- `pulse-app/ui/src/halo/lch.ts` — rename the `errorRate` parameter to a severity-derived `t` (keep LCH logic); update `lch.test.ts`.

- `pulse-app/ui/src/halo/shaders/halo.wgsl` — add `connection_dim` (+ optional `opacity_target`) to `HaloUniforms` via the `_pad0`/`_pad1` slots; apply saturation/opacity modulation in `fs_main`; keep blur-driven breathing (no scale).

- `pulse-app/ui/src/widget/AggregatedBadgeCanvas.tsx` — source `connectionState` (`useConnectionState`) + cumulative severity (`useFindings().severityMax` or derived IncidentSeverity per OQ3) + (activity per OQ1) and pass new props to `<HaloCanvas>`; drop `throughputHz`/`errorRate` pass-through to the Halo (badge overlay may keep its own metrics).

- `pulse-app/ui/src/halo/HaloCanvas.test.tsx` — update all `<HaloCanvas …>` renders (currently `throughputHz=… errorRate=…`) to the new prop surface; add severity/connection/reduced-motion assertions.
- **Deletions:** `pulse-app/ui/src/halo/error-rate-to-blur.ts` + `.test.ts`; `pulse-app/ui/src/halo/throughput-to-hz.ts` + `.test.ts`.

- **Verify-then-retire (implement-time):** `pulse-app/ui/src/hooks/use-synthetic-halo-input.ts` + `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/halo-input-context.tsx` — legacy synthetic-input path; confirm App.tsx/Dashboard usage and either retype to the new surface or delete. (Not in the chunk's named file list; flagged for plan.)

- `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/routes/traces/ConstellationCanvas.tsx` — the dashboard per-service Halo dots; updating it to the new HaloCanvas API is **chunk #91 "ConstellationCanvas dashboard cascade"** (route §2, the next chunk), NOT chunk #90. Touch only if implement reveals a hard compile dependency.
- `pulse-app/capabilities/*.json`, `pulse-app/tauri.conf.json` — no capability/CSP change (zero arch delta).

- **OQ1 (scope — `activityState`): the chunk's third prop has no backing type or data source.** `ActivityState` exists nowhere (grep `crates/` + `pulse-app/ui/src` both empty). `connectionState` (use-connection-state #89) and a cumulative-incident signal (use-findings #87) ARE available; `activityState` is not. Per CLAUDE.md HYBRID-RENDER learning (2026-05-26), this is the canonical "capability assumed but not yet implemented" fork → surfaced to the user (see AskUserQuestion). Options: (a) hybrid 2-axis (connection + severity; drop/derive activity) — zero arch delta, reuses #87/#89; (b) extend scope to add an ActivityState type + source (risks breaching "zero arch delta"); (c) defer the chunk.

- **OQ2 (breathing cadence band):** design-system.md §Motion (locked token) = **0.8–2.4 Hz**; project-doc §89 summary = **4–5 s quiet / 2 s active** (≈0.2–0.5 Hz). Incompatible; `/andromeda-phase` cannot edit design-system.md. → surfaced to the user. Default: honor the locked 0.8–2.4 Hz token; alternative requires a `/andromeda-design` (or manual) token change first.

- **OQ3 (severity vs priority-tier + blur table):** prop is named `cumulativeSeverity: Severity`, but project-doc §89's blur table uses PriorityTier names (Autonomous=16/Suggested=12/Curious=8/None=4) and the ready `use-findings` hook exposes `severityMax: PriorityTier | null`. `IncidentRecord` has both `severity` + `priority_tier`. **Defaulted** (not asked): reuse the ready `PriorityTier` signal (matches the blur table + zero extra derivation); map None→4 px / Curious→8 / Suggested→12 / Autonomous→16 with corresponding LCH hue fraction; design-system owns final values. Documented in plan; adjustable at Phase 6.
1. Read ≥1 "Files to modify" file? ✓ (all of HaloCanvas.tsx, halo-types.ts, lch.ts, halo.wgsl, AggregatedBadgeCanvas.tsx).
2. Patterns cited to file:line? ✓.
3. New-file paths consistent with structure? ✓ (`pulse-app/ui/src/halo/`).
4. "Files to modify" all exist? ✓ (every path verified by Read or Grep this phase).

Consumer-side of `services.list_with_states` + `pulse://stream/service-lifecycle` (both chunk #67). Capability P-027; distillation layer L5.
**Constraints across domains:**

- (arch) Code lives under `pulse-app/ui/` (webview source root); the constellation is a webview component, not a new library crate; 14 reserved crate names unchanged (per arch §Inherited Defaults / §Occupied Resources).

- (arch) MUST consume the EXISTING `services.list_with_states` TauRPC (`ServicesApiImpl` → `ServiceListPayload` from `triage::lifecycle::InMemoryServiceRegistry::list`; chunk #67) — no new TauRPC procedure (per arch §Occupied Resources Tauri IPC routes, Registry Update 2026-05-18).

- (arch) MUST subscribe to the EXISTING `pulse://stream/service-lifecycle` broadcast (chunk #67) — no new broadcast topic (per arch §Occupied Resources Tauri IPC events, Registry Update 2026-05-18). [Research note: no webview Channel subscriber procedure exists for this topic — see research.md.]

- (arch) Webview runs under `pulse:default` (negative-default); no new procedure → existing capability JSON sufficient → `xtask capability-drift` MUST stay clean, zero `pulse-app/capabilities/` edit + zero `EXPECTED_PROCEDURES` change (per arch §Cross-cutting Webview IPC capability policy + §Critical Warnings).

- (arch) Visualization surface is webview WebGPU (`<canvas>` + `navigator.gpu`, WGSL) — same substrate the chunk #90 Halo settled; no native `wgpu` overlay (per arch §Established Decisions [WebGPU Visualization Surface]).

- (arch) Zero arch-registry delta confirmed (no new env var/crate/table/procedure/topic) → NO `/andromeda-evolve --allow-arch-registry` required (per arch §Occupied Resources; chunk "Arch registry delta: none").

- (design) Per-service dot HUE MUST use LCH Earth Blue (#4A90E2) → Alert Burgundy (#C7556A) interpolation driven by per-service incident SEVERITY — same axis as the chunk #90 Halo, NOT error-rate (per design-system §Motion item 1 + Decisions Log 2026-05-29 (a)/(b)).

- (design) Per-service dot BRIGHTNESS encodes recent activity, derived from an activity STATE tier, consistent with the breathing-cadence model "driven by an activity state rather than raw throughput" (per design-system §Motion item 1 + Decisions Log 2026-05-29 (a)).

- (design) ALL color values MUST be `@theme` tokens (`--color-primary`, `--color-accent`, `--color-inset` #0F1117 canvas bg); no hardcoded hex / magic numbers (per design-system §Self-Validation §4 Token Test + §Anti-Patterns Universal Bans).
- (design) Canvas container background MUST be `--color-inset` #0F1117 (per design-system §Surface desktop-webview §Canvas Container + §Color Palette Inset row).

- (design) Any dot twinkle/activity/breathing motion MUST degrade under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` to static glow (hue/brightness retained, rhythm removed); modulation opacity + blur ONLY, never scale (P-026; per design-system §Motion §Accessibility + item 1).

- (design) Tooltip is an elevated surface → `--color-raised-2` #2D3139 bg + 1px subtle border, no shadow (borders-only depth); IBM Plex Sans for name/state label + JetBrains Mono tabular-nums for the numeric activity-rate (per design-system §Depth Strategy + §Color Palette Raised-2 + §Typography).

- (design) Lifecycle/severity visual encoding MUST NOT rely on hue alone — pair brightness/dimming + tooltip text label (not-color-alone; per design-system §Anti-Patterns Universal Bans + Rejected Defaults).

- (layouts) Renders in the compact-widget hero/signature canvas region (`position: relative; width/height: 100%` filling the viewport between titlebar and the chunk-#89-removed footer); per-service dots replace the prior single aggregated badge occupant (per layout-templates.md §Component — Halo State Pulse canvas Layout + §Wireframe — Compact widget + §Signature placement).

- (layouts) Migrates the compact widget from the "unified single halo around an aggregated badge" model to the distributed per-service-dot model (the same model the full-dashboard Traces constellation uses) (per layout-templates.md §Signature placement strategy).

- (layouts) Compact widget is fixed quarter-screen with NO CSS media-query breakpoints — the up-to-~20-dot scatter must fit the fixed canvas region without breakpoint reflow; glance-readable from peripheral vision (per layout-templates.md §Responsive breakpoints Compact widget + §IA notes Navigation model).

- (a11y) WebGPU `<canvas>` is opaque to screen readers — provide equivalent semantics via a named wrapper (`<section aria-label="…">` taking implicit `role="region"`); preserve an off-canvas accessible text summary of count + per-service activity/severity/lifecycle (per a11y-plan §1 WebGPU-canvas row + §7 Landmark roles).

- (a11y) Not-color-alone (SC 1.4.1): severity hue + activity brightness MUST NOT be sole carriers — off-canvas text / tooltip conveys severity + activity + lifecycle in words (per a11y-plan §6 + §11 Visual ban 1); axe-core does not detect this → custom DOM-inspect assertion required.

- (a11y) Reduced-motion (SC 2.3.3 AAA + SC 2.3.1 A): any dot animation degrades static under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`; use `useReducedMotion` from `motion/react` 12.x in the frame loop (per a11y-plan §6 + §11 Motion bans + CLAUDE.md Critical Warning).

- (a11y) Contrast (SC 1.4.3 / 1.4.11): dot colors are graphical objects on `--color-inset` bg → severity hue endpoints meet ≥3:1 non-text contrast; tooltip text 4.5:1; shader colors read from CSSOM design tokens, not hardcoded RGB (per a11y-plan §6 + design-tokens.md 2026-05-08).

- (a11y) Hover tooltip MUST NOT be hover-only without keyboard-reachable equivalent (SC 1.4.13 / frontend.md ban); off-canvas summary satisfies the equivalent-information requirement if dots are not individually focusable (per a11y-plan §6 + frontend.md).

- (a11y) Status messages (SC 4.1.3): if lifecycle-state changes are announced, use `aria-live="polite"` (non-urgent, does not steal focus); avoid stacking ~20 simultaneous announcements (per a11y-plan §7 Live regions + P4).

- (tests) Co-locate `*.test.tsx`/`*.test.ts` adjacent to source under `pulse-app/ui/src/`; new `ConstellationCanvas.tsx` (widget) gets a colocated test; replaced `AggregatedBadgeCanvas.test.tsx` deleted/rewritten in lockstep (no orphaned import) (per test-plan §4 + §2).

- (tests) Every test exits with a deterministic signal; NO visual diff / canvas pixel inspection / human review — assert IPC contract + DOM shape + pure-function output (per test-plan §11 Universal + §2).

- (tests) Seeded-scatter `position = f(hash(service_name))` is a deterministic pure function — test directly: same input → identical coords across calls AND across "sessions"; distinct names → distinct positions (per test-plan §2 Unit + §4).
- (tests) Component render tests MUST mock the TauRPC proxy (no live backend); stub `services.list_with_states` returning canned `ServiceListPayload` (per test-plan §8 + §11 Mocking).

- (tests) Coverage gate for new non-presentational pure functions ≥75% line / ≥70% branch / ≥85% function (Standard tier); presentational canvas wrapper excluded per webview carve-out (per test-plan §10 + §4).

- (obs) If the constellation runs an animated frame loop, bridge per-frame timing via `telemetry.frontend.record_frame_ms` → backend `metric.webgpu.frame_duration_ms`; SLO p99 ≤33ms / 30 fps. If static-render (no loop), no frame emission required (per obs-plan §10 Performance budgets + §5).

- (obs) Service names rendered as labels/tooltip MUST NEVER be written into any `tracing` field (Vector 1 raw-OTLP-attribute ban); consumer-side emits no logs, but any added diagnostic must exclude `service_name` (per obs-plan §11 Logs + §1).

- (obs) No new metric target may carry an unbounded per-service label; any per-service self-observation event (should be NONE — consumer-side) must be aggregate-only, not per-`service_name` (per observability rule 2026-05-17 tighter triage/per-service convention; obs-plan §5).

- (security) Service names + tooltip text derive from OTLP resource attributes / incident records (user-controlled, may carry incidental secrets); any NEW consumer log line MUST NOT log raw service name / activity rate / tooltip payload (per security plan §Logging & Monitoring).
- (security) Introduces NO new TauRPC procedure + NO `pulse-app/capabilities/` entry; negative-default gate already satisfied + MUST NOT be widened (per security plan §API Security).

- (security) Errors from `services.list_with_states` surface only via the existing `AppError` enum (no raw error chain / path / struct name rendered) (per security plan §Error Handling TauRPC bridge).

- (security) PII scrubbing for service-name text is satisfied at the producing/persistence boundary already (chunk #72 uniform coverage); consumer-only chunk inherits scrubbed data, adds no new scrub site (no new TauRPC text-egress resolver) (per security plan §Anti-Patterns §Logging uniform-scrubber framing).
**Patterns to follow:**

- (arch) Consumer-side reuse of an already-acknowledged TauRPC + broadcast pair — initial state via `services.list_with_states`, deltas from `pulse://stream/service-lifecycle`, mirroring the initial-query-plus-live-stream pattern (per arch §Standard Contracts Real-time push + §Occupied Resources services namespace).

- (arch) Module dependency direction preserved trivially — a webview component consuming TauRPC bindings adds no Cargo dep edge; `triage` stays free of reverse deps; DAG rooted at `pulse-app` (per arch §Cross-cutting Module dependency direction).

- (arch) Consume the generated TauRPC `.ts` bindings (`ServiceListPayload` + 7 `ServiceLifecycleState` variants) — do not re-declare payload shape manually (per arch §Conventions Workspace API style).
- (design) WebGPU-canvas-outside-React: render dots to canvas via WGSL, not inside React's render tree (per design-system §Surface Performance notes + §Depth Strategy).

- (design) Halo State Pulse is the SOLE exemption from the no-gradient/no-canvas chrome bans — radial gradient + blur (4–16 px) permitted for the signature dots only (per design-system §Depth Strategy + §Motion Hard-limits + §Anti-Patterns gradient exception).
- (design) WebGPU-unavailable → `<canvas>` fallback "WebGPU not supported in this browser" message (per design-system §Surface §Canvas Container).
- (design) Empty/loading state: centered Tertiary-color text + optional telescope icon if no services yet — reuse existing empty-state pattern (per design-system §Surface §Loading/Empty States).

- (design) Severity↔activity dual-dimension encoding precedent: chunk #90 Halo already drives hue from severity + breathing from activity-state; per-service dots reuse the SAME two-dimension model at per-dot granularity (per design-system §Brand Identity Signature element + Decisions Log 2026-05-29).

- (layouts) Canvas render-loop pattern: 60 FPS via `requestAnimationFrame`, iterate per-service one dot+halo per service — established pattern for the constellation canvas (per layout-templates.md §Component — Halo State Pulse canvas Canvas rendering).

- (layouts) Reduced-motion degradation: dot becomes a static glow (no rhythm) but hue still updates per severity (per layout-templates.md §Component — Halo State Pulse canvas Reduced motion; aligns with chunk #90).

- (layouts) Hover-to-detail-display: existing surface convention uses hover for in-place affordances; dot hover tooltip follows the hover-reveals-detail convention (per layout-templates.md §Component patterns).

- (a11y) Canonical canvas wrapper `<section aria-label="…"><canvas /></section>` — NOT explicit `role="region"` (redundant per `no-redundant-roles`); complete-sentence aria-label summarizing the constellation (per a11y.md Session Additions 2026-05-09).
- (a11y) Decorative-glyph flip: any inline icon carrying only context gets `aria-hidden="true"`, meaning carried by accessible name (per existing `AggregatedBadgeCanvas.tsx` + a11y-plan §11 ARIA).

- (a11y) Reduced-motion hook `useReducedMotion` (non-reactive after mount per testing.md 2026-05-04 — capture once) feeds the frame loop; Tailwind `motion-reduce:` variants on CSS transitions (per a11y-plan §3.5 + frontend.md).
- (a11y) WebGPU fallback message wrapped in accessible region so SR-readable (per a11y.md §WebGPU canvas a11y + frontend.md).

- (tests) Constellation canvas render-test shape: `vi.mock` the webgpu-adapter returning `unavailable`, assert `<section aria-label>` wrapper + `data-service-count` + empty-array-no-crash — the existing dashboard `ConstellationCanvas.test.tsx` precedent (per test-plan §6).
- (tests) Pure-function table tests via `it.each([...])` for brightness/hue/filter mappings + non-finite/edge inputs returning a placeholder — mirror `widget-types.test.ts` (per test-plan §4 + §7).
- (tests) Channel/TauRPC mock: `vi.mock("../bindings/index", …)` returning canned payloads; the proxy auto-wraps callbacks into Channels (testing.md 2026-05-16) (per test-plan §8).

- (obs) Frame-duration bridge: reuse `canvas/frame-metrics.ts::recordFrameMs` + `canvas/frame-loop.ts` (HaloCanvas wiring) if animated — do not introduce a parallel telemetry path (per obs-plan §3 Frontend bridge; chunk #29 substrate).

- (security) Reuse-the-shipped-IPC-surface: consume existing `services.list_with_states` rather than adding a namespace, sidestepping the TauRPC capability-binding cost (per security plan §API Security; security.md 2026-05-09).
**Anti-patterns to avoid:**
- (design) NEVER encode service state with HUE ALONE — Archived/Dormant/severity need brightness + tooltip text pairing (per design-system §Anti-Patterns Universal Bans; binds a11y SC 1.4.1).

- (design) NEVER drive dot hue/brightness from raw `throughput_hz` or rule-based `error_rate` — those are SUPERSEDED chunk #31 inputs; severity + activity-state are the current drivers (per design-system Decisions Log 2026-05-29).

- (design) NEVER use scale-based pulsing / bounce-spring easing / opacity fades >200ms on chrome; Halo breathing is opacity+blur only, non-scale (per design-system §Motion Hard limits + item 1 P-026).

- (design) NEVER hardcode hex / pixel scatter constants outside the token system — seeded scatter is a deterministic layout but COLORS come from `@theme` tokens (per design-system §Self-Validation §4).

- (layouts) Do NOT reintroduce / rely on the footer band as the activity/error readout — route#89 REMOVED the compact-widget footer band; layout-templates.md §Wireframe + §Footer are STALE on this point (predate chunk #89). Per-service activity must be encoded on the dots, not in a removed footer.

- (layouts) Do NOT break the canvas-fills-viewport region invariant — constellation occupies the same hero canvas region the aggregated badge occupied; do not push into titlebar drag region (per layout-templates.md §Wireframe).

- (layouts) Do NOT add a new navigation/deep-link affordance on the compact widget — it has "no deep links (glance-only)"; dots are glance/hover affordances, clicking a dot must not route to a dashboard view (per layout-templates.md §IA notes).
- (a11y) NEVER convey dot state by color/brightness alone — must have text/word equivalent (off-canvas summary or tooltip); axe-core will not catch this (per a11y-plan §11 Visual ban 1; SC 1.4.1).
- (a11y) NEVER autoplay dot motion without `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` respect (per a11y-plan §11 Motion bans + CLAUDE.md Critical Warning; SC 2.3.3 AAA).

- (a11y) NEVER hide the constellation's essential meaning from assistive tech — canvas pixels are opaque to SR, so omitting the off-canvas summary leaves SR users with no state (per a11y-plan §11 Screen Reader ban).
- (tests) NEVER use a real/unseeded random source for scatter without seed control — determinism is the testable contract (per test-plan §11 Test Data).
- (tests) NEVER assert via canvas pixel inspection / screenshot comparison — assert mapping pure-function output + DOM-attribute contract (per test-plan §11 E2E + Universal).
- (tests) NEVER leave the deleted `AggregatedBadgeCanvas` referenced by a stale test/mock — dangling import fails at collection time (per test-plan §11 CI; testing.md 2026-05-10).
- (obs) NEVER write `service_name` (or any rendered telemetry-derived attribute) into a `tracing` field (per obs-plan §11 Logs + §1 Vector 1).
- (obs) NEVER emit per-frame `tracing` at info level in the render hot path / format expensive payloads without level-gating (per obs-plan §11 Logs + Metrics).
- (security) NEVER log raw OTLP attribute values / service-name text / tooltip payloads in any new consumer log line (per security plan §Anti-Patterns §Logging bullet 1).
- (security) NEVER widen `pulse:default` or add an unmatched capabilities entry for this consumer-only chunk (per security plan §Anti-Patterns §API bullet 3).
**Contract bindings:**
- **design ↔ a11y (contrast)**: design supplies LCH endpoints + Text Hierarchy ratios; a11y owns SC 1.4.3 / 1.4.11 derivation for the new dot/tooltip pairs. RECIPROCATED (both extracts).
- **design ↔ a11y (motion / SC 2.3.3)**: design specifies static-glow degradation; a11y validates `prefers-reduced-motion` enforcement. RECIPROCATED.
- **design ↔ a11y (not-color-alone / SC 1.4.1)**: design provides pairing intent; a11y validates the discipline. RECIPROCATED.
- **design ↔ layouts**: design owns tokens/motion/encoding; layouts owns widget geometry/placement/scatter. RECIPROCATED.

- **layouts ↔ a11y (focus order + tooltip dismiss)**: layouts defines dot tab-order position (if focusable) + tooltip placement; a11y owns ARIA roles + keyboard trigger + Escape-dismiss semantics. RECIPROCATED.
- **layouts ↔ design (severity color axis)**: dot hue spans the Earth Blue → Alert Burgundy axis settled by chunk #90; layouts owns scatter, design owns hue token values. RECIPROCATED.

- **obs ↔ design/a11y (reduced-motion + WebGPU frame SLO)**: obs owns the p99 ≤33ms SLO + `record_frame_ms` emission; design/a11y own static degradation. Consistent (reduced-motion suspends loop → frame emission naturally ceases). RECIPROCATED.
- **obs ↔ tests (frame-budget CI gate)**: obs defines the gate; tests own running the perf harness. Engages only if the canvas animates. RECIPROCATED.

- **tests ↔ a11y (DOM-shape ↔ WCAG)**: tests own DOM-shape assertion (aria-label / `role` / `data-*`); a11y owns WCAG conformance (SC 4.1.3 / 1.4.1). RECIPROCATED — coordinate on canonical aria-label sentence shape at /implement.
- **tests ↔ design (mapping functions)**: tests unit-test brightness/hue mapping monotonicity/boundaries; design owns LCH endpoints + token values. RECIPROCATED.
- **security ↔ obs (service-name redaction)**: security owns "redact this field"; obs owns the self-observation log schema (no raw service name). RECIPROCATED.
- **arch ↔ tests (capability-drift clean)**: arch fixes no-new-procedure; tests verify `xtask capability-drift` + unchanged bindings.ts services namespace. RECIPROCATED.
**Acceptance criteria contributions:**

- (arch) Constellation consumes EXISTING `services.list_with_states` + `pulse://stream/service-lifecycle` only; `cargo xtask capability-drift` clean with zero `EXPECTED_PROCEDURES` / capabilities JSON changes.
- (arch) No new entry in arch §Occupied Resources; `git diff .andromeda/architecture.md` shows no registry addition; no `/andromeda-evolve --allow-arch-registry` run.

- (design) Per-service dot colors use only `@theme` tokens (`--color-primary` ↔ `--color-accent` LCH severity interpolation, `--color-inset` canvas bg); no hardcoded hex / magic-number colors.

- (design) Dot hue driven by per-service incident SEVERITY (not error-rate); brightness by activity STATE (not raw throughput), matching the chunk #90 model. [Research note: per-service severity not in shipped contract — see research.md Open Question.]
- (design) Any dot activity/twinkle animation degrades to static glow under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` and uses opacity+blur only (never scale).

- (design) Lifecycle/severity conveyed by brightness/dimming + tooltip text label, not hue alone; tooltip uses Raised-2 #2D3139 bg + 1px border (no shadow) + IBM Plex Sans label + JetBrains Mono tabular-nums rate.

- (layouts) Per-service dots render in the compact-widget hero canvas region (where the aggregated badge sat), filling the `<canvas>` container; verified by visual inspection / DOM shape showing per-service dots, not a single badge.

- (layouts) Up to ~20 dots legible at fixed quarter-screen size with no overlap-to-illegibility, positioned by `hash(service_name)`-seeded scatter stable across sessions (same service → same position on relaunch).
- (layouts) Dormant dots dimmed; Archived dots absent (hidden), preserving glance-readability; verified by seeding Dormant/Archived states.
- (layouts) WebGPU-unavailable fallback message + `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` static-glow preserved; verified by forcing both conditions (no crash, hue still encodes severity).
- (a11y) `npm run test --prefix pulse-app/ui` passes for the new component; axe-core (`npm run test:a11y`) reports zero critical/serious violations on the compact-widget surface.

- (a11y) Off-canvas accessible name present: wrapper exposes complete-sentence summary of count + per-service activity/severity/lifecycle reachable by SR; verified via `getByRole("region"/"status", { name: … })`.
- (a11y) Not-color-alone: severity + activity + lifecycle conveyed in text, not hue/brightness alone — custom DOM-inspect assertion (SC 1.4.1).
- (a11y) Reduced-motion: under `emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: 'reduce' })`, dot animation degrades static (severity hue + brightness still convey state); Playwright + Lighthouse audit (SC 2.3.3 AAA).
- (a11y) Contrast: dot endpoints meet ≥3:1 non-text contrast vs `--color-inset`; tooltip text 4.5:1 — colorjs.io token-pair assertion (SC 1.4.3 / 1.4.11).

- (tests) `npm run test --prefix pulse-app/ui` passes incl. new `ConstellationCanvas.test.tsx` + rewritten/removed `AggregatedBadgeCanvas.test.tsx`; full webview vitest baseline (623 ✓) preserved or grows, zero orphaned-import failures.

- (tests) Mapping + filter pure-function tests cover brightness=activity, hue=severity, dormant-dimmed, archived-hidden, AND non-finite/empty/edge inputs returning a defined placeholder (`it.each`).
- (tests) Rust side baseline unchanged: `cargo nextest run --workspace --profile ci` (1544 ✓ + 1 skip) + `cargo xtask capability-drift` clean.

- (obs) If animated, per-frame timing bridged via `telemetry.frontend.record_frame_ms` → `metric.webgpu.frame_duration_ms` (bounded labels), p99 ≤33ms; if static-render, criterion N/A — note "static render, no frame emission" in plan.
- (obs) No `service_name` (or other rendered OTLP-derived attribute) in any `tracing` field — grep `agent-latest.jsonl` for a seeded service-name canary after rendering (negative-canary guard).
- (obs) Reduced-motion path: loop suspended (dots static) + frame-duration emission ceases — verified by absence of new `metric.webgpu.frame_duration_ms` under the reduced-motion fixture.
- (security) No new consumer log statement emits raw service names / activity rates / tooltip text — grep new `.tsx`/`.rs` diff for log lines referencing service-name/attribute fields returns none.
