title: Phase 88 Plan — chunk route#91: "Service constellation rendering"

data.head: # Phase 88 Plan — chunk route#91: "Service constellation rendering"

body: _Generated by /andromeda-phase Phase 4. Read by /andromeda-implement. Manual edits between runs are fine; do not edit during /implement run._
- **Phase number:** 88

- **Route chunks covered:**
  - route#91 "Service constellation rendering" (Epoch 9 — Foundation v0.2.0; terminal chunk; capability P-027; L5)
- **Epoch:** Epoch 9 — Foundation v0.2.0

Replace the compact-widget aggregated service badge (`AggregatedBadgeCanvas.tsx`) with a per-service constellation: one dot per service from the service registry, positioned by a stable `hash(service_name)` seeded scatter, with **brightness = activity** (lifecycle-state tier) and **hue = true per-service incident severity**, Dormant dimmed / Archived hidden, and a hover/focus tooltip (name + lifecycle state + activity). Per the **user-confirmed scope decision (2026-05-29, Phase 3 AskUserQuestion ×2): one big chunk, full faithful path** — including the backend plumbing required to make per-service severity real. Codebase research (research.md) established that the shipped `ServiceListItem` carries no severity and the `Incident` model has no `scope_id` (only the `AttentionCue` does, and it is dropped at incident creation), so this chunk first adds service attribution to incidents + a per-service severity join, then renders.

The work spans three crates and is intentionally ~2× a normal chunk: (A) backend — add `Incident.scope_id` (service attribution) with serde-default corpus-BLOB backward-compat, thread it from the originating cue through the incident-construction path; (B) resolver — inject the incident registry into `services.list_with_states` and compute per-service max-severity, surfaced as a new `severity` field on `ServiceListItem`; (C) webview — a new `ConstellationCanvas` consuming the extended payload via a PULL-poll hook, rendering with the post-#90 severity/activity model (`severity-to-halo.ts`) + seeded scatter. Per arch §Established Decisions [WebGPU Visualization Surface] + §Cross-cutting Module dependency direction (resolver join at the binary boundary, `triage` stays Tauri-free), design-system §Motion Decisions Log 2026-05-29 (severity hue / activity breathing), a11y-plan §1/§6/§11 (canvas a11y + not-color-alone + reduced-motion), and the chunk #86 `resolution_summary_text` serde-default persistence precedent. No new TauRPC procedure, broadcast topic, crate, env var, or corpus column — `services.list_with_states` gains a payload field only; `xtask capability-drift` stays clean.

title: Step 1 — Inspection (locate the cue→incident creation path)

data.head: ### Step 1 — Inspection (locate the cue→incident creation path)

body: - Grep for the production incident-construction site (`Incident {` outside `#[cfg(test)]`; candidates: the L4 interpretation path in `pulse-app/src/inference_runtime.rs` + `crates/triage/src/incident/registry.rs` register/upsert). Confirm where a cue's `scope_id` is (or is not) available at construction.

- Trace whether `scope_id` survives the cue→digest→L4→incident pipeline: `DigestCueRef` (contract.rs:418) carries only `{kind, priority_tier, summary}` — it DROPS `scope_id`. So if incidents are created downstream of the digest, the attribution source for `Incident.scope_id` must be decided (options surfaced for /implement: thread `scope_id` onto `DigestCueRef`; OR attribute from the digest's dominant `DigestServiceRow.service`; OR carry the cue's `scope_id` directly to the incident constructor if it is upstream of the digest). Pick the path that keeps the attribution faithful (cue's own `scope_id`) and record the decision in the commit body.

title: Step 2 — Add `scope_id` to the `Incident` contract (backend, crates/triage)

data.head: ### Step 2 — Add `scope_id` to the `Incident` contract (backend, crates/triage)

body: - Add `pub scope_id: Option<String>` to `Incident` (`crates/triage/src/contract.rs:317-371`), documented like the sibling fields (service identifier when `scope == CueScope::Service`; `None` otherwise; bounded by OTLP cardinality discipline at the producer). Annotate `#[serde(default)]` so pre-existing corpus BLOB rows deserialize (mirrors the chunk #86 `resolution_summary_text` backward-compat pattern + the 2026-05-20 bincode-prefix safety lesson).
- Update every `Incident { … }` literal (test helpers at `persistence.rs:224`, `registry.rs:350`, and any production constructor found in Step 1) to populate `scope_id`.

- At the production incident-construction site (Step 1), populate `Incident.scope_id` from the originating cue's `scope_id` (the `AttentionCue.scope_id` at `contract.rs:278`). If the digest pipeline drops it (DigestCueRef), apply the Step 1 attribution decision.

- Confirm corpus round-trip: `crates/corpus/src/contract.rs` `IncidentRow.payload` is the bincode BLOB source-of-truth for non-column fields — `scope_id` lives in the BLOB; **no SQL column + no PRAGMA user_version migration needed**. Verify a write→read round-trip preserves `scope_id` (extend `incident/persistence.rs` tests).

title: Step 4 — Per-service severity join in the resolver (backend, pulse-app)

data.head: ### Step 4 — Per-service severity join in the resolver (backend, pulse-app)

body: - Add `pub severity: Option<Severity>` (and/or `pub priority_tier: Option<PriorityTier>`) to `ServiceListItem` (`crates/triage/src/lifecycle/registry.rs:53`); `#[serde(default)]` for any persisted-state compat. Keep `triage` Tauri-free (the field is plain data).

- Inject `Arc<dyn IncidentRegistry>` (trait at `incident/registry.rs:64`; `list_active(workspace) -> Vec<Incident>`) + the current `workspace_root` into `ServicesApiImpl` (`pulse-app/src/services_router.rs`), mirroring `IncidentsApiImpl`'s `workspace_root` field. In `list_with_states`, after `registry.list_all()`, fetch `incident_registry.list_active(&workspace_root)`, filter `scope == CueScope::Service`, group by `scope_id`, take the max `severity`/`priority_tier` per service, and populate each `ServiceListItem.severity`. Services with no active service-scoped incident → `None` (calm baseline hue).
- Keep the resolver's observability event aggregate-only (item_count); NEVER add per-`service_name` fields (observability rule 2026-05-17).

title: Step 5 — Boot wiring + bindings regen (backend, pulse-app)

data.head: ### Step 5 — Boot wiring + bindings regen (backend, pulse-app)

body: - Update the `ServicesApiImpl::new(...)` construction in `pulse-app/src/main.rs` for the new dependency (incident registry + workspace_root) — the same `Arc<dyn IncidentRegistry>` already wired for `IncidentsApiImpl`.
- Update the `emit_taurpc_bindings` test's `ServicesApiImpl::new(...)` call (`pulse-app/src/main.rs::tests`) for the new signature (the 4th-binding discipline, CLAUDE.md 2026-05-12).

- Regenerate `pulse-app/ui/src/bindings/index.ts` (the `ServiceListItem` TS type gains `severity`) via the mcp-server-feature `emit_taurpc_bindings` path; pre-commit verify `grep -c '"mcp":'` ≥1 (CLAUDE.md 2026-05-17). `capability-drift` stays clean (no new procedure).

- New `pulse-app/ui/src/hooks/use-service-constellation.ts` — mirror `use-connection-state.ts`: poll `services.list_with_states()` on mount + 1s interval + `window.focus`, `.catch(() => {})` jsdom-silent, return `ServiceListItem[]`. (No Channel subscriber exists for `pulse://stream/service-lifecycle`; PULL-poll is the established posture; public shape stays stable so a future push subscriber can be added without API churn.)

- New `pulse-app/ui/src/widget/constellation-types.ts` — pure functions (the unit-test core):
  - `scatterPosition(serviceName): {x, y}` — deterministic `hash(service_name)` → stable normalized `[-1,1]` coordinates (cross-session consistent; no `Math.random`).
  - `lifecycleToBrightness(state): number` — active brightest → quiet → silent → dormant dim (the "brightness = activity" axis from the 7-state lifecycle).
  - `lifecycleToActivityLabel(state): string` — human label for the tooltip + accessible summary.
  - `severityToHueFraction` reuse from `halo/severity-to-halo.ts` (map `ServiceListItem.severity` → `PriorityTier`-equivalent fraction; bridge the `Severity` "info|warning|critical" enum to the hue fraction).
  - `visibleServices(items): ConstellationDot[]` — filter Archived (hidden); flag Dormant (dimmed); cap ~20.
  - `constellationSummary(items): string` — off-canvas complete-sentence accessible summary (count + per-state breakdown + any critical-severity service).
- New `pulse-app/ui/src/widget/constellation-types.test.ts` — `it.each` tables incl. non-finite/empty/edge + cross-session determinism.

- New `pulse-app/ui/src/widget/ConstellationCanvas.tsx` — adapt the dashboard `ConstellationCanvas.tsx` per-service draw-loop STRUCTURE (section wrapper + `Fallback` + `frame-metrics` bridge + `useReducedMotion`) but with the **new** severity/activity model (`severity-to-halo.ts`), NOT the legacy `errorRate`/`throughputHz` helpers. Per-dot uniform writes: hue=`lchInterpolate(severityToHueFraction(serviceSeverity))`, blur/brightness from severity + lifecycle activity, breathing period from activity, position from `scatterPosition`. True scatter requires writing a per-dot center-offset + scale into the uniform + adjusting `halo.wgsl` (or a lightweight dot pipeline) — see Implementation notes.

body: _Generated by /andromeda-phase Phase 3 from targeted reads informed by combined.md._

- **Globs / Greps:** 6.
- **Parallel batches:** 4.

- `pulse-app/ui/src/widget/AggregatedBadgeCanvas.tsx` (full) — **the replace target**. Current shape: composes one `HaloCanvas` (unified aggregated halo, new-API props) + a `role="status"` badge overlay showing `formatServiceCount` + "services" decoration. Props: `{ serviceCount, errorRate, connectionState, cumulativeSeverity: PriorityTier|null, activityState }`. Already on the post-#90 HaloCanvas API.

- `pulse-app/ui/src/widget/AggregatedBadgeCanvas.test.tsx` (full) — 7 tests (HaloCanvas-axis forwarding, role=status aria-label, aria-hidden decoration, tabular-nums digits, absolute positioning, NaN placeholder). Must be deleted/rewritten in lockstep with the component replacement (no orphaned `vi.mock("../halo/HaloCanvas")` import).

- `pulse-app/ui/src/widget/CompactWidget.tsx` (full) — **the mount point**. Renders `<AggregatedBadgeCanvas serviceCount={metrics.serviceCount} errorRate={metrics.errorRate} connectionState={connection?.state ?? DEFAULT} cumulativeSeverity={findings.severityMax} activityState={throughputToActivityState(metrics.throughputHz)} />` inside the hero `<div style={{ flex:1, padding: spacing-md }}>`. Already consumes `useConnectionState()` + `useFindings()`. The findings band + live region + Report sit below.

- `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/routes/traces/ConstellationCanvas.tsx` (full) — **the per-service-constellation precedent**. Per-service draw loop (one `device.queue.writeBuffer` + `draw(6)` per service; `loadOp: i===0 ? "clear" : "load"`), `<section aria-label="Service constellation" data-service-count={N}>` wrapper, `Fallback`, `frame-metrics` bridge, `useReducedMotion`. **Uses the LEGACY model** — `lchInterpolate(service.errorRate, …)` + `errorRateToBlur` + `throughputToHz`. NOTE: `ServiceAggregate.position` is computed but **NOT written into the uniform** — every dot draws the same centered full-quad halo; visual scatter is not yet implemented even in the dashboard precedent.

- `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/routes/traces/use-constellation-data.ts` (full) — `ServiceAggregate { serviceName, throughputHz, errorRate, position }` + `aggregateByService(rows, windowSeconds)` + `radialPosition(index, total)` (evenly-spaced around unit circle, NOT seeded by name). Derives per-service throughput/error from `TraceRow[]`, not from the service registry.

- `pulse-app/ui/src/hooks/use-connection-state.ts` (full) — **the PULL-poll pattern to mirror**. 1s `setInterval` + `window.focus` poll of `connection.current_state()`; `.catch(() => {})` jsdom-silent; docstring states `pulse://stream/connection-state` "is emit-only with no webview Channel subscriber wired yet, so a future chunk can add push-driven invalidation without changing this hook's public shape."

- `pulse-app/ui/src/hooks/use-findings.ts` (full) — PULL-only `incidents.list_active()` on mount + `window.focus`; same emit-only-broadcast posture. Derives `severityMax` (cumulative `PriorityTier`) via `maxPriorityTier(selectUnreadRows(records))`.

- `pulse-app/ui/src/halo/severity-to-halo.ts` (full) — **the new-API mappers to reuse**: `severityToHueFraction(PriorityTier|null)` (None=0 → Curious=.33 → Suggested=.67 → Autonomous=1), `severityToBlurPx` (4/8/12/16), `activityStateToBreathingPeriodMs` (active=2000 / quiet=3500 / idle=4500), `connectionStateToDim`. The header comment explicitly says these "replace the legacy error-rate-to-blur / throughput-to-hz helpers."
- `pulse-app/ui/src/halo/activity-state.ts` (full) — `throughputToActivityState(hz): "active"|"quiet"|"idle"` (≥5 Hz active; >0 quiet; else idle).

- `pulse-app/ui/src/halo/HaloCanvas.tsx` (full) — **the new-API canvas reference**. 32-byte uniform `[color.rgba(16), blurTarget(4), pulsePhase(4), connectionDim(4), pad(4)]`; `lchInterpolate(severityToHueFraction(severity), primaryHex, accentHex)`; refs hold latest props so the rAF loop reads fresh data; reduced-motion suppresses the loop + a secondary effect re-invokes one static render on prop change via `restartLoopRef`.
- `pulse-app/ui/src/halo/halo-types.ts` (full) — `ActivityState = "active"|"quiet"|"idle"`; `HaloInput {throughputHz, errorRate}` (legacy, chunk-#90-pending-retype debt).
- `pulse-app/ui/src/canvas/Fallback.tsx` (full) — `role="alert" aria-live="assertive"` "WebGPU not supported in this browser" message; reuse for the constellation fallback.

- `pulse-app/ui/src/widget/widget-types.ts` (full) — **the pure-function-formatter precedent**: `formatServiceCount`, `formatBadgeAriaLabel`, `formatSpansPerSec`, `PLACEHOLDER = "—"` for non-finite. `WidgetMetrics` interface (serviceCount/throughputHz/errorRate/retention…).

- `pulse-app/ui/src/bindings/index.ts` (grep + lines 250–313) — **the decisive data contract** (see Open questions):
  - `ServiceLifecycleState = "unknown"|"bootstrapping"|"active"|"quiet"|"silent"|"dormant"|"archived"` (7 states).
  - `ServiceListItem = { service: string; state: ServiceLifecycleState; last_seen_unix_nano: number; manual_override: ServiceLifecycleState|null }` — **no severity, no activity rate**.
  - `ServiceListPayload = { items: ServiceListItem[]; total; next_cursor }`; `services.list_with_states: () => Promise<ServiceListPayload>`.
  - `IncidentRecord = { id; workspace; kind; scope: "service"|"operation"|"global"; status; severity; priority_tier; title; detail; … }` — has `scope` + `workspace` but **no `service` name field** to join incidents → per-service severity.
  - `ARGS_MAP.streams = subscribe_logs / subscribe_metrics / subscribe_spans` only — **no `subscribe_service_lifecycle`** Channel procedure.

- **New-API severity/activity canvas model** (`halo/HaloCanvas.tsx` + `halo/severity-to-halo.ts`): hue=`lchInterpolate(severityToHueFraction(tier))`, blur=`severityToBlurPx(tier)`, breathing=`activityStateToBreathingPeriodMs(state)`, dim=`connectionStateToDim`. This is the model chunk #91 MUST use (NOT the dashboard ConstellationCanvas's legacy `errorRate`/`throughputHz`).

- **Per-service canvas draw loop** (`dashboard/.../ConstellationCanvas.tsx:117-159`): iterate services, per-call uniform write + `draw(6)`, first service `clear` then `load`. Reusable structure; the widget version swaps the legacy mappers for the new severity/activity ones and adds true positional scatter.

- **PULL-poll hook for emit-only broadcasts** (`use-connection-state.ts` + `use-findings.ts`): mount + 1s interval + `window.focus` poll, `.catch(() => {})` jsdom-silent, public shape stable so a future Channel subscriber can be added without API churn. This is the established posture for `pulse://stream/service-lifecycle` (which has no Channel subscriber).

- **Pure-function formatter + `"—"` placeholder for non-finite** (`widget-types.ts`): the testable-pure-function convention; new constellation pure fns (seeded scatter, lifecycle→brightness, filter, accessible summary) follow this.

- **Accessible canvas wrapper** (`dashboard ConstellationCanvas` + `HaloCanvas`): `<section aria-label="…">` (implicit `role="region"`, no explicit role), `Fallback` on WebGPU-unavailable, `data-service-count` attribute for DOM-shape tests.

- **Inline WebGPU spec constants** (`UNIFORM_BUFFER_USAGE = 0x40 | 0x08`) — jsdom doesn't expose `GPUBufferUsage` (testing.md 2026-05-09).

- **jsdom-silent proxy calls** (`.catch(() => {})`), neutral default while loading (CompactWidget's `DEFAULT_CONNECTION_STATE`).
- **TauRPC proxy auto-wraps callbacks into Channels** (testing.md 2026-05-16) — but irrelevant here; this chunk uses the `list_with_states()` Promise, not a Channel.
- **`data-testid` query disambiguation** if a second `role="status"` region coexists (testing.md 2026-05-19) — CompactWidget already has a `findings-live-region` `role="status"`.

body: _Generated by /andromeda-phase Phase 3 from targeted reads informed by combined.md._

- **Research depth:** deep (mature codebase; the chunk wires an L4→incident producer that touches the inference subscriber, two cross-crate enum mappings, the incident registry/persistence traits, the digest assembler, and the boot graph). 8 files read (1 full central file + targeted reads), 4 greps, 4 parallel batches.

- **Reads performed:** 8 (inference_runtime.rs full; schema.rs 96–190; contract.rs 150–538; registry.rs full; persistence.rs full; incident/broadcast.rs full; assembler.rs targeted; main.rs boot-wiring grep).
- **Globs / Greps:** 4.

- `pulse-app/src/inference_runtime.rs` (full) — **the deferral site.** Lines 9–16 document the deferred L4Output→Incident persistence. `spawn_l4_inference_subscriber` (102–163) ALREADY receives `Arc<dyn IncidentRegistry>` + `Arc<dyn IncidentPersistence>`. The Success arm (127–147) currently acts ONLY on `DigestKind::ResolutionSummary` (calling `attach_resolution_summary_to_incident`); for every other digest kind the parsed `L4Output` is **discarded** — that discard is where chunk #92 hooks in. `attach_resolution_summary_to_incident` (487–523) is the exact scrub→persist→error-handle template to mirror (serde_json::to_string → `scrub_attribute` → `ScrubbedValue::Redacted` → `[redacted: {category}]` → persist → `err.error_category()` on failure). Existing observability targets `interpretation.*` (41–77) + metric `metric.pipeline.l4.inferences_total` with bounded `result` label (53–55).

- `crates/interpretation/src/schema.rs` (96–190) — `L4Output` (150–165) fields: `decision: Decision` {Surface, Dismiss, Watch}; `severity: Severity` {Autonomous, Suggested, Curious, None}; `title`, `symptom`, `timeline`, `hypotheses`, `investigation_steps`, `evidence_refs: Vec<String>`, `fingerprint`, `model_tier`, `hardware_profile`, `is_resolution_summary: bool`. `validate()` + `parse_bounded()` already enforce bounded shapes. **There are TWO enums** (the rot-scan item): `Decision` AND `Severity` — the arch extract conflated them.

title: Open questions (for Phase 6 / user — surfaced per CLAUDE.md 2026-05-30 data-producer discipline)

data.head: ## Open questions (for Phase 6 / user — surfaced per CLAUDE.md 2026-05-30 data-producer discipline)

body: 1. **[CENTRAL] Activation completeness / cue-scope_id sourcing.** The chunk's headline ("activates chunk-#91 per-service severity") requires the produced incident to carry the real service `scope_id`, but `DigestCueRef` drops it (folded into free-text `summary`). Three resolutions: **(A) Extend scope** — thread `scope`+`scope_id` structurally through `DigestCueRef` + populate in the chunk #81 assembler so the constellation hue lights up at runtime (small additive triage change; the route text "persist **with cue scope_id**" implies this is in-scope); **(B) Forward-inert** — build the full producer but leave `scope_id = None` → incidents become real (Findings counter / dropdown / report all populate) but constellation per-service hues stay baseline until a later threading chunk; **(C) Defer** chunk #92 behind a prerequisite scope_id-threading chunk. **Recommendation: A** (faithful + the threading cost is small because the scope_id is already in hand at the assembler).

2. **Creation predicate.** Which `(decision, severity)` combinations create an incident? Recommended default: `Decision::Surface` → Active incident; `Decision::Watch` → a `Curious`-tier incident (recorded, low-interrupt per `PriorityTier::Curious` semantics); `Decision::Dismiss` OR `severity == None` → no incident; `is_resolution_summary == true` → existing resolution-summary path (unchanged).

3. **Severity enum mapping.** `interpretation::Severity` → `triage`: `priority_tier` maps 1:1 (Autonomous→Autonomous, Suggested→Suggested, Curious→Curious); `severity` maps Autonomous→`Error`, Suggested→`Warn`, Curious→`Info` (`Critical` reserved for future escalation). Confirm or adjust.
4. **Dedup.** Recommended: re-emission dedup on `(kind, scope, workspace)` via `observe_reemission` to avoid incident spam (vs always-create).

5. **Creation broadcast.** Recommended: do NOT emit `IncidentLifecycleEvent` on creation (its shape is transition-oriented, its webview consumer is deferred, and activation works via `registry.insert` which the join reads directly) — keeps boot wiring unchanged + avoids a boot-smoke gate. Revisit when the `pulse://stream/incidents` live UI consumer lands.

data.head: ### Chunk route#12: "Contrast verification harness — design tokens + colorjs.io + per-pair JSON emission against design plan §Color Palette ratios"

body: **Domain relevance summary:**
- (security) partially-relevant — supply-chain pinning + path-traversal class defense + secret-scanning hygiene
- (design) directly relevant — owns the canonical token values, target ratios per pair, and pairing-discipline catalog

- (arch) partially-relevant — workspace-boundary discipline + agent-driven output + directory placement under `pulse-app/ui/`
**Constraints across domains:**

- (security) New npm dep `colorjs.io` MUST be pinned to a specific minimum version (NOT `"latest"` / `"*"`), matching Rust crate convention `tonic = "0.14"` (per security plan §Dependency Security Pinning + §API Security row 1).
- (security) `package-lock.json` MUST be committed alongside `package.json` — same posture as `Cargo.lock` (per security plan §Dependency Security Pinning).

- (security) Harness MUST NOT introduce path-traversal vectors; paths MUST be statically known (relative to repo root or `pulse-app/ui/`), not env-var-derived without validation (per security plan §Security Anti-Patterns § Input bullet 4 — CWE-22 generalized).

- (security) Harness output MUST NOT log/embed any §Logging "What NEVER to log" set; chunk #12 is naturally clear because input is first-party design tokens (per security plan §Logging & Monitoring NEVER-log list, applied prospectively).

- (security) If wired into `ci.yml` at chunk #13's gate, every third-party Action MUST be 40-char SHA-pinned — NEVER `@v2` / `@latest` (per security plan §Security Anti-Patterns § Secrets, tj-actions/changed-files CVE-2025-30066 anchor).

- (security) Harness output paths MUST NOT shadow existing `.gitignore` secret-file globs (`*.p12` / `*.pem` / `*.cer` / `.env*` / `*.key` / `~/.tauri/*.key`) (per security plan §Secret Management + §Security Anti-Patterns § Secrets bullet 1).

- (design) Harness MUST read input from canonical Tailwind v4 `@theme` block defined in design-system.md §Surface: desktop-webview Tokens — the 13 enumerated `--color-*` custom properties verbatim (per design-system.md §Surface: desktop-webview Tokens).

- (design) Hex values declared in design-system.md are single source of truth; drift between `tokens.css` and spec table is a harness FAIL — `#1A1D24` / `#262A33` / `#2D3139` / `#343A45` / `#0F1117` / `#4A90E2` / `#2C3E7F` / `#8B2E3B` / `#E8EEF7` / `#B4BCCB` / `#7D8697` / `#56606E` / `#17B3A3` (per design-system.md §Color Palette Core Colors / Surface Scale / Text Hierarchy / Semantic Colors + §Anti-Patterns Universal Bans).

- (design) Contrast targets per §Text Hierarchy on Base (#1A1D24): Primary (#E8EEF7) ≈ 8.5:1, Secondary (#B4BCCB) ≈ 6.8:1, Tertiary (#7D8697) ≈ 4.2:1 large text only, Muted (#56606E) ≈ 2.1:1 decorative only (per design-system.md §Color Palette Text Hierarchy table).

- (design) Semantic-state pairs MUST also be enumerated per §Color Palette Semantic Colors: Success border/text #17B3A3 on bg #0F1117; Warning text #E8EEF7 on bg #1A1D24 with border #8B2E3B; Error text #8B2E3B on bg #1A1D24; Info text #4A90E2 on bg #1A1D24 (per design-system.md §Color Palette Semantic Colors).

- (design) Focus-ring pair (#4A90E2 on adjacent surface colors) MUST be perceivable — verify Primary (#4A90E2) on each Surface scale level (Base / Raised-1 / Raised-2 / Raised-3 / Inset) (per design-system.md §Border Progression "Focus" + §Self-Validation Protocol §6 Contrast Test).

- (tests) Harness MUST exit with deterministic agent-parseable signal — exit code 0 = all pairs ≥ target ratio; non-zero = at least one pair below; structured JSON written to a stable path regardless of pass/fail (per test-plan §1 agent-driven-discipline trigger).

- (tests) If wired into CI, harness MUST run under per-process isolation alongside `cargo nextest` + `vitest` without cross-test interference (per test-plan §3 5-command discipline).

- (tests) Vitest at `pulse-app/ui/` is established (chunk #11 — 57 tests passing); pure-function helper logic in harness (e.g., a token-CSS parser) MAY land in `pulse-app/ui/src/**/*.test.ts` and run under existing Vitest (per test-plan §4).

- (a11y) Harness MUST validate the **6 token-pair contrast assertions enumerated verbatim** in plan: `--color-text-primary / --color-base` ≥ 4.5:1 (SC 1.4.3 AA), `--color-text-secondary / --color-base` ≥ 3:1 (SC 1.4.3 large text), `--color-text-tertiary / --color-base` ≥ 3:1 (SC 1.4.3 large text only), `--color-primary / --color-base` ≥ 3:1 non-text (SC 1.4.11), `--color-feedback-success / --color-inset` ≥ 4.5:1 text or 3:1 non-text (SC 1.4.3 / SC 1.4.11), `--color-accent / --color-base` ≥ 4.5:1 text or 3:1 non-text (SC 1.4.3 / SC 1.4.11) (per a11y-plan §3 Contrast verification harness + §6 Color contrast pairs table).

- (arch) The 10 reserved Cargo workspace crate names are LOCKED; the harness MUST NOT introduce a new Cargo crate (per arch §Occupied Resources + §Established Decisions [Module Boundaries]).

- (arch) Webview frontend tooling lives under `pulse-app/ui/`; harness `package.json` scripts and source files MUST live within `pulse-app/ui/` (not `crates/` / `xtask/` / new top-level dir) (per arch §Infrastructure Patterns Project directory structure).

- (security) NEVER read tokens.css or any harness-input file path from an env var without canonicalization + confinement (per security plan §Security Anti-Patterns § Input bullet 4 — CWE-22).
- (security) NEVER write the harness output JSON to a path that escapes the repository or the configured `pulse-app/ui/dist/` build directory — same CWE-22 (per security plan §Code Patterns).

- (design) Do NOT introduce new hex values inside the harness for "expected" comparison — harness reads `tokens.css` and compares to the spec table values; coding additional hexes creates a third source of truth and violates §Token Test (per design-system.md §Self-Validation Protocol §4 + §Anti-Patterns Universal Bans).

- (design) Do NOT validate Halo State Pulse colors (Earth Blue ↔ Alert Burgundy LCH interpolation) as a contrast pair — Halo is a WebGPU canvas signature element exempt from chrome contrast accounting (per design-system.md §Brand Identity Halo State Pulse + §Anti-Patterns).

- (design) Do NOT treat Muted (#56606E) as a text-on-base contrast failure — it is "decorative only" per spec, ratio ≈ 2.1:1 is intentional; mark as informational rather than violation (per design-system.md §Color Palette Text Hierarchy Muted row).
- (tests) NEVER hand-write an "expected ratios" JSON fixture committed as source of truth — pre-baked-snapshot anti-pattern (per test-plan §11 Test Data).
- (tests) NEVER include a "developer reads JSON output and decides if ratios are acceptable" step — pass/fail per pair MUST be a boolean computed by the harness (per test-plan §11 Universal).

- (tests) NEVER add retry-once or "ratios sometimes pass on Linux but fail on macOS" tolerance — colorjs.io operating on identical hex/LCH values must yield byte-identical ratios cross-platform (per test-plan §10 Zero-flakiness budget).
- (a11y) NEVER use partial axe-core or partial WCAG configuration without explicit a11y Decisions Log entry — undermines agent-driven invariant (per a11y-plan §11 Strategy).

- (a11y) NEVER claim contrast conformance from manual pre-flight values alone — colorjs.io machine-verifiable JSON output must be the primary gate; the chunk #11 14.46/7.20/5.12 numbers are supplemental reference points (per a11y-plan §11 Strategy).
- (a11y) NEVER allow a foreground/background pair below WCAG minimum to ship — colorjs.io harness gate enforces per token pair, no overrides (per a11y-plan §11 Visual).

- (a11y) NEVER invent new token names in JSON output / harness scaffolding — the 7 token names listed in plan §6 are the verbatim catalog; widening requires a design-plan amendment first (per a11y-plan §6 source-of-truth note).

- (arch) DO NOT add the harness as a new Cargo crate (e.g., `crates/contrast-check/`) — violates §Established Decisions [Module Boundaries] and §Occupied Resources reserved-crate-names rule (per arch §Occupied Resources).

- (arch) DO NOT introduce a new `ANDROMEDA_PULSE_*` env var to configure the harness — the env-var namespace is reserved for the Tauri runtime; build-time tooling configures via `package.json` scripts / sidecar config (per arch §Occupied Resources).

- (arch) DO NOT bind the contrast harness output to a Tauri IPC procedure or runtime surface — chunk is build-time tooling; JSON output is a CI gate artifact, not a runtime introspection surface (per arch §Cross-cutting Patterns Webview IPC capability policy).

- (arch) DO NOT reach into Rust source files (`crates/*/src/`, `pulse-app/src/`) for token values — design tokens are owned by the webview surface; canonical token-source is `pulse-app/ui/dist/tokens.css` (per arch §Design Philosophy).
**Contract bindings (cross-domain reconciliation):**

- **design ↔ a11y (token catalog ↔ WCAG derivation):** design owns target ratios + pair enumeration (which color × which surface); a11y owns formal WCAG pass/fail derivation + policy on deviations. JSON emitted by chunk #12 is the artifact a11y consumes downstream. Reciprocates: design.md flags "design ↔ a11y" + a11y.md flags "a11y ↔ design (§Color Palette ratios)". (per design-system.md §Downstream Readiness + a11y-plan §3 Contrast verification harness "Source-of-truth tokens".)

- **design ↔ tests (executable lint):** §Color Palette Text Hierarchy table values are tests-lint targets — chunk #12 harness becomes the executable form of that lint, replacing per-component manual assertions. test plan owns CI invocation; design owns spec input. Reciprocates: design.md flags + tests.md flags. (per design-system.md §Downstream Readiness + test-plan §1.)

- **a11y ↔ obs (Structured Violation JSON schema):** harness JSON output uses the obs-plan-defined structured-log schema with a11y extensions (`token_name`, `measured_value`, `required_value`); both surfaces share a stable schema. obs.md acknowledges a11y owns the schema; a11y.md flags binding explicitly. Reciprocal acknowledgement (obs in deferral mode). (per a11y-plan §3 Structured violation JSON schema + obs-plan §6 cited via a11y-plan binding.)

- **a11y ↔ tests (5-command discipline / harness execution):** chunk #12 harness must be invocable both standalone (Node script) AND via Playwright `page.evaluate()` so chunk #13 can choose either path; chunk #13's a11y CI gate when wired reuses tests' boot/run/status/cleanup/logs 5-command harness. tests-domain owns exit code semantics + JSON schema stability; a11y-domain owns per-pair target ratios + WCAG SC mapping. Reciprocates: tests.md flags + a11y.md flags. (per a11y-plan §3 CI Integration + test-plan §3 5-command discipline.)

- **a11y ↔ arch (motion deferral):** out-of-scope for chunk #12 (chunk #15 motion tokens library install owns reduced-motion harness); flagged for plan.md in case orchestrator wants to bundle a reduced-motion contrast pre-check (a11y-plan §3 contrast harness mentions "If motion-sensitive trigger escalates to SC 2.3.3 AAA, verify reduced-motion override does not break contrast" — but chunks #13/14/15 territory).

- **security ↔ tests (CI gate hygiene):** if chunk #12 wires harness as CI step (or sets up scaffold for chunk #13), harden-runner SHA-pinning + workflow-level `permissions: contents: read` posture applies. tests-domain owns harness execution wiring; security-domain owns pinning + permissions discipline. Unilateral binding (security flags; tests doesn't reciprocate explicitly — by convention CI wiring is in tests' surface) — orchestrator notes for plan.md. (per security plan §Bootstrap phases `dep-security-ci-gate`.)

- **security ↔ a11y (JSON wire contract):** chunk #12's JSON output format is the wire contract chunk #13's a11y CI gate consumes. Security flags only the supply-chain + path-canonicalization slice; format / WCAG criterion mapping / per-pair semantics belong to a11y. (Unilateral; not contradictory.)

- **security ↔ obs (no PII concern at chunk #12):** harness output is first-party design tokens, NOT runtime telemetry; binding becomes load-bearing only if a future chunk wires harness to read runtime user content. Obs concurs (out-of-domain at chunk #12). (Reciprocal in absence-of-concern mode.)

- **arch ↔ a11y (machine-parseable output):** arch §Cross-cutting Patterns Development Style "machine-parseable outputs" binds to a11y's CI-gate-ingestion; JSON shape MUST be stable enough that a11y CI gates ingest without re-parsing tokens.css. arch declares placement; a11y defines required pair list and threshold semantics. (Reciprocates with a11y's "JSON artifact suffix-consistent with the planned a11y log family" pattern.)

- **arch ↔ design (token placement):** arch §Design Philosophy "Concrete tokens are owned by the design specialist" binds to design plan §Color Palette ratios. arch defines WHERE tokens live (`pulse-app/ui/dist/tokens.css`); design defines WHAT values + WHAT ratios should pass. (Reciprocates.)

- **arch ↔ tests (parallel sibling gate):** build-time gates (lint / typecheck / contrast) live alongside Vitest + cargo nextest as parallel CI quality gates — they do NOT couple to the test harness 5-command discipline (boot/run/status/cleanup/logs); chunk #12's harness is a static check, not a runtime test. Binding is "parallel sibling gate," not "5-command participant." (Reciprocates with tests' ↔ obs note that binding is absent for this chunk group.)
**Acceptance criteria contributions:**

- (security) `pulse-app/ui/package.json` pins `colorjs.io` to a specific minimum version and `package-lock.json` is committed to the repo (verified by reading both files; lockfile MUST exist with `colorjs.io` resolved version recorded).

- (security) Harness script(s) use only statically-known relative paths (or explicitly-validated paths) for input (`pulse-app/ui/dist/tokens.css`) and output (under `pulse-app/ui/dist/` or equivalent); `grep` for `process.env`-derived path construction inside the harness returns zero results, OR every match is followed by a `path.resolve` + `startsWith` boundary check.

- (security) `.gitignore` continues to cover `*.p12`, `*.pem`, `*.cer`, `.env*`, `*.key`, `~/.tauri/*.key` after chunk #12 lands; harness output paths do NOT shadow these rules with a broader allow (verified by `git check-ignore` on a representative secret filename inside `pulse-app/ui/`).

- (security) If chunk #12 adds a CI workflow step or modifies an existing workflow, every third-party Action reference uses 40-char commit SHA pinning; no `@v2` / `@latest` / floating tags introduced.

- (design) The harness reads the 13 `--color-*` tokens from `pulse-app/ui/dist/tokens.css` (chunk #10 output) and matches each hex byte-exact to the §Color Palette / §Surface Scale / §Text Hierarchy / §Semantic Colors / §Border Progression Focus tables (no hardcoded hexes inside the harness itself).

- (design) JSON output schema enumerates at minimum: each Text Hierarchy level on Base (Primary/Secondary/Tertiary/Muted), each Semantic state pair (Success/Warning/Error/Info), Focus ring (Primary on each Surface level Base/Raised-1/Raised-2/Raised-3/Inset), with a `target_ratio` field reflecting the spec value and a `computed_ratio` field from colorjs.io.

- (design) Tertiary text and Muted text entries are flagged in JSON as `usage: "large-text-only"` and `usage: "decorative-only"` respectively so downstream a11y CI does not false-flag them as SC 1.4.3 violations.
- (design) Halo State Pulse colors are NOT enumerated as contrast pairs in JSON output (signature-element-exempt per §Brand Identity); harness output is scoped to chrome contrast pairs only.

- (tests) Harness is invocable as a single command (e.g., `npm run verify:contrast` from `pulse-app/ui/` OR `cargo xtask verify-contrast` from workspace root) with deterministic exit code: 0 = all declared token pairs meet design-plan §Color Palette targets, non-zero = at least one pair below target. Agent reads exit code without parsing stdout.

- (tests) Harness emits JSON to a stable path on every run regardless of pass/fail, with one entry per declared token pair: `{ pair: "text-primary/base", computed_ratio: 14.46, target_ratio: 7.0, wcag_level: "AAA", pass: true }`. Schema is stable; schema-shape regression is a failure.
- (tests) Harness is hermetic — no network access, no random seed; same `tokens.css` + same target table → byte-identical JSON output cross-platform.

- (tests) If pure-function helper logic is extracted (e.g., a CSS-token parser), it has unit tests in `pulse-app/ui/src/**/*.test.ts` running under existing Vitest, with `npm run test` passing alongside the existing 57 Vitest tests + 36 cargo nextest tests.

- (tests) Harness output JSON is gitignored (build-time artifact, not committed); committed authority is `design-system.md` §Color Palette (target table) + chunk #10's `pulse-app/ui/dist/tokens.css` build pipeline (token values).

- (a11y) Contrast harness emits per-pair JSON for all 6 token pairs in a11y-plan §6 table; running the harness against `pulse-app/ui/dist/tokens.css` produces a JSON artifact with one record per pair, each with `wcag_criterion`, `actual_contrast_ratio`, `required_ratio`, and PASS/FAIL status.
- (a11y) All 6 pairs PASS at current `tokens.css` values; failure of any pair (actual ratio < required ratio) is a CI-blocking violation per a11y-plan §10 SLO.

- (a11y) Harness JSON conforms to a11y-plan §3 Structured Violation JSON Schema (required fields present; `tool: "colorjs.io"` for token-based records; `surface: "desktop-webview"`); validates against the schema fields listed in §3.
- (a11y) Algorithm under the hood is `colorjs.io` 0.6.x `Color.contrast(fg, bg, 'WCAG21')`; the harness imports `colorjs.io` rather than implementing a custom contrast formula.

- (arch) Contrast harness scripts and source live under `pulse-app/ui/` (in `pulse-app/ui/package.json` scripts and sibling `pulse-app/ui/scripts/` or `pulse-app/ui/src/contrast/`); no files added under `crates/`, no new directory at workspace root.
- (arch) `cargo metadata --format-version 1 | jq -r '.workspace_members'` returns the same 10 workspace members as before chunk #12 — no new Cargo crate introduced.
- (arch) Harness emits machine-parseable JSON output to a deterministic artifact path — verifiable via `node pulse-app/ui/scripts/<harness>.mjs && test -f <artifact>` (or `npm run contrast:check`).

- (arch) No new env var added beyond existing `ANDROMEDA_PULSE_*` reserved namespace; no new Tauri IPC procedure added to Occupied Resources Tauri IPC routes list; no new capability identifier added to the existing 5-capability set.
**Open questions to surface in plan.md:**

- **OQ1 (a11y + design):** Should chunk #11's manual contrast pre-flight values (text-primary/base 14.46:1, feedback-success/inset 7.20:1, border-focus/base 5.12:1) be retroactively encoded as JSON records in chunk #12's output schema? Both a11y and design extracts flag this; session-handoff explicitly defers to phase-9. Resolution likely YES (retroactive backfill establishes canonical schema is a superset of what's verified manually) but Phase 6 user review confirms.

- **OQ2 (tests + arch):** Single-runner (`npm run verify:contrast` from `pulse-app/ui/`) vs. dual-runner (also `cargo xtask verify-contrast` from workspace root)? Tests notes both as candidates; arch notes xtask integration is "OPTIONAL but preferred". Phase 4 plan to pick one; recommendation is single-runner at chunk #12 (npm script), defer xtask delegation to chunk #13 or later if cross-language workspace command is needed.

- **OQ3 (design):** Should the harness validate Focus ring contrast on each Surface scale level (Base/Raised-1/Raised-2/Raised-3/Inset = 5 pairs) OR only on Base? Design extract enumerates the 5-surface list as MUST; a11y extract enumerates a single `--border-focus / background` pair. Phase 4 plan to clarify — likely include all 5 surfaces, mark Raised-1..3 / Inset variants as informational rather than CI-blocking, with primary CI-block on `--border-focus / --color-base` pair.

data.head: # Phase 9 Plan — chunk route#12: "Contrast verification harness — design tokens + colorjs.io + per-pair JSON emission against design plan §Color Palette ratios"

body:
_Generated by /andromeda-phase Phase 4. Read by /andromeda-implement.
Manual edits between runs are fine; do not edit during /implement run._
- **Phase number:** 9

- **Route chunks covered:**
  - route#12 "Contrast verification harness — design tokens + colorjs.io + per-pair JSON emission against design plan §Color Palette ratios"
- **Epoch:** Foundation (epoch 1 of 8; 12 of 15 Foundation chunks after this lands)

Materialize the a11y-plan §3 Bootstrap phase `contrast-verification-harness-setup` as a deterministic, agent-driven Node.js / `colorjs.io` harness that reads design tokens from the chunk-#10 output `pulse-app/ui/dist/tokens.css`, computes WCAG 2.1 contrast ratios for every chrome token pair design-system.md §Color Palette enumerates, and emits machine-parseable JSON to `pulse-app/ui/dist/contrast-report.json` for downstream consumption by chunk #13's a11y dev stack and chunk #45's a11y CI gate. The harness exits 0 when every required pair meets its WCAG-derived target (SC 1.4.3 for text / SC 1.4.11 for non-text per a11y plan §3); exits non-zero on any failure with the offending pair recorded in JSON; runs hermetically (no network, no random seed) so identical inputs produce byte-identical output across Linux/macOS/Windows. The harness lives entirely within `pulse-app/ui/` (no Cargo crate addition, no env-var reservation, no IPC surface, no xtask delegation at this chunk per arch §Occupied Resources discipline + §Cross-cutting Patterns "parallel sibling gate" stance).

The chunk also resolves three open questions surfaced by extracts: (OQ1) chunk #11's manual pre-flight contrast values are recomputed by the harness from `tokens.css` and recorded in JSON — establishing the canonical schema as a superset of manual-verification surface; (OQ2) chunk #12 ships single-runner (`npm run verify:contrast` from `pulse-app/ui/`) — xtask delegation deferred to a future cross-language harness chunk; (OQ3) focus-ring contrast is enumerated against all 5 surface scale levels (Base / Raised-1..3 / Inset) with `border-focus/base` flagged as CI-blocking critical, the other 4 as informational. Provenance: combined.md §Per-chunk extracts + §Cross-domain binding reconciliation; research.md §Patterns detected + §Conventions to follow + §Open questions.

1. **Add `colorjs.io` 0.6.x to `pulse-app/ui/package.json` devDependencies** with explicit version pin (e.g., `"colorjs.io": "^0.6.0"` — matches the Rust workspace pattern of `tonic = "0.14"` per security extract constraint #1). Run `npm install` from `pulse-app/ui/` to populate `node_modules/` and refresh `package-lock.json`. Confirm the lockfile records a resolved `colorjs.io` version (committed alongside `package.json` per security extract constraint #2).
2. **Add `verify:contrast` script** to `pulse-app/ui/package.json` `scripts`: `"verify:contrast": "node scripts/verify-contrast.mjs"`. Single-runner per OQ2 resolution; xtask delegation deferred.

3. **Create `pulse-app/ui/src/contrast/parse-tokens.mjs`** — pure-function ESM helper that takes a CSS string (the contents of `pulse-app/ui/dist/tokens.css`) and returns a `Map<string, string>` of token name → uppercase-normalized hex value. Parser must handle the Tailwind v4.2.4-minified output shape (single line, `:root,:host{--token-name:#hex;...}` inside `@layer theme{}`). Case-insensitive on hex input; output normalized to uppercase. Pure / sync / no I/O — testable under Vitest.

4. **Create `pulse-app/ui/src/contrast/pairs.mjs`** — exported const array of pair-catalog entries. Each entry: `{ pair_name, fg_token, bg_token, target_ratio, wcag_criterion, wcag_level, usage, severity }`. Catalog includes:
   - **6 a11y-plan §6 required pairs** (CI-blocking severity `critical` unless explicitly informational):
     - `text-primary/base` → fg `--color-text-primary` × bg `--color-base` ≥ 4.5:1 (SC 1.4.3 AA, level "AA"); usage `"normal-text"`; severity `critical`.
     - `text-secondary/base` → fg `--color-text-secondary` × bg `--color-base` ≥ 3:1 (SC 1.4.3 large-text); usage `"large-text-only"`; severity `critical`.
     - `text-tertiary/base` → fg `--color-text-tertiary` × bg `--color-base` ≥ 3:1 (SC 1.4.3 large-text); usage `"large-text-only"`; severity `critical`.
     - `primary/base` (focus ring proxy) → fg `--color-primary` × bg `--color-base` ≥ 3:1 (SC 1.4.11); usage `"non-text"`; severity `critical`.
     - `feedback-success/inset` → fg `--color-feedback-success` × bg `--color-inset` ≥ 4.5:1 OR ≥ 3:1 non-text (SC 1.4.3 / SC 1.4.11); usage `"normal-text-or-non-text"`; severity `critical`.
     - `accent/base` → fg `--color-accent` × bg `--color-base` ≥ 4.5:1 OR ≥ 3:1 non-text (SC 1.4.3 / SC 1.4.11); usage `"normal-text-or-non-text"`; severity `critical`.
   - **Border-focus pair (a11y-plan §6 final bullet)**: `border-focus/base` → fg `--border-focus` × bg `--color-base` ≥ 3:1 (SC 1.4.11 + SC 2.4.7 binding); usage `"focus-ring"`; severity `critical`.
   - **OQ3 surface-scale focus-ring informational pairs**: `border-focus/raised-1`, `border-focus/raised-2`, `border-focus/raised-3`, `border-focus/inset` — each ≥ 3:1 (SC 1.4.11); usage `"focus-ring-on-surface-variant"`; severity `informational` (computed and recorded but not CI-blocking).
   - **Muted text informational pair (per design extract)**: `text-muted/base` → fg `--color-text-muted` × bg `--color-base` (target ratio recorded as informational; design-system marks it "decorative only" with ≈2.1:1 — harness emits with `usage: "decorative-only"` and `severity: "informational"` so downstream a11y CI does not false-flag).
5. **Create `pulse-app/ui/scripts/verify-contrast.mjs`** — Node.js entry point. Pseudocode:
Schema fields conform to a11y-plan §3 Structured Violation JSON Schema (security extract + a11y extract acceptance criteria).

6. **Create `pulse-app/ui/src/contrast/parse-tokens.test.ts`** — Vitest suite for the parser. Test cases (≥5):
   - Parse the actual `pulse-app/ui/dist/tokens.css` and assert presence of all 14 token names referenced in `pairs.mjs` (Map size + keys).
   - Lowercase hex input → uppercase Map values (Tailwind minifier emits `#4a90e2`; design-system spec uses `#4A90E2`).
   - Token-with-no-value (malformed input) → throws or returns Map without that key (decide and document).
   - Comment-stripped input (`/*! ... */` Tailwind banner) → ignores comments.
   - Multiple selectors (`:root,:host{--x:#hex}`) → parses both correctly (de-duplicated).

7. **Run `cd pulse-app/ui && npm install` then `npm run build` then `npm run verify:contrast`** to exercise the full pipeline locally; commit `package.json` + `package-lock.json` + new `pulse-app/ui/scripts/verify-contrast.mjs` + `pulse-app/ui/src/contrast/{parse-tokens,pairs}.mjs` + `pulse-app/ui/src/contrast/parse-tokens.test.ts`. Verify all critical pairs PASS at current `tokens.css` values; confirm `pulse-app/ui/dist/contrast-report.json` is `.gitignore`-covered (line 30 `dist/`).

8. **Run `npm run test`** to confirm parse-tokens unit tests pass alongside chunk #11's existing 57 Vitest tests (Icon.test.tsx + ancestors). New test count: 57 + N (where N is the parse-tokens test case count, ~5–8). `target/junit-ui.xml` re-emitted; cargo nextest count remains 36.

9. **Verify acceptance criteria** end-to-end (security/design/tests/a11y/arch — see Acceptance Criteria section). Commit with conventional-commit subject following predecessor pattern: `feat(foundation): contrast verification harness + colorjs.io + per-pair JSON (chunk #12)`.
- `pulse-app/ui/scripts/verify-contrast.mjs` — Node.js harness entry point; reads `dist/tokens.css`, emits `dist/contrast-report.json`, exits 0/non-zero.
- `pulse-app/ui/src/contrast/pairs.mjs` — token-pair catalog (6 required + 1 border-focus/base critical + 4 surface-scale informational + 1 muted informational = 12 records).
- `pulse-app/ui/src/contrast/parse-tokens.mjs` — pure-function CSS custom-property parser; testable.
- `pulse-app/ui/src/contrast/parse-tokens.test.ts` — Vitest tests for the parser (~5–8 cases).
- `pulse-app/ui/package.json` — add `colorjs.io: ^0.6.0` to `devDependencies`; add `verify:contrast: node scripts/verify-contrast.mjs` to `scripts`.
- `xtask/src/main.rs` — DO NOT add `verify-contrast` xtask subcommand at chunk #12 (OQ2 resolution; defer cross-language shell-out precedent).
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` — DO NOT wire the harness into CI at chunk #12; chunk #13 a11y dev stack stack install or chunk #45 a11y CI gate handles wiring.
- `pulse-app/src/observability.rs` and `crates/*/src/` — DO NOT instrument the harness via `tracing`; build-time tooling is not runtime telemetry per obs-plan §1.
- `pulse-app/capabilities/` — DO NOT add a TauRPC capability; harness has no IPC surface per arch extract anti-pattern.
- `pulse-app/ui/src/styles/tokens.css` — DO NOT modify the Tailwind input; harness reads built `dist/tokens.css` per a11y-plan §3 "Source-of-truth tokens".

- `.andromeda/context/dependency-tree.md` and `.andromeda/context/api-surface.md` — DO NOT modify; chunk #12 produces no Rust source change, so living artifacts need no refresh per arch extract pattern.
Per tests-plan §3 5-command discipline + chunk-specific tests. Tests must pass for /andromeda-implement to exit Phase 2 fix loop with success.

cd pulse-app/ui && npm run test
# Expected: existing chunk-#11 tests + new parse-tokens tests; total 57 + N (where N is parse-tokens test case count)

cd pulse-app/ui && npm run build
# Expected: dist/tokens.css emitted (chunk #10/11 baseline); dist/index.html + dist/assets/ from Vite

- **OQ1 backfill mechanism:** chunk #11 contributed three manual contrast values in session-handoff (text-primary/base 14.46:1, feedback-success/inset 7.20:1, border-focus/base 5.12:1). The harness recomputes these from `tokens.css` via `colorjs.io`; no transcription. The recorded `actual_contrast_ratio` may differ from the manual values by ±0.01 due to floating-point precision differences between manual calc and `colorjs.io`'s WCAG21 algorithm — both are spec-conformant; the harness value is canonical going forward.

- **OQ2 / xtask deferral:** when chunk #45 (a11y CI gate) wires the harness into CI, evaluate whether to add `cargo xtask verify-contrast` as a thin shell-out or wire `npm run verify:contrast` directly into `ci.yml`. Both are valid; current xtask pattern is cargo-only, so direct npm in CI may be cleaner. Decision deferred to chunk #45 plan.

- **OQ3 surface-scale enumeration rationale:** focus rings can appear on any elevated surface (cards on `--color-raised-1`, dropdowns on `--color-raised-2`, modals on `--color-raised-3`); a strict "only validate against base" stance under-specifies. But making all 5 CI-blocking would block legitimate UI patterns where the focus ring still meets ≥3:1 against the dominant background even if the variant fails. Compromise: emit all 5 records, gate only on the `border-focus/base` baseline; designers can review the informational records to catch latent issues without CI churn.

- **Tailwind hex case round-trip:** input `tokens.css` has uppercase hex (`#4A90E2`); minified output has lowercase (`#4a90e2`). `colorjs.io` is case-insensitive natively, so no normalization needed for ratio computation; the parser normalizes to uppercase for predictable JSON output and stable `tool_result_id` strings.

- **Vitest test count delta:** N≈5–8 new tests is a guideline; actual count emerges during implementation. Aim for one test per parse-tokens edge case + one integration test that parses the actual `dist/tokens.css` and asserts presence of the 14 token names. CI count baseline updates accordingly when next session-handoff is written.

- **No Rust source change:** living artifacts (`dependency-tree.md` / `api-surface.md`) need no refresh per arch extract pattern; wrap-session Phase 5 reconcile will produce byte-identical LIVING blocks.

- **OQ1 (a11y + design):** Should chunk #11's manual contrast pre-flight values (text-primary/base 14.46:1, feedback-success/inset 7.20:1, border-focus/base 5.12:1) be retroactively encoded as JSON records in chunk #12's output schema? Both a11y and design extracts flag this; session-handoff explicitly defers to phase-9. **Recommendation:** YES — including these pairs in the harness output establishes the canonical schema as a superset of what's verified manually, and the values are auto-computed by `colorjs.io` from the tokens (no manual transcription). The 14.46/7.20/5.12 numbers in session-handoff are illustrative; the harness recomputes them from `tokens.css`.

- **OQ2 (tests + arch):** Single-runner (`npm run verify:contrast` from `pulse-app/ui/`) vs. dual-runner (also `cargo xtask verify-contrast` from workspace root)? **Recommendation:** Single npm runner at chunk #12; xtask delegation deferred. - **OQ3 (design):** Should the harness validate Focus ring contrast on each Surface scale level (Base / Raised-1 / Raised-2 / Raised-3 / Inset = 5 pairs) OR only on Base? _Generated by /andromeda-phase Phase 4. Read by /andromeda-implement.
Manual edits between runs are fine; do not edit during /implement run._
- **Phase number:** 90

- **Route chunks covered:**
  - route#93 "ConstellationCanvas dashboard cascade"
- **Epoch:** Epoch 9 — Foundation v0.2.0 (terminal chunk of the 93-chunk route)

Complete the deferred dashboard-side half of the v0.2.0 Halo/constellation
cascade. Chunks #90/#91 migrated the WIDGET surface (and the header
`HaloCanvas`) to the per-service severity/activity API — hue = cumulative
incident severity, brightness = lifecycle activity, seeded-scatter position —
but left the full-window dashboard `ConstellationCanvas` on the legacy
error-rate/throughput single-blob model, plus a pile of now-dead plumbing.
This chunk migrates the dashboard `ConstellationCanvas` to mirror the widget
(reuse `widget/constellation-types.ts` + `widget/constellation-pipeline.ts`,
fed by `useServiceConstellation`), then removes every module the migration
orphans: the legacy `error-rate-to-blur` / `throughput-to-hz` helpers, the
orphaned `use-widget-metrics` hook, the now-orphaned `use-constellation-data`
aggregate, and the fully-dead synthetic `HaloInput` chain
(`use-synthetic-halo-input` → `HaloInputProvider` → `useHaloInput`, which has
zero call sites). It is webview-only (TypeScript / React / WGSL), consumer-side
IPC only (reuses `services.list_with_states`, chunk #67), with zero arch-registry
delta — per arch §Occupied Resources (no new TauRPC / capability / broadcast),
design-system.md §Motion Decisions Log 2026-05-29 (severity-driven Halo, legacy
mapping superseded), a11y-plan §6/§11 (SC 2.3.3 reduced-motion + SC 1.4.1
not-color-alone), and obs-plan §1/§10 (the `metric.webgpu.frame_duration_ms`
bridge is preserved). Two scope decisions were resolved with the user at Phase 3:
"retype HaloInput" → **delete the dead chain**; orphan cleanup → **delete
everything orphaned** (incl. `use-constellation-data`).

**NOTE — `HaloCanvas.tsx` is intentionally NOT touched:** it was already
migrated by chunk #90 (it consumes `cumulativeSeverity`/`activityState`/
`connectionState` via `severity-to-halo`). The route §2 phrase "migrate …
HaloCanvas" is imprecise; the §91 source spec scopes the work to
`pulse-app/ui/dashboard/ConstellationCanvas.tsx` only.

Suggested order keeps the deletions safe (migrate the consumers first so the
legacy modules become unreferenced before removal):

1. **Migrate the dashboard `ConstellationCanvas.tsx`** to mirror the widget
   (`pulse-app/ui/src/widget/ConstellationCanvas.tsx`):
   - Change the prop from `services: readonly ServiceAggregate[]` to
     `items: readonly ServiceListItem[]` (import `ServiceListItem` from
     `../../../bindings/index`).
   - Replace the `createHaloPipeline` + `errorRateToBlur` + `throughputToHz` +
     `lchInterpolate(service.errorRate, …)` render path with the per-dot path:
     `visibleDots(items)` + `constellationSummary(items)` from
     `../../../widget/constellation-types`, `createConstellationPipeline` from
     `../../../widget/constellation-pipeline`, and `writeUniformsForDot` using
     `lchInterpolate(dot.hueFraction, primaryHex, accentHex)` + `dot.x`/`dot.y` +
     `dot.brightness * envelope` (breathing `0.6 + 0.4*(0.5+0.5*sin)` per the
     widget).
   - Keep the existing dashboard container chrome: fixed `height: "240px"` hero,
     `background: var(--color-inset)`, `border: 1px solid rgba(74, 144, 226, 0.3)`,
     `borderRadius: var(--radius-md)`, `padding: var(--spacing-md)`,
     `data-testid="constellation-canvas"`, `Fallback`, and the `recordFrameMs`
     frame-metrics bridge (both `onFrame` and `onReducedMotionFrame`).
   - Switch the wrapper accessible name from the static
     `aria-label="Service constellation"` to the dynamic
     `aria-label={constellationSummary(items)}` (the not-color-alone text
     equivalent). Do NOT add explicit `role="region"` (redundant on
     `<section aria-label>`).
   - Preserve `readDesignToken` CSSOM reads + inlined `UNIFORM_BUFFER_USAGE`.

2. **Switch `TracesRoute.tsx`** from `useConstellationData(rows)` to
   `useServiceConstellation()`: `const items = useServiceConstellation();` and
   render `<ConstellationCanvas items={items} />`. Keep `useTraces` / `rows` for
   `<TraceTable>` (unchanged).

3. **Delete the dead `HaloInput` synthetic chain** + rewire its two consumers:
   - `App.tsx`: drop the `useSyntheticHaloInput` import + `const haloInput`;
     render `<Dashboard />` (no prop).
   - `Dashboard.tsx`: drop `DashboardProps.haloInput`, the `HaloInput` import,
     and the `HaloInputProvider` wrapper; render `InvestigationProvider` →
     `RouterProvider` + `DashboardInvestigationModal` directly.
   - Delete `pulse-app/ui/src/hooks/use-synthetic-halo-input.ts` (+ `.test.ts`)
     and `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/halo-input-context.tsx`.
   - Remove the `HaloInput` interface from `pulse-app/ui/src/halo/halo-types.ts`
     (keep `MotionMode` + `ActivityState`).

4. **Delete the orphaned legacy modules** (now unreferenced after steps 1–2):
   - `pulse-app/ui/src/halo/error-rate-to-blur.ts` (+ `.test.ts`)
   - `pulse-app/ui/src/halo/throughput-to-hz.ts` (+ `.test.ts`)
   - `pulse-app/ui/src/hooks/use-widget-metrics.ts` (+ `.test.ts`)
   - `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/routes/traces/use-constellation-data.ts` (+ `.test.ts`)

5. **Update the affected tests:**
   - Rewrite `dashboard/routes/traces/ConstellationCanvas.test.tsx` — fixtures
     from `ServiceAggregate[]` → `ServiceListItem[]`; assert the new prop shape,
     the accessible summary, the WebGPU fallback, the reduced-motion static-glow
     path, and the `recordFrameMs` bridge. Mirror
     `pulse-app/ui/src/widget/ConstellationCanvas.test.tsx`.
   - `App.test.tsx` — remove the `useSyntheticHaloInput` mock + the "forwards
     HaloInput to <Dashboard>" test; adjust the `<Dashboard>` render expectation.
   - `dashboard/router.test.tsx` — remove the `HaloInputProvider` wrapper.

6. **Run the full standard gate set** (see Test Commands). Resolve any
   tsc/lint/vitest fallout from the deletions (dangling imports surface as
   TS2307 / lint no-unused). Regenerate `bindings/index.ts` to the canonical
   mcp-server-feature shape before `cargo xtask capability-drift` if any
   default-features cargo run overwrote it (per testing.md 2026-05-17).

- (none) — migration + deletion cascade; the widget's `constellation-types.ts`
  + `constellation-pipeline.ts` are reused cross-surface, not duplicated.
- `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/routes/traces/ConstellationCanvas.tsx` — rewrite to the per-service `ServiceListItem` / `visibleDots` model (preserve 240px container + Fallback + recordFrameMs).
- `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/routes/traces/ConstellationCanvas.test.tsx` — `ServiceListItem` fixtures; new assertions.
- `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/routes/TracesRoute.tsx` — `useServiceConstellation()` + `items` prop.
- `pulse-app/ui/src/App.tsx` — drop synthetic halo input; `<Dashboard />`.
- `pulse-app/ui/src/App.test.tsx` — drop synthetic-halo mock + test.
- `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/Dashboard.tsx` — drop `haloInput` prop + `HaloInputProvider`.
- `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/router.test.tsx` — drop `HaloInputProvider` wrapper.

- `pulse-app/ui/src/halo/error-rate-to-blur.ts` + `error-rate-to-blur.test.ts`
- `pulse-app/ui/src/halo/throughput-to-hz.ts` + `throughput-to-hz.test.ts`
- `pulse-app/ui/src/hooks/use-widget-metrics.ts` + `use-widget-metrics.test.ts`
- `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/routes/traces/use-constellation-data.ts` + `use-constellation-data.test.ts`
- `pulse-app/ui/src/hooks/use-synthetic-halo-input.ts` + `use-synthetic-halo-input.test.ts`
- `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/halo-input-context.tsx`
- `pulse-app/ui/src/halo/HaloCanvas.tsx` — already on the new API (chunk #90); not in §91 scope.
- `pulse-app/ui/src/widget/ConstellationCanvas.tsx` / `constellation-types.ts` / `constellation-pipeline.ts` — the reused reference machinery; consumed, not changed.
- `pulse-app/ui/src/halo/activity-state.ts` — pure fn; only a stale comment references the deleted `use-widget-metrics` (cosmetic, out of scope — see research.md Open questions).

body: _Generated by /andromeda-phase Phase 3 from targeted reads informed by combined.md._

- `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/routes/traces/ConstellationCanvas.tsx` (full) — THE migration target. Takes `services: readonly ServiceAggregate[]`; imports `errorRateToBlur` (line 15) + `throughputToHz` (line 16); uses `createHaloPipeline` + `lchInterpolate(service.errorRate, …)` + `errorRateToBlur(service.errorRate)` (line 103) + `throughputToHz(service.throughputHz)` (line 138). Per-service draw via the single-blob halo pipeline (services overlap at origin — no scatter positions). 240px fixed hero height; `<section aria-label="Service constellation" data-testid="constellation-canvas">` wrapper; `Fallback` + `recordFrameMs` bridge already present. This is the pre-#91 error-rate/throughput model.

- `pulse-app/ui/src/widget/ConstellationCanvas.tsx` (full) — THE migrated reference (chunk #91). Takes `items: readonly ServiceListItem[]`; uses `visibleDots(items)` + `constellationSummary(items)` (`./constellation-types`) + `createConstellationPipeline` (`./constellation-pipeline`); per-dot `writeUniformsForDot` with `lchInterpolate(dot.hueFraction, …)` + `dot.x`/`dot.y` (scatter) + `dot.brightness * envelope`. Shared breathing envelope `0.6 + 0.4*sin`. `<section aria-label={summary} data-testid="service-constellation">`; `Fallback` + `recordFrameMs`. The dashboard migration mirrors this at 240px scale.

- `pulse-app/ui/src/halo/HaloCanvas.tsx` (full) — ALREADY migrated (chunk #90). Takes `HaloCanvasProps { ariaLabel, connectionState, cumulativeSeverity: PriorityTier|null, activityState }`; uses `severity-to-halo` helpers (`severityToHueFraction`, `severityToBlurPx`, `activityStateToBreathingPeriodMs`, `connectionStateToDim`); reduced-motion via `restartLoopRef` secondary effect. **Needs NO change** — the route §2 "migrate … HaloCanvas" phrasing is imprecise; §91 source touches only the dashboard ConstellationCanvas.

- `pulse-app/ui/src/halo/halo-types.ts` (full) — exports `HaloInput { throughputHz; errorRate }` (legacy), `MotionMode`, `ActivityState`. `HaloInput` is the dead-chain type to delete; `ActivityState` stays (used by HaloCanvas + activity-state.ts); `MotionMode` left as-is (not in scope).

- `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/routes/traces/use-constellation-data.ts` (full) — `ServiceAggregate { serviceName, throughputHz, errorRate, position }` + `useConstellationData` + `aggregateByService` (derives from `TraceRow[]`, radial layout). Consumed ONLY by TracesRoute + the dashboard ConstellationCanvas + its own test → orphaned once TracesRoute switches to `useServiceConstellation`.

- `pulse-app/ui/src/widget/constellation-types.ts` (full) — the shared per-service dot model: `ConstellationDot`, `visibleDots(items)` (filter archived, sort, cap 20, map to hue=severity + brightness=lifecycle + scatter), `constellationSummary(items)` (accessible sentence: count + per-state + findings), `scatterPosition` (FNV-1a hash), `lifecycleToBrightness`, `severityToHueFraction` import. Reused verbatim by the dashboard migration.

- `pulse-app/ui/src/hooks/use-service-constellation.ts` (full) — `useServiceConstellation(): ServiceListItem[]` polls `services.list_with_states()` (1s + focus), `.catch(()=>{})` jsdom-silent. The dashboard's new data source (reused as-is; no new IPC).

- `pulse-app/ui/src/hooks/use-widget-metrics.ts` (full) — `useWidgetMetrics()` subscribes `streams.subscribe_metrics`; produces `{throughputHz, errorRate=0, serviceCount=0, retention…}`. **Orphaned** — the only importer is its own `.test.ts`; other grep hits (`activity-state.ts`, `use-connection-state.ts`, `use-findings.ts`, `use-service-constellation.ts`) are COMMENT references. Delete.
- `pulse-app/ui/src/hooks/use-synthetic-halo-input.ts` (full) — `useSyntheticHaloInput(): HaloInput` synthetic `{throughputHz, errorRate}` simulator (250ms). Feeds the dead chain. Delete.

- `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/halo-input-context.tsx` (full) — `HaloInputProvider` + `useHaloInput()`. **`useHaloInput()` has ZERO call sites** (the only `useHaloInput` reference is its own definition) → the whole context is dead. Delete.

- `pulse-app/ui/src/App.tsx` (full) — `const haloInput = useSyntheticHaloInput()` (line 18) → `<Dashboard haloInput={haloInput} />` (line 27). Modify: drop the import + variable + prop; render `<Dashboard />`.

- `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/Dashboard.tsx` (full) — `DashboardProps { haloInput: HaloInput }`; wraps the router tree in `<HaloInputProvider value={haloInput}>` (line 29). Modify: drop the prop + HaloInput import + HaloInputProvider; keep `InvestigationProvider` + `RouterProvider` + `DashboardInvestigationModal`.

- `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/routes/TracesRoute.tsx` (full) — renders `<ConstellationCanvas services={services} />` (line 66) where `services = useConstellationData(rows, …)` (line 25). Modify: switch to `const items = useServiceConstellation();` + `<ConstellationCanvas items={items} />`; keep `useTraces`/`rows` for `<TraceTable>`.

- `pulse-app/ui/src/halo/activity-state.ts` (full) — `throughputToActivityState`; references `use-widget-metrics` only in a comment (line 5). Deleting use-widget-metrics does NOT break it (pure fn over a number arg). Left untouched.

- `pulse-app/ui/src/widget/CompactWidget.tsx` (full) — confirms the widget surface uses `useServiceConstellation()` + the widget ConstellationCanvas; does NOT import `useWidgetMetrics` (corroborates orphan status).

- **Mirror-the-widget migration** (`pulse-app/ui/src/widget/ConstellationCanvas.tsx`): the dashboard ConstellationCanvas should become a near-copy of the widget one — same `visibleDots`/`constellationSummary`/`createConstellationPipeline` machinery, differing only in the fixed 240px hero height (vs `100%`) and `data-testid`. The shared `widget/constellation-types.ts` + `widget/constellation-pipeline.ts` are reused verbatim across both surfaces (three-surface coherence).

- **CSSOM token-read + lchInterpolate** (`HaloCanvas.tsx:64–68,127–128` + both ConstellationCanvas files): `readDesignToken("--color-primary","#4A90E2")` / `("--color-accent","#C7556A")` at pipeline init → `lchInterpolate(hueFraction, primaryHex, accentHex)`. No hardcoded hex in shaders.

- **Frame-metrics bridge** (`canvas/frame-metrics` → `recordFrameMs`, both ConstellationCanvas files): `onFrame` times `performance.now()` + `device.queue.onSubmittedWorkDone()`; `onReducedMotionFrame` records `duration_ms: 0`. The migration preserves this verbatim.

- **Reduced-motion via createFrameLoop** (`canvas/frame-loop`): `prefersReducedMotion` + `onReducedMotionFrame` render one static frame (full envelope) — severity/brightness still encode state. Widget pattern; dashboard mirrors.

- **jsdom-silent TauRPC hooks** (`use-service-constellation.ts`, `use-widget-metrics.ts`): `.catch(()=>{})` on every proxy call; the dashboard inherits this for free by reusing `useServiceConstellation`.

- **`<section aria-label={…}>` implicit region** (a11y rules 2026-05-09): the wrapper uses `aria-label` WITHOUT explicit `role="region"` (redundant-role lint); the dashboard switches its static `aria-label="Service constellation"` to the dynamic `constellationSummary(items)` sentence for the not-color-alone text equivalent.

- **Webview tests:** co-located `*.test.tsx` (vitest 3 + @testing-library/react 16), DOM-shape assertions only; mirror `pulse-app/ui/src/widget/ConstellationCanvas.test.tsx` for the rewritten dashboard test (per `.claude/rules/testing.md` §Framework webview).

- **Bindings import discipline:** import `ServiceListItem` / `PriorityTier` / `ServiceLifecycleState` from `../../../bindings/index` (dashboard depth) — never re-declare (per `.claude/rules/frontend.md` TauRPC integration).
- **No `role="region"` on `<section aria-label>`** (per `.claude/rules/a11y.md` 2026-05-09 redundant-roles).
- **Delete co-located tests with their source** (per testing.md §File placement): every deleted `*.ts` drops its `*.test.ts` in the same change.
- (none) — this chunk is a migration + deletion cascade; no new modules. The widget's `constellation-types.ts` / `constellation-pipeline.ts` are reused, not duplicated.

- `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/routes/traces/ConstellationCanvas.tsx` — rewrite to take `items: readonly ServiceListItem[]`, mirror the widget per-dot render (visibleDots/constellationSummary/createConstellationPipeline), keep 240px hero container + `data-testid="constellation-canvas"` + Fallback + recordFrameMs; drop the `errorRateToBlur`/`throughputToHz`/`createHaloPipeline`/`ServiceAggregate` imports.

- `pulse-app/ui/src/App.tsx` — remove `useSyntheticHaloInput` import + `haloInput`; render `<Dashboard />`.
- `pulse-app/ui/src/App.test.tsx` — remove the `useSyntheticHaloInput` mock (lines 10–11) + the "forwards HaloInput to <Dashboard>" test (line 61); adjust the Dashboard render assertion.
- `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/Dashboard.tsx` — remove `HaloInputProvider` + `haloInput` prop + `HaloInput` import; render `InvestigationProvider`/`RouterProvider` directly.
- `pulse-app/ui/src/dashboard/router.test.tsx` — remove the `HaloInputProvider` wrapper (lines 10, 43–47).
